<file path="libs/client/admins/contexts/src/lib/AdminsAuthContext.tsx">
import { useMutation, useQuery } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { LOGOUT_MUTATION, ME_QUERY } from '@kickzone-workspace/admins-graphql';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import {
  createContext,
  ReactNode,
  useContext,
  useState,
  useEffect,
} from 'react';
type AdminUser = Pick<
  KickzoneGraphqlTypes.User,
  'id' | 'name' | 'email' | 'role'
>;
interface AuthContextType {
  admin: AdminUser | null;
  setAdmin: (user: AdminUser | null) => void;
  logoutAdmin: () => void;
}
const AdminsAuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);
export const AdminsAuthProvider = ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => {
  const [admin, setAdmin] = useState<AdminUser | null>(() => {
    const savedUser = localStorage.getItem('admin_user');
    return savedUser ? JSON.parse(savedUser) : null;
  });
  // Server `me` silently refreshes expired access tokens via refresh cookie
  const { loading, data, error } = useQuery<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'me'>
  >(ME_QUERY, {
    fetchPolicy: 'network-only',
  });
  const [logoutMutation] =
    useMutation<Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'logout'>>(LOGOUT_MUTATION);
  // Handle data changes - only for ADMIN role users
  useEffect(() => {
    if (data?.me && data.me.role === KickzoneGraphqlTypes.UserRole.Admin) {
      setAdmin(data.me);
      localStorage.setItem('admin_user', JSON.stringify(data.me));
    } else if (
      error ||
      data?.me === null ||
      (data?.me && data.me.role !== KickzoneGraphqlTypes.UserRole.Admin)
    ) {
      setAdmin(null);
      localStorage.removeItem('admin_user');
    }
  }, [data, error]);
  const logoutAdmin = async () => {
    try {
      await logoutMutation();
      setAdmin(null);
      localStorage.removeItem('admin_user');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Logout error:', error);
    }
  };
  if (loading) return <div>Loading...</div>;
  return (
    <AdminsAuthContext.Provider value={{ admin, setAdmin, logoutAdmin }}>
      {children}
    </AdminsAuthContext.Provider>
  );
};
export const useAdminsAuthContext = () => {
  const context = useContext(AdminsAuthContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAdminsAuth must be used within an AdminsAuthProvider');
  }
  return context;
};
</file>

<file path="libs/client/admins/graphql/src/lib/AdminsApolloProvider.tsx">
import React from 'react';
import { ApolloProviderBase } from '@kickzone-workspace/apollo-provider-base';
import { createAdminsApolloClient } from './client';
import { useCallback } from 'react';
import { ADMIN_ROUTES } from '@kickzone-workspace/admins-routes';
interface AdminsApolloProviderProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}
export const AdminsApolloProvider: React.FC<AdminsApolloProviderProps> = ({
  children,
}) => {
  const handleAuthError = useCallback(() => {
    console.log('Authentication error in Admins, redirecting to login...');
    // Clear only admin authentication data
    localStorage.removeItem('admin_user');
    // Redirect to login page using window.location
    window.location.href = ADMIN_ROUTES.LOGIN;
  }, []);
  const apolloClient = React.useMemo(
    () => createAdminsApolloClient(handleAuthError),
    [handleAuthError]
  );
  return (
    <ApolloProviderBase client={apolloClient}>{children}</ApolloProviderBase>
  );
};

<file path="libs/client/admins/graphql/src/lib/client.ts">
import {
  ApolloClient,
  InMemoryCache,
  ApolloLink,
} from '@apollo/client';
import { relayStylePagination } from '@apollo/client/utilities';
import { createSilentRefreshAuthLink } from '@kickzone-workspace/apollo-provider-base';
import UploadHttpLink from 'apollo-upload-client/UploadHttpLink.mjs';
const csrfLink = new ApolloLink((operation, forward) => {
  // Get current locale from localStorage (used by LanguageContext)
  const currentLocale =
    typeof window !== 'undefined'
      ? localStorage.getItem('kickzone-language-preference') || 'en'
      : 'en';
  operation.setContext(({ headers = {} }) => ({
    headers: {
      ...headers,
      'apollo-require-preflight': 'true',
      'x-locale': currentLocale,
    },
  }));
  return forward(operation);
});
// Get GraphQL endpoint:
// - Local + production both prefer relative /graphql (Vite proxy locally, nginx in prod)
// - Absolute VITE_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT wins when explicitly set
const getGraphQLEndpoint = () => {
  type ViteEnv = { VITE_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT?: string };
  const viteEnv =
    (import.meta as unknown as { env?: ViteEnv }).env || ({} as ViteEnv);
  const fromEnv = viteEnv.VITE_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT;
  if (fromEnv) {
    return fromEnv;
  }
  return '/graphql';
};
const graphqlUri = getGraphQLEndpoint();
const httpLink = new UploadHttpLink({
  uri: graphqlUri,
  credentials: 'include',
}) as unknown as ApolloLink;
export const createAdminsApolloClient = (onAuthError: () => void) => {
  const authErrorLink = createSilentRefreshAuthLink({
    graphqlUri,
    onAuthError,
  });
  return new ApolloClient({
    link: ApolloLink.from([csrfLink, authErrorLink, httpLink]),
    cache: new InMemoryCache({
      typePolicies: {
        Query: {
          fields: {
            products: relayStylePagination(['filter']),
            sellers: relayStylePagination(['filter']),
          },
        },
        Translation: {
          // Disable normalization for Translation objects since they have duplicate id=0
          keyFields: false,
        },
      },
    }),
    defaultOptions: {
      watchQuery: {
        errorPolicy: 'all',
      },
      query: {
        errorPolicy: 'all',
      },
      mutate: {
        fetchPolicy: 'no-cache',
        errorPolicy: 'all',
      },
    },
  });
};
// Default client for backward compatibility (without error handling)
const apolloClient = new ApolloClient({
  link: ApolloLink.from([csrfLink, httpLink]),
  cache: new InMemoryCache({
    typePolicies: {
      Query: {
        fields: {
          products: relayStylePagination(['filter']),
          sellers: relayStylePagination(['filter']),
        },
      },
      Translation: {
        // Disable normalization for Translation objects since they have duplicate id=0
        keyFields: false,
      },
    },
  }),
  defaultOptions: {
    watchQuery: {
      errorPolicy: 'all',
    },
    query: {
      errorPolicy: 'all',
    },
    mutate: {
      fetchPolicy: 'no-cache',
      errorPolicy: 'all',
    },
  },
});
export default apolloClient;
</file>

import {

    expect(typeof SELLER_INFO_FRAGMENT).toBe('object');

    expect(ADMIN_SELLER_PRODUCT_FRAGMENT).toBeDefined();

  });

    expect(ADMIN_PRODUCT_FRAGMENT).toBeDefined();
    expect(typeof ADMIN_PRODUCT_FRAGMENT).toBe('object');
  });
  it('should export ADMIN_PRODUCT_MANAGEMENT_FRAGMENT', () => {

    expect(typeof ADMIN_PRODUCT_MANAGEMENT_FRAGMENT).toBe('object');
  });

    expect(fragmentString).toContain('fragment SellerInfoFields on SellerInfo');
    expect(fragmentString).toContain('id');

import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
import { render } from '@testing-library/react';
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
import { AdminsGraphQLProvider } from './Provider';
import { AdminsApolloProvider } from './AdminsApolloProvider';
// Mock AdminsApolloProvider
vi.mock('./AdminsApolloProvider', () => ({
  AdminsApolloProvider: vi.fn(({ children }) => (
    <div data-testid="admins-apollo-provider">{children}</div>
  )),
}));
describe('AdminsGraphQLProvider', () => {
  it('should render children', () => {
    const { getByText } = render(
      <AdminsGraphQLProvider>
        <div>Test Child</div>
      </AdminsGraphQLProvider>
    );
    expect(getByText('Test Child')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should render AdminsApolloProvider', () => {
    const { getByTestId } = render(
      <AdminsGraphQLProvider>
        <div>Test Child</div>
      </AdminsGraphQLProvider>
    );
    expect(getByTestId('admins-apollo-provider')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should pass children to AdminsApolloProvider', () => {
    render(
      <AdminsGraphQLProvider>
        <div>Test Child</div>
      </AdminsGraphQLProvider>
    );
    expect(vi.mocked(AdminsApolloProvider)).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({
        children: expect.any(Object),
      }),
      undefined
    );
  });
  it('should handle multiple children', () => {
    const { getByText } = render(
      <AdminsGraphQLProvider>
        <div>Child 1</div>
        <div>Child 2</div>
        <span>Child 3</span>
      </AdminsGraphQLProvider>
    );
    expect(getByText('Child 1')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(getByText('Child 2')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(getByText('Child 3')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should handle empty children', () => {
    const { container } = render(
      <AdminsGraphQLProvider>{null}</AdminsGraphQLProvider>
    );
    expect(container.firstChild).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(vi.mocked(AdminsApolloProvider)).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('should handle undefined children', () => {
    const { container } = render(
      <AdminsGraphQLProvider>{undefined}</AdminsGraphQLProvider>
    );
    expect(container.firstChild).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(vi.mocked(AdminsApolloProvider)).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

        cursor
        node {
          ...AdminProductFields
        }
      }
      pageInfo {
        endCursor
        hasNextPage

    }

    }

      edges {
        node {
          ...AdminProductManagementFields
        }
      }
    }

<file path="libs/client/admins/hooks/auth/src/lib/useAdminLogin.spec.ts">
import { vi, describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react';
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
import { useAdminLogin } from './useAdminLogin';
// Mock dependencies
const mockSetAdmin = vi.fn();
const mockNavigate = vi.fn();
const mockLogin = vi.fn();
const mockLogoutAdmin = vi.fn();
// Mock Apollo Client
vi.mock('@apollo/client/react', () => ({
  useMutation: vi.fn((mutation) => {
    if (mutation === 'LOGIN_MUTATION') {
      return [
        mockLogin,
        {
          loading: false,
          error: null,
        },
      ];
    }
    if (mutation === 'LOGOUT_MUTATION') {
      return [mockLogoutAdmin];
    }
    return [vi.fn(), { loading: false, error: null }];
  }),
}));
// Mock contexts
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/admins-contexts', () => ({
  useAdminsAuthContext: () => ({
    setAdmin: mockSetAdmin,
  }),
}));
// Mock React Router
vi.mock('react-router-dom', () => ({
  useNavigate: () => mockNavigate,
}));
// Mock GraphQL mutations
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/admins-graphql', () => ({
  LOGIN_MUTATION: 'LOGIN_MUTATION',
  LOGOUT_MUTATION: 'LOGOUT_MUTATION',
}));
// Mock localStorage
const mockLocalStorage = {
  setItem: vi.fn(),
  getItem: vi.fn(),
  removeItem: vi.fn(),
  clear: vi.fn(),
};
Object.defineProperty(window, 'localStorage', {
  value: mockLocalStorage,
});
describe('useAdminLogin', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
  });
  it('should return login function and loading state', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useAdminLogin());
    expect(result.current.loginAdmin).toBeDefined();
    expect(result.current.adminsLoginLoading).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.adminsLoginError).toBe(null);
    expect(result.current.logoutAdmin).toBeDefined();
  });
  it('should call login mutation with correct variables', async () => {
    const mockUser = {
      id: 1,
      name: 'Admin',
      email: 'admin@test.com',
      role: 'ADMIN',
    };
    mockLogin.mockResolvedValue({
      data: { login: mockUser },
    });
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useAdminLogin());
    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.loginAdmin({
        email: 'admin@test.com',
        password: 'password123',
      });
    });
    expect(mockLogin).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      variables: {
        email: 'admin@test.com',
        password: 'password123',
      },
    });
  });
  it('should set admin and navigate on successful login', async () => {
    const mockUser = {
      id: 1,
      name: 'Admin',
      email: 'admin@test.com',
      role: 'ADMIN',
    };
    mockLogin.mockResolvedValue({
      data: { login: mockUser },
    });
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useAdminLogin());
    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.loginAdmin({
        email: 'admin@test.com',
        password: 'password123',
      });
    });
    expect(mockSetAdmin).toHaveBeenCalledWith(mockUser);
    expect(mockLocalStorage.setItem).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'admin_user',
      JSON.stringify(mockUser)
    );
    expect(mockNavigate).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/products');
  });
  it('should handle login error gracefully', async () => {
    const consoleSpy = vi
      .spyOn(console, 'error')
      .mockImplementation(() => undefined);
    const loginError = new Error('Login failed');
    mockLogin.mockRejectedValue(loginError);
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useAdminLogin());
    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.loginAdmin({
        email: 'admin@test.com',
        password: 'wrongpassword',
      });
    });
    expect(consoleSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Login failed:', loginError);
    expect(mockSetAdmin).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockNavigate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    consoleSpy.mockRestore();
  });
  it('should not set admin or navigate when login data is missing', async () => {
    mockLogin.mockResolvedValue({
      data: null,
    });
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useAdminLogin());
    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.loginAdmin({
        email: 'admin@test.com',
        password: 'password123',
      });
    });
    expect(mockSetAdmin).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockNavigate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('should not set admin or navigate when login user is missing', async () => {
    mockLogin.mockResolvedValue({
      data: { login: null },
    });
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useAdminLogin());
    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.loginAdmin({
        email: 'admin@test.com',
        password: 'password123',
      });
    });
    expect(mockSetAdmin).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockNavigate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/admins/hooks/auth/src/lib/useAdminLogin.ts">
import { useMutation } from '@apollo/client/react';
import {
  LOGIN_MUTATION,
  LOGOUT_MUTATION,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/admins-graphql';
import { useAdminsAuthContext } from '@kickzone-workspace/admins-contexts';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
interface LoginInput {
  email: string;
  password: string;
}
export const useAdminLogin = () => {
  const { setAdmin } = useAdminsAuthContext();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [login, { loading: adminsLoginLoading, error: adminsLoginError }] =
    useMutation<
      Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'login'>,
      KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationLoginArgs
    >(LOGIN_MUTATION);
  const loginAdmin = async (input: LoginInput) => {
    try {
      const result = await login({
        variables: { email: input.email, password: input.password },
      });
      if (result.data?.login && result.data.login.role === KickzoneGraphqlTypes.UserRole.Admin) {
        setAdmin(result.data.login);
        localStorage.setItem('admin_user', JSON.stringify(result.data.login));
        navigate('/products');
      } else if (result.data?.login && result.data.login.role !== KickzoneGraphqlTypes.UserRole.Admin) {
        console.error('Login failed: User does not have admin privileges');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Login failed:', error);
    }
  };
  const [logoutAdmin] =
    useMutation<Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'logout'>>(LOGOUT_MUTATION);
  return {
    loginAdmin,
    adminsLoginLoading,
    adminsLoginError,
    logoutAdmin,
  };
};
</file>

<file path="libs/client/admins/hooks/currency-management/src/lib/useAdminsCurrencyManagement.ts">
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useMutation, useQuery } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import {
  GET_CURRENCIES,
  GET_CURRENT_EXCHANGE_RATE,
  GET_EXCHANGE_RATE_HISTORY,
  SET_EXCHANGE_RATE,
  GET_CURRENCY_PREFERENCES,
  SET_CURRENCY_PREFERENCE,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/client-shared-graphql';
import { useSnackbar } from '@kickzone-workspace/snackbar-hook';
import { useI18nContext } from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
export const useAdminsCurrencyManagement = () => {
  const { showSnackbar } = useSnackbar();
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  // Start empty so MUI Select does not warn before currencies load.
  const [selectedFromCurrency, setSelectedFromCurrency] = useState('');
  const [selectedToCurrency, setSelectedToCurrency] = useState('');
  const [newRate, setNewRate] = useState('');
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');
  const [locale, setLocale] = useState('fa');
  const [currencyCode, setCurrencyCode] = useState('');
  const currenciesQuery =
    useQuery<Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'currencies'>>(GET_CURRENCIES);
  const currencies = currenciesQuery.data?.currencies ?? [];
  const hasCurrencyPair = Boolean(selectedFromCurrency && selectedToCurrency);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!currencies.length) {
      return;
    }
    const codes = new Set(currencies.map((currency) => currency.code));
    const base =
      currencies.find((currency) => currency.isBaseCurrency) ?? currencies[0];
    const secondary =
      currencies.find((currency) => currency.code !== base.code) ?? base;
    if (!codes.has(selectedFromCurrency)) {
      setSelectedFromCurrency(base.code);
    }
    if (!codes.has(selectedToCurrency)) {
      setSelectedToCurrency(secondary.code);
    }
    if (!codes.has(currencyCode)) {
      setCurrencyCode(secondary.code);
    }
  }, [currencies, selectedFromCurrency, selectedToCurrency, currencyCode]);
  const exchangeRateQuery = useQuery<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'currentExchangeRate'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.QueryCurrentExchangeRateArgs
  >(GET_CURRENT_EXCHANGE_RATE, {
    variables: {
      fromCurrencyCode: selectedFromCurrency,
      toCurrencyCode: selectedToCurrency,
    },
    skip: !hasCurrencyPair,
  });
  const historyQuery = useQuery<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'exchangeRateHistory'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.QueryExchangeRateHistoryArgs
  >(GET_EXCHANGE_RATE_HISTORY, {
    variables: {
      fromCurrencyCode: selectedFromCurrency,
      toCurrencyCode: selectedToCurrency,
      limit: 10,
    },
    skip: !hasCurrencyPair,
  });
  const preferencesQuery = useQuery<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'currencyPreferences'>
  >(GET_CURRENCY_PREFERENCES);
  const [setExchangeRateMutation, { loading: settingRate }] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'setExchangeRate'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationSetExchangeRateArgs
  >(SET_EXCHANGE_RATE, {
    onCompleted: () => {
      exchangeRateQuery.refetch();
      historyQuery.refetch();
      setNewRate('');
      setNotes('');
      const rateUpdateText =
        LL.currency.rateUpdateSuccess?.() ?? LL.currency.setExchangeRate();
      showSnackbar(rateUpdateText, { severity: 'success' });
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      showSnackbar(`Error: ${error.message}`, { severity: 'error' });
    },
  });
  const [setCurrencyPreferenceMutation, { loading: settingPreference }] =
    useMutation<
      Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'setCurrencyPreference'>,
      KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationSetCurrencyPreferenceArgs
    >(SET_CURRENCY_PREFERENCE, {
      onCompleted: () => {
        preferencesQuery.refetch();
        showSnackbar(
          LL.currency.preferenceUpdateSuccess?.() ??
            LL.currency.setPreference(),
          {
            severity: 'success',
          }
        );
      },
      onError: (error) => {
        showSnackbar(`Error: ${error.message}`, { severity: 'error' });
      },
    });
  const currentRate = exchangeRateQuery.data?.currentExchangeRate;
  const history = historyQuery.data?.exchangeRateHistory ?? [];
  const preferences = preferencesQuery.data?.currencyPreferences ?? [];
  const handleSetExchangeRate = () => {
    if (!hasCurrencyPair) {
      return;
    }
    if (!newRate || isNaN(Number(newRate))) {
      showSnackbar(LL.currency.enterExchangeRate(), { severity: 'error' });
      return;
    }
    setExchangeRateMutation({
      variables: {
        input: {
          fromCurrencyCode: selectedFromCurrency,
          toCurrencyCode: selectedToCurrency,
          rate: parseFloat(newRate),
          notes: notes || null,
        },
      },
    });
  };
  const handleSetCurrencyPreference = () => {
    if (!currencyCode) {
      return;
    }
    setCurrencyPreferenceMutation({
      variables: {
        locale,
        currencyCode,
      },
    });
  };
  return {
    // state
    selectedFromCurrency,
    setSelectedFromCurrency,
    selectedToCurrency,
    setSelectedToCurrency,
    newRate,
    setNewRate,
    notes,
    setNotes,
    locale,
    setLocale,
    currencyCode,
    setCurrencyCode,
    // queries data
    currencies,
    currentRate,
    history,
    preferences,
    // loading states
    settingRate,
    settingPreference,
    loadingCurrencies: currenciesQuery.loading,
    loadingCurrentRate: exchangeRateQuery.loading,
    loadingHistory: historyQuery.loading,
    loadingPreferences: preferencesQuery.loading,
    // actions
    handleSetExchangeRate,
    handleSetCurrencyPreference,
  };
};
</file>

<file path="libs/client/admins/hooks/customers/src/lib/adminsCustomers.graphql.ts">
import { gql } from '@apollo/client';
export const CUSTOMER_FIELDS = gql`
  fragment CustomerFields on User {
    id
    name
    lastName
    username
    email
    role
    locale
    customerProfile {
      id
      phone
      address
      city
      state
      zipCode
      country
    }
  }
`;
export const GET_CUSTOMERS = gql`
  query GetCustomers($first: Int, $after: String, $searchTerm: String) {
    customers(first: $first, after: $after, searchTerm: $searchTerm) {
      edges {
        node {
          ...CustomerFields
        }
        cursor
      }
      pageInfo {
        hasNextPage
        endCursor
      }
      totalCount
    }
  }
  ${CUSTOMER_FIELDS}
`;
</file>

<file path="libs/client/admins/hooks/customers/src/lib/useAdminsCustomers.spec.tsx">
import { vi, describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { renderHook } from '@testing-library/react';
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
import { useAdminsCustomers } from './useAdminsCustomers';
import { useQuery } from '@apollo/client/react';
vi.mock('@apollo/client/react', () => ({
  useQuery: vi.fn(),
}));
vi.mock('./adminsCustomers.graphql', () => ({
  GET_CUSTOMERS: 'GET_CUSTOMERS',
  CUSTOMER_FIELDS: 'CUSTOMER_FIELDS',
}));
describe('useAdminsCustomers', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
  });
  it('should return customers data, loading state, error and refetch function', () => {
    const mockCustomersData = {
      customers: {
        edges: [
          {
            node: {
              id: '123',
              name: 'Alice',
              lastName: 'Smith',
              username: 'alicesmith',
              email: 'alice@example.com',
              role: 'CUSTOMER',
              customerProfile: {
                id: 'p1',
                phone: '1234567890',
                address: '123 Main St',
                city: 'Cityville',
              },
            },
            cursor: '123',
          },
        ],
        pageInfo: {
          hasNextPage: false,
          endCursor: '123',
        },
        totalCount: 1,
      },
    };
    const mockRefetch = vi.fn();
    vi.mocked(useQuery).mockReturnValue({
      data: mockCustomersData,
      loading: false,
      error: null,
      refetch: mockRefetch,
    } as unknown as ReturnType<typeof useQuery>);
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useAdminsCustomers());
    expect(result.current.customers).toEqual(mockCustomersData.customers);
    expect(result.current.isLoadingCustomers).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.customersError).toBe(null);
    expect(result.current.refetchCustomers).toBe(mockRefetch);
    expect(useQuery).toHaveBeenCalledWith('GET_CUSTOMERS', {
      variables: {
        first: 100,
        after: undefined,
        searchTerm: undefined,
      },
      fetchPolicy: 'cache-and-network',
      errorPolicy: 'all',
      notifyOnNetworkStatusChange: true,
    });
  });
  it('should pass options to variables when provided', () => {
    vi.mocked(useQuery).mockReturnValue({
      data: null,
      loading: true,
      error: null,
      refetch: vi.fn(),
    } as unknown as ReturnType<typeof useQuery>);
    const { result } = renderHook(() =>
      useAdminsCustomers({ first: 25, after: 'cursor-1', searchTerm: 'alice' })
    );
    expect(result.current.isLoadingCustomers).toBe(true);
    expect(useQuery).toHaveBeenCalledWith('GET_CUSTOMERS', {
      variables: {
        first: 25,
        after: 'cursor-1',
        searchTerm: 'alice',
      },
      fetchPolicy: 'cache-and-network',
      errorPolicy: 'all',
      notifyOnNetworkStatusChange: true,
    });
  });
  it('should handle error state', () => {
    const mockError = new Error('Failed to load customers');
    vi.mocked(useQuery).mockReturnValue({
      data: null,
      loading: false,
      error: mockError,
      refetch: vi.fn(),
    } as unknown as ReturnType<typeof useQuery>);
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useAdminsCustomers());
    expect(result.current.customersError).toBe(mockError);
    expect(result.current.isLoadingCustomers).toBe(false);
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/admins/hooks/customers/src/lib/useAdminsCustomers.ts">
import { useQuery } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import { GET_CUSTOMERS } from './adminsCustomers.graphql';
export interface UseAdminsCustomersOptions {
  first?: number;
  after?: string;
  searchTerm?: string;
}
export const useAdminsCustomers = (options?: UseAdminsCustomersOptions) => {
  const {
    data,
    loading: isLoadingCustomers,
    error: customersError,
    refetch: refetchCustomers,
  } = useQuery<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'customers'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.QueryCustomersArgs
  >(GET_CUSTOMERS, {
    variables: {
      first: options?.first ?? 100,
      after: options?.after,
      searchTerm: options?.searchTerm,
    },
    fetchPolicy: 'cache-and-network',
    errorPolicy: 'all',
    notifyOnNetworkStatusChange: true,
  });
  return {
    customers: data?.customers,
    isLoadingCustomers,
    customersError,
    refetchCustomers,
  };
};
</file>

<file path="libs/client/admins/hooks/orders/src/lib/admins-orders-hook.tsx">
import { useQuery, useMutation } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import {
  GET_SELLERS_QUERY,
  GET_ALL_ORDERS_QUERY,
  UPDATE_ORDER_STATUS_MUTATION,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/admins-graphql';
export function useAdminsOrders({
  first = 10,
  after,
  status,
}: {
  first?: number;
  after?: string;
  status?: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus;
} = {}) {
  const { data, loading, error, refetch, fetchMore } = useQuery<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'allSellerOrders'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.QueryAllSellerOrdersArgs
  >(GET_ALL_ORDERS_QUERY, {
    variables: { first, after, status },
    fetchPolicy: 'cache-and-network',
    notifyOnNetworkStatusChange: true,
  });
  const [updateOrderStatusMutation, { loading: updateStatusLoading }] =
    useMutation<
      Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'updateOrderStatus'>,
      KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationUpdateOrderStatusArgs
    >(UPDATE_ORDER_STATUS_MUTATION, {
      refetchQueries: [
        { query: GET_ALL_ORDERS_QUERY, variables: { first, after, status } },
      ],
    });
  const updateOrderStatus = async (
    orderId: string,
    status: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus
  ) => {
    const response = await updateOrderStatusMutation({
      variables: {
        updateOrderStatusInput: {
          id: orderId,
          status,
        },
      },
    });
    return response.data?.updateOrderStatus;
  };
  const loadMore = () => {
    const endCursor = data?.allSellerOrders?.pageInfo?.endCursor;
    if (endCursor) {
      return fetchMore({
        variables: {
          after: endCursor,
        },
      });
    }
  };
  const orders =
    data?.allSellerOrders?.edges?.map((edge) => edge?.node).filter(Boolean) ||
    [];
  return {
    orders,
    loading,
    error,
    refetch,
    loadMore,
    updateOrderStatus,
    updateStatusLoading,
  };
}
export function useAdminsSellers({
  filter,
}: {
  filter?: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SellerFilterInput;
} = {}) {
  const { data, loading, error, refetch } = useQuery<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'sellers'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.QuerySellersArgs
  >(GET_SELLERS_QUERY, {
    variables: { filter },
    fetchPolicy: 'cache-and-network',
  });
  return {
    sellers:
      data?.sellers?.edges?.map((edge) => edge?.node).filter(Boolean) || [],
    pageInfo: data?.sellers?.pageInfo,
    totalCount: data?.sellers?.totalCount || 0,
    loading,
    error,
    refetch,
  };
}

<file path="libs/client/admins/hooks/sellers/src/lib/useAdminsSellers.ts">
import { useMutation, useQuery } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import {
  GET_SELLERS,
  CREATE_SELLER,
  UPDATE_SELLER,
  TOGGLE_SELLER_ACTIVE,
  INITIATE_SELLER_PASSWORD_SETUP,
} from './adminsSellers.graphql';
export const useAdminsSellersQuery = (
  filter: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SellerFilterInput = { isActive: true }
) => {
  const {
    data: sellersData,
    loading: isLoadingSellers,
    error: sellersError,
    refetch: refetchSellers,
  } = useQuery<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'sellers'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.QuerySellersArgs
  >(GET_SELLERS, {
    variables: { filter },
    fetchPolicy: 'cache-and-network', // Always fetch fresh data
    errorPolicy: 'all', // Return both data and errors
    notifyOnNetworkStatusChange: true, // Notify on loading state changes
  });
  return {
    sellers: sellersData?.sellers,
    isLoadingSellers,
    sellersError,
    refetchSellers,
  };
};
export const useAdminsSellers = (
  filter: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SellerFilterInput = { isActive: true }
) => {
  const [createSeller, { loading: isCreatingSeller }] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'createSeller'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationCreateSellerArgs
  >(CREATE_SELLER, {
    refetchQueries: [
      {
        query: GET_SELLERS,
        variables: { filter: { isActive: filter.isActive } },
      },
    ],
  });
  const [updateSeller, { loading: isUpdatingSeller }] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'updateSeller'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationUpdateSellerArgs
  >(UPDATE_SELLER, {
    refetchQueries: [
      {
        query: GET_SELLERS,
        variables: { filter: { isActive: filter.isActive } },
      },
    ],
  });
  const [toggleSellerActive, { loading: isTogglingSellerActive }] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'toggleSellerActive'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationToggleSellerActiveArgs
  >(TOGGLE_SELLER_ACTIVE, {
    refetchQueries: [
      {
        query: GET_SELLERS,
        variables: { filter: { isActive: filter.isActive } },
      },
    ],
  });
  const [initiateSellerPasswordSetup, { loading: isInitiatingPasswordSetup }] =
    useMutation<
      Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'initiatePasswordSetup'>,
      KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationInitiatePasswordSetupArgs
    >(INITIATE_SELLER_PASSWORD_SETUP);
  return {
    createSeller,
    updateSeller,
    toggleSellerActive,
    initiateSellerPasswordSetup,
    isCreatingSeller,
    isUpdatingSeller,
    isTogglingSellerActive,
    isInitiatingPasswordSetup,
  };
};

      renderWithRouter(['/sellers']);
      expect(screen.getByTestId('private-route-outlet')).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByTestId('outlet-content')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    it('should render private route outlet for /customers route', () => {
      renderWithRouter(['/customers']);
      expect(screen.getByTestId('private-route-outlet')).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByTestId('outlet-content')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    it('should still render login screen for /login route even when authenticated', () => {
      renderWithRouter(['/login']);
      expect(screen.getByTestId('admins-login')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    it('should still render unauthorized screen for /unauthorized route even when authenticated', () => {
      renderWithRouter(['/unauthorized']);
      expect(screen.getByTestId('admins-unauthorized')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    it('should render language settings route', () => {
      renderWithRouter(['/language-settings']);
      expect(screen.getByTestId('language-components')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });
  describe('when admin is authenticated with non-ADMIN role', () => {
    beforeEach(() => {
      mockUseAdminsAuthContext.mockReturnValue({
        admin: {
          id: '2',
          name: 'Test User',
          email: 'user@test.com',
          role: 'CUSTOMER',
        },
      });
    });
    it('should redirect to unauthorized for root route', () => {
      renderWithRouter(['/']);
      expect(
        screen.getByTestId('navigate-to-unauthorized')
      ).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    it('should redirect to unauthorized for /products route', () => {
      renderWithRouter(['/products']);
      expect(
        screen.getByTestId('navigate-to-unauthorized')
      ).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    it('should redirect to unauthorized for /products/new route', () => {
      renderWithRouter(['/products/new']);
      expect(
        screen.getByTestId('navigate-to-unauthorized')
      ).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    it('should redirect to unauthorized for /products/edit/123 route', () => {
      renderWithRouter(['/products/edit/123']);
      expect(
        screen.getByTestId('navigate-to-unauthorized')
      ).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    it('should redirect to unauthorized for /sellers route', () => {
      renderWithRouter(['/sellers']);
      expect(
        screen.getByTestId('navigate-to-unauthorized')
      ).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    it('should still render login screen for /login route', () => {
      renderWithRouter(['/login']);
      expect(screen.getByTestId('admins-login')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    it('should still render unauthorized screen for /unauthorized route', () => {
      renderWithRouter(['/unauthorized']);
      expect(screen.getByTestId('admins-unauthorized')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });
  describe('when admin is authenticated with SELLER role', () => {
    beforeEach(() => {
      mockUseAdminsAuthContext.mockReturnValue({
        admin: {
          id: '3',
          name: 'Test Seller',
          email: 'seller@test.com',
          role: 'SELLER',
        },
      });
    });
    it('should redirect to unauthorized for all protected routes', () => {
      const protectedRoutes = [
        '/',
        '/products',
        '/products/new',
        '/products/edit/123',
        '/sellers',
        '/customers',
      ];
      protectedRoutes.forEach((route) => {
        const { unmount } = renderWithRouter([route]);
        expect(
          screen.getByTestId('navigate-to-unauthorized')
        ).toBeInTheDocument();
        unmount();
      });
    });
  });
  describe('router configuration', () => {
    beforeEach(() => {
      mockUseAdminsAuthContext.mockReturnValue({
        admin: {
          id: '1',
          name: 'Test Admin',
          email: 'admin@test.com',
          role: 'ADMIN',
        },
      });
    });
    it('should create private route with correct roles and admin', () => {
      renderWithRouter(['/']);
      // Verify that the private route is created with ADMIN role
      expect(screen.getByTestId('private-route-outlet')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    it('should handle all defined routes correctly', () => {
      const protectedRoutes = [
        '/',
        '/products',
        '/products/new',
        '/products/edit/123',
        '/sellers',
        '/customers',
      ];
      const publicRoutes = ['/login', '/unauthorized'];
      // Test protected routes
      protectedRoutes.forEach((path) => {
        const { unmount } = renderWithRouter([path]);
        expect(screen.getByTestId('private-route-outlet')).toBeInTheDocument();
        unmount();
      });
      // Test public routes
      const publicRouteTests = [
        { path: '/login', expectedComponent: 'admins-login' },
        { path: '/unauthorized', expectedComponent: 'admins-unauthorized' },
      ];
      publicRouteTests.forEach(({ path, expectedComponent }) => {
        const { unmount } = renderWithRouter([path]);
        expect(screen.getByTestId(expectedComponent)).toBeInTheDocument();
        unmount();
      });
    });
  });
  describe('edge cases', () => {
    it('should handle undefined admin gracefully', () => {
      mockUseAdminsAuthContext.mockReturnValue({
        admin: undefined,
      });
      renderWithRouter(['/']);
      expect(screen.getByTestId('navigate-to-login')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    it('should handle admin with null role', () => {
      mockUseAdminsAuthContext.mockReturnValue({
        admin: {
          id: '1',
          name: 'Test Admin',
          email: 'admin@test.com',
          role: null,
        },
      });
      renderWithRouter(['/']);
      expect(
        screen.getByTestId('navigate-to-unauthorized')
      ).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    it('should handle admin with empty string role', () => {
      mockUseAdminsAuthContext.mockReturnValue({
        admin: {
          id: '1',
          name: 'Test Admin',
          email: 'admin@test.com',
          role: '',
        },
      });
      renderWithRouter(['/']);
      expect(
        screen.getByTestId('navigate-to-unauthorized')
      ).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });
  describe('component integration', () => {
    beforeEach(() => {
      mockUseAdminsAuthContext.mockReturnValue({
        admin: {
          id: '1',
          name: 'Test Admin',
          email: 'admin@test.com',
          role: 'ADMIN',
        },
      });
    });
    it('should render BrowserRouter wrapper', () => {
      renderWithRouter(['/']);
      // The BrowserRouter is mocked to use MemoryRouter, so we can't directly test it
      // But we can verify that routing works correctly
      expect(screen.getByTestId('private-route-outlet')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    it('should pass correct props to createPrivateRoute', () => {
      renderWithRouter(['/']);
      // Verify that the private route receives the correct admin user
      expect(screen.getByTestId('private-route-outlet')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    it('should handle route parameters correctly', () => {
      renderWithRouter(['/products/edit/test-id-123']);
      expect(screen.getByTestId('private-route-outlet')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/admins/router/src/lib/AdminsRouter.tsx">
import { AdminProductEditor } from '@kickzone-workspace/admin-product-editor';
import { AdminProducts } from '@kickzone-workspace/admin-products';
import { ADMIN_ROUTES } from '@kickzone-workspace/admins-routes';
import { useAdminsAuthContext } from '@kickzone-workspace/admins-contexts';
import { AdminsLogin } from '@kickzone-workspace/admins-login';
import { AdminsUnauthorizedScreen } from '@kickzone-workspace/admins-unauthorized-screen';
import { createPrivateRoute } from '@kickzone-workspace/private-route';
import { BrowserRouter, Route, Routes } from 'react-router-dom';
import { SellerManagement } from '@kickzone-workspace/admin-seller-management';
import { AdminCustomerManagement } from '@kickzone-workspace/admin-customer-management';
import { LanguageComponents } from '@kickzone-workspace/language-components';
import { AdminTranslationManagement } from '@kickzone-workspace/translation-management';
import { AdminSellerOrders } from '@kickzone-workspace/admin-seller-orders';
import { AdminsLayout } from '@kickzone-workspace/admins-layout';
import { CurrencyManagement } from '@kickzone-workspace/currency-management';
export function AdminsRouter() {
  const { admin } = useAdminsAuthContext();
  const AdminRoute = createPrivateRoute(['ADMIN'], admin);
  return (
    <BrowserRouter>
      <Routes>
        <Route element={<AdminRoute />}>
          <Route path={ADMIN_ROUTES.HOME} element={<AdminProductEditor />} />
          <Route path={ADMIN_ROUTES.PRODUCTS} element={<AdminProducts />} />
          <Route
            path={ADMIN_ROUTES.PRODUCTS_NEW}
            element={<AdminProductEditor />}
          />
          <Route
            path={ADMIN_ROUTES.PRODUCTS_EDIT}
            element={<AdminProductEditor />}
          />
          <Route path={ADMIN_ROUTES.SELLERS} element={<SellerManagement />} />
          <Route
            path={ADMIN_ROUTES.CUSTOMERS}
            element={<AdminCustomerManagement />}
          />
          <Route path={ADMIN_ROUTES.ORDERS} element={<AdminSellerOrders />} />
          <Route
            path={ADMIN_ROUTES.CURRENCY}
            element={<CurrencyManagement />}
          />
          <Route
            path={ADMIN_ROUTES.TRANSLATIONS}
            element={<AdminTranslationManagement />}
          />
        </Route>
        <Route path={ADMIN_ROUTES.LOGIN} element={<AdminsLogin />} />
        <Route
          path={ADMIN_ROUTES.LANGUAGE_SETTINGS}
          element={<LanguageComponents LayoutComponent={AdminsLayout} />}
        />
        <Route
          path={ADMIN_ROUTES.UNAUTHORIZED}
          element={<AdminsUnauthorizedScreen />}
        />
      </Routes>
    </BrowserRouter>
  );
}
export default AdminsRouter;
</file>

<file path="libs/client/admins/routes/src/lib/admin-routes.spec.ts">
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { ADMIN_ROUTES, AdminRouteKey } from './admin-routes';
describe('ADMIN_ROUTES', () => {
  it('should define HOME route', () => {
    expect(ADMIN_ROUTES.HOME).toBe('/');
  });
  it('should define PRODUCTS route', () => {
    expect(ADMIN_ROUTES.PRODUCTS).toBe('/products');
  });
  it('should define PRODUCTS_NEW route', () => {
    expect(ADMIN_ROUTES.PRODUCTS_NEW).toBe('/products/new');
  });
  it('should define PRODUCTS_EDIT route', () => {
    expect(ADMIN_ROUTES.PRODUCTS_EDIT).toBe('/products/edit/:id');
  });
  it('should define SELLERS route', () => {
    expect(ADMIN_ROUTES.SELLERS).toBe('/sellers');
  });
  it('should define CUSTOMERS route', () => {
    expect(ADMIN_ROUTES.CUSTOMERS).toBe('/customers');
  });
  it('should define LOGIN route', () => {
    expect(ADMIN_ROUTES.LOGIN).toBe('/login');
  });
  it('should define UNAUTHORIZED route', () => {
    expect(ADMIN_ROUTES.UNAUTHORIZED).toBe('/unauthorized');
  });
  it('should define CONTACT route', () => {
    expect(ADMIN_ROUTES.CONTACT).toBe('/contact');
  });
  it('should have all expected route keys', () => {
    const expectedKeys: AdminRouteKey[] = [
      'HOME',
      'PRODUCTS',
      'PRODUCTS_NEW',
      'PRODUCTS_EDIT',
      'SELLERS',
      'CUSTOMERS',
      'ORDERS',
      'CURRENCY',
      'LOGIN',
      'UNAUTHORIZED',
      'CONTACT',
      'TRANSLATIONS',
      'LANGUAGE_SETTINGS',
    ];
    const actualKeys = Object.keys(ADMIN_ROUTES) as AdminRouteKey[];
    expect(actualKeys).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(expectedKeys));
    expect(actualKeys.length).toBe(expectedKeys.length);
  });
  it('should be readonly at compile time', () => {
    // TypeScript will prevent mutation at compile time
    // At runtime, the object is still mutable but TypeScript prevents it
    // We just verify the object exists and is defined as const
    expect(ADMIN_ROUTES).toBeDefined();
    expect(Object.isFrozen(ADMIN_ROUTES)).toBe(false); // const doesn't freeze, just prevents reassignment
  });
  it('should have correct route structure', () => {
    expect(typeof ADMIN_ROUTES).toBe('object');
    expect(ADMIN_ROUTES).not.toBeNull();
  });
  it('should have string values for all routes', () => {
    Object.values(ADMIN_ROUTES).forEach((route) => {
      expect(typeof route).toBe('string');
    });
  });
  it('should have unique route paths', () => {
    const routePaths = Object.values(ADMIN_ROUTES);
    const uniquePaths = new Set(routePaths);
    expect(uniquePaths.size).toBe(routePaths.length);
  });
  it('should have routes starting with /', () => {
    Object.values(ADMIN_ROUTES).forEach((route) => {
      expect(route).toMatch(/^\//);
    });
  });
});

    // Color should still be shown

  it('renders regular apparel sizes "M" and "L" unchanged', () => {
    render(<AdminSellerOrders />);
    // The detail panel for order-2 (apparel) should be rendered
    expect(screen.getByText('Red - M')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Black - L')).toBeInTheDocument();
    // No "W" prefix labels for apparel sizes (check the specific apparel variant cells)
    const apparelVariantCells = screen.getAllByText(/Red - M|Black - L/);
    apparelVariantCells.forEach(cell => {
      expect(cell.textContent).not.toMatch(/W\d+\/L\d+/);
    });
  });
});

    const detailsButtons = screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Customer Details' });
    expect(detailsButtons.length).toBe(2);
    fireEvent.click(detailsButtons[0]);
    expect(screen.getByText('Customer Profile Details')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('123 Elm St')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Springfield')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('+123456789')).toBeInTheDocument();
    const closeBtn = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Close' });
    fireEvent.click(closeBtn);
  });
  it('shows info alert in modal when customer has no profile details', () => {
    render(<AdminCustomerManagement />);
    const detailsButtons = screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Customer Details' });
    fireEvent.click(detailsButtons[1]); // Bob has null profile
    expect(screen.getByText('Customer Profile Details')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('No profile details provided')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
</file>

<file path="libs/client/admins/screens/customer-management/src/lib/admin-customer-management.tsx">
import { AdminsLayout } from '@kickzone-workspace/admins-layout';
import { useAdminsCustomers } from '@kickzone-workspace/admins-customers-hooks';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import { GlassmorphismContainer } from '@kickzone-workspace/glassmorphism-container';
import { useSnackbar } from '@kickzone-workspace/snackbar-hook';
import {
  useI18nContext,
  useLanguageContext,
  usePageTitle,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
import {
  useTableAlignment,
  getRTLTableProps,
  createRTLTextColumn,
  getRTLColumnProps,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/rtl-table-utils';
import { DialogFormContent } from '@kickzone-workspace/language-components';
import { MRT_Localization_FA } from 'material-react-table/locales/fa';
import { MRT_Localization_EN } from 'material-react-table/locales/en';
import type { MRT_Localization } from 'material-react-table';
import {
  MaterialReactTable,
  useMaterialReactTable,
  type MRT_ColumnDef,
} from 'material-react-table';
import VisibilityIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Visibility';
import RefreshIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Refresh';
import PeopleIcon from '@mui/icons-material/People';
import PersonIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Person';
import ContactPhoneIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ContactPhone';
import HomeIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Home';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import Dialog from '@mui/material/Dialog';
import DialogActions from '@mui/material/DialogActions';
import DialogTitle from '@mui/material/DialogTitle';
import Divider from '@mui/material/Divider';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Stack from '@mui/material/Stack';
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Alert from '@mui/material/Alert';
import { useMemo, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
type Customer = NonNullable<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.User>;
export const AdminCustomerManagement = () => {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  usePageTitle(() => LL.pageTitles.adminCustomers());
  const { isRTL } = useLanguageContext();
  const { alignment, isFarsi, currentLocale } = useTableAlignment();
  const { showSnackbar } = useSnackbar();
  const [selectedCustomer, setSelectedCustomer] = useState<Customer | null>(null);
  const [detailsModalOpen, setDetailsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const { customers, isLoadingCustomers, customersError, refetchCustomers } =
    useAdminsCustomers();
  // Convert Western numerals to Farsi numerals
  const toFarsiNumber = (num: number | string): string => {
    const farsiDigits = ['۰', '۱', '۲', '۳', '۴', '۵', '۶', '۷', '۸', '۹'];
    return String(num).replace(/\d/g, (digit) => farsiDigits[parseInt(digit, 10)]);
  };
  const formatNumbersInString = (str: string): string => {
    if (currentLocale !== 'fa') return str;
    return str.replace(/\d+/g, (match) => toFarsiNumber(match));
  };
  const baseLocalization =
    currentLocale === 'fa'
      ? MRT_Localization_FA
      : MRT_Localization_EN;
  const tableLocalization: Partial<MRT_Localization> = {
    ...baseLocalization,
    sortByColumnAsc: formatNumbersInString(
      LL.tableMenu.sortByColumnAsc({ column: '{column}' })
    ),
    sortByColumnDesc: formatNumbersInString(
      LL.tableMenu.sortByColumnDesc({ column: '{column}' })
    ),
    sortedByColumnAsc: formatNumbersInString(
      LL.tableMenu.sortedByColumnAsc({ column: '{column}' })
    ),
    sortedByColumnDesc: formatNumbersInString(
      LL.tableMenu.sortedByColumnDesc({ column: '{column}' })
    ),
  };
  const customersData = useMemo(
    () => (customers?.edges?.map((edge) => edge.node) || []) as Customer[],
    [customers]
  );
  const totalCount = customers?.totalCount ?? customersData.length;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (customersError) {
      if (
        !customersError.message.includes('Forbidden') &&
        !customersError.message.includes('Unauthorized') &&
        !customersError.message.includes('Authentication')
      ) {
        showSnackbar(`Error loading customers: ${customersError.message}`, {
          severity: 'error',
        });
      }
    }
  }, [customersError, showSnackbar]);
  const handleOpenDetails = (customer: Customer) => {
    setSelectedCustomer(customer);
    setDetailsModalOpen(true);
  };
  const handleCloseDetails = () => {
    setDetailsModalOpen(false);
    setSelectedCustomer(null);
  };
  const columns: MRT_ColumnDef<Customer>[] = useMemo(() => {
    const dataColumns: MRT_ColumnDef<Customer>[] = [
      createRTLTextColumn<Customer>('name', LL.table.name(), { alignment }),
      createRTLTextColumn<Customer>('lastName', LL.table.lastName(), {
        alignment,
      }),
      createRTLTextColumn<Customer>('username', LL.table.username(), {
        alignment,
      }),
      createRTLTextColumn<Customer>('email', LL.table.email(), {
        alignment,
      }),
      {
        accessorKey: 'customerProfile.phone',
        header: LL.table.phone(),
        ...getRTLColumnProps(alignment),
        Cell: ({ row }) => row.original.customerProfile?.phone || '-',
      },
      {
        accessorKey: 'customerProfile.city',
        header: LL.table.city(),
        ...getRTLColumnProps(alignment),
        Cell: ({ row }) => row.original.customerProfile?.city || '-',
      },
      {
        accessorKey: 'customerProfile.country',
        header: LL.table.country(),
        ...getRTLColumnProps(alignment),
        Cell: ({ row }) => row.original.customerProfile?.country || '-',
      },
    ];
    const actionsColumn: MRT_ColumnDef<Customer> = {
      id: 'actions',
      header: LL.table.actions(),
      ...getRTLColumnProps(alignment),
      Cell: ({ row }) => (
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',
            gap: 1,
            justifyContent: isRTL ? 'flex-end' : 'flex-start',
            flexDirection: isRTL ? 'row-reverse' : 'row',
          }}
        >
          <Tooltip title={LL.table.customerDetails()}>
            <IconButton
              aria-label={LL.table.customerDetails()}
              onClick={() => handleOpenDetails(row.original)}
              color="primary"
              size="small"
            >
              <VisibilityIcon />
            </IconButton>
          </Tooltip>
        </Box>
      ),
    };
    return [...dataColumns, actionsColumn];
  }, [LL, alignment, isRTL]);
  const table = useMaterialReactTable<Customer>({
    columns,
    data: customersData,
    state: { isLoading: isLoadingCustomers },
    enableRowActions: false,
    enableColumnOrdering: false,
    localization: tableLocalization,
    ...getRTLTableProps({ alignment, isFarsi }),
    renderTopToolbarCustomActions: () => (
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
        <Button
          color="primary"
          variant="outlined"
          startIcon={<RefreshIcon />}
          onClick={() => refetchCustomers()}
          disabled={isLoadingCustomers}
        >
          {LL.tableMenu.refresh()}
        </Button>
        <Chip
          icon={<PeopleIcon />}
          label={
            currentLocale === 'fa'
              ? `${toFarsiNumber(totalCount)} مشتری ثبت‌نام شده`
              : `${totalCount} registered customer${totalCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
          }
          color="primary"
          variant="filled"
          sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}
        />
      </Box>
    ),
  });
  return (
    <AdminsLayout>
      <GlassmorphismContainer fullHeight>
        <MaterialReactTable
          table={table}
          key={`customer-table-${isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}`}
        />
        {/* Customer Details Modal */}
        <Dialog
          open={detailsModalOpen}
          onClose={handleCloseDetails}
          maxWidth="md"
          fullWidth
        >
          <DialogTitle sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
            <PersonIcon color="primary" />
            <Typography variant="h6" component="span" fontWeight="bold">
              {LL.adminCustomers.profileDetails()}
            </Typography>
          </DialogTitle>
          <DialogFormContent>
            {selectedCustomer && (
              <Stack spacing={3} sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                {/* Account Information Card */}
                <Paper
                  variant="outlined"
                  sx={{
                    p: 2.5,
                    borderRadius: 2,
                    backgroundColor: 'background.paper',
                  }}
                >
                  <Typography
                    variant="subtitle1"
                    fontWeight="bold"
                    color="primary"
                    gutterBottom
                    sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}
                  >
                    <PersonIcon fontSize="small" />
                    Account Information
                  </Typography>
                  <Divider sx={{ mb: 2 }} />
                  <Grid container spacing={2}>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                      <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                        {LL.table.name()}
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body1" fontWeight={500}>
                        {selectedCustomer.name}
                      </Typography>
                    </Grid>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                      <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                        {LL.table.lastName()}
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body1" fontWeight={500}>
                        {selectedCustomer.lastName || '-'}
                      </Typography>
                    </Grid>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                      <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                        {LL.table.username()}
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body1" fontWeight={500}>
                        {selectedCustomer.username}
                      </Typography>
                    </Grid>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                      <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                        {LL.table.email()}
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body1" fontWeight={500}>
                        {selectedCustomer.email}
                      </Typography>
                    </Grid>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                      <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                        ID
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                        {selectedCustomer.id}
                      </Typography>
                    </Grid>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                      <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                        Role
                      </Typography>
                      <Box sx={{ mt: 0.5 }}>
                        <Chip
                          label={selectedCustomer.role}
                          size="small"
                          color="info"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      </Box>
                    </Grid>
                  </Grid>
                </Paper>
                {/* Profile & Address Information Card */}
                <Paper
                  variant="outlined"
                  sx={{
                    p: 2.5,
                    borderRadius: 2,
                    backgroundColor: 'background.paper',
                  }}
                >
                  <Typography
                    variant="subtitle1"
                    fontWeight="bold"
                    color="primary"
                    gutterBottom
                    sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}
                  >
                    <HomeIcon fontSize="small" />
                    Profile & Shipping Address
                  </Typography>
                  <Divider sx={{ mb: 2 }} />
                  {selectedCustomer.customerProfile ? (
                    <Grid container spacing={2}>
                      <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                          {LL.table.phone()}
                        </Typography>
                        <Typography variant="body1" fontWeight={500}>
                          {selectedCustomer.customerProfile.phone || '-'}
                        </Typography>
                      </Grid>
                      <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                          {LL.table.country()}
                        </Typography>
                        <Typography variant="body1" fontWeight={500}>
                          {selectedCustomer.customerProfile.country || '-'}
                        </Typography>
                      </Grid>
                      <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                          {LL.table.city()}
                        </Typography>
                        <Typography variant="body1" fontWeight={500}>
                          {selectedCustomer.customerProfile.city || '-'}
                        </Typography>
                      </Grid>
                      <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                          {LL.table.state()}
                        </Typography>
                        <Typography variant="body1" fontWeight={500}>
                          {selectedCustomer.customerProfile.state || '-'}
                        </Typography>
                      </Grid>
                      <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                          {LL.table.zipCode()}
                        </Typography>
                        <Typography variant="body1" fontWeight={500}>
                          {selectedCustomer.customerProfile.zipCode || '-'}
                        </Typography>
                      </Grid>
                      <Grid size={12}>
                        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                          {LL.table.address()}
                        </Typography>
                        <Typography variant="body1" fontWeight={500}>
                          {selectedCustomer.customerProfile.address || '-'}
                        </Typography>
                      </Grid>
                    </Grid>
                  ) : (
                    <Alert severity="info" variant="outlined" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                      {LL.adminCustomers.noProfile()}
                    </Alert>
                  )}
                </Paper>
              </Stack>
            )}
          </DialogFormContent>
          <DialogActions sx={{ px: 3, pb: 2 }}>
            <Button onClick={handleCloseDetails} variant="contained">
              Close
            </Button>
          </DialogActions>
        </Dialog>
      </GlassmorphismContainer>
    </AdminsLayout>
  );
};
export default AdminCustomerManagement;
</file>

<file path="libs/client/admins/screens/login/src/lib/AdminsLogin.spec.tsx">
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { AdminsLogin } from './AdminsLogin';
import { vi } from 'vitest';
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/admins-layout', () => ({
  AdminsLayout: ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => (
    <div data-testid="admins-layout">{children}</div>
  ),
}));
const mockLoginAdmin = vi.fn();
const mockUseAdminLogin = vi.fn();
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/admins-auth-hooks', () => ({
  useAdminLogin: () => mockUseAdminLogin(),
}));
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n', () => ({
  useI18nContext: () => ({
    LL: {
      authorization: {
        signIn: () => 'Sign In',
      },
      pageTitles: {
        adminLogin: () => 'Admin Login',
      },
      form: {
        email: () => 'Email',
        password: () => 'Password',
      },
      errors: {
        'auth.invalid-credentials': () => 'Invalid credentials',
        'auth.network-error': () => 'Network error',
      },
    },
  }),
  usePageTitle: vi.fn(),
}));
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/language-components', () => ({
  getLtrTextFieldProps: () => ({}),
}));
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/password-field', () => ({
  PasswordTextField: ({
    label,
    value,
    onChange,
    ...props
  }: {
    label: string;
    value: string;
    onChange: (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
  }) => (
    <input
      aria-label={label}
      value={value}
      onChange={onChange}
      type="password"
      {...props}
    />
  ),
}));
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/translations', () => ({
  mapApolloErrorToTranslationKey: (_error: unknown) =>
    'auth.invalid-credentials',
}));
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/colors', () => ({
  colors: {
    main: '#1976d2',
    text: '#333333',
    accent1: '#f5f5f5',
    hoverMain: '#1565c0',
  },
}));
describe('AdminsLogin', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockUseAdminLogin.mockReturnValue({
      loginAdmin: mockLoginAdmin,
      adminsLoginLoading: false,
      adminsLoginError: null,
    });
  });
  it('should render successfully', () => {
    render(<AdminsLogin />);
    expect(screen.getByTestId('admins-layout')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Sign In' })
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should render form fields', () => {
    render(<AdminsLogin />);
    expect(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: /email/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Password')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign In' })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should update email field when typed', () => {
    render(<AdminsLogin />);
    const emailInput = screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: /email/i });
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: 'test@example.com' } });
    expect(emailInput).toHaveValue('test@example.com');
  });
  it('should update password field when typed', () => {
    render(<AdminsLogin />);
    const passwordInput = screen.getByLabelText('Password');
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'password123' } });
    expect(passwordInput).toHaveValue('password123');
  });
  it('should call loginAdmin when form is submitted', async () => {
    render(<AdminsLogin />);
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: /email/i }), {
      target: { value: 'test@example.com' },
    });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Password'), {
      target: { value: 'password123' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign In' }));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockLoginAdmin).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        email: 'test@example.com',
        password: 'password123',
      });
    });
  });
  it('should show loading state when login is in progress', () => {
    mockUseAdminLogin.mockReturnValue({
      loginAdmin: mockLoginAdmin,
      adminsLoginLoading: true,
      adminsLoginError: null,
    });
    render(<AdminsLogin />);
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign In' })).toBeDisabled();
  });
  it('should show error message when login fails', () => {
    mockUseAdminLogin.mockReturnValue({
      loginAdmin: mockLoginAdmin,
      adminsLoginLoading: false,
      adminsLoginError: { message: 'Invalid credentials' },
    });
    render(<AdminsLogin />);
    expect(screen.getByText('Invalid credentials')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "jsx": "react-jsx",
    "allowJs": false,
    "esModuleInterop": false,

<file path="libs/client/admins/screens/products/src/lib/adminProducts.graphql.ts">
import { gql } from '@apollo/client';
export const SELLER_PRODUCTS_BY_PRODUCT = gql`
  query SellerProductsByProduct($productId: Int!) {
    sellerProductsByProduct(productId: $productId) {
      id
      price
      discount
      stockQuantity
      recommended
      boxLess
      seller {
        id
        user {
          name
        }
      }
      productInfo {
        id
        size
        colors {
          name
        }
      }
    }
  }
`;
export const UPDATE_SELLER_PRODUCT_RECOMMENDED = gql`
  mutation UpdateSellerProductRecommended(
    $sellerId: Int!
    $input: UpdateSellerProductInput!
  ) {
    updateSellerProduct(sellerId: $sellerId, input: $input) {
      id
      recommended
    }
  }
`;
</file>

<file path="libs/client/admins/screens/products/src/lib/adminProducts.hooks.ts">
import { useLazyQuery, useMutation } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import {
  SELLER_PRODUCTS_BY_PRODUCT,
  UPDATE_SELLER_PRODUCT_RECOMMENDED,
} from './adminProducts.graphql';
export const useSellerListingsByProduct = () => {
  const [fetchSellerListings, listingsResult] = useLazyQuery<{
    sellerProductsByProduct: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SellerProduct[];
  }>(SELLER_PRODUCTS_BY_PRODUCT, {
    fetchPolicy: 'network-only',
  });
  const [mutateSellerProduct] = useMutation(UPDATE_SELLER_PRODUCT_RECOMMENDED);
  return {
    fetchSellerListings,
    listingsResult,
    mutateSellerProduct,
  };
};
</file>
