import { useSellerListingsByProduct } from './adminProducts.hooks';
import { useAdminsProductsStore } from '@kickzone-workspace/admins-products-store';
import { formatVariantColorNames } from '@kickzone-workspace/client-shared-graphql';
import { useSnackbarContext } from '@kickzone-workspace/snackbar-hook';
type LayoutComponentType = React.ComponentType<{ children: ReactNode }>;
const hasActiveSellerInventory = (
  product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product
): boolean =>
  (product.sellerProducts ?? []).some(
    (sellerProduct) => (sellerProduct.stockQuantity ?? 0) > 0
  );
export interface AdminProductsProps {
  LayoutComponent?: LayoutComponentType;
  productsNewPath?: string;
  productsEditPath?: (id: number) => string;
  /** Admin-only: seller listings / recommended toggles. Hidden for catalog sellers. */
  showSellerListings?: boolean;
  title?: string;
  /** Whether archived products with zero active inventory can be deleted. Defaults to true. */
  allowDelete?: boolean;
}
export function AdminProducts({
  LayoutComponent = AdminsLayout,
  productsNewPath = '/products/new',
  productsEditPath = (id: number) => `/products/edit/${id}`,
  showSellerListings = true,
  title,
  allowDelete = true,
}: AdminProductsProps = {}) {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  usePageTitle(() => title || LL.pageTitles.adminProducts());
  const {
    search,
    setSearch,
    category,
    setCategory,
    sort,
    setSort,
    sortOrder,
    setSortOrder,
    status,
    setStatus,
    archiveDialogOpen,
    productToArchive,
    openArchiveDialog,
    closeArchiveDialog,
    productDeleteDialogOpen,
    productToDelete,
    productDeleteConfirmName,
    openProductDeleteDialog,
    closeProductDeleteDialog,
    setProductDeleteConfirmName,
    listingsProduct,
    setListingsProduct,
    openImageModal,
    closeImageModal,
    currentProduct,
    imageModal,
  } = useAdminsProductsStore();
  const imageModalOpen = imageModal.open;
  const { showSnackbar } = useSnackbarContext();
  const {
    fetchSellerListings,
    listingsResult: {
      data: listingsData,
      loading: listingsLoading,
      refetch: refetchListings,
    },
    mutateSellerProduct,
  } = useSellerListingsByProduct();
  const sellerListings: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SellerProduct[] =
    listingsData?.sellerProductsByProduct || [];
  const categoryIdValue = category ? Number(category) : undefined;
  const {
    products,
    loading,
    error,
    loadMore,
    hasNextPage,
    totalCount,
    refetch,
  } = useProductsQuery({
    search,
    categoryId: categoryIdValue,
    sort,
    sortOrder,
    archivedStatus: status,
  });
  const { categories } = useCategoriesQuery();
  const {
    archiveProduct,
    isArchivingProduct,
    deleteProduct,
    isDeletingProduct,
  } = useProducts();
  const loaderRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const theme = useTheme();
  // Infinite scroll: observe the loader div
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hasNextPage) return;
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        if (entries[0].isIntersecting) {
          loadMore();
        }
      },
      { threshold: 1 }
    );
    if (loaderRef.current) observer.observe(loaderRef.current);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [loadMore, hasNextPage]);
  // Filtering and sorting logic (client-side sort only)
  const filteredProducts = products;
  const handleArchiveClick = (product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product) => {
    openArchiveDialog(product);
  };
  const handleArchiveConfirm = async () => {
    if (productToArchive) {
      await archiveProduct(productToArchive.id);
      closeArchiveDialog();
      refetch();
    }
  };
  const handleArchiveCancel = () => {
    closeArchiveDialog();
  };
  const canPermanentlyDelete = (product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product) =>
    allowDelete &&
    product.archived &&
    !hasActiveSellerInventory(product);
  const handleDeleteClick = (product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product) => {
    if (!canPermanentlyDelete(product)) {
      showSnackbar(LL.products.deleteProductBlockedActiveSelling(), {
        severity: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }
    openProductDeleteDialog(product);
  };
  const handleDeleteConfirm = async () => {
    if (!productToDelete) return;
    if (productDeleteConfirmName.trim() !== productToDelete.name) {
      showSnackbar(LL.products.deleteProductNameMismatch(), {
        severity: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }
    try {
      await deleteProduct(productToDelete.id);
      closeProductDeleteDialog();
      showSnackbar(LL.products.deleteProductSuccess(), { severity: 'success' });
      refetch();
    } catch (err) {
      showSnackbar((err as Error).message, { severity: 'error' });
    }
  };
  const handleDeleteCancel = () => {
    closeProductDeleteDialog();
  };
  const deleteNameMatches =
    !!productToDelete &&
    productDeleteConfirmName.trim() === productToDelete.name;
  const handleOpenImageModal = (product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product) => {
    openImageModal(product, true);
  };
  const handleCloseImageModal = () => {
    closeImageModal();
  };
  const handleOpenListings = (product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product) => {
    setListingsProduct(product);
    fetchSellerListings({ variables: { productId: Number(product.id) } });
  };
  const handleToggleRecommended = async (
    sellerProductId: string,
    sellerId: number | undefined,
    recommended: boolean
  ) => {
    if (sellerId === undefined || sellerId === null) return;
    await mutateSellerProduct({
      variables: {
        sellerId,
        input: { id: sellerProductId, recommended },
      },
    });
    if (listingsProduct && refetchListings) {
      refetchListings({ productId: Number(listingsProduct.id) });
    }
  };
  return (
    <LayoutComponent>
      <GlassmorphismContainer fullHeight>
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            alignItems: 'center',
            mb: 3,
            flexWrap: 'wrap',
            gap: 2,
          }}
        >
          <Typography variant="h4" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
            {title || LL.navigation.products()}
          </Typography>
          <Button
            variant="contained"
            color="primary"
            component={RouterLink}
            to={productsNewPath}
          >
            {LL.products.addProduct()}
          </Button>
        </Box>
        <Grid container spacing={2} sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 3 }}>
            <TextField
              label={LL.products.searchByName()}
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              size="small"
              fullWidth
            />
          </Grid>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 2 }}>
            <FormControl size="small" fullWidth>
              <InputLabel>{LL.form.category()}</InputLabel>
              <Select
                value={category}
                label={LL.form.category()}
                onChange={(e) => setCategory(String(e.target.value))}
              >
                <MenuItem value="">{LL.table.all()}</MenuItem>
                {categories?.map((c: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Category) => (
                  <MenuItem key={c.id} value={String(c.id)}>
                    {c.name}
                  </MenuItem>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </FormControl>
          </Grid>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 2.5 }}>
            <FormControl size="small" fullWidth>
              <InputLabel>{LL.form.sortBy()}</InputLabel>
              <Select
                value={sort}
                label={LL.form.sortBy()}
                onChange={(e) => setSort(e.target.value)}
              >
                <MenuItem value="">{LL.products.none()}</MenuItem>
                <MenuItem value="price">{LL.products.price()}</MenuItem>
                <MenuItem value="color">{LL.products.color()}</MenuItem>
                {/* Add more sort options as needed */}
              </Select>
            </FormControl>
          </Grid>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 2.5 }}>
            <FormControl size="small" fullWidth>
              <InputLabel>{LL.form.order()}</InputLabel>
              <Select
                value={sortOrder}
                label={LL.form.order()}
                onChange={(e) => setSortOrder(e.target.value as 'asc' | 'desc')}
              >
                <MenuItem value="asc">{LL.products.ascending()}</MenuItem>
                <MenuItem value="desc">{LL.products.descending()}</MenuItem>
              </Select>
            </FormControl>
          </Grid>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 2 }}>
            <FormControl size="small" fullWidth>
              <InputLabel>{LL.form.status()}</InputLabel>
              <Select
                value={status}
                label={LL.form.status()}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setStatus(
                    e.target.value as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductArchivedStatus
                  )
                }
              >
                <MenuItem value="ALL">{LL.table.all()}</MenuItem>
                <MenuItem value="ACTIVE">{LL.table.active()}</MenuItem>
                <MenuItem value="ARCHIVED">{LL.table.archived()}</MenuItem>
              </Select>
            </FormControl>
          </Grid>
        </Grid>
        {loading && !products.length ? (
          <Typography>{LL.status.loading()}</Typography>
        ) : error ? (
          <Typography color="error">
            {LL.products.errorLoadingProducts()}
          </Typography>
        ) : (
          <>
            <Grid container spacing={3}>
              {filteredProducts.map((product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product) => {
                const info = product.productInfos?.[0];
                const primaryImage = getProductPrimaryImage(product);
                const imageUrl = resolveProductImageUrl(primaryImage);
                return (
                  <Grid key={product.id} size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 4, lg: 3 }}>
                    <Card
                      sx={{
                        height: '100%',
                        display: 'flex',
                        flexDirection: 'column',
                        transition: 'all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)',
                        borderRadius: 2,
                        overflow: 'hidden',
                        '&:hover': {
                          transform: 'translateY(-8px)',
                          boxShadow: '0 12px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)',
                        },
                        ...(product.archived && {
                          opacity: 0.7,
                          backgroundColor: 'action.disabledBackground',
                        }),
                      }}
                    >
                      {/* Product Image */}
                      <Box
                        sx={{
                          position: 'relative',
                          paddingTop: '100%', // 1:1 aspect ratio
                          backgroundColor: 'grey.100',
                          overflow: 'hidden',
                        }}
                      >
                        <Box
                          sx={{
                            position: 'absolute',
                            top: 0,
                            left: 0,
                            width: '100%',
                            height: '100%',
                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            justifyContent: 'center',
                            color: 'text.disabled',
                          }}
                        >
                          <ImageIcon sx={{ fontSize: 60 }} />
                        </Box>
                        {imageUrl && (
                          <Box
                            component="img"
                            src={imageUrl}
                            alt={product.name}
                            onError={(e: React.SyntheticEvent<HTMLImageElement>) => {
                              (e.target as HTMLImageElement).style.display = 'none';
                            }}
                            sx={{
                              position: 'absolute',
                              top: 0,
                              left: 0,
                              width: '100%',
                              height: '100%',
                              objectFit: 'cover',
                            }}
                          />
                        )}
                        {/* Status Badge */}
                        <Box
                          sx={{
                            position: 'absolute',
                            top: 12,
                            right: 12,
                            backgroundColor: product.archived
                              ? 'error.main'
                              : 'success.main',
                            color: 'white',
                            px: 1.5,
                            py: 0.5,
                            borderRadius: 1,
                            fontSize: '0.75rem',
                            fontWeight: 600,
                            boxShadow: '0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)',
                          }}
                        >
                          {product.archived
                            ? LL.table.archived()
                            : LL.table.active()}
                        </Box>
                        {/* Color Indicator */}
                        {info?.colors?.length > 0 && (
                          <Box
                            sx={{
                              position: 'absolute',
                              bottom: 12,
                              left: 12,
                              display: 'flex',
                              alignItems: 'center',
                              gap: 1,
                              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95)',
                              px: 1.5,
                              py: 0.5,
                              borderRadius: 1,
                              boxShadow: '0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)',
                            }}
                          >
                            <Box
                              sx={{
                                display: 'flex',
                                alignItems: 'center',
                                gap: 0.5,
                              }}
                            >
                              {info.colors.map((color) => (
                                <Box
                                  key={color.id}
                                  sx={{
                                    width: 16,
                                    height: 16,
                                    borderRadius: '50%',
                                    backgroundColor: color.hexCode,
                                    border: '2px solid white',
                                    boxShadow: '0 0 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)',
                                  }}
                                />
                              ))}
                            </Box>
                            <Typography
                              variant="caption"
                              fontWeight={600}
                              sx={{ color: '#000' }}
                            >
                              {formatVariantColorNames(info.colors)}
                            </Typography>
                          </Box>
                        )}
                      </Box>
                      {/* Card Content */}
                      <CardContent sx={{ flexGrow: 1, p: 2 }}>
                        <Typography
                          variant="h6"
                          sx={{
                            fontWeight: 600,
                            mb: 1,
                            overflow: 'hidden',
                            textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                            display: '-webkit-box',
                            WebkitLineClamp: 2,
                            WebkitBoxOrient: 'vertical',
                            minHeight: '3em',
                          }}
                        >
                          {product.name}
                        </Typography>
                        {/* Categories */}
                        <Box
                          sx={{
                            display: 'flex',
                            flexWrap: 'wrap',
                            gap: 0.5,
                            mb: 1,
                          }}
                        >
                          {product.categories
                            .slice(0, 2)
                            .map((cat: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Category) => (
                              <Box
                                key={cat.id}
                                sx={{
                                  backgroundColor:
                                    theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
                                      ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'
                                      : 'primary.50',
                                  color:
                                    theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
                                      ? theme.palette.text.primary
                                      : 'primary.main',
                                  px: 1,
                                  py: 0.25,
                                  borderRadius: 0.5,
                                  fontSize: '0.7rem',
                                  fontWeight: 500,
                                }}
                              >
                                {cat.name}
                              </Box>
                            ))}
                          {product.categories.length > 2 && (
                            <Box
                              sx={{
                                backgroundColor:
                                  theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
                                    ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'
                                    : 'grey.200',
                                color: theme.palette.text.secondary,
                                px: 1,
                                py: 0.25,
                                borderRadius: 0.5,
                                fontSize: '0.7rem',
                                fontWeight: 500,
                              }}
                            >
                              +{product.categories.length - 2}
                            </Box>
                          )}
                        </Box>
                        {/* Product Variants */}
                        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                          {product.productInfos.length}{' '}
                          {product.productInfos.length === 1
                            ? 'variant'
                            : 'variants'}
                        </Typography>
                      </CardContent>
                      {/* Action Buttons */}
                      <CardActions
                        sx={{
                          justifyContent: 'space-around',
                          borderTop: '1px solid',
                          borderColor: 'divider',
                          p: 1.5,
                          gap: 1,
                        }}
                      >
                        <Tooltip title={LL.button.edit()}>
                          <IconButton
                            size="medium"
                            component={RouterLink}
                            to={productsEditPath(product.id)}
                            sx={{
                              color: 'primary.main',
                              '&:hover': {
                                backgroundColor: 'primary.50',
                              },
                            }}
                          >
                            <EditIcon />
                          </IconButton>
                        </Tooltip>
                        <Tooltip title={LL.products.images()}>
                          <IconButton
                            size="medium"
                            onClick={() => handleOpenImageModal(product)}
                            sx={{
                              color: 'info.main',
                              '&:hover': {
                                backgroundColor: 'info.50',
                              },
                            }}
                          >
                            <ImageIcon />
                          </IconButton>
                        </Tooltip>
                        {showSellerListings && (
                          <Tooltip title={LL.navigation.sellers()}>
                            <IconButton
                              size="medium"
                              onClick={() => handleOpenListings(product)}
                              sx={{
                                color: 'secondary.main',
                                '&:hover': {
                                  backgroundColor: 'secondary.50',
                                },
                              }}
                            >
                              <StorefrontIcon />
                            </IconButton>
                          </Tooltip>
                        )}
                        {!product.archived && (
                          <Tooltip title={LL.products.archiveProduct()}>
                            <IconButton
                              size="medium"
                              onClick={() => handleArchiveClick(product)}
                              sx={{
                                color: 'error.main',
                                '&:hover': {
                                  backgroundColor: 'error.50',
                                },
                              }}
                            >
                              <ArchiveIcon />
                            </IconButton>
                          </Tooltip>
                        )}
                        {canPermanentlyDelete(product) && (
                          <Tooltip title={LL.products.deleteProduct()}>
                            <IconButton
                              size="medium"
                              onClick={() => handleDeleteClick(product)}
                              sx={{
                                color: 'error.dark',
                                '&:hover': {
                                  backgroundColor: 'error.50',
                                },
                              }}
                            >
                              <DeleteForeverIcon />
                            </IconButton>
                          </Tooltip>
                        )}
                      </CardActions>
                    </Card>
                  </Grid>
                );
              })}
            </Grid>
            {hasNextPage && <div ref={loaderRef} style={{ height: 40 }} />}
            <Box mt={2} textAlign="center">
              <Typography variant="caption">
                {LL.products.showingProducts({
                  count: products.length,
                  total: totalCount,
                })}
              </Typography>
            </Box>
            <Dialog open={archiveDialogOpen} onClose={handleArchiveCancel}>
              <DialogTitle>{LL.products.archiveProduct()}</DialogTitle>
              <DialogContent dividers sx={{ pt: 2 }}>
                {LL.products.archiveProductConfirm()}
              </DialogContent>
              <DialogActions>
                <Button
                  onClick={handleArchiveCancel}
                  disabled={isArchivingProduct}
                >
                  {LL.button.cancel()}
                </Button>
                <Button
                  onClick={handleArchiveConfirm}
                  color="secondary"
                  variant="contained"
                  loading={isArchivingProduct}
                >
                  {LL.products.archiveProduct()}
                </Button>
              </DialogActions>
            </Dialog>
            <Dialog
              open={productDeleteDialogOpen}
              onClose={handleDeleteCancel}
              maxWidth="sm"
              fullWidth
            >
              <DialogTitle>{LL.products.deleteProduct()}</DialogTitle>
              <DialogContent dividers sx={{ pt: 2 }}>
                <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                  {LL.products.deleteProductConfirm({
                    name: productToDelete?.name ?? '',
                  })}
                </Alert>
                <TextField
                  autoFocus
                  fullWidth
                  label={LL.form.productName()}
                  value={productDeleteConfirmName}
                  onChange={(e) => setProductDeleteConfirmName(e.target.value)}
                  disabled={isDeletingProduct}
                  placeholder={productToDelete?.name}
                />
              </DialogContent>
              <DialogActions>
                <Button
                  onClick={handleDeleteCancel}
                  disabled={isDeletingProduct}
                >
                  {LL.button.cancel()}
                </Button>
                <Button
                  onClick={handleDeleteConfirm}
                  color="error"
                  variant="contained"
                  loading={isDeletingProduct}
                  disabled={!deleteNameMatches || isDeletingProduct}
                >
                  {LL.products.deleteProduct()}
                </Button>
              </DialogActions>
            </Dialog>
            <ProductImageManagementModal
              open={imageModalOpen}
              onClose={handleCloseImageModal}
              product={currentProduct || null}
              onProductUpdated={() => {
                refetch()
                  .then((result) => {
                    // Update the selected product with the latest data
                    if (currentProduct && result.data?.products?.edges) {
                      const updatedProduct = result.data.products.edges.find(
                        (edge) => edge.node.id === currentProduct.id
                      )?.node;
                      if (updatedProduct) {
                        openImageModal(updatedProduct, false);
                      }
                    }
                  })
                  .catch((error) => {
                    // Handle refetch error silently
                  });
              }}
            />
            {showSellerListings && (
              <Dialog
                open={Boolean(listingsProduct)}
                onClose={() => setListingsProduct(null)}
                maxWidth="md"
                fullWidth
              >
                <DialogTitle>
                  Seller listings — {listingsProduct?.name}
                </DialogTitle>
                <DialogContent dividers>
                  {listingsLoading && (
                    <Typography>{LL.status.loading()}</Typography>
                  )}
                  {!listingsLoading &&
                    listingsData?.sellerProductsByProduct?.length === 0 && (
                      <Typography>
                        {LL.products.noSellersAvailable()}
                      </Typography>
                    )}
                  {!listingsLoading && sellerListings.length > 0 && (
                    <Stack spacing={1.5}>
                      {sellerListings.map((sp, idx) => (
                        <Box
                          key={sp.id}
                          sx={{
                            display: 'grid',
                            gridTemplateColumns: '1.5fr 1fr 1fr 0.8fr 0.8fr',
                            gap: 1,
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            border: '1px solid',
                            borderColor: 'divider',
                            borderRadius: 1,
                            p: 1,
                            backgroundColor:
                              idx % 2 === 0
                                ? 'background.default'
                                : 'action.hover',
                          }}
                        >
                          <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
                            {sp.seller?.user?.name || 'Seller'}
                          </Typography>
                          <Typography>
                            {LL.products.price()}: {sp.price}
                          </Typography>
                          <Typography>
                            {LL.products.discount()}: {sp.discount}%
                          </Typography>
                          <Typography>
                            {LL.products.stock()}: {sp.stockQuantity}
                          </Typography>
                          <Stack
                            direction="row"
                            alignItems="center"
                            spacing={1}
                          >
                            <Typography variant="body2">Recommended</Typography>
                            <Switch
                              checked={sp.recommended}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                handleToggleRecommended(
                                  sp.id,
                                  sp.seller?.id,
                                  e.target.checked
                                )
                              }
                            />
                          </Stack>
                        </Box>
                      ))}
                    </Stack>
                  )}
                </DialogContent>
                <DialogActions>
                  <Button onClick={() => setListingsProduct(null)}>
                    {LL.button.close()}
                  </Button>
                </DialogActions>
              </Dialog>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </GlassmorphismContainer>
    </LayoutComponent>
  );
}
export default AdminProducts;

  ],
  category: { id: 1, name: 'Pants', slug: 'pants' },
  brand: { id: 1, name: 'Test Brand', slug: 'test-brand' },
  createdAt: '2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
  updatedAt: '2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
} as unknown as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product;

describe('ProductImageManagementModal - pants size display', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
  });
  it('renders pants size "32x34" as "W32/L34" and does not show raw "32x34"', () => {
    setupRender(0);
    // The tab for 32x34 should show formatted size
    expect(screen.getByText('W32/L34 - Black')).toBeInTheDocument();
    // The panel heading for 32x34 should show formatted size (first tab is selected by default)
    expect(screen.getByText('Variant: W32/L34 - Black')).toBeInTheDocument();
    // Raw pants size code should NOT appear anywhere
    expect(screen.queryByText('32x34')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('renders non-pants size "M" unchanged in tab label and panel', () => {
    setupRender(1); // Select the M tab (index 1)
    // The tab for M should show unchanged size
    expect(screen.getByText('M - Red')).toBeInTheDocument();
    // The panel heading for M should show unchanged size
    expect(screen.getByText('Variant: M - Red')).toBeInTheDocument();
    // The M tab should not have W/L format
    expect(screen.getByText('M - Red').textContent).not.toMatch(/W\d+\/L\d+/);
    // The M panel should not have W/L format
    expect(screen.getByText('Variant: M - Red').textContent).not.toMatch(/W\d+\/L\d+/);
  });
  it('renders non-pants size "L" unchanged in tab label and panel', () => {
    setupRender(2); // Select the L tab (index 2)
    // The tab for L should show unchanged size
    expect(screen.getByText('L - Blue')).toBeInTheDocument();
    // The panel heading for L should show unchanged size
    expect(screen.getByText('Variant: L - Blue')).toBeInTheDocument();
    // The L tab should not have W/L format
    expect(screen.getByText('L - Blue').textContent).not.toMatch(/W\d+\/L\d+/);
    // The L panel should not have W/L format
    expect(screen.getByText('Variant: L - Blue').textContent).not.toMatch(/W\d+\/L\d+/);
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/admins/screens/products/src/lib/ProductImageManagementModal.tsx">
import React, { useCallback } from 'react';
import Dialog from '@mui/material/Dialog';
import DialogTitle from '@mui/material/DialogTitle';
import DialogContent from '@mui/material/DialogContent';
import DialogActions from '@mui/material/DialogActions';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import Card from '@mui/material/Card';
import CardMedia from '@mui/material/CardMedia';
import CardActions from '@mui/material/CardActions';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import Tabs from '@mui/material/Tabs';
import Tab from '@mui/material/Tab';
import Alert from '@mui/material/Alert';
import DeleteIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Delete';
import AddPhotoIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AddPhotoAlternate';
import UploadIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Upload';
import WarningIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Warning';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import {
  useProducts,
  resolveProductImageUrl,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/products-hook';
import { useSnackbarContext } from '@kickzone-workspace/snackbar-hook';
import { useAdminsProductsStore } from '@kickzone-workspace/admins-products-store';
import { useI18nContext } from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
import { DialogFormContent } from '@kickzone-workspace/language-components';
import { formatVariantColorNames } from '@kickzone-workspace/client-shared-graphql';
import { formatSizeLabel, SizeKind } from '@kickzone-workspace/product-sizes';
const CANONICAL_PANTS_SIZE_RE = /^[1-9]\d?x[1-9]\d?$/;
const displayItemSize = (size?: string | null): string => {
  if (!size) return '';
  const t = size.trim();
  return CANONICAL_PANTS_SIZE_RE.test(t)
    ? formatSizeLabel(SizeKind.Pants, t) || size
    : size;
};
interface ProductImageManagementModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product | null;
  onProductUpdated?: () => void;
}
interface DeleteImageModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onConfirm: () => void;
  imageName: string;
  isLoading?: boolean;
}
interface TabPanelProps {
  children?: React.ReactNode;
  index: number;
  value: number;
  productInfoId: number;
}
function TabPanel(props: TabPanelProps) {
  const { children, value, index, productInfoId, ...other } = props;
  return (
    <div
      role="tabpanel"
      hidden={value !== index}
      id={`image-tabpanel-${productInfoId}`}
      aria-labelledby={`image-tab-${productInfoId}`}
      {...other}
    >
      {value === index && <Box sx={{ p: 3 }}>{children}</Box>}
    </div>
  );
}
const DeleteImageModal = ({
  open,
  onClose,
  onConfirm,
  imageName,
  isLoading = false,
}: DeleteImageModalProps) => {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onClose={onClose} maxWidth="xs" fullWidth>
      <DialogTitle sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
        <WarningIcon color="warning" />
        {LL.modal.deleteImage()}
      </DialogTitle>
      <DialogFormContent>
        <Typography>
          {LL.products.deleteImageConfirmMessage({ imageName })}
        </Typography>
      </DialogFormContent>
      <DialogActions>
        <Button onClick={onClose} disabled={isLoading}>
          {LL.button.cancel()}
        </Button>
        <Button
          onClick={onConfirm}
          variant="contained"
          color="error"
          loading={isLoading}
        >
          {LL.button.delete()}
        </Button>
      </DialogActions>
    </Dialog>
  );
};
export function ProductImageManagementModal({
  open,
  onClose,
  product,
  onProductUpdated,
}: ProductImageManagementModalProps) {
  // Use Zustand store instead of local state
  const {
    currentProduct,
    imageModal,
    deleteModal,
    closeImageModal,
    setSelectedTab,
    addSelectedFiles,
    removeSelectedFile,
    setUploading,
    clearSelectedFiles,
    openDeleteModal,
    closeDeleteModal,
    setDeleteModalLoading,
    updateProductImages,
  } = useAdminsProductsStore();
  const { uploadProductInfoImages, removeProductInfoImage } = useProducts();
  const { showSnackbar } = useSnackbarContext();
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  const handleTabChange = (_event: React.SyntheticEvent, newValue: number) => {
    console.log('🔄 handleTabChange called:', {
      oldValue: imageModal.selectedTab,
      newValue,
    });
    setSelectedTab(newValue);
  };
  const handleFileSelection = useCallback(
    (productInfoId: number, event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      const files = event.target.files;
      if (!files) return;
      const newFiles = Array.from(files);
      // Validate file types
      const validImageTypes = [
        'image/jpeg',
        'image/png',
        'image/gif',
        'image/webp',
      ];
      const invalidFiles = newFiles.filter(
        (file) => !validImageTypes.includes(file.type)
      );
      if (invalidFiles.length > 0) {
        showSnackbar(LL.products.onlyImageFilesAllowed(), {
          severity: 'error',
        });
        return;
      }
      // Validate file sizes (max 5MB per file)
      const maxSize = 5 * 1024 * 1024; // 5MB
      const oversizedFiles = newFiles.filter((file) => file.size > maxSize);
      if (oversizedFiles.length > 0) {
        showSnackbar(LL.products.filesExceedMaxSize(), {
          severity: 'error',
        });
        return;
      }
      addSelectedFiles(productInfoId, newFiles);
    },
    [addSelectedFiles, showSnackbar, LL]
  );
  const handleUploadImages = useCallback(
    async (productInfoId: number) => {
      const files = imageModal.selectedFiles[productInfoId];
      if (!files || files.length === 0) return;
      setUploading(productInfoId, true);
      try {
        const result = await uploadProductInfoImages(productInfoId, files);
        // Update the store with new images
        if (currentProduct) {
          const productInfo = currentProduct.productInfos.find(
            (info) => info.id === productInfoId
          );
          if (productInfo && result) {
            updateProductImages(productInfoId, result);
          }
        }
        clearSelectedFiles(productInfoId);
        showSnackbar(LL.products.imagesUploadedSuccessfully(), {
          severity: 'success',
        });
        onProductUpdated?.();
      } catch (error) {
        showSnackbar((error as Error).message, { severity: 'error' });
      } finally {
        setUploading(productInfoId, false);
      }
    },
    [
      imageModal.selectedFiles,
      uploadProductInfoImages,
      setUploading,
      clearSelectedFiles,
      showSnackbar,
      onProductUpdated,
      currentProduct,
      updateProductImages,
      LL,
    ]
  );
  const handleRemoveImage = useCallback(
    (productInfoId: number, imageUrl: string) => {
      const imageName = imageUrl.split('/').pop();
      if (!imageName) return;
      openDeleteModal(productInfoId, imageUrl, imageName);
    },
    [openDeleteModal]
  );
  const handleClose = () => {
    // Clear all selected files when closing
    Object.keys(imageModal.selectedFiles).forEach((productInfoId) => {
      clearSelectedFiles(parseInt(productInfoId));
    });
    closeImageModal();
    onClose?.();
  };
  const handleConfirmDeleteImage = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!deleteModal.productInfoId || !deleteModal.imageName) {
      closeDeleteModal();
      return;
    }
    setDeleteModalLoading(true);
    try {
      await removeProductInfoImage(
        deleteModal.productInfoId,
        deleteModal.imageName
      );
      // Update the store to remove the deleted image
      if (currentProduct) {
        const productInfo = currentProduct.productInfos.find(
          (info) => info.id === deleteModal.productInfoId
        );
        if (productInfo && productInfo.images) {
          const updatedImages = productInfo.images.filter(
            (img) =>
              deleteModal.imageName && !img.includes(deleteModal.imageName)
          );
          updateProductImages(deleteModal.productInfoId, updatedImages);
        }
      }
      showSnackbar(LL.products.imageRemovedSuccessfully(), {
        severity: 'success',
      });
      onProductUpdated?.();
    } catch (error) {
      showSnackbar((error as Error).message, { severity: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setDeleteModalLoading(false);
      closeDeleteModal();
    }
  }, [
    deleteModal.productInfoId,
    deleteModal.imageName,
    removeProductInfoImage,
    setDeleteModalLoading,
    closeDeleteModal,
    showSnackbar,
    onProductUpdated,
    currentProduct,
    updateProductImages,
    LL,
  ]);
  if (!currentProduct) {
    return null;
  }
  return (
    <>
      <Dialog
        open={imageModal.open}
        onClose={handleClose}
        maxWidth="md"
        fullWidth
      >
        <DialogTitle>
          {LL.products.manageImages()} - {currentProduct.name}
        </DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent dividers sx={{ pt: 2 }}>
          <Box sx={{ borderBottom: 1, borderColor: 'divider' }}>
            <Tabs value={imageModal.selectedTab} onChange={handleTabChange}>
              {currentProduct.productInfos.map((productInfo, index) => (
                <Tab
                  key={productInfo.id}
                  label={`${displayItemSize(productInfo.size)}${
                    productInfo.colors?.length
                      ? ` - ${formatVariantColorNames(productInfo.colors)}`
                      : ''
                  }`}
                  id={`image-tab-${productInfo.id}`}
                  aria-controls={`image-tabpanel-${productInfo.id}`}
                />
              ))}
            </Tabs>
          </Box>
          {currentProduct.productInfos.map((productInfo, index) => (
            <TabPanel
              key={productInfo.id}
              value={imageModal.selectedTab}
              index={index}
              productInfoId={productInfo.id}
            >
              <Box sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                  {LL.products.variant()}: {displayItemSize(productInfo.size)}
                  {productInfo.colors?.length
                    ? ` - ${formatVariantColorNames(productInfo.colors)}`
                    : ''}
                </Typography>
                {/* Current Images */}
                <Typography variant="subtitle1" gutterBottom>
                  {LL.products.currentImages({
                    count: productInfo.images?.length || 0,
                  })}
                </Typography>
                {productInfo.images && productInfo.images.length > 0 ? (
                  <Grid container spacing={2} sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                    {productInfo.images.map((imageUrl, imageIndex) => (
                      <Grid key={imageIndex} size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 4 }}>
                        <Card>
                          <CardMedia
                            component="img"
                            height="140"
                            image={resolveProductImageUrl(imageUrl)}
                            alt={`Product image ${imageIndex + 1}`}
                            sx={{ objectFit: 'cover' }}
                          />
                          <CardActions>
                            <IconButton
                              size="small"
                              color="error"
                              onClick={() =>
                                handleRemoveImage(productInfo.id, imageUrl)
                              }
                            >
                              <DeleteIcon />
                            </IconButton>
                          </CardActions>
                        </Card>
                      </Grid>
                    ))}
                  </Grid>
                ) : (
                  <Alert severity="info" sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                    {LL.products.noImagesUploaded()}
                  </Alert>
                )}
                {/* Add New Images */}
                <Typography variant="subtitle1" gutterBottom>
                  {LL.products.addNewImages()}
                </Typography>
                <Box sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                  <input
                    accept="image/*"
                    style={{ display: 'none' }}
                    id={`file-input-${productInfo.id}`}
                    type="file"
                    multiple
                    onChange={(e) => handleFileSelection(productInfo.id, e)}
                  />
                  <label htmlFor={`file-input-${productInfo.id}`}>
                    <Button
                      variant="outlined"
                      component="span"
                      startIcon={<AddPhotoIcon />}
                      sx={{ mr: 2 }}
                    >
                      {LL.products.selectImages()}
                    </Button>
                  </label>
                  {imageModal.selectedFiles[productInfo.id] &&
                    imageModal.selectedFiles[productInfo.id].length > 0 && (
                      <Button
                        variant="contained"
                        startIcon={<UploadIcon />}
                        onClick={() => handleUploadImages(productInfo.id)}
                        disabled={imageModal.uploading[productInfo.id]}
                      >
                        {imageModal.uploading[productInfo.id]
                          ? LL.status.uploading()
                          : LL.products.uploadImages()}
                      </Button>
                    )}
                </Box>
                {/* Selected Files Preview */}
                {imageModal.selectedFilePreviews[productInfo.id] &&
                  imageModal.selectedFilePreviews[productInfo.id].length >
                    0 && (
                    <Box>
                      <Typography variant="body2" gutterBottom>
                        {LL.products.selectedFiles({
                          count:
                            imageModal.selectedFilePreviews[productInfo.id]
                              .length,
                        })}
                      </Typography>
                      <Box
                        sx={{
                          display: 'flex',
                          flexWrap: 'wrap',
                          gap: 1,
                          mb: 2,
                        }}
                      >
                        {imageModal.selectedFilePreviews[productInfo.id].map(
                          (preview, fileIndex) => (
                            <Chip
                              key={fileIndex}
                              label={preview.file.name}
                              size="small"
                              onDelete={() => {
                                removeSelectedFile(productInfo.id, fileIndex);
                              }}
                            />
                          )
                        )}
                      </Box>
                      {/* Image Thumbnails */}
                      <Typography variant="body2" gutterBottom>
                        {LL.products.imagePreviews()}
                      </Typography>
                      <Grid container spacing={2} sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                        {imageModal.selectedFilePreviews[productInfo.id].map(
                          (preview, fileIndex) => (
                            <Grid
                              key={fileIndex}
                              size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 4 }}
                            >
                              <Card>
                                <CardMedia
                                  component="img"
                                  height="140"
                                  image={preview.url}
                                  alt={`Selected image ${fileIndex + 1}`}
                                  sx={{ objectFit: 'cover' }}
                                />
                                <CardActions>
                                  <IconButton
                                    size="small"
                                    color="error"
                                    onClick={() => {
                                      removeSelectedFile(
                                        productInfo.id,
                                        fileIndex
                                      );
                                    }}
                                  >
                                    <DeleteIcon />
                                  </IconButton>
                                </CardActions>
                              </Card>
                            </Grid>
                          )
                        )}
                      </Grid>
                    </Box>
                  )}
              </Box>
            </TabPanel>
          ))}
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={handleClose}>{LL.products.close()}</Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
      <DeleteImageModal
        open={deleteModal.open}
        onClose={closeDeleteModal}
        onConfirm={handleConfirmDeleteImage}
        imageName={deleteModal.imageName || ''}
        isLoading={deleteModal.isLoading}
      />
    </>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="libs/client/admins/screens/seller-management/src/index.spec.tsx">
import React from 'react';
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
import * as exports from './index';
vi.mock('./lib/SellerManagement', () => ({
  SellerManagement: (_props: { children?: React.ReactNode }) => (
    <div data-testid="seller-management">Seller Management</div>
  ),
  default: () => (
    <div data-testid="seller-management-default">Seller Management</div>
  ),
}));

import * as React from 'react';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import { useI18nContext } from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
interface TranslateToOtherLanguagesButtonProps {
  onClick: () => void;
  size?: 'small' | 'medium' | 'large';
  variant?: 'text' | 'outlined' | 'contained';
}
export function TranslateToOtherLanguagesButton({
  onClick,
  size = 'small',
  variant = 'outlined',
}: TranslateToOtherLanguagesButtonProps) {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  return (
    <Button size={size} variant={variant} onClick={onClick}>
      {LL.admin.translationManagement.translateToOtherLanguages()}
    </Button>
  );
}

<file path="libs/client/admins/zustand/admins-products-store/src/lib/admins-products-store.spec.ts">
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import { useAdminsProductsStore } from './admins-products-store';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
// Mock URL.createObjectURL and revokeObjectURL
global.URL.createObjectURL = vi.fn(() => 'blob:mock-url');
global.URL.revokeObjectURL = vi.fn();
const mockProduct: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product = {
  id: 1,
  name: 'Test Product',
  description: 'Test Description',
  categories: [],
  productInfos: [
    {
      id: 10,
      size: 'M',
      weight: 1.5,
      colors: [{ id: 1, name: 'Red', hexCode: '#ff0000' }],
      images: ['/uploads/image1.jpg', '/uploads/image2.jpg'],
    },
    {
      id: 20,
      size: 'L',
      weight: 1.8,
      colors: [{ id: 2, name: 'Blue', hexCode: '#0000ff' }],
      images: [],
    },
  ],
};
describe('useAdminsProductsStore', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    // Reset store state before each test
    useAdminsProductsStore.setState({
      currentProduct: null,
      imageModal: {
        open: false,
        selectedTab: 0,
        selectedFiles: {},
        selectedFilePreviews: {},
        uploading: {},
      },
      deleteModal: {
        open: false,
        productInfoId: null,
        imageUrl: null,
        imageName: null,
        isLoading: false,
      },
    });
    vi.clearAllMocks();
  });
  describe('Initial State', () => {
    it('should have correct initial state', () => {
      const state = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      expect(state.currentProduct).toBeNull();
      expect(state.imageModal.open).toBe(false);
      expect(state.imageModal.selectedTab).toBe(0);
      expect(state.deleteModal.open).toBe(false);
    });
  });
  describe('openImageModal', () => {
    it('should open image modal with product', () => {
      const { openImageModal } = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      openImageModal(mockProduct);
      const state = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      expect(state.currentProduct).toEqual(mockProduct);
      expect(state.imageModal.open).toBe(true);
      expect(state.imageModal.selectedTab).toBe(0);
    });
    it('should reset tab when resetTab is true', () => {
      // First open with tab 2
      useAdminsProductsStore.setState({
        imageModal: {
          open: true,
          selectedTab: 2,
          selectedFiles: {},
          selectedFilePreviews: {},
          uploading: {},
        },
      });
      const { openImageModal } = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      openImageModal(mockProduct, true);
      const state = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      expect(state.imageModal.selectedTab).toBe(0);
    });
    it('should preserve tab when resetTab is false', () => {
      useAdminsProductsStore.setState({
        imageModal: {
          open: true,
          selectedTab: 2,
          selectedFiles: {},
          selectedFilePreviews: {},
          uploading: {},
        },
      });
      const { openImageModal } = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      openImageModal(mockProduct, false);
      const state = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      expect(state.imageModal.selectedTab).toBe(2);
    });
    it('should clear selected files when opening modal', () => {
      useAdminsProductsStore.setState({
        imageModal: {
          open: false,
          selectedTab: 0,
          selectedFiles: { 1: [new File([], 'test.jpg')] },
          selectedFilePreviews: { 1: [] },
          uploading: { 1: false },
        },
      });
      const { openImageModal } = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      openImageModal(mockProduct);
      const state = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      expect(state.imageModal.selectedFiles).toEqual({});
      expect(state.imageModal.selectedFilePreviews).toEqual({});
    });
  });
  describe('closeImageModal', () => {
    it('should close image modal', () => {
      useAdminsProductsStore.setState({
        imageModal: {
          open: true,
          selectedTab: 1,
          selectedFiles: {},
          selectedFilePreviews: {},
          uploading: {},
        },
      });
      const { closeImageModal } = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      closeImageModal();
      const state = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      expect(state.imageModal.open).toBe(false);
    });
    it('should clear selected files when closing', () => {
      useAdminsProductsStore.setState({
        imageModal: {
          open: true,
          selectedTab: 0,
          selectedFiles: { 1: [new File([], 'test.jpg')] },
          selectedFilePreviews: { 1: [] },
          uploading: { 1: true },
        },
      });
      const { closeImageModal } = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      closeImageModal();
      const state = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      expect(state.imageModal.selectedFiles).toEqual({});
      expect(state.imageModal.selectedFilePreviews).toEqual({});
      expect(state.imageModal.uploading).toEqual({});
    });
    it('should close delete modal when closing image modal', () => {
      useAdminsProductsStore.setState({
        deleteModal: {
          open: true,
          productInfoId: 1,
          imageUrl: '/test.jpg',
          imageName: 'test.jpg',
          isLoading: false,
        },
      });
      const { closeImageModal } = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      closeImageModal();
      const state = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      expect(state.deleteModal.open).toBe(false);
    });
  });
  describe('setSelectedTab', () => {
    it('should update selected tab', () => {
      const { setSelectedTab } = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      setSelectedTab(3);
      const state = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      expect(state.imageModal.selectedTab).toBe(3);
    });
  });
  describe('addSelectedFiles', () => {
    it('should add files to selected files', () => {
      const file1 = new File(['content1'], 'test1.jpg', { type: 'image/jpeg' });
      const file2 = new File(['content2'], 'test2.jpg', { type: 'image/jpeg' });
      const { addSelectedFiles } = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      addSelectedFiles(10, [file1, file2]);
      const state = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      expect(state.imageModal.selectedFiles[10]).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(state.imageModal.selectedFilePreviews[10]).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(URL.createObjectURL).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    });
    it('should append to existing files', () => {
      const file1 = new File(['content1'], 'test1.jpg', { type: 'image/jpeg' });
      const file2 = new File(['content2'], 'test2.jpg', { type: 'image/jpeg' });
      const { addSelectedFiles } = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      addSelectedFiles(10, [file1]);
      addSelectedFiles(10, [file2]);
      const state = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      expect(state.imageModal.selectedFiles[10]).toHaveLength(2);
    });
  });
  describe('removeSelectedFile', () => {
    it('should remove file from selected files', () => {
      const file1 = new File(['content1'], 'test1.jpg', { type: 'image/jpeg' });
      const file2 = new File(['content2'], 'test2.jpg', { type: 'image/jpeg' });
      const { addSelectedFiles, removeSelectedFile } =
        useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      addSelectedFiles(10, [file1, file2]);
      removeSelectedFile(10, 0);
      const state = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      expect(state.imageModal.selectedFiles[10]).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(state.imageModal.selectedFilePreviews[10]).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(URL.revokeObjectURL).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });
    it('should handle removing from empty array', () => {
      const { removeSelectedFile } = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      removeSelectedFile(10, 0);
      const state = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      expect(state.imageModal.selectedFiles[10]).toEqual([]);
    });
  });
  describe('setUploading', () => {
    it('should set uploading state for productInfo', () => {
      const { setUploading } = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      setUploading(10, true);
      const state = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      expect(state.imageModal.uploading[10]).toBe(true);
    });
    it('should update uploading state', () => {
      const { setUploading } = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      setUploading(10, true);
      setUploading(10, false);
      const state = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      expect(state.imageModal.uploading[10]).toBe(false);
    });
  });
  describe('clearSelectedFiles', () => {
    it('should clear selected files for productInfo', () => {
      const file = new File(['content'], 'test.jpg', { type: 'image/jpeg' });
      const { addSelectedFiles, clearSelectedFiles } =
        useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      addSelectedFiles(10, [file]);
      clearSelectedFiles(10);
      const state = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      expect(state.imageModal.selectedFiles[10]).toEqual([]);
      expect(state.imageModal.selectedFilePreviews[10]).toEqual([]);
      expect(URL.revokeObjectURL).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
  describe('openDeleteModal', () => {
    it('should open delete modal with image info', () => {
      const { openDeleteModal } = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      openDeleteModal(10, '/uploads/test.jpg', 'test.jpg');
      const state = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      expect(state.deleteModal.open).toBe(true);
      expect(state.deleteModal.productInfoId).toBe(10);
      expect(state.deleteModal.imageUrl).toBe('/uploads/test.jpg');
      expect(state.deleteModal.imageName).toBe('test.jpg');
      expect(state.deleteModal.isLoading).toBe(false);
    });
  });
  describe('closeDeleteModal', () => {
    it('should close delete modal and reset state', () => {
      useAdminsProductsStore.setState({
        deleteModal: {
          open: true,
          productInfoId: 10,
          imageUrl: '/test.jpg',
          imageName: 'test.jpg',
          isLoading: true,
        },
      });
      const { closeDeleteModal } = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      closeDeleteModal();
      const state = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      expect(state.deleteModal.open).toBe(false);
      expect(state.deleteModal.productInfoId).toBeNull();
      expect(state.deleteModal.imageUrl).toBeNull();
      expect(state.deleteModal.imageName).toBeNull();
      expect(state.deleteModal.isLoading).toBe(false);
    });
  });
  describe('setDeleteModalLoading', () => {
    it('should update delete modal loading state', () => {
      const { setDeleteModalLoading } = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      setDeleteModalLoading(true);
      const state = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      expect(state.deleteModal.isLoading).toBe(true);
    });
  });
  describe('updateProductImages', () => {
    it('should update product images for specific productInfo', () => {
      useAdminsProductsStore.setState({ currentProduct: mockProduct });
      const { updateProductImages } = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      const newImages = [
        '/uploads/new1.jpg',
        '/uploads/new2.jpg',
        '/uploads/new3.jpg',
      ];
      updateProductImages(10, newImages);
      const state = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      const updatedProductInfo = state.currentProduct?.productInfos.find(
        (pi) => pi.id === 10
      );
      expect(updatedProductInfo?.images).toEqual(newImages);
    });
    it('should not update other productInfo images', () => {
      useAdminsProductsStore.setState({ currentProduct: mockProduct });
      const { updateProductImages } = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      const newImages = ['/uploads/new1.jpg'];
      updateProductImages(10, newImages);
      const state = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      const otherProductInfo = state.currentProduct?.productInfos.find(
        (pi) => pi.id === 20
      );
      expect(otherProductInfo?.images).toEqual([]);
    });
    it('should handle null currentProduct gracefully', () => {
      useAdminsProductsStore.setState({ currentProduct: null });
      const { updateProductImages } = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      updateProductImages(10, ['/uploads/new.jpg']);
      const state = useAdminsProductsStore.getState();
      expect(state.currentProduct).toBeNull();
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/admins/zustand/admins-products-store/src/lib/admins-products-store.ts">
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
// Types for the store
interface ImageModalState {
  open: boolean;
  selectedTab: number;
  selectedFiles: Record<number, File[]>;
  selectedFilePreviews: Record<number, Array<{ file: File; url: string }>>;
  uploading: Record<number, boolean>;
}
interface DeleteModalState {
  open: boolean;
  productInfoId: number | null;
  imageUrl: string | null;
  imageName: string | null;
  isLoading: boolean;
}
interface AdminsProductsStore {
  // List view state
  search: string;
  category: string;
  sort: string;
  sortOrder: 'asc' | 'desc';
  status: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductArchivedStatus;
  setSearch: (value: string) => void;
  setCategory: (value: string) => void;
  setSort: (value: string) => void;
  setSortOrder: (value: 'asc' | 'desc') => void;
  setStatus: (value: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductArchivedStatus) => void;
  // Archive dialog
  archiveDialogOpen: boolean;
  productToArchive: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product | null;
  openArchiveDialog: (product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product) => void;
  closeArchiveDialog: () => void;
  // Permanent delete dialog (admin, archived + no active selling only)
  productDeleteDialogOpen: boolean;
  productToDelete: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product | null;
  productDeleteConfirmName: string;
  openProductDeleteDialog: (product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product) => void;
  closeProductDeleteDialog: () => void;
  setProductDeleteConfirmName: (value: string) => void;
  // Seller listings dialog
  listingsProduct: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product | null;
  setListingsProduct: (product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product | null) => void;
  // Current product being managed
  currentProduct: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product | null;
  // Image management modal state
  imageModal: ImageModalState;
  // Delete confirmation modal state
  deleteModal: DeleteModalState;
  // Actions
  openImageModal: (
    product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product,
    resetTab?: boolean
  ) => void;
  closeImageModal: () => void;
  setSelectedTab: (tabIndex: number) => void;
  addSelectedFiles: (productInfoId: number, files: File[]) => void;
  removeSelectedFile: (productInfoId: number, fileIndex: number) => void;
  setUploading: (productInfoId: number, uploading: boolean) => void;
  clearSelectedFiles: (productInfoId: number) => void;
  // Delete modal actions
  openDeleteModal: (
    productInfoId: number,
    imageUrl: string,
    imageName: string
  ) => void;
  closeDeleteModal: () => void;
  setDeleteModalLoading: (loading: boolean) => void;
  // Product update actions
  updateProductImages: (productInfoId: number, images: string[]) => void;
}
export const useAdminsProductsStore = create<AdminsProductsStore>(
  (set, get) => ({
    // Initial state
    search: '',
    category: '',
    sort: '',
    sortOrder: 'asc',
    status: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductArchivedStatus.Active,
    archiveDialogOpen: false,
    productToArchive: null,
    productDeleteDialogOpen: false,
    productToDelete: null,
    productDeleteConfirmName: '',
    listingsProduct: null,
    currentProduct: null,
    imageModal: {
      open: false,
      selectedTab: 0,
      selectedFiles: {},
      selectedFilePreviews: {},
      uploading: {},
    },
    deleteModal: {
      open: false,
      productInfoId: null,
      imageUrl: null,
      imageName: null,
      isLoading: false,
    },
    setSearch: (value) => set(() => ({ search: value })),
    setCategory: (value) => set(() => ({ category: value })),
    setSort: (value) => set(() => ({ sort: value })),
    setSortOrder: (value) => set(() => ({ sortOrder: value })),
    setStatus: (value) => set(() => ({ status: value })),
    openArchiveDialog: (product) =>
      set(() => ({ archiveDialogOpen: true, productToArchive: product })),
    closeArchiveDialog: () =>
      set(() => ({ archiveDialogOpen: false, productToArchive: null })),
    openProductDeleteDialog: (product) =>
      set(() => ({
        productDeleteDialogOpen: true,
        productToDelete: product,
        productDeleteConfirmName: '',
      })),
    closeProductDeleteDialog: () =>
      set(() => ({
        productDeleteDialogOpen: false,
        productToDelete: null,
        productDeleteConfirmName: '',
      })),
    setProductDeleteConfirmName: (value) =>
      set(() => ({ productDeleteConfirmName: value })),
    setListingsProduct: (product) => set(() => ({ listingsProduct: product })),
    // Actions
    openImageModal: (product, resetTab = true) => {
      set((state) => ({
        currentProduct: product,
        imageModal: {
          ...state.imageModal,
          open: true,
          selectedTab: resetTab ? 0 : state.imageModal.selectedTab,
          selectedFiles: {},
          selectedFilePreviews: {},
          uploading: {},
        },
      }));
    },
    closeImageModal: () => {
      set((state) => ({
        imageModal: {
          ...state.imageModal,
          open: false,
          selectedFiles: {},
          selectedFilePreviews: {},
          uploading: {},
        },
        deleteModal: {
          ...state.deleteModal,
          open: false,
        },
      }));
    },
    setSelectedTab: (tabIndex) => {
      set((state) => ({
        imageModal: {
          ...state.imageModal,
          selectedTab: tabIndex,
        },
      }));
    },
    addSelectedFiles: (productInfoId, files) => {
      set((state) => {
        const currentFiles =
          state.imageModal.selectedFiles[productInfoId] || [];
        const currentPreviews =
          state.imageModal.selectedFilePreviews[productInfoId] || [];
        // Create preview URLs for new files
        const newPreviews = files.map((file) => ({
          file,
          url: URL.createObjectURL(file),
        }));
        return {
          imageModal: {
            ...state.imageModal,
            selectedFiles: {
              ...state.imageModal.selectedFiles,
              [productInfoId]: [...currentFiles, ...files],
            },
            selectedFilePreviews: {
              ...state.imageModal.selectedFilePreviews,
              [productInfoId]: [...currentPreviews, ...newPreviews],
            },
          },
        };
      });
    },
    removeSelectedFile: (productInfoId, fileIndex) => {
      set((state) => {
        const currentFiles =
          state.imageModal.selectedFiles[productInfoId] || [];
        const currentPreviews =
          state.imageModal.selectedFilePreviews[productInfoId] || [];
        // Revoke the object URL to prevent memory leaks
        if (currentPreviews[fileIndex]) {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(currentPreviews[fileIndex].url);
        }
        const newFiles = currentFiles.filter((_, index) => index !== fileIndex);
        const newPreviews = currentPreviews.filter(
          (_, index) => index !== fileIndex
        );
        return {
          imageModal: {
            ...state.imageModal,
            selectedFiles: {
              ...state.imageModal.selectedFiles,
              [productInfoId]: newFiles,
            },
            selectedFilePreviews: {
              ...state.imageModal.selectedFilePreviews,
              [productInfoId]: newPreviews,
            },
          },
        };
      });
    },
    setUploading: (productInfoId, uploading) => {
      set((state) => ({
        imageModal: {
          ...state.imageModal,
          uploading: {
            ...state.imageModal.uploading,
            [productInfoId]: uploading,
          },
        },
      }));
    },
    clearSelectedFiles: (productInfoId) => {
      set((state) => {
        const currentPreviews =
          state.imageModal.selectedFilePreviews[productInfoId] || [];
        // Revoke all object URLs to prevent memory leaks
        currentPreviews.forEach((preview) => {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(preview.url);
        });
        return {
          imageModal: {
            ...state.imageModal,
            selectedFiles: {
              ...state.imageModal.selectedFiles,
              [productInfoId]: [],
            },
            selectedFilePreviews: {
              ...state.imageModal.selectedFilePreviews,
              [productInfoId]: [],
            },
          },
        };
      });
    },
    openDeleteModal: (productInfoId, imageUrl, imageName) => {
      set((state) => ({
        deleteModal: {
          open: true,
          productInfoId,
          imageUrl,
          imageName,
          isLoading: false,
        },
      }));
    },
    closeDeleteModal: () => {
      set((state) => ({
        deleteModal: {
          ...state.deleteModal,
          open: false,
          productInfoId: null,
          imageUrl: null,
          imageName: null,
          isLoading: false,
        },
      }));
    },
    setDeleteModalLoading: (loading) => {
      set((state) => ({
        deleteModal: {
          ...state.deleteModal,
          isLoading: loading,
        },
      }));
    },
    updateProductImages: (productInfoId, images) => {
      set((state) => {
        if (!state.currentProduct) return state;
        const updatedProductInfos = state.currentProduct.productInfos.map(
          (info) => (info.id === productInfoId ? { ...info, images } : info)
        );
        return {
          currentProduct: {
            ...state.currentProduct,
            productInfos: updatedProductInfos,
          },
        };
      });
    },
  })
);
</file>

import { Link as RouterLink } from 'react-router-dom';

export function CustomersFooter({
