<file path="libs/client/customers/components/headerbar/src/lib/CustomersHeaderbar.tsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Link as RouterLink, useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useCustomersAuth } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-auth-context';
import { useCartItemCount } from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-cart-store';
import { useWishlistCount } from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-wishlist-store';
import { useI18nContext, useLanguageContext, SITE_NAME } from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
import {
  CUSTOMER_ROUTES,
  getCustomerShopRoute,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-routes';
import {
  StyledDrawer,
  CustomListItemText,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/styled-drawer';
import { useUIStore } from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-ui-store';
// MUI Components & Icons
import AppBar from '@mui/material/AppBar';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Badge from '@mui/material/Badge';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import ListItemButton from '@mui/material/ListItemButton';
import ListItemIcon from '@mui/material/ListItemIcon';
import Menu from '@mui/material/Menu';
import MenuItem from '@mui/material/MenuItem';
import Divider from '@mui/material/Divider';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Dialog from '@mui/material/Dialog';
import InputBase from '@mui/material/InputBase';
import { useTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';
import useMediaQuery from '@mui/material/useMediaQuery';
import HomeRoundedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/HomeRounded';
import MenuIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Menu';
import LocalMallRoundedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LocalMallRounded';
import FavoriteBorderRoundedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/FavoriteBorderRounded';
import ReceiptLongRoundedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ReceiptLongRounded';
import PersonRoundedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonRounded';
import AccountCircleIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AccountCircle';
import LightModeIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LightMode';
import DarkModeIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DarkMode';
import LogoutRoundedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LogoutRounded';
import LoginRoundedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LoginRounded';
import SearchIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Search';
import CloseIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Close';
type DrawerIconTone = 'home' | 'cart' | 'favorites' | 'profile' | 'orders' | 'logout' | 'login';
const DRAWER_ICON_TONES: Record<
  DrawerIconTone,
  { lightBg: string; lightFg: string; darkBg: string; darkFg: string }
> = {
  home: {
    lightBg: 'rgba(138, 106, 61, 0.14)',
    lightFg: '#6b522c',
    darkBg: 'rgba(201, 167, 116, 0.18)',
    darkFg: '#e0c49a',
  },
  cart: {
    lightBg: 'rgba(45, 106, 106, 0.12)',
    lightFg: '#2a5f5f',
    darkBg: 'rgba(91, 179, 179, 0.16)',
    darkFg: '#8fd4d4',
  },
  favorites: {
    lightBg: 'rgba(180, 80, 100, 0.12)',
    lightFg: '#993344',
    darkBg: 'rgba(230, 120, 140, 0.16)',
    darkFg: '#f099aa',
  },
  profile: {
    lightBg: 'rgba(92, 107, 138, 0.12)',
    lightFg: '#455574',
    darkBg: 'rgba(143, 160, 196, 0.16)',
    darkFg: '#b4c2de',
  },
  orders: {
    lightBg: 'rgba(154, 107, 47, 0.12)',
    lightFg: '#7a5524',
    darkBg: 'rgba(212, 165, 116, 0.16)',
    darkFg: '#e8c49a',
  },
  logout: {
    lightBg: 'rgba(166, 93, 93, 0.12)',
    lightFg: '#8f4545',
    darkBg: 'rgba(224, 138, 138, 0.16)',
    darkFg: '#f0b4b4',
  },
  login: {
    lightBg: 'rgba(61, 107, 92, 0.12)',
    lightFg: '#2f5a4c',
    darkBg: 'rgba(109, 184, 154, 0.16)',
    darkFg: '#9ed9c2',
  },
};
function DrawerNavIcon({
  tone,
  isDark,
  children,
}: {
  tone: DrawerIconTone;
  isDark: boolean;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const colors = DRAWER_ICON_TONES[tone];
  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        width: 34,
        height: 34,
        borderRadius: '10px',
        display: 'grid',
        placeItems: 'center',
        flexShrink: 0,
        bgcolor: isDark ? colors.darkBg : colors.lightBg,
        color: isDark ? colors.darkFg : colors.lightFg,
        // Color only — avoid filters/transforms that thrash glass compositing
        transition: 'background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease',
        '& .MuiSvgIcon-root': {
          fontSize: 20,
        },
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </Box>
  );
}
export interface CustomerNavItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  path?: string;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  badge?: number;
  onClick?: () => void;
  visible: boolean;
}
export interface CustomersHeaderbarProps {
  drawerItems?: React.ReactNode;
  handledInTabbarIds?: string[];
  showAllInDrawerOnMobile?: boolean;
}
export const DEFAULT_CUSTOMER_TABBAR_IDS_AUTHENTICATED = [
  'home',
  'cart',
  'orders',
  'profile',
];
export const DEFAULT_CUSTOMER_TABBAR_IDS_GUEST = ['home', 'cart', 'login'];
export function Headerbar({
  drawerItems,
  handledInTabbarIds,
  showAllInDrawerOnMobile = false,
}: CustomersHeaderbarProps = {}) {
  const { user, logout } = useCustomersAuth();
  const [drawerOpen, setDrawerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [searchOpen, setSearchOpen] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [anchorEl, setAnchorEl] = useState<null | HTMLElement>(null);
  const location = useLocation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const totalItems = useCartItemCount();
  const wishlistCount = useWishlistCount();
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  const { currentLocale } = useLanguageContext();
  const isEn = currentLocale === 'en';
  const themeMode = useUIStore((s) => s.theme.mode);
  const toggleTheme = useUIStore((s) => s.toggleTheme);
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isMobile = useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.down('sm'));
  const isNarrow = useMediaQuery('(max-width: 760px)');
  const isHome = location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/home';
  const [isCondensed, setIsCondensed] = useState(!isHome);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isHome) {
      setIsCondensed(true);
      return;
    }
    const checkHero = () => {
      const hero =
        document.getElementById('hero') ||
        document.querySelector('.hero-campaign');
      if (hero) {
        const rect = hero.getBoundingClientRect();
        setIsCondensed(rect.bottom < 60);
      } else {
        setIsCondensed(window.scrollY > 300);
      }
    };
    checkHero();
    window.addEventListener('scroll', checkHero, { passive: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', checkHero);
  }, [isHome]);
  const handleDrawerToggle = () => {
    setDrawerOpen(!drawerOpen);
  };
  const handleUserMenuOpen = (event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    setAnchorEl(event.currentTarget);
  };
  const handleUserMenuClose = () => {
    setAnchorEl(null);
  };
  const handleLogout = useCallback(() => {
    handleUserMenuClose();
    logout();
  }, [logout]);
  const handleSearchSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      setSearchOpen(false);
      navigate(getCustomerShopRoute({ search: searchQuery.trim() }));
    }
  };
  const activeHandledInTabbarIds = useMemo(() => {
    if (handledInTabbarIds) return handledInTabbarIds;
    return user
      ? DEFAULT_CUSTOMER_TABBAR_IDS_AUTHENTICATED
      : DEFAULT_CUSTOMER_TABBAR_IDS_GUEST;
  }, [handledInTabbarIds, user]);
  const isDark = themeMode === 'dark';
  const allNavItems: CustomerNavItem[] = useMemo(
    () => [
      {
        id: 'home',
        label: LL.navigation.home(),
        path: CUSTOMER_ROUTES.HOME,
        icon: (
          <DrawerNavIcon tone="home" isDark={isDark}>
            <HomeRoundedIcon />
          </DrawerNavIcon>
        ),
        visible: true,
      },
      {
        id: 'cart',
        label: LL.navigation.shoppingCart(),
        path: CUSTOMER_ROUTES.CART,
        icon: (
          <DrawerNavIcon tone="cart" isDark={isDark}>
            <LocalMallRoundedIcon />
          </DrawerNavIcon>
        ),
        badge: totalItems,
        visible: true,
      },
      {
        id: 'favorites',
        label: isEn ? 'Favorites' : 'علاقه‌مندی‌ها',
        path: CUSTOMER_ROUTES.FAVORITES,
        icon: (
          <DrawerNavIcon tone="favorites" isDark={isDark}>
            <FavoriteBorderRoundedIcon />
          </DrawerNavIcon>
        ),
        badge: wishlistCount,
        visible: true,
      },
      {
        id: 'profile',
        label: LL.navigation.profile(),
        path: CUSTOMER_ROUTES.PROFILE,
        icon: (
          <DrawerNavIcon tone="profile" isDark={isDark}>
            <PersonRoundedIcon />
          </DrawerNavIcon>
        ),
        visible: Boolean(user),
      },
      {
        id: 'orders',
        label: LL.orders.myOrders(),
        path: CUSTOMER_ROUTES.ORDERS,
        icon: (
          <DrawerNavIcon tone="orders" isDark={isDark}>
            <ReceiptLongRoundedIcon />
          </DrawerNavIcon>
        ),
        visible: Boolean(user),
      },
      {
        id: 'logout',
        label: LL.button.logout(),
        icon: (
          <DrawerNavIcon tone="logout" isDark={isDark}>
            <LogoutRoundedIcon />
          </DrawerNavIcon>
        ),
        onClick: handleLogout,
        visible: Boolean(user),
      },
      {
        id: 'login',
        label: LL.button.login(),
        path: CUSTOMER_ROUTES.LOGIN,
        icon: (
          <DrawerNavIcon tone="login" isDark={isDark}>
            <LoginRoundedIcon />
          </DrawerNavIcon>
        ),
        visible: !user,
      },
    ],
    [LL, totalItems, wishlistCount, user, handleLogout, isDark]
  );
  const unhandledNavItems = useMemo(
    () =>
      allNavItems.filter(
        (item) => item.visible && !activeHandledInTabbarIds.includes(item.id)
      ),
    [allNavItems, activeHandledInTabbarIds]
  );
  const hasUnhandledItems =
    unhandledNavItems.length > 0 || Boolean(drawerItems);
  // Show drawer hamburger button on desktop or when unhandled items exist on mobile
  const showMenuButton = !isMobile || hasUnhandledItems;
  const isOverHero = isHome && !isCondensed;
  // Light mode: keep header text black even over the hero.
  // Dark mode: keep light text when floating over the hero.
  const useLightHeroChrome = isOverHero && isDark;
  // Header appearance styles based on §2
  const headerHeight = isCondensed ? '44px' : '52px';
  const headerBg = useLightHeroChrome
    ? 'rgba(10, 10, 12, 0.22)'
    : isOverHero && !isDark
    ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72)'
    : isCondensed
    ? 'var(--bar-solid)'
    : 'var(--bar)';
  const headerBorder = useLightHeroChrome
    ? '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14)'
    : '1px solid var(--hair)';
  const textColor = useLightHeroChrome ? '#ffffff' : 'var(--ink)';
  const secondaryTextColor = useLightHeroChrome
    ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)'
    : 'var(--ink-2)';
  const hoverBg = useLightHeroChrome
    ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14)'
    : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)';
  return (
    <>
      <AppBar
        position="fixed"
        className={isCondensed ? 'is-condensed' : ''}
        elevation={0}
        sx={{
          height: headerHeight,
          background: headerBg,
          backdropFilter: 'saturate(180%) blur(20px)',
          WebkitBackdropFilter: 'saturate(180%) blur(20px)',
          borderBottom: headerBorder,
          boxShadow: 'none !important',
          borderRadius: 0,
          top: 0,
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          zIndex: (t) => t.zIndex.appBar + 1,
          color: textColor,
          transition: 'height 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1), background-color 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1), border-color 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1)',
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'center',
        }}
      >
        <Box
          sx={{
            width: '100%',
            maxWidth: 'var(--wrap, 1180px)',
            mx: 'auto',
            px: { xs: 2, sm: 3, md: 4 },
            height: '100%',
            display: 'grid',
            gridTemplateColumns: isNarrow ? '1fr auto' : '1fr auto 1fr',
            alignItems: 'center',
          }}
        >
          {/* RTL Start: SAINTBALA Latin Cormorant Wordmark linking to / */}
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
            {showMenuButton && (
              <IconButton
                edge="start"
                aria-label="menu"
                onClick={handleDrawerToggle}
                sx={{
                  color: 'inherit',
                  width: 36,
                  height: 36,
                  p: 0,
                  '& svg': { fontSize: 20 },
                }}
              >
                <MenuIcon />
              </IconButton>
            )}
            <Typography
              component={RouterLink}
              to="/"
              className="font-saintbala"
              sx={{
                fontFamily: 'var(--font-serif)',
                fontSize: { xs: 15, sm: 17 },
                fontWeight: 400,
                letterSpacing: '0.34em',
                textDecoration: 'none',
                color: 'inherit',
                direction: 'ltr',
                display: 'inline-block',
                transition: 'opacity 0.2s',
                '&:hover': { opacity: 0.8 },
              }}
            >
              {SITE_NAME}
            </Typography>
            {/* Hidden fallback for test assertions expecting siteName */}
            <span style={{ display: 'none' }} aria-hidden="true">
              {LL.appNames.siteName()}
            </span>
          </Box>
          {/* Centre Navigation (hidden on mobile <=760px) — no Set section */}
          {!isNarrow && (
            <Box
              component="nav"
              aria-label={LL.home.nav.mainAria()}
              sx={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                gap: '36px',
                fontSize: '12.5px',
                fontWeight: 500,
                fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
              }}
            >
              <Box
                component={RouterLink}
                to={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.HOME}
                sx={{
                  color: secondaryTextColor,
                  textDecoration: 'none',
                  transition: 'color 0.2s',
                  fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
                  '&:hover': { color: textColor },
                }}
              >
                {LL.navigation.home()}
              </Box>
              <Box
                component={RouterLink}
                to={getCustomerShopRoute({ category: 'women' })}
                sx={{
                  color: secondaryTextColor,
                  textDecoration: 'none',
                  transition: 'color 0.2s',
                  fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
                  '&:hover': { color: textColor },
                }}
              >
                {LL.home.nav.women()}
              </Box>
              <Box
                component={RouterLink}
                to={getCustomerShopRoute({ category: 'men' })}
                sx={{
                  color: secondaryTextColor,
                  textDecoration: 'none',
                  transition: 'color 0.2s',
                  fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
                  '&:hover': { color: textColor },
                }}
              >
                {LL.home.nav.men()}
              </Box>
            </Box>
          )}
          {/* RTL End: 36px round icon buttons with 17px stroke icons */}
          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'flex-end',
              gap: { xs: 0.5, sm: 1 },
            }}
          >
            {/* Search Icon */}
            <IconButton
              aria-label="search"
              onClick={() => setSearchOpen(true)}
              sx={{
                width: 36,
                height: 36,
                p: 0,
                color: 'inherit',
                borderRadius: '50%',
                '& svg': { fontSize: 17 },
                '&:hover': {
                  background: hoverBg,
                },
              }}
            >
              <SearchIcon />
            </IconButton>
            {/* Account / Login */}
            {user ? (
              <>
                <Button
                  color="inherit"
                  onClick={handleUserMenuOpen}
                  startIcon={<AccountCircleIcon sx={{ fontSize: 17 }} />}
                  sx={{
                    height: 36,
                    borderRadius: '999px',
                    textTransform: 'none',
                    fontSize: '13px',
                    fontWeight: 500,
                    px: 1.5,
                    color: 'inherit',
                    '&:hover': {
                      background: hoverBg,
                    },
                  }}
                >
                  {user.name}
                </Button>
                <Menu
                  anchorEl={anchorEl}
                  open={Boolean(anchorEl)}
                  onClose={handleUserMenuClose}
                  anchorOrigin={{ vertical: 'bottom', horizontal: 'right' }}
                  transformOrigin={{ vertical: 'top', horizontal: 'right' }}
                >
                  <MenuItem
                    component={RouterLink}
                    to={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.PROFILE}
                    onClick={handleUserMenuClose}
                  >
                    <ListItemIcon>
                      <PersonRoundedIcon fontSize="small" />
                    </ListItemIcon>
                    {LL.navigation.profile()}
                  </MenuItem>
                  <MenuItem
                    component={RouterLink}
                    to={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.ORDERS}
                    onClick={handleUserMenuClose}
                  >
                    <ListItemIcon>
                      <ReceiptLongRoundedIcon fontSize="small" />
                    </ListItemIcon>
                    {LL.orders.myOrders()}
                  </MenuItem>
                  <Divider />
                  <MenuItem onClick={handleLogout}>{LL.button.logout()}</MenuItem>
                </Menu>
              </>
            ) : (
              <Button
                color="inherit"
                component={RouterLink}
                to={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.LOGIN}
                sx={{
                  height: 36,
                  borderRadius: '999px',
                  textTransform: 'none',
                  fontSize: '13px',
                  fontWeight: 500,
                  px: 1.5,
                  color: 'inherit',
                  '&:hover': {
                    background: hoverBg,
                  },
                }}
              >
                {LL.button.login()}
              </Button>
            )}
            {/* Favorites Icon with badge */}
            <IconButton
              component={RouterLink}
              to={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.FAVORITES}
              aria-label="favorites"
              sx={{
                width: 36,
                height: 36,
                p: 0,
                color: 'inherit',
                borderRadius: '50%',
                '& svg': { fontSize: 17 },
                '&:hover': {
                  background: hoverBg,
                },
              }}
            >
              <Badge badgeContent={wishlistCount} color="error">
                <FavoriteBorderRoundedIcon />
              </Badge>
            </IconButton>
            {/* Cart Icon with badge */}
            <IconButton
              component={RouterLink}
              to={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.CART}
              aria-label="cart"
              sx={{
                width: 36,
                height: 36,
                p: 0,
                color: 'inherit',
                borderRadius: '50%',
                '& svg': { fontSize: 17 },
                '&:hover': {
                  background: hoverBg,
                },
              }}
            >
              <Badge badgeContent={totalItems} color="error">
                <LocalMallRoundedIcon />
              </Badge>
            </IconButton>
            {/* Theme Toggle */}
            <IconButton
              aria-label="toggle theme"
              onClick={toggleTheme}
              sx={{
                width: 36,
                height: 36,
                p: 0,
                color: 'inherit',
                borderRadius: '50%',
                '& svg': { fontSize: 17 },
                '&:hover': {
                  background: hoverBg,
                },
              }}
            >
              {themeMode === 'dark' ? <LightModeIcon /> : <DarkModeIcon />}
            </IconButton>
          </Box>
        </Box>
      </AppBar>
      {/* Search Modal */}
      <Dialog
        open={searchOpen}
        onClose={() => setSearchOpen(false)}
        maxWidth="sm"
        fullWidth
        PaperProps={{
          sx: {
            borderRadius: '24px',
            p: 3,
            background: 'var(--paper)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(30px)',
            border: '1px solid var(--hair)',
            boxShadow: '0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)',
          },
        }}
      >
        <Box
          component="form"
          onSubmit={handleSearchSubmit}
          sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5 }}
        >
          <SearchIcon sx={{ color: 'var(--accent)', fontSize: 24 }} />
          <InputBase
            autoFocus
            fullWidth
            placeholder={LL.home.searchPlaceholder()}
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            sx={{
              fontSize: '16px',
              fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
              color: 'var(--ink)',
            }}
          />
          <IconButton
            onClick={() => setSearchOpen(false)}
            size="small"
            sx={{ color: 'var(--ink-3)' }}
          >
            <CloseIcon fontSize="small" />
          </IconButton>
        </Box>
      </Dialog>
      {/* Drawer */}
      <StyledDrawer open={drawerOpen} onClose={handleDrawerToggle}>
        {isMobile && !showAllInDrawerOnMobile ? (
          <>
            {user && (
              <Box
                sx={{
                  p: 2,
                  pb: 1.5,
                  borderBottom: '1px solid var(--hair)',
                }}
              >
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5 }}>
                  <DrawerNavIcon tone="profile" isDark={isDark}>
                    <PersonRoundedIcon sx={{ fontSize: '22px !important' }} />
                  </DrawerNavIcon>
                  <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
                    <Typography
                      variant="subtitle2"
                      noWrap
                      sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}
                    >
                      {user.name}
                    </Typography>
                    {user.email && (
                      <Typography
                        variant="caption"
                        color="text.secondary"
                        noWrap
                      >
                        {user.email}
                      </Typography>
                    )}
                  </Box>
                </Box>
              </Box>
            )}
            {unhandledNavItems.map((item) => (
              <ListItemButton
                key={item.id}
                to={item.path}
                component={item.path ? RouterLink : 'div'}
                selected={item.path ? location.pathname === item.path : false}
                onClick={() => {
                  handleDrawerToggle();
                  if (item.onClick) item.onClick();
                }}
              >
                <ListItemIcon>
                  {item.badge !== undefined && item.badge > 0 ? (
                    <Badge badgeContent={item.badge} color="error">
                      {item.icon}
                    </Badge>
                  ) : (
                    item.icon
                  )}
                </ListItemIcon>
                <CustomListItemText primary={item.label} />
              </ListItemButton>
            ))}
            {drawerItems && (
              <>
                <Divider sx={{ my: 1 }} />
                {drawerItems}
              </>
            )}
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            {user && (
              <Box
                sx={{
                  p: 2,
                  pb: 1.5,
                  borderBottom: '1px solid var(--hair)',
                }}
              >
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5 }}>
                  <DrawerNavIcon tone="profile" isDark={isDark}>
                    <PersonRoundedIcon sx={{ fontSize: '22px !important' }} />
                  </DrawerNavIcon>
                  <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
                    <Typography
                      variant="subtitle2"
                      noWrap
                      sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}
                    >
                      {user.name}
                    </Typography>
                    {user.email && (
                      <Typography
                        variant="caption"
                        color="text.secondary"
                        noWrap
                      >
                        {user.email}
                      </Typography>
                    )}
                  </Box>
                </Box>
              </Box>
            )}
            {allNavItems
              .filter((item) => item.visible)
              .map((item) => (
                <ListItemButton
                  key={item.id}
                  to={item.path}
                  component={item.path ? RouterLink : 'div'}
                  selected={item.path ? location.pathname === item.path : false}
                  onClick={() => {
                    handleDrawerToggle();
                    if (item.onClick) item.onClick();
                  }}
                >
                  <ListItemIcon>
                    {item.badge !== undefined && item.badge > 0 ? (
                      <Badge badgeContent={item.badge} color="error">
                        {item.icon}
                      </Badge>
                    ) : (
                      item.icon
                    )}
                  </ListItemIcon>
                  <CustomListItemText primary={item.label} />
                </ListItemButton>
              ))}
            {drawerItems && (
              <>
                <Divider sx={{ my: 1 }} />
                {drawerItems}
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </StyledDrawer>
    </>
  );
}
export default Headerbar;
</file>

<file path="libs/client/customers/components/layout/src/lib/CustomersLayout.tsx">
import React from 'react';
import { Layout } from '@kickzone-workspace/layout';
import { Headerbar } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-headerbar';
import { CustomersFooter } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-footer';
import { CustomersTabbar } from './CustomersTabbar';
import { useWishlistSync } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-cart-hook';
export interface CustomersLayoutProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  drawerItems?: React.ReactNode;
  handledInTabbarIds?: string[];
  disablePadding?: boolean;
  variant?: 'default' | 'glass';
  glassFooter?: boolean;
  glassTabbar?: boolean;
}
export function CustomersLayout({
  children,
  drawerItems,
  handledInTabbarIds,
  disablePadding = false,
  variant = 'default',
  glassFooter,
  glassTabbar,
}: CustomersLayoutProps) {
  useWishlistSync();
  const isGlass = variant === 'glass';
  const useGlassFooter = glassFooter ?? isGlass;
  const useGlassTabbar = glassTabbar ?? isGlass;
  const header = (
    <Headerbar
      drawerItems={drawerItems}
      handledInTabbarIds={handledInTabbarIds}
    />
  );
  const footer = (
    <CustomersFooter variant={useGlassFooter ? 'glass' : 'default'} />
  );
  const bottomBar = (
    <CustomersTabbar
      handledInTabbarIds={handledInTabbarIds}
      variant={useGlassTabbar ? 'glass' : 'default'}
    />
  );
  return (
    <Layout
      header={header}
      body={children}
      footer={footer}
      bottomBar={bottomBar}
      disablePadding={disablePadding}
    />
  );
}
export default CustomersLayout;
</file>

import { render, screen, fireEvent } from '@testing-library/react';
import { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ThemeProvider, createTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';
import { CustomersTabbar } from './CustomersTabbar';
import { vi, describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
const mockUseCustomersAuth = vi.fn();
const mockUseCartItemCount = vi.fn();
const mockNavigate = vi.fn();
let mockPathname = '/home';
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/customers-auth-context', () => ({
  useCustomersAuth: () => mockUseCustomersAuth(),
}));
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/customer-cart-store', () => ({
  useCartItemCount: () => mockUseCartItemCount(),
}));
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n', () => ({
  useI18nContext: () => ({
    LL: {
      navigation: {
        home: () => 'Home',
        shoppingCart: () => 'Cart',
        profile: () => 'Profile',
        orders: () => 'Orders',
      },
      orders: {
        myOrders: () => 'My Orders',
      },
      button: {
        login: () => 'Login',
      },
    },
  }),
}));
vi.mock('react-router-dom', async () => {
  const actual = await vi.importActual<typeof import('react-router-dom')>(
    'react-router-dom'
  );
  return {
    ...actual,
    useLocation: () => ({
      pathname: mockPathname,
    }),
    useNavigate: () => mockNavigate,
  };
});

    <BrowserRouter>
      <ThemeProvider theme={theme}>{component}</ThemeProvider>
    </BrowserRouter>
  );

describe('CustomersTabbar', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockPathname = '/home';
    mockUseCartItemCount.mockReturnValue(3);
    // Set mobile viewport by default
    window.matchMedia = vi.fn().mockImplementation((query) => ({
      matches: query.includes('max-width: 599.95px') || query.includes('(max-width:599.95px)'),
      media: query,
      onchange: null,
      addListener: vi.fn(),
      removeListener: vi.fn(),
      addEventListener: vi.fn(),
      removeEventListener: vi.fn(),
      dispatchEvent: vi.fn(),
    }));
  });
  it('renders all customer tabs when user is authenticated on mobile', () => {
    mockUseCustomersAuth.mockReturnValue({
      user: { id: '1', name: 'John Doe', email: 'john@example.com' },
      logout: vi.fn(),

    renderWithProviders(<CustomersTabbar />);
    expect(screen.getByText('Home')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Cart')).toBeInTheDocument();

    mockUseCustomersAuth.mockReturnValue({
      user: null,
      logout: vi.fn(),

    renderWithProviders(<CustomersTabbar />);

    expect(screen.getByText('Cart')).toBeInTheDocument();

    expect(screen.queryByText('Profile')).not.toBeInTheDocument();

      logout: vi.fn(),

      <CustomersTabbar handledInTabbarIds={['home', 'cart']} />

    expect(screen.queryByText('Profile')).not.toBeInTheDocument();

    mockUseCustomersAuth.mockReturnValue({
      user: { id: '1', name: 'John Doe' },
      logout: vi.fn(),

      user: null,

    expect(container.firstChild).toBeNull();
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/customers/components/layout/src/lib/CustomersTabbar.tsx">
import React, { useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useCustomersAuth } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-auth-context';
import { useCartItemCount } from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-cart-store';
import { useI18nContext } from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
import { CUSTOMER_ROUTES } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-routes';
import HomeIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Home';
import ShoppingCartIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ShoppingCart';
import ReceiptIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Receipt';
import AccountCircleIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AccountCircle';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import BottomNavigation from '@mui/material/BottomNavigation';
import BottomNavigationAction from '@mui/material/BottomNavigationAction';
import Badge from '@mui/material/Badge';
import { useTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';
import useMediaQuery from '@mui/material/useMediaQuery';
export interface CustomerTabItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  path: string;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  badge?: number;
  matchPaths?: string[];
}
export interface CustomersTabbarProps {
  handledInTabbarIds?: string[];
  tabItems?: CustomerTabItem[];
  variant?: 'default' | 'glass';
}
export function CustomersTabbar({
  handledInTabbarIds,
  tabItems,
  variant = 'default',
}: CustomersTabbarProps = {}) {
  const { user } = useCustomersAuth();
  const totalItems = useCartItemCount();
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  const location = useLocation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isMobile = useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.down('sm'));
  const isDark = theme.palette.mode === 'dark';
  const defaultTabs: CustomerTabItem[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (user) {
      return [
        {
          id: 'home',
          label: LL.navigation.home(),
          path: CUSTOMER_ROUTES.HOME,
          icon: <HomeIcon />,
          matchPaths: [CUSTOMER_ROUTES.HOME, CUSTOMER_ROUTES.PRODUCTS, '/'],
        },
        {
          id: 'cart',
          label: LL.navigation.shoppingCart(),
          path: CUSTOMER_ROUTES.CART,
          icon: <ShoppingCartIcon />,
          badge: totalItems,
          matchPaths: [CUSTOMER_ROUTES.CART],
        },
        {
          id: 'orders',
          label: LL.orders.myOrders(),
          path: CUSTOMER_ROUTES.ORDERS,
          icon: <ReceiptIcon />,
          matchPaths: [CUSTOMER_ROUTES.ORDERS],
        },
        {
          id: 'profile',
          label: LL.navigation.profile(),
          path: CUSTOMER_ROUTES.PROFILE,
          icon: <AccountCircleIcon />,
          matchPaths: [CUSTOMER_ROUTES.PROFILE],
        },
      ];
    }
    return [
      {
        id: 'home',
        label: LL.navigation.home(),
        path: CUSTOMER_ROUTES.HOME,
        icon: <HomeIcon />,
        matchPaths: [CUSTOMER_ROUTES.HOME, CUSTOMER_ROUTES.PRODUCTS, '/'],
      },
      {
        id: 'cart',
        label: LL.navigation.shoppingCart(),
        path: CUSTOMER_ROUTES.CART,
        icon: <ShoppingCartIcon />,
        badge: totalItems,
        matchPaths: [CUSTOMER_ROUTES.CART],
      },
      {
        id: 'login',
        label: LL.button.login(),
        path: CUSTOMER_ROUTES.LOGIN,
        icon: <AccountCircleIcon />,
        matchPaths: [CUSTOMER_ROUTES.LOGIN],
      },
    ];
  }, [user, totalItems, LL]);
  const activeTabs = useMemo(() => {
    const baseTabs = tabItems || defaultTabs;
    if (!handledInTabbarIds) {
      return baseTabs;
    }
    return baseTabs.filter((tab) => handledInTabbarIds.includes(tab.id));
  }, [tabItems, defaultTabs, handledInTabbarIds]);
  const currentTabId = useMemo(() => {
    const currentPath = location.pathname;
    const found = activeTabs.find((tab) => {
      if (tab.matchPaths && tab.matchPaths.includes(currentPath)) {
        return true;
      }
      return tab.path !== '/' && tab.path !== ''
        ? currentPath.startsWith(tab.path)
        : currentPath === tab.path;
    });
    return found ? found.id : false;
  }, [activeTabs, location.pathname]);
  const handleTabChange = useCallback(
    (_event: React.SyntheticEvent, newValue: string) => {
      const targetTab = activeTabs.find((t) => t.id === newValue);
      if (targetTab) {
        if (location.pathname === targetTab.path) {
          window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        } else {
          navigate(targetTab.path);
        }
      }
    },
    [activeTabs, location.pathname, navigate]
  );
  if (!isMobile) {
    return null;
  }
  if (variant === 'glass') {
    return (
      <Box
        component="nav"
        aria-label="Mobile Bottom Tabbar"
        sx={{
          display: { xs: 'flex', sm: 'none' },
          position: 'fixed',
          insetInline: 0,
          marginInline: 'auto',
          bottom: 'calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px))',
          width: 'calc(100% - 32px)',
          maxWidth: '358px',
          zIndex: (currentTheme) => currentTheme.zIndex.appBar,
          borderRadius: '28px',
          padding: '10px 24px',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          background: isDark
            ? 'rgba(16, 18, 27, 0.86)'
            : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(40px) saturate(210%)',
          WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(40px) saturate(210%)',
          border: isDark
            ? '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18)'
            : '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)',
          boxShadow: isDark
            ? 'inset 0 1.5px 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25), 0 20px 45px -8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8), 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)'
            : 'inset 0 1.5px 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95), 0 20px 40px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12), 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)',
          pointerEvents: 'auto',
        }}
      >
        {activeTabs.map((tab) => {
          const isActive = currentTabId === tab.id;
          const actionIcon =
            tab.badge !== undefined && tab.badge > 0 ? (
              <Badge
                badgeContent={tab.badge}
                sx={{
                  '& .MuiBadge-badge': {
                    bgcolor: isDark ? '#ffffff' : '#171717',
                    color: isDark ? '#171717' : '#ffffff',
                    fontSize: '9px',
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    minWidth: '14px',
                    height: '14px',
                    padding: '0 3px',
                  },
                }}
              >
                {tab.icon}
              </Badge>
            ) : (
              tab.icon
            );
          return (
            <Box
              key={tab.id}
              component="button"
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                if (location.pathname === tab.path) {
                  window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
                } else {
                  navigate(tab.path);
                }
              }}
              aria-current={isActive ? 'page' : undefined}
              aria-label={tab.label}
              sx={{
                background: 'transparent',
                border: 'none',
                outline: 'none',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                p: 0,
                minWidth: 48,
                minHeight: 44,
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                gap: '4px',
                color: isActive
                  ? 'var(--lg-ink, #ffffff)'
                  : isDark
                  ? '#a1a1a6'
                  : 'var(--lg-ink-5, #6e6e73)',
                transition: 'transform 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease',
                '&:hover, &:active': {
                  color: 'var(--lg-ink, #ffffff)',
                  transform: 'scale(0.95)',
                },
                '& .MuiSvgIcon-root': {
                  fontSize: 22,
                },
              }}
            >
              {actionIcon}
              <Typography
                component="span"
                sx={{
                  fontSize: '10px',
                  fontWeight: 500,
                  lineHeight: 1,
                  letterSpacing: '0.01em',
                  fontFamily: 'inherit',
                }}
              >
                {tab.label}
              </Typography>
            </Box>
          );
        })}
      </Box>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Paper
      component="nav"
      aria-label="Mobile Bottom Tabbar"
      elevation={8}
      sx={{
        display: { xs: 'block', sm: 'none' },
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: 0,
        left: 0,
        right: 0,
        zIndex: (currentTheme) => currentTheme.zIndex.appBar,
        backgroundColor: (currentTheme) => {
          const isDark = currentTheme.palette.mode === 'dark';
          return isDark
            ? 'rgba(14, 14, 18, 0.94)'
            : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96)';
        },
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px) saturate(180%)',
        WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(20px) saturate(180%)',
        borderTop: (currentTheme) =>
          currentTheme.palette.mode === 'dark'
            ? '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)'
            : '1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)',
        boxShadow: (currentTheme) =>
          currentTheme.palette.mode === 'dark'
            ? '0 -4px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)'
            : '0 -4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)',
        pb: 'env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)',
      }}
    >
      <BottomNavigation
        value={currentTabId}
        onChange={handleTabChange}
        showLabels
        sx={{
          backgroundColor: 'transparent',
          height: 60,
          '& .MuiBottomNavigationAction-root': {
            minWidth: 0,
            padding: '6px 0',
            color: (currentTheme) =>
              currentTheme.palette.mode === 'dark'
                ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55)'
                : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55)',
            transition: 'all 0.2s ease-in-out',
            '&.Mui-selected': {
              color: (currentTheme) =>
                currentTheme.palette.mode === 'dark'
                  ? currentTheme.palette.primary.light || '#90caf9'
                  : currentTheme.palette.primary.main,
              fontWeight: 600,
            },
            '& .MuiBottomNavigationAction-label': {
              fontSize: '0.72rem',
              letterSpacing: '0.02em',
              mt: 0.25,
              '&.Mui-selected': {
                fontSize: '0.75rem',
                fontWeight: 600,
              },
            },
          },
        }}
      >
        {activeTabs.map((tab) => {
          const actionIcon =
            tab.badge !== undefined && tab.badge > 0 ? (
              <Badge badgeContent={tab.badge} color="error">
                {tab.icon}
              </Badge>
            ) : (
              tab.icon
            );
          return (
            <BottomNavigationAction
              key={tab.id}
              value={tab.id}
              label={tab.label}
              icon={actionIcon}
            />
          );
        })}
      </BottomNavigation>
    </Paper>
  );
}
export default CustomersTabbar;

import React from 'react';
import { render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { vi, describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
import {
  CustomersAuthProvider,
  useCustomersAuth,
} from './CustomersAuthContext';
const mockUseQuery = vi.fn();
const mockUseMutation = vi.fn();
vi.mock('@apollo/client/react', () => ({
  useQuery: (...args: unknown[]) => mockUseQuery(...args),
  useMutation: (...args: unknown[]) => mockUseMutation(...args),
}));
vi.mock('@apollo/client', () => ({
  gql: (strings: TemplateStringsArray) => strings.join(''),
}));
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/codegen', () => ({
  KickzoneGraphqlTypes: {
    UserRole: {
      Customer: 'CUSTOMER',
      Admin: 'ADMIN',
      Seller: 'SELLER',
    },
  },
}));
const TestComponent = () => {
  const { user, login, logout, loading } = useCustomersAuth();
  return (
    <div>
      <div data-testid="loading">{String(loading)}</div>
      <div data-testid="user-name">{user?.name || 'No User'}</div>
      <div data-testid="user-email">{user?.email || 'No Email'}</div>
      <button
        onClick={() =>
          login({
            id: '2',
            name: 'Jane',
            email: 'jane@test.com',
            role: 'CUSTOMER' as never,
          })
        }
      >
        Login
      </button>
      <button onClick={() => void logout()}>Logout</button>
    </div>
  );
};
describe('CustomersAuthContext', () => {
  const mockLogoutMutation = vi.fn();
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockUseMutation.mockReturnValue([mockLogoutMutation, {}]);
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
  });
  it('exposes loading while ME query is in flight', () => {
    mockUseQuery.mockReturnValue({ loading: true, data: undefined });
    render(
      <CustomersAuthProvider>
        <TestComponent />
      </CustomersAuthProvider>
    );
    expect(screen.getByTestId('loading')).toHaveTextContent('true');
  });
  it('sets customer user from ME query', async () => {
    mockUseQuery.mockReturnValue({
      loading: false,
      data: {
        me: {
          id: '1',
          name: 'Customer',
          email: 'customer@test.com',
          role: 'CUSTOMER',
        },
      },
    });
    render(
      <CustomersAuthProvider>
        <TestComponent />
      </CustomersAuthProvider>
    );
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByTestId('user-name')).toHaveTextContent('Customer');
      expect(screen.getByTestId('user-email')).toHaveTextContent(
        'customer@test.com'
      );
    });
  });
  it('clears user when ME returns null (expired session)', async () => {
    mockUseQuery.mockReturnValue({
      loading: false,
      data: { me: null },
    });
    render(
      <CustomersAuthProvider>
        <TestComponent />
      </CustomersAuthProvider>
    );
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByTestId('user-name')).toHaveTextContent('No User');
    });
  });
  it('ignores non-customer roles from ME', async () => {
    mockUseQuery.mockReturnValue({
      loading: false,
      data: {
        me: {
          id: '1',
          name: 'Admin',
          email: 'admin@test.com',
          role: 'ADMIN',
        },
      },
    });
    render(
      <CustomersAuthProvider>
        <TestComponent />
      </CustomersAuthProvider>
    );
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByTestId('user-name')).toHaveTextContent('No User');
    });
  });
  it('allows login for customer role only', async () => {
    mockUseQuery.mockReturnValue({ loading: false, data: { me: null } });
    render(
      <CustomersAuthProvider>
        <TestComponent />
      </CustomersAuthProvider>
    );
    screen.getByText('Login').click();
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByTestId('user-name')).toHaveTextContent('Jane');
    });
  });
  it('calls logout mutation and clears user', async () => {
    mockUseQuery.mockReturnValue({
      loading: false,
      data: {
        me: {
          id: '1',
          name: 'Customer',
          email: 'customer@test.com',
          role: 'CUSTOMER',
        },
      },
    });
    mockLogoutMutation.mockResolvedValue({ data: { logout: true } });
    render(
      <CustomersAuthProvider>
        <TestComponent />
      </CustomersAuthProvider>
    );
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByTestId('user-name')).toHaveTextContent('Customer');
    });
    screen.getByText('Logout').click();
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockLogoutMutation).toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(screen.getByTestId('user-name')).toHaveTextContent('No User');
    });
  });
  it('clears user even when logout mutation fails', async () => {
    mockUseQuery.mockReturnValue({
      loading: false,
      data: {
        me: {
          id: '1',
          name: 'Customer',
          email: 'customer@test.com',
          role: 'CUSTOMER',
        },
      },
    });
    mockLogoutMutation.mockRejectedValue(new Error('network'));
    render(
      <CustomersAuthProvider>
        <TestComponent />
      </CustomersAuthProvider>
    );
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByTestId('user-name')).toHaveTextContent('Customer');
    });
    screen.getByText('Logout').click();
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByTestId('user-name')).toHaveTextContent('No User');
    });
  });
  it('throws when used outside provider', () => {
    const consoleErrorSpy = vi
      .spyOn(console, 'error')
      .mockImplementation(() => undefined);
    expect(() => render(<TestComponent />)).toThrow(
      'useCustomersAuth must be used within an CustomersAuthProvider'
    );
    consoleErrorSpy.mockRestore();
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/customers/contexts/auth/src/lib/CustomersAuthContext.tsx">
import {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useState,
  useEffect,
  ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { gql } from '@apollo/client';
import { useQuery, useMutation } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
type CustomerUser = Pick<
  KickzoneGraphqlTypes.User,
  'id' | 'name' | 'email' | 'role'
> & { lastName?: string | null };
interface AuthContextType {
  user: CustomerUser | null;
  login: (user: CustomerUser) => void;
  logout: () => Promise<void>;
  loading: boolean;
}
const CustomersAuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(
  undefined
);
const ME_QUERY = gql`
  query Me {
    me {
      id
      name
      lastName
      email
      role
    }
  }
`;
const LOGOUT_MUTATION = gql`
  mutation Logout {
    logout
  }
`;
export const CustomersAuthProvider = ({
  children,
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
}) => {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<CustomerUser | null>(null);
  // Check if user is already authenticated on mount
  // Server `me` silently refreshes expired access tokens via refresh cookie
  const { data, loading } = useQuery<Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'me'>>(
    ME_QUERY,
    {
      fetchPolicy: 'network-only', // Always check with server
      errorPolicy: 'ignore', // Ignore errors if not authenticated
    }
  );
  const [logoutMutation] =
    useMutation<Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'logout'>>(LOGOUT_MUTATION);
  // Update user when query returns - only for CUSTOMER role users
  useEffect(() => {
    if (data?.me && data.me.role === KickzoneGraphqlTypes.UserRole.Customer) {
      setUser(data.me);
    } else {
      // Clear user if not a customer or not authenticated
      setUser(null);
    }
  }, [data]);
  const login = (user: CustomerUser) => {
    // Only allow login for CUSTOMER role users
    if (user.role === KickzoneGraphqlTypes.UserRole.Customer) {
      setUser(user);
      // Cart will be loaded automatically by useCartService when user logs in
    }
  };
  const logout = async () => {
    try {
      // Call server to clear cookies
      await logoutMutation();
    } catch {
      // Ignore logout errors - always clear local state
    } finally {
      // Always clear local user state
      setUser(null);
      // Cart will be cleared automatically by useCartService when user logs out
    }
  };
  return (
    <CustomersAuthContext.Provider value={{ user, login, logout, loading }}>
      {children}
    </CustomersAuthContext.Provider>
  );
};
export const useCustomersAuth = () => {
  const context = useContext(CustomersAuthContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error(
      'useCustomersAuth must be used within an CustomersAuthProvider'
    );
  }
  return context;
};

<file path="libs/client/customers/graphql/src/lib/client.ts">
import {
  ApolloClient,
  InMemoryCache,
  ApolloLink,
} from '@apollo/client';
import {
  createSilentRefreshAuthLink,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/apollo-provider-base';
import { CUSTOMER_ROUTES } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-routes';
import UploadHttpLink from 'apollo-upload-client/UploadHttpLink.mjs';
const csrfLink = new ApolloLink((operation, forward) => {
  // Get current locale from localStorage (used by LanguageContext)
  const currentLocale =
    typeof window !== 'undefined'
      ? localStorage.getItem('kickzone-language-preference') || 'en'
      : 'en';
  operation.setContext(({ headers = {} }) => ({
    headers: {
      ...headers,
      'apollo-require-preflight': 'true',
      'x-locale': currentLocale,
    },
  }));
  return forward(operation);
});
// Get GraphQL endpoint:
// - Local + production both prefer relative /graphql (Vite proxy locally, nginx in prod)
// - Absolute VITE_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT wins when explicitly set
const getGraphQLEndpoint = () => {
  type ViteEnv = { VITE_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT?: string };
  const viteEnv =
    (import.meta as unknown as { env?: ViteEnv }).env || ({} as ViteEnv);
  const fromEnv = viteEnv.VITE_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT;
  if (fromEnv) {
    return fromEnv;
  }
  return '/graphql';
};
const graphqlUri = getGraphQLEndpoint();
const httpLink = new UploadHttpLink({
  uri: graphqlUri,
  credentials: 'include',
}) as unknown as ApolloLink;
interface ProductConnectionCache {
  edges?: Array<{ node?: { id?: number | string }; cursor?: string }>;
  pageInfo?: {
    endCursor?: string;
    hasNextPage?: boolean;
    hasPreviousPage?: boolean;
  };
  totalCount?: number;
}
export const productsPaginationPolicy = () => ({
  keyArgs: (args: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> | null) => {
    if (!args || !args.filter) return false;
    const { first: _first, after: _after, ...rest } = args.filter;
    return JSON.stringify(rest);
  },
  merge(
    existing: ProductConnectionCache | undefined,
    incoming: ProductConnectionCache | undefined,
    { args }: { args: Record<string, { after?: string }> | null }
  ) {
    if (!existing) return incoming;
    if (!incoming) return existing;
    const existingEdges = existing.edges || [];
    const incomingEdges = incoming.edges || [];
    if (args?.filter?.after) {
      const existingIds = new Set(
        existingEdges.map((e) => e?.node?.id)
      );
      const uniqueIncomingEdges = incomingEdges.filter(
        (e) => e?.node?.id != null && !existingIds.has(e.node.id)
      );
      return {
        ...incoming,
        edges: [...existingEdges, ...uniqueIncomingEdges],
        pageInfo: incoming.pageInfo,
        totalCount:
          incoming.totalCount !== undefined
            ? incoming.totalCount
            : existing.totalCount,
      };
    }
    return incoming;
  },
});
const isCartRoute = () => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
  const currentPath = window.location.pathname;
  return (
    currentPath === CUSTOMER_ROUTES.CART ||
    currentPath.startsWith(`${CUSTOMER_ROUTES.CART}/`)
  );
};
export const createCustomersApolloClient = (onAuthError: () => void) => {
  const authErrorLink = createSilentRefreshAuthLink({
    graphqlUri,
    onAuthError,
    shouldSkipRedirect: isCartRoute,
  });
  return new ApolloClient({
    link: ApolloLink.from([csrfLink, authErrorLink, httpLink]),
    cache: new InMemoryCache({
      typePolicies: {
        Query: {
          fields: {
            products: productsPaginationPolicy(),
          },
        },
      },
    }),
    defaultOptions: {
      watchQuery: {
        fetchPolicy: 'network-only',
      },
      query: {
        fetchPolicy: 'network-only',
      },
      mutate: {
        fetchPolicy: 'no-cache',
      },
    },
  });
};
// Default client for backward compatibility (without error handling)
const apolloClient = new ApolloClient({
  link: ApolloLink.from([csrfLink, httpLink]),
  cache: new InMemoryCache({
    typePolicies: {
      Query: {
        fields: {
          products: productsPaginationPolicy(),
        },
      },
    },
  }),
  defaultOptions: {
    watchQuery: {
      fetchPolicy: 'network-only',
    },
    query: {
      fetchPolicy: 'network-only',
    },
    mutate: {
      fetchPolicy: 'no-cache',
    },
  },
});
export default apolloClient;

import React from 'react';
import { ApolloProviderBase } from '@kickzone-workspace/apollo-provider-base';
import { createCustomersApolloClient } from './client';
import { useCallback } from 'react';
import { CUSTOMER_ROUTES } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-routes';
interface CustomersApolloProviderProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}
export const CustomersApolloProvider: React.FC<
  CustomersApolloProviderProps
> = ({ children }) => {
  const handleAuthError = useCallback(() => {
    console.log('Authentication error in Customers, redirecting to login...');
    // Clear only customer authentication data
    localStorage.removeItem('customer_user');
    // Redirect to login page using window.location
    window.location.href = CUSTOMER_ROUTES.LOGIN;
  }, []);
  const apolloClient = React.useMemo(
    () => createCustomersApolloClient(handleAuthError),
    [handleAuthError]
  );
  return (
    <ApolloProviderBase client={apolloClient}>{children}</ApolloProviderBase>
  );
};

<file path="libs/client/customers/hooks/auth/src/lib/useCustomersLogin.spec.tsx">
import { useMutation } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import { act, renderHook } from '@testing-library/react';
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { useCustomersLogin } from './useCustomersLogin';
const mockSetAuthUser = vi.fn();
const mockLogin = vi.fn();
const mockAddToCart = vi.fn();
const mockUseCartItems = vi.fn(() => []);
vi.mock('@apollo/client/react', () => ({
  useMutation: vi.fn(() => {
    // First call is login, second is addToCart — track by call order via wrappers
    return [vi.fn(), { loading: false }];
  }),
}));
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/customers-auth-context', () => ({
  useCustomersAuth: () => ({
    login: mockSetAuthUser,
  }),
}));
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/customer-cart-store', () => ({
  useCartItems: () => mockUseCartItems(),
}));
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/customers-graphql', () => ({
  ADD_TO_CART_MUTATION: 'ADD_TO_CART_MUTATION',
}));
vi.mock('@apollo/client', () => ({
  gql: (strings: TemplateStringsArray) => strings.join(''),
}));
describe('useCustomersLogin', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockUseCartItems.mockReturnValue([]);
    mockLogin.mockReset();
    mockAddToCart.mockReset();
    let call = 0;
    vi.mocked(useMutation).mockImplementation(() => {
      call += 1;
      if (call === 1) {
        return [mockLogin, { loading: false }] as never;
      }
      return [mockAddToCart, { loading: false }] as never;
    });
  });
  it('returns handleLogin and loading state', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useCustomersLogin());
    expect(result.current.handleLogin).toBeTypeOf('function');
    expect(result.current.loginLoading).toBe(false);
  });
  it('sets auth user for a customer login', async () => {
    mockLogin.mockResolvedValue({
      data: {
        login: {
          id: '1',
          name: 'Cust',
          email: 'c@test.com',
          role: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.UserRole.Customer,
        },
      },
    });
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useCustomersLogin());
    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.handleLogin('c@test.com', 'secret');
    });
    expect(mockLogin).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      variables: { email: 'c@test.com', password: 'secret' },
    });
    expect(mockSetAuthUser).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('rejects non-customer accounts', async () => {
    mockLogin.mockResolvedValue({
      data: {
        login: {
          id: '1',
          name: 'Admin',
          email: 'a@test.com',
          role: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.UserRole.Admin,
        },
      },
    });
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useCustomersLogin());
    await expect(
      act(async () => {
        await result.current.handleLogin('a@test.com', 'secret');
      })
    ).rejects.toThrow(/not a customer account/i);
    expect(mockSetAuthUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('syncs local cart items after successful login', async () => {
    mockUseCartItems.mockReturnValue([
      { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 2 },
      { sellerProductId: 'sp-2', quantity: 1 },
    ]);
    mockLogin.mockResolvedValue({
      data: {
        login: {
          id: '1',
          name: 'Cust',
          email: 'c@test.com',
          role: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.UserRole.Customer,
        },
      },
    });
    mockAddToCart.mockResolvedValue({ data: {} });
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useCustomersLogin());
    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.handleLogin('c@test.com', 'secret');
    });
    expect(mockAddToCart).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(mockAddToCart).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      variables: {
        addToCartInput: { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 2 },
      },
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/customers/hooks/auth/src/lib/useCustomersLogin.tsx">
import { gql } from '@apollo/client';
import { useMutation } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { useCustomersAuth } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-auth-context';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import { useCartItems } from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-cart-store';
import { ADD_TO_CART_MUTATION } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-graphql';
const LOGIN_MUTATION = gql`
  mutation Login($email: String!, $password: String!) {
    login(email: $email, password: $password) {
      id
      name
      email
      role
    }
  }
`;
export function useCustomersLogin() {
  const { login: setAuthUser } = useCustomersAuth();
  const cartItems = useCartItems();
  const [login, { loading: loginLoading }] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'login'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationLoginArgs
  >(LOGIN_MUTATION);
  const [addToCartMutation] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'addToCart'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationAddToCartArgs
  >(ADD_TO_CART_MUTATION);
  const handleLogin = async (email: string, password: string) => {
    const { data } = await login({ variables: { email, password } });
    if (data?.login && data.login.role === KickzoneGraphqlTypes.UserRole.Customer) {
      // Set the authenticated user
      setAuthUser(data.login);
      // Sync local cart items to server after login
      if (cartItems.length > 0) {
        try {
          // Add each local cart item to the server cart (only send sellerProductId & quantity)
          for (const item of cartItems) {
            await addToCartMutation({
              variables: {
                addToCartInput: {
                  sellerProductId: item.sellerProductId,
                  quantity: item.quantity,
                },
              },
            });
          }
        } catch {
          // Don't throw error here - allow login to succeed even if cart sync fails
        }
      }
    } else if (data?.login && data.login.role !== KickzoneGraphqlTypes.UserRole.Customer) {
      throw new Error('Login failed: This account is not a customer account');
    } else {
      throw new Error('Login failed: No user data returned');
    }
  };
  return {
    handleLogin,
    loginLoading,
  };
}

<file path="libs/client/customers/hooks/auth/src/lib/useCustomersRegister.tsx">
import { useMutation } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { useCustomersAuth } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-auth-context';
import {
  REGISTER_MUTATION,
  ADD_TO_CART_MUTATION,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-graphql';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import { useCartItems } from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-cart-store';
export function useCustomersRegister() {
  const { login: setAuthUser } = useCustomersAuth();
  const cartItems = useCartItems();
  const [register, { loading: registerLoading }] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'register'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationRegisterArgs
  >(REGISTER_MUTATION);
  const [addToCartMutation] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'addToCart'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationAddToCartArgs
  >(ADD_TO_CART_MUTATION);
  const handleRegister = async (
    name: string,
    email: string,
    password: string
  ) => {
    const { data } = await register({
      variables: { name, email, password },
    });
    if (data?.register) {
      // Set the authenticated user
      setAuthUser(data.register);
      // Sync local cart items to server after registration
      if (cartItems.length > 0) {
        try {
          // Add each local cart item to the server cart (only send sellerProductId & quantity)
          for (const item of cartItems) {
            await addToCartMutation({
              variables: {
                addToCartInput: {
                  sellerProductId: item.sellerProductId,
                  quantity: item.quantity,
                },
              },
            });
          }
        } catch {
          // Don't throw error here - allow registration to succeed even if cart sync fails
        }
      }
    }
    return data?.register;
  };
  return {
    handleRegister,
    registerLoading,
  };
}

<file path="libs/client/customers/hooks/auth/src/lib/useCustomersResetPassword.tsx">
import { useMutation } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { useCustomersAuth } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-auth-context';
import { RESET_PASSWORD_MUTATION } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-graphql';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
export function useCustomersResetPassword() {
  const { login: setAuthUser } = useCustomersAuth();
  const [resetPassword, { loading: resetPasswordLoading }] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'resetPassword'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationResetPasswordArgs
  >(RESET_PASSWORD_MUTATION);
  const handleResetPassword = async (token: string, newPassword: string) => {
    const { data } = await resetPassword({
      variables: { token, newPassword },
    });
    if (data?.resetPassword) {
      setAuthUser(data.resetPassword);
    }
    return data?.resetPassword;
  };
  return {
    handleResetPassword,
    resetPasswordLoading,
  };
}

<file path="libs/client/customers/hooks/cart/src/lib/customers-cart-hook.tsx">
import { useQuery, useMutation } from '@apollo/client/react';
import {
  GET_MY_CART_QUERY,
  ADD_TO_CART_MUTATION,
  UPDATE_CART_ITEM_MUTATION,
  REMOVE_FROM_CART_MUTATION,
  CLEAR_CART_MUTATION,
  CREATE_ORDER_MUTATION,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-graphql';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import { useCustomersAuth } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-auth-context';
export function useCustomersCart() {
  const { data, loading, error, refetch } = useQuery<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'myCart'>
  >(GET_MY_CART_QUERY, {
    fetchPolicy: 'cache-and-network',
  });
  return {
    cart: data?.myCart,
    loading,
    error,
    refetch,
  };
}
export function useCustomersCartMutations() {
  const { user } = useCustomersAuth();
  const [addToCartMutation, { loading: addLoading }] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'addToCart'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationAddToCartArgs
  >(ADD_TO_CART_MUTATION, {
    refetchQueries: user ? [{ query: GET_MY_CART_QUERY }] : [],
  });
  const [updateCartItemMutation, { loading: updateLoading }] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'updateCartItem'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationUpdateCartItemArgs
  >(UPDATE_CART_ITEM_MUTATION, {
    refetchQueries: user ? [{ query: GET_MY_CART_QUERY }] : [],
  });
  const [removeFromCartMutation, { loading: removeLoading }] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'removeFromCart'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationRemoveFromCartArgs
  >(REMOVE_FROM_CART_MUTATION, {
    refetchQueries: user ? [{ query: GET_MY_CART_QUERY }] : [],
  });
  const [clearCartMutation, { loading: clearLoading }] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'clearCart'>
  >(CLEAR_CART_MUTATION, {
    refetchQueries: user ? [{ query: GET_MY_CART_QUERY }] : [],
    awaitRefetchQueries: Boolean(user),
  });
  const [createOrderMutation, { loading: orderLoading }] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'createOrder'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationCreateOrderArgs
  >(CREATE_ORDER_MUTATION, {
    refetchQueries: user ? [{ query: GET_MY_CART_QUERY }] : [],
    awaitRefetchQueries: Boolean(user),
  });
  const addToCart = async (input: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.AddToCartInput) => {
    const response = await addToCartMutation({
      variables: { addToCartInput: input },
    });
    return response.data?.addToCart;
  };
  const updateCartItem = async (
    itemId: string,
    updateInput: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.UpdateCartItemInput
  ) => {
    const response = await updateCartItemMutation({
      variables: { itemId, updateInput },
    });
    return response.data?.updateCartItem;
  };
  const removeFromCart = async (itemId: string) => {
    const response = await removeFromCartMutation({
      variables: { itemId },
    });
    return response.data?.removeFromCart;
  };
  const clearCart = async () => {
    const response = await clearCartMutation();
    return response.data?.clearCart;
  };
  const createOrder = async (input: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.CreateOrderInput) => {
    const response = await createOrderMutation({
      variables: { createOrderInput: input },
    });
    return response.data?.createOrder;
  };
  return {
    addToCart,
    updateCartItem,
    removeFromCart,
    clearCart,
    createOrder,
    loading:
      addLoading ||
      updateLoading ||
      removeLoading ||
      clearLoading ||
      orderLoading,
  };
}
</file>

<file path="libs/client/customers/hooks/cart/src/lib/useWishlistSync.ts">
import { useEffect, useRef, useContext } from 'react';
import { getApolloContext } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { useCustomersAuth } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-auth-context';
import {
  GET_MY_PROFILE,
  UPDATE_MY_PROFILE,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-graphql';
import {
  useWishlistStore,
  useWishlistItems,
  WishlistItem,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-wishlist-store';
/**
 * Hook to synchronize favorites between client localStorage and server database profile
 * - When guest browses, items persist in localStorage & sync across tabs
 * - When user logs in, merges local guest items with server-persisted favorites
 * - When favorites change while logged in, saves them to server CustomerProfile
 */
export function useWishlistSync() {
  const { user } = useCustomersAuth();
  const isLoggedIn = !!user;
  const items = useWishlistItems();
  const hasLoadedFromServer = useRef(false);
  const apolloCtx = useContext(getApolloContext());
  const client = apolloCtx?.client;
  // When user logs in and Apollo client is available, load & merge server favorites
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLoggedIn || !client || hasLoadedFromServer.current) {
      return;
    }
    let isMounted = true;
    client
      .query<{ myProfile?: { id: string; favorites?: string | null } }>({
        query: GET_MY_PROFILE,
        fetchPolicy: 'cache-first',
      })
      .then((result) => {
        if (!isMounted) return;
        hasLoadedFromServer.current = true;
        const profileFavorites = result.data?.myProfile?.favorites;
        if (profileFavorites) {
          try {
            const serverFavorites: WishlistItem[] = JSON.parse(profileFavorites);
            if (Array.isArray(serverFavorites) && serverFavorites.length > 0) {
              const localItems = useWishlistStore.getState().items;
              const merged = [...localItems];
              serverFavorites.forEach((sItem) => {
                if (!merged.some((m) => String(m.id) === String(sItem.id))) {
                  merged.push(sItem);
                }
              });
              useWishlistStore.getState().setItems(merged);
            }
          } catch (e) {
            console.error('Failed to parse server favorites:', e);
          }
        } else if (result.data?.myProfile) {
          // If server has no favorites but local has items, sync local items to server
          const localItems = useWishlistStore.getState().items;
          if (localItems.length > 0) {
            client
              .mutate({
                mutation: UPDATE_MY_PROFILE,
                variables: {
                  input: {
                    favorites: JSON.stringify(localItems),
                  },
                },
              })
              .catch((err) => {
                console.error('Failed to save initial favorites to server:', err);
              });
          }
        }
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        console.error('Failed to fetch profile favorites:', err);
      });
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [isLoggedIn, client]);
  // When user is logged in and items change, synchronize to server
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoggedIn && client && hasLoadedFromServer.current) {
      const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
        client
          .mutate({
            mutation: UPDATE_MY_PROFILE,
            variables: {
              input: {
                favorites: JSON.stringify(items),
              },
            },
          })
          .catch((err) => {
            console.error('Failed to persist favorites to server:', err);
          });
      }, 800);
      return () => clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    }
  }, [isLoggedIn, client, items]);
  // Reset loaded ref on logout
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLoggedIn) {
      hasLoadedFromServer.current = false;
    }
  }, [isLoggedIn]);
}
export default useWishlistSync;
</file>

<file path="libs/client/customers/hooks/products/src/lib/customers-product-hook.tsx">
import { useQuery } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import {
  DISTINCT_PRODUCT_SIZES_QUERY,
  GET_PRODUCTS_QUERY,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-graphql';
import { useCategoriesQuery } from '@kickzone-workspace/categories-hook';
import { useColors } from '@kickzone-workspace/colors-hook';
export function useCustomersProducts({
  first = 12,
  after,
  filter,
}: {
  first?: number;
  after?: string;
  filter?: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductFilterInput;
} = {}) {
  const { data, loading, error, refetch, fetchMore } = useQuery<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'products'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.QueryProductsArgs
  >(GET_PRODUCTS_QUERY, {
    variables: { filter: { ...filter, first, after } },
    notifyOnNetworkStatusChange: true,
  });
  const loadMore = () => {
    if (
      data?.products?.pageInfo?.hasNextPage &&
      data.products.pageInfo.endCursor
    ) {
      return fetchMore({
        variables: {
          filter: { ...filter, first, after: data.products.pageInfo.endCursor },
        },
      });
    }
  };
  return {
    products: data?.products?.edges?.map((edge) => edge.node) || [],
    pageInfo: data?.products?.pageInfo,
    totalCount: data?.products?.totalCount || 0,
    loading,
    error,
    refetch,
    loadMore,
  };
}
export function useCustomersCategories() {
  const {
    categories,
    getCategoriesLoading,
    getCategoriesError,
    refetchCategories,
  } = useCategoriesQuery();
  return {
    categories,
    loading: getCategoriesLoading,
    error: getCategoriesError,
    refetch: refetchCategories,
  };
}
export function useCustomersColors() {
  const { colors, loading, error, refetchColors } = useColors();
  return {
    colors,
    loading,
    error,
    refetch: refetchColors,
  };
}
export function useDistinctProductSizes(
  sizeKind?: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SizeKind
) {
  const { data, loading, error, refetch } = useQuery<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'distinctProductSizes'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.QueryDistinctProductSizesArgs
  >(DISTINCT_PRODUCT_SIZES_QUERY, {
    variables: { sizeKind },
  });
  return {
    sizes: data?.distinctProductSizes ?? [],
    loading,
    error,
    refetch,
  };
}

  CustomersHome,
