import { CustomerForgotPassword } from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-forgot-password';
import { CustomerResetPassword } from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-reset-password';
import { CustomerOrders } from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-orders';
import { CustomerProfile } from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-profile';
import { CustomerOrderConfirmation } from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-order-confirmation';
import { CustomerPaymentCallback } from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-payment';
import { LanguageComponents } from '@kickzone-workspace/language-components';
import { CustomersLayout } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-layout';
import { CUSTOMER_ROUTES } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-routes';
import { CustomerFavorites } from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-favorites';
import { CustomerGuideAuthenticity } from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-guide-authenticity';
import { CustomerGuidePayment } from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-guide-payment';
import { CustomerContact } from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-contact';
import { CustomerShippingReturns } from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-shipping-returns';
import { CustomerPrivacyPolicy } from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-privacy-policy';
import { CustomerNotFound } from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-not-found';
import { ErrorBoundary } from '@kickzone-workspace/error-boundary';
import { ScrollToTop } from './ScrollToTop';
export function CustomersRouter() {
  return (
    <ErrorBoundary>
      <BrowserRouter>
        <ScrollToTop />
        <Routes>
          <Route path={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.HOME} element={<CustomersHome />} />
          <Route
            path={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.PRODUCTS}
            element={<Navigate to={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.HOME} replace />}
          />
          <Route path={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.SHOP} element={<CustomersShopScreen />} />
          <Route path={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.BRAND} element={<CustomersShopScreen />} />
          <Route
            path={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.PRODUCT_DETAILS}
            element={<CustomerProductDetails />}
          />
          <Route path="/product/:id" element={<CustomerProductDetails />} />
          <Route path={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.LOGIN} element={<CustomersLogin />} />
          <Route path={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.SIGNUP} element={<CustomerSignup />} />
          <Route
            path={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.FORGOT_PASSWORD}
            element={<CustomerForgotPassword />}
          />
          <Route
            path={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.RESET_PASSWORD}
            element={<CustomerResetPassword />}
          />
          <Route path={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.CART} element={<CustomerShoppingCart />} />
          <Route path={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.ORDERS} element={<CustomerOrders />} />
          <Route path={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.PROFILE} element={<CustomerProfile />} />
          <Route
            path={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.ORDER_CONFIRMATION}
            element={<CustomerOrderConfirmation />}
          />
          <Route
            path={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.PAYMENT_CALLBACK}
            element={<CustomerPaymentCallback />}
          />
          <Route
            path={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.LANGUAGE_SETTINGS}
            element={<LanguageComponents LayoutComponent={CustomersLayout} />}
          />
          <Route
            path={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.UNAUTHORIZED}
            element={<CustomersUnauthorizedScreen />}
          />
          {/* New Verified Guide & Favorites Routes */}
          <Route
            path={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.FAVORITES}
            element={<CustomerFavorites />}
          />
          <Route
            path={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.GUIDE_AUTHENTICITY}
            element={<CustomerGuideAuthenticity />}
          />
          <Route
            path={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.GUIDE_PAYMENT}
            element={<CustomerGuidePayment />}
          />
          <Route
            path={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.CONTACT}
            element={<CustomerContact />}
          />
          <Route
            path={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.SHIPPING_RETURNS}
            element={<CustomerShippingReturns />}
          />
          <Route
            path={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.PRIVACY_POLICY}
            element={<CustomerPrivacyPolicy />}
          />
          {/* Wildcard 404 Route */}
          <Route path="*" element={<CustomerNotFound />} />
        </Routes>
      </BrowserRouter>
    </ErrorBoundary>
  );
}
export default CustomersRouter;

<file path="libs/client/customers/router/src/lib/ScrollToTop.spec.tsx">
import React from 'react';
import { render, act } from '@testing-library/react';
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
import { beforeEach, afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { MemoryRouter, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ScrollToTop } from './ScrollToTop';
describe('ScrollToTop', () => {
  let scrollToSpy: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
  beforeEach(() => {
    scrollToSpy = vi.fn();
    window.scrollTo = scrollToSpy as unknown as typeof window.scrollTo;
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
  });
  function NavigationHarness() {
    const navigate = useNavigate();
    return (
      <div>
        <button
          onClick={() => navigate('/shop?category=women')}
          data-testid="go-women"
        >
          Women
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => navigate('/shop?category=men')}
          data-testid="go-men"
        >
          Men
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => navigate('/product/42')}
          data-testid="go-product"
        >
          Product
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => navigate('/product/42#details')}
          data-testid="go-hash"
        >
          Hash
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }
  it('scrolls to top on initial mount', () => {
    render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={['/']}>
        <ScrollToTop />
        <NavigationHarness />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    expect(scrollToSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ top: 0, left: 0 })
    );
  });
  it('scrolls to top when navigating to another route path', () => {
    const { getByTestId } = render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={['/']}>
        <ScrollToTop />
        <NavigationHarness />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    scrollToSpy.mockClear();
    act(() => {
      getByTestId('go-product').click();
    });
    expect(scrollToSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ top: 0, left: 0 })
    );
  });
  it('scrolls to top when query params change', () => {
    const { getByTestId } = render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={['/shop?category=women']}>
        <ScrollToTop />
        <NavigationHarness />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    scrollToSpy.mockClear();
    act(() => {
      getByTestId('go-men').click();
    });
    expect(scrollToSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ top: 0, left: 0 })
    );
  });
  it('scrolls to anchored element when hash is present and element exists', () => {
    const scrollIntoViewMock = vi.fn();
    const targetEl = document.createElement('div');
    targetEl.id = 'details';
    targetEl.scrollIntoView = scrollIntoViewMock;
    document.body.appendChild(targetEl);
    const { getByTestId } = render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={['/product/42']}>
        <ScrollToTop />
        <NavigationHarness />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    scrollToSpy.mockClear();
    act(() => {
      getByTestId('go-hash').click();
    });
    expect(scrollIntoViewMock).toHaveBeenCalled();
    document.body.removeChild(targetEl);
  });
  it('sets window.history.scrollRestoration to manual when supported', () => {
    Object.defineProperty(window.history, 'scrollRestoration', {
      value: 'auto',
      writable: true,
      configurable: true,
    });
    render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={['/']}>
        <ScrollToTop />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    expect(window.history.scrollRestoration).toBe('manual');
  });
});
</file>

<file path="libs/client/customers/router/src/lib/ScrollToTop.tsx">
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
/**
 * Ensures that whenever navigation occurs (route path, query params, hash, or history key changes),
 * the window scroll position is reset to the top (or scrolled to the anchored element if a hash exists).
 */
export function ScrollToTop() {
  const { pathname, search, hash, key } = useLocation();
  // Set browser scroll restoration to manual so SPA routing controls the scroll position
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'scrollRestoration' in window.history) {
      try {
        const previous = window.history.scrollRestoration;
        window.history.scrollRestoration = 'manual';
        return () => {
          try {
            window.history.scrollRestoration = previous;
          } catch {
            // ignore
          }
        };
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
    }
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    // If an in-page anchor hash exists, attempt to scroll to it
    if (hash) {
      const elementId = hash.replace(/^#/, '');
      const targetElement =
        document.getElementById(elementId) ||
        (elementId ? document.querySelector(hash) : null);
      if (targetElement) {
        targetElement.scrollIntoView();
        return;
      }
    }
    const resetScroll = () => {
      if (
        typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
        typeof window.scrollTo === 'function'
      ) {
        try {
          window.scrollTo({ top: 0, left: 0, behavior: 'instant' });
        } catch {
          window.scrollTo(0, 0);
        }
      }
      if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
        if (document.documentElement) {
          document.documentElement.scrollTop = 0;
        }
        if (document.body) {
          document.body.scrollTop = 0;
        }
      }
    };
    // 1. Immediately reset scroll
    resetScroll();
    // 2. Re-assert scroll to top in the next animation frame to prevent
    // any browser layout adjustment or deferred jump
    let rafId: number | null = null;
    if (
      typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
      typeof window.requestAnimationFrame === 'function'
    ) {
      rafId = window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        resetScroll();
      });
    }
    return () => {
      if (rafId !== null && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
      }
    };
  }, [pathname, search, hash, key]);
  return null;
}
export default ScrollToTop;
</file>

<file path="libs/client/customers/routes/src/lib/customer-routes.spec.ts">
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  CUSTOMER_ROUTES,
  getCustomerProductDetailsRoute,
  getCustomerBrandRoute,
  getCustomerShopRoute,
} from './customer-routes';
describe('CUSTOMER_ROUTES', () => {
  it('defines all required customer routes including guides and favorites', () => {
    expect(CUSTOMER_ROUTES.HOME).toBe('/');
    expect(CUSTOMER_ROUTES.SHOP).toBe('/shop');
    expect(CUSTOMER_ROUTES.FAVORITES).toBe('/favorites');
    expect(CUSTOMER_ROUTES.GUIDE_AUTHENTICITY).toBe('/guide/authenticity');
    expect(CUSTOMER_ROUTES.GUIDE_PAYMENT).toBe('/guide/payment');
    expect(CUSTOMER_ROUTES.CONTACT).toBe('/contact');
    expect(CUSTOMER_ROUTES.SHIPPING_RETURNS).toBe('/shipping-returns');
    expect(CUSTOMER_ROUTES.PRIVACY_POLICY).toBe('/privacy-policy');
  });
  it('generates product details routes properly', () => {
    expect(getCustomerProductDetailsRoute(123)).toBe('/products/123');
    expect(getCustomerProductDetailsRoute('abc')).toBe('/products/abc');
  });
  it('generates brand routes properly', () => {
    expect(getCustomerBrandRoute('Nike')).toBe('/brands/nike');
  });
  it('generates shop routes with query parameters', () => {
    expect(getCustomerShopRoute()).toBe('/shop');
    expect(getCustomerShopRoute({ category: 'shoes', sort: 'cheapest' })).toBe(
      '/shop?category=shoes&sort=cheapest'
    );
    expect(getCustomerShopRoute({ brand: 'Adidas', category: 'hoodies' })).toBe(
      '/brands/adidas?category=hoodies'
    );
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/customers/routes/src/lib/customer-routes.ts">
export const CUSTOMER_ROUTES = {
  HOME: '/',
  SHOP: '/shop',
  BRAND: '/brands/:brandSlug',
  PRODUCTS: '/home',
  PRODUCT_DETAILS: '/products/:id',
  LOGIN: '/login',
  SIGNUP: '/signup',
  FORGOT_PASSWORD: '/forgot-password',
  RESET_PASSWORD: '/reset-password/:token',
  CART: '/cart',
  ORDERS: '/orders',
  PROFILE: '/profile',
  CONTACT: '/contact',
  LANGUAGE_SETTINGS: '/language-settings',
  UNAUTHORIZED: '/unauthorized',
  ORDER_CONFIRMATION: '/order-confirmation',
  PAYMENT_CALLBACK: '/payment-callback',
  FAVORITES: '/favorites',
  GUIDE_AUTHENTICITY: '/guide/authenticity',
  GUIDE_PAYMENT: '/guide/payment',
  SHIPPING_RETURNS: '/shipping-returns',
  PRIVACY_POLICY: '/privacy-policy',
} as const;
export type CustomerRouteKey = keyof typeof CUSTOMER_ROUTES;
export const getCustomerProductDetailsRoute = (id: string | number) =>
  `/products/${id}`;
export const getCustomerBrandRoute = (brandSlug: string) =>
  `/brands/${encodeURIComponent(brandSlug.toLowerCase())}`;
export const getCustomerShopRoute = (opts?: {
  category?: string;
  search?: string;
  sort?: string;
  brand?: string;
}) => {
  if (opts?.brand) {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (opts.category) params.set('category', opts.category);
    if (opts.search) params.set('search', opts.search);
    if (opts.sort && opts.sort !== 'newest') params.set('sort', opts.sort);
    const qs = params.toString();
    return `${getCustomerBrandRoute(opts.brand)}${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`;
  }
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (opts?.category) params.set('category', opts.category);
  if (opts?.search) params.set('search', opts.search);
  if (opts?.sort && opts.sort !== 'newest') params.set('sort', opts.sort);
  const qs = params.toString();
  return `${CUSTOMER_ROUTES.SHOP}${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`;
};
</file>

<file path="libs/client/customers/screens/customer-products/src/lib/customer-products.tsx">
import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Card from '@mui/material/Card';
import CardContent from '@mui/material/CardContent';
import CardMedia from '@mui/material/CardMedia';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import TextField from '@mui/material/TextField';
import FormControl from '@mui/material/FormControl';
import InputLabel from '@mui/material/InputLabel';
import Select, { SelectChangeEvent } from '@mui/material/Select';
import MenuItem from '@mui/material/MenuItem';
import Autocomplete from '@mui/material/Autocomplete';
import Pagination from '@mui/material/Pagination';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import Alert from '@mui/material/Alert';
import InputAdornment from '@mui/material/InputAdornment';
import ToggleButton from '@mui/material/ToggleButton';
import ToggleButtonGroup from '@mui/material/ToggleButtonGroup';
import Search from '@mui/icons-material/Search';
import ShoppingCart from '@mui/icons-material/ShoppingCart';
import { CustomersLayout } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-layout';
import {
  useCustomersProducts,
  useCustomersCategories,
  useCustomersColors,
  useDistinctProductSizes,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-product-hook';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import { useCustomersCartService } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-cart-hook';
import { useI18nContext } from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
import {
  formatVariantColorNames,
  serializeVariantColorHexes,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/client-shared-graphql';
import { PriceDisplay } from '@kickzone-workspace/price-display';
import {
  euToUs,
  expandFilterSizes,
  formatSizeLabel,
  FootwearSizeSystem,
  isFootwearSizeKind,
  isPantsSizeKind,
  SizeKind,
  sortSizeCodes,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/product-sizes';
export function CustomerProducts() {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [selectedCategories, setSelectedCategories] = useState<
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Category[]
  >([]);
  const [selectedColor, setSelectedColor] = useState('');
  const [sizeFilterKind, setSizeFilterKind] = useState<SizeKind>(
    SizeKind.Apparel
  );
  const [footwearSystem, setFootwearSystem] = useState<FootwearSizeSystem>(
    FootwearSizeSystem.Eu
  );
  const [selectedSizes, setSelectedSizes] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const itemsPerPage = 12;
  const { addItem } = useCustomersCartService();
  const resetPage = () => setCurrentPage(1);
  const getPricingInfo = (product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product) => {
    if (!product.sellerProducts || product.sellerProducts.length === 0) {
      return null;
    }
    const sellerProduct = product.sellerProducts[0];
    const originalPrice = sellerProduct.price;
    const discount = sellerProduct.discount;
    const finalPrice =
      discount > 0
        ? originalPrice - (originalPrice * discount) / 100
        : originalPrice;
    const pricingInfo = {
      originalPrice,
      finalPrice,
      discount,
      stockQuantity: sellerProduct.stockQuantity,
    };
    return pricingInfo;
  };
  const canonicalFilterSizes = useMemo(
    () =>
      expandFilterSizes(sizeFilterKind, footwearSystem, selectedSizes),
    [sizeFilterKind, footwearSystem, selectedSizes]
  );
  const productInfoFilter = useMemo<
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductInfoFilterInput | undefined
  >(
    () =>
      selectedColor || canonicalFilterSizes.length
        ? {
            ...(selectedColor
              ? { colorId: [parseInt(selectedColor, 10)] }
              : {}),
            ...(canonicalFilterSizes.length
              ? {
                  size: canonicalFilterSizes,
                  sizeKind: sizeFilterKind,
                }
              : {}),
          }
        : undefined,
    [selectedColor, canonicalFilterSizes, sizeFilterKind]
  );
  const filter = useMemo<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductFilterInput>(
    () => ({
      searchTerm: searchTerm || undefined,
      categoryIds: selectedCategories.length
        ? selectedCategories.map((category) => category.id)
        : undefined,
      productInfoFilter,
      onlyWithSellers: true, // Only show products that have sellers
      onlyInStock: true, // Only show products that are in stock
    }),
    [productInfoFilter, searchTerm, selectedCategories]
  );
  const afterCursor = useMemo(
    () =>
      currentPage > 1
        ? btoa(`cursor:${(currentPage - 1) * itemsPerPage}`)
        : undefined,
    [currentPage, itemsPerPage]
  );
  const {
    products,
    totalCount,
    loading: productsLoading,
    error: productsError,
  } = useCustomersProducts({
    first: itemsPerPage,
    after: afterCursor,
    filter,
  });
  const { categories } = useCustomersCategories();
  const { colors } = useCustomersColors();
  const { sizes: catalogSizes } = useDistinctProductSizes(sizeFilterKind);
  const safeColors: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Color[] = (colors ?? []).filter(
    (color): color is KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Color =>
      Boolean(
        color &&
          typeof color.id === 'number' &&
          typeof color.hexCode === 'string' &&
          typeof color.name === 'string'
      )
  );
  const availableSizes = useMemo(() => {
    const sorted = sortSizeCodes(sizeFilterKind, catalogSizes);
    if (
      sizeFilterKind === SizeKind.Footwear &&
      footwearSystem === FootwearSizeSystem.Us
    ) {
      const usCodes = new Set<string>();
      for (const eu of sorted) {
        const us = euToUs(eu);
        if (us) {
          usCodes.add(us);
        }
      }
      return Array.from(usCodes).sort((a, b) => Number(a) - Number(b));
    }
    return sorted;
  }, [catalogSizes, sizeFilterKind, footwearSystem]);
  const handleSearch = (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setSearchTerm(event.target.value);
    resetPage();
  };
  const handleCategoryChange = (
    _event: React.SyntheticEvent,
    value: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Category[]
  ) => {
    setSelectedCategories(value);
    resetPage();
  };
  const handleSizeChange = (_event: React.SyntheticEvent, value: string[]) => {
    setSelectedSizes(value);
    resetPage();
  };
  const handleSizeKindChange = (
    _event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLElement>,
    next: SizeKind | null
  ) => {
    if (!next) {
      return;
    }
    setSizeFilterKind(next);
    setSelectedSizes([]);
    resetPage();
  };
  const handleFootwearSystemChange = (
    _event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLElement>,
    next: FootwearSizeSystem | null
  ) => {
    if (!next) {
      return;
    }
    setFootwearSystem(next);
    setSelectedSizes([]);
    resetPage();
  };
  const handleColorChange = (event: SelectChangeEvent) => {
    setSelectedColor(event.target.value as string);
    resetPage();
  };
  const handlePageChange = (
    event: React.ChangeEvent<unknown>,
    page: number
  ) => {
    setCurrentPage(page);
  };
  const handleAddToCart = (
    product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product,
    productInfo: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductInfo
  ) => {
    // Find the sellerProduct that matches this productInfo
    const sellerProduct = product.sellerProducts?.find(
      (sp) => sp.productInfoId === productInfo.id
    );
    if (!sellerProduct || !sellerProduct.seller) {
      console.error('No seller product found for this product info');
      return;
    }
    // Check stock availability
    if (sellerProduct.stockQuantity <= 0) {
      console.error('Product out of stock');
      return;
    }
    // Calculate final price after discount
    const finalPrice =
      sellerProduct.discount > 0
        ? sellerProduct.price -
          (sellerProduct.price * sellerProduct.discount) / 100
        : sellerProduct.price;
    addItem({
      productId: product.id.toString(),
      productName: product.name,
      productImage: productInfo.images?.[0] || null,
      quantity: 1,
      unitPrice: finalPrice,
      color: serializeVariantColorHexes(productInfo.colors),
      size: productInfo.size || null,
      sellerId: sellerProduct.seller.id.toString(),
      sellerName: '', // Not displayed to customers
      sellerShippingFee: sellerProduct.seller.shippingFee || 0,
      productInfoId: productInfo.id.toString(),
      sellerProductId: sellerProduct.id.toString(),
      availableStock: sellerProduct.stockQuantity,
    });
  };
  if (productsLoading) {
    return (
      <CustomersLayout>
        <Box
          display="flex"
          justifyContent="center"
          alignItems="center"
          minHeight="400px"
        >
          <CircularProgress />
        </Box>
      </CustomersLayout>
    );
  }
  if (productsError) {
    return (
      <CustomersLayout>
        <Alert severity="error">
          Error loading products: {productsError.message}
        </Alert>
      </CustomersLayout>
    );
  }
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalCount / itemsPerPage);
  return (
    <CustomersLayout>
      <Box sx={{ p: 3 }}>
        <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
          {LL.navigation.products()}
        </Typography>
        {/* Filters */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            mb: 3,
            display: 'flex',
            gap: 2,
            flexWrap: 'wrap',
            alignItems: 'center',
          }}
        >
          <TextField
            placeholder={LL.products.searchProductsPlaceholder()}
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={handleSearch}
            InputProps={{
              startAdornment: (
                <InputAdornment position="start">
                  <Search />
                </InputAdornment>
              ),
            }}
            sx={{ minWidth: 200 }}
          />
          <Autocomplete
            multiple
            options={categories}
            value={selectedCategories}
            onChange={handleCategoryChange}
            getOptionLabel={(option) => option.name}
            isOptionEqualToValue={(option, value) => option.id === value.id}
            renderInput={(params) => (
              <TextField
                {...params}
                label={LL.form.category()}
                placeholder={LL.products.allCategories()}
              />
            )}
            sx={{ minWidth: 220 }}
          />
          <ToggleButtonGroup
            exclusive
            size="small"
            value={sizeFilterKind}
            onChange={handleSizeKindChange}
            aria-label={LL.products.sizeKind()}
          >
            <ToggleButton value={SizeKind.Apparel}>
              {LL.products.sizeKindApparel()}
            </ToggleButton>
            <ToggleButton value={SizeKind.Footwear}>
              {LL.products.sizeKindFootwear()}
            </ToggleButton>
            <ToggleButton value={SizeKind.Pants}>
              {LL.products.sizeKindPants()}
            </ToggleButton>
          </ToggleButtonGroup>
          {(sizeFilterKind === SizeKind.Footwear || sizeFilterKind === SizeKind.Pants) ? (
            <ToggleButtonGroup
              exclusive
              size="small"
              value={footwearSystem}
              onChange={handleFootwearSystemChange}
              aria-label={LL.products.size()}
            >
              <ToggleButton value={FootwearSizeSystem.Eu}>
                {LL.products.sizeSystemEu()}
              </ToggleButton>
              <ToggleButton value={FootwearSizeSystem.Us}>
                {LL.products.sizeSystemUs()}
              </ToggleButton>
            </ToggleButtonGroup>
          ) : null}
          <Autocomplete
            multiple
            options={availableSizes}
            value={selectedSizes}
            onChange={handleSizeChange}
            getOptionLabel={(option) =>
              isPantsSizeKind(sizeFilterKind)
                ? formatSizeLabel(SizeKind.Pants, option) || option
                : option
            }
            renderInput={(params) => (
              <TextField
                {...params}
                label={LL.products.size()}
                placeholder={LL.products.size()}
              />
            )}
            sx={{ minWidth: 180 }}
          />
          <FormControl sx={{ minWidth: 150 }}>
            <InputLabel>{LL.form.color()}</InputLabel>
            <Select
              value={selectedColor}
              onChange={handleColorChange}
              label={LL.form.color()}
            >
              <MenuItem value="">{LL.products.allCategories()}</MenuItem>
              {safeColors.map((color) => (
                <MenuItem key={color.id} value={color.id.toString()}>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                    <Box
                      sx={{
                        width: 20,
                        height: 20,
                        backgroundColor: color.hexCode,
                        border: '1px solid #ccc',
                        borderRadius: '50%',
                      }}
                    />
                    {color.name}
                  </Box>
                </MenuItem>
              ))}
            </Select>
          </FormControl>
        </Box>
        {/* Products Grid */}
        <Grid container spacing={3}>
          {products.map((product) => {
            const pricingInfo = getPricingInfo(product);
            const hasNoSellers = Boolean(
              !product.sellerProducts || product.sellerProducts.length === 0
            );
            const isOutOfStock = pricingInfo
              ? pricingInfo.stockQuantity <= 0
              : false;
            const primaryInfo = product.productInfos[0];
            const canAddToCart = Boolean(
              primaryInfo && !hasNoSellers && !isOutOfStock
            );
            return (
              <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 4, lg: 3 }} key={product.id}>
                <Card
                  sx={{
                    height: '100%',
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    opacity: isOutOfStock ? 0.6 : 1,
                  }}
                >
                  {primaryInfo?.images?.[0] && (
                    <CardMedia
                      component="img"
                      height="200"
                      image={primaryInfo.images?.[0]}
                      alt={product.name}
                      sx={{ objectFit: 'cover' }}
                    />
                  )}
                  <CardContent sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
                    <Typography variant="h6" component="h2" gutterBottom>
                      {product.name}
                    </Typography>
                    {product.sku && (
                      <Typography
                        variant="body2"
                        color="text.secondary"
                        sx={{ mb: 1 }}
                      >
                        {LL.products.itemCodeSku()}: {product.sku}
                      </Typography>
                    )}
                    <Typography
                      variant="body2"
                      color="text.secondary"
                      sx={{ mb: 2 }}
                    >
                      {product.description}
                    </Typography>
                    {/* Pricing Information */}
                    {hasNoSellers ? (
                      <Box sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                        <Typography
                          variant="body2"
                          color="text.secondary"
                          sx={{ mb: 1 }}
                        >
                          {LL.products.noSellersAvailable()}
                        </Typography>
                        <Typography
                          variant="body2"
                          color="warning.main"
                          sx={{ fontWeight: 'bold' }}
                        >
                          {LL.products.checkBackLater()}
                        </Typography>
                      </Box>
                    ) : pricingInfo ? (
                      <Box sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                        <Box
                          sx={{
                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            gap: 1,
                            mb: 1,
                          }}
                        >
                          {pricingInfo.discount > 0 && (
                            <Typography
                              variant="body2"
                              sx={{
                                textDecoration: 'line-through',
                                color: 'text.secondary',
                              }}
                            >
                              <PriceDisplay
                                priceInUSD={pricingInfo.originalPrice}
                                showSymbol={true}
                                showOriginal={false}
                              />
                            </Typography>
                          )}
                          <Typography
                            variant="h6"
                            color={
                              pricingInfo.discount > 0 ? 'error' : 'primary'
                            }
                            sx={{ fontWeight: 'bold' }}
                          >
                            <PriceDisplay
                              priceInUSD={pricingInfo.finalPrice}
                              showSymbol={true}
                              showOriginal={false}
                            />
                          </Typography>
                          {pricingInfo.discount > 0 && (
                            <Chip
                              label={`${pricingInfo.discount}% OFF`}
                              size="small"
                              color="error"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          )}
                        </Box>
                        <Typography
                          variant="body2"
                          color={isOutOfStock ? 'error' : 'success.main'}
                          sx={{ fontWeight: 'bold' }}
                        >
                          {isOutOfStock
                            ? LL.products.outOfStock()
                            : `${
                                pricingInfo.stockQuantity
                              } ${LL.products.left()}`}
                        </Typography>
                      </Box>
                    ) : (
                      <Box sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                        <Typography
                          variant="body2"
                          color="text.secondary"
                          sx={{ mb: 1 }}
                        >
                          {LL.products.priceNotAvailable()}
                        </Typography>
                        <Typography
                          variant="body2"
                          color="warning.main"
                          sx={{ fontWeight: 'bold' }}
                        >
                          {LL.products.contactSeller()}
                        </Typography>
                      </Box>
                    )}
                    <Box sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                      {product.categories.map((category) => (
                        <Chip
                          key={category.id}
                          label={category.name}
                          size="small"
                          sx={{ mr: 1, mb: 1 }}
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Box>
                    <Typography variant="h6" color="primary" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                      {LL.products.availableVariants()}:{' '}
                      {product.productInfos.length}
                    </Typography>
                    <Box
                      sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1, mb: 2 }}
                    >
                      {product.productInfos.slice(0, 3).map((info) => (
                        <Box
                          key={info.id}
                          sx={{
                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            gap: 0.5,
                          }}
                        >
                          {info.colors?.map((color) => (
                            <Box
                              key={color.id}
                              sx={{
                                width: 16,
                                height: 16,
                                backgroundColor: color.hexCode,
                                border: '1px solid #ccc',
                                borderRadius: '50%',
                              }}
                              title={color.name}
                            />
                          ))}
                          <Typography variant="caption">
                            {formatSizeLabel(
                              info.sizeKind ?? SizeKind.Apparel,
                              info.size,
                              FootwearSizeSystem.Eu
                            )}
                            {isFootwearSizeKind(info.sizeKind) &&
                            euToUs(info.size)
                              ? ` (${LL.products.usEquivalent({
                                  us: euToUs(info.size)!,
                                })})`
                              : ''}
                            {info.colors?.length
                              ? ` · ${formatVariantColorNames(info.colors)}`
                              : ''}
                          </Typography>
                        </Box>
                      ))}
                      {product.productInfos.length > 3 && (
                        <Typography variant="caption">
                          +{product.productInfos.length - 3}{' '}
                          {LL.products.more()}
                        </Typography>
                      )}
                    </Box>
                    <Button
                      variant="contained"
                      startIcon={<ShoppingCart />}
                      onClick={() =>
                        primaryInfo && handleAddToCart(product, primaryInfo)
                      }
                      disabled={!canAddToCart}
                      fullWidth
                      sx={{
                        backgroundColor:
                          hasNoSellers || isOutOfStock
                            ? 'grey.400'
                            : 'primary.main',
                        '&:hover': {
                          backgroundColor:
                            hasNoSellers || isOutOfStock
                              ? 'grey.400'
                              : 'primary.dark',
                        },
                      }}
                    >
                      {hasNoSellers
                        ? LL.products.noSellers()
                        : isOutOfStock
                        ? LL.products.outOfStock()
                        : LL.products.addToCart()}
                    </Button>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              </Grid>
            );
          })}
        </Grid>
        {/* Pagination */}
        {totalPages > 1 && (
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', mt: 4 }}>
            <Pagination
              count={totalPages}
              page={currentPage}
              onChange={handlePageChange}
              color="primary"
            />
          </Box>
        )}
        {products.length === 0 && !productsLoading && (
          <Box sx={{ textAlign: 'center', py: 4 }}>
            <Typography variant="h6" color="text.secondary">
              {LL.products.noProductsFound()}
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        )}
      </Box>
    </CustomersLayout>
  );
}
export default CustomerProducts;
</file>

describe('CustomerProfile', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockAuthState.user = {
      id: '89210-alb',
      name: 'آرشام',
      lastName: 'پارسا',
      email: 'arsham.parsa@saintbala.com',
      role: 'CUSTOMER',
    };
  });
  it('renders successfully with user details, preferred sizes from service, and orders navigation', () => {
    render(
      <MemoryRouter>
        <CustomerProfile />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    expect(screen.getAllByText('آرشام پارسا').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(screen.getByText('مشخصات و نشانی')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('امنیت حساب')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('اطلاعات کاربری')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('نشانی تحویل سفارش')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('سایز انتخابی برای خرید')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('حساب مشتری')).toBeTruthy();
    // Verify sizes loaded from backend service
    expect(screen.getByText('M')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('42 EU (9 US)')).toBeTruthy();
    // Verify direct orders button is available
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: /سفارش‌های من/i })).toBeTruthy();
    // Verify edit buttons are enabled
    const editInfoBtn = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'ویرایش اطلاعات' });
    expect(editInfoBtn).not.toBeDisabled();
  });
  it('renders placeholder state and disables interactions when user is unauthenticated (guest)', () => {
    mockAuthState.user = null;
    render(
      <MemoryRouter>
        <CustomerProfile />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    // Displays login prompt
    expect(screen.getByText('لطفاً ابتدا وارد حساب کاربری خود شوید.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'ورود به حساب کاربری' })).toBeTruthy();
    // User details show placeholders and guest badge
    expect(screen.getByText('مهمان')).toBeTruthy();
    const dashes = screen.getAllByText('—');
    expect(dashes.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    // Edit buttons are disabled for guests
    const editInfoBtn = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'ویرایش اطلاعات' });
    expect(editInfoBtn).toBeDisabled();
    const addAddressBtns = screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: 'ثبت نشانی جدید' });
    expect(addAddressBtns.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    addAddressBtns.forEach((btn) => {
      expect(btn).toBeDisabled();
    });
    const editPrefBtn = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'ویرایش' });
    expect(editPrefBtn).toBeDisabled();
  });
  it('normalizes Persian digits to English ASCII digits when updating postal code', async () => {
    render(
      <MemoryRouter>
        <CustomerProfile />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    // Click edit address button
    const editAddressBtn = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'ویرایش نشانی' });
    fireEvent.click(editAddressBtn);
    // Dialog opens with title
    expect(screen.getByText('ویرایش نشانی تحویل')).toBeTruthy();
    // Find postal code input and type Persian digits
    const postalCodeInput = screen.getByLabelText('کد پستی:');
    fireEvent.change(postalCodeInput, { target: { value: '۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹۰' } });
    expect(postalCodeInput).toHaveValue('1234567890');
    // Click save changes
    const saveBtn = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'ذخیره تغییرات' });
    fireEvent.click(saveBtn);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockMutationFn).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          variables: {
            input: expect.objectContaining({
              zipCode: '1234567890',
            }),
          },
        })
      );
    });
  });
  it('saves preferred sizing selections to backend service', async () => {
    render(
      <MemoryRouter>
        <CustomerProfile />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    // Click edit preferred sizing button
    const editPrefBtn = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'ویرایش' });
    fireEvent.click(editPrefBtn);
    // Dialog opens
    expect(screen.getByText('ویرایش سایزهای انتخابی')).toBeTruthy();
    // Click save changes
    const saveBtn = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'ذخیره تغییرات' });
    fireEvent.click(saveBtn);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockMutationFn).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          variables: {
            input: expect.objectContaining({
              clothingSize: 'M',
              shoeSize: '42 EU (9 US)',
            }),
          },
        })
      );
    });
  });
});

import React, { type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { CustomerSignup } from './customer-signup';
import { vi, describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
import { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
// Mock the layout component
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/customers-layout', () => ({
  CustomersLayout: ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => (
    <div data-testid="customers-layout">{children}</div>
  ),
}));
// Mock the auth hook
const mockHandleRegister = vi.fn();
const mockUseCustomersRegister = vi.fn();
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/customers-auth-hooks', () => ({
  useCustomersRegister: () => mockUseCustomersRegister(),
}));
const mockShowSnackbar = vi.fn();
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/snackbar-hook', () => ({
  useSnackbar: () => ({
    showSnackbar: mockShowSnackbar,
  }),
}));
// Mock the error message utility
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/translations', () => ({
  getErrorMessage: (error: Error) => {
    if (error.message.includes('Email already exists')) {
      return { translationKey: 'emailAlreadyExists' };
    }
    return { rawMessage: error.message };
  },
}));
// Mock the i18n context with passwordTooShort
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n', () => ({
  useI18nContext: () => ({
    LL: {
      pageTitles: {
        signup: () => 'Sign Up',
      },
      authorization: {
        createAccount: () => 'Create Account',
        signIn: () => 'Sign In',
        signUp: () => 'Sign Up',
        alreadyHaveAccount: () => 'Already have an account?',
        confirmPassword: () => 'Confirm Password',
        passwordsDoNotMatch: () => 'Passwords do not match',
        passwordTooShort: () => 'Password must be at least 8 characters long',
        registrationSuccess: () =>
          'Registration successful! Welcome to SAINTBALA.',
        registrationFailed: () => 'Registration failed. Please try again.',
      },
      form: {
        email: () => 'Email Address',
        password: () => 'Password',
        fullName: () => 'Full Name',
      },
      errors: {
        requiredFields: () => 'Please fill in all required fields',
        emailAlreadyExists: () =>
          'This email is already registered. Please use a different email or try logging in.',
        unknown: () => 'An unknown error occurred. Please try again.',
      },
      status: {
        error: () => 'Error',
      },
    },
  }),
  usePageTitle: vi.fn(),
}));
// Mock the colors
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/colors', () => ({
  colors: {
    main: '#1976d2',
    text: '#333333',
    accent1: '#f5f5f5',
    hoverMain: '#1565c0',
  },
}));
// Mock React Router
const mockNavigate = vi.fn();
vi.mock('react-router-dom', async () => {
  const actual: Record<string, unknown> = await vi.importActual(
    'react-router-dom'
  );
  return {
    ...actual,
    useNavigate: () => mockNavigate,
    Link: ({ to, children }: { to: string; children: ReactNode }) => (
      <a href={to}>{children}</a>
    ),
  };
});
describe('CustomerSignup - Password Length Validation', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockUseCustomersRegister.mockReturnValue({
      handleRegister: mockHandleRegister,
      registerLoading: false,
    });
  });
  const renderComponent = () => {
    return render(
      <BrowserRouter>
        <CustomerSignup />
      </BrowserRouter>
    );
  };
  it('should show passwordTooShort error and NOT call handleRegister when password is 7 characters', async () => {
    renderComponent();
    const nameInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Full Name/i);
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i);
    const passwordInputs = screen.getAllByLabelText(/^Password/i);
    const passwordInput = passwordInputs[0];
    const confirmPasswordInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Confirm Password/i);
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create Account' });
    fireEvent.change(nameInput, { target: { value: 'John Doe' } });
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: 'john@example.com' } });
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'short7c' } });
    fireEvent.change(confirmPasswordInput, { target: { value: 'short7c' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Password must be at least 8 characters long')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    expect(mockHandleRegister).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('should call handleRegister when password is exactly 8 characters', async () => {
    mockHandleRegister.mockResolvedValue({});
    renderComponent();
    const nameInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Full Name/i);
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i);
    const passwordInputs = screen.getAllByLabelText(/^Password/i);
    const passwordInput = passwordInputs[0];
    const confirmPasswordInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Confirm Password/i);
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create Account' });
    fireEvent.change(nameInput, { target: { value: 'John Doe' } });
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: 'john@example.com' } });
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'abcdefgh' } });
    fireEvent.change(confirmPasswordInput, { target: { value: 'abcdefgh' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockHandleRegister).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'John Doe',
        'john@example.com',
        'abcdefgh'
      );
    });
  });
});

import React, { type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { CustomerSignup } from './customer-signup';
import { vi, describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';

  CustomersLayout: ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => (
    <div data-testid="customers-layout">{children}</div>
  ),
}));
// Mock the auth hook
const mockHandleRegister = vi.fn();
const mockUseCustomersRegister = vi.fn();
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/customers-auth-hooks', () => ({
  useCustomersRegister: () => mockUseCustomersRegister(),
}));
const mockShowSnackbar = vi.fn();

  useSnackbar: () => ({

          'Registration successful! Welcome to SAINTBALA.',

      },

        password: () => 'Password',
        fullName: () => 'Full Name',
      },
      errors: {
        requiredFields: () => 'Please fill in all required fields',
        emailAlreadyExists: () =>
          'This email is already registered. Please use a different email or try logging in.',
        unknown: () => 'An unknown error occurred. Please try again.',
      },
      status: {
        error: () => 'Error',
      },
    },

describe('CustomerSignup', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockUseCustomersRegister.mockReturnValue({
      handleRegister: mockHandleRegister,
      registerLoading: false,
    });
  });
  const renderComponent = () => {
    return render(
      <BrowserRouter>
        <CustomerSignup />
      </BrowserRouter>
    );
  };
  it('should render successfully', () => {
    renderComponent();
    expect(screen.getByTestId('customers-layout')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Create Account' })
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should render all form fields', () => {
    renderComponent();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/Full Name/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getAllByLabelText(/^Password/i)[0]).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/Confirm Password/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create Account' })
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should update form fields when typed', () => {
    renderComponent();
    const nameInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Full Name/i) as HTMLInputElement;
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(
      /Email Address/i
    ) as HTMLInputElement;
    const passwordInputs = screen.getAllByLabelText(
      /^Password/i
    ) as HTMLInputElement[];
    const passwordInput = passwordInputs[0];
    const confirmPasswordInput = screen.getByLabelText(
      /Confirm Password/i
    ) as HTMLInputElement;
    fireEvent.change(nameInput, { target: { value: 'John Doe' } });
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: 'john@example.com' } });
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'password123' } });
    fireEvent.change(confirmPasswordInput, {
      target: { value: 'password123' },
    });
    expect(nameInput.value).toBe('John Doe');
    expect(emailInput.value).toBe('john@example.com');
    expect(passwordInput.value).toBe('password123');
    expect(confirmPasswordInput.value).toBe('password123');
  });
  it('should show validation error when passwords do not match', async () => {
    renderComponent();
    const nameInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Full Name/i);
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i);
    const passwordInputs = screen.getAllByLabelText(/^Password/i);
    const passwordInput = passwordInputs[0];
    const confirmPasswordInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Confirm Password/i);
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create Account' });
    fireEvent.change(nameInput, { target: { value: 'John Doe' } });
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: 'john@example.com' } });
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'password123' } });
    fireEvent.change(confirmPasswordInput, { target: { value: 'different' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Passwords do not match')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });
  it('should call handleRegister with correct data on valid submission', async () => {
    mockHandleRegister.mockResolvedValue({});
    renderComponent();
    const nameInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Full Name/i);
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i);
    const passwordInputs = screen.getAllByLabelText(/^Password/i);
    const passwordInput = passwordInputs[0];
    const confirmPasswordInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Confirm Password/i);
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create Account' });
    fireEvent.change(nameInput, { target: { value: 'John Doe' } });
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: 'john@example.com' } });
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'password123' } });
    fireEvent.change(confirmPasswordInput, {
      target: { value: 'password123' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockHandleRegister).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'John Doe',
        'john@example.com',
        'password123'
      );
    });
  });
  it('should show success toast and navigate on successful registration', async () => {
    mockHandleRegister.mockResolvedValue({});
    renderComponent();
    const nameInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Full Name/i);
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i);
    const passwordInputs = screen.getAllByLabelText(/^Password/i);
    const passwordInput = passwordInputs[0];
    const confirmPasswordInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Confirm Password/i);
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create Account' });
    fireEvent.change(nameInput, { target: { value: 'John Doe' } });
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: 'john@example.com' } });
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'password123' } });
    fireEvent.change(confirmPasswordInput, {
      target: { value: 'password123' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockShowSnackbar).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'Registration successful! Welcome to SAINTBALA.',
        { severity: 'success' }
      );
      expect(mockNavigate).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/', { replace: true });
    });
  });
  it('should show translated error toast for duplicate email', async () => {
    const error = new Error('Email already exists');
    mockHandleRegister.mockRejectedValue(error);
    renderComponent();
    const nameInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Full Name/i);
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i);
    const passwordInputs = screen.getAllByLabelText(/^Password/i);
    const passwordInput = passwordInputs[0];
    const confirmPasswordInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Confirm Password/i);
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create Account' });
    fireEvent.change(nameInput, { target: { value: 'John Doe' } });
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: 'john@example.com' } });
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'password123' } });
    fireEvent.change(confirmPasswordInput, {
      target: { value: 'password123' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockShowSnackbar).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'This email is already registered. Please use a different email or try logging in.',
        { severity: 'error' }
      );
    });
  });
  it('should show raw error message for unknown errors', async () => {
    const error = new Error('Some unexpected server error');
    mockHandleRegister.mockRejectedValue(error);
    renderComponent();
    const nameInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Full Name/i);
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i);
    const passwordInputs = screen.getAllByLabelText(/^Password/i);

      expect(mockShowSnackbar).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'Some unexpected server error',
        { severity: 'error' }
      );
    });
  });
  it('should show loading state when registration is in progress', () => {
    mockUseCustomersRegister.mockReturnValue({
      handleRegister: mockHandleRegister,
      registerLoading: true,
    });
    renderComponent();
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create Account' });
    expect(submitButton).toBeDisabled();
    expect(screen.getByRole('progressbar', { name: 'Create Account' })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should have link to login page', () => {
    renderComponent();
    const loginLink = screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Sign In' });
    expect(loginLink).toHaveAttribute('href', '/login');
  });
  it('should have correct form attributes for accessibility', () => {
    renderComponent();
    const nameInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Full Name/i);
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i);
    const passwordInputs = screen.getAllByLabelText(/^Password/i);
    const passwordInput = passwordInputs[0];
    const confirmPasswordInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Confirm Password/i);
    expect(nameInput).toHaveAttribute('type', 'text');
    expect(nameInput).toHaveAttribute('required');
    expect(nameInput).toHaveAttribute('autoComplete', 'name');
    expect(emailInput).toHaveAttribute('type', 'text');
    expect(emailInput).toHaveAttribute('required');
    expect(emailInput).toHaveAttribute('autoComplete', 'email');
    expect(passwordInput).toHaveAttribute('type', 'password');
    expect(passwordInput).toHaveAttribute('required');
    expect(passwordInput).toHaveAttribute('autoComplete', 'new-password');
    expect(confirmPasswordInput).toHaveAttribute('type', 'password');
    expect(confirmPasswordInput).toHaveAttribute('required');
    expect(confirmPasswordInput).toHaveAttribute(
      'autoComplete',
      'new-password'
    );
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/customers/screens/forgot-password/src/lib/customer-forgot-password.spec.tsx">
import React, { type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { CustomerForgotPassword } from './customer-forgot-password';
import { vi, describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
import { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
// Mock the layout component
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/customers-layout', () => ({
  CustomersLayout: ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => (
    <div data-testid="customers-layout">{children}</div>
  ),
}));
// Mock the forgot password hook
const mockHandleForgotPassword = vi.fn();
const mockUseCustomersForgotPassword = vi.fn();
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/customers-auth-hooks', () => ({
  useCustomersForgotPassword: () => mockUseCustomersForgotPassword(),
}));
const mockShowSnackbar = vi.fn();
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/snackbar-hook', () => ({
  useSnackbar: () => ({
    showSnackbar: mockShowSnackbar,
  }),
}));
// Mock the error message utility
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/translations', () => ({
  getErrorMessage: (error: Error) => {
    if (error.message.includes('User not found')) {
      return { translationKey: 'userNotFound' };
    }
    return { rawMessage: error.message };
  },
}));
// Mock the i18n context
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n', () => ({
  useI18nContext: () => ({
    LL: {
      pageTitles: {
        forgotPassword: () => 'Forgot Password',
      },
      authorization: {
        resetYourPassword: () => 'Reset Your Password',
        enterEmailForReset: () =>
          'Enter your email address and we will send you a link to reset your password.',
        sendResetLink: () => 'Send Reset Link',
        backToLogin: () => 'Back to Login',
        resetLinkSent: () => 'Reset link sent! Check your email.',
        forgotPassword: () => 'Forgot Password',
      },
      form: {
        email: () => 'Email Address',
      },
      errors: {
        requiredFields: () => 'Please fill in all required fields',
        unknown: () => 'An unknown error occurred. Please try again.',
        userNotFound: () => 'User not found. Please check your email address.',
      },
      status: {
        error: () => 'Error',
      },
      checkout: {
        orderProcessed: () =>
          'Your order will be processed and you will receive a confirmation email.',
      },
    },
  }),
  usePageTitle: vi.fn(),
}));
// Mock the colors
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/colors', () => ({
  colors: {
    main: '#1976d2',
    text: '#333333',
    accent1: '#f5f5f5',
    hoverMain: '#1565c0',
  },
}));
// Mock React Router
vi.mock('react-router-dom', async () => {
  const actual: Record<string, unknown> = await vi.importActual(
    'react-router-dom'
  );
  return {
    ...actual,
    Link: ({ to, children }: { to: string; children: ReactNode }) => (
      <a href={to}>{children}</a>
    ),
  };
});
// Mock window.location.origin
Object.defineProperty(window, 'location', {
  value: {
    origin: 'http://localhost:4200',
  },
  writable: true,
});
describe('CustomerForgotPassword', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockUseCustomersForgotPassword.mockReturnValue({
      handleForgotPassword: mockHandleForgotPassword,
      forgotPasswordLoading: false,
    });
  });
  const renderComponent = () => {
    return render(
      <BrowserRouter>
        <CustomerForgotPassword />
      </BrowserRouter>
    );
  };
  it('should render successfully', () => {
    renderComponent();
    expect(screen.getByTestId('customers-layout')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Reset Your Password' })
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should render form fields', () => {
    renderComponent();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send Reset Link' })
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Back to Login' })
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should render helper text', () => {
    renderComponent();
    expect(
      screen.getByText(
        /Enter your email address and we will send you a link to reset your password/i
      )
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should update email field when typed', () => {
    renderComponent();
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(
      /Email Address/i
    ) as HTMLInputElement;
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: 'test@example.com' } });
    expect(emailInput.value).toBe('test@example.com');
  });
  it('should call handleForgotPassword with correct data on valid submission', async () => {
    mockHandleForgotPassword.mockResolvedValue(true);
    renderComponent();
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i);
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', {
      name: 'Send Reset Link',
    });
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: 'test@example.com' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockHandleForgotPassword).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'test@example.com',
        'http://localhost:4200'
      );
    });
  });
  it('should show success toast on successful submission', async () => {
    mockHandleForgotPassword.mockResolvedValue(true);
    renderComponent();
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i);
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', {
      name: 'Send Reset Link',
    });
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: 'test@example.com' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockShowSnackbar).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'Reset link sent! Check your email.',
        { severity: 'success' }
      );
    });
  });
  it('should show success message after submission', async () => {
    mockHandleForgotPassword.mockResolvedValue(true);
    renderComponent();
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i);
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', {
      name: 'Send Reset Link',
    });
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: 'test@example.com' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText(/Reset link sent/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });
  it('should show translated error toast for known errors', async () => {
    const error = new Error('User not found');
    mockHandleForgotPassword.mockRejectedValue(error);
    renderComponent();
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i);
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', {
      name: 'Send Reset Link',
    });
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: 'notfound@example.com' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockShowSnackbar).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'User not found. Please check your email address.',
        { severity: 'error' }
      );
    });
  });
  it('should show raw error message for unknown errors', async () => {
    const error = new Error('Some unexpected database error');
    mockHandleForgotPassword.mockRejectedValue(error);
    renderComponent();
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i);
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', {
      name: 'Send Reset Link',
    });
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: 'test@example.com' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockShowSnackbar).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'Some unexpected database error',
        { severity: 'error' }
      );
    });
  });
  it('should not call forgot password when email is empty (HTML5 validation)', () => {
    renderComponent();
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', {
      name: 'Send Reset Link',
    });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    // HTML5 validation prevents submit, so forgot password should not be called
    expect(mockHandleForgotPassword).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('should trim email before submission', async () => {
    mockHandleForgotPassword.mockResolvedValue(true);
    renderComponent();
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i);
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', {
      name: 'Send Reset Link',
    });
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: '  test@example.com  ' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockHandleForgotPassword).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'test@example.com',
        'http://localhost:4200'
      );
    });
  });
  it('should show loading state when submission is in progress', () => {
    mockUseCustomersForgotPassword.mockReturnValue({
      handleForgotPassword: mockHandleForgotPassword,
      forgotPasswordLoading: true,
    });
    renderComponent();
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send Reset Link' });
    expect(submitButton).toBeDisabled();
    expect(screen.getByRole('progressbar', { name: 'Send Reset Link' })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should have link to login page', () => {
    renderComponent();
    const loginLinks = screen.getAllByText(/Back to Login/i);
    const loginLink = loginLinks[0].closest('a');
    expect(loginLink).toHaveAttribute('href', '/login');
  });
  it('should have correct form attributes for accessibility', () => {
    renderComponent();
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i);
    expect(emailInput).toHaveAttribute('type', 'text');
    expect(emailInput).toHaveAttribute('required');
    expect(emailInput).toHaveAttribute('autoComplete', 'email');
  });
});

describe('CustomerGuidePayment Screen', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockLocale = 'en';
    window.matchMedia = vi.fn().mockImplementation((query) => ({
      matches: false,
      media: query,
      onchange: null,
      addListener: vi.fn(),
      removeListener: vi.fn(),
      addEventListener: vi.fn(),
      removeEventListener: vi.fn(),
      dispatchEvent: vi.fn(),
    }));
  });
  it('renders all payment security pillars, FAQs, and CTAs in English', () => {
    mockLocale = 'en';
    renderWithProviders(<CustomerGuidePayment />);
    expect(screen.getAllByText('SAINTBALA').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(
      screen.getByText('Payment & Gateway Security Guide')
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    // Pillars
    expect(

    expect(screen.getAllByText('SAINTBALA').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(
      screen.getByText('روش‌های پرداخت پشتیبانی‌شده')
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      screen.getByText('امنیت درگاه و رمزنگاری ۲۵۶ بیتی')
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      screen.getByText('راستی‌آزمایی و تسویه آنی سفارش')
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      screen.getByText('تضمین بازگشت وجه خودکار بانکی')
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      screen.getByText('پرسش‌های متداول و راهنمای رفع خطای پرداخت')
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

import React from 'react';
import { Link as RouterLink } from 'react-router-dom';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';

import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import {
  useI18nContext,
  useLanguageContext,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
import { formatTomanPrice } from '../home-selectors';
const API_BASE_URL =
  (import.meta as unknown as { env?: Record<string, string> }).env?.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '';
const resolveImageUrl = (img?: string | null) => {
  if (!img) return null;
  if (img.startsWith('http://') || img.startsWith('https://')) return img;
  if (img.startsWith('//')) return `https:${img}`;
  if (img.startsWith('/')) {
    const base =
      API_BASE_URL && API_BASE_URL.startsWith('http')
        ? API_BASE_URL
        : typeof window !== 'undefined'
        ? window.location.origin
        : '';
    return `${base}${img}`;
  }
  return img;
};
export interface BrandBlockItem {
  brand: string;
  mediaProduct?: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product;
  lineKey: 'nike' | 'jordan' | 'adidas';

}
interface BrandBlocksSectionProps {
  blocks: BrandBlockItem[];
  exchangeRate: number;
}

};

interface BentoTileProps {

function BentoTile({
  title,
  countLabel,
  link,
  product,
  isBig = false,
  kicker,
  tagline,
  fallbackImage,
}: BentoTileProps) {

interface CategoryBentoSectionProps {
  bento: {
    jordan: { product?: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product; count: number };
    women: { product?: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product; count: number };
    men: { product?: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product; count: number };
    hoodies: { product?: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product; count: number };
    pants: { product?: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product; count: number };
  };
  categories?: HomeCategory[];
}
export function CategoryBentoSection({
  bento,
  categories,
}: CategoryBentoSectionProps) {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  const { currentLocale, formatNumber } = useLanguageContext();
  const labels = useMemo(
    () => ({
      women: resolveCategoryLabel(
        'women',
        categories,
        LL.home.categories.women()
      ),
      men: resolveCategoryLabel('men', categories, LL.home.categories.men()),
      hoodies: resolveCategoryLabel(
        'hoodies',
        categories,
        LL.home.categories.hoodies()
      ),
      pants: resolveCategoryLabel(
        'pants',
        categories,
        LL.home.categories.pants()
      ),
      jordan: LL.home.categories.jordan(),
    }),
    [LL, categories]
  );
  const formatCount = (count: number) => {
    const n =
      currentLocale === 'fa'
        ? toPersianDigits(count)
        : typeof formatNumber === 'function'
        ? String(formatNumber(count))
        : String(count);
    return LL.home.categories.productCount({ count: n });
  };
  return (
    <Box
      component="section"
      aria-labelledby="bento-title"
      sx={{
        width: 'min(var(--wrap, 1180px), 100% - 2 * clamp(20px, 4vw, 48px))',
        mx: 'auto',
        pt: 'clamp(72px, 9vw, 120px)',
        fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
      }}
    >
      <Box className="rv" sx={{ mb: '32px' }}>
        <Typography
          sx={{
            fontSize: '13px',
            fontWeight: 500,
            color: 'var(--accent)',
            letterSpacing: '0.02em',
            mb: 0.5,
            fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
          }}
        >
          {LL.home.categories.kicker()}
        </Typography>
        <Typography
          id="bento-title"
          component="h2"
          sx={{
            fontSize: 'clamp(28px, 3vw, 40px)',
            fontWeight: 800,
            lineHeight: 1.25,
            letterSpacing: '-0.01em',
            color: 'var(--ink)',
            fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
          }}
        >
          {LL.home.categories.title()}
        </Typography>
      </Box>
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'grid',
          gridTemplateColumns: {
            xs: 'repeat(2, 1fr)',
            md: 'repeat(4, 1fr)',
          },
          gridAutoRows: {
            xs: '200px',
            sm: '220px',
            md: 'clamp(240px, 22vw, 320px)',
          },
          gap: '16px',
        }}
      >
        <BentoTile
          isBig
          title={labels.jordan}
          countLabel={formatCount(bento.jordan.count)}
          kicker="AIR JORDAN"
          tagline={LL.home.categories.jordanTagline()}
          link={getCustomerBrandRoute('jordan')}
          product={bento.jordan.product}
          fallbackImage="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1552346154-21d32810aba3?w=800"
        />
        <BentoTile
          title={labels.women}
          countLabel={formatCount(bento.women.count)}
          link={getCustomerShopRoute({ category: 'women' })}
          product={bento.women.product}
          fallbackImage="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1515886657613-9f3515b0c78f?w=600"
        />
        <BentoTile
          title={labels.men}
          countLabel={formatCount(bento.men.count)}
          link={getCustomerShopRoute({ category: 'men' })}
          product={bento.men.product}
          fallbackImage="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1507679799987-c73779587ccf?w=600"
        />
        <BentoTile
          title={labels.hoodies}
          countLabel={formatCount(bento.hoodies.count)}
          link={getCustomerShopRoute({ category: 'hoodies' })}
          product={bento.hoodies.product}
          fallbackImage="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1556905055-8f358a7a47b2?w=600"
