import React, { useState } from 'react';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import ButtonBase from '@mui/material/ButtonBase';
import MailOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/MailOutline';
import CheckCircleOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutline';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import { useI18nContext } from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
interface NewsletterSectionProps {
  onSubscribe?: (email: string) => Promise<boolean>;
}
export function NewsletterSection({ onSubscribe }: NewsletterSectionProps) {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'loading' | 'success' | 'error'>('idle');
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState('');
  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!email || !email.includes('@')) return;
    setStatus('loading');
    setErrorMessage('');
    try {
      if (onSubscribe) {
        const success = await onSubscribe(email);
        if (success) {
          setStatus('success');
          setEmail('');
        } else {
          setStatus('error');
          setErrorMessage(LL.home.newsletter.error());
        }
      } else {
        setStatus('success');
        setEmail('');
      }
    } catch {
      setStatus('error');
      setErrorMessage(LL.home.newsletter.error());
    }
  };
  return (
    <Box
      component="section"
      aria-labelledby="newsletter-heading"
      sx={{
        py: { xs: 8, md: 12 },
        px: { xs: 2.5, sm: 4, md: 6 },
        maxWidth: 1280,
        margin: '0 auto',
        fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
      }}
    >
      <Box
        className="rv"
        sx={{
          bgcolor: 'var(--paper)',
          borderRadius: '32px',
          boxShadow: '0 0 0 1px var(--hair), 0 24px 48px -20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)',
          p: { xs: '32px 24px', sm: '40px 32px', md: '56px 48px' },
          display: 'grid',
          gridTemplateColumns: { xs: '1fr', md: '1.2fr 1fr' },
          gap: { xs: 4, md: 6 },
          alignItems: 'center',
        }}
      >
        <Box>
          <Typography
            variant="overline"
            sx={{
              display: 'block',
              color: 'var(--accent)',
              fontSize: '12px',
              fontWeight: 700,
              letterSpacing: '0.16em',
              mb: 1,
              fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
            }}
          >
            {LL.home.newsletter.kicker()}
          </Typography>
          <Typography
            id="newsletter-heading"
            component="h2"
            sx={{
              fontSize: { xs: '26px', sm: '32px', md: '36px' },
              fontWeight: 800,
              color: 'var(--ink)',
              mb: 1.5,
              lineHeight: 1.25,
              fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
            }}
          >
            {LL.home.newsletter.title()}
          </Typography>
          <Typography
            sx={{
              fontSize: { xs: '15px', md: '16px' },
              color: 'var(--ink-2)',
              lineHeight: 1.8,
              fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
            }}
          >
            {LL.home.newsletter.subtitle()}
          </Typography>
        </Box>
        <Box>
          {status === 'success' ? (
            <Box
              role="status"
              sx={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 1.5,
                p: 2.5,
                borderRadius: '20px',
                bgcolor: 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent)',
                color: 'var(--ink)',
              }}
            >
              <CheckCircleOutlineIcon sx={{ color: 'var(--accent)', fontSize: 26 }} />
              <Typography
                sx={{
                  fontSize: '15px',
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
                }}
              >
                {LL.home.newsletter.success()}
              </Typography>
            </Box>
          ) : (
            <Box component="form" onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate>
              <Box
                sx={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
                  gap: 1.5,
                  alignItems: 'stretch',
                }}
              >
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    flex: 1,
                    position: 'relative',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    height: 50,
                    borderRadius: '25px',
                    bgcolor: 'var(--page)',
                    border: '1px solid var(--hair)',
                    px: 2,
                    transition: 'border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease',
                    '&:focus-within': {
                      borderColor: 'var(--accent)',
                      boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px var(--focus)',
                    },
                  }}
                >
                  <MailOutlineIcon
                    sx={{
                      color: 'var(--ink-3)',
                      fontSize: 20,
                      mr: 1,
                      flexShrink: 0,
                    }}
                  />
                  <label htmlFor="newsletter-email" style={{ display: 'none' }}>
                    {LL.home.newsletter.emailLabel()}
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="newsletter-email"
                    type="email"
                    required
                    autoComplete="email"
                    dir="ltr"
                    placeholder={LL.home.newsletter.emailPlaceholder()}
                    value={email}
                    onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                    style={{
                      width: '100%',
                      background: 'transparent',
                      border: 'none',
                      outline: 'none',
                      color: 'var(--ink)',
                      fontSize: '14.5px',
                      fontFamily: 'inherit',
                    }}
                  />
                </Box>
                <ButtonBase
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={status === 'loading'}
                  sx={{
                    height: 50,
                    px: { xs: 3, sm: 4 },
                    borderRadius: '25px',
                    bgcolor: 'var(--accent)',
                    color: '#ffffff',
                    fontSize: '15px',
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
                    boxShadow: '0 4px 16px rgba(184, 115, 51, 0.25)',
                    transition:
                      'transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease',
                    '&:hover': {
                      transform: 'translateY(-2px)',
                      boxShadow: '0 6px 22px rgba(184, 115, 51, 0.35)',
                    },
                    '&:disabled': {
                      opacity: 0.6,
                    },
                  }}
                >
                  {status === 'loading' ? (
                    <CircularProgress size={20} sx={{ color: '#ffffff' }} />
                  ) : (
                    LL.home.newsletter.subscribe()
                  )}
                </ButtonBase>
              </Box>
              {status === 'error' && errorMessage && (
                <Typography
                  sx={{
                    mt: 1.5,
                    fontSize: '13px',
                    color: '#e53935',
                    fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
                  }}
                >
                  {errorMessage}
                </Typography>
              )}
            </Box>
          )}
        </Box>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
}
export default NewsletterSection;

<file path="libs/client/customers/screens/home/src/lib/components/PicksRailSection.tsx">
import React, { useRef } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import ArrowBackIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArrowBack';
import ArrowForwardIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArrowForward';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import { CustomersProductCard } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-product-card';
import { getCustomerProductDetailsRoute } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-routes';
import {
  useI18nContext,
  useLanguageContext,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
interface PicksRailSectionProps {
  products: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product[];
  exchangeRate: number;
  onAddItem?: (product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product, size?: string) => void;
}
export function PicksRailSection({
  products,
  exchangeRate,
  onAddItem,
}: PicksRailSectionProps) {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  const { isRTL } = useLanguageContext();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const railRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const scrollPrev = () => {
    if (!railRef.current) return;
    const step = railRef.current.clientWidth * 0.75;
    railRef.current.scrollBy({
      left: isRTL ? step : -step,
      behavior: 'smooth',
    });
  };
  const scrollNext = () => {
    if (!railRef.current) return;
    const step = railRef.current.clientWidth * 0.75;
    railRef.current.scrollBy({
      left: isRTL ? -step : step,
      behavior: 'smooth',
    });
  };
  if (!products || products.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <Box
      component="section"
      id="picks"
      aria-labelledby="picks-heading"
      sx={{
        py: { xs: 8, md: 12 },
        position: 'relative',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
      }}
    >
      <Box
        className="rv"
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'flex-end',
          maxWidth: 1280,
          margin: '0 auto',
          px: { xs: 2.5, sm: 4, md: 6 },
          mb: { xs: 3.5, md: 5 },
        }}
      >
        <Box>
          <Typography
            variant="overline"
            sx={{
              display: 'block',
              color: 'var(--accent)',
              fontSize: '12px',
              fontWeight: 700,
              letterSpacing: '0.16em',
              mb: 1,
              fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
            }}
          >
            {LL.home.picks.kicker()}
          </Typography>
          <Typography
            id="picks-heading"
            component="h2"
            sx={{
              fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
              fontSize: { xs: '26px', sm: '32px', md: '38px' },
              fontWeight: 800,
              color: 'var(--ink)',
              lineHeight: 1.25,
            }}
          >
            {LL.home.picks.title()}
          </Typography>
        </Box>
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',
            gap: 1.5,
          }}
        >
          <IconButton
            onClick={scrollPrev}
            aria-label={LL.home.picks.prev()}
            sx={{
              width: 40,
              height: 40,
              borderRadius: '50%',
              bgcolor: 'var(--paper)',
              color: 'var(--ink)',
              border: '1px solid var(--hair)',
              boxShadow: '0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)',
              transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
              '&:hover': {
                bgcolor: 'var(--page)',
                borderColor: 'var(--ink-3)',
                transform: 'scale(1.05)',
              },
            }}
          >
            {isRTL ? (
              <ArrowForwardIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
            ) : (
              <ArrowBackIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
            )}
          </IconButton>
          <IconButton
            onClick={scrollNext}
            aria-label={LL.home.picks.next()}
            sx={{
              width: 40,
              height: 40,
              borderRadius: '50%',
              bgcolor: 'var(--paper)',
              color: 'var(--ink)',
              border: '1px solid var(--hair)',
              boxShadow: '0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)',
              transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
              '&:hover': {
                bgcolor: 'var(--page)',
                borderColor: 'var(--ink-3)',
                transform: 'scale(1.05)',
              },
            }}
          >
            {isRTL ? (
              <ArrowBackIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
            ) : (
              <ArrowForwardIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
            )}
          </IconButton>
        </Box>
      </Box>
      {/* Horizontal Rail */}
      <Box
        ref={railRef}
        data-testid="picks-rail"
        tabIndex={0}
        aria-label={LL.home.picks.title()}
        sx={{
          display: 'grid',
          gridAutoFlow: 'column',
          gridAutoColumns: {
            xs: '78%',
            sm: '46%',
            md: 'clamp(260px, 22vw, 300px)',
          },
          gap: { xs: '16px', md: '24px' },
          overflowX: 'auto',
          scrollSnapType: 'x mandatory',
          scrollbarWidth: 'none',
          '&::-webkit-scrollbar': { display: 'none' },
          px: {
            xs: '20px',
            md: 'max(24px, calc((100% - 1180px) / 2))',
          },
          scrollPaddingInline: {
            xs: '20px',
            md: 'max(24px, calc((100% - 1180px) / 2))',
          },
          py: 2,
          outline: 'none',
          '&:focus-visible': {
            outline: '2px solid var(--focus)',
            outlineOffset: '2px',
          },
        }}
      >
        {products.map((prod, idx) => (
          <Box
            key={prod.id}
            sx={{
              scrollSnapAlign: 'start',
              height: '100%',
              display: 'flex',
            }}
          >
            <CustomersProductCard
              appearance="glass"
              product={prod}
              exchangeRate={exchangeRate}
              index={idx}
              onCardClick={(p) => {
                navigate(getCustomerProductDetailsRoute(p.id));
              }}
              onAddToCart={(p) => {
                const size = p.productInfos?.[0]?.size || undefined;
                onAddItem?.(p, size);
              }}
              onAddVariantToCart={({ product: p, productInfo }) => {
                onAddItem?.(p, productInfo.size || undefined);
              }}
            />
          </Box>
        ))}
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
}
export default PicksRailSection;

<file path="libs/client/customers/screens/home/src/lib/components/ShopTheLookSection.tsx">
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Link as RouterLink } from 'react-router-dom';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import AddIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Add';
import ShoppingBagOutlined from '@mui/icons-material/ShoppingBagOutlined';
import CheckIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Check';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import { formatTomanPrice, isProductInStock } from '../home-selectors';
const API_BASE_URL =
  (import.meta as unknown as { env?: Record<string, string> }).env?.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '';
const resolveImageUrl = (img?: string | null) => {
  if (!img) return null;
  if (img.startsWith('http://') || img.startsWith('https://')) return img;
  if (img.startsWith('//')) return `https:${img}`;
  if (img.startsWith('/')) {
    const base =
      API_BASE_URL && API_BASE_URL.startsWith('http')
        ? API_BASE_URL
        : typeof window !== 'undefined'
        ? window.location.origin
        : '';
    return `${base}${img}`;
  }
  return img;
};
interface LookItemData {
  item?: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product;
  typeLabel: string;
  hotspot: { left: string; top: string };
  size: string;
}
interface ShopTheLookSectionProps {
  lookProducts: LookItemData[];
  exchangeRate: number;
  onAddItem?: (product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product, size?: string) => void;
  onAddAll?: (products: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product[]) => void;
}
export function ShopTheLookSection({
  lookProducts,
  exchangeRate,
  onAddItem,
  onAddAll,
}: ShopTheLookSectionProps) {
  const [activeHighlight, setActiveHighlight] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [addedItemIdx, setAddedItemIdx] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [addedAll, setAddedAll] = useState(false);
  // Fallback photos
  const fallbackPhotos = [
    'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1578632767115-351597cf2477?w=800',
    'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1552346154-21d32810aba3?w=800',
    'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1503342217505-b0a15ec3261c?w=800',
  ];
  const getProductPriceUSD = (p?: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product) => {
    if (!p?.sellerProducts || p.sellerProducts.length === 0) return 0;
    const sp = p.sellerProducts.find((s) => (s.stockQuantity || 0) > 0) || p.sellerProducts[0];
    const original = sp?.price || 0;
    const discount = sp?.discount || 0;
    return discount > 0 ? original * (1 - discount / 100) : original;
  };
  // Compute sum of in-stock items
  const inStockItems = lookProducts.filter(
    (lp) => lp.item && isProductInStock(lp.item)
  );
  const totalSumUSD = inStockItems.reduce(
    (sum, lp) => sum + getProductPriceUSD(lp.item),
    0
  );
  const handleAddSingle = (idx: number, lp: LookItemData) => {
    if (!lp.item || !isProductInStock(lp.item)) return;
    onAddItem?.(lp.item, lp.size);
    setAddedItemIdx(idx);
    setTimeout(() => setAddedItemIdx(null), 1800);
  };
  const handleAddAll = () => {
    const valid = inStockItems.map((lp) => lp.item as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product);
    if (valid.length === 0) return;
    onAddAll?.(valid);
    setAddedAll(true);
    setTimeout(() => setAddedAll(false), 1800);
  };
  return (
    <Box
      id="look"
      component="section"
      aria-labelledby="look-title"
      sx={{
        width: 'min(var(--wrap, 1180px), 100% - 2 * clamp(20px, 4vw, 48px))',
        mx: 'auto',
        pt: 'clamp(72px, 9vw, 120px)',
      }}
    >
      {/* 2 columns layout: 1.65fr (photos right in RTL) and 1fr (panel left in RTL) */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'grid',
          gridTemplateColumns: { xs: '1fr', md: '1.65fr 1fr' },
          gap: { xs: '32px', md: '40px' },
          alignItems: 'start',
        }}
      >
        {/* Look Board: 2x2 grid, aspect-ratio 1.12, gap 12px, radius 22px */}
        <Box
          className="rv"
          sx={{
            position: 'relative',
            display: 'grid',
            gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr',
            gridTemplateRows: '1fr 1fr',
            gap: '12px',
            aspectRatio: { xs: '1', sm: '1.12' },
            width: '100%',
          }}
        >
          {lookProducts.map((lp, idx) => {
            const rawImg =
              lp.item?.productInfos?.[0]?.images?.[0] ||
              lp.item?.sellerProducts?.[0]?.productInfo?.images?.[0];
            const imgSrc = resolveImageUrl(rawImg) || fallbackPhotos[idx];
            const isSpanned = idx === 0; // Photo 0 spans both rows
            const isHighlighted = activeHighlight === idx;
            const priceUSD = getProductPriceUSD(lp.item);
            const inStock = lp.item ? isProductInStock(lp.item) : true;
            return (
              <Box
                key={idx}
                onMouseEnter={() => setActiveHighlight(idx)}
                onMouseLeave={() => setActiveHighlight(null)}
                sx={{
                  position: 'relative',
                  gridRow: isSpanned ? 'span 2' : 'span 1',
                  borderRadius: '22px',
                  overflow: 'hidden',
                  backgroundColor: 'var(--frame)',
                }}
              >
                {/* Photo */}
                <Box
                  component="img"
                  src={imgSrc}
                  alt={lp.item?.name || lp.typeLabel}
                  loading="lazy"
                  sx={{
                    width: '100%',
                    height: '100%',
                    objectFit: 'cover',
                    objectPosition:
                      idx === 1 ? '50% 70%' : '50% 25%',
                    transform: isHighlighted ? 'scale(1.035)' : 'scale(1)',
                    filter: 'brightness(1.08) contrast(1.02)',
                    transition: 'transform 0.8s var(--ease), filter 0.3s ease',
                  }}
                />
                {/* Hotspot Button */}
                <Box
                  component="button"
                  type="button"
                  aria-label={lp.item?.name || lp.typeLabel}
                  aria-describedby={`tooltip-${idx}`}
                  onClick={() => setActiveHighlight(isHighlighted ? null : idx)}
                  sx={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    left: lp.hotspot.left,
                    top: lp.hotspot.top,
                    width: '30px',
                    height: '30px',
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    background: '#ffffff',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    boxShadow: '0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    zIndex: 4,
                    transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
                    transition: 'transform 0.2s',
                    '&:hover': {
                      transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.12)',
                    },
                  }}
                >
                  {/* Black 10px dot inside */}
                  <Box
                    sx={{
                      width: '10px',
                      height: '10px',
                      borderRadius: '50%',
                      background: '#111111',
                    }}
                  />
                  {/* Pulsing Ring */}
                  <Box
                    sx={{
                      position: 'absolute',
                      inset: '-7px',
                      borderRadius: '50%',
                      border: '1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)',
                      pointerEvents: 'none',
                      animation: 'hotspotPulse 2.4s infinite ease-out',
                      '@keyframes hotspotPulse': {
                        '0%': { transform: 'scale(0.7)', opacity: 0.85 },
                        '100%': { transform: 'scale(1.5)', opacity: 0 },
                      },
                      '@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)': {
                        animation: 'none',
                        opacity: 0.6,
                      },
                    }}
                  />
                </Box>
                {/* Hotspot Tooltip */}
                {isHighlighted && (
                  <Box
                    id={`tooltip-${idx}`}
                    role="tooltip"
                    sx={{
                      position: 'absolute',
                      left: lp.hotspot.left,
                      bottom: `calc(100% - ${lp.hotspot.top} + 18px)`,
                      transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
                      background: 'var(--paper)',
                      borderRadius: '14px',
                      p: '10px 14px',
                      fontSize: '12.5px',
                      zIndex: 10,
                      boxShadow: '0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)',
                      border: '1px solid var(--hair)',
                      whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                      pointerEvents: 'none',
                      maxWidth: '220px',
                    }}
                  >
                    <Typography
                      noWrap
                      sx={{
                        fontSize: '12px',
                        color: 'var(--ink)',
                        direction: 'ltr',
                        mb: 0.5,
                      }}
                    >
                      <bdi dir="ltr">{lp.item?.name || lp.typeLabel}</bdi>
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography
                      sx={{
                        fontSize: '13px',
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        color: 'var(--ink)',
                      }}
                    >
                      {inStock
                        ? formatTomanPrice(priceUSD, exchangeRate)
                        : 'ناموجود'}
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>
                )}
              </Box>
            );
          })}
        </Box>
        {/* Sticky Panel */}
        <Box
          className="rv"
          sx={{
            position: { xs: 'static', md: 'sticky' },
            top: { md: '88px' },
            background: 'var(--paper)',
            borderRadius: '28px',
            p: { xs: '24px', sm: '32px' },
            boxShadow:
              '0 0 0 1px var(--hair), 0 30px 60px -40px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)',
          }}
        >
          <Typography
            sx={{
              fontSize: '13px',
              fontWeight: 500,
              color: 'var(--accent)',
              letterSpacing: '0.02em',
              mb: 0.5,
            }}
          >
            ست کامل
          </Typography>
          <Typography
            id="look-title"
            component="h2"
            sx={{
              fontSize: 'clamp(28px, 3vw, 40px)',
              fontWeight: 800,
              lineHeight: 1.25,
              color: 'var(--ink)',
              mb: 1.5,
            }}
          >
            جردن قرمز
          </Typography>
          <Typography
            sx={{
              fontSize: '15px',
              lineHeight: 1.9,
              color: 'var(--ink-2)',
              mb: 3,
            }}
          >
            سه تکه از یک رنگ — سویشرت، شلوار فلیس و تی‌شرت جامپمن. جدا یا با هم.
          </Typography>
          {/* Ordered List of 3 rows */}
          <Box
            component="ol"
            sx={{
              listStyle: 'none',
              p: 0,
              m: 0,
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
            }}
          >
            {lookProducts.map((lp, idx) => {
              const rawImg =
                lp.item?.productInfos?.[0]?.images?.[0] ||
                lp.item?.sellerProducts?.[0]?.productInfo?.images?.[0];
              const imgSrc = resolveImageUrl(rawImg) || fallbackPhotos[idx];
              const priceUSD = getProductPriceUSD(lp.item);
              const inStock = lp.item ? isProductInStock(lp.item) : true;

              const isAdded = addedItemIdx === idx;
              return (
                <Box
                  component="li"

                  onMouseLeave={() => setActiveHighlight(null)}

              );
            })}
          </Box>

          <Box

              جمع ست
            </Typography>
            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '22px', fontWeight: 800, color: 'var(--ink)' }}>
              {formatTomanPrice(totalSumUSD, exchangeRate)}
            </Typography>
          </Box>
          {/* Full-width Solid Button */}
          <Button
            fullWidth
            onClick={handleAddAll}
            disabled={inStockItems.length === 0}
            startIcon={
              addedAll ? (
                <CheckIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} />
              ) : (
                <ShoppingBagOutlined sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} />
              )
            }
            sx={{

              },

<file path="libs/client/customers/screens/home/src/lib/useScrollProgress.ts">
import { useEffect } from 'react';
/**
 * Hook to provide JS fallback for scroll-driven animations (@property --t and --v)
 * when CSS animation-timeline: view() is not supported (e.g. Safari / Firefox).
 */
export function useScrollProgress() {
  useEffect(() => {
    // If browser supports CSS animation-timeline: view(), let native engine handle it
    const supportsViewTimeline =
      typeof CSS !== 'undefined' &&
      typeof CSS.supports === 'function' &&
      CSS.supports('animation-timeline: view()');
    const prefersReducedMotion =
      typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
      typeof window.matchMedia === 'function' &&
      window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    if (supportsViewTimeline && !prefersReducedMotion) {
      return;
    }
    const clamp = (val: number, min = 0, max = 1) =>
      Math.min(Math.max(val, min), max);
    let rafId: number | null = null;
    const onScroll = () => {
      if (rafId !== null) return;
      rafId = window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        rafId = null;
        if (prefersReducedMotion) {
          const hero = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.hero-campaign');
          if (hero) hero.style.setProperty('--t', '0');
          const rvElements = document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.rv');
          rvElements.forEach((el) => {
            el.style.setProperty('--v', '1');
          });
          return;
        }
        const vh = window.innerHeight;
        // 1. Hero progress --t
        const hero = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.hero-campaign');
        if (hero) {
          const rect = hero.getBoundingClientRect();
          const t = clamp(-rect.top / (rect.height || 1));
          hero.style.setProperty('--t', t.toFixed(4));
        }
        // 2. Reveal elements .rv progress --v
        const rvElements = document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.rv');
        rvElements.forEach((el) => {
          const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
          const h = rect.height;
          const start = 0.05 * Math.min(h, vh);
          const end = 0.3 * (vh + h);
          const v = clamp((vh - rect.top - start) / (end - start || 1));
          el.style.setProperty('--v', v.toFixed(4));
        });
      });
    };
    onScroll();
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', onScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => {
      if (rafId !== null) window.cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
      window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', onScroll);
    };
  }, []);
}

import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { CustomersLogin } from './CustomersLoginScreen';
import { vi, describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';

// Mock the auth hook
const mockHandleLogin = vi.fn();
const mockUseCustomersLogin = vi.fn();

    showSnackbar: mockShowSnackbar,
  }),

  },

// Mock the i18n context
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n', () => ({

        createAccount: () => 'Create Account',
      },
      form: {
        email: () => 'Email Address',
        password: () => 'Password',
      },
      errors: {
        wrongEmailOrPassword: () => 'Incorrect credentials',
      },
    },
  }),
  usePageTitle: vi.fn(),
}));
// Mock React Router
const mockNavigate = vi.fn();
vi.mock('react-router-dom', async () => {
  const actual: Record<string, unknown> = await vi.importActual(
    'react-router-dom'
  );
  return {
    ...actual,
    useNavigate: () => mockNavigate,
    useLocation: () => ({ state: { from: '/checkout' } }),
    Link: ({ to, children }: { to: string; children: ReactNode }) => (
      <a href={to}>{children}</a>
    ),
  };
});
describe('CustomersLogin', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockUseCustomersLogin.mockReturnValue({
      handleLogin: mockHandleLogin,
      loginLoading: false,
    });
  });
  const renderComponent = () => {
    return render(
      <BrowserRouter>
        <CustomersLogin />
      </BrowserRouter>
    );
  };
  it('should render successfully with layout and heading', () => {
    renderComponent();
    expect(screen.getByTestId('customers-layout')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Sign In' })
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should render form fields and action button', () => {
    renderComponent();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/^Password/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign In' })
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should update form fields when typed', () => {
    renderComponent();
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(
      /Email Address/i
    ) as HTMLInputElement;
    const passwordInput = screen.getByLabelText(
      /^Password/i
    ) as HTMLInputElement;
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: 'user@example.com' } });
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'secret123' } });
    expect(emailInput.value).toBe('user@example.com');
    expect(passwordInput.value).toBe('secret123');
  });
  it('should call handleLogin with correct data and navigate on submit', async () => {
    mockHandleLogin.mockResolvedValue({});
    renderComponent();
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i);
    const passwordInput = screen.getByLabelText(/^Password/i);
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign In' });
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: 'user@example.com' } });
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'secret123' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockHandleLogin).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'user@example.com',
        'secret123'
      );
      expect(mockShowSnackbar).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Welcome back!', {
        severity: 'success',
      });
      expect(mockNavigate).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/checkout', { replace: true });
    });
  });
  it('should show error toast on login failure', async () => {
    const error = new Error('wrong password');
    mockHandleLogin.mockRejectedValue(error);
    renderComponent();
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i);
    const passwordInput = screen.getByLabelText(/^Password/i);
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign In' });
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: 'user@example.com' } });
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'secret123' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockShowSnackbar).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Incorrect credentials', {
        severity: 'error',
      });
    });
  });
  it('should show loading indicator on button when loading', () => {
    mockUseCustomersLogin.mockReturnValue({
      handleLogin: mockHandleLogin,
      loginLoading: true,
    });
    renderComponent();
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign In' });
    expect(submitButton).toBeDisabled();
    expect(
      screen.getByRole('progressbar', { name: 'Sign In' })
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should have links to forgot password and signup pages', () => {
    renderComponent();
    const forgotPasswordLink = screen
      .getByText(/Forgot Password/i)
      .closest('a');
    expect(forgotPasswordLink).toHaveAttribute('href', '/forgot-password');
    const signupLink = screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Create Account' });
    expect(signupLink).toHaveAttribute('href', '/signup');
  });
  it('should have correct input attributes for accessibility', () => {
    renderComponent();
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i);
    const passwordInput = screen.getByLabelText(/^Password/i);
    expect(emailInput).toHaveAttribute('type', 'text');
    expect(emailInput).toHaveAttribute('required');
    expect(emailInput).toHaveAttribute('autoComplete', 'email');
    expect(passwordInput).toHaveAttribute('type', 'password');
    expect(passwordInput).toHaveAttribute('required');
    expect(passwordInput).toHaveAttribute('autoComplete', 'current-password');
  });
});

export function CustomerPrivacyPolicy() {

<file path="libs/client/customers/screens/reset-password/src/lib/customer-reset-password.password-length.spec.tsx">
import React, { type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { CustomerResetPassword } from './customer-reset-password';
import { vi, describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
import { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
// Mock the layout component
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/customers-layout', () => ({
  CustomersLayout: ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => (
    <div data-testid="customers-layout">{children}</div>
  ),
}));
// Mock the auth hook
const mockHandleResetPassword = vi.fn();
const mockUseCustomersResetPassword = vi.fn();
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/customers-auth-hooks', () => ({
  useCustomersResetPassword: () => mockUseCustomersResetPassword(),
}));
const mockShowSnackbar = vi.fn();
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/snackbar-hook', () => ({
  useSnackbar: () => ({
    showSnackbar: mockShowSnackbar,
  }),
}));
// Mock the error message utility
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/translations', () => ({
  getErrorMessage: (error: Error) => {
    if (error.message.includes('Invalid token')) {
      return { translationKey: 'invalidToken' };
    }
    return { rawMessage: error.message };
  },
}));
// Mock the i18n context with passwordTooShort
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n', () => ({
  useI18nContext: () => ({
    LL: {
      pageTitles: {
        resetPassword: () => 'Reset Password',
      },
      authorization: {
        resetPassword: () => 'Reset Password',
        enterNewPassword: () => 'Enter your new password below.',
        confirmPassword: () => 'Confirm Password',
        passwordsDoNotMatch: () => 'Passwords do not match',
        passwordTooShort: () => 'Password must be at least 8 characters long',
        invalidToken: () => 'Invalid or expired reset token.',
        passwordResetSuccess: () => 'Password has been reset successfully.',
        backToLogin: () => 'Back to Login',
      },
      form: {
        password: () => 'Password',
      },
      errors: {
        invalidToken: () => 'Invalid or expired reset token. Please request a new password reset.',
        unknown: () => 'An unknown error occurred. Please try again.',
      },
      status: {
        error: () => 'Error',
      },
    },
  }),
  usePageTitle: vi.fn(),
}));
// Mock React Router
const mockNavigate = vi.fn();
vi.mock('react-router-dom', async () => {
  const actual: Record<string, unknown> = await vi.importActual(
    'react-router-dom'
  );
  return {
    ...actual,
    useNavigate: () => mockNavigate,
    useParams: () => ({ token: 'valid-reset-token' }),
    Link: ({ to, children }: { to: string; children: ReactNode }) => (
      <a href={to}>{children}</a>
    ),
  };
});
describe('CustomerResetPassword - Password Length Validation', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockUseCustomersResetPassword.mockReturnValue({
      handleResetPassword: mockHandleResetPassword,
      resetPasswordLoading: false,
    });
  });
  const renderComponent = () => {
    return render(
      <BrowserRouter>
        <CustomerResetPassword />
      </BrowserRouter>
    );
  };
  it('should show passwordTooShort error and NOT call handleResetPassword when password is 7 characters', async () => {
    renderComponent();
    const passwordInputs = screen.getAllByLabelText(/^Password/i);
    const passwordInput = passwordInputs[0];
    const confirmPasswordInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Confirm Password/i);
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reset Password' });
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'short7c' } });
    fireEvent.change(confirmPasswordInput, { target: { value: 'short7c' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Password must be at least 8 characters long')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    expect(mockHandleResetPassword).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('should call handleResetPassword when password is exactly 8 characters', async () => {
    mockHandleResetPassword.mockResolvedValue({});
    renderComponent();
    const passwordInputs = screen.getAllByLabelText(/^Password/i);
    const passwordInput = passwordInputs[0];
    const confirmPasswordInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Confirm Password/i);
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reset Password' });
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'abcdefgh' } });
    fireEvent.change(confirmPasswordInput, { target: { value: 'abcdefgh' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockHandleResetPassword).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'valid-reset-token',
        'abcdefgh'
      );
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/customers/zustand/customer-checkout-store/src/lib/customer-checkout-store.spec.ts">
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { useCheckoutStore } from './customer-checkout-store';
describe('customer-checkout-store', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    useCheckoutStore.getState().resetCheckout();
  });
  it('should initialize with default state', () => {
    const state = useCheckoutStore.getState();
    expect(state.isCheckoutDialogOpen).toBe(false);
    expect(state.isAuthDialogOpen).toBe(false);
    expect(state.activeStep).toBe(0);
    expect(state.shippingMethod).toBe('vip');
    expect(state.shippingInfo.customerName).toBe('');
    expect(state.createdOrder).toBeNull();
  });
  it('should update shipping method', () => {
    expect(useCheckoutStore.getState().shippingMethod).toBe('vip');
    useCheckoutStore.getState().setShippingMethod('express');
    expect(useCheckoutStore.getState().shippingMethod).toBe('express');
    useCheckoutStore.getState().setShippingMethod('pickup');
    expect(useCheckoutStore.getState().shippingMethod).toBe('pickup');
  });
  it('should handle dialog controls', () => {
    useCheckoutStore.getState().openCheckoutDialog();
    expect(useCheckoutStore.getState().isCheckoutDialogOpen).toBe(true);
    useCheckoutStore.getState().closeCheckoutDialog();
    expect(useCheckoutStore.getState().isCheckoutDialogOpen).toBe(false);
    useCheckoutStore.getState().openAuthDialog();
    expect(useCheckoutStore.getState().isAuthDialogOpen).toBe(true);
    useCheckoutStore.getState().closeAuthDialog();
    expect(useCheckoutStore.getState().isAuthDialogOpen).toBe(false);
  });
  it('should handle stepper steps', () => {
    useCheckoutStore.getState().nextStep();
    expect(useCheckoutStore.getState().activeStep).toBe(1);
    useCheckoutStore.getState().nextStep();
    expect(useCheckoutStore.getState().activeStep).toBe(2);
    useCheckoutStore.getState().prevStep();
    expect(useCheckoutStore.getState().activeStep).toBe(1);
    useCheckoutStore.getState().setActiveStep(3);
    expect(useCheckoutStore.getState().activeStep).toBe(3);
  });
  it('should update shipping fields and clear field validation error', () => {
    useCheckoutStore.getState().setValidationErrors({
      customerName: 'Name is required',
      customerEmail: 'Email is required',
    });
    useCheckoutStore.getState().updateShippingField('customerName', 'John Doe');
    expect(useCheckoutStore.getState().shippingInfo.customerName).toBe('John Doe');
    expect(useCheckoutStore.getState().validationErrors.customerName).toBeUndefined();
    expect(useCheckoutStore.getState().validationErrors.customerEmail).toBe('Email is required');
  });
  it('should reset checkout state properly', () => {
    useCheckoutStore.getState().openCheckoutDialog();
    useCheckoutStore.getState().setActiveStep(2);
    useCheckoutStore.getState().setIsCreatingOrder(true);
    useCheckoutStore.getState().resetCheckout();
    const state = useCheckoutStore.getState();
    expect(state.isCheckoutDialogOpen).toBe(false);
    expect(state.activeStep).toBe(0);
    expect(state.isCreatingOrder).toBe(false);
  });
});
</file>

<file path="libs/client/customers/zustand/customer-checkout-store/src/lib/customer-checkout-store.ts">
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { persist } from 'zustand/middleware';
export interface ShippingInfo {
  customerName: string;
  customerEmail: string;
  customerPhone: string;
  shippingAddress: string;
  city: string;
  state: string;
  zipCode: string;
  country: string;
  notes: string;
}
export interface CreatedOrder {
  id: string;
  orderNumber: string;
}
export type ShippingMethod = 'vip' | 'express' | 'pickup';
export interface CheckoutState {
  // Modal visibility
  isCheckoutDialogOpen: boolean;
  isAuthDialogOpen: boolean;
  // Stepper
  activeStep: number;
  // Shipping Method
  shippingMethod: ShippingMethod;
  // Shipping Form Data
  shippingInfo: Partial<ShippingInfo>;
  validationErrors: Record<string, string | undefined>;
  // Order & Payment
  isCreatingOrder: boolean;
  createdOrder: CreatedOrder | null;
  paymentAuthority: string | null;
}
export interface CheckoutActions {
  // Dialog controls
  openCheckoutDialog: () => void;
  closeCheckoutDialog: () => void;
  openAuthDialog: () => void;
  closeAuthDialog: () => void;
  // Stepper controls
  setActiveStep: (step: number) => void;
  nextStep: () => void;
  prevStep: () => void;
  // Shipping method controls
  setShippingMethod: (method: ShippingMethod) => void;
  // Shipping form controls
  setShippingInfo: (
    info:
      | Partial<ShippingInfo>
      | ((prev: Partial<ShippingInfo>) => Partial<ShippingInfo>)
  ) => void;
  updateShippingField: (field: keyof ShippingInfo, value: string) => void;
  setValidationErrors: (errors: Record<string, string | undefined>) => void;
  clearValidationError: (field: string) => void;
  clearAllValidationErrors: () => void;
  // Order & Payment controls
  setIsCreatingOrder: (isCreating: boolean) => void;
  setCreatedOrder: (order: CreatedOrder | null) => void;
  setPaymentAuthority: (authority: string | null) => void;
  // Reset
  resetCheckout: () => void;
}
export type CheckoutStore = CheckoutState & CheckoutActions;
const initialShippingInfo: Partial<ShippingInfo> = {
  customerName: '',
  customerEmail: '',
  customerPhone: '',
  shippingAddress: '',
  city: '',
  state: '',
  zipCode: '',
  country: '',
  notes: '',
};
export const useCheckoutStore = create<CheckoutStore>()(
  persist(
    (set) => ({
      // Initial state
      isCheckoutDialogOpen: false,
      isAuthDialogOpen: false,
      activeStep: 0,
      shippingMethod: 'vip',
      shippingInfo: initialShippingInfo,
      validationErrors: {},
      isCreatingOrder: false,
      createdOrder: null,
      paymentAuthority: null,
      // Dialog controls
      openCheckoutDialog: () => set({ isCheckoutDialogOpen: true }),
      closeCheckoutDialog: () => set({ isCheckoutDialogOpen: false }),
      openAuthDialog: () => set({ isAuthDialogOpen: true }),
      closeAuthDialog: () => set({ isAuthDialogOpen: false }),
      // Stepper controls
      setActiveStep: (step) => set({ activeStep: step }),
      nextStep: () => set((state) => ({ activeStep: state.activeStep + 1 })),
      prevStep: () =>
        set((state) => ({
          activeStep: Math.max(0, state.activeStep - 1),
        })),
      // Shipping method controls
      setShippingMethod: (method) => set({ shippingMethod: method }),
      // Shipping form controls
      setShippingInfo: (info) =>
        set((state) => ({
          shippingInfo:
            typeof info === 'function' ? info(state.shippingInfo) : info,
        })),
      updateShippingField: (field, value) =>
        set((state) => {
          const newErrors = { ...state.validationErrors };
          delete newErrors[field];
          return {
            shippingInfo: { ...state.shippingInfo, [field]: value },
            validationErrors: newErrors,
          };
        }),
      setValidationErrors: (errors) => set({ validationErrors: errors }),
      clearValidationError: (field) =>
        set((state) => {
          const newErrors = { ...state.validationErrors };
          delete newErrors[field];
          return { validationErrors: newErrors };
        }),
      clearAllValidationErrors: () => set({ validationErrors: {} }),
      // Order & Payment controls
      setIsCreatingOrder: (isCreating) => set({ isCreatingOrder: isCreating }),
      setCreatedOrder: (order) => set({ createdOrder: order }),
      setPaymentAuthority: (authority) => set({ paymentAuthority: authority }),
      // Reset
      resetCheckout: () =>
        set({
          isCheckoutDialogOpen: false,
          isAuthDialogOpen: false,
          activeStep: 0,
          shippingMethod: 'vip',
          validationErrors: {},
          isCreatingOrder: false,
          createdOrder: null,
          paymentAuthority: null,
        }),
    }),
    {
      name: 'customer-checkout-storage',
      // Persist shippingInfo and shippingMethod across sessions
      partialize: (state) => ({
        shippingInfo: state.shippingInfo,
        shippingMethod: state.shippingMethod,
      }),
    }
  )
);
// Selector hooks for components
export const useIsCheckoutDialogOpen = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.isCheckoutDialogOpen);
export const useIsAuthDialogOpen = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.isAuthDialogOpen);
export const useCheckoutActiveStep = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.activeStep);
export const useCheckoutShippingMethod = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.shippingMethod);
export const useCheckoutShippingInfo = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.shippingInfo);
export const useCheckoutValidationErrors = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.validationErrors);
export const useIsCreatingOrder = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.isCreatingOrder);
export const useCreatedOrder = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.createdOrder);
export const usePaymentAuthority = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.paymentAuthority);
// Action hooks
export const useOpenCheckoutDialog = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.openCheckoutDialog);
export const useCloseCheckoutDialog = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.closeCheckoutDialog);
export const useOpenAuthDialog = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.openAuthDialog);
export const useCloseAuthDialog = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.closeAuthDialog);
export const useSetCheckoutStep = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.setActiveStep);
export const useNextCheckoutStep = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.nextStep);
export const usePrevCheckoutStep = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.prevStep);
export const useSetShippingMethod = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.setShippingMethod);
export const useSetShippingInfo = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.setShippingInfo);
export const useUpdateShippingField = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.updateShippingField);
export const useSetValidationErrors = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.setValidationErrors);
export const useClearValidationError = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.clearValidationError);
export const useClearAllValidationErrors = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.clearAllValidationErrors);
export const useSetIsCreatingOrder = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.setIsCreatingOrder);
export const useSetCreatedOrder = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.setCreatedOrder);
export const useSetPaymentAuthority = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.setPaymentAuthority);
export const useResetCheckout = () =>
  useCheckoutStore((state) => state.resetCheckout);
</file>

<file path="libs/client/customers/zustand/customer-wishlist-store/src/lib/customer-wishlist-store.spec.ts">
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import {
  useWishlistStore,
  useWishlistItems,
  useWishlistCount,
  useIsFavorite,
  WishlistItem,
} from './customer-wishlist-store';
import { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react';
const mockItem1: WishlistItem = {
  id: 101,
  name: 'Oversized Silk Blend Hoodie',
  brand: 'SAINTBALA',
  price: 450,
  productCode: 'SB-HD-001',
};
const mockItem2: WishlistItem = {
  id: 102,
  name: 'Monogram Technical Runner',
  brand: 'SAINTBALA',
  price: 680,
  productCode: 'SB-RN-002',
};
describe('customer-wishlist-store', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    useWishlistStore.setState({
      items: [],
      isLoading: false,
      error: null,
      lastUpdated: null,
    });
  });
  it('starts with an empty items array', () => {
    const state = useWishlistStore.getState();
    expect(state.items).toEqual([]);
    expect(state.isItemFavorite(101)).toBe(false);
  });
  it('adds an item safely and prevents duplicate additions', () => {
    useWishlistStore.getState().addItem(mockItem1);
    expect(useWishlistStore.getState().items).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(useWishlistStore.getState().isItemFavorite(101)).toBe(true);
    // Re-adding same item should not duplicate
    useWishlistStore.getState().addItem(mockItem1);
    expect(useWishlistStore.getState().items).toHaveLength(1);
  });
  it('removes an item by id', () => {
    useWishlistStore.getState().addItem(mockItem1);
    useWishlistStore.getState().addItem(mockItem2);
    expect(useWishlistStore.getState().items).toHaveLength(2);
    useWishlistStore.getState().removeItem(101);
    expect(useWishlistStore.getState().items).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(useWishlistStore.getState().isItemFavorite(101)).toBe(false);
    expect(useWishlistStore.getState().isItemFavorite(102)).toBe(true);
  });
  it('toggles an item between added and removed', () => {
    useWishlistStore.getState().toggleItem(mockItem1);
    expect(useWishlistStore.getState().isItemFavorite(101)).toBe(true);
    useWishlistStore.getState().toggleItem(mockItem1);
    expect(useWishlistStore.getState().isItemFavorite(101)).toBe(false);
  });
  it('clears all items in the wishlist', () => {
    useWishlistStore.getState().addItem(mockItem1);
    useWishlistStore.getState().addItem(mockItem2);
    expect(useWishlistStore.getState().items).toHaveLength(2);
    useWishlistStore.getState().clearWishlist();
    expect(useWishlistStore.getState().items).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('handles null, undefined, and malformed inputs defensively without throwing', () => {
    // @ts-expect-error test invalid invocation
    useWishlistStore.getState().addItem(null);
    // @ts-expect-error test invalid invocation
    useWishlistStore.getState().addItem(undefined);
    // @ts-expect-error test item without id
    useWishlistStore.getState().addItem({ name: 'No ID' });
    expect(useWishlistStore.getState().items).toEqual([]);
    // @ts-expect-error test invalid invocation
    useWishlistStore.getState().removeItem(null);
    // @ts-expect-error test invalid invocation
    useWishlistStore.getState().removeItem(undefined);
    // @ts-expect-error test invalid invocation
    expect(useWishlistStore.getState().isItemFavorite(null)).toBe(false);
    // @ts-expect-error test invalid invocation
    expect(useWishlistStore.getState().isItemFavorite(undefined)).toBe(false);
  });
  it('hook selectors return defensive defaults when state has empty or corrupted items', () => {
    const { result: itemsResult } = renderHook(() => useWishlistItems());
    const { result: countResult } = renderHook(() => useWishlistCount());
    const { result: isFavResult } = renderHook(() => useIsFavorite(101));
    expect(itemsResult.current).toEqual([]);
    expect(countResult.current).toBe(0);
    expect(isFavResult.current).toBe(false);
    act(() => {
      useWishlistStore.getState().addItem(mockItem1);
    });
    expect(itemsResult.current).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(countResult.current).toBe(1);
    expect(isFavResult.current).toBe(true);
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/customers/zustand/customer-wishlist-store/src/lib/customer-wishlist-store.ts">
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { persist, createJSONStorage } from 'zustand/middleware';
export interface WishlistItem {
  id: number | string;
  name: string;
  brand?: string | null;
  model?: string | null;
  primaryImage?: string | null;
  price?: number | null;
  discount?: number | null;
  slug?: string | null;
  productCode?: string | null;
  categories?: Array<{ id?: string | number; name?: string; slug?: string }>;
  rawProduct?: unknown;
}
export interface WishlistState {
  items: WishlistItem[];
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  lastUpdated: string | null;
}
export interface WishlistActions {
  addItem: (item: WishlistItem) => void;
  removeItem: (itemId: number | string) => void;
  toggleItem: (item: WishlistItem) => void;
  clearWishlist: () => void;
  setItems: (items: WishlistItem[]) => void;
  isItemFavorite: (itemId: number | string) => boolean;
}
export type WishlistStore = WishlistState & WishlistActions;
const notifyWishlistSync = () => {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    try {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('saintbala-wishlist-sync'));
    } catch (e) {
      // Ignore if CustomEvent not supported
    }
  }
};
export const useWishlistStore = create<WishlistStore>()(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      items: [],
      isLoading: false,
      error: null,
      lastUpdated: null,
      addItem: (item) => {
        if (!item || item.id === undefined || item.id === null) return;
        set((state) => {
          const currentItems = Array.isArray(state?.items) ? state.items : [];
          const exists = currentItems.some(
            (i) => String(i.id) === String(item.id)
          );
          if (exists) {
            return state;
          }
          return {
            ...state,
            items: [...currentItems, item],
            lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
          };
        });
        notifyWishlistSync();
      },
      removeItem: (itemId) => {
        if (itemId === undefined || itemId === null) return;
        set((state) => {
          const currentItems = Array.isArray(state?.items) ? state.items : [];
          return {
            ...state,
            items: currentItems.filter((i) => String(i.id) !== String(itemId)),
            lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
          };
        });
        notifyWishlistSync();
      },
      toggleItem: (item) => {
        if (!item || item.id === undefined || item.id === null) return;
        const exists = get().isItemFavorite(item.id);
        if (exists) {
          get().removeItem(item.id);
        } else {
          get().addItem(item);
        }
      },
      clearWishlist: () => {
        set((state) => ({
          ...state,
          items: [],
          lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
        }));
        notifyWishlistSync();
      },
      setItems: (items) => {
        set((state) => ({
          ...state,
          items: Array.isArray(items) ? items : [],
          lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
        }));
        notifyWishlistSync();
      },
      isItemFavorite: (itemId) => {
        if (itemId === undefined || itemId === null) return false;
        const currentItems = Array.isArray(get()?.items) ? get().items : [];
        return currentItems.some((i) => String(i.id) === String(itemId));
      },
    }),
    {
      name: 'saintbala-customer-wishlist',
      storage: createJSONStorage(() => {
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
          return window.localStorage;
        }
        // Fallback in-memory storage for SSR / tests without localStorage
        return {
          getItem: () => null,
          setItem: () => undefined,
          removeItem: () => undefined,
        };
      }),
      // Defensive merge: always ensures `items` is an array even if corrupted
      merge: (persistedState, currentState) => {
        const persisted = (persistedState || {}) as Partial<WishlistState>;
        const safeItems = Array.isArray(persisted.items)
          ? persisted.items.filter(
              (item): item is WishlistItem =>
                Boolean(item) &&
                typeof item === 'object' &&
                item.id !== undefined &&
                item.id !== null
            )
          : [];
        return {
          ...currentState,
          ...persisted,
          items: safeItems,
        };
      },
    }
  )
);
// Cross-tab synchronization via storage events & custom event
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  const syncWishlist = () => {
    try {
      useWishlistStore.persist?.rehydrate();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to rehydrate wishlist:', err);
    }
  };
  window.addEventListener('storage', (event) => {
    if (event.key === 'saintbala-customer-wishlist') {
      syncWishlist();
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('saintbala-wishlist-sync', () => {
    syncWishlist();
  });
}
// Defensive selectors & hooks
export const useWishlistItems = (): WishlistItem[] => {
  return useWishlistStore((state) =>
    Array.isArray(state?.items) ? state.items : []
  );
};
export const useWishlistCount = (): number => {
  return useWishlistStore((state) =>
    Array.isArray(state?.items) ? state.items.length : 0
  );
};
export const useIsFavorite = (itemId: number | string | undefined | null): boolean => {
  return useWishlistStore((state) => {
    if (itemId === undefined || itemId === null) return false;
    const items = Array.isArray(state?.items) ? state.items : [];
    return items.some((i) => String(i.id) === String(itemId));
  });
};
export const useAddToWishlist = () => useWishlistStore((state) => state.addItem);
export const useRemoveFromWishlist = () =>
  useWishlistStore((state) => state.removeItem);
export const useToggleFavorite = () =>
  useWishlistStore((state) => state.toggleItem);
export const useClearWishlist = () =>
  useWishlistStore((state) => state.clearWishlist);
export const useWishlistActions = () => {
  const addItem = useAddToWishlist();
  const removeItem = useRemoveFromWishlist();
  const toggleItem = useToggleFavorite();
  const clearWishlist = useClearWishlist();
  return {
    addItem,
    removeItem,
    toggleItem,
    clearWishlist,
  };
};
export default useWishlistStore;
</file>

<file path="libs/client/customers/zustand/src/lib/customers-products-store.tsx">
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { immer } from 'zustand/middleware/immer';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
// Define the shape of our customer product state
interface CustomerProductState {
  // Product browsing state
  products: {
    items: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product[];
    isLoading: boolean;
    error: string | null;
    filters: {
      category?: string;
      color?: string;
      size?: string;
      priceRange?: { min: number; max: number };
    };
    pagination: {
      page: number;
      limit: number;
      total: number;
    };
  };
  // Shopping cart state
  cart: {
    items: Array<{
      productId: number;
      productInfoId: number;
      quantity: number;
      product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product;
      selectedVariant: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductInfo;
    }>;
  };
  // Wishlist state
  wishlist: {
    items: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product[];
  };
}
// Define the actions
interface CustomerProductActions {
  // Product browsing actions
  setProducts: (products: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product[]) => void;
  setProductsLoading: (loading: boolean) => void;
  setProductsError: (error: string | null) => void;
  setFilters: (
    filters: Partial<CustomerProductState['products']['filters']>
  ) => void;
  setPagination: (
    pagination: Partial<CustomerProductState['products']['pagination']>
  ) => void;
  // Cart actions
  addToCart: (
    product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product,
    variant: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductInfo,
    quantity: number
  ) => void;
  removeFromCart: (productId: number, productInfoId: number) => void;
  updateCartItemQuantity: (
    productId: number,
    productInfoId: number,
    quantity: number
  ) => void;
  clearCart: () => void;
  // Wishlist actions
  addToWishlist: (product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product) => void;
  removeFromWishlist: (productId: number) => void;
  clearWishlist: () => void;
}
// Create the store
export const useCustomersProductsStore = create<
  CustomerProductState & CustomerProductActions
>()(
  immer((set, get) => ({
    // Initial state
    products: {
      items: [],
      isLoading: false,
      error: null,
      filters: {},
      pagination: {
        page: 1,
        limit: 20,
        total: 0,
      },
    },
    cart: {
      items: [],
    },
    wishlist: {
      items: [],
    },
    // Actions
    setProducts: (products) => {
      set((state) => {
        state.products.items = products;
      });
    },
    setProductsLoading: (loading) => {
      set((state) => {
        state.products.isLoading = loading;
      });
    },
    setProductsError: (error) => {
      set((state) => {
        state.products.error = error;
      });
    },
    setFilters: (filters) => {
      set((state) => {
        state.products.filters = { ...state.products.filters, ...filters };
      });
    },
    setPagination: (pagination) => {
      set((state) => {
        state.products.pagination = {
          ...state.products.pagination,
          ...pagination,
        };
      });
    },
    addToCart: (product, variant, quantity) => {
      set((state) => {
        const existingItem = state.cart.items.find(
          (item) =>
            item.productId === product.id && item.productInfoId === variant.id
        );
        if (existingItem) {
          existingItem.quantity += quantity;
        } else {
          state.cart.items.push({
            productId: product.id,
            productInfoId: variant.id,
            quantity,
            product,
            selectedVariant: variant,
          });
        }
      });
    },
    removeFromCart: (productId, productInfoId) => {
      set((state) => {
        state.cart.items = state.cart.items.filter(
          (item) =>
            !(
              item.productId === productId &&
              item.productInfoId === productInfoId
            )
        );
      });
    },
    updateCartItemQuantity: (productId, productInfoId, quantity) => {
      set((state) => {
        const item = state.cart.items.find(
          (item) =>
            item.productId === productId && item.productInfoId === productInfoId
        );
        if (item) {
          item.quantity = quantity;
        }
      });
    },
    clearCart: () => {
      set((state) => {
        state.cart.items = [];
      });
    },
    addToWishlist: (product) => {
      set((state) => {
        const exists = state.wishlist.items.some(
          (item) => item.id === product.id
        );
        if (!exists) {
          state.wishlist.items.push(product);
        }
      });
    },
    removeFromWishlist: (productId) => {
      set((state) => {
        state.wishlist.items = state.wishlist.items.filter(
          (item) => item.id !== productId
        );
      });
    },
    clearWishlist: () => {
      set((state) => {
        state.wishlist.items = [];
      });
    },
  }))
);
</file>

  "extends": "../../../../../tsconfig.base.json"
}
</file>
