describe('SellersProducts', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    mockStoreState = {
      search: '',
      category: '',
      sort: '',
      sortOrder: 'asc',
      status: 'ACTIVE' as const,
      setSearch: mockSetSearch,
      setCategory: mockSetCategory,
      setSellersProductsSortField: mockSetSellersProductsSortField,
      setStatus: mockSetStatus,
    };
    mockHookState = {
      sellersProducts: [],
      isSellersProductsLoading: false,
      sellersProductsError: null,
      loadMoreSellersProducts: mockLoadMoreSellersProducts,
      hasMoreSellersProducts: false,
    };
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.useRealTimers();
  });
  const renderComponent = () =>
    render(
      <MemoryRouter>
        <SellersProducts />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
  it('renders search input and filters even while loading', () => {
    mockHookState.isSellersProductsLoading = true;
    renderComponent();
    // Layout and container should remain mounted
    expect(screen.getByTestId('sellers-layout')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByTestId('glass-container')).toBeInTheDocument();
    // Search input and filter controls must remain mounted and visible
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Search products')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Loading products...')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('debounces search input updates before updating the store', () => {
    renderComponent();
    const searchInput = screen.getByLabelText('Search products') as HTMLInputElement;
    expect(searchInput.value).toBe('');
    // User types "cleats"
    fireEvent.change(searchInput, { target: { value: 'cleats' } });
    // Input updates immediately for responsive typing
    expect(searchInput.value).toBe('cleats');
    // Store's setSearch should NOT have been called yet
    expect(mockSetSearch).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    // Advance time by 300ms (less than 400ms debounce)
    act(() => {
      vi.advanceTimersByTime(300);
    });
    expect(mockSetSearch).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    // Advance remaining 100ms (total 400ms)
    act(() => {
      vi.advanceTimersByTime(100);
    });
    expect(mockSetSearch).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockSetSearch).toHaveBeenCalledWith('cleats');
  });
  it('immediately triggers search when pressing Enter key', () => {
    renderComponent();
    const searchInput = screen.getByLabelText('Search products') as HTMLInputElement;
    fireEvent.change(searchInput, { target: { value: 'jersey' } });
    expect(mockSetSearch).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    // Press Enter
    fireEvent.keyDown(searchInput, { key: 'Enter', code: 'Enter' });
    expect(mockSetSearch).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockSetSearch).toHaveBeenCalledWith('jersey');
  });
  it('clears search input and updates store immediately when clear button is clicked', () => {
    mockStoreState.search = 'shoes';
    renderComponent();
    const searchInput = screen.getByLabelText('Search products') as HTMLInputElement;
    expect(searchInput.value).toBe('shoes');
    const clearButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /clear/i });
    expect(clearButton).toBeInTheDocument();
    fireEvent.click(clearButton);
    expect(searchInput.value).toBe('');
    expect(mockSetSearch).toHaveBeenCalledWith('');
  });
  const createMockCategory = (
    id: number,
    name: string
  ): KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Category => ({
    id,
    name,
    slug: name.toLowerCase(),
    sortOrder: 0,
    isActive: true,
    createdAt: '2026-01-01',
    updatedAt: '2026-01-01',
  });
  const createMockColor = (
    id: number,
    name: string,
    hexCode: string
  ): KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Color => ({
    id,
    name,
    hexCode,
    isActive: true,
    sortOrder: 0,
    createdAt: '2026-01-01',
    updatedAt: '2026-01-01',
  });
  const createMockProductInfo = (
    id: number,
    size: string,
    sizeKind: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SizeKind,
    colors: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Color[] = [],
    images: string[] = []
  ): KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductInfo => ({
    id,
    size,
    sizeKind,
    colors,
    weight: 1,
    images,
    product: {} as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product,
  });
  const createMockSellerProduct = (
    id: string,
    price: number,
    discount: number,
    stockQuantity: number,
    productInfo: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductInfo
  ): KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SellerProduct => ({
    id,
    price,
    discount,
    stockQuantity,
    productInfoId: productInfo.id,
    boxLess: false,
    recommended: false,
    productInfo,
    product: {} as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product,
  });
  it('renders products and keeps layout stable during subsequent search/loading', () => {
    const info = createMockProductInfo(1, '42', KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SizeKind.Footwear, [], ['https://example.com/shoe.jpg']);
    mockHookState.sellersProducts = [
      {
        id: 1,
        name: 'Nike Mercurial',
        archived: false,
        productInfos: [info],
        description: 'Football shoes',
        categories: [createMockCategory(1, 'Shoes')],
        sellerProducts: [createMockSellerProduct('sp-1', 150, 10, 5, info)],
      },
    ];
    renderComponent();
    expect(screen.getByText('Nike Mercurial')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Search products')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('renders deduplicated color swatches and does not render "No color" when variants have colors', () => {
    const grayColor = createMockColor(1, 'Gray', '#808080');
    const blackColor = createMockColor(2, 'Black', '#000000');
    const info1 = createMockProductInfo(1, '42', KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SizeKind.Footwear, [grayColor, blackColor], ['https://example.com/shoe.jpg']);
    const info2 = createMockProductInfo(2, '43', KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SizeKind.Footwear, [grayColor, blackColor], ['https://example.com/shoe2.jpg']);
    mockHookState.sellersProducts = [
      {
        id: 1,
        name: 'Nike Mercurial',
        archived: false,
        productInfos: [info1, info2],
        description: 'Football shoes',
        categories: [createMockCategory(1, 'Shoes')],
        sellerProducts: [
          createMockSellerProduct('sp-1', 150, 10, 5, info1),
          createMockSellerProduct('sp-2', 160, 0, 3, info2),
        ],
      },
    ];
    renderComponent();
    // Both "Gray" and "Black" swatches render exactly once (deduplicated)
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Gray')).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Black')).toHaveLength(1);
    // The "No color" text is NOT rendered
    expect(screen.queryByText(/No Color/i)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

  beforeEach(() => {

    mockStoreState = {

    name,
    hexCode,
    isActive: true,
    sortOrder: 0,
    createdAt: '2026-01-01',
    updatedAt: '2026-01-01',
  });
  const createMockProductInfo = (
    id: number,
    size: string,
    sizeKind: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SizeKind,
    colors: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Color[] = [],
    images: string[] = []
  ): KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductInfo => ({
    id,
    size,
    sizeKind,
    colors,
    weight: 1,
    images,
    product: {} as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product,
  });
  const createMockSellerProduct = (
    id: string,
    price: number,
    discount: number,
    stockQuantity: number,
    productInfo: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductInfo
  ): KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SellerProduct => ({
    id,
    price,
    discount,
    stockQuantity,
    productInfoId: productInfo.id,
    boxLess: false,
    recommended: false,
    productInfo,
    product: {} as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product,
  });
  const renderComponent = () =>
    render(
      <MemoryRouter>
        <SellersProducts />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
  it('renders W32/L34 for pants sizeKind and hides raw 32x34', () => {
    const blackColor = createMockColor(1, 'Black', '#000000');
    // A) Pants: size='32x34', sizeKind='Pants' -> should display 'W32/L34'
    const infoPants = createMockProductInfo(201, '32x34', KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SizeKind.Pants, [blackColor], ['https://example.com/pants.jpg']);
    // B) Footwear: size='42', sizeKind='Footwear' -> should display '42'
    const infoFootwear = createMockProductInfo(202, '42', KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SizeKind.Footwear, [blackColor], ['https://example.com/shoe.jpg']);
    // C) Apparel: size='M', sizeKind='Apparel' -> should display 'M'
    const infoApparel = createMockProductInfo(203, 'M', KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SizeKind.Apparel, [blackColor], ['https://example.com/shirt.jpg']);
    mockHookState.sellersProducts = [
      {
        id: 1,
        name: 'Test Product',
        archived: false,
        productInfos: [infoPants, infoFootwear, infoApparel],
        description: 'Test product with multiple size kinds',
        categories: [createMockCategory(1, 'Test')],
        sellerProducts: [
          createMockSellerProduct('sp-1', 100, 0, 10, infoPants),
          createMockSellerProduct('sp-2', 120, 0, 5, infoFootwear),
          createMockSellerProduct('sp-3', 80, 0, 8, infoApparel),
        ],
      },
    ];
    renderComponent();
    // Verify product card renders
    expect(screen.getByText('Test Product')).toBeInTheDocument();
    // T1: some rendered text matches /W32\/L34/
    expect(screen.getByText(/W32\/L34/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    // T2: no rendered text matches /\b32x34\b/
    expect(screen.queryByText(/\b32x34\b/)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    // T3: text '42' still rendered for footwear (unchanged) - check in sizes line
    // T4: text 'M' still rendered for apparel - check in sizes line
    // The sizes line is in a Typography that contains "Sizes:" and the sizes
    const sizesElement = screen.getByText(/Sizes:/).closest('p, div, span, typography') || screen.getByText(/Sizes:/).parentElement;
    const sizesText = sizesElement?.textContent || '';
    expect(sizesText).toContain('42');
    expect(sizesText).toContain('M');
  });
});

  ): KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Category => ({
    id,
    name,
    slug: name.toLowerCase(),
    sortOrder: 0,
    isActive: true,
    createdAt: '2026-01-01',
    updatedAt: '2026-01-01',
  });
  const createMockColor = (
    id: number,
    name: string,
    hexCode: string
  ): KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Color => ({
    id,
    name,
    hexCode,
    isActive: true,
    sortOrder: 0,
    createdAt: '2026-01-01',
    updatedAt: '2026-01-01',
  });
  const createMockProductInfo = (
    id: number,
    size: string,
    colors: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Color[] = [],
    images: string[] = []
  ): KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductInfo => ({
    id,
    size,
    sizeKind: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SizeKind.Footwear,
    colors,
    weight: 1,
    images,
    product: {} as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product,
  });
  const createMockSellerProduct = (
    id: string,
    price: number,
    discount: number,
    stockQuantity: number,
    productInfo: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductInfo
  ): KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SellerProduct => ({
    id,
    price,
    discount,
    stockQuantity,
    productInfoId: productInfo.id,
    boxLess: false,
    recommended: false,
    productInfo,
    product: {} as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product,
  });
  it('renders products and keeps layout stable during subsequent search/loading', () => {
    const info = createMockProductInfo(1, '42', [], ['https://example.com/shoe.jpg']);
    mockHookState.sellersProducts = [
      {
        id: 1,
        name: 'Nike Mercurial',
        archived: false,
        productInfos: [info],
        description: 'Football shoes',
        categories: [createMockCategory(1, 'Shoes')],
        sellerProducts: [createMockSellerProduct('sp-1', 150, 10, 5, info)],
      },
    ];
    renderComponent();
    expect(screen.getByText('Nike Mercurial')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Search products')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('renders deduplicated color swatches and does not render "No color" when variants have colors', () => {
    const grayColor = createMockColor(1, 'Gray', '#808080');
    const blackColor = createMockColor(2, 'Black', '#000000');
    const info1 = createMockProductInfo(1, '42', [grayColor, blackColor], ['https://example.com/shoe.jpg']);
    const info2 = createMockProductInfo(2, '43', [grayColor, blackColor], ['https://example.com/shoe2.jpg']);
    mockHookState.sellersProducts = [
      {
        id: 1,
        name: 'Nike Mercurial',
        archived: false,
        productInfos: [info1, info2],
        description: 'Football shoes',
        categories: [createMockCategory(1, 'Shoes')],
        sellerProducts: [
          createMockSellerProduct('sp-1', 150, 10, 5, info1),
          createMockSellerProduct('sp-2', 160, 0, 3, info2),
        ],
      },
    ];
    renderComponent();
    // Both "Gray" and "Black" swatches render exactly once (deduplicated)
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Gray')).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Black')).toHaveLength(1);
    // The "No color" text is NOT rendered
    expect(screen.queryByText(/No Color/i)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

import { SellersLayout } from '@kickzone-workspace/sellers-layout';

  useI18nContext,

  usePageTitle,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
import { PriceDisplay } from '@kickzone-workspace/price-display';

const displayVariantSize = (info?: { size?: string | null; sizeKind?: string | null } | null): string =>
  !info?.size ? '' : isPantsSizeKind(info.sizeKind) ? formatSizeLabel(SizeKind.Pants, info.size) || info.size : info.size;
const SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_MS = 400;
export const SellersProducts = () => {
  const { canManageCatalog } = useSellersAuthContext();
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  usePageTitle(() => LL.pageTitles.sellerProducts());
  const { formatNumber } = useLanguageContext();
  const [viewModalOpen, setViewModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedProductForView, setSelectedProductForView] =
    useState<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product | null>(null);
  const {
    search,
    category,
    sort,
    sortOrder,
    status,
    setSearch,
    setCategory,
    setSellersProductsSortField,
    setStatus,
  } = useSellersProductsStore();
  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState(search);
  // Sync local searchInput if search in store changes externally (e.g. resetFilters)
  useEffect(() => {
    setSearchInput(search);
  }, [search]);
  // Debounce search update to avoid firing queries on every keystroke
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (searchInput !== search) {
        setSearch(searchInput);
      }
    }, SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_MS);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [searchInput, search, setSearch]);
  const handleSearchKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      if (searchInput !== search) {
        setSearch(searchInput);
      }
    }
  };
  const handleClearSearch = () => {
    setSearchInput('');
    setSearch('');
  };
  const {
    sellersProducts,
    isSellersProductsLoading,
    sellersProductsError,
    loadMoreSellersProducts,
    hasMoreSellersProducts,
  } = useSellersProducts({
    search,
    categoryId: category ? Number(category) : undefined,
    sort,
    sortOrder,
    archivedStatus: status,
  });
  // Log product variants for debugging
  useEffect(() => {
    if (sellersProducts && sellersProducts.length > 0) {
      console.log('[SellersPanel] Products with variants:', {
        totalProducts: sellersProducts.length,
        products: sellersProducts.map((product) => {
          // Expand products into variants - each variant is a combination of productInfo + sellerProduct
          const variants: Array<{
            productInfo: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductInfo;
            sellerProduct: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SellerProduct;
            variantKey: string;
          }> = [];
          product.productInfos?.forEach((productInfo) => {
            // Match by productInfoId OR by productInfo relation (fallback for old data)
            const sellerProduct = product.sellerProducts?.find(
              (sp) =>
                sp.productInfoId === productInfo.id ||
                sp.productInfo?.id === productInfo.id
            );
            if (sellerProduct) {
              variants.push({
                productInfo,
                sellerProduct,
                variantKey: `${product.id}-${productInfo.id}`,
              });
            }
          });
          return {
            id: product.id,
            name: product.name,
            productInfosCount: product.productInfos?.length || 0,
            sellerProductsCount: product.sellerProducts?.length || 0,
            variantsCount: variants.length,
            variants: variants.map((v) => ({
              variantKey: v.variantKey,
              productInfo: {
                id: v.productInfo.id,
                size: v.productInfo.size,
                color: formatVariantColorNames(v.productInfo.colors),
                weight: v.productInfo.weight,
              },
              sellerProduct: {
                id: v.sellerProduct.id,
                productInfoId: v.sellerProduct.productInfoId,
                price: v.sellerProduct.price,
                discount: v.sellerProduct.discount,
                stockQuantity: v.sellerProduct.stockQuantity,
              },
            })),
            unmatchedProductInfos:
              product.productInfos?.filter(
                (pi) =>
                  !product.sellerProducts?.some(
                    (sp) =>
                      sp.productInfoId === pi.id || sp.productInfo?.id === pi.id
                  )
              ).length || 0,
            unmatchedSellerProducts:
              product.sellerProducts?.filter(
                (sp) =>
                  !product.productInfos?.some(
                    (pi) =>
                      pi.id === sp.productInfoId || pi.id === sp.productInfo?.id
                  )
              ).length || 0,
          };
        }),
      });
    }
  }, [sellersProducts]);
  const editSellerProductHref = (sellerProductId: string | number) =>
    `${SELLER_ROUTES.MANAGE_PRODUCT}?sellerProductId=${sellerProductId}`;
  const handleViewProduct = (productId: number) => {
    const product = sellersProducts.find((p) => p.id === productId);
    if (product) {
      // Log detailed variants for the selected product
      const variants: Array<{
        productInfo: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductInfo;
        sellerProduct: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SellerProduct;
        variantKey: string;
      }> = [];
      product.productInfos?.forEach((productInfo) => {
        // Match by productInfoId OR by productInfo relation (fallback for old data)
        const sellerProduct = product.sellerProducts?.find(
          (sp) =>
            sp.productInfoId === productInfo.id ||
            sp.productInfo?.id === productInfo.id
        );
        if (sellerProduct) {
          variants.push({
            productInfo,
            sellerProduct,
            variantKey: `${product.id}-${productInfo.id}`,
          });
        }
      });
      console.log(
        `[SellersPanel] Product "${product.name}" (ID: ${product.id}) variants:`,
        {
          productId: product.id,
          productName: product.name,
          productInfosCount: product.productInfos?.length || 0,
          sellerProductsCount: product.sellerProducts?.length || 0,
          variantsCount: variants.length,
          variants: variants.map((v) => ({
            variantKey: v.variantKey,
            productInfo: {
              id: v.productInfo.id,
              size: v.productInfo.size,
              colors: v.productInfo.colors,
              weight: v.productInfo.weight,
              images: v.productInfo.images,
            },
            sellerProduct: {
              id: v.sellerProduct.id,
              productInfoId: v.sellerProduct.productInfoId,
              price: v.sellerProduct.price,
              costPrice: v.sellerProduct.costPrice,
              discount: v.sellerProduct.discount,
              stockQuantity: v.sellerProduct.stockQuantity,
              sellerId: v.sellerProduct.seller?.id,
            },
          })),
          unmatchedProductInfos: product.productInfos
            ?.filter(
              (pi) =>
                !product.sellerProducts?.some(
                  (sp) =>
                    sp.productInfoId === pi.id || sp.productInfo?.id === pi.id
                )
            )
            .map((pi) => ({
              id: pi.id,
              size: pi.size,
              color: formatVariantColorNames(pi.colors),
            })),
          unmatchedSellerProducts: product.sellerProducts
            ?.filter(
              (sp) =>
                !product.productInfos?.some(
                  (pi) =>
                    pi.id === sp.productInfoId || pi.id === sp.productInfo?.id
                )
            )
            .map((sp) => ({
              id: sp.id,
              productInfoId: sp.productInfoId,
              productInfoRelationId: sp.productInfo?.id,
              price: sp.price,
              stockQuantity: sp.stockQuantity,
            })),
        }
      );
      setSelectedProductForView(product);
      setViewModalOpen(true);
    }
  };
  const handleCloseViewModal = () => {
    setViewModalOpen(false);
    setSelectedProductForView(null);
  };
  return (
    <SellersLayout>
      <GlassmorphismContainer fullHeight>
        {/* Header with Add Product button */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',

            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            alignItems: { xs: 'stretch', sm: 'center' },
            gap: 2,
            mb: 3,
          }}
        >
          <Typography variant="h4" component="h1">
            {LL.products.myProducts()}

          <Stack
            direction={{ xs: 'column', sm: 'row' }}

            flexWrap="wrap"
            useFlexGap

          >

                onKeyDown={handleSearchKeyDown}

                slotProps={{

                    startAdornment: (
                      <InputAdornment position="start">
                        <SearchIcon fontSize="small" color="action" />

                    ),
                    endAdornment: searchInput ? (

                          onClick={handleClearSearch}

                          <CloseIcon fontSize="small" />

                    ) : null,

              />
            </Grid>
            <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 3 }}>
              <FormControl fullWidth size="small">
                <InputLabel>{LL.form.category()}</InputLabel>
                <Select
                  value={category}
                  onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value)}
                  label={LL.form.category()}
                >
                  <MenuItem value="">{LL.table.allCategories()}</MenuItem>
                  {/* TODO: Add categories from API */}

                  <MenuItem value="name">{LL.table.name()}</MenuItem>

                    {LL.table.dateCreated()}

            </Grid>
            <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 3 }}>
              <FormControl fullWidth size="small">
                <InputLabel>{LL.form.status()}</InputLabel>
                <Select
                  value={status}

                    setStatus(
                      e.target
                        .value as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductArchivedStatus
                    )
                  }

                    value={KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductArchivedStatus.All}

        </Box>

        )}
        {/* Initial Loading State */}
        {isSellersProductsLoading && sellersProducts.length === 0 && !sellersProductsError && (

            const firstSellerProduct = sellerProducts[0];

                  sx={{
                    height: '100%',
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',

                        src={firstSellerProduct.productInfo.images[0]}
                        alt={product.name}
                        sx={{
                          position: 'absolute',
                          top: 0,
                          left: 0,
                          width: '100%',
                          height: '100%',
                          objectFit: 'cover',
                          transition: 'transform 0.3s',
                          '&:hover': {
                            transform: 'scale(1.05)',
                          },
                        }}
                      />
                      <Chip
                        label={
                          product.archived
                            ? LL.table.archived()
                            : LL.table.active()
                        }
                        color={product.archived ? 'default' : 'success'}
                        size="small"
                        sx={{
                          position: 'absolute',
                          top: 12,
                          right: 12,
                          fontWeight: 600,
                        }}
                      />
                    </Box>
                  )}
                  <CardContent sx={{ flexGrow: 1, p: 2.5 }}>
                    <Box
                      sx={{
                        display: 'flex',
                        justifyContent: 'space-between',
                        alignItems: 'flex-start',
                        mb: 1.5,
                      }}
                    >
                      <Typography
                        variant="h6"
                        component="h2"
                        sx={{
                          fontWeight: 700,
                          flex: 1,
                          fontSize: '1.1rem',
                          color: 'text.primary',
                        }}
                      >
                        {product.name}
                      </Typography>
                      {!firstSellerProduct?.productInfo?.images?.[0] && (
                        <Chip
                          label={
                            product.archived
                              ? LL.table.archived()
                              : LL.table.active()
                          }
                          color={product.archived ? 'default' : 'success'}
                          size="small"
                        />
                      )}
                    </Box>
                    <Stack spacing={1} sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                      {product.description && (
                        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                          <strong>{LL.form.description()}:</strong>{' '}
                          {product.description.length > 100
                            ? `${product.description.substring(0, 100)}...`
                            : product.description}
                        </Typography>
                      )}
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        <strong>{LL.products.categories()}:</strong>{' '}
                        {product.categories
                          .map((cat: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Category) => cat.name)
                          .join(', ') || LL.products.noCategories()}
                      </Typography>
                      {/* Show all seller's variants */}
                      {sellerProducts.length > 0 && (
                        <>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            <strong>{LL.products.sizes()}:</strong>{' '}
                            {sellerProducts
                              .map((sp) => displayVariantSize(sp.productInfo))
                              .filter(Boolean)
                              .join(', ')}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box
                            sx={{
                              display: 'flex',
                              alignItems: 'center',
                              gap: 0.5,
                              flexWrap: 'wrap',
                              mb: 1,
                            }}
                          >
                            <Typography
                              variant="body2"
                              color="text.secondary"
                              component="span"
                            >
                              <strong>{LL.products.colors()}:</strong>{' '}
                            </Typography>
                            {sellerProducts
                              .flatMap((sp) => sp.productInfo?.colors ?? [])
                              .filter(
                                (color, index, arr) =>
                                  arr.findIndex((c) =>
                                    c.id != null && color.id != null
                                      ? c.id === color.id
                                      : c.name === color.name
                                  ) === index
                              )
                              .map((color, index) => (
                                <Box
                                  key={color.id ?? color.name ?? index}
                                  sx={{
                                    display: 'flex',
                                    alignItems: 'center',
                                    gap: 0.5,
                                  }}
                                >
                                  <Box
                                    component="span"
                                    sx={{
                                      display: 'inline-block',
                                      width: 12,
                                      height: 12,
                                      backgroundColor: color.hexCode || '#ccc',
                                      borderRadius: '50%',
                                      border: '1px solid #ccc',
                                    }}
                                  />
                                  <Typography
                                    variant="body2"
                                    color="text.secondary"
                                    component="span"
                                  >
                                    {color.name}
                                  </Typography>
                                </Box>
                              ))}
                            {sellerProducts.filter(
                              (sp) => !sp.productInfo?.colors?.length
                            ).length > 0 && (
                              <Typography
                                variant="body2"
                                color="text.secondary"
                                component="span"
                              >
                                {LL.products.noColor()} (
                                {formatNumber(
                                  sellerProducts.filter(
                                    (sp) => !sp.productInfo?.colors?.length
                                  ).length
                                )}
                                )
                              </Typography>
                            )}
                          </Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            <strong>{LL.products.weightRange()}:</strong>{' '}
                            {(() => {
                              const weights = sellerProducts
                                .map((sp) => sp.productInfo?.weight)
                                .filter(Boolean)
                                .map(Number);
                              if (weights.length === 0)
                                return LL.products.notAvailable();
                              if (weights.length === 1)
                                return `${formatNumber(weights[0])}kg`;
                              const min = Math.min(...weights);
                              const max = Math.max(...weights);
                              return min === max
                                ? `${formatNumber(min)}kg`
                                : `${formatNumber(min)}-${formatNumber(max)}kg`;
                            })()}
                          </Typography>
                        </>
                      )}
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        <strong>{LL.products.yourVariants()}:</strong>{' '}
                        {formatNumber(sellerProducts.length)}
                      </Typography>
                      {/* Current Seller's Product Information */}
                      {sellerProducts.length > 0 && (
                        <Box
                          sx={{
                            mt: 2,
                            p: 2,
                            bgcolor: 'primary.50',
                            borderRadius: 2,
                            border: '1px solid',
                            borderColor: 'primary.100',
                          }}
                        >
                          {sellerProducts.length === 1 ? (
                            <>
                              <Box
                                sx={{
                                  display: 'flex',
                                  justifyContent: 'space-between',
                                  alignItems: 'center',
                                  mb: 1,
                                }}
                              >
                                <Typography
                                  variant="h5"
                                  sx={{
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    color: 'primary.main',
                                  }}
                                >
                                  <PriceDisplay
                                    priceInUSD={firstSellerProduct.price}
                                    showOriginal={true}
                                  />
                                </Typography>
                                {firstSellerProduct.discount > 0 && (
                                  <Chip
                                    label={`-${formatNumber(
                                      firstSellerProduct.discount
                                    )}%`}
                                    color="error"
                                    size="small"
                                    sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}
                                  />
                                )}
                              </Box>
                              {firstSellerProduct.discount > 0 && (
                                <Typography
                                  variant="caption"
                                  color="text.secondary"
                                  sx={{ display: 'block', mb: 1 }}
                                >
                                  {LL.products.finalPrice()}:{' '}
                                  <PriceDisplay
                                    priceInUSD={
                                      (firstSellerProduct.price *
                                        (100 - firstSellerProduct.discount)) /
                                      100
                                    }
                                    showOriginal={true}
                                  />
                                </Typography>
                              )}
                              <Box
                                sx={{
                                  display: 'flex',
                                  alignItems: 'center',
                                  gap: 0.5,
                                }}
                              >
                                <Typography
                                  variant="body2"
                                  color="text.secondary"
                                >
                                  {LL.form.stockQuantity()}:
                                </Typography>
                                <Chip
                                  label={`${formatNumber(
                                    firstSellerProduct.stockQuantity
                                  )} ${LL.products.units()}`}
                                  size="small"
                                  color={
                                    firstSellerProduct.stockQuantity > 10
                                      ? 'success'
                                      : firstSellerProduct.stockQuantity > 0
                                      ? 'warning'
                                      : 'error'
                                  }
                                  variant="outlined"
                                />
                                {firstSellerProduct.boxLess && (
                                  <Chip
                                    label={LL.products.boxLess()}
                                    size="small"
                                    color="info"
                                    variant="outlined"
                                  />
                                )}
                              </Box>
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            <>
                              <Typography
                                variant="h6"
                                sx={{
                                  fontWeight: 700,
                                  color: 'primary.main',
                                  mb: 1,
                                }}
                              >
                                <PriceDisplay
                                  priceInUSD={Math.min(
                                    ...sellerProducts.map((sp) => sp.price)
                                  )}
                                  showOriginal={true}
                                />{' '}
                                -{' '}
                                <PriceDisplay
                                  priceInUSD={Math.max(
                                    ...sellerProducts.map((sp) => sp.price)
                                  )}
                                  showOriginal={true}
                                />
                              </Typography>
                              <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ mb: 1 }}>
                                <Chip
                                  label={`${formatNumber(
                                    sellerProducts.reduce(
                                      (sum, sp) => sum + sp.stockQuantity,
                                      0
                                    )
                                  )} ${LL.products.unitsInStock()}`}
                                  size="small"
                                  color="success"
                                  variant="outlined"
                                />
                                <Chip
                                  label={`${formatNumber(
                                    sellerProducts.length
                                  )} ${LL.products.variants()}`}
                                  size="small"
                                  color="info"
                                  variant="outlined"
                                />
                              </Stack>
                            </>
                          )}
                        </Box>
                      )}
                    </Stack>
                  </CardContent>
                  <CardActions
                    sx={{
                      justifyContent: 'center',
                      p: 2,
                      borderTop: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                    }}
                  >
                    <Button
                      size="small"
                      startIcon={<ViewIcon />}
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        handleViewProduct(product.id);
                      }}
                      sx={{ textTransform: 'none' }}
                    >
                      {LL.button.viewDetails()}
                    </Button>
                  </CardActions>
                </Card>
              </Grid>
            );
          })}
        </Grid>
        )}
        {/* Load More */}
        {hasMoreSellersProducts && sellersProducts.length > 0 && (
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', mt: 4 }}>
            <Button
              onClick={loadMoreSellersProducts}
              variant="outlined"
              size="large"
              disabled={isSellersProductsLoading}
              sx={{ minWidth: 200, textTransform: 'none' }}
            >
              {LL.products.loadMore()}
            </Button>
          </Box>
        )}
        {/* Empty State */}
        {sellersProducts.length === 0 &&
          !isSellersProductsLoading &&
          !sellersProductsError && (
          <Box
            sx={(theme) => {
              const isDark = theme.palette.mode === 'dark';
              return {
                textAlign: 'center',
                py: 10,
                px: 3,
                backgroundColor: isDark
                  ? 'transparent'
                  : theme.palette.action.hover,
                borderRadius: 3,
                border: `2px dashed ${theme.palette.divider}`,
              };
            }}
          >
            <Box
              sx={(theme) => ({
                width: 120,
                height: 120,
                margin: '0 auto 24px',
                backgroundColor:
                  theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
                    ? 'rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.12)'
                    : 'rgba(143, 132, 104, 0.12)',
                borderRadius: '50%',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
              })}
            >
              <AddIcon sx={{ fontSize: 60, color: 'primary.main' }} />
            </Box>
            <Typography
              variant="h5"
              sx={{ fontWeight: 700, mb: 1.5, color: 'text.primary' }}
            >
              {LL.products.noProductsFound()}
            </Typography>
            <Typography
              variant="body1"
              color="text.secondary"
              sx={{ mb: 4, maxWidth: 500, margin: '0 auto 32px' }}
            >
              {LL.products.startBySelling()}
            </Typography>
            <Stack
              direction={{ xs: 'column', sm: 'row' }}
              spacing={2}
              justifyContent="center"
              alignItems="stretch"
              flexWrap="wrap"
              useFlexGap
              sx={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: 480, mx: 'auto' }}
            >
              {canManageCatalog && (
                <Button
                  variant="outlined"
                  size="large"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  component={RouterLink}
                  to={`${SELLER_ROUTES.MANAGE_PRODUCT}?define=1`}
                  sx={{
                    textTransform: 'none',
                    px: 4,
                    py: 1.5,
                    fontSize: '1rem',
                    width: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' },
                  }}
                >
                  {LL.navigation.catalogManagement()}
                </Button>
              )}
              <Button
                variant="contained"
                size="large"
                startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                component={RouterLink}
                to={SELLER_ROUTES.MANAGE_PRODUCT}
                sx={{
                  textTransform: 'none',
                  px: 4,
                  py: 1.5,
                  fontSize: '1rem',
                  width: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' },
                }}
              >
                {LL.products.addFirstProduct()}
              </Button>
            </Stack>
          </Box>
        )}
        {/* View Product Modal */}
        <Dialog
          open={viewModalOpen}
          onClose={handleCloseViewModal}
          maxWidth="md"
          fullWidth
        >
          <DialogTitle>
            <Box
              sx={{
                display: 'flex',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                alignItems: 'center',
              }}
            >
              <Typography variant="h6">
                {selectedProductForView?.name}
              </Typography>
              <IconButton onClick={handleCloseViewModal} size="small">
                <CloseIcon />
              </IconButton>
            </Box>
          </DialogTitle>
          <DialogContent dividers sx={{ pt: 2 }}>
            {selectedProductForView && (
              <Box sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                <Grid container spacing={3}>
                  <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
                    <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                      {LL.products.productInformationTitle()}
                    </Typography>
                    <Stack spacing={2}>
                      <Box>
                        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                          <strong>{LL.table.name()}:</strong>{' '}
                          {selectedProductForView.name}
                        </Typography>
                      </Box>
                      <Box>
                        <Typography
                          variant="body2"
                          color="text.secondary"
                          component="div"
                        >
                          <strong>{LL.form.status()}:</strong>{' '}
                          <Chip
                            label={
                              selectedProductForView.archived
                                ? LL.table.archived()
                                : LL.table.active()
                            }
                            color={
                              selectedProductForView.archived
                                ? 'default'
                                : 'success'
                            }
                            size="small"
                          />
                        </Typography>
                      </Box>
                      <Box>
                        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                          <strong>{LL.products.categories()}:</strong>{' '}
                          {selectedProductForView.categories
                            .map(
                              (cat: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Category) => cat.name
                            )
                            .join(', ') || LL.products.noCategories()}
                        </Typography>
                      </Box>
                      <Box>
                        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                          <strong>{LL.products.yourVariants()}:</strong>{' '}
                          {formatNumber(
                            selectedProductForView.sellerProducts?.length || 0
                          )}
                        </Typography>
                      </Box>
                      {selectedProductForView.description && (
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            <strong>{LL.form.description()}:</strong>
                          </Typography>
                          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                            {selectedProductForView.description}
                          </Typography>
                        </Box>
                      )}
                    </Stack>
                  </Grid>
                  <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
                    <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                      {LL.products.yourProductVariantsTitle()}
                    </Typography>
                    <Stack spacing={2}>
                      {selectedProductForView.sellerProducts?.map(
                        (sellerProduct, index) => {
                          if (!sellerProduct.productInfo) {
                            return null;
                          }
                          return (
                            <Card key={sellerProduct.id} variant="outlined">
                              <CardContent sx={{ p: 2 }}>
                                <Box
                                  sx={{
                                    display: 'flex',
                                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                                    alignItems: 'flex-start',
                                    mb: 1,
                                  }}
                                >
                                  <Typography variant="subtitle2">
                                    {LL.products.yourVariant()}{' '}
                                    {formatNumber(index + 1)}
                                  </Typography>
                                  <Tooltip title={LL.button.editVariant()}>
                                    <IconButton
                                      size="small"
                                      color="primary"
                                      component={RouterLink}
                                      to={editSellerProductHref(
                                        sellerProduct.id
                                      )}
                                    >
                                      <EditIcon />
                                    </IconButton>
                                  </Tooltip>
                                </Box>
                                <Stack spacing={1}>
                                  <Typography
                                    variant="body2"
                                    color="text.secondary"
                                  >
                                    <strong>{LL.products.size()}:</strong>{' '}
                                    {displayVariantSize(sellerProduct.productInfo)}
                                  </Typography>
                                  <Typography
                                    variant="body2"
                                    color="text.secondary"
                                  >
                                    <strong>{LL.products.color()}:</strong>{' '}
                                    {formatVariantColorNames(
                                      sellerProduct.productInfo.colors,
                                      LL.products.noColorSpecified()
                                    )}
                                    {sellerProduct.productInfo.colors?.length >
                                      0 && (
                                      <Box
                                        component="span"
                                        sx={{
                                          display: 'inline-flex',
                                          alignItems: 'center',
                                          gap: 0.5,
                                          ml: 1,
                                          verticalAlign: 'middle',
                                        }}
                                      >
                                        {sellerProduct.productInfo.colors.map(
                                          (color) => (
                                            <Box
                                              key={color.id}
                                              sx={{
                                                width: 16,
                                                height: 16,
                                                backgroundColor: color.hexCode,
                                                borderRadius: '50%',
                                                border: '1px solid #ccc',
                                              }}
                                            />
                                          )
                                        )}
                                      </Box>
                                    )}
                                  </Typography>
                                  <Typography
                                    variant="body2"
                                    color="text.secondary"
                                  >
                                    <strong>{LL.products.weight()}:</strong>{' '}
                                    {formatNumber(
                                      sellerProduct.productInfo.weight
                                    )}
                                    kg
                                  </Typography>
                                  <Typography
                                    variant="body2"
                                    color="text.secondary"
                                  >
                                    <strong>{LL.products.yourPrice()}:</strong>{' '}
                                    <PriceDisplay
                                      priceInUSD={sellerProduct.price}
                                      showOriginal={true}
                                    />
                                  </Typography>
                                  <Typography
                                    variant="body2"
                                    color="text.secondary"
                                  >
                                    <strong>{LL.products.costPrice()}:</strong>{' '}
                                    <PriceDisplay
                                      priceInUSD={sellerProduct.costPrice || 0}
                                      showOriginal={true}
                                    />
                                  </Typography>
                                  <Typography
                                    variant="body2"
                                    color="text.secondary"
                                  >
                                    <strong>{LL.products.discount()}:</strong>{' '}
                                    {formatNumber(sellerProduct.discount)}%
                                  </Typography>
                                  <Typography
                                    variant="body2"
                                    color="text.secondary"
                                  >
                                    <strong>{LL.products.finalPrice()}:</strong>{' '}
                                    <PriceDisplay
                                      priceInUSD={
                                        (sellerProduct.price *
                                          (100 - sellerProduct.discount)) /
                                        100
                                      }
                                      showOriginal={true}
                                    />
                                  </Typography>
                                  <Typography
                                    variant="body2"
                                    color="text.secondary"
                                  >
                                    <strong>{LL.products.stock()}:</strong>{' '}
                                    {formatNumber(sellerProduct.stockQuantity)}{' '}
                                    {LL.products.units()}
                                  </Typography>
                                  {sellerProduct.boxLess && (
                                    <Chip
                                      label={LL.products.boxLess()}
                                      size="small"
                                      color="info"
                                      variant="outlined"
                                    />
                                  )}
                                  {sellerProduct.productInfo.images &&
                                    sellerProduct.productInfo.images.length >
                                      0 && (
                                      <Typography
                                        variant="body2"
                                        color="text.secondary"
                                      >
                                        <strong>{LL.products.images()}:</strong>{' '}
                                        {formatNumber(
                                          sellerProduct.productInfo.images
                                            .length
                                        )}{' '}
                                        {LL.products.image()}(s)
                                      </Typography>
                                    )}
                                </Stack>
                              </CardContent>
                            </Card>
                          );
                        }
                      )}
                    </Stack>
                  </Grid>
                </Grid>
              </Box>
            )}
          </DialogContent>
          <DialogActions>
            <Button onClick={handleCloseViewModal}>{LL.button.close()}</Button>
          </DialogActions>
        </Dialog>
      </GlassmorphismContainer>
    </SellersLayout>
  );
};
export default SellersProducts;
</file>

describe('SellerOrdersScreen - Pants Size Display', () => {
  const createMockOrder = (itemSize: string | undefined, itemColor?: string) => ({

    status: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Pending,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    sellerId: 1,
    total: 100,
    subtotal: 90,
    shippingCost: 10,
    trackingNumber: 'TRACK-123',
    items: [
      {
        id: 'item-1',
        orderId: 'order-1',
        productId: 'product-1',
        productName: 'Test Pants',
        quantity: 1,
        unitPrice: 100,
        totalPrice: 100,
        size: itemSize,
        color: itemColor,
        productImage: undefined,
      },
    ],
    notes: 'Test note',
  });
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
  });
  const expandOrder = async () => {
    // Find and click the accordion summary button to expand
    const accordionButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /ORD-123/ });
    accordionButton.click();
    // Wait for accordion to expand (aria-expanded becomes true)
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(accordionButton).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    });
  };
  it('renders pants size "32x34" as "W32/L34" and does NOT show raw "32x34"', async () => {
    const orderWithPantsSize = createMockOrder('32x34', 'Black');
    mockUseSellerOrders.mockReturnValue({
      orders: [orderWithPantsSize],
      loading: false,
      error: null,
      updateOrderStatus: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
      updateStatusLoading: false,
    });
    renderWithTheme(<SellerOrdersScreen />);
    await expandOrder();
    // Check that formatted pants size "W32/L34" is rendered (use regex for flexible matching)
    expect(screen.getByText(/W32\/L34/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    // Check that raw "32x34" is NOT in the document
    expect(screen.queryByText('32x34')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('renders regular apparel size "M" unchanged (no "W" + digit label)', async () => {
    const orderWithApparelSize = createMockOrder('M', 'Blue');
    mockUseSellerOrders.mockReturnValue({
      orders: [orderWithApparelSize],
      loading: false,
      error: null,
      updateOrderStatus: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
      updateStatusLoading: false,
    });
    renderWithTheme(<SellerOrdersScreen />);
    await expandOrder();
    // Check that "Blue - M" is rendered (color + unchanged size)
    expect(screen.getByText('Blue - M')).toBeInTheDocument();
    // Check that no "W" + digit label appears (e.g., "W" followed by number)
    const allText = screen.getByTestId('sellers-layout').textContent || '';
    // Verify no pants-style label like "W32/L34" appears for apparel size
    expect(allText).not.toMatch(/W\d+\/L\d+/);
  });
  it('renders regular apparel size "L" unchanged (no "W" + digit label)', async () => {
    const orderWithApparelSize = createMockOrder('L', 'Red');
    mockUseSellerOrders.mockReturnValue({
      orders: [orderWithApparelSize],
      loading: false,
      error: null,
      updateOrderStatus: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
      updateStatusLoading: false,
    });
    renderWithTheme(<SellerOrdersScreen />);
    await expandOrder();
    // Check that "Red - L" is rendered (color + unchanged size)
    expect(screen.getByText('Red - L')).toBeInTheDocument();
    // Check that no "W" + digit label appears
    const allText = screen.getByTestId('sellers-layout').textContent || '';
    expect(allText).not.toMatch(/W\d+\/L\d+/);
  });
  it('renders pants size "30x32" as "W30/L32"', async () => {
    const orderWithPantsSize = createMockOrder('30x32', 'Grey');
    mockUseSellerOrders.mockReturnValue({
      orders: [orderWithPantsSize],
      loading: false,
      error: null,
      updateOrderStatus: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
      updateStatusLoading: false,
    });
    renderWithTheme(<SellerOrdersScreen />);
    await expandOrder();
    expect(screen.getByText(/W30\/L32/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText('30x32')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('renders pants size with color as "Color - W32/L34"', async () => {
    const orderWithPantsSize = createMockOrder('32x34', 'Navy');
    mockUseSellerOrders.mockReturnValue({
      orders: [orderWithPantsSize],
      loading: false,
      error: null,
      updateOrderStatus: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
      updateStatusLoading: false,
    });
    renderWithTheme(<SellerOrdersScreen />);
    await expandOrder();
    // Should show "Navy - W32/L34" (color + formatted size)
    expect(screen.getByText(/Navy - W32\/L34/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText('32x34')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('renders apparel size with color as "Color - M"', async () => {
    const orderWithApparelSize = createMockOrder('M', 'Green');
    mockUseSellerOrders.mockReturnValue({
      orders: [orderWithApparelSize],
      loading: false,
      error: null,
      updateOrderStatus: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
      updateStatusLoading: false,
    });
    renderWithTheme(<SellerOrdersScreen />);
    await expandOrder();
    // Should show "Green - M" (color + unchanged size)
    expect(screen.getByText(/Green - M/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    const allText = screen.getByTestId('sellers-layout').textContent || '';
    expect(allText).not.toMatch(/W\d+\/L\d+/);
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/sellers/zustand/sellers-products-store/src/lib/sellers-products-store.tsx">
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { immer } from 'zustand/middleware/immer';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
// Define the shape of our seller product state
interface SellerProductState {
  // Current product being managed
  currentProduct: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product | null;
  // Product management modal state
  productModal: {
    open: boolean;
    mode: 'create' | 'edit';
    selectedTab: number;
  };
  // Product list state
  products: {
    items: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product[];
    isLoading: boolean;
    error: string | null;
  };
  // Filter states
  search: string;
  category: string;
  sort: string;
  sortOrder: 'asc' | 'desc';
  status: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductArchivedStatus;
}
// Define the actions
interface SellerProductActions {
  // Product management
  setCurrentProduct: (product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product | null) => void;
  updateProduct: (
    productId: number,
    updates: Partial<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product>
  ) => void;
  // Product modal actions
  openProductModal: (
    mode: 'create' | 'edit',
    product?: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product
  ) => void;
  closeProductModal: () => void;
  setSelectedTab: (tabIndex: number) => void;
  // Product list actions
  setProducts: (products: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product[]) => void;
  addProduct: (product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product) => void;
  removeProduct: (productId: number) => void;
  setProductsLoading: (loading: boolean) => void;
  setProductsError: (error: string | null) => void;
  // Filter actions
  setSearch: (search: string) => void;
  setCategory: (category: string) => void;
  setSellersProductsSortField: (sortField: string) => void;
  setSellersProductsSortOrder: (sortOrder: 'asc' | 'desc') => void;
  setStatus: (status: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductArchivedStatus) => void;
  resetFilters: () => void;
}
// Create the store
export const useSellersProductsStore = create<
  SellerProductState & SellerProductActions
>()(
  immer((set) => ({
    // Initial state
    currentProduct: null,
    productModal: {
      open: false,
      mode: 'create',
      selectedTab: 0,
    },
    products: {
      items: [],
      isLoading: false,
      error: null,
    },
    // Filter initial state
    search: '',
    category: '',
    sort: '',
    sortOrder: 'asc',
    status: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductArchivedStatus.Active,
    // Actions
    setCurrentProduct: (product) => {
      set((state) => {
        state.currentProduct = product;
      });
    },
    updateProduct: (productId, updates) => {
      set((state) => {
        const productIndex = state.products.items.findIndex(
          (p) => p.id === productId
        );
        if (productIndex !== -1) {
          Object.assign(state.products.items[productIndex], updates);
        }
        if (state.currentProduct?.id === productId) {
          Object.assign(state.currentProduct, updates);
        }
      });
    },
    openProductModal: (mode, product) => {
      set((state) => {
        state.productModal.open = true;
        state.productModal.mode = mode;
        state.productModal.selectedTab = 0;
        if (product) {
          state.currentProduct = product;
        }
      });
    },
    closeProductModal: () => {
      set((state) => {
        state.productModal.open = false;
        state.productModal.selectedTab = 0;
        state.currentProduct = null;
      });
    },
    setSelectedTab: (tabIndex) => {
      set((state) => {
        state.productModal.selectedTab = tabIndex;
      });
    },
    setProducts: (products) => {
      set((state) => {
        state.products.items = products;
      });
    },
    addProduct: (product) => {
      set((state) => {
        state.products.items.push(product);
      });
    },
    removeProduct: (productId) => {
      set((state) => {
        state.products.items = state.products.items.filter(
          (p) => p.id !== productId
        );
      });
    },
    setProductsLoading: (loading) => {
      set((state) => {
        state.products.isLoading = loading;
      });
    },
    setProductsError: (error) => {
      set((state) => {
        state.products.error = error;
      });
    },
    // Filter actions
    setSearch: (search) => {
      set((state) => {
        state.search = search;
      });
    },
    setCategory: (category) => {
      set((state) => {
        state.category = category;
      });
    },
    setSellersProductsSortField: (sortField) => {
      set((state) => {
        state.sort = sortField;
      });
    },
    setSellersProductsSortOrder: (sortOrder) => {
      set((state) => {
        state.sortOrder = sortOrder;
      });
    },
    setStatus: (status) => {
      set((state) => {
        state.status = status;
      });
    },
    resetFilters: () => {
      set((state) => {
        state.search = '';
        state.category = '';
        state.sort = '';
        state.sortOrder = 'asc';
        state.status = KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductArchivedStatus.Active;
      });
    },
  }))
);
</file>

<file path="libs/client/sellers/zustand/sellers-products-store/src/lib/useSellersProductsStore.ts">
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
interface SellersProductsState {
  // Filter states
  search: string;
  category: string;
  sort: string;
  sortOrder: 'asc' | 'desc';
  status: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductArchivedStatus;
  // Actions
  setSearch: (search: string) => void;
  setCategory: (category: string) => void;
  setSellersProductsSortField: (sortField: string) => void;
  setSellersProductsSortOrder: (sortOrder: 'asc' | 'desc') => void;
  setStatus: (status: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductArchivedStatus) => void;
  resetFilters: () => void;
}
export const useSellersProductsStore = create<SellersProductsState>((set) => ({
  // Initial state
  search: '',
  category: '',
  sort: '',
  sortOrder: 'asc',
  status: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductArchivedStatus.Active,
  // Actions
  setSearch: (search: string) => set({ search }),
  setCategory: (category: string) => set({ category }),
  setSellersProductsSortField: (sortField: string) => set({ sort: sortField }),
  setSellersProductsSortOrder: (sortOrder: 'asc' | 'desc') =>
    set({ sortOrder }),
  setStatus: (status: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductArchivedStatus) =>
    set({ status }),
  resetFilters: () =>
    set({
      search: '',
      category: '',
      sort: '',
      sortOrder: 'asc',
      status: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductArchivedStatus.Active,
    }),
}));
</file>

import React from 'react';
import { ApolloProvider } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { ApolloClient } from '@apollo/client';
interface ApolloProviderBaseProps {
  client: ApolloClient;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}
// Note: Error handling is now done at the client level or through error policies
// The errorLink is no longer needed in the same way in Apollo Client 4
export const errorLink = null;
/**
 * ApolloProviderBase wraps ApolloProvider and provides a base for Apollo Client configuration.
 *
 * In Apollo Client 4, error handling is typically done through error policies
 * and the client configuration rather than through custom error links.
 */
export const ApolloProviderBase: React.FC<ApolloProviderBaseProps> = ({
  client,
  children,
}) => {
  return <ApolloProvider client={client}>{children}</ApolloProvider>;
};

import { ApolloClient, ApolloLink, InMemoryCache, gql } from '@apollo/client';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import {
  createSilentRefreshAuthLink,
  refreshAuthSession,
  resetRefreshAuthSessionForTests,
} from './createSilentRefreshAuthLink';
const mockClient = new ApolloClient({
  cache: new InMemoryCache(),
  link: ApolloLink.empty(),
});
describe('refreshAuthSession', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    resetRefreshAuthSessionForTests();
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', vi.fn());
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
    resetRefreshAuthSessionForTests();
  });
  it('returns true when refresh mutation succeeds', async () => {
    vi.mocked(fetch).mockResolvedValue({
      json: async () => ({ data: { refresh: true } }),
    } as Response);
    await expect(refreshAuthSession('/graphql')).resolves.toBe(true);
    expect(fetch).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/graphql',
      expect.objectContaining({
        method: 'POST',
        credentials: 'include',
        body: expect.stringContaining('Refresh'),
      })
    );
  });
  it('returns false when refresh mutation fails', async () => {
    vi.mocked(fetch).mockResolvedValue({
      json: async () => ({
        errors: [{ message: 'Unauthorized' }],
        data: null,
      }),
    } as Response);
    await expect(refreshAuthSession('/graphql')).resolves.toBe(false);
  });
  it('returns false when fetch throws', async () => {
    vi.mocked(fetch).mockRejectedValue(new Error('network down'));
    await expect(refreshAuthSession('/graphql')).resolves.toBe(false);
  });
  it('single-flights concurrent refresh calls', async () => {
    let resolveFetch: (value: Response) => void = () => undefined;
    vi.mocked(fetch).mockImplementation(
      () =>
        new Promise<Response>((resolve) => {
          resolveFetch = resolve;
        })
    );
    const first = refreshAuthSession('/graphql');
    const second = refreshAuthSession('/graphql');
    expect(fetch).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    resolveFetch({
      json: async () => ({ data: { refresh: true } }),
    } as Response);
    await expect(Promise.all([first, second])).resolves.toEqual([true, true]);
  });
});
describe('createSilentRefreshAuthLink', () => {
  const protectedQuery = gql`
    query Protected {
      me {
        id
      }
    }
  `;
  const loginMutation = gql`
    mutation Login {
      login(email: "a", password: "b") {
        id
      }
    }
  `;
  beforeEach(() => {
    resetRefreshAuthSessionForTests();
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', vi.fn());
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
    resetRefreshAuthSessionForTests();
  });
  const runLink = (
    authLink: ApolloLink,
    terminating: ApolloLink,
    query = protectedQuery
  ) =>
    new Promise<{ next?: unknown; error?: unknown }>((resolve) => {
      ApolloLink.execute(
        ApolloLink.from([authLink, terminating]),
        { query },
        { client: mockClient }
      ).subscribe({
        next: (value) => resolve({ next: value }),
        error: (error) => resolve({ error }),
        complete: () => resolve({}),
      });
    });
  it('refreshes and retries the operation on unauthenticated errors', async () => {
    const onAuthError = vi.fn();
    let attempts = 0;
    vi.mocked(fetch).mockResolvedValue({
      json: async () => ({ data: { refresh: true } }),
    } as Response);
    const terminating = new ApolloLink(() => {
      attempts += 1;
      if (attempts === 1) {
        return new Observable((observer) => {
          const err = Object.assign(new Error('User not authenticated'), {
            statusCode: 401,
          });
          observer.error(err);
        });
      }
      return new Observable((observer) => {
        observer.next({ data: { me: { id: '1' } } });
        observer.complete();
      });
    });
    const result = await runLink(
      createSilentRefreshAuthLink({
        graphqlUri: '/graphql',
        onAuthError,
      }),
      terminating
    );
    expect(fetch).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(onAuthError).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(result.next).toEqual({ data: { me: { id: '1' } } });
    expect(attempts).toBe(2);
  });
  it('calls onAuthError when refresh fails', async () => {
    const onAuthError = vi.fn();
    vi.mocked(fetch).mockResolvedValue({
      json: async () => ({ data: { refresh: false } }),
    } as Response);
    const terminating = new ApolloLink(
      () =>
        new Observable((observer) => {
          observer.error(new Error('not authenticated'));
        })
    );
    const result = await runLink(
      createSilentRefreshAuthLink({
        graphqlUri: '/graphql',
        onAuthError,
      }),
      terminating
    );
    expect(onAuthError).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(result.error).toBeTruthy();
  });
  it('skips redirect when shouldSkipRedirect returns true', async () => {
    const onAuthError = vi.fn();
    vi.mocked(fetch).mockResolvedValue({
      json: async () => ({ data: { refresh: false } }),
    } as Response);
    const terminating = new ApolloLink(
      () =>
        new Observable((observer) => {
          observer.error(new Error('unauthorized'));
        })
    );
    await runLink(
      createSilentRefreshAuthLink({
        graphqlUri: '/graphql',
        onAuthError,
        shouldSkipRedirect: () => true,
      }),
      terminating
    );
    expect(onAuthError).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('does not attempt refresh for login operations', async () => {
    const onAuthError = vi.fn();
    const terminating = new ApolloLink(
      () =>
        new Observable((observer) => {
          observer.error(new Error('unauthorized'));
        })
    );
    const result = await runLink(
      createSilentRefreshAuthLink({
        graphqlUri: '/graphql',
        onAuthError,
      }),
      terminating,
      loginMutation
    );
    expect(fetch).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(onAuthError).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(result.error).toBeTruthy();
  });
  it('does not attempt refresh for non-auth errors', async () => {
    const onAuthError = vi.fn();
    const terminating = new ApolloLink(
      () =>
        new Observable((observer) => {
          observer.error(new Error('Internal server error'));
        })
    );
    await runLink(
      createSilentRefreshAuthLink({
        graphqlUri: '/graphql',
        onAuthError,
      }),
      terminating
    );
    expect(fetch).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(onAuthError).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
