<file path="libs/client/shared/components/apollo-provider-base/src/lib/createSilentRefreshAuthLink.ts">
import { CombinedGraphQLErrors } from '@apollo/client/errors';
import { onError } from '@apollo/client/link/error';
import type { ApolloLink } from '@apollo/client';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
const REFRESH_MUTATION = `
  mutation Refresh {
    refresh
  }
`;
const DEFAULT_SKIP_OPERATIONS = new Set([
  'login',
  'refresh',
  'logout',
  'register',
]);
export interface SilentRefreshAuthLinkOptions {
  graphqlUri: string;
  onAuthError: () => void;
  /** Extra operation names (lowercase) that should not trigger refresh/redirect */
  skipOperations?: string[];
  /** When true, do not redirect on failed refresh (e.g. public cart page) */
  shouldSkipRedirect?: () => boolean;
}
let refreshInFlight: Promise<boolean> | null = null;
/** Test helper to clear single-flight state between cases */
export function resetRefreshAuthSessionForTests(): void {
  refreshInFlight = null;
}
export function refreshAuthSession(graphqlUri: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!refreshInFlight) {
    refreshInFlight = fetch(graphqlUri, {
      method: 'POST',
      credentials: 'include',
      headers: {
        'content-type': 'application/json',
        'apollo-require-preflight': 'true',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        query: REFRESH_MUTATION,
        operationName: 'Refresh',
      }),
    })
      .then(async (response) => {
        const json = (await response.json()) as {
          data?: { refresh?: boolean };
        };
        return json?.data?.refresh === true;
      })
      .catch(() => false)
      .finally(() => {
        refreshInFlight = null;
      });
  }
  return refreshInFlight;
}
function isUnauthenticatedError(error: unknown): boolean {
  if (CombinedGraphQLErrors.is(error)) {
    return error.errors.some((graphQLError) => {
      const message = graphQLError.message?.toLowerCase() ?? '';
      const code = graphQLError.extensions?.code;
      return (
        code === 'UNAUTHENTICATED' ||
        message.includes('not authenticated') ||
        message.includes('unauthorized')
      );
    });
  }
  const err = error as { message?: string; statusCode?: number } | null;
  const message = err?.message?.toLowerCase() ?? '';
  return (
    message.includes('not authenticated') ||
    message.includes('unauthorized') ||
    err?.statusCode === 401
  );
}
export function createSilentRefreshAuthLink(
  options: SilentRefreshAuthLinkOptions
): ApolloLink {
  const skipOperations = new Set([
    ...DEFAULT_SKIP_OPERATIONS,
    ...(options.skipOperations ?? []).map((name) => name.toLowerCase()),
  ]);
  return onError(({ error, operation, forward }) => {
    const operationName = operation.operationName?.toLowerCase() ?? '';
    if (skipOperations.has(operationName)) {
      return;
    }
    if (!isUnauthenticatedError(error)) {
      return;
    }
    if (operation.getContext()._authRefreshRetried) {
      if (!options.shouldSkipRedirect?.()) {
        options.onAuthError();
      }
      return;
    }
    return new Observable((observer) => {
      let innerSub: { unsubscribe: () => void } | undefined;
      refreshAuthSession(options.graphqlUri)
        .then((success) => {
          if (!success) {
            if (!options.shouldSkipRedirect?.()) {
              options.onAuthError();
            }
            observer.error(error);
            return;
          }
          operation.setContext({ _authRefreshRetried: true });
          innerSub = forward(operation).subscribe({
            next: (value) => observer.next(value),
            error: (err) => observer.error(err),
            complete: () => observer.complete(),
          });
        })
        .catch((err) => {
          if (!options.shouldSkipRedirect?.()) {
            options.onAuthError();
          }
          observer.error(err);
        });
      return () => {
        innerSub?.unsubscribe();
      };
    });
  });
}

<file path="libs/client/shared/components/error-boundary/src/lib/error-boundary.spec.tsx">
import { render, screen, fireEvent } from '@testing-library/react';
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
import ErrorBoundary from './error-boundary';
function ProblemChild({ shouldThrow = false }: { shouldThrow?: boolean }) {
  if (shouldThrow) {
    throw new Error('Simulated crash in component');
  }
  return <div data-testid="safe-child">Normal content</div>;
}
function RecoveryTestHarness() {
  const [shouldThrow, setShouldThrow] = useState(true);
  return (
    <ErrorBoundary onReset={() => setShouldThrow(false)}>
      <ProblemChild shouldThrow={shouldThrow} />
    </ErrorBoundary>
  );
}
describe('ErrorBoundary', () => {
  const originalError = console.error;
  beforeEach(() => {
    // Suppress expected React error logging during boundary tests
    console.error = vi.fn();
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    console.error = originalError;
  });
  it('renders children when no error is thrown', () => {
    render(
      <ErrorBoundary>
        <ProblemChild shouldThrow={false} />
      </ErrorBoundary>
    );
    expect(screen.getByTestId('safe-child')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('catches thrown error and renders the default luxury fallback UI with recovery button', () => {
    render(
      <ErrorBoundary>
        <ProblemChild shouldThrow={true} />
      </ErrorBoundary>
    );
    // Brand wordmark must be present
    expect(screen.getByText('SAINTBALA')).toBeInTheDocument();
    // Default error heading
    expect(
      screen.getByText('Service Temporarily Unavailable')
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    // Recovery button with minHeight: 44px
    const returnBtn = screen.getByTestId('return-to-storefront-btn');
    expect(returnBtn).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(returnBtn).toHaveTextContent('Return to Storefront');
    expect(returnBtn).toHaveStyle({ minHeight: '44px' });
    // Try again button
    const tryAgainBtn = screen.getByTestId('try-again-btn');
    expect(tryAgainBtn).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('renders a custom function fallback when provided', () => {
    render(
      <ErrorBoundary
        fallback={({ error, resetError }) => (
          <div data-testid="custom-fallback">
            <span>Custom Error: {error?.message}</span>
            <button onClick={resetError}>Reset</button>
          </div>
        )}
      >
        <ProblemChild shouldThrow={true} />
      </ErrorBoundary>
    );
    expect(screen.getByTestId('custom-fallback')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      screen.getByText('Custom Error: Simulated crash in component')
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('renders a custom ReactNode fallback when provided', () => {
    render(
      <ErrorBoundary fallback={<div data-testid="static-fallback">Static</div>}>
        <ProblemChild shouldThrow={true} />
      </ErrorBoundary>
    );
    expect(screen.getByTestId('static-fallback')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('calls onError callback when error is caught', () => {
    const onError = vi.fn();
    render(
      <ErrorBoundary onError={onError}>
        <ProblemChild shouldThrow={true} />
      </ErrorBoundary>
    );
    expect(onError).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ message: 'Simulated crash in component' }),
      expect.any(Object)
    );
  });
  it('resets error state when Try Again is clicked and child no longer throws', () => {
    render(<RecoveryTestHarness />);
    expect(
      screen.getByText('Service Temporarily Unavailable')
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    const tryAgainBtn = screen.getByTestId('try-again-btn');
    fireEvent.click(tryAgainBtn);
    expect(screen.getByTestId('safe-child')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/shared/components/error-boundary/src/lib/error-boundary.tsx">
import React, { Component, ErrorInfo, ReactNode } from 'react';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Container from '@mui/material/Container';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
export interface ErrorBoundaryFallbackProps {
  error: Error | null;
  resetError: () => void;
  homePath?: string;
}
export interface ErrorBoundaryProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  fallback?: ReactNode | ((props: ErrorBoundaryFallbackProps) => ReactNode);
  onReset?: () => void;
  onError?: (error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) => void;
  homePath?: string;
}
interface ErrorBoundaryState {
  hasError: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
}
export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<
  ErrorBoundaryProps,
  ErrorBoundaryState
> {
  override state: ErrorBoundaryState = {
    hasError: false,
    error: null,
  };
  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): ErrorBoundaryState {
    return {
      hasError: true,
      error,
    };
  }
  override componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
    if (this.props.onError) {
      this.props.onError(error, errorInfo);
    }
  }
  resetError = () => {
    this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null });
    this.props.onReset?.();
  };
  handleReturnToStorefront = () => {
    this.resetError();
    const target = this.props.homePath || '/';
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.location.assign(target);
    }
  };
  override render(): ReactNode {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      if (typeof this.props.fallback === 'function') {
        return this.props.fallback({
          error: this.state.error,
          resetError: this.resetError,
          homePath: this.props.homePath,
        });
      }
      if (this.props.fallback) {
        return this.props.fallback;
      }
      const homeTarget = this.props.homePath || '/';
      return (
        <Box
          data-testid="saintbala-error-boundary-fallback"
          sx={{
            minHeight: '100vh',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            bgcolor: '#000000',
            color: '#f5f5f7',
            px: 2,
            py: 6,
          }}
        >
          <Container maxWidth="sm">
            <Paper
              elevation={0}
              sx={{
                p: { xs: 3, sm: 5 },
                bgcolor: '#0b0b0c',
                border: '1px solid rgba(201, 167, 116, 0.25)',
                borderRadius: '16px',
                boxShadow:
                  '0 24px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)',
                textAlign: 'center',
              }}
            >
              {/* Brand wordmark */}
              <Typography
                component="div"
                sx={{
                  fontFamily: '"Manrope", sans-serif',
                  letterSpacing: '0.28em',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  color: '#c9a774',
                  textTransform: 'uppercase',
                  mb: 3,
                }}
              >
                <bdi>SAINTBALA</bdi>
              </Typography>
              {/* Status & Title */}
              <Typography
                component="h1"
                variant="h4"
                sx={{
                  fontFamily: '"Manrope", "Vazirmatn", sans-serif',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  color: '#ffffff',
                  mb: 2,
                  fontSize: { xs: '1.4rem', sm: '1.75rem' },
                  letterSpacing: '-0.02em',
                }}
              >
                Service Temporarily Unavailable
              </Typography>
              <Typography
                variant="body1"
                sx={{
                  fontFamily: '"Manrope", "Vazirmatn", sans-serif',
                  color: '#d2d2d7',
                  mb: 4,
                  lineHeight: 1.7,
                  fontSize: { xs: '0.9rem', sm: '1rem' },
                }}
              >
                An unexpected interruption occurred while loading this view. You
                can refresh the current state or return directly to the main
                storefront.
              </Typography>
              {/* Recovery Actions */}
              <Box
                sx={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
                  gap: 2,
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  alignItems: 'stretch',
                }}
              >
                <Button
                  data-testid="return-to-storefront-btn"
                  variant="contained"
                  onClick={this.handleReturnToStorefront}
                  href={homeTarget}
                  sx={{
                    minHeight: '44px',
                    bgcolor: '#c9a774',
                    color: '#000000',
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    px: 3.5,
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    textTransform: 'none',
                    fontSize: '0.92rem',
                    letterSpacing: '0.02em',
                    boxShadow: '0 4px 14px rgba(201, 167, 116, 0.3)',
                    '&:hover': {
                      bgcolor: '#d8bc8c',
                      boxShadow: '0 6px 20px rgba(201, 167, 116, 0.45)',
                    },
                  }}
                >
                  Return to Storefront
                </Button>
                <Button
                  data-testid="try-again-btn"
                  variant="outlined"
                  onClick={this.resetError}
                  sx={{
                    minHeight: '44px',
                    borderColor: 'rgba(201, 167, 116, 0.4)',
                    color: '#f5f5f7',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    px: 3,
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    textTransform: 'none',
                    fontSize: '0.92rem',
                    '&:hover': {
                      borderColor: '#c9a774',
                      bgcolor: 'rgba(201, 167, 116, 0.08)',
                    },
                  }}
                >
                  Try Again
                </Button>
              </Box>
              {process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' &&
                this.state.error?.message && (
                  <Box
                    sx={{
                      mt: 4,
                      p: 2,
                      bgcolor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)',
                      borderRadius: '8px',
                      border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)',
                      textAlign: 'left',
                      fontFamily: 'monospace',
                      fontSize: '0.78rem',
                      color: '#a8a8ae',
                      overflowX: 'auto',
                    }}
                  >
                    {this.state.error.message}
                  </Box>
                )}
            </Paper>
          </Container>
        </Box>
      );
    }
    return this.props.children;
  }
}
export default ErrorBoundary;
</file>

<file path="libs/client/shared/components/glassmorphism-container/src/lib/glassmorphism-container.tsx">
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import { SxProps, Theme } from '@mui/material/styles';
import React from 'react';
import { useTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';
export interface GlassmorphismContainerProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  /**
   * Additional sx props for the outer Box wrapper (controls margin/padding around the container)
   */
  wrapperSx?: SxProps<Theme>;
  /**
   * Additional sx props for the inner Paper component (controls the glassmorphism container itself)
   */
  containerSx?: SxProps<Theme>;
  /**
   * If true, adds minHeight: '80vh' to the container
   */
  fullHeight?: boolean;
}
export function GlassmorphismContainer({
  children,
  wrapperSx,
  containerSx,
  fullHeight = false,
}: GlassmorphismContainerProps) {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isDark = theme.palette.mode === 'dark';
  return (
    <Box sx={{ p: { xs: 1, md: 2 }, ...wrapperSx }}>
      <Box
        sx={{
          position: 'relative',
          borderRadius: '24px',
          // Gradient border effect using padding trick
          padding: '1px',
          background: 'transparent',
          boxShadow: 'none',
        }}
      >
        <Paper
          elevation={0}
          sx={{
            position: 'relative',
            backgroundColor: isDark
              ? 'rgba(24, 24, 22, 0.92) !important'
              : 'rgba(250, 249, 247, 0.92) !important',
            backgroundImage: 'none !important',
            border: isDark
              ? '1px solid rgba(240, 239, 235, 0.08) !important'
              : '1px solid rgba(26, 26, 25, 0.08) !important',
            backdropFilter: isDark ? 'blur(12px)' : 'none',
            WebkitBackdropFilter: isDark ? 'blur(12px)' : 'none',
            borderRadius: '23px', // Slightly smaller to account for border
            // Multiple layered inner shadows for glassy edge highlights
            boxShadow: 'none !important',
            p: { xs: 2, md: 4 },
            ...(fullHeight && { minHeight: '80vh' }),
            ...containerSx,
          }}
        >
          {children}
        </Paper>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
}
export default GlassmorphismContainer;

<file path="libs/client/shared/components/layout/src/lib/Layout.tsx">
import React from 'react';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import { useSnackbar } from '@kickzone-workspace/snackbar-hook';
import { Snackbar } from '@kickzone-workspace/snackbar';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
type LayoutProps = ILayoutProps & {
  header: React.ReactNode;
  body: React.ReactNode;
  footer: React.ReactNode;
  loadingComponent?: React.ReactNode;
  bottomBar?: React.ReactNode;
};
export interface ILayoutProps {
  isLoading?: boolean;
  disablePadding?: boolean;
}
export function Layout({
  header,
  body,
  footer,
  isLoading = false,
  disablePadding = false,
  loadingComponent,
  bottomBar,
}: LayoutProps) {
  const { handleClose, open, message, severity, progress } = useSnackbar();
  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        minHeight: '100vh',
        // Ensure the layout doesn't interfere with the gradient background
        background: 'transparent',
      }}
    >
      <Box
        sx={{
          position: 'fixed',
          top: 0,
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          zIndex: (theme) => theme.zIndex.appBar + 1,
        }}
      >
        {header}
      </Box>
      <Box
        sx={{
          flex: 1,
          pt: disablePadding ? 0 : 10,
          px: disablePadding ? 0 : { xs: 2, sm: 3, md: 4 },
          pb: disablePadding ? 0 : bottomBar ? { xs: 11, sm: 4 } : 4,
        }}
      >
        {disablePadding ? (
          isLoading ? loadingComponent : body
        ) : (
          <Grid container spacing={2}>
            <Grid size={12} component="div">
              {isLoading ? loadingComponent : body}
            </Grid>
          </Grid>
        )}
      </Box>
      <Box sx={{ pb: bottomBar ? { xs: 9, sm: 0 } : 0 }}>{footer}</Box>
      {bottomBar && (
        <Box
          component="aside"
          sx={{
            display: { xs: 'block', sm: 'none' },
            position: 'fixed',
            bottom: 0,
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            zIndex: (theme) => theme.zIndex.appBar,
          }}
        >
          {bottomBar}
        </Box>
      )}
      <Snackbar
        open={open}
        message={message}
        severity={severity}
        progress={progress}
        onClose={handleClose}
      />
    </Box>
  );
}
export default Layout;
</file>

<file path="libs/client/shared/components/material-data-table/src/lib/material-data-table.tsx">
import React from 'react';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Alert from '@mui/material/Alert';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import {
  MaterialReactTable,
  useMaterialReactTable,
  type MRT_TableOptions,
  type MRT_RowData,
} from 'material-react-table';
import { MRT_Localization_FA } from 'material-react-table/locales/fa';
import { MRT_Localization_EN } from 'material-react-table/locales/en';
import {
  useLanguageContext,
  useTableLocalization,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
import type { DataTableProps } from './table-types';
import { mergeTableConfig } from './table-config';
/**
 * Reusable DataTable component that consolidates common Material React Table configurations
 *
 * Features:
 * - Automatic RTL support
 * - Built-in localization
 * - Common table presets (orders, sellers, products, etc.)
 * - Consistent styling and behavior
 * - Loading and error states
 */
export function DataTable<T extends MRT_RowData = MRT_RowData>({
  columns,
  data,
  loading = false,
  error = null,
  config = {},
  tableOptions = {},
  emptyMessage = 'No data available',
  errorMessage,
}: DataTableProps<T>) {
  const { isRTL, currentLocale } = useLanguageContext();
  const customTableLocalization = useTableLocalization();
  // Use built-in localizations for supported languages, custom localization for others
  const tableLocalization =
    currentLocale === 'fa'
      ? MRT_Localization_FA
      : currentLocale === 'en'
      ? MRT_Localization_EN
      : customTableLocalization;
  // Merge configuration with preset
  const mergedConfig = mergeTableConfig(config.preset || 'default', config);
  // Create table options
  const tableConfig: MRT_TableOptions<T> = {
    columns,
    data,
    state: { isLoading: loading },
    enableRowActions: mergedConfig.enableRowActions,
    enableColumnOrdering: mergedConfig.enableColumnOrdering,
    enableGlobalFilter: mergedConfig.enableGlobalFilter,
    enableSorting: mergedConfig.enableSorting,
    enableRowSelection: mergedConfig.enableRowSelection,
    localization: tableLocalization,
    muiTableHeadCellProps: {
      align: isRTL ? 'right' : 'left',
      sx: {
        textAlign: isRTL ? 'right' : 'left',
        '& .Mui-TableHeadCell-Content': {
          justifyContent: isRTL ? 'flex-end' : 'flex-start',
          width: '100%',
        },
        '& .Mui-TableHeadCell-Content-Labels': {
          justifyContent: isRTL ? 'flex-end' : 'flex-start',
          width: '100%',
        },
        '& .Mui-TableHeadCell-Content-Wrapper': {
          textAlign: isRTL ? 'right' : 'left',
          width: '100%',
        },
        '& .MuiTableSortLabel-root': {
          width: '100%',
          justifyContent: isRTL ? 'flex-end' : 'flex-start',
          flexDirection: isRTL ? 'row-reverse' : 'row',
        },
      },
    },
    muiTableBodyCellProps: {
      align: isRTL ? 'right' : 'left',
      sx: {
        textAlign: isRTL ? 'right' : 'left',
      },
    },
    enableColumnActions: false,
    muiTableContainerProps: {
      sx: {
        direction: isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr',
      },
    },
    muiTableProps: {
      sx: {
        direction: isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr',
      },
    },
    muiTablePaperProps: {
      sx: {
        direction: isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr',
      },
    },
    initialState: {
      sorting: mergedConfig.initialSorting,
      density: mergedConfig.initialDensity,
    },
    muiTableBodyRowProps: ({ row }) => ({
      sx: {
        cursor: mergedConfig.onRowClick ? 'pointer' : 'default',
        '&:hover': {
          backgroundColor: mergedConfig.onRowClick
            ? 'action.hover'
            : 'transparent',
        },
        onClick: mergedConfig.onRowClick
          ? () => mergedConfig.onRowClick?.(row.original)
          : undefined,
      },
    }),
    renderTopToolbarCustomActions: mergedConfig.renderTopToolbarCustomActions,
    renderDetailPanel: mergedConfig.renderDetailPanel,
    ...tableOptions,
  };
  const table = useMaterialReactTable(tableConfig);
  // Show error state
  if (error) {
    return (
      <Alert severity="error" sx={{ m: 2 }}>
        {errorMessage || `Error loading data: ${error.message}`}
      </Alert>
    );
  }
  // Show loading state
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box
        display="flex"
        justifyContent="center"
        alignItems="center"
        minHeight="200px"
      >
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }
  // Show empty state
  if (!loading && (!data || data.length === 0)) {
    return (
      <Box
        display="flex"
        justifyContent="center"
        alignItems="center"
        minHeight="200px"
        color="text.secondary"
      >
        {emptyMessage}
      </Box>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Box sx={{ direction: isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr' }}>
      <MaterialReactTable table={table} />
    </Box>
  );
}
export default DataTable;
</file>

<file path="libs/client/shared/components/material-data-table/src/lib/table-config.ts">
import type { MRT_ColumnDef, MRT_RowData } from 'material-react-table';
import type { DataTableConfig, TableConfigPreset } from './table-types';
/**
 * Default table configuration presets
 */
export const TABLE_CONFIG_PRESETS: Record<TableConfigPreset, DataTableConfig> =
  {
    default: {
      enableRowActions: false,
      enableColumnOrdering: false,
      enableGlobalFilter: true,
      enableSorting: true,
      enableRowSelection: false,
      initialDensity: 'compact',
    },
    orders: {
      enableRowActions: false,
      enableColumnOrdering: false,
      enableGlobalFilter: true,
      enableSorting: true,
      enableRowSelection: false,
      initialSorting: [{ id: 'createdAt', desc: true }],
      initialDensity: 'compact',
    },
    sellers: {
      enableRowActions: false,
      enableColumnOrdering: false,
      enableGlobalFilter: true,
      enableSorting: true,
      enableRowSelection: false,
      initialDensity: 'compact',
    },
    products: {
      enableRowActions: false,
      enableColumnOrdering: false,
      enableGlobalFilter: true,
      enableSorting: true,
      enableRowSelection: false,
      initialDensity: 'comfortable',
    },
    minimal: {
      enableRowActions: false,
      enableColumnOrdering: false,
      enableGlobalFilter: false,
      enableSorting: false,
      enableRowSelection: false,
      initialDensity: 'compact',
    },
  };
/**
 * Common column definitions for reuse across tables
 */
export const createCommonColumns = () => ({
  /**
   * Creates a date column with proper formatting
   */
  dateColumn: (
    accessorKey: string,
    header: string
  ): MRT_ColumnDef<MRT_RowData> => ({
    accessorKey,
    header,
    Cell: ({ cell }) => {
      const dateValue = cell.getValue() as string;
      if (!dateValue) return '-';
      try {
        return new Date(dateValue).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
          year: 'numeric',
          month: 'short',
          day: 'numeric',
          hour: '2-digit',
          minute: '2-digit',
        });
      } catch {
        return dateValue;
      }
    },
  }),
  /**
   * Creates a status column with plain text display
   */
  statusColumn: (
    accessorKey: string,
    header: string
  ): MRT_ColumnDef<MRT_RowData> => ({
    accessorKey,
    header,
    Cell: ({ cell }) => {
      const status = cell.getValue() as string;
      return status || '-';
    },
  }),
  /**
   * Creates a number column with proper formatting
   */
  numberColumn: (
    accessorKey: string,
    header: string
  ): MRT_ColumnDef<MRT_RowData> => ({
    accessorKey,
    header,
    Cell: ({ cell }) => {
      const value = cell.getValue() as number;
      return value?.toLocaleString() || '-';
    },
  }),
  /**
   * Creates a currency column with proper formatting
   */
  currencyColumn: (
    accessorKey: string,
    header: string
  ): MRT_ColumnDef<MRT_RowData> => ({
    accessorKey,
    header,
    Cell: ({ cell }) => {
      const value = cell.getValue() as number;
      return value ? `$${value.toFixed(2)}` : '-';
    },
  }),
});
/**
 * Get status color based on status value
 */
function getStatusColor(status: string): string {
  const statusColors: Record<string, string> = {
    active: '#4caf50',
    inactive: '#f44336',
    pending: '#ff9800',
    confirmed: '#2196f3',
    processing: '#9c27b0',
    shipped: '#00bcd4',
    delivered: '#4caf50',
    cancelled: '#f44336',
    refunded: '#ff5722',
  };
  return statusColors[status.toLowerCase()] || '#757575';
}
/**
 * Merge table configuration with preset
 */
export function mergeTableConfig(
  preset: TableConfigPreset,
  customConfig?: Partial<DataTableConfig>
): DataTableConfig {
  return {
    ...TABLE_CONFIG_PRESETS[preset],
    ...customConfig,
  };
}

<file path="libs/client/shared/components/material-data-table/src/lib/table-utils.ts">
import type { MRT_ColumnDef, MRT_RowData } from 'material-react-table';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
/**
 * Utility functions for common table operations
 */
/**
 * Creates a formatted date column
 */
export function createDateColumn(
  accessorKey: string,
  header: string,
  options?: {
    format?: 'short' | 'long' | 'time';
    locale?: string;
  }
): MRT_ColumnDef<MRT_RowData> {
  const { format = 'short', locale = 'en-US' } = options || {};
  const formatOptions: Record<string, Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions> = {
    short: {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
    },
    long: {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'long',
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    },
    time: {
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    },
  };
  return {
    accessorKey,
    header,
    Cell: ({ cell }) => {
      const dateValue = cell.getValue() as string;
      if (!dateValue) return '-';
      try {
        return new Date(dateValue).toLocaleDateString(
          locale,
          formatOptions[format]
        );
      } catch {
        return dateValue;
      }
    },
  };
}
/**
 * Creates a status column with colored chips
 */
export function createStatusColumn(
  accessorKey: string,
  header: string,
  _statusColors?: Record<string, string>
): MRT_ColumnDef<MRT_RowData> {
  return {
    accessorKey,
    header,
    Cell: ({ cell }) => {
      const status = cell.getValue() as string;
      return status || '-';
    },
  };
}
/**
 * Creates a number column with proper formatting
 */
export function createNumberColumn(
  accessorKey: string,
  header: string,
  options?: {
    decimals?: number;
    locale?: string;
  }
): MRT_ColumnDef<MRT_RowData> {
  const { decimals = 0, locale = 'en-US' } = options || {};
  return {
    accessorKey,
    header,
    Cell: ({ cell }) => {
      const value = cell.getValue() as number;
      if (value === null || value === undefined) return '-';
      return value.toLocaleString(locale, {
        minimumFractionDigits: decimals,
        maximumFractionDigits: decimals,
      });
    },
  };
}
/**
 * Creates a currency column with proper formatting
 */
export function createCurrencyColumn(
  accessorKey: string,
  header: string,
  options?: {
    currency?: string;
    locale?: string;
  }
): MRT_ColumnDef<MRT_RowData> {
  const { currency = 'USD', locale = 'en-US' } = options || {};
  return {
    accessorKey,
    header,
    Cell: ({ cell }) => {
      const value = cell.getValue() as number;
      if (value === null || value === undefined) return '-';
      return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
        style: 'currency',
        currency,
      }).format(value);
    },
  };
}
/**
 * Creates an actions column with custom actions
 */
export function createActionsColumn(
  header: string,
  actions: (row: MRT_RowData) => ReactNode
): MRT_ColumnDef<MRT_RowData> {
  return {
    id: 'actions',
    header,
    enableSorting: false,
    enableColumnFilter: false,
    Cell: ({ row }) => actions(row.original),
  };
}
/**
 * Creates a boolean column with yes/no display
 */
export function createBooleanColumn(
  accessorKey: string,
  header: string,
  options?: {
    trueText?: string;
    falseText?: string;
  }
): MRT_ColumnDef<MRT_RowData> {
  const { trueText = 'Yes', falseText = 'No' } = options || {};
  return {
    accessorKey,
    header,
    Cell: ({ cell }) => {
      const value = cell.getValue() as boolean;
      return value ? trueText : falseText;
    },
  };
}
/**
 * Creates a text column with truncation
 */
export function createTextColumn(
  accessorKey: string,
  header: string,
  options?: {
    maxLength?: number;
    _showTooltip?: boolean;
  }
): MRT_ColumnDef<MRT_RowData> {
  const { maxLength = 50 } = options || {};
  return {
    accessorKey,
    header,
    Cell: ({ cell }) => {
      const value = cell.getValue() as string;
      if (!value) return '-';
      const truncated =
        value.length > maxLength
          ? `${value.substring(0, maxLength)}...`
          : value;
      return truncated;
    },
  };
}

import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import { useI18nContext } from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
interface OrderStatusChipProps {
  status: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus | string;
  size?: 'small' | 'medium';
}
const getStatusColor = (
  status: string
):
  | 'default'
  | 'primary'
  | 'secondary'
  | 'error'
  | 'info'
  | 'success'
  | 'warning' => {
  switch (status) {
    case 'PENDING':
      return 'warning';
    case 'CONFIRMED':
      return 'info';
    case 'PROCESSING':
      return 'primary';
    case 'SHIPPED':
      return 'secondary';
    case 'DELIVERED':
      return 'success';
    case 'CANCELLED':
      return 'error';
    case 'REFUNDED':
      return 'default';
    default:
      return 'default';
  }
};
export function OrderStatusChip({
  status,
  size = 'small',
}: OrderStatusChipProps) {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  const getStatusLabel = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'PENDING':
        return LL.orders.pending();
      case 'CONFIRMED':
        return LL.orders.confirmed();
      case 'PROCESSING':
        return LL.orders.processing();
      case 'SHIPPED':
        return LL.orders.shipped();
      case 'DELIVERED':
        return LL.orders.delivered();
      case 'CANCELLED':
        return LL.orders.cancelled();
      case 'REFUNDED':
        return LL.orders.refunded();
      default:
        return status;
    }
  };
  return (
    <Chip
      label={getStatusLabel(status)}
      color={getStatusColor(status)}
      size={size}
      sx={{
        maxWidth: '100%',
        '& .MuiChip-label': {
          whiteSpace: 'normal',
          overflow: 'visible',
        },
      }}
    />
  );
}
export default OrderStatusChip;

<file path="libs/client/shared/components/password-field/src/lib/PasswordTextField.tsx">
import { useState } from 'react';
import TextField, { TextFieldProps } from '@mui/material/TextField';
import InputAdornment from '@mui/material/InputAdornment';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import Visibility from '@mui/icons-material/Visibility';
import VisibilityOff from '@mui/icons-material/VisibilityOff';
export type PasswordTextFieldProps = Omit<TextFieldProps, 'type'>;
export function PasswordTextField({
  InputProps,
  slotProps,
  sx,
  ...props
}: PasswordTextFieldProps) {
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const htmlInputSlot =
    slotProps && typeof slotProps === 'object' && 'htmlInput' in slotProps
      ? (slotProps.htmlInput as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)
      : undefined;
  return (
    <TextField
      {...props}
      type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
      slotProps={{
        ...slotProps,
        htmlInput: {
          ...htmlInputSlot,
          dir: 'ltr',
        },
      }}
      sx={[
        {
          '& .MuiInputBase-input': {
            direction: 'ltr',
            textAlign: 'left',
            unicodeBidi: 'isolate',
          },
        },
        ...(Array.isArray(sx) ? sx : sx ? [sx] : []),
      ]}
      InputProps={{
        ...InputProps,
        endAdornment: (
          <InputAdornment position="end">
            <IconButton
              aria-label={showPassword ? 'hide password' : 'show password'}
              onClick={() => setShowPassword((prev) => !prev)}
              onMouseDown={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
              edge="end"
            >
              {showPassword ? <VisibilityOff /> : <Visibility />}
            </IconButton>
          </InputAdornment>
        ),
      }}
    />
  );
}
export default PasswordTextField;

import {
  useCurrencyForLocale,
  useConvertPrice,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/currency-hook';
import Skeleton from '@mui/material/Skeleton';
export interface PriceDisplayProps {
  /** Price in USD (base currency) */
  priceInUSD: number;
  /** Additional CSS class */
  className?: string;
  /** Show currency symbol */
  showSymbol?: boolean;
  /** Show original USD price when converted */
  showOriginal?: boolean;
}
/**
 * Smart component that displays prices in the user's preferred currency based on locale
 * - For 'fa' locale: Shows price in Toman (converted from USD)
 * - For other locales: Shows price in USD
 */
export function PriceDisplay({
  priceInUSD,
  className = '',
  showSymbol = true,
  showOriginal = false,
}: PriceDisplayProps) {
  const {
    currencyCode,
    currencySymbol,
    decimalPlaces,
    locale,
    loading: currencyLoading,
  } = useCurrencyForLocale();
  const { convertedAmount, loading: conversionLoading } = useConvertPrice({
    amount: priceInUSD,
    fromCurrency: 'USD',
    toCurrency: currencyCode,
  });
  if (currencyLoading || conversionLoading) {
    return (
      <Skeleton
        component="span"
        variant="text"
        animation="wave"
        width={56}
        sx={{
          display: 'inline-block',
          verticalAlign: 'middle',
          opacity: 0.6,
        }}
        className={className}
        data-testid="price-display-skeleton"
      />
    );
  }
  // Format the number with proper decimal places
  const formattedPrice = convertedAmount.toLocaleString(locale, {
    minimumFractionDigits: decimalPlaces,
    maximumFractionDigits: decimalPlaces,
  });
  let displayPrice = formattedPrice;
  if (showSymbol) {
    if (currencyCode === 'USD' || (locale && locale.startsWith('en'))) {
      displayPrice = `${currencySymbol || '$'}${formattedPrice}`;
    } else {
      displayPrice = `${formattedPrice} ${currencySymbol || 'تومان'}`;
    }
  }
  return (
    <span className={className}>
      {displayPrice}
      {showOriginal && currencyCode !== 'USD' && (
        <span style={{ fontSize: '0.85em', opacity: 0.7, marginLeft: '0.5em' }}>
          (${priceInUSD})
        </span>
      )}
    </span>
  );
}
export default PriceDisplay;
</file>

<file path="libs/client/shared/components/private-route/src/lib/PrivateRoute.tsx">
import { Navigate, Outlet } from 'react-router-dom';
export type BaseUser = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  role: string;
};
interface PrivateRouteProps<T extends BaseUser> {
  acceptedRoles?: string[];
  user?: T | null;
}
export const PrivateRoute = <T extends BaseUser>({
  acceptedRoles,
  user,
}: PrivateRouteProps<T>) => {
  if (!user) {
    return <Navigate to="/login" />;
  }
  if (acceptedRoles && !acceptedRoles.includes(user.role)) {
    return <Navigate to="/unauthorized" />;
  }
  return <Outlet />;
};

<file path="libs/client/shared/components/rtl-table-utils/src/lib/rtl-cell-components.tsx">
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import type { MRT_Cell } from 'material-react-table';
/**
 * Props for RTL cell components
 */
export interface RTLCellProps {
  alignment: 'left' | 'right' | 'center';
  value?: string | number | null;
}
/**
 * RTL-aligned text cell component for MaterialReactTable
 * Ensures proper right-to-left alignment in Farsi mode
 */
export function RTLTextCell({ alignment, value }: RTLCellProps) {
  return (
    <Typography
      component="div"
      sx={{
        textAlign: alignment,
        width: '100%',
        display: 'block',
      }}
      style={{
        textAlign: alignment,
        width: '100%',
        display: 'block',
      }}
    >
      {value || ''}
    </Typography>
  );
}
/**
 * RTL-aligned status cell component with color support
 */
export interface RTLStatusCellProps extends RTLCellProps {
  activeColor?: string;
  inactiveColor?: string;
  isActive?: boolean;
  fontWeight?: 'normal' | 'bold';
}
/**
 * RTL-aligned status cell component for MaterialReactTable
 * Displays status text with color coding and proper RTL alignment
 */
export function RTLStatusCell({
  alignment,
  value,
  activeColor = 'success.main',
  inactiveColor = 'error.main',
  isActive,
  fontWeight = 'bold',
}: RTLStatusCellProps) {
  const color = isActive ? activeColor : inactiveColor;
  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        color,
        fontWeight,
        textAlign: alignment,
        width: '100%',
        display: 'block',
      }}
      style={{
        textAlign: alignment,
        width: '100%',
        display: 'block',
      }}
    >
      {value || ''}
    </Box>
  );
}
/**
 * Helper function to create a text cell renderer for MaterialReactTable
 */
export function createRTLTextCellRenderer<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
  alignment: 'left' | 'right' | 'center'
) {
  return ({ cell }: { cell: MRT_Cell<T, unknown> }) => (
    <RTLTextCell alignment={alignment} value={cell.getValue<string>()} />
  );
}
/**
 * Helper function to create a status cell renderer for MaterialReactTable
 */
export function createRTLStatusCellRenderer<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
  alignment: 'left' | 'right' | 'center',
  options?: {
    activeColor?: string;
    inactiveColor?: string;
    getIsActive?: (row: T) => boolean;
  }
) {
  return ({
    row,
    cell,
  }: {
    row: { original: T };
    cell: MRT_Cell<T, unknown>;
  }) => {
    const isActive = options?.getIsActive
      ? options.getIsActive(row.original)
      : cell.getValue<boolean>();
    return (
      <RTLStatusCell
        alignment={alignment}
        value={cell.getValue<string>()}
        isActive={isActive}
        activeColor={options?.activeColor}
        inactiveColor={options?.inactiveColor}
      />
    );
  };
}

import type { MRT_ColumnDef } from 'material-react-table';
import {
  createRTLTextCellRenderer,
  createRTLStatusCellRenderer,
} from './rtl-cell-components';
import { getRTLColumnProps } from './rtl-table-props';
/**
 * Options for creating RTL text columns
 */
export interface CreateRTLTextColumnOptions {
  alignment: 'left' | 'right' | 'center';
}
/**
 * Creates a RTL-aligned text column for MaterialReactTable
 * @param accessorKey The key to access the data
 * @param header The column header text
 * @param options Configuration options
 * @returns MRT_ColumnDef with RTL alignment support
 */
export function createRTLTextColumn<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
  accessorKey: string,
  header: string,
  options: CreateRTLTextColumnOptions
): MRT_ColumnDef<T> {
  const { alignment } = options;
  return {
    accessorKey,
    header,
    Cell: createRTLTextCellRenderer(alignment),
    ...getRTLColumnProps(alignment),
  };
}
/**
 * Options for creating RTL status columns
 */
export interface CreateRTLStatusColumnOptions<
  T extends Record<string, unknown>
> {
  alignment: 'left' | 'right' | 'center';
  activeColor?: string;
  inactiveColor?: string;
  getIsActive?: (row: T) => boolean;
}
/**
 * Creates a RTL-aligned status column for MaterialReactTable
 * @param accessorKey The key to access the data
 * @param header The column header text
 * @param options Configuration options
 * @returns MRT_ColumnDef with RTL alignment support and status styling
 */
export function createRTLStatusColumn<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
  accessorKey: string,
  header: string,
  options: CreateRTLStatusColumnOptions<T>
): MRT_ColumnDef<T> {
  const { alignment, activeColor, inactiveColor, getIsActive } = options;
  return {
    accessorKey,
    header,
    Cell: createRTLStatusCellRenderer(alignment, {
      activeColor,
      inactiveColor,
      getIsActive,
    }),
    ...getRTLColumnProps(alignment),
  };
}

<file path="libs/client/shared/components/rtl-table-utils/src/lib/use-table-alignment.ts">
import { useLanguageContext } from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
/**
 * Hook that provides RTL alignment utilities for MaterialReactTable
 * @returns Object with alignment, isFarsi, and isRTL values
 */
export function useTableAlignment() {
  const { isRTL, currentLocale } = useLanguageContext();
  const isFarsi = currentLocale === 'fa';
  const alignment: 'left' | 'right' | 'center' = isFarsi ? 'right' : 'left';
  return {
    alignment,
    isFarsi,
    isRTL,
    currentLocale,
  };
}

<file path="libs/client/shared/components/snackbar/src/lib/snackbar.tsx">
import React from 'react';
import MuiSnackbar from '@mui/material/Snackbar';
import Alert, { AlertColor } from '@mui/material/Alert';
import LinearProgress from '@mui/material/LinearProgress';
import { styled } from '@mui/material/styles';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
export interface SnackbarProps {
  open: boolean;
  message: string;
  severity: AlertColor;
  progress: number;
  onClose: () => void;
}
const StyledAlert = styled(Alert)(({ theme }) => ({
  width: '100%',
  color: theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? '#ffffff' : undefined,
  backgroundColor:
    theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
      ? 'rgba(20, 20, 24, 0.92)'
      : theme.palette.background.paper,
  '& .MuiAlert-message': {
    width: '100%',
  },
}));
export function Snackbar({
  open,
  message,
  severity,
  progress,
  onClose,
}: SnackbarProps) {
  return (
    <MuiSnackbar
      open={open}
      anchorOrigin={{ vertical: 'bottom', horizontal: 'center' }}
      onClose={onClose}
    >
      <StyledAlert onClose={onClose} severity={severity} sx={{ width: '100%' }}>
        <Box sx={{ width: '100%' }}>
          {message}
          <LinearProgress
            variant="determinate"
            value={progress}
            sx={{
              marginTop: 1,
              backgroundColor: (theme) =>
                severity === 'error'
                  ? theme.palette.error.light
                  : severity === 'warning'
                  ? theme.palette.warning.light
                  : severity === 'success'
                  ? theme.palette.success.light
                  : theme.palette.info.light,
              '& .MuiLinearProgress-bar': {
                backgroundColor: (theme) =>
                  severity === 'error'
                    ? theme.palette.error.main
                    : severity === 'warning'
                    ? theme.palette.warning.main
                    : severity === 'success'
                    ? theme.palette.success.main
                    : theme.palette.info.main,
              },
            }}
          />
        </Box>
      </StyledAlert>
    </MuiSnackbar>
  );
}
export default Snackbar;

<file path="libs/client/shared/components/styled-drawer/src/lib/styled-drawer.spec.tsx">
import { render, screen, fireEvent } from '@testing-library/react';
import {
  LanguageProvider,
  RTLThemeProvider,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
import { useUIStore } from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-ui-store';
import { vi } from 'vitest';
import StyledDrawer, { CustomListItemText } from './styled-drawer';
describe('StyledDrawer', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    useUIStore.getState().resetUI();
  });
  it('should render successfully with content in light theme', () => {
    useUIStore.getState().setTheme({ mode: 'light' });
    const { baseElement } = render(
      <LanguageProvider>
        <RTLThemeProvider>
          <StyledDrawer open={true} onClose={vi.fn()}>
            <div data-testid="drawer-child">Liquid Glass Content</div>
          </StyledDrawer>
        </RTLThemeProvider>
      </LanguageProvider>
    );
    expect(baseElement).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByTestId('drawer-child')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Liquid Glass Content')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should render successfully in dark theme', () => {
    useUIStore.getState().setTheme({ mode: 'dark' });
    const { baseElement } = render(
      <LanguageProvider>
        <RTLThemeProvider>
          <StyledDrawer open={true} onClose={vi.fn()}>
            <div data-testid="dark-drawer-child">Dark Theme Liquid Glass</div>
          </StyledDrawer>
        </RTLThemeProvider>
      </LanguageProvider>
    );
    expect(baseElement).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByTestId('dark-drawer-child')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should call onClose when close button is clicked', () => {
    const handleClose = vi.fn();
    render(
      <LanguageProvider>
        <RTLThemeProvider>
          <StyledDrawer open={true} onClose={handleClose}>
            <div>Content</div>
          </StyledDrawer>
        </RTLThemeProvider>
      </LanguageProvider>
    );
    const closeBtn = screen.getByLabelText('close drawer');
    expect(closeBtn).toBeInTheDocument();
    fireEvent.click(closeBtn);
    expect(handleClose).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
  it('should support custom anchor and render CustomListItemText', () => {
    render(
      <LanguageProvider>
        <RTLThemeProvider>
          <StyledDrawer open={true} onClose={vi.fn()} anchor="left">
            <CustomListItemText primary="Navigation Item" />
          </StyledDrawer>
        </RTLThemeProvider>
      </LanguageProvider>
    );
    expect(screen.getByText('Navigation Item')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should render drawer in Farsi (RTL) mode with default anchor', () => {
    localStorage.setItem('kickzone-language', 'fa');
    const { baseElement } = render(
      <LanguageProvider>
        <RTLThemeProvider>
          <StyledDrawer open={true} onClose={vi.fn()}>
            <div>منوی فارسی</div>
          </StyledDrawer>
        </RTLThemeProvider>
      </LanguageProvider>
    );
    expect(baseElement).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('منوی فارسی')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
</file>

import { DRAWER_WIDTH, HEIGHTS } from '@kickzone-workspace/sizes';
import CloseIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Close';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Drawer from '@mui/material/Drawer';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import List from '@mui/material/List';
import ListItemText from '@mui/material/ListItemText';
import Divider from '@mui/material/Divider';
import { styled } from '@mui/material/styles';
import { ReactNode } from 'react';
const BaseStyledDrawer = styled(Drawer)(({ theme }) => {
  const isDark = theme.palette.mode === 'dark';
  return {
    width: DRAWER_WIDTH,
    flexShrink: 0,
    '& .MuiDrawer-paper': {
      width: DRAWER_WIDTH,
      boxSizing: 'border-box',
      marginTop: HEIGHTS.header,
      height: HEIGHTS.drawer,
      borderTopLeftRadius: '0 !important',
      borderBottomLeftRadius: '0 !important',
      borderTopRightRadius: '18px !important',
      borderBottomRightRadius: '18px !important',
      // Liquid glass — GPU-isolated layer (avoids hover thrash with backdrop-filter)
      isolation: 'isolate',
      transform: 'translateZ(0)',
      backfaceVisibility: 'hidden',
      contain: 'paint',
      backgroundColor: isDark
        ? 'rgba(14, 14, 16, 0.52) !important'
        : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42) !important',
      backgroundImage: isDark
        ? [
            'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10) 0%, transparent 28%)',
            'linear-gradient(155deg, rgba(201, 167, 116, 0.08) 0%, transparent 42%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22) 100%)',
          ].join(', ') + ' !important'
        : [
            'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72) 0%, transparent 32%)',
            'linear-gradient(155deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) 0%, rgba(246, 245, 242, 0.18) 45%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) 100%)',
          ].join(', ') + ' !important',
      backdropFilter: 'blur(24px) saturate(180%) !important',
      WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(24px) saturate(180%) !important',
      borderRight: isDark
        ? '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important'
        : '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72) !important',
      borderLeft: 'none !important',
      boxShadow: isDark
        ? [
            '0 28px 64px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55)',
            'inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14)',
            'inset 0 -1px 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
            'inset -1px 0 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)',
          ].join(', ') + ' !important'
        : [
            '0 24px 56px rgba(29, 29, 31, 0.08)',
            'inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)',
            'inset 0 -1px 0 0 rgba(143, 132, 104, 0.06)',
            'inset -1px 0 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55)',
          ].join(', ') + ' !important',
    },
  };
});
export const CustomListItemText = styled(ListItemText)(({ theme }) => ({
  color: theme.palette.text.primary,
  '& .MuiListItemText-primary': {
    fontWeight: 600,
    fontSize: '0.9375rem',
    letterSpacing: '0.01em',
  },
}));
export interface StyledDrawerProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  children: ReactNode;
  variant?: 'temporary' | 'persistent' | 'permanent';
  keepMounted?: boolean;
  anchor?: 'left' | 'right' | 'top' | 'bottom';
}
export function StyledDrawer({
  open,
  onClose,
  children,
  variant = 'temporary',
  keepMounted = false,
  anchor = 'left',
}: StyledDrawerProps) {
  return (
    <BaseStyledDrawer
      anchor={anchor}
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      variant={variant}
      ModalProps={{ keepMounted }}
    >
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'flex-end',
          px: 1,
          pt: 1,
          pb: 0.5,
        }}
      >
        <IconButton
          onClick={onClose}
          sx={{
            color: 'text.secondary',
            transition: 'background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease',
            '&:hover': {
              backgroundColor: (t) =>
                t.palette.mode === 'dark'
                  ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)'
                  : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)',
              color: 'text.primary',
            },
          }}
          aria-label="close drawer"
        >
          <CloseIcon fontSize="small" />
        </IconButton>
      </Box>
      <Divider sx={{ opacity: 0.7 }} />
      <List
        sx={{
          px: 0.5,
          py: 1,
          // Keep item hover cheap: no backdrop-filter on children
          '& .MuiListItemButton-root': {
            transition:
              'background-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease !important',
            backdropFilter: 'none !important',
            WebkitBackdropFilter: 'none !important',
          },
        }}
      >
        {children}
      </List>
    </BaseStyledDrawer>
  );
}
export default StyledDrawer;

import React from 'react';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Container from '@mui/material/Container';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import { Link as RouterLink, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { LottieUnauthorized } from '@kickzone-workspace/lottie-unauthorized';
import styles from './unauthorized-path.module.css';
interface UnauthorizedPathProps {
  appName: string;
  loginPath: string;
  showAnimation?: boolean;
  animationWidth?: number;
  animationHeight?: number;
}
export function UnauthorizedPath({
  appName,
  loginPath,
  showAnimation = true,
  animationWidth = 300,
  animationHeight = 300,
}: UnauthorizedPathProps) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const handleGoBack = () => {
    navigate(-1);
  };
  return (
    <Container component="main" maxWidth="sm">
      <Box
        sx={{
          marginTop: 8,
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          alignItems: 'center',
        }}
      >
        <Paper
          elevation={3}
          sx={{
            padding: 4,
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            alignItems: 'center',
            borderRadius: 2,
            width: '100%',
          }}
        >
          {showAnimation && (
            <Box sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
              <LottieUnauthorized
                width={animationWidth}
                height={animationHeight}
              />
            </Box>
          )}
          <Typography
            component="h1"
            variant="h4"
            sx={{
              mb: 2,
              textAlign: 'center',
              color: 'error.main',
              fontWeight: 'bold',
            }}
          >
            Access Denied
          </Typography>
          <Typography
            variant="h6"
            sx={{
              mb: 3,
              textAlign: 'center',
              color: 'text.secondary',
            }}
          >
            You don't have permission to access this page in {appName}.
          </Typography>
          <Typography
            variant="body1"
            sx={{
              mb: 4,
              textAlign: 'center',
              color: 'text.secondary',
            }}
          >
            Please contact your administrator if you believe this is an error.
          </Typography>
          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'flex',
              gap: 2,
              flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
              width: '100%',
            }}
          >
            <Button
              variant="contained"
              color="primary"
              component={RouterLink}
              to={loginPath}
              sx={{ flex: 1 }}
            >
              Go to Login
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outlined" onClick={handleGoBack} sx={{ flex: 1 }}>
              Go Back
            </Button>
          </Box>
        </Paper>
      </Box>
    </Container>
  );
}
export default UnauthorizedPath;

<file path="libs/client/shared/graphql/src/lib/variant-colors.ts">
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
type ColorLike = Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Color, 'name' | 'hexCode'> & {
  id?: number;
};
export function formatVariantColorNames(
  colors?: ColorLike[] | null,
  fallback = ''
): string {
  if (!colors?.length) {
    return fallback;
  }
  return colors.map((c) => c.name || c.hexCode).join(' / ');
}
export function serializeVariantColorHexes(
  colors?: ColorLike[] | null
): string | null {
  if (!colors?.length) {
    return null;
  }
  return colors.map((c) => c.hexCode).join(',');
}
export function parseColorHexes(color?: string | null): string[] {
  if (!color) {
    return [];
  }
  return color
    .split(',')
    .map((part) => part.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);
}
</file>

<file path="libs/client/shared/hooks/brands/src/lib/useBrands.ts">
import { useQuery, useMutation } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import { CreateBrandInput } from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
import {
  BRANDS_QUERY,
  CREATE_BRAND,
  UPDATE_BRAND,
  DELETE_BRAND,
  BULK_TRANSLATE_BRANDS,
  SET_BRAND_TRANSLATION,
} from './brands.graphql';
export function useBrandsQuery() {
  const {
    data,
    loading: getBrandsLoading,
    error: getBrandsError,
    refetch: refetchBrands,
  } = useQuery<Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'brands'>>(BRANDS_QUERY);
  return {
    brands: data?.brands || [],
    getBrandsLoading,
    getBrandsError,
    refetchBrands,
  };
}
export const useBrands = () => {
  const [createBrandMutation, { loading: isCreatingBrand }] = useMutation(
    CREATE_BRAND,
    {
      refetchQueries: [{ query: BRANDS_QUERY }],
    }
  );
  const [updateBrandMutation, { loading: isUpdatingBrand }] = useMutation(
    UPDATE_BRAND,
    {
      refetchQueries: [{ query: BRANDS_QUERY }],
    }
  );
  const [deleteBrandMutation, { loading: isDeletingBrand }] = useMutation(
    DELETE_BRAND,
    {
      refetchQueries: [{ query: BRANDS_QUERY }],
    }
  );
  const [bulkTranslateMutation, { loading: isBulkTranslating }] = useMutation(
    BULK_TRANSLATE_BRANDS
  );
  const [setTranslationMutation, { loading: isSettingTranslation }] =
    useMutation(SET_BRAND_TRANSLATION);
  const createBrand = (slug: string, sortOrder = 0, name?: string) =>
    createBrandMutation({
      variables: {
        input: { slug, sortOrder },
        ...(name && { name }),
      } as { input: CreateBrandInput; name?: string },
    });
  const updateBrand = (
    id: number,
    slug: string,
    sortOrder?: number,
    isActive?: boolean,
    name?: string
  ) =>
    updateBrandMutation({
      variables: {
        input: { id, slug, sortOrder, isActive },
        ...(name?.trim() ? { name: name.trim() } : {}),
      },
    });
  const deleteBrand = (id: number) =>
    deleteBrandMutation({
      variables: { id },
      optimisticResponse: {
        deleteBrand: true,
      },
    });
  const bulkTranslateBrands = (
    entityIds: number[],
    sourceLocale: string,
    targetLocales: string[]
  ) =>
    bulkTranslateMutation({
      variables: {
        input: {
          entityType: 'brand',
          entityIds,
          sourceLocale,
          targetLocales,
        },
      },
    });
  const setBrandTranslation = (
    entityId: number,
    locale: string,
    fieldName: string,
    value: string,
    isAutoTranslated = false
  ) =>
    setTranslationMutation({
      variables: {
        input: {
          entityType: 'brand',
          entityId,
          locale,
          fieldName,
          value,
          isAutoTranslated,
        },
      },
    });
  return {
    createBrand,
    updateBrand,
    deleteBrand,
    bulkTranslateBrands,
    setBrandTranslation,
    isCreatingBrand,
    isUpdatingBrand,
    isDeletingBrand,
    isBulkTranslating,
    isSettingTranslation,
  };
};
</file>

<file path="libs/client/shared/hooks/colors/src/lib/useColors.ts">
import { useQuery, useMutation } from '@apollo/client/react';
import {
  GET_COLORS,
  CREATE_COLOR,
  UPDATE_COLOR,
  DELETE_COLOR,
  BULK_TRANSLATE_COLORS,
  SET_COLOR_TRANSLATION,
} from './color.graphql';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
export function useColors() {
  const { data, loading, error, refetch } = useQuery<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'colors'>
  >(GET_COLORS);
  const [createColorMutation, { loading: createLoading, error: createError }] =
    useMutation<
      Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'createColor'>,
      KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationCreateColorArgs
    >(CREATE_COLOR, {
      refetchQueries: [{ query: GET_COLORS }],
    });
  const [updateColorMutation, { loading: updateLoading, error: updateError }] =
    useMutation<
      Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'updateColor'>,
      KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationUpdateColorArgs
    >(UPDATE_COLOR, {
      refetchQueries: [{ query: GET_COLORS }],
    });
  const [deleteColorMutation, { loading: deleteLoading, error: deleteError }] =
    useMutation<
      Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'deleteColor'>,
      KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationDeleteColorArgs
    >(DELETE_COLOR, {
      refetchQueries: [{ query: GET_COLORS }],
    });
  const [bulkTranslateMutation, { loading: isBulkTranslating }] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'bulkTranslateEntities'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationBulkTranslateEntitiesArgs
  >(BULK_TRANSLATE_COLORS);
  const [setTranslationMutation, { loading: isSettingTranslation }] =
    useMutation<
      Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'setTranslation'>,
      KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationSetTranslationArgs
    >(SET_COLOR_TRANSLATION);
  const createColor = async (
    name: string,
    hexCode: string,
    sortOrder = 0
  ) => {
    const response = await createColorMutation({
      variables: { input: { hexCode, sortOrder }, name },
    });
    return response.data?.createColor;
  };
  const updateColor = async (
    id: number,
    name: string,
    hexCode: string,
    sortOrder?: number,
    isActive?: boolean
  ) => {
    const response = await updateColorMutation({
      variables: {
        id,
        input: { hexCode, sortOrder, isActive },
        ...(name?.trim() ? { name: name.trim() } : {}),
      },
    });
    return response.data?.updateColor;
  };
  const deleteColor = async (id: number) => {
    const response = await deleteColorMutation({ variables: { id } });
    return response.data?.deleteColor;
  };
  const bulkTranslateColors = (
    entityIds: number[],
    sourceLocale: string,
    targetLocales: string[]
  ) =>
    bulkTranslateMutation({
      variables: {
        input: {
          entityType: 'color',
          entityIds,
          sourceLocale,
          targetLocales,
        },
      },
    });
  const setColorTranslation = (
    entityId: number,
    locale: string,
    fieldName: string,
    value: string,
    isAutoTranslated = false
  ) =>
    setTranslationMutation({
      variables: {
        input: {
          entityType: 'color',
          entityId,
          locale,
          fieldName,
          value,
          isAutoTranslated,
        },
      },
    });
  return {
    colors: data?.colors || [],
    loading: loading || createLoading || updateLoading || deleteLoading,
    error: error || createError || updateError || deleteError,
    refetchColors: refetch,
    createColor,
    updateColor,
    deleteColor,
    bulkTranslateColors,
    setColorTranslation,
    isBulkTranslating,
    isSettingTranslation,
  };
}
</file>

<file path="libs/client/shared/hooks/currency/src/lib/useConvertPrice.tsx">
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useExchangeRate } from './useExchangeRate';
interface UseConvertPriceOptions {
  amount: number;
  fromCurrency?: string;
  toCurrency?: string;
}
/**
 * Hook to convert a price from one currency to another
 * @param amount - The amount to convert
 * @param fromCurrency - Source currency code (default: 'USD')
 * @param toCurrency - Target currency code (default: 'USD')
 */
export function useConvertPrice({
  amount,
  fromCurrency = 'USD',
  toCurrency = 'USD',
}: UseConvertPriceOptions) {
  const { rate, loading, error, exchangeRate } = useExchangeRate({
    fromCurrencyCode: fromCurrency,
    toCurrencyCode: toCurrency,
    skip: fromCurrency === toCurrency,
  });
  const convertedAmount = useMemo(() => {
    if (fromCurrency === toCurrency) return amount;
    return amount * rate;
  }, [amount, rate, fromCurrency, toCurrency]);
  const formattedAmount = useMemo(() => {
    const decimalPlaces = exchangeRate?.toCurrency?.decimalPlaces ?? 2;
    return Number(convertedAmount.toFixed(decimalPlaces));
  }, [convertedAmount, exchangeRate]);
  return {
    originalAmount: amount,
    convertedAmount: formattedAmount,
    rate,
    fromCurrency,
    toCurrency,
    symbol: exchangeRate?.toCurrency?.symbol,
    loading,
    error,
  };
}
</file>

<file path="libs/client/shared/hooks/currency/src/lib/useCurrencyForLocale.tsx">
import { useQuery } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { GET_CURRENCY_PREFERENCE_BY_LOCALE } from '@kickzone-workspace/client-shared-graphql';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import { useLanguageContext } from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
/**
 * Hook to get the preferred currency for the current user's locale
 * Falls back to USD if no preference is set
 */
export function useCurrencyForLocale() {
  const { currentLocale } = useLanguageContext();
  const { data, loading, error } = useQuery<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'currencyPreferenceByLocale'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.QueryCurrencyPreferenceByLocaleArgs
  >(GET_CURRENCY_PREFERENCE_BY_LOCALE, {
    variables: { locale: currentLocale },
    fetchPolicy: 'network-only', // Disable cache for debugging
  });
  const currency = data?.currencyPreferenceByLocale?.currency;
  return {
    currency,
    currencyCode: currency?.code || 'USD',
    currencySymbol: currency?.symbol || '$',
    decimalPlaces: currency?.decimalPlaces ?? 2,
    locale: currentLocale,
    loading,
    error,
  };
}

<file path="libs/client/shared/hooks/currency/src/lib/useExchangeRate.tsx">
import { useQuery } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { GET_CURRENT_EXCHANGE_RATE } from '@kickzone-workspace/client-shared-graphql';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
interface UseExchangeRateOptions {
  fromCurrencyCode: string;
  toCurrencyCode: string;
  skip?: boolean;
}
export function useExchangeRate({
  fromCurrencyCode,
  toCurrencyCode,
  skip = false,
}: UseExchangeRateOptions) {
  const { data, loading, error, refetch } = useQuery<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'currentExchangeRate'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.QueryCurrentExchangeRateArgs
  >(GET_CURRENT_EXCHANGE_RATE, {
    variables: { fromCurrencyCode, toCurrencyCode },
    skip: skip || fromCurrencyCode === toCurrencyCode,
    fetchPolicy: 'network-only', // Disable cache for debugging
  });
  const rawRate = Number(data?.currentExchangeRate?.rate);
  const isValidRate = Number.isFinite(rawRate) && rawRate > 1;
  const validRate = isValidRate ? rawRate : 0;
  return {
    exchangeRate: data?.currentExchangeRate,
    rate: validRate,
    hasValidRate: isValidRate,
    loading,
    error,
    refetch,
  };
}

<file path="libs/client/shared/hooks/products/src/lib/productImage.spec.ts">
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  resolveProductImageUrl,
  getProductPrimaryImage,
} from './productImage';
describe('resolveProductImageUrl', () => {
  it('returns empty string for null, undefined, or empty values', () => {
    expect(resolveProductImageUrl(null)).toBe('');
    expect(resolveProductImageUrl(undefined)).toBe('');
    expect(resolveProductImageUrl('')).toBe('');
    expect(resolveProductImageUrl('   ')).toBe('');
  });
  it('preserves valid relative paths starting with slash', () => {
    expect(resolveProductImageUrl('/uploads/products/shoe.jpg')).toBe(
      '/uploads/products/shoe.jpg'
    );
  });
  it('adds leading slash to relative paths without leading slash', () => {
    expect(resolveProductImageUrl('uploads/products/shoe.jpg')).toBe(
      '/uploads/products/shoe.jpg'
    );
  });
  it('strips http://127.0.0.1:4000 to prevent mixed content and SSL protocol errors', () => {
    expect(
      resolveProductImageUrl(
        'http://127.0.0.1:4000/uploads/products/shoe.jpg'
      )
    ).toBe('/uploads/products/shoe.jpg');
  });
  it('strips http://localhost:4000 to prevent mixed content and SSL protocol errors', () => {
    expect(
      resolveProductImageUrl(
        'http://localhost:4000/uploads/products/shoe.jpg'
      )
    ).toBe('/uploads/products/shoe.jpg');
  });
  it('preserves external https URLs', () => {
    expect(resolveProductImageUrl('https://example.com/photo.png')).toBe(
      'https://example.com/photo.png'
    );
  });
  it('preserves protocol-relative URLs', () => {
    expect(resolveProductImageUrl('//cdn.example.com/photo.png')).toBe(
      '//cdn.example.com/photo.png'
    );
  });
});
describe('getProductPrimaryImage', () => {
  it('returns null if product is null or undefined', () => {
    expect(getProductPrimaryImage(null)).toBeNull();
    expect(getProductPrimaryImage(undefined)).toBeNull();
  });
  it('returns the first image from the first productInfo that has images', () => {
    const product = {
      productInfos: [
        { images: [] },
        { images: ['/uploads/products/variant2.jpg'] },
      ],
    };
    expect(getProductPrimaryImage(product)).toBe(
      '/uploads/products/variant2.jpg'
    );
  });
  it('falls back to sellerProducts if productInfos have no images', () => {
    const product = {
      productInfos: [{ images: [] }],
      sellerProducts: [
        {
          productInfo: {
            images: ['/uploads/products/seller-prod.jpg'],
          },
        },
      ],
    };
    expect(getProductPrimaryImage(product)).toBe(
      '/uploads/products/seller-prod.jpg'
    );
  });
  it('returns null when no images are present anywhere', () => {
    const product = {
      productInfos: [{ images: [] }],
      sellerProducts: [{ productInfo: { images: [] } }],
    };
    expect(getProductPrimaryImage(product)).toBeNull();
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/shared/hooks/products/src/lib/productImage.ts">
/**
 * Resolves a product image path/URL for safe display in the browser across all environments
 * (local Vite dev server with HTTPS, and production with Nginx reverse proxy).
 *
 * Handles:
 * - relative paths like `/uploads/products/xyz.jpg`
 * - relative paths missing leading slash like `uploads/products/xyz.jpg`
 * - localhost:4000 / 127.0.0.1:4000 URLs: strips the origin so requests route via the current origin
 *   over HTTPS (through Vite proxy in dev or Nginx in prod), avoiding mixed-content and SSL errors.
 * - absolute external URLs (https://, http://, //): preserved as-is.
 */
export function resolveProductImageUrl(img?: string | null): string {
  if (!img) return '';
  const trimmed = img.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return '';
  // Strip localhost / 127.0.0.1:4000 backend origin so requests route via same-origin proxy (HTTPS)
  const localhostMatch = trimmed.match(
    /^https?:\/\/(?:127\.0\.0\.1|localhost):4000(\/.*)$/i
  );
  if (localhostMatch) {
    return localhostMatch[1];
  }
  // Already a full external URL (http, https, //)
  if (
    trimmed.startsWith('http://') ||
    trimmed.startsWith('https://') ||
    trimmed.startsWith('//')
  ) {
    return trimmed;
  }
  // Absolute path from origin
  if (trimmed.startsWith('/')) {
    return trimmed;
  }
  // Relative path missing leading slash (e.g. "uploads/products/...")
  return `/${trimmed}`;
}
/**
 * Extracts the first available product image from productInfos or sellerProducts.
 */
export function getProductPrimaryImage(
  product?: {
    productInfos?: Array<{ images?: string[] | null }> | null;
    sellerProducts?: Array<{
      productInfo?: { images?: string[] | null } | null;
    }> | null;
  } | null
): string | null {
  if (!product) return null;
  return (
    product.productInfos?.find(
      (pi) => pi.images && pi.images.length > 0 && !!pi.images[0]
    )?.images?.[0] ||
    product.productInfos?.[0]?.images?.[0] ||
    product.sellerProducts?.find(
      (sp) =>
        sp.productInfo?.images &&
        sp.productInfo.images.length > 0 &&
        !!sp.productInfo.images[0]
    )?.productInfo?.images?.[0] ||
    null
  );
}
</file>

<file path="libs/client/shared/hooks/snackbar/src/lib/SnackbarContext.tsx">
import React, {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useState,
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useRef,
} from 'react';
import { AlertColor } from '@mui/material/Alert';
interface SnackbarState {
  open: boolean;
  message: string;
  severity: AlertColor;
  progress: number;
}
interface SnackbarContextType {
  showSnackbar: (
    message: string,
    options?: { severity?: AlertColor; duration?: number }
  ) => void;
  handleClose: () => void;
  state: SnackbarState;
}
const SnackbarContext = createContext<SnackbarContextType | undefined>(
  undefined
);
const DEFAULT_DURATION = 10000; // 10 seconds
export const useSnackbarContext = () => {
  const context = useContext(SnackbarContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error(
      'useSnackbarContext must be used within a SnackbarProvider'
    );
  }
  return context;
};
export const SnackbarProvider = ({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) => {
  const [state, setState] = useState<SnackbarState>({
    open: false,
    message: '',
    severity: 'info',
    progress: 100,
  });
  const progressTimerRef = useRef<number>(null);
  const closeTimerRef = useRef<number>(null);
  const clearTimers = useCallback(() => {
    if (progressTimerRef.current) {
      window.clearInterval(progressTimerRef.current);
    }
    if (closeTimerRef.current) {
      window.clearTimeout(closeTimerRef.current);
    }
  }, []);
  const handleClose = useCallback(() => {
    setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, open: false }));
    clearTimers();
  }, [clearTimers]);
  const showSnackbar = useCallback(
    (
      message: string,
      options?: { severity?: AlertColor; duration?: number }
    ) => {
      const duration = options?.duration ?? DEFAULT_DURATION;
      const severity = options?.severity ?? 'info';
      clearTimers();
      setState({
        open: true,
        message,
        severity,
        progress: 100,
      });
      // Set up progress timer
      const startTime = Date.now();
      const updateInterval = 10; // Update every 10ms for smooth progress
      progressTimerRef.current = window.setInterval(() => {
        const elapsedTime = Date.now() - startTime;
        const progress = 100 - (elapsedTime / duration) * 100;
        if (progress <= 0) {
          clearTimers();
          handleClose();
        } else {
          setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, progress }));
        }
      }, updateInterval);
      // Set up close timer as backup
      closeTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(handleClose, duration);
    },
    [clearTimers, handleClose]
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      clearTimers();
    };
  }, [clearTimers]);
  return (
    <SnackbarContext.Provider value={{ showSnackbar, handleClose, state }}>
      {children}
    </SnackbarContext.Provider>
  );
};
</file>

<file path="libs/client/shared/hooks/snackbar/src/lib/useSnackbar.ts">
import { useSnackbarContext } from './SnackbarContext';
export const useSnackbar = () => {
  const { showSnackbar, handleClose, state } = useSnackbarContext();
  return {
    showSnackbar,
    handleClose,
    open: state.open,
    message: state.message,
    severity: state.severity,
    progress: state.progress,
  };
};
