<file path="libs/client/shared/hooks/translations-management-hook/src/lib/useTranslationsManagement.ts">
import { useMutation, useQuery } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { gql } from '@apollo/client';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
const SET_TRANSLATION = gql`
  mutation SetTranslation($input: TranslationInput!) {
    setTranslation(input: $input) {
      id
      entityType
      entityId
      locale
      fieldName
      value
      isAutoTranslated
      translatedBy
      createdAt
      updatedAt
    }
  }
`;
const BULK_TRANSLATE_ENTITIES = gql`
  mutation BulkTranslateEntities($input: BulkTranslationInput!) {
    bulkTranslateEntities(input: $input)
  }
`;
const GET_CATEGORIES = gql`
  query GetCategories {
    categories {
      id
      slug
      sortOrder
      isActive
      name
    }
  }
`;
const GET_COLORS = gql`
  query GetColors {
    colors {
      id
      hexCode
      sortOrder
      isActive
      name
    }
  }
`;
const GET_ENTITY_TRANSLATIONS = gql`
  query GetEntityTranslations($entityType: String!, $entityId: Int!) {
    getEntityTranslations(entityType: $entityType, entityId: $entityId) {
      id
      locale
      fieldName
      value
      isAutoTranslated
    }
  }
`;
export const useTranslationsManagement = () => {
  const [setTranslationMutation, { loading: isSettingTranslation, client }] =
    useMutation<
      Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'setTranslation'>,
      KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationSetTranslationArgs
    >(SET_TRANSLATION, {
      refetchQueries: [{ query: GET_CATEGORIES }, { query: GET_COLORS }],
      awaitRefetchQueries: true,
      onCompleted: () => {
        // Clear the Apollo cache for categories and colors to force refetch with new translations
        client?.refetchQueries({
          include: ['GetCategories', 'GetColors'],
        });
      },
    });
  const [
    bulkTranslateMutation,
    { loading: isBulkTranslating, client: bulkClient },
  ] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'bulkTranslateEntities'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationBulkTranslateEntitiesArgs
  >(BULK_TRANSLATE_ENTITIES, {
    refetchQueries: [{ query: GET_CATEGORIES }, { query: GET_COLORS }],
    awaitRefetchQueries: true,
    onCompleted: () => {
      // Clear the Apollo cache to force refetch with new translations
      bulkClient?.refetchQueries({
        include: ['GetCategories', 'GetColors'],
      });
    },
  });
  const setTranslation = (
    entityType: string,
    entityId: number,
    locale: string,
    fieldName: string,
    value: string,
    isAutoTranslated = false
  ) => {
    console.log('🔵 [CLIENT] Setting translation:', {
      entityType,
      entityId,
      locale,
      fieldName,
      value,
      isAutoTranslated,
    });
    return setTranslationMutation({
      variables: {
        input: {
          entityType,
          entityId,
          locale,
          fieldName,
          value,
          isAutoTranslated,
        },
      },
    })
      .then((result) => {
        console.log('✅ [CLIENT] Translation saved successfully:', result);
        return result;
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        console.error('❌ [CLIENT] Failed to save translation:', error);
        throw error;
      });
  };
  const bulkTranslate = (
    entityType: string,
    entityIds: number[],
    sourceLocale: string,
    targetLocales: string[]
  ) => {
    console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════');
    console.log('🌍 [CLIENT] BULK TRANSLATION REQUEST');
    console.log('📦 Entity Type:', entityType);
    console.log('🆔 Entity IDs:', entityIds);
    console.log('🔤 Source Locale:', sourceLocale);
    console.log('🎯 Target Locales:', targetLocales);
    console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════');
    return bulkTranslateMutation({
      variables: {
        input: {
          entityType,
          entityIds,
          sourceLocale,
          targetLocales,
        },
      },
    })
      .then((result) => {
        console.log('✅ [CLIENT] Bulk translation completed successfully!');
        console.log('📊 Result:', result);
        console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════');
        return result;
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        console.error('❌ [CLIENT] Bulk translation FAILED!');
        console.error('Error details:', error);
        console.error('═══════════════════════════════════════════════');
        throw error;
      });
  };
  return {
    setTranslation,
    bulkTranslate,
    isSettingTranslation,
    isBulkTranslating,
  };
};
export const useEntityTranslations = (entityType: string, entityId: number) => {
  const { data, loading, refetch } = useQuery<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'getEntityTranslations'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.QueryGetEntityTranslationsArgs
  >(GET_ENTITY_TRANSLATIONS, {
    variables: { entityType, entityId },
    skip: !entityId,
    fetchPolicy: 'network-only', // Always fetch fresh data from the server
  });
  const translations = new Map<string, string>();
  data?.getEntityTranslations?.forEach((t) => {
    if (t.fieldName === 'name') {
      translations.set(t.locale, t.value);
    }
  });
  return { translations, loading, refetch };
};
</file>

<file path="libs/client/shared/lottie/empty-cart/src/lib/lottie-empty-cart.tsx">
import Lottie from 'lottie-react';
import emptyCartAnimation from './empty-cart.json';
interface LottieEmptyCartProps {
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  loop?: boolean;
  onComplete?: () => void;
}
export function LottieEmptyCart({
  width = 200,
  height = 200,
  loop = true,
  onComplete,
}: LottieEmptyCartProps) {
  return (
    <div
      style={{
        display: 'inline-flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
      }}
    >
      <Lottie
        animationData={emptyCartAnimation}
        loop={loop}
        autoplay
        style={{ width, height }}
        onComplete={() => {
          if (onComplete) {
            onComplete();
          }
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
export default LottieEmptyCart;
</file>

import React from 'react';
import { render } from '@testing-library/react';
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
import LottieLoading from './lottie-loading';
vi.mock('lottie-react', () => ({
  default: () => <div data-testid="lottie-mock" />,
}));
describe('LottieLoading', () => {
  it('should render successfully', () => {
    const { baseElement } = render(<LottieLoading />);
    expect(baseElement).toBeTruthy();
  });
  it('renders lottie element with custom sizes', () => {
    const { getByTestId } = render(<LottieLoading width={280} height={280} />);
    expect(getByTestId('lottie-loading')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/shared/lottie/loading/src/lib/lottie-loading.tsx">
import React from 'react';
import Lottie from 'lottie-react';
import loadingAnimation from './loading.json';
import styles from './lottie-loading.module.css';
export interface LottieLoadingProps {
  width?: number | string;
  height?: number | string;
  loop?: boolean;
  autoplay?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}
export function LottieLoading({
  width = 220,
  height = 220,
  loop = true,
  autoplay = true,
  className,
  style,
}: LottieLoadingProps) {
  return (
    <div
      className={`${styles.container} ${className || ''}`.trim()}
      style={style}
      data-testid="lottie-loading"
    >
      <Lottie
        animationData={loadingAnimation}
        loop={loop}
        autoplay={autoplay}
        style={{ width, height }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
export default LottieLoading;
</file>

<file path="libs/client/shared/lottie/success-check/src/lib/lottie-success-check.tsx">
import Lottie from 'lottie-react';
import successAnimation from './success.json';
import styles from './lottie-success-check.module.css';
interface LottieSuccessCheckProps {
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  onComplete?: () => void;
}
export function LottieSuccessCheck({
  width = 64,
  height = 64,
  onComplete,
}: LottieSuccessCheckProps) {
  return (
    <div className={styles['container']}>
      <Lottie
        animationData={successAnimation}
        loop={false}
        autoplay={true}
        style={{ width, height }}
        onComplete={() => {
          if (onComplete) {
            // Keep it visible for 2 seconds after animation completes
            setTimeout(() => {
              onComplete();
            }, 2000);
          }
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
export default LottieSuccessCheck;
</file>

export function LottieUnauthorized({
  width = 300,
  height = 300,
}: LottieUnauthorizedProps) {
  return (
    <div>
      <Lottie
        animationData={failedAnimation}
        loop={true}
        autoplay={true}
        style={{ width, height }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="libs/client/shared/translations/src/lib/mapApolloErrorToTranslationKey.ts">
// ApolloError type definition
interface ApolloError extends Error {
  graphQLErrors?: Array<{
    extensions?: { code?: string };
  }>;
}
export type ErrorTranslationKey =
  | 'unauthorized'
  | 'emailAlreadyExists'
  | 'userNotFound'
  | 'invalidToken'
  | 'wrongEmailOrPassword'
  | 'networkError'
  | 'serverError'
  | 'unknown';
export function mapApolloErrorToTranslationKey(
  error: ApolloError | Error
): ErrorTranslationKey {
  // Check error message for specific patterns first (more specific checks first)
  const message = error?.message?.toLowerCase() || '';
  if (message.includes('email already exists')) return 'emailAlreadyExists';
  if (message.includes('user not found')) return 'userNotFound';
  if (message.includes('invalid or expired token')) return 'invalidToken';
  if (message.includes('invalid') && message.includes('token'))
    return 'invalidToken';
  if (message.includes('wrong') || message.includes('credentials'))
    return 'wrongEmailOrPassword';
  if (message.includes('network') || message.includes('fetch'))
    return 'networkError';
  if (
    message.includes('internal server error') ||
    message.includes('500') ||
    message.includes('503')
  )
    return 'serverError';
  // Check for Apollo GraphQL errors
  if ('graphQLErrors' in error) {
    const code = error?.graphQLErrors?.[0]?.extensions?.code;
    // UNAUTHENTICATED from login attempts = wrong credentials
    if (code === 'UNAUTHENTICATED') return 'wrongEmailOrPassword';
  }
  // Generic unauthorized message check (for login errors without specific code)
  if (message.includes('unauthorized')) return 'wrongEmailOrPassword';
  return 'unknown';
}
/**
 * Get a user-friendly error message from an error object
 * Returns the translation key for auth errors, or the raw message for others
 */
export function getErrorMessage(error: ApolloError | Error): {
  translationKey?: ErrorTranslationKey;
  rawMessage?: string;
} {
  const translationKey = mapApolloErrorToTranslationKey(error);
  // If we have a known translation key, return it
  if (translationKey !== 'unknown') {
    return { translationKey };
  }
  // Otherwise return the raw error message (in English)
  return { rawMessage: error.message };
}
</file>

<file path="libs/client/shared/translations/src/lib/WrapTranslation.tsx">
import { LocalizedString } from 'typesafe-i18n';
interface WrapTranslationPropsType {
  message: LocalizedString;
  renderComponent: (messagePart: LocalizedString) => Element;
}
export function WrapTranslation({
  message,
  renderComponent,
}: WrapTranslationPropsType) {
  let prefix: LocalizedString, infix: LocalizedString;
  const [p, i, postfix] = message.split('<>') as LocalizedString[];
  prefix = p;
  infix = i;
  // render infix only if the message doesn't have any split characters
  if (!infix && !postfix) {
    infix = prefix;
    prefix = '' as LocalizedString;
  }
  return (
    <>
      {prefix}
      {renderComponent(infix)}
      {postfix}
    </>
  );
}

<file path="libs/client/shared/ui/language-components/src/lib/language-components.tsx">
import { colors } from '@kickzone-workspace/colors';
import {
  useI18nContext,
  useLanguageContext,
  usePageTitle,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
import { LottieSuccessCheck } from '@kickzone-workspace/lottie-success-check';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import CardContent from '@mui/material/CardContent';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import FormControl from '@mui/material/FormControl';
import InputLabel from '@mui/material/InputLabel';
import MenuItem from '@mui/material/MenuItem';
import Select from '@mui/material/Select';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { GlassmorphismContainer } from '@kickzone-workspace/glassmorphism-container';
interface LanguageComponentsProps {
  LayoutComponent: React.ComponentType<{ children: React.ReactNode }>;
}
export function LanguageComponents({
  LayoutComponent,
}: LanguageComponentsProps) {
  const { currentLocale, setLocale, availableLocales, isLoading } =
    useLanguageContext();
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  usePageTitle(() =>
    currentLocale === 'en'
      ? 'Language Settings — SAINTBALA'
      : 'تنظیمات زبان — SAINTBALA'
  );
  const [selectedLanguage, setSelectedLanguage] =
    React.useState<typeof currentLocale>(currentLocale);
  const [showSuccess, setShowSuccess] = React.useState(false);
  // Keep combobox synchronized with active locale/cookie state
  useEffect(() => {
    setSelectedLanguage(currentLocale);
  }, [currentLocale]);
  const handleLanguageChange = (event: {
    target: { value: typeof currentLocale };
  }) => {
    const newLocale = event.target.value;
    setSelectedLanguage(newLocale);
    try {
      if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
        document.cookie = `kickzone-language-preference=${newLocale}; path=/; max-age=31536000; SameSite=Lax`;
      }
      setLocale(newLocale);
      setShowSuccess(true);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to change language:', error);
    }
  };
  const handleAnimationComplete = () => {
    setShowSuccess(false);
  };
  const currentLanguageInfo = availableLocales.find(
    (lang) => lang.code === currentLocale
  );
  return (
    <LayoutComponent>
      <Box sx={{ minHeight: '100vh', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', p: 2 }}>
        <GlassmorphismContainer
          wrapperSx={{ p: 0, width: '100%', maxWidth: 520 }}
          containerSx={{ p: 4, borderRadius: 3 }}
        >
          <CardContent sx={{ p: 0 }}>
            <Typography
              variant="h4"
              component="h1"
              sx={(theme) => ({
                textAlign: 'center',
                marginBottom: 3,
                color: theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? '#f5f5f5' : colors.text,
                fontWeight: 600,
              })}
            >
              {LL.navigation.languageSettings()}
            </Typography>
            <Box
              sx={{
                height: 50,
                display: 'flex',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                alignItems: 'center',
                marginBottom: 3,
                position: 'relative',
              }}
            >
              {showSuccess && (
                <LottieSuccessCheck
                  width={50}
                  height={50}
                  onComplete={handleAnimationComplete}
                />
              )}
            </Box>
            <Box sx={{ marginBottom: 3 }}>
              <Typography
                variant="body1"
              sx={(theme) => ({
                marginBottom: 2,
                color: theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? '#f5f5f5' : colors.text,
                textAlign: 'center',
              })}
              >
                {LL.form.currentLanguage()}:{' '}
                <strong>{currentLanguageInfo?.nativeName}</strong>
              </Typography>
            </Box>
            <FormControl fullWidth sx={{ marginBottom: 3 }}>
            <InputLabel
              id="language-select-label"
              sx={(theme) => ({
                color: theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? '#f5f5f5' : undefined,
              })}
            >
                {LL.form.selectLanguage()}
              </InputLabel>
              <Select
                labelId="language-select-label"
                value={selectedLanguage}
                label={LL.form.selectLanguage()}
                onChange={handleLanguageChange}
                disabled={isLoading}
              sx={(theme) => ({
                color: theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? '#f7f7f7' : undefined,
              })}
              >
                {availableLocales.map((locale) => (
                <MenuItem
                  key={locale.code}
                  value={locale.code}
                  sx={(theme) => ({
                    color:
                      theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
                        ? '#f7f7f7'
                        : theme.palette.text.primary,
                  })}
                >
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                    <Typography
                      variant="body1"
                      sx={(theme) => ({
                        color:
                          theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
                            ? '#ffffff'
                            : theme.palette.text.primary,
                      })}
                    >
                        {locale.nativeName}
                      </Typography>
                    <Typography
                      variant="body2"
                      sx={(theme) => ({
                        color:
                          theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
                            ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)'
                            : theme.palette.text.secondary,
                      })}
                    >
                        ({locale.name})
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                  </MenuItem>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </FormControl>
            {isLoading && (
              <Box
                sx={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 2,
                  marginTop: 2,
                }}
              >
                <CircularProgress size={20} />
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  {LL.status.changingLanguage()}
                </Typography>
              </Box>
            )}
            <Typography
              variant="body2"
              sx={(theme) => ({
                textAlign: 'center',
                color: theme.palette.mode === 'dark' ? '#f5f5f5' : colors.text,
                marginTop: 3,
                fontStyle: 'italic',
              })}
            >
              {LL.messages.languagePreferenceSaved()}
            </Typography>
          </CardContent>
        </GlassmorphismContainer>
      </Box>
    </LayoutComponent>
  );
}
export default LanguageComponents;
</file>

<file path="libs/client/shared/ui/language-components/src/lib/ltr-text-field.tsx">
import type { SxProps, Theme } from '@mui/material/styles';
import type { TextFieldProps } from '@mui/material/TextField';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import DialogContent, {
  type DialogContentProps,
} from '@mui/material/DialogContent';
/** Keep Latin values (email, username, phone, numbers) LTR in RTL locales. */
export const ltrInputSx: SxProps<Theme> = {
  '& .MuiInputBase-input': {
    direction: 'ltr',
    textAlign: 'left',
    unicodeBidi: 'isolate',
  },
};
type Sx = SxProps<Theme> | undefined;
function mergeSx(...parts: Sx[]): SxProps<Theme> {
  const flat = parts.flatMap((part) => {
    if (!part) return [];
    return Array.isArray(part) ? part : [part];
  });
  return flat as SxProps<Theme>;
}
/**
 * Spread onto TextField for values that must stay LTR regardless of UI language.
 */
export function getLtrTextFieldProps(
  extraSx?: SxProps<Theme>
): Pick<TextFieldProps, 'sx' | 'slotProps'> {
  return {
    slotProps: {
      htmlInput: { dir: 'ltr' },
    },
    sx: mergeSx(ltrInputSx, extraSx),
  };
}
/**
 * Dialog body for forms with outlined TextFields.
 * Uses dividers + inner padding so the first field label is not clipped
 * under DialogTitle (MUI sets DialogContent padding-top to 0 after a title).
 */
export function DialogFormContent({
  children,
  sx,
  ...props
}: DialogContentProps) {
  return (
    <DialogContent
      dividers
      {...props}
      sx={mergeSx({ overflowY: 'auto' }, sx)}
    >
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          gap: 2,
          pt: 1,
        }}
      >
        {children}
      </Box>
    </DialogContent>
  );
}

<file path="libs/client/shared/zustand/shared-auth-store/src/lib/shared-auth-store.ts">
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { persist } from 'zustand/middleware';
// Define user interface
export interface User {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  name: string;
  role: 'CUSTOMER' | 'SELLER' | 'ADMIN';
  avatar?: string;
  isEmailVerified: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}
// Define auth state interface
export interface AuthState {
  user: User | null;
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  token: string | null;
  refreshToken: string | null;
}
// Define auth actions interface
export interface AuthActions {
  // Authentication actions
  login: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<void>;
  logout: () => void;
  register: (userData: RegisterData) => Promise<void>;
  refreshAuthToken: () => Promise<void>;
  // User management actions
  updateUser: (userData: Partial<User>) => void;
  setUser: (user: User) => void;
  clearUser: () => void;
  // State management actions
  setLoading: (loading: boolean) => void;
  setError: (error: string | null) => void;
  clearError: () => void;
  // Token management
  setTokens: (token: string, refreshToken: string) => void;
  clearTokens: () => void;
}
// Define register data interface
export interface RegisterData {
  email: string;
  password: string;
  name: string;
  role: 'CUSTOMER' | 'SELLER';
}
// Define the complete store type
export type AuthStore = AuthState & AuthActions;
// Create the auth store with persistence
export const useAuthStore = create<AuthStore>()(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      // Initial state
      user: null,
      isAuthenticated: false,
      isLoading: false,
      error: null,
      token: null,
      refreshToken: null,
      // Authentication actions
      login: async (email: string, password: string) => {
        set({ isLoading: true, error: null });
        try {
          // TODO: Replace with actual API call
          const response = await fetch('/api/auth/login', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ email, password }),
          });
          if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error('Login failed');
          }
          const data = await response.json();
          set({
            user: data.user,
            isAuthenticated: true,
            token: data.token,
            refreshToken: data.refreshToken,
            isLoading: false,
            error: null,
          });
        } catch (error) {
          set({
            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Login failed',
            isLoading: false,
          });
        }
      },
      logout: () => {
        set({
          user: null,
          isAuthenticated: false,
          token: null,
          refreshToken: null,
          error: null,
        });
      },
      register: async (userData: RegisterData) => {
        set({ isLoading: true, error: null });
        try {
          // TODO: Replace with actual API call
          const response = await fetch('/api/auth/register', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            },
            body: JSON.stringify(userData),
          });
          if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error('Registration failed');
          }
          const data = await response.json();
          set({
            user: data.user,
            isAuthenticated: true,
            token: data.token,
            refreshToken: data.refreshToken,
            isLoading: false,
            error: null,
          });
        } catch (error) {
          set({
            error:
              error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Registration failed',
            isLoading: false,
          });
        }
      },
      refreshAuthToken: async () => {
        const { refreshToken } = get();
        if (!refreshToken) {
          set({ error: 'No refresh token available' });
          return;
        }
        try {
          // TODO: Replace with actual API call
          const response = await fetch('/api/auth/refresh', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ refreshToken }),
          });
          if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error('Token refresh failed');
          }
          const data = await response.json();
          set({
            token: data.token,
            refreshToken: data.refreshToken,
            error: null,
          });
        } catch (error) {
          set({
            error:
              error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Token refresh failed',
            user: null,
            isAuthenticated: false,
            token: null,
            refreshToken: null,
          });
        }
      },
      // User management actions
      updateUser: (userData: Partial<User>) => {
        set((state) => ({
          user: state.user ? { ...state.user, ...userData } : null,
        }));
      },
      setUser: (user: User) => {
        set({
          user,
          isAuthenticated: true,
        });
      },
      clearUser: () => {
        set({
          user: null,
          isAuthenticated: false,
        });
      },
      // State management actions
      setLoading: (loading: boolean) => {
        set({ isLoading: loading });
      },
      setError: (error: string | null) => {
        set({ error });
      },
      clearError: () => {
        set({ error: null });
      },
      // Token management
      setTokens: (token: string, refreshToken: string) => {
        set({ token, refreshToken });
      },
      clearTokens: () => {
        set({ token: null, refreshToken: null });
      },
    }),
    {
      name: 'auth-storage',
      partialize: (state) => ({
        user: state.user,
        isAuthenticated: state.isAuthenticated,
        token: state.token,
        refreshToken: state.refreshToken,
      }),
    }
  )
);
// Selector hooks for better performance
export const useUser = () => useAuthStore((state) => state.user);
export const useIsAuthenticated = () =>
  useAuthStore((state) => state.isAuthenticated);
export const useAuthLoading = () => useAuthStore((state) => state.isLoading);
export const useAuthError = () => useAuthStore((state) => state.error);
export const useAuthActions = () => {
  const login = useAuthStore((state) => state.login);
  const logout = useAuthStore((state) => state.logout);
  const register = useAuthStore((state) => state.register);
  const refreshAuthToken = useAuthStore((state) => state.refreshAuthToken);
  const updateUser = useAuthStore((state) => state.updateUser);
  const setUser = useAuthStore((state) => state.setUser);
  const clearUser = useAuthStore((state) => state.clearUser);
  const setLoading = useAuthStore((state) => state.setLoading);
  const setError = useAuthStore((state) => state.setError);
  const clearError = useAuthStore((state) => state.clearError);
  const setTokens = useAuthStore((state) => state.setTokens);
  const clearTokens = useAuthStore((state) => state.clearTokens);
  return {
    login,
    logout,
    register,
    refreshAuthToken,
    updateUser,
    setUser,
    clearUser,
    setLoading,
    setError,
    clearError,
    setTokens,
    clearTokens,
  };
};

<file path="libs/client/shared/zustand/shared-ui-store/src/lib/shared-ui-store.ts">
import { create } from 'zustand';
// Define modal state interface
export interface ModalState {
  isOpen: boolean;
  title?: string;
  content?: React.ReactNode;
  size?: 'small' | 'medium' | 'large' | 'fullscreen';
  onClose?: () => void;
}
// Define loading state interface
export interface LoadingState {
  isLoading: boolean;
  message?: string;
}
// Define theme state interface
export interface ThemeState {
  mode: 'light' | 'dark';
  primaryColor: string;
  secondaryColor: string;
}
// Define UI state interface
export interface UIState {
  // Modal state
  modal: ModalState;
  // Loading state
  loading: LoadingState;
  // Theme state
  theme: ThemeState;
  // Sidebar state
  sidebarOpen: boolean;
  // Mobile menu state
  mobileMenuOpen: boolean;
  // Toast notifications
  toasts: ToastNotification[];
}
// Define toast notification interface
export interface ToastNotification {
  id: string;
  type: 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info';
  title: string;
  message?: string;
  duration?: number;
  action?: {
    label: string;
    onClick: () => void;
  };
}
// Define UI actions interface
export interface UIActions {
  // Modal actions
  openModal: (config: Omit<ModalState, 'isOpen'>) => void;
  closeModal: () => void;
  // Loading actions
  setLoading: (loading: boolean, message?: string) => void;
  // Theme actions
  setTheme: (theme: Partial<ThemeState>) => void;
  toggleTheme: () => void;
  // Sidebar actions
  toggleSidebar: () => void;
  setSidebarOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  // Mobile menu actions
  toggleMobileMenu: () => void;
  setMobileMenuOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  // Toast actions
  addToast: (toast: Omit<ToastNotification, 'id'>) => void;
  removeToast: (id: string) => void;
  clearToasts: () => void;
  // Reset actions
  resetUI: () => void;
}
// Define the complete store type
export type UIStore = UIState & UIActions;
const THEME_STORAGE_KEY = 'kickzone-theme-mode';
const detectSystemMode = (): 'light' | 'dark' => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.matchMedia) {
    return 'light';
  }
  return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches
    ? 'dark'
    : 'light';
};
const getInitialTheme = (): ThemeState => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return {
      mode: 'light',
      primaryColor: '#8f8468',
      secondaryColor: '#1a1a19',
    };
  }
  const stored = localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY) as
    | 'light'
    | 'dark'
    | null;
  const mode = stored || detectSystemMode();
  return {
    mode,
    primaryColor: '#8f8468',
    secondaryColor: '#1a1a19',
  };
};
// Default theme configuration (used for reset)
const defaultTheme: ThemeState = getInitialTheme();
// Create the UI store
export const useUIStore = create<UIStore>((set, get) => ({
  // Initial state
  modal: {
    isOpen: false,
  },
  loading: {
    isLoading: false,
  },
  theme: getInitialTheme(),
  sidebarOpen: false,
  mobileMenuOpen: false,
  toasts: [],
  // Modal actions
  openModal: (config) => {
    set({
      modal: {
        isOpen: true,
        ...config,
      },
    });
  },
  closeModal: () => {
    set((state) => ({
      modal: {
        ...state.modal,
        isOpen: false,
      },
    }));
  },
  // Loading actions
  setLoading: (isLoading, message) => {
    set({
      loading: {
        isLoading,
        message,
      },
    });
  },
  // Theme actions
  setTheme: (theme) => {
    set((state) => {
      const next = {
        ...state.theme,
        ...theme,
      };
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, next.mode);
      }
      return { theme: next };
    });
  },
  toggleTheme: () => {
    set((state) => {
      const mode = state.theme.mode === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light';
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, mode);
      }
      return {
        theme: {
          ...state.theme,
          mode,
        },
      };
    });
  },
  // Sidebar actions
  toggleSidebar: () => {
    set((state) => ({
      sidebarOpen: !state.sidebarOpen,
    }));
  },
  setSidebarOpen: (open) => {
    set({ sidebarOpen: open });
  },
  // Mobile menu actions
  toggleMobileMenu: () => {
    set((state) => ({
      mobileMenuOpen: !state.mobileMenuOpen,
    }));
  },
  setMobileMenuOpen: (open) => {
    set({ mobileMenuOpen: open });
  },
  // Toast actions
  addToast: (toast) => {
    const id = Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9);
    const newToast: ToastNotification = {
      id,
      duration: 5000,
      ...toast,
    };
    set((state) => ({
      toasts: [...state.toasts, newToast],
    }));
    // Auto-remove toast after duration
    if (newToast.duration && newToast.duration > 0) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        get().removeToast(id);
      }, newToast.duration);
    }
  },
  removeToast: (id) => {
    set((state) => ({
      toasts: state.toasts.filter((toast) => toast.id !== id),
    }));
  },
  clearToasts: () => {
    set({ toasts: [] });
  },
  // Reset actions
  resetUI: () => {
    set({
      modal: { isOpen: false },
      loading: { isLoading: false },
      theme: defaultTheme,
      sidebarOpen: false,
      mobileMenuOpen: false,
      toasts: [],
    });
  },
}));
// Selector hooks for better performance
export const useModal = () => useUIStore((state) => state.modal);
export const useLoading = () => useUIStore((state) => state.loading);
export const useTheme = () => useUIStore((state) => state.theme);
export const useSidebar = () => useUIStore((state) => state.sidebarOpen);
export const useMobileMenu = () => useUIStore((state) => state.mobileMenuOpen);
export const useToasts = () => useUIStore((state) => state.toasts);
export const useUIActions = () => {
  const openModal = useUIStore((state) => state.openModal);
  const closeModal = useUIStore((state) => state.closeModal);
  const setLoading = useUIStore((state) => state.setLoading);
  const setTheme = useUIStore((state) => state.setTheme);
  const toggleTheme = useUIStore((state) => state.toggleTheme);
  const toggleSidebar = useUIStore((state) => state.toggleSidebar);
  const setSidebarOpen = useUIStore((state) => state.setSidebarOpen);
  const toggleMobileMenu = useUIStore((state) => state.toggleMobileMenu);
  const setMobileMenuOpen = useUIStore((state) => state.setMobileMenuOpen);
  const addToast = useUIStore((state) => state.addToast);
  const removeToast = useUIStore((state) => state.removeToast);
  const clearToasts = useUIStore((state) => state.clearToasts);
  const resetUI = useUIStore((state) => state.resetUI);
  return {
    openModal,
    closeModal,
    setLoading,
    setTheme,
    toggleTheme,
    toggleSidebar,
    setSidebarOpen,
    toggleMobileMenu,
    setMobileMenuOpen,
    addToast,
    removeToast,
    clearToasts,
    resetUI,
  };
};
</file>

<file path="libs/server/decorators/src/lib/current-user.decorator.ts">
import { createParamDecorator, ExecutionContext } from '@nestjs/common';
import { GqlExecutionContext } from '@nestjs/graphql';
export const CurrentUser = createParamDecorator(
  (data: unknown, context: ExecutionContext) => {
    // Check if this is a GraphQL context
    const gqlContext = GqlExecutionContext.create(context);
    const gqlReq = gqlContext.getContext().req;
    // If GraphQL context has a request, use it
    if (gqlReq) {
      return gqlReq.user;
    }
    // Otherwise, fall back to HTTP context
    const httpReq = context.switchToHttp().getRequest();
    return httpReq.user;
  }
);
</file>

import { ObjectType, Field, ID, Int, Float, registerEnumType } from '@nestjs/graphql';
import {
  Entity,
  Column,
  PrimaryGeneratedColumn,
  CreateDateColumn,
  UpdateDateColumn,
} from 'typeorm';
export enum ShippingStrategy {
  FULL_SUM = 'full_sum', // Sum all seller fees (current behavior)
  TIERED_DISCOUNT = 'tiered_discount', // First seller full, others discounted
  TIERED_FIXED = 'tiered_fixed', // First seller full, others fixed fee
  HIGHEST_ONLY = 'highest_only', // Only charge highest fee
  AVERAGE = 'average', // Charge average of all fees
}
registerEnumType(ShippingStrategy, {
  name: 'ShippingStrategy',
});
@ObjectType()
@Entity('platform_settings')
export class PlatformSettings {
  @Field(() => ID)
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn()
  id: number;
  // Free shipping configuration
  @Field(() => Float, { nullable: true })
  @Column('decimal', { precision: 10, scale: 2, nullable: true })
  freeShippingThreshold?: number;
  @Field(() => Boolean, { defaultValue: false })
  @Column({ default: false })
  freeShippingEnabled: boolean;
  // Shipping strategy
  @Field(() => String)
  @Column({
    type: 'enum',
    enum: ShippingStrategy,
    default: ShippingStrategy.TIERED_DISCOUNT,
  })
  shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy;
  // Tiered shipping configuration
  @Field(() => Float, { nullable: true })
  @Column('decimal', { precision: 5, scale: 2, nullable: true })
  additionalSellerDiscount?: number; // 0.5 = 50% discount
  @Field(() => Float, { nullable: true })
  @Column('decimal', { precision: 10, scale: 2, nullable: true })
  additionalSellerFixedFee?: number; // Fixed fee per additional seller
  // Maximum shipping cap
  @Field(() => Float, { nullable: true })
  @Column('decimal', { precision: 10, scale: 2, nullable: true })
  maxShippingCap?: number;
  @Field(() => Boolean, { defaultValue: false })
  @Column({ default: false })
  maxShippingCapEnabled: boolean;
  @Field(() => Date)
  @CreateDateColumn()
  createdAt: Date;
  @Field(() => Date)
  @UpdateDateColumn()
  updatedAt: Date;
}

<file path="libs/server/entities/src/lib/product.entity.ts">
import { ConnectionType, EdgeType } from '@kickzone-workspace/utils';
import { Field, Int, ObjectType } from '@nestjs/graphql';
import {
  Column,
  Entity,
  JoinColumn,
  JoinTable,
  ManyToMany,
  ManyToOne,
  OneToMany,
  PrimaryGeneratedColumn,
  Relation,
} from 'typeorm';
import { Brand } from './brand.entity';
import { Category } from './category.entity';
import { ProductInfo } from './product-info.entity';
import { SellerProduct } from './seller-product.entity';
import { SellerInfo } from './seller-info.entity';
import { ProductDescription } from './product-description.entity';
@ObjectType()
@Entity()
export class Product {
  @Field(() => Int)
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn()
  id: number;
  @Field()
  @Column({ unique: true })
  name: string;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  @Column({ unique: true, nullable: true })
  sku?: string | null;
  @Field(() => [ProductInfo])
  @OneToMany(() => ProductInfo, (productInfo) => productInfo.product, {
    cascade: true,
  })
  productInfos: ProductInfo[];
  @Field(() => [Category])
  @ManyToMany(() => Category, (category) => category.products)
  @JoinTable()
  categories: Category[];
  @Field(() => Brand, { nullable: true })
  @ManyToOne(() => Brand, (brand) => brand.products, {
    nullable: true,
    onDelete: 'SET NULL',
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: 'brandId' })
  brand?: Brand | null;
  @Field(() => Int, { nullable: true })
  @Column({ type: 'int', nullable: true })
  brandId?: number | null;
  @Field(() => SellerInfo, { nullable: true })
  @ManyToOne(() => SellerInfo, { nullable: true, onDelete: 'SET NULL' })
  @JoinColumn({ name: 'sellerId' })
  seller?: SellerInfo | null;
  @Field(() => Int, { nullable: true })
  @Column({ type: 'int', nullable: true })
  sellerId?: number | null;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  @Column({ type: 'text', nullable: true })
  description?: string | null;
  @Field(() => [ProductDescription], { nullable: true })
  @OneToMany(
    () => ProductDescription,
    (productDescription) => productDescription.product,
    { cascade: true }
  )
  descriptions?: Relation<ProductDescription>[];
  @Field(() => [SellerProduct], { nullable: true })
  @OneToMany(() => SellerProduct, (sellerProduct) => sellerProduct.product)
  sellerProducts: Relation<SellerProduct>[];
  @Field({ defaultValue: false })
  @Column({
    type: 'boolean',
    default: false,
    nullable: false,
    comment: 'For partitioning',
  })
  archived: boolean;
}
@ObjectType()
export class ProductEdge extends EdgeType<Product> {
  @Field(() => Product)
  node: Product;
}
@ObjectType()
export class ProductConnection extends ConnectionType<Product> {
  @Field(() => [ProductEdge])
  edges: ProductEdge[];
}

// src/entities/seller-product.entity.ts
import {
  Entity,
  PrimaryGeneratedColumn,
  ManyToOne,
  Column,
  Relation,
  BeforeInsert,
  BeforeUpdate,
  Index,
} from 'typeorm';
import { SellerInfo } from './seller-info.entity';
import { Product } from './product.entity';
import { ProductInfo } from './product-info.entity';
import { ObjectType, Field, Int, Float } from '@nestjs/graphql';
@ObjectType()
@Entity()
@Index(['seller', 'productInfoId'], { unique: true })
export class SellerProduct {
  @Field(() => String)
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn('uuid')
  id: string;
  @Field(() => SellerInfo, { nullable: true })
  @ManyToOne(() => SellerInfo, (seller) => seller.sellerProducts)
  seller: SellerInfo;
  @Field(() => Product)
  @ManyToOne(() => Product, (product) => product.sellerProducts)
  product: Relation<Product>;
  @Field(() => ProductInfo)
  @ManyToOne(() => ProductInfo, { nullable: false })
  productInfo: ProductInfo;
  @Field(() => Int)
  @Column({ nullable: false })
  productInfoId: number;
  @Field(() => Float)
  @Column('decimal', { precision: 10, scale: 2 })
  price: number;
  @Field(() => Float, { nullable: true })
  @Column('decimal', { precision: 10, scale: 2 })
  costPrice: number;
  @Field(() => Float)
  @Column('decimal', { precision: 5, scale: 2, default: 0 })
  discount: number;
  @Field(() => Int)
  @Column()
  stockQuantity: number;
  @Field(() => Boolean, { defaultValue: false })
  @Column({ type: 'boolean', default: false })
  recommended: boolean;
  @Field(() => Boolean, { defaultValue: false })
  @Column({ type: 'boolean', default: false })
  boxLess: boolean;
  @BeforeInsert()
  @BeforeUpdate()
  setProductInfoId() {
    // If productInfo relation is set but productInfoId is not, set it from the relation
    if (this.productInfo && !this.productInfoId) {
      this.productInfoId = this.productInfo.id;
      console.log(
        '🔧 Setting productInfoId:',
        this.productInfoId,
        'from productInfo:',
        this.productInfo.id
      );
    }
    // If productInfoId is set but productInfo relation is not, this is handled in the service layer
  }
}

<file path="libs/server/entities/src/lib/user.entity.ts">
import { Entity, PrimaryGeneratedColumn, Column, Index } from 'typeorm';
import { ObjectType, Field, ID, registerEnumType, Int } from '@nestjs/graphql';
import { Connection, Edge, PageInfo } from '@kickzone-workspace/utils';
export enum UserRole {
  ADMIN = 'ADMIN',
  SELLER = 'SELLER',
  CUSTOMER = 'CUSTOMER',
}
registerEnumType(UserRole, {
  name: 'UserRole',
});
@ObjectType()
@Entity()
export class User {
  @Field(() => ID)
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn('uuid')
  id: string;
  @Field()
  @Column()
  @Index()
  name: string;
  @Field()
  @Column()
  @Index()
  lastName: string;
  @Field()
  @Column({ unique: true })
  @Index()
  username: string;
  @Field()
  @Column({ unique: true })
  @Index()
  email: string;
  @Column()
  password: string;
  @Field(() => UserRole)
  @Column({
    type: 'enum',
    enum: UserRole,
    default: UserRole.CUSTOMER,
  })
  role: UserRole;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  @Column({ nullable: true, default: 'en' })
  locale?: string;
}
@ObjectType()
export class UserEdge implements Edge<User> {
  @Field(() => User)
  node: User;
  @Field()
  cursor: string;
}
@ObjectType()
export class UserConnection implements Connection<User> {
  @Field(() => [UserEdge])
  edges: UserEdge[];
  @Field(() => PageInfo)
  pageInfo: PageInfo;
  @Field(() => Int)
  totalCount: number;
}
export type UserWithoutPassword = Omit<User, 'password'>;

<file path="libs/server/guards/src/lib/catalog.guard.spec.ts">
import { ExecutionContext, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { CatalogGuard } from './catalog.guard';
import { SellerInfo } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
jest.mock('@kickzone-workspace/entities', () => ({
  UserRole: {
    ADMIN: 'ADMIN',
    SELLER: 'SELLER',
    CUSTOMER: 'CUSTOMER',
  },
  SellerInfo: class SellerInfo {},
}));
jest.mock('@nestjs/graphql', () => ({
  GqlExecutionContext: {
    create: (context: ExecutionContext) => ({
      getContext: () =>
        (
          context as unknown as {
            _gql: { req: { user?: { id: number; role: string } } };
          }
        )._gql,
    }),
  },
}));
describe('CatalogGuard', () => {
  let guard: CatalogGuard;
  let sellerInfoRepo: jest.Mocked<Repository<SellerInfo>>;
  const makeContext = (user?: { id: number; role: string }): ExecutionContext =>
    ({
      getHandler: () => ({}),
      getClass: () => ({}),
      _gql: { req: { user } },
    } as unknown as ExecutionContext);
  beforeEach(() => {
    sellerInfoRepo = {
      findOne: jest.fn(),
    } as unknown as jest.Mocked<Repository<SellerInfo>>;
    guard = new CatalogGuard(sellerInfoRepo);
  });
  it('throws UnauthorizedException when user is not authenticated', async () => {
    await expect(guard.canActivate(makeContext())).rejects.toThrow(
      UnauthorizedException
    );
  });
  it('allows access for ADMIN users without querying seller info', async () => {
    const result = await guard.canActivate(
      makeContext({ id: 1, role: 'ADMIN' })
    );
    expect(result).toBe(true);
    expect(sellerInfoRepo.findOne).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('allows access for SELLER users with canManageCatalog === true', async () => {
    sellerInfoRepo.findOne.mockResolvedValue({
      canManageCatalog: true,
    } as SellerInfo);
    const result = await guard.canActivate(
      makeContext({ id: 2, role: 'SELLER' })
    );
    expect(result).toBe(true);
    expect(sellerInfoRepo.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      where: { user: { id: 2 } },
    });
  });
  it('denies access for SELLER users with canManageCatalog === false', async () => {
    sellerInfoRepo.findOne.mockResolvedValue({
      canManageCatalog: false,
    } as SellerInfo);
    const result = await guard.canActivate(
      makeContext({ id: 2, role: 'SELLER' })
    );
    expect(result).toBe(false);
  });
  it('denies access for other roles (e.g. CUSTOMER)', async () => {
    const result = await guard.canActivate(
      makeContext({ id: 3, role: 'CUSTOMER' })
    );
    expect(result).toBe(false);
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/guards/src/lib/catalog.guard.ts">
import {
  Injectable,
  CanActivate,
  ExecutionContext,
  UnauthorizedException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { GqlExecutionContext } from '@nestjs/graphql';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { SellerInfo, UserRole } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
@Injectable()
export class CatalogGuard implements CanActivate {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(SellerInfo)
    private readonly sellerInfoRepository: Repository<SellerInfo>
  ) {}
  async canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): Promise<boolean> {
    const gqlContext = GqlExecutionContext.create(context);
    const { req } = gqlContext.getContext();
    const user = req.user;
    if (!user) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException('User not authenticated');
    }
    if (user.role === UserRole.ADMIN) {
      return true;
    }
    if (user.role === UserRole.SELLER) {
      const seller = await this.sellerInfoRepository.findOne({
        where: { user: { id: user.id } },
      });
      return seller?.canManageCatalog === true;
    }
    return false;
  }
}
</file>

import { ExecutionContext } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core';
import { RolesGuard } from './roles.guard';
jest.mock('@kickzone-workspace/entities', () => ({
  UserRole: {
    ADMIN: 'ADMIN',
    SELLER: 'SELLER',
    CUSTOMER: 'CUSTOMER',
  },
}));
jest.mock('@nestjs/graphql', () => ({
  GqlExecutionContext: {
    create: (context: ExecutionContext) => ({
      getContext: () =>
        (
          context as unknown as {
            _gql: { req: { user?: { role: string } } };
          }
        )._gql,
    }),
  },
}));
const UserRole = {
  ADMIN: 'ADMIN',
  SELLER: 'SELLER',
  CUSTOMER: 'CUSTOMER',
} as const;
describe('RolesGuard', () => {
  let guard: RolesGuard;
  let reflector: Reflector;
  const makeContext = (user?: { role: string }): ExecutionContext =>
    ({
      getHandler: () => ({}),
      getClass: () => ({}),
      _gql: { req: { user } },
    } as unknown as ExecutionContext);
  beforeEach(() => {
    reflector = new Reflector();
    guard = new RolesGuard(reflector);
  });
  it('allows access when no roles are required', () => {
    jest.spyOn(reflector, 'get').mockReturnValue(undefined);
    expect(guard.canActivate(makeContext())).toBe(true);
  });
  it('denies access when user is missing', () => {
    jest.spyOn(reflector, 'get').mockReturnValue([UserRole.ADMIN]);
    expect(guard.canActivate(makeContext())).toBe(false);
  });
  it('allows access when user has a required role', () => {
    jest.spyOn(reflector, 'get').mockReturnValue([UserRole.ADMIN]);
    expect(
      guard.canActivate(makeContext({ role: UserRole.ADMIN }))
    ).toBe(true);
  });
  it('denies access when user lacks a required role', () => {
    jest.spyOn(reflector, 'get').mockReturnValue([UserRole.ADMIN]);
    expect(
      guard.canActivate(makeContext({ role: UserRole.CUSTOMER }))
    ).toBe(false);
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/guards/src/lib/roles.guard.ts">
import { Injectable, CanActivate, ExecutionContext } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core';
import { UserRole } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { GqlExecutionContext } from '@nestjs/graphql';
@Injectable()
export class RolesGuard implements CanActivate {
  constructor(private reflector: Reflector) {}
  canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): boolean {
    const requiredRoles = this.reflector.get<UserRole[]>(
      'roles',
      context.getHandler()
    );
    if (!requiredRoles) {
      return true;
    }
    // Convert to GraphQL context
    const gqlContext = GqlExecutionContext.create(context);
    const { req } = gqlContext.getContext();
    // Get user from request
    const user = req.user;
    if (!user) {
      return false;
    }
    return requiredRoles.includes(user.role);
  }
}

import { ObjectType, Field, Int } from '@nestjs/graphql';
import { Order } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';

<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/product-info.resolver.spec.ts">
import { ProductInfoResolver } from './product-info.resolver';
import { Color, ProductInfo, ProductInfoColor } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
describe('ProductInfoResolver', () => {
  let resolver: ProductInfoResolver;
  beforeEach(() => {
    resolver = new ProductInfoResolver();
  });
  it('resolves ALL ordered colors for a product info, not just the first one', () => {
    const colorRed = { id: 1, name: 'Red', hexCode: '#ff0000' } as Color;
    const colorBlue = { id: 2, name: 'Blue', hexCode: '#0000ff' } as Color;
    const colorGreen = { id: 3, name: 'Green', hexCode: '#00ff00' } as Color;
    const productInfo = {
      id: 10,
      colorLinks: [
        { id: 102, position: 1, color: colorBlue } as ProductInfoColor,
        { id: 101, position: 0, color: colorRed } as ProductInfoColor,
        { id: 103, position: 2, color: colorGreen } as ProductInfoColor,
      ],
    } as ProductInfo;
    const colors = resolver.colors(productInfo);
    expect(colors).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(colors[0]).toEqual(colorRed);
    expect(colors[1]).toEqual(colorBlue);
    expect(colors[2]).toEqual(colorGreen);
  });
  it('returns empty array when colorLinks is empty or null', () => {
    expect(resolver.colors({} as unknown as ProductInfo)).toEqual([]);
    expect(resolver.colors({ colorLinks: [] } as unknown as ProductInfo)).toEqual([]);
  });
});
</file>

<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/product-info.resolver.ts">
import { Parent, ResolveField, Resolver } from '@nestjs/graphql';
import { Color, ProductInfo } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { orderedColorsFromLinks } from '@kickzone-workspace/services';
@Resolver(() => ProductInfo)
export class ProductInfoResolver {
  @ResolveField(() => [Color])
  colors(@Parent() productInfo: ProductInfo): Color[] {
    return orderedColorsFromLinks(productInfo.colorLinks);
  }
}
</file>

<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/translation.resolver.guards.spec.ts">
import { GUARDS_METADATA } from '@nestjs/common/constants';
import { GraphqlAuthGuard } from '@kickzone-workspace/guards';
import { CatalogGuard } from '@kickzone-workspace/guards';
import { TranslationResolver } from './translation.resolver';
describe('TranslationResolver guards metadata', () => {
  const getGuards = (methodName: keyof TranslationResolver) =>
    Reflect.getMetadata(GUARDS_METADATA, TranslationResolver.prototype[methodName]) ?? [];
  it('setTranslation has CatalogGuard and does not rely on GraphqlAuthGuard alone', () => {
    const guards = getGuards('setTranslation');
    expect(guards).toContain(CatalogGuard);
    expect(guards).not.toEqual([GraphqlAuthGuard]);
  });
  it('bulkTranslateEntities has CatalogGuard and does not rely on GraphqlAuthGuard alone', () => {
    const guards = getGuards('bulkTranslateEntities');
    expect(guards).toContain(CatalogGuard);
    expect(guards).not.toEqual([GraphqlAuthGuard]);
  });
  it('deleteEntityTranslations has CatalogGuard and does not rely on GraphqlAuthGuard alone', () => {
    const guards = getGuards('deleteEntityTranslations');
    expect(guards).toContain(CatalogGuard);
    expect(guards).not.toEqual([GraphqlAuthGuard]);
  });

  });
  it('getTranslationWithFallback has no guards (stays public)', () => {

import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { getRepositoryToken } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { JwtService } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import { BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
import { RefreshToken, User, UserRole } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { UserService } from './user.service';
import { EmailService } from './email.service';
import { TokenService } from './token.service';
describe('AuthService - Password Policy', () => {
  let service: AuthService;
  let userService: {
    findByEmail: jest.Mock;
    getUserById: jest.Mock;
    createUser: jest.Mock;
    updateUser: jest.Mock;
  };
  let jwtService: { sign: jest.Mock; verify: jest.Mock };
  let refreshTokenRepository: {
    create: jest.Mock;
    save: jest.Mock;
    findOne: jest.Mock;
    update: jest.Mock;
  };
  let tokenService: {
    generateToken: jest.Mock;
    validateToken: jest.Mock;
  };
  const mockUser = {
    id: 'user-1',
    email: 'user@test.com',
    role: UserRole.CUSTOMER,
    name: 'Test',
    lastName: 'User',
    username: 'user@test.com',
    password: 'hashed',
  } as User;
  beforeEach(async () => {
    userService = {
      findByEmail: jest.fn(),
      getUserById: jest.fn(),
      createUser: jest.fn(),
      updateUser: jest.fn(),
    };
    jwtService = {
      sign: jest.fn().mockReturnValue('access.jwt.token'),
      verify: jest.fn(),
    };
    refreshTokenRepository = {
      create: jest.fn((entity) => entity),
      save: jest.fn(async (entity) => ({
        id: 'rt-1',
        ...entity,
      })),
      findOne: jest.fn(),
      update: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue({ affected: 1 }),
    };
    tokenService = {
      generateToken: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue('reset-token-123'),
      validateToken: jest.fn(),
    };
    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        AuthService,
        { provide: UserService, useValue: userService },
        { provide: JwtService, useValue: jwtService },
        { provide: EmailService, useValue: { sendEmail: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined) } },
        { provide: TokenService, useValue: tokenService },
        {
          provide: getRepositoryToken(RefreshToken),
          useValue: refreshTokenRepository,
        },
      ],
    }).compile();
    service = module.get(AuthService);
  });
  describe('register', () => {
    it('rejects empty password with BadRequestException', async () => {
      await expect(service.register('Test', 'test@test.com', '')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
      expect(userService.findByEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(userService.createUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('rejects 7-character password with BadRequestException', async () => {
      await expect(service.register('Test', 'test@test.com', 'short7c')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
      expect(userService.findByEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(userService.createUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('accepts 8-character password and creates user', async () => {
      userService.findByEmail.mockResolvedValue(null);
      userService.createUser.mockResolvedValue({ ...mockUser, password: 'hashed-abcdefgh' });
      const result = await service.register('Test', 'test@test.com', 'abcdefgh');
      expect(userService.findByEmail).toHaveBeenCalledWith('test@test.com');
      expect(userService.createUser).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          email: 'test@test.com',
          password: expect.any(String),
        })
      );
      expect(result).toEqual({ ...mockUser, password: 'hashed-abcdefgh' });
    });
  });
  describe('adminCreateUser', () => {
    it('rejects 3-character password with BadRequestException', async () => {
      await expect(
        service.adminCreateUser({
          name: 'Admin',
          lastName: 'User',
          username: 'admin',
          email: 'admin@test.com',
          password: 'abc',
          role: UserRole.ADMIN,
        })
      ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
      expect(userService.findByEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(userService.createUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('accepts 8-character password and creates user', async () => {
      userService.findByEmail.mockResolvedValue(null);
      userService.createUser.mockResolvedValue({
        ...mockUser,
        role: UserRole.ADMIN,
        password: 'hashed-abcdefgh',
      });
      const result = await service.adminCreateUser({
        name: 'Admin',
        lastName: 'User',
        username: 'admin',
        email: 'admin@test.com',
        password: 'abcdefgh',
        role: UserRole.ADMIN,
      });
      expect(userService.findByEmail).toHaveBeenCalledWith('admin@test.com');
      expect(userService.createUser).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          email: 'admin@test.com',
          password: expect.any(String),
        })
      );
      expect(result.role).toBe(UserRole.ADMIN);
    });
  });
  describe('setupPassword', () => {
    it('rejects 3-character password with BadRequestException before token validation', async () => {
      await expect(service.setupPassword('valid-token', 'abc')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
      expect(tokenService.validateToken).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(userService.findByEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(userService.updateUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('rejects empty password with BadRequestException before token validation', async () => {
      await expect(service.setupPassword('valid-token', '')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
      expect(tokenService.validateToken).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(userService.findByEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(userService.updateUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('accepts 8-character password and proceeds with token validation', async () => {
      const tokenData = {
        userId: 'user-1',
        email: 'user@test.com',
        userType: 'CUSTOMER',
        tokenType: 'password_setup',
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000),
      };
      tokenService.validateToken.mockResolvedValue(tokenData);
      userService.findByEmail.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);
      userService.updateUser.mockResolvedValue({ ...mockUser, password: 'new-hashed' });
      const result = await service.setupPassword('valid-token', 'abcdefgh');
      expect(tokenService.validateToken).toHaveBeenCalledWith('valid-token');
      expect(userService.findByEmail).toHaveBeenCalledWith('user@test.com');
      expect(userService.updateUser).toHaveBeenCalledWith('user-1', {
        password: expect.any(String),
      });
      expect(refreshTokenRepository.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        { userId: 'user-1', revokedAt: undefined },
        { revokedAt: expect.any(Date) }
      );
      expect(result.password).toBe('new-hashed');
    });
  });
  describe('resetPassword', () => {
    it('rejects 3-character password with BadRequestException before token validation', async () => {
      await expect(service.resetPassword('valid-token', 'abc')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
      expect(tokenService.validateToken).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(userService.findByEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(userService.updateUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('rejects empty password with BadRequestException before token validation', async () => {
      await expect(service.resetPassword('valid-token', '')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
      expect(tokenService.validateToken).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(userService.findByEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(userService.updateUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('accepts 8-character password and proceeds with token validation', async () => {
      const tokenData = {
        userId: 'user-1',
        email: 'user@test.com',
        userType: 'CUSTOMER',
        tokenType: 'password_reset',
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000),
      };
      tokenService.validateToken.mockResolvedValue(tokenData);
      userService.findByEmail.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);
      userService.updateUser.mockResolvedValue({ ...mockUser, password: 'new-hashed' });
      const result = await service.resetPassword('valid-reset-token', 'abcdefgh');
      expect(tokenService.validateToken).toHaveBeenCalledWith('valid-reset-token');
      expect(userService.findByEmail).toHaveBeenCalledWith('user@test.com');
      expect(userService.updateUser).toHaveBeenCalledWith('user-1', {
        password: expect.any(String),
      });
      expect(refreshTokenRepository.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        { userId: 'user-1', revokedAt: undefined },
        { revokedAt: expect.any(Date) }
      );
      expect(result.password).toBe('new-hashed');
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/brand.service.ts">
import { Injectable, Logger, OnModuleInit } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, IsNull } from 'typeorm';
import { Brand, Product } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { CreateBrandInput, UpdateBrandInput } from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
import { TranslationService } from './translation.service';
/** Basic catalog brands seeded on startup. */
export const BASIC_BRANDS: Array<{
  slug: string;
  sortOrder: number;
  name: { en: string; fa: string };
  namePrefixes: string[];
}> = [
  {
    slug: 'nike',
    sortOrder: 1,
    name: { en: 'Nike', fa: 'نایک' },
    namePrefixes: ['nike'],
  },
  {
    slug: 'jordan',
    sortOrder: 2,
    name: { en: 'Jordan', fa: 'جردن' },
    namePrefixes: ['jordan', 'air jordan'],
  },
  {
    slug: 'adidas',
    sortOrder: 3,
    name: { en: 'Adidas', fa: 'آدیداس' },
    namePrefixes: ['adidas'],
  },
  {
    slug: 'puma',
    sortOrder: 4,
    name: { en: 'Puma', fa: 'پوما' },
    namePrefixes: ['puma'],
  },
  {
    slug: 'new-balance',
    sortOrder: 5,
    name: { en: 'New Balance', fa: 'نیو بالانس' },
    namePrefixes: ['new balance'],
  },
  {
    slug: 'under-armour',
    sortOrder: 6,
    name: { en: 'Under Armour', fa: 'آندر آرمور' },
    namePrefixes: ['under armour'],
  },
  {
    slug: 'reebok',
    sortOrder: 7,
    name: { en: 'Reebok', fa: 'ریبوک' },
    namePrefixes: ['reebok'],
  },
  {
    slug: 'asics',
    sortOrder: 8,
    name: { en: 'Asics', fa: 'اسیکس' },
    namePrefixes: ['asics'],
  },
  {
    slug: 'converse',
    sortOrder: 9,
    name: { en: 'Converse', fa: 'کانورس' },
    namePrefixes: ['converse'],
  },
  {
    slug: 'vans',
    sortOrder: 10,
    name: { en: 'Vans', fa: 'ونز' },
    namePrefixes: ['vans'],
  },
];
@Injectable()
export class BrandService implements OnModuleInit {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(BrandService.name);
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Brand)
    private readonly brandRepository: Repository<Brand>,
    @InjectRepository(Product)
    private readonly productRepository: Repository<Product>,
    private readonly translationService: TranslationService
  ) {}
  async onModuleInit() {
    await this.seedBasicBrands();
    await this.backfillProductBrands();
  }
  async getBrands(options?: { onlyWithProducts?: boolean }): Promise<Brand[]> {
    const qb = this.brandRepository
      .createQueryBuilder('brand')
      .orderBy('brand.sortOrder', 'ASC')
      .addOrderBy('brand.id', 'ASC');
    if (options?.onlyWithProducts) {
      qb.andWhere('brand.isActive = true').andWhere(
        `EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM product p
          INNER JOIN seller_product sp ON sp."productId" = p.id
          WHERE p."brandId" = brand.id
            AND p.archived = false
            AND sp."stockQuantity" > 0
        )`
      );
    }
    return qb.getMany();
  }
  async getBrandById(id: number): Promise<Brand | null> {
    return this.brandRepository.findOneBy({ id });
  }
  async getBrandBySlug(slug: string): Promise<Brand | null> {
    return this.brandRepository.findOneBy({ slug: slug.toLowerCase() });
  }
  async createBrand(input: CreateBrandInput, name?: string): Promise<Brand> {
    const slug = input.slug.trim().toLowerCase();
    const existing = await this.brandRepository.findOneBy({ slug });
    if (existing) {
      throw new Error('A brand with this slug already exists.');
    }
    const brand = this.brandRepository.create({
      slug,
      sortOrder: input.sortOrder ?? 0,
      isActive: true,
    });
    const saved = await this.brandRepository.save(brand);
    if (name?.trim()) {
      await this.translationService.setTranslation({
        entityType: 'brand',
        entityId: saved.id,
        locale: 'en',
        fieldName: 'name',
        value: name.trim(),
        isAutoTranslated: false,
      });
    }
    return saved;
  }
  async updateBrand(
    input: UpdateBrandInput,
    name?: string,
    locale = 'en'
  ): Promise<Brand> {
    const brand = await this.brandRepository.findOneBy({ id: input.id });
    if (!brand) {
      throw new Error(`Brand with ID ${input.id} not found`);
    }
    if (input.slug && input.slug !== brand.slug) {
      const slug = input.slug.trim().toLowerCase();
      const existing = await this.brandRepository.findOneBy({ slug });
      if (existing) {
        throw new Error('A brand with this slug already exists.');
      }
      brand.slug = slug;
    }
    if (input.sortOrder !== undefined) brand.sortOrder = input.sortOrder;
    if (input.isActive !== undefined) brand.isActive = input.isActive;
    const saved = await this.brandRepository.save(brand);
    if (name?.trim()) {
      await this.translationService.setTranslation({
        entityType: 'brand',
        entityId: saved.id,
        locale,
        fieldName: 'name',
        value: name.trim(),
        isAutoTranslated: false,
      });
    }
    return saved;
  }
  async deleteBrand(id: number): Promise<boolean> {
    const brand = await this.brandRepository.findOneBy({ id });
    if (!brand) {
      throw new Error(`Brand with ID ${id} not found`);
    }
    const productCount = await this.productRepository.count({
      where: { brandId: id },
    });
    if (productCount > 0) {
      throw new Error('Cannot delete brand that is assigned to products');
    }
    await this.translationService.deleteEntityTranslations('brand', id);
    await this.brandRepository.remove(brand);
    return true;
  }
  private async seedBasicBrands(): Promise<void> {
    let created = 0;
    for (const basic of BASIC_BRANDS) {
      let brand = await this.brandRepository.findOneBy({ slug: basic.slug });
      if (!brand) {
        brand = await this.brandRepository.save(
          this.brandRepository.create({
            slug: basic.slug,
            sortOrder: basic.sortOrder,
            isActive: true,
          })
        );
        created += 1;
      }
      await this.ensureBrandNameTranslation(brand.id, 'en', basic.name.en);
      await this.ensureBrandNameTranslation(brand.id, 'fa', basic.name.fa);
    }
    if (created > 0) {
      this.logger.log(`Seeded ${created} basic brand(s)`);
    }
  }
  /**
   * Assign brands to products that still lack one, using name prefixes.
   */
  private async backfillProductBrands(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const brands = await this.brandRepository.find();
      if (!brands.length) return;
      const products = await this.productRepository.find({
        where: { brandId: IsNull() },
      });
      if (!products.length) return;
      let updated = 0;
      for (const product of products) {
        const nameLower = (product.name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const matched = BASIC_BRANDS.find((b) =>
          b.namePrefixes.some(
            (prefix) =>
              nameLower === prefix || nameLower.startsWith(`${prefix} `)
          )
        );
        if (!matched) continue;
        const brand = brands.find((b) => b.slug === matched.slug);
        if (!brand) continue;
        product.brandId = brand.id;
        await this.productRepository.save(product);
        updated += 1;
      }
      if (updated > 0) {
        this.logger.log(`Backfilled brand on ${updated} product(s)`);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.warn(
        `Skipped brand backfill: ${(error as Error).message}`
      );
    }
  }
  private async ensureBrandNameTranslation(
    brandId: number,
    locale: string,
    value: string
  ): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.translationService.getTranslation(
      'brand',
      brandId,
      locale,
      'name',
      ''
    );
    if (existing) {
      return;
    }
    await this.translationService.setTranslation({
      entityType: 'brand',
      entityId: brandId,
      locale,
      fieldName: 'name',
      value,
      isAutoTranslated: false,
    });
  }
}
</file>

/** Basic catalog categories seeded on startup so admins/sellers don't recreate them. */
export const BASIC_CATEGORIES: Array<{

  { slug: 'sale', sortOrder: 31, name: { en: 'Sale', fa: 'حراج' } },
  { slug: 'limited-edition', sortOrder: 32, name: { en: 'Limited Edition', fa: 'نسخه محدود' } },
  { slug: 'accessories', sortOrder: 33, name: { en: 'Accessories', fa: 'لوازم جانبی' } },
];
@Injectable()
export class CategoryService implements OnModuleInit {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(CategoryService.name);
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Category)
    private readonly categoryRepository: Repository<Category>,
    private readonly translationService: TranslationService
  ) {}
  async onModuleInit() {
    await this.seedBasicCategories();
  }
  async getCategories(): Promise<Category[]> {
    return this.categoryRepository.find({
      order: { sortOrder: 'ASC', id: 'ASC' },
    });
  }
  async createCategory(name: string): Promise<Category> {
    const category = this.categoryRepository.create({ name, products: [] });
    return this.categoryRepository.save(category);
  }
  async updateCategory(id: number, name: string): Promise<Category> {
    const category = await this.categoryRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    if (!category) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Category with ID ${id} not found`);
    }
    // Check for duplicate name (excluding current category)
    const existing = await this.categoryRepository.findOne({ where: { name } });
    if (existing && existing.id !== id) {
      throw new Error('A category with this name already exists.');
    }
    category.name = name;
    return this.categoryRepository.save(category);
  }
  async deleteCategory(id: number): Promise<void> {
    const category = await this.categoryRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    if (!category) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Category with ID ${id} not found`);
    }
    // Check if category has any products using a count query
    const productCount = await this.categoryRepository
      .createQueryBuilder('category')
      .leftJoin('category.products', 'product')
      .where('category.id = :id', { id })
      .select('COUNT(product.id)', 'count')
      .getRawOne();
    if (productCount && Number(productCount.count) > 0) {
      throw new Error('Cannot delete category that is assigned to products');
    }
    await this.categoryRepository.remove(category);
  }
  /**
   * Idempotently insert basic categories + EN/FA name translations.
   */
  async seedBasicCategories(): Promise<void> {
    let created = 0;
    for (const basic of BASIC_CATEGORIES) {
      let category = await this.categoryRepository.findOneBy({
        slug: basic.slug,
      });
      if (!category) {
        category = await this.categoryRepository.save(
          this.categoryRepository.create({
            slug: basic.slug,
            sortOrder: basic.sortOrder,
            isActive: true,
          })
        );
        created += 1;
      }
      await this.ensureCategoryNameTranslation(
        category.id,
        'en',
        basic.name.en
      );
      await this.ensureCategoryNameTranslation(
        category.id,
        'fa',
        basic.name.fa
      );
    }
    if (created > 0) {
      this.logger.log(`Seeded ${created} basic categor(y/ies)`);
    }
  }
  private async ensureCategoryNameTranslation(
    categoryId: number,
    locale: string,
    value: string
  ): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.translationService.getTranslation(
      'category',
      categoryId,
      locale,
      'name',
      ''
    );
    if (existing) {
      return;
    }
    await this.translationService.setTranslation({
      entityType: 'category',
      entityId: categoryId,
      locale,
      fieldName: 'name',
      value,
      isAutoTranslated: false,
    });
  }
}

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/color.service.ts">
import { Injectable, Logger, OnModuleInit } from '@nestjs/common';

  { hexCode: '#9370DB', sortOrder: 49, name: { en: 'Lavender', fa: 'اسطوخودوسی' } },
  { hexCode: '#E6E6FA', sortOrder: 50, name: { en: 'Lilac', fa: 'یاسی' } },
];
@Injectable()
export class ColorService implements OnModuleInit {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(ColorService.name);
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Color)
    private readonly colorRepository: Repository<Color>,
    private readonly translationService: TranslationService
  ) {}
  async onModuleInit() {
    await this.seedBasicColors();
  }
  async getColors(): Promise<Color[]> {
    return this.colorRepository.find({
      order: { sortOrder: 'ASC', id: 'ASC' },
    });
  }
  async getColorById(id: number): Promise<Color | null> {
    return this.colorRepository.findOneBy({ id });
  }
  async createColor(input: CreateColorInput, name?: string): Promise<Color> {
    const hexCode = this.normalizeHex(input.hexCode);
    const existing = await this.colorRepository.findOneBy({ hexCode });
    if (existing) {
      throw new Error('A color with this hex code already exists.');
    }
    const color = this.colorRepository.create({
      hexCode,
      sortOrder: input.sortOrder || 0,
    });
    const savedColor = await this.colorRepository.save(color);
    // Create a translation entry for the color name if provided
    if (name) {
      await this.translationService.setTranslation({
        entityType: 'color',
        entityId: savedColor.id,
        locale: 'en', // Default to English
        fieldName: 'name',
        value: name,
        isAutoTranslated: false, // Not auto-translated
      });
    }
    return savedColor;
  }
  async updateColor(
    id: number,
    input: UpdateColorInput,
    name?: string,
    locale = 'en'
  ): Promise<Color> {
    const color = await this.colorRepository.findOneBy({ id });
    if (!color) {
      throw new Error(`Color with ID ${id} not found`);
    }
    const hexCode = this.normalizeHex(input.hexCode);
    const existing = await this.colorRepository.findOne({
      where: { hexCode },
    });
    if (existing && existing.id !== id) {
      throw new Error('A color with this hex code already exists.');
    }
    color.hexCode = hexCode;
    if (input.sortOrder !== undefined) {
      color.sortOrder = input.sortOrder;
    }
    if (input.isActive !== undefined) {
      color.isActive = input.isActive;
    }
    const saved = await this.colorRepository.save(color);
    const trimmedName = name?.trim();
    if (trimmedName) {
      await this.translationService.setTranslation({
        entityType: 'color',
        entityId: saved.id,
        locale,
        fieldName: 'name',
        value: trimmedName,
        isAutoTranslated: false,
      });
    }
    return saved;
  }
  async deleteColor(id: number): Promise<boolean> {
    const result = await this.colorRepository.delete(id);
    return (result.affected ?? 0) > 0;
  }
  /**
   * Idempotently insert basic colors + EN/FA name translations.
   */
  async seedBasicColors(): Promise<void> {
    let created = 0;
    for (const basic of BASIC_COLORS) {
      const hexCode = this.normalizeHex(basic.hexCode);
      let color = await this.colorRepository.findOneBy({ hexCode });
      if (!color) {
        color = await this.colorRepository.save(
          this.colorRepository.create({
            hexCode,
            sortOrder: basic.sortOrder,
            isActive: true,
          })
        );
        created += 1;
      }
      await this.ensureColorNameTranslation(color.id, 'en', basic.name.en);
      await this.ensureColorNameTranslation(color.id, 'fa', basic.name.fa);
    }
    if (created > 0) {
      this.logger.log(`Seeded ${created} basic color(s)`);
    }
  }
  private async ensureColorNameTranslation(
    colorId: number,
    locale: string,
    value: string
  ): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.translationService.getTranslation(
      'color',
      colorId,
      locale,
      'name',
      ''
    );
    if (existing) {
      return;
    }
    await this.translationService.setTranslation({
      entityType: 'color',
      entityId: colorId,
      locale,
      fieldName: 'name',
      value,
      isAutoTranslated: false,
    });
  }
  private normalizeHex(hexCode: string): string {
    const trimmed = hexCode.trim();
    return trimmed.startsWith('#')
      ? trimmed.toUpperCase()
      : `#${trimmed.toUpperCase()}`;
  }
}
