<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/currency.service.ts">
import {
  Injectable,
  Logger,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
  OnModuleInit,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, LessThanOrEqual } from 'typeorm';
import {
  Currency,
  ExchangeRate,
  CurrencyPreference,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
/** Core currencies seeded on startup so the admin currency screen works out of the box. */
export const BASIC_CURRENCIES: Array<{
  code: string;
  name: string;
  symbol: string;
  decimalPlaces: number;
  isBaseCurrency: boolean;
}> = [
  {
    code: 'USD',
    name: 'US Dollar',
    symbol: '$',
    decimalPlaces: 2,
    isBaseCurrency: true,
  },
  {
    code: 'IRR',
    // Code is IRR for legacy reasons; amounts/symbol are Toman (ZarinPal IRT).
    name: 'Iranian Toman',
    symbol: 'تومان',
    decimalPlaces: 0,
    isBaseCurrency: false,
  },
];
/** Locale → currency defaults seeded on startup. */
export const BASIC_CURRENCY_PREFERENCES: Array<{
  locale: string;
  currencyCode: string;
}> = [
  { locale: 'fa', currencyCode: 'IRR' },
  { locale: 'en', currencyCode: 'USD' },
];
@Injectable()
export class CurrencyService implements OnModuleInit {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(CurrencyService.name);
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Currency)
    private currencyRepository: Repository<Currency>,
    @InjectRepository(ExchangeRate)
    private exchangeRateRepository: Repository<ExchangeRate>,
    @InjectRepository(CurrencyPreference)
    private currencyPreferenceRepository: Repository<CurrencyPreference>
  ) {}
  async onModuleInit() {
    await this.seedBasicCurrencies();
  }
  /**
   * Idempotently insert USD/IRR and default locale preferences.
   * Does not set an exchange rate — admins configure that in the UI.
   */
  async seedBasicCurrencies(): Promise<void> {
    let createdCurrencies = 0;
    for (const basic of BASIC_CURRENCIES) {
      let currency = await this.currencyRepository.findOne({
        where: { code: basic.code },
      });
      if (!currency) {
        currency = await this.currencyRepository.save(
          this.currencyRepository.create({
            ...basic,
            isActive: true,
          })
        );
        createdCurrencies += 1;
      }
    }
    let createdPreferences = 0;
    for (const basic of BASIC_CURRENCY_PREFERENCES) {
      const existing = await this.currencyPreferenceRepository.findOne({
        where: { locale: basic.locale },
      });
      if (existing) {
        continue;
      }
      const currency = await this.findCurrencyByCode(basic.currencyCode);
      if (!currency) {
        continue;
      }
      await this.currencyPreferenceRepository.save(
        this.currencyPreferenceRepository.create({
          locale: basic.locale,
          currencyId: currency.id,
          isActive: true,
        })
      );
      createdPreferences += 1;
    }
    if (createdCurrencies > 0 || createdPreferences > 0) {
      this.logger.log(
        `Seeded ${createdCurrencies} currency(ies) and ${createdPreferences} preference(s)`
      );
    }
  }
  // =============== Currency Management ===============
  async findAllCurrencies(): Promise<Currency[]> {
    return this.currencyRepository.find({
      order: { isBaseCurrency: 'DESC', code: 'ASC' },
    });
  }
  async findCurrencyById(id: number): Promise<Currency | null> {
    return this.currencyRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
  }
  async findCurrencyByCode(code: string): Promise<Currency | null> {
    return this.currencyRepository.findOne({
      where: { code: code.toUpperCase() },
    });
  }
  async createCurrency(data: {
    code: string;
    name: string;
    symbol: string;
    decimalPlaces: number;
    isActive?: boolean;
    isBaseCurrency?: boolean;
  }): Promise<Currency> {
    // If setting as base currency, unset all others
    if (data.isBaseCurrency) {
      await this.currencyRepository.update(
        { isBaseCurrency: true },
        { isBaseCurrency: false }
      );
    }
    const currency = this.currencyRepository.create({
      ...data,
      code: data.code.toUpperCase(),
    });
    return this.currencyRepository.save(currency);
  }
  async updateCurrency(
    id: number,
    data: {
      code?: string;
      name?: string;
      symbol?: string;
      decimalPlaces?: number;
      isActive?: boolean;
      isBaseCurrency?: boolean;
    }
  ): Promise<Currency> {
    const currency = await this.findCurrencyById(id);
    if (!currency) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Currency with ID ${id} not found`);
    }
    // If setting as base currency, unset all others
    if (data.isBaseCurrency && !currency.isBaseCurrency) {
      await this.currencyRepository.update(
        { isBaseCurrency: true },
        { isBaseCurrency: false }
      );
    }
    Object.assign(currency, {
      ...data,
      code: data.code ? data.code.toUpperCase() : currency.code,
    });
    return this.currencyRepository.save(currency);
  }
  async getBaseCurrency(): Promise<Currency> {
    const baseCurrency = await this.currencyRepository.findOne({
      where: { isBaseCurrency: true, isActive: true },
    });
    if (!baseCurrency) {
      throw new NotFoundException('No base currency configured');
    }
    return baseCurrency;
  }
  // =============== Exchange Rate Management ===============
  async setExchangeRate(data: {
    fromCurrencyCode: string;
    toCurrencyCode: string;
    rate: number;
    effectiveDate?: Date;
    notes?: string;
    createdById?: string;
  }): Promise<ExchangeRate> {
    const fromCurrency = await this.findCurrencyByCode(data.fromCurrencyCode);
    const toCurrency = await this.findCurrencyByCode(data.toCurrencyCode);
    if (!fromCurrency) {
      throw new NotFoundException(
        `Currency ${data.fromCurrencyCode} not found`
      );
    }
    if (!toCurrency) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Currency ${data.toCurrencyCode} not found`);
    }
    if (data.rate <= 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Exchange rate must be greater than 0');
    }
    const exchangeRate = this.exchangeRateRepository.create({
      fromCurrencyId: fromCurrency.id,
      toCurrencyId: toCurrency.id,
      rate: data.rate,
      effectiveDate: data.effectiveDate || new Date(),
      notes: data.notes,
      createdById: data.createdById,
    });
    const saved = await this.exchangeRateRepository.save(exchangeRate);
    // Reload with relations to satisfy GraphQL schema
    return this.exchangeRateRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: saved.id },
      relations: ['fromCurrency', 'toCurrency', 'createdBy'],
    }) as Promise<ExchangeRate>;
  }
  async getCurrentExchangeRate(
    fromCurrencyCode: string,
    toCurrencyCode: string
  ): Promise<ExchangeRate | null> {
    const fromCurrency = await this.findCurrencyByCode(fromCurrencyCode);
    const toCurrency = await this.findCurrencyByCode(toCurrencyCode);
    if (!fromCurrency || !toCurrency) {
      return null;
    }
    // If same currency, return rate of 1
    if (fromCurrency.id === toCurrency.id) {
      return this.exchangeRateRepository.create({
        fromCurrencyId: fromCurrency.id,
        toCurrencyId: toCurrency.id,
        rate: 1,
        effectiveDate: new Date(),
        id: 0,
      });
    }
    const exchangeRate = await this.exchangeRateRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        fromCurrencyId: fromCurrency.id,
        toCurrencyId: toCurrency.id,
        effectiveDate: LessThanOrEqual(new Date()),
      },
      order: { effectiveDate: 'DESC' },
      relations: ['fromCurrency', 'toCurrency', 'createdBy'],
    });
    return exchangeRate;
  }
  async getExchangeRateHistory(
    fromCurrencyCode: string,
    toCurrencyCode: string,
    limit = 10
  ): Promise<ExchangeRate[]> {
    const fromCurrency = await this.findCurrencyByCode(fromCurrencyCode);
    const toCurrency = await this.findCurrencyByCode(toCurrencyCode);
    if (!fromCurrency || !toCurrency) {
      return [];
    }
    return this.exchangeRateRepository.find({
      where: {
        fromCurrencyId: fromCurrency.id,
        toCurrencyId: toCurrency.id,
      },
      order: { effectiveDate: 'DESC' },
      take: limit,
      relations: ['fromCurrency', 'toCurrency', 'createdBy'],
    });
  }
  async convertPrice(
    amount: number,
    fromCurrencyCode: string,
    toCurrencyCode: string
  ): Promise<{ amount: number; rate: number }> {
    const exchangeRate = await this.getCurrentExchangeRate(
      fromCurrencyCode,
      toCurrencyCode
    );
    if (!exchangeRate) {
      throw new NotFoundException(
        `No exchange rate found from ${fromCurrencyCode} to ${toCurrencyCode}`
      );
    }
    const convertedAmount = amount * exchangeRate.rate;
    const toCurrency = await this.findCurrencyByCode(toCurrencyCode);
    // Round based on decimal places
    const rounded = toCurrency
      ? Number(convertedAmount.toFixed(toCurrency.decimalPlaces))
      : convertedAmount;
    return {
      amount: rounded,
      rate: exchangeRate.rate,
    };
  }
  // =============== Currency Preference Management ===============
  async findAllCurrencyPreferences(): Promise<CurrencyPreference[]> {
    return this.currencyPreferenceRepository.find({
      relations: ['currency'],
      order: { locale: 'ASC' },
    });
  }
  async findCurrencyPreferenceByLocale(
    locale: string
  ): Promise<CurrencyPreference | null> {
    return this.currencyPreferenceRepository.findOne({
      where: { locale },
      relations: ['currency'],
    });
  }
  async setCurrencyPreference(
    locale: string,
    currencyCode: string
  ): Promise<CurrencyPreference> {
    const currency = await this.findCurrencyByCode(currencyCode);
    if (!currency) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Currency ${currencyCode} not found`);
    }
    let preference = await this.findCurrencyPreferenceByLocale(locale);
    if (preference) {
      preference.currencyId = currency.id;
      preference.currency = currency;
    } else {
      preference = this.currencyPreferenceRepository.create({
        locale,
        currencyId: currency.id,
        currency,
      });
    }
    return this.currencyPreferenceRepository.save(preference);
  }
  async deleteCurrencyPreference(id: number): Promise<boolean> {
    const result = await this.currencyPreferenceRepository.delete(id);
    return result.affected ? result.affected > 0 : false;
  }
  async getCurrencyForLocale(locale: string): Promise<Currency | null> {
    const preference = await this.findCurrencyPreferenceByLocale(locale);
    return preference ? preference.currency : null;
  }
}

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/customer-profile.service.ts">
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { CustomerProfile } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
export interface UpdateCustomerProfileInput {
  phone?: string;
  address?: string;
  city?: string;
  state?: string;
  zipCode?: string;
  country?: string;
  clothingSize?: string;
  shoeSize?: string;
  favorites?: string;
}
@Injectable()
export class CustomerProfileService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(CustomerProfile)
    private readonly customerProfileRepository: Repository<CustomerProfile>
  ) {}
  async getOrCreateProfile(userId: string): Promise<CustomerProfile> {
    let profile = await this.customerProfileRepository.findOne({
      where: { userId },
    });
    if (!profile) {
      profile = this.customerProfileRepository.create({ userId });
      profile = await this.customerProfileRepository.save(profile);
    }
    return profile;
  }
  async updateProfile(
    userId: string,
    input: UpdateCustomerProfileInput
  ): Promise<CustomerProfile> {
    const profile = await this.getOrCreateProfile(userId);
    Object.assign(profile, {
      phone: input.phone ?? profile.phone,
      address: input.address ?? profile.address,
      city: input.city ?? profile.city,
      state: input.state ?? profile.state,
      zipCode: input.zipCode ?? profile.zipCode,
      country: input.country ?? profile.country,
      clothingSize: input.clothingSize ?? profile.clothingSize,
      shoeSize: input.shoeSize ?? profile.shoeSize,
      favorites: input.favorites ?? profile.favorites,
    });
    return this.customerProfileRepository.save(profile);
  }
  async getProfile(userId: string): Promise<CustomerProfile | null> {
    return this.customerProfileRepository.findOne({
      where: { userId },
    });
  }
}

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/image-upload.service.ts">
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { Request } from 'express';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as multer from 'multer';
import * as path from 'path';
@Injectable()
export class ImageUploadService {
  private readonly uploadDir: string;
  constructor(private configService: ConfigService) {
    this.uploadDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'uploads', 'products');
    this.ensureUploadDirectoryExists();
  }
  private ensureUploadDirectoryExists() {
    if (!fs.existsSync(this.uploadDir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(this.uploadDir, { recursive: true });
    }
  }
  getMulterConfig() {
    return {
      storage: multer.diskStorage({
        destination: (
          req: Request,
          file: Express.Multer.File,
          cb: (error: Error | null, destination: string) => void
        ) => {
          cb(null, this.uploadDir);
        },
        filename: (
          req: Request,
          file: Express.Multer.File,
          cb: (error: Error | null, filename: string) => void
        ) => {
          const uniqueSuffix =
            Date.now() + '-' + Math.round(Math.random() * 1e9);
          cb(null, uniqueSuffix + path.extname(file.originalname));
        },
      }),
      fileFilter: (
        req: Request,
        file: Express.Multer.File,
        cb: (error: Error | null, acceptFile: boolean) => void
      ) => {
        if (file.mimetype.match(/\/(jpg|jpeg|png|gif)$/)) {
          cb(null, true);
        } else {
          cb(new Error('Only image files are allowed!'), false);
        }
      },
      limits: {
        fileSize: 5 * 1024 * 1024, // 5MB limit
      },
    };
  }
  getImageUrl(filename: string): string {
    return `/uploads/products/${filename}`;
  }
}

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PinoLogger } from 'nestjs-pino';
@Injectable()
export class PaymentLogger {
  constructor(private readonly logger: PinoLogger) {
    this.logger.setContext(PaymentLogger.name);
  }
  logPaymentInitiated(input: {
    orderId?: string;
    userId?: string;
    amount: number;
    currency: string;
    gateway: string;
  }) {
    this.logger.info(
      {
        event: 'payment_initiated',
        orderId: input.orderId,
        userId: input.userId,
        amount: input.amount,
        currency: input.currency,
        gateway: input.gateway,
      },
      'Payment initiated'
    );
  }
  logGatewayResponse(input: {
    orderId?: string;
    authority?: string;
    code: number;
    message: string;
    gateway: string;
  }) {
    this.logger.info(
      {
        event: 'payment_gateway_response',
        orderId: input.orderId,
        authority: input.authority,
        code: input.code,
        message: input.message,
        gateway: input.gateway,
      },
      'Payment gateway responded'
    );
  }
  logVerificationResult(input: {
    orderId?: string;
    authority: string;
    amount: number;
    code: number;
    message: string;
    refId?: number;
  }) {
    this.logger.info(
      {
        event: 'payment_verification_result',
        orderId: input.orderId,
        authority: input.authority,
        amount: input.amount,
        code: input.code,
        message: input.message,
        refId: input.refId,
      },
      'Payment verification finished'
    );
  }
  logOrderConfirmationFailed(orderId: string, error: unknown) {
    this.logger.error(
      {
        event: 'order_confirmation_failed',
        orderId,
        error:
          error instanceof Error
            ? { name: error.name, message: error.message }
            : error,
      },
      'Failed to confirm order after successful payment'
    );
  }
  logOrderCancellationFailed(orderId: string, error: unknown) {
    this.logger.error(
      {
        event: 'order_cancellation_failed',
        orderId,
        error:
          error instanceof Error
            ? { name: error.name, message: error.message }
            : error,
      },
      'Failed to cancel order after failed payment'
    );
  }
}

import {
  formatProductInfoColorNames,
  orderedColorsFromLinks,
  serializeProductInfoColorHexes,
} from './product-info-colors.util';
describe('product-info-colors.util', () => {
  const red = { id: 1, name: 'Red', hexCode: '#ff0000' } as never;
  const blue = { id: 2, name: 'Blue', hexCode: '#0000ff' } as never;
  it('orders colors by position', () => {
    const links = [
      { position: 1, color: blue },
      { position: 0, color: red },
    ] as never[];
    expect(orderedColorsFromLinks(links)).toEqual([red, blue]);
  });
  it('serializes hex codes and formats names', () => {
    const links = [
      { position: 0, color: red },
      { position: 1, color: blue },
    ] as never[];
    expect(serializeProductInfoColorHexes(links)).toBe('#ff0000,#0000ff');
    expect(formatProductInfoColorNames(links)).toBe('Red / Blue');
  });
  it('handles empty links', () => {
    expect(orderedColorsFromLinks(null)).toEqual([]);
    expect(serializeProductInfoColorHexes([])).toBeUndefined();
    expect(formatProductInfoColorNames(undefined)).toBe('');
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/product-info-colors.util.ts">
import { Color, ProductInfoColor } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
export function orderedColorsFromLinks(
  colorLinks?: ProductInfoColor[] | null
): Color[] {
  if (!colorLinks?.length) {
    return [];
  }
  return [...colorLinks]
    .sort((a, b) => a.position - b.position)
    .map((link) => link.color)
    .filter((color): color is Color => !!color);
}
export function serializeProductInfoColorHexes(
  colorLinks?: ProductInfoColor[] | null
): string | undefined {
  const hexes = orderedColorsFromLinks(colorLinks).map((c) => c.hexCode);
  return hexes.length ? hexes.join(',') : undefined;
}
export function formatProductInfoColorNames(
  colorLinks?: ProductInfoColor[] | null
): string {
  return orderedColorsFromLinks(colorLinks)
    .map((c) => c.name || c.hexCode)
    .join(' / ');
}

import {
  createConnection,
  parseOffset,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/utils';
describe('relay-connection', () => {
  describe('parseOffset', () => {
    it('returns 0 for falsy or empty values', () => {
      expect(parseOffset(undefined)).toBe(0);
      expect(parseOffset(null)).toBe(0);
      expect(parseOffset('')).toBe(0);
    });
    it('returns 0 for UUIDs', () => {
      expect(parseOffset('123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000')).toBe(0);
    });
    it('parses raw integer string', () => {
      expect(parseOffset('12')).toBe(12);
      expect(parseOffset(' 24 ')).toBe(24);
    });
    it('parses cursor:offset string', () => {
      expect(parseOffset('cursor:12')).toBe(12);
    });
    it('parses base64 encoded cursor:offset and numeric strings', () => {
      const b64Cursor = Buffer.from('cursor:36').toString('base64');
      expect(parseOffset(b64Cursor)).toBe(36);
      const b64Num = Buffer.from('48').toString('base64');
      expect(parseOffset(b64Num)).toBe(48);
    });
  });
  describe('createConnection', () => {
    const products = [
      { id: 101, name: 'Product 1' },
      { id: 102, name: 'Product 2' },
      { id: 103, name: 'Product 3' },
    ];
    it('creates offset-based connection for first page', () => {
      const conn = createConnection(products, 10, 3, undefined);
      expect(conn.edges).toHaveLength(3);
      expect(conn.edges[0].cursor).toBe('1');
      expect(conn.edges[2].cursor).toBe('3');
      expect(conn.pageInfo.endCursor).toBe('3');
      expect(conn.pageInfo.hasNextPage).toBe(true);
      expect(conn.pageInfo.hasPreviousPage).toBe(false);
      expect(conn.totalCount).toBe(10);
    });
    it('creates offset-based connection for middle page', () => {
      const conn = createConnection(products, 10, 3, '3');
      expect(conn.edges[0].cursor).toBe('4');
      expect(conn.edges[2].cursor).toBe('6');
      expect(conn.pageInfo.endCursor).toBe('6');
      expect(conn.pageInfo.hasNextPage).toBe(true);
      expect(conn.pageInfo.hasPreviousPage).toBe(true);
    });
    it('creates offset-based connection for final page', () => {
      const lastPageProducts = [{ id: 110, name: 'Product 10' }];
      const conn = createConnection(lastPageProducts, 10, 3, '9');
      expect(conn.edges).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(conn.edges[0].cursor).toBe('10');
      expect(conn.pageInfo.endCursor).toBe('10');
      expect(conn.pageInfo.hasNextPage).toBe(false);
      expect(conn.pageInfo.hasPreviousPage).toBe(true);
    });
    it('handles UUID-based cursor correctly', () => {
      const uuid = '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000';
      const users = [
        { id: '223e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174001', name: 'User 1' },
        { id: '323e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174002', name: 'User 2' },
      ];
      const conn = createConnection(users, 5, 2, uuid);
      expect(conn.edges[0].cursor).toBe('223e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174001');
      expect(conn.pageInfo.endCursor).toBe('323e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174002');
      expect(conn.pageInfo.hasNextPage).toBe(true);
      expect(conn.pageInfo.hasPreviousPage).toBe(true);
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/site-language.service.ts">
import {
  Injectable,
  Logger,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
  OnModuleInit,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { SiteLanguage } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import {
  CreateSiteLanguageInput,
  UpdateSiteLanguageInput,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
export const BASIC_LANGUAGES: Array<{
  code: string;
  name: string;
  nativeName: string;
  isRTL: boolean;
  isActive: boolean;
  isDefault: boolean;
}> = [
  {
    code: 'fa',
    name: 'Persian',
    nativeName: 'فارسی',
    isRTL: true,
    isActive: true,
    isDefault: true,
  },
  {
    code: 'en',
    name: 'English',
    nativeName: 'English',
    isRTL: false,
    isActive: true,
    isDefault: false,
  },
];
@Injectable()
export class SiteLanguageService implements OnModuleInit {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(SiteLanguageService.name);
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(SiteLanguage)
    private readonly siteLanguageRepository: Repository<SiteLanguage>
  ) {}
  async onModuleInit() {
    await this.seedBasicLanguages();
  }
  async seedBasicLanguages(): Promise<void> {
    for (const basic of BASIC_LANGUAGES) {
      const existing = await this.siteLanguageRepository.findOne({
        where: { code: basic.code },
      });
      if (!existing) {
        await this.siteLanguageRepository.save(
          this.siteLanguageRepository.create(basic)
        );
        this.logger.log(`Seeded site language: ${basic.name} (${basic.code})`);
      }
    }
  }
  async findAll(activeOnly = false): Promise<SiteLanguage[]> {
    if (activeOnly) {
      return this.siteLanguageRepository.find({
        where: { isActive: true },
        order: { isDefault: 'DESC', id: 'ASC' },
      });
    }
    return this.siteLanguageRepository.find({
      order: { isDefault: 'DESC', id: 'ASC' },
    });
  }
  async findByCode(code: string): Promise<SiteLanguage | null> {
    return this.siteLanguageRepository.findOne({
      where: { code },
    });
  }
  async findById(id: number): Promise<SiteLanguage | null> {
    return this.siteLanguageRepository.findOne({
      where: { id },
    });
  }
  async getDefaultLanguage(): Promise<SiteLanguage | null> {
    const defaultLang = await this.siteLanguageRepository.findOne({
      where: { isDefault: true, isActive: true },
    });
    if (defaultLang) return defaultLang;
    // Fallback to first active language
    return this.siteLanguageRepository.findOne({
      where: { isActive: true },
      order: { id: 'ASC' },
    });
  }
  async create(input: CreateSiteLanguageInput): Promise<SiteLanguage> {
    const code = input.code.trim().toLowerCase();
    const existing = await this.findByCode(code);
    if (existing) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Language with code "${code}" already exists.`
      );
    }
    if (input.isDefault) {
      // Unset previous default
      await this.siteLanguageRepository.update(
        { isDefault: true },
        { isDefault: false }
      );
    }
    const language = this.siteLanguageRepository.create({
      code,
      name: input.name.trim(),
      nativeName: input.nativeName.trim(),
      isRTL: input.isRTL ?? false,
      isActive: input.isActive ?? true,
      isDefault: input.isDefault ?? false,
    });
    return this.siteLanguageRepository.save(language);
  }
  async update(
    id: number,
    input: UpdateSiteLanguageInput
  ): Promise<SiteLanguage> {
    const language = await this.findById(id);
    if (!language) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`SiteLanguage with ID ${id} not found.`);
    }
    if (input.isDefault) {
      await this.siteLanguageRepository.update(
        { isDefault: true },
        { isDefault: false }
      );
    }
    if (input.name !== undefined) language.name = input.name.trim();
    if (input.nativeName !== undefined)
      language.nativeName = input.nativeName.trim();
    if (input.isRTL !== undefined) language.isRTL = input.isRTL;
    if (input.isActive !== undefined) language.isActive = input.isActive;
    if (input.isDefault !== undefined) language.isDefault = input.isDefault;
    return this.siteLanguageRepository.save(language);
  }
  async delete(id: number): Promise<boolean> {
    const language = await this.findById(id);
    if (!language) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`SiteLanguage with ID ${id} not found.`);
    }
    if (language.isDefault) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Cannot delete default site language.');
    }
    await this.siteLanguageRepository.delete(id);
    return true;
  }
}

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/token.service.ts">
import { Injectable, Optional, OnModuleInit } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectDataSource } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { DataSource } from 'typeorm';
import { randomBytes, createHash } from 'crypto';
interface TokenData {
  userId: string;
  email: string;
  userType: string;
  tokenType: string;
  expiresAt: Date;
}
@Injectable()
export class TokenService implements OnModuleInit {
  private tokens: Map<string, TokenData> = new Map();
  private tableInitialized = false;
  constructor(
    @Optional()
    @InjectDataSource()
    private readonly dataSource?: DataSource
  ) {}
  async onModuleInit(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.dataSource) {
      await this.ensureTableExists();
    }
  }
  private async ensureTableExists(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.tableInitialized) return;
    try {
      await this.dataSource!.query(`
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS auth_action_tokens (
          token_hash VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
          user_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
          email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
          user_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
          token_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
          expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
          created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_auth_action_tokens_user_id ON auth_action_tokens(user_id);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_auth_action_tokens_expires_at ON auth_action_tokens(expires_at);
      `);
      this.tableInitialized = true;
    } catch (error) {
      // Table creation might fail in tests without a real database
      // Fall back to in-memory storage
      console.warn('Failed to initialize auth_action_tokens table, falling back to in-memory storage:', error);
    }
  }
  private hashToken(token: string): string {
    return createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex');
  }
  async generateToken(
    userId: string,
    email: string,
    userType: string,
    tokenType: string,
    expiresInHours = 24
  ): Promise<string> {
    const token = randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
    const expiresAt = new Date();
    expiresAt.setHours(expiresAt.getHours() + expiresInHours);
    const tokenData: TokenData = {
      userId,
      email,
      userType,
      tokenType,
      expiresAt,
    };
    if (this.dataSource && this.tableInitialized) {
      const tokenHash = this.hashToken(token);
      try {
        await this.storeInDatabase(tokenHash, tokenData);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to store token in database:', err);
        // Fall back to in-memory
        this.tokens.set(token, tokenData);
      }
    } else {
      // In-memory fallback for tests or when DB is not available
      this.tokens.set(token, tokenData);
    }
    return token;
  }
  private async storeInDatabase(tokenHash: string, tokenData: TokenData): Promise<void> {
    await this.dataSource!.query(
      `INSERT INTO auth_action_tokens (token_hash, user_id, email, user_type, token_type, expires_at)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)`,
      [tokenHash, tokenData.userId, tokenData.email, tokenData.userType, tokenData.tokenType, tokenData.expiresAt]
    );
  }
  async validateToken(token: string): Promise<TokenData | null> {
    const tokenHash = this.hashToken(token);
    if (this.dataSource && this.tableInitialized) {
      return this.validateInDatabase(tokenHash);
    }
    // In-memory fallback
    return this.validateInMemory(token);
  }
  private async validateInDatabase(tokenHash: string): Promise<TokenData | null> {
    try {
      // Atomic consume: DELETE ... RETURNING ensures single-use across instances
      const result = await this.dataSource!.query(
        `DELETE FROM auth_action_tokens
         WHERE token_hash = $1 AND expires_at > NOW()
         RETURNING user_id, email, user_type, token_type, expires_at`,
        [tokenHash]
      );
      if (!result || result.length === 0) {
        return null;
      }
      const row = result[0];
      return {
        userId: row.user_id,
        email: row.email,
        userType: row.user_type,
        tokenType: row.token_type,
        expiresAt: new Date(row.expires_at),
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to validate token in database:', error);
      // Fall back to in-memory
      return this.validateInMemoryByHash(tokenHash);
    }
  }
  private validateInMemory(token: string): TokenData | null {
    const tokenData = this.tokens.get(token);
    if (!tokenData) {
      return null;
    }
    if (new Date() > tokenData.expiresAt) {
      this.tokens.delete(token);
      return null;
    }
    // Remove the token after validation (one-time use)
    this.tokens.delete(token);
    return tokenData;
  }
  private validateInMemoryByHash(tokenHash: string): TokenData | null {
    // For in-memory fallback, we need to find by raw token
    // This is only used when DB fails, so we iterate
    for (const [rawToken, tokenData] of this.tokens.entries()) {
      if (this.hashToken(rawToken) === tokenHash) {
        if (new Date() > tokenData.expiresAt) {
          this.tokens.delete(rawToken);
          return null;
        }
        this.tokens.delete(rawToken);
        return tokenData;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }
  // Helper method for tests to clear in-memory storage
  clearMemoryStore(): void {
    this.tokens.clear();
  }
  // Helper method for tests to check if using database
  isUsingDatabase(): boolean {
    return !!(this.dataSource && this.tableInitialized);
  }
}

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/user.service.ts">
import { User, UserRole } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { CreateUserInput } from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
import {
  Connection,
  ConnectionArgs,
  createConnection,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/utils';
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import * as bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
@Injectable()
export class UserService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(User)
    private userRepository: Repository<User>
  ) {}
  async findAllPaginated({
    first = 10,
    after,
    searchTerm,
    role,
  }: ConnectionArgs & { role?: UserRole }): Promise<Connection<User>> {
    const query = this.userRepository.createQueryBuilder('user');
    if (role) {
      query.andWhere('user.role = :role', { role });
    }
    if (searchTerm) {
      query.andWhere(
        '(LOWER(user.name) LIKE LOWER(:searchTerm) OR LOWER(user.lastName) LIKE LOWER(:searchTerm) OR LOWER(user.email) LIKE LOWER(:searchTerm) OR LOWER(user.username) LIKE LOWER(:searchTerm))',
        { searchTerm: `%${searchTerm}%` }
      );
    }
    if (after) {
      query.andWhere('user.id > :after', { after });
    }
    const [users, totalCount] = await query
      .orderBy('user.id', 'ASC')
      .take(first)
      .getManyAndCount();
    return createConnection(users, totalCount, first, after);
  }
  async findByEmail(email: string): Promise<User | null> {
    return this.userRepository.findOne({ where: { email } });
  }
  async getUserById(id: string): Promise<User | null> {
    return this.userRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
  }
  async createUser(createUserInput: CreateUserInput): Promise<User> {
    // Note: Password should already be hashed by the caller (auth.service)
    // This service is just for CRUD operations
    const user = this.userRepository.create({
      ...createUserInput,
    });
    return this.userRepository.save(user);
  }
  async updateUser(id: string, updateData: Partial<User>): Promise<User> {
    const user = await this.getUserById(id);
    if (!user) {
      throw new Error('User not found');
    }
    Object.assign(user, updateData);
    return this.userRepository.save(user);
  }
}

<file path="libs/server/strategies/src/lib/local.strategy.ts">
import { Strategy } from 'passport-local';
import { PassportStrategy } from '@nestjs/passport';
import { Injectable, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { AuthService } from '@kickzone-workspace/services';
import { UserWithoutPassword } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
@Injectable()
export class LocalStrategy extends PassportStrategy(Strategy) {
  constructor(private authService: AuthService) {
    super({ usernameField: 'email' });
  }
  async validate(
    email: string,
    password: string
  ): Promise<UserWithoutPassword> {
    const user = await this.authService.validateUser(email, password);
    if (!user) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException();
    }
    return user;
  }
}
</file>

<file path="libs/server/utils/src/lib/relay-connection.ts">
import { Field, Int, ObjectType } from '@nestjs/graphql';
@ObjectType()
export class PageInfo {
  @Field(() => String, { nullable: true })
  endCursor?: string;
  @Field(() => Boolean)
  hasNextPage: boolean;
  @Field(() => Boolean)
  hasPreviousPage: boolean;
}
export type ConnectionArgs = {
  first?: number;
  after?: string | null;
  searchTerm?: string;
};
export type Node = {
  id: string | number;
};
export type Edge<T extends Node> = {
  cursor: string | number;
  node: T;
};
export type Connection<T extends Node> = {
  edges: Edge<T>[];
  pageInfo: PageInfo;
  totalCount: number;
};
export function parseOffset(cursor?: string | null): number {
  if (!cursor) return 0;
  // If it's a UUID, it's not an offset
  if (
    /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(
      cursor
    )
  ) {
    return 0;
  }
  const trimmed = cursor.trim();
  const num = parseInt(trimmed, 10);
  if (!isNaN(num) && String(num) === trimmed) {
    return num;
  }
  if (trimmed.startsWith('cursor:')) {
    const val = parseInt(trimmed.replace('cursor:', ''), 10);
    if (!isNaN(val)) return val;
  }
  try {
    const decoded = Buffer.from(trimmed, 'base64').toString('utf8');
    if (decoded.startsWith('cursor:')) {
      const val = parseInt(decoded.replace('cursor:', ''), 10);
      if (!isNaN(val)) return val;
    }
    const val = parseInt(decoded, 10);
    if (!isNaN(val)) return val;
  } catch {
    // Non-base64 or invalid format - fallback to numeric parse
  }
  if (!isNaN(num)) return num;
  return 0;
}
export function createConnection<T extends Node>(
  nodes: T[],
  totalCount: number,
  first: number,
  after?: string | null
): Connection<T> {
  const isUuid = Boolean(
    after &&
      /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(
        after
      )
  );
  if (isUuid) {
    const edges: Edge<T>[] = nodes.map((node) => ({
      cursor: node.id,
      node,
    }));
    return {
      edges,
      pageInfo: {
        endCursor:
          edges.length > 0 ? String(edges[edges.length - 1].cursor) : undefined,
        hasNextPage: nodes.length >= (first || 10),
        hasPreviousPage: !!after,
      },
      totalCount,
    };
  }
  const currentOffset = parseOffset(after);
  const edges: Edge<T>[] = nodes.map((node, index) => ({
    cursor: String(currentOffset + index + 1),
    node,
  }));
  const pageInfo: PageInfo = {
    endCursor:
      edges.length > 0 ? String(currentOffset + nodes.length) : undefined,
    hasNextPage: currentOffset + nodes.length < totalCount,
    hasPreviousPage: currentOffset > 0,
  };
  return {
    edges,
    pageInfo,
    totalCount,
  };
}
@ObjectType({ isAbstract: true })
export class EdgeType<T> {
  @Field(() => String)
  cursor: string | number;
}
@ObjectType({ isAbstract: true })
export class ConnectionType<T> {
  @Field(() => PageInfo)
  pageInfo: PageInfo;
  @Field(() => Int)
  totalCount: number;
}
</file>

import {
  SizeKind,
  expandFilterSizes,
  inferSizeKindFromRaw,
  normalizeSizeCode,
  parsePantsSize,
  FootwearSizeSystem,
} from './product-sizes';
const VALID = [
  '32x34', '32X34', '32 x 34', '32×34', '32*34',
  'W32/L34', 'w32/l34', 'W32 / L34', 'W32xL34', 'w32xl34',
  'W32-L34', 'W32 L34', 'w32 l34', 'W32L34', '32/34', '32 / 34',
];
const INVALID = [
  'W0/L34', '0/34', '-32/34', '32.5/34', 'W999/L34', '999/34',
  '0x34', '-32x34', '32.5x34', '999x34',
];
describe('product-sizes pants notation coverage (P1b)', () => {
  it.each(VALID)('parsePantsSize(%s) -> 32/34', (raw) => {
    expect(parsePantsSize(raw)).toEqual({ waist: 32, inseam: 34 });
  });
  it.each(INVALID)('parsePantsSize(%s) -> null', (raw) => {
    expect(parsePantsSize(raw)).toBeNull();
  });
  it.each(VALID)('normalizeSizeCode(Pants, %s) -> 32x34', (raw) => {
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Pants, raw)).toBe('32x34');
  });
  it.each([...INVALID, '', '   ', 'M'])('normalizeSizeCode(Pants, %s) -> null', (raw) => {
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Pants, raw)).toBeNull();
  });
  it.each(VALID)('inferSizeKindFromRaw(%s) -> Pants 32x34', (raw) => {
    expect(inferSizeKindFromRaw(raw)).toEqual({ sizeKind: SizeKind.Pants, size: '32x34' });
  });
  it.each(['0x34', '-32x34', '32.5x34', '999x34'])('inferSizeKindFromRaw(%s) is not Pants', (raw) => {
    expect(inferSizeKindFromRaw(raw).sizeKind).not.toBe(SizeKind.Pants);
  });
  it('expandFilterSizes(Pants) normalizes, drops invalid, dedupes in order', () => {
    expect(
      expandFilterSizes(SizeKind.Pants, FootwearSizeSystem.Eu, [
        '32x34', 'W32/L34', '32/34', '32X34', '34x32', '0x34', 'M',
      ]),
    ).toEqual(['32x34', '34x32']);
  });
});

import {
  SizeKind,
  expandFilterSizes,
  formatPantsSize,
  formatSizeLabel,
  inferSizeKindFromRaw,
  normalizeSizeCode,
  parsePantsSize,
} from './product-sizes';
describe('product-sizes strict pants parsing and formatting (P1a)', () => {
  it('parses valid 1..99 integer waist and inseam formats', () => {
    expect(parsePantsSize('32x34')).toEqual({ waist: 32, inseam: 34 });
    expect(parsePantsSize('1x99')).toEqual({ waist: 1, inseam: 99 });
    expect(parsePantsSize('32X34')).toEqual({ waist: 32, inseam: 34 });
    expect(parsePantsSize('32×34')).toEqual({ waist: 32, inseam: 34 });
    expect(parsePantsSize('W32/L34')).toEqual({ waist: 32, inseam: 34 });
    expect(parsePantsSize('w32/l34')).toEqual({ waist: 32, inseam: 34 });
    expect(parsePantsSize('32/34')).toEqual({ waist: 32, inseam: 34 });
    expect(parsePantsSize('W32 L34')).toEqual({ waist: 32, inseam: 34 });
  });
  it('rejects 0, leading zeros, negative, decimal, >99, empty, and non-numeric inputs in parsePantsSize', () => {
    expect(parsePantsSize('0x34')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePantsSize('32x0')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePantsSize('032x34')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePantsSize('-32x34')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePantsSize('32x-34')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePantsSize('32.5x34')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePantsSize('32x34.5')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePantsSize('100x34')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePantsSize('32x100')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePantsSize('999x34')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePantsSize('')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePantsSize('   ')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePantsSize('32x')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePantsSize('x34')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePantsSize('abc')).toBeNull();
  });
  it('formats valid 1..99 integers and returns empty string for invalid inputs in formatPantsSize', () => {
    expect(formatPantsSize(32, 34)).toBe('32x34');
    expect(formatPantsSize('32', '34')).toBe('32x34');
    expect(formatPantsSize(' 32 ', ' 34 ')).toBe('32x34');
    expect(formatPantsSize(1, 99)).toBe('1x99');
    expect(formatPantsSize(0, 34)).toBe('');
    expect(formatPantsSize(32, 0)).toBe('');
    expect(formatPantsSize('0', '34')).toBe('');
    expect(formatPantsSize('032', '34')).toBe('');
    expect(formatPantsSize(-32, 34)).toBe('');
    expect(formatPantsSize(32, -34)).toBe('');
    expect(formatPantsSize(32.5, 34)).toBe('');
    expect(formatPantsSize('32.5', '34')).toBe('');
    expect(formatPantsSize(999, 34)).toBe('');
    expect(formatPantsSize(32, 100)).toBe('');
    expect(formatPantsSize('', 34)).toBe('');
    expect(formatPantsSize(32, '')).toBe('');
    expect(formatPantsSize('   ', '34')).toBe('');
    expect(formatPantsSize('abc', '34')).toBe('');
    expect(formatPantsSize(NaN, 34)).toBe('');
    expect(formatPantsSize(Infinity, 34)).toBe('');
  });
  it('preserves kind-first normalizeSizeCode null contract, inferSizeKindFromRaw shape, formatSizeLabel, and canonical expandFilterSizes', () => {
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Pants, '32x34')).toBe('32x34');
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Pants, 'W32/L34')).toBe('32x34');
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Pants, '32/34')).toBe('32x34');
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Pants, '0x34')).toBeNull();
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Pants, '-32x34')).toBeNull();
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Pants, '32.5x34')).toBeNull();
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Pants, '999x34')).toBeNull();
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Pants, '')).toBeNull();
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Pants, 'M')).toBeNull();
    expect(inferSizeKindFromRaw('32x34')).toEqual({
      sizeKind: SizeKind.Pants,
      size: '32x34',
    });
    expect(inferSizeKindFromRaw('W32/L34')).toEqual({
      sizeKind: SizeKind.Pants,
      size: '32x34',
    });
    expect(inferSizeKindFromRaw('32/34')).toEqual({
      sizeKind: SizeKind.Pants,
      size: '32x34',
    });
    expect(formatSizeLabel(SizeKind.Pants, 'W32/L34')).toBe(
      formatSizeLabel(SizeKind.Pants, '32x34'),
    );
    expect(formatSizeLabel(SizeKind.Pants, '32/34')).toBe(
      formatSizeLabel(SizeKind.Pants, '32x34'),
    );
    expect(
      expandFilterSizes(SizeKind.Pants, undefined, ['32x34', 'W32/L34', '34x32']),
    ).toEqual(['32x34', '34x32']);
  });
});

import { initFormatters } from './formatters'
import type { Locales, Translations } from './i18n-types'
import { loadedFormatters, loadedLocales, locales } from './i18n-util'
const localeTranslationLoaders = {
	en: () => import('./en'),
	fa: () => import('./fa'),
}
const updateDictionary = (locale: Locales, dictionary: Partial<Translations>): Translations =>
	loadedLocales[locale] = { ...loadedLocales[locale], ...dictionary }
export const importLocaleAsync = async (locale: Locales): Promise<Translations> =>
	(await localeTranslationLoaders[locale]()).default as unknown as Translations
export const loadLocaleAsync = async (locale: Locales): Promise<void> => {
	updateDictionary(locale, await importLocaleAsync(locale))
	loadFormatters(locale)
}
export const loadAllLocalesAsync = (): Promise<void[]> => Promise.all(locales.map(loadLocaleAsync))
export const loadFormatters = (locale: Locales): void =>
	void (loadedFormatters[locale] = initFormatters(locale))

import { initFormatters } from './formatters'
import type { Locales, Translations } from './i18n-types'

import fa from './fa'

	en,
	fa,

export const loadLocale = (locale: Locales): void => {

	loadedLocales[locale] = localeTranslations[locale] as unknown as Translations
	loadFormatters(locale)

<file path="libs/shared/shared-i18n/src/lib/language-context.tsx">
import React, {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useState,
  ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { loadLocaleAsync } from './locales/i18n-util.async';
import type { Locales } from './locales/i18n-types';
import { I18nContext } from './locales/i18n-react';
import {
  DEFAULT_LOCALE,
  getInitialLocale,
  LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY,
} from './language-detector';
interface LanguageContextType {
  currentLocale: Locales;
  setLocale: (locale: Locales) => void;
  availableLocales: { code: Locales; name: string; nativeName: string }[];
  isLoading: boolean;
  formatNumber: (num: number | string) => string;
  isRTL: boolean;
}
const LanguageContext = createContext<LanguageContextType | undefined>(
  undefined
);
// Available languages with their display names
const AVAILABLE_LOCALES = [
  { code: 'en' as Locales, name: 'English', nativeName: 'English' },
  { code: 'fa' as Locales, name: 'Farsi', nativeName: 'فارسی' },
];
// Convert Western numerals to Farsi numerals
const toFarsiNumber = (num: number | string): string => {
  const farsiDigits = ['۰', '۱', '۲', '۳', '۴', '۵', '۶', '۷', '۸', '۹'];
  return String(num).replace(/\d/g, (digit) => farsiDigits[parseInt(digit)]);
};
// Format number based on locale
const formatNumberByLocale = (
  num: number | string,
  locale: Locales
): string => {
  return locale === 'fa' ? toFarsiNumber(num) : String(num);
};
interface LanguageProviderProps {
  children: ReactNode;
}
export function LanguageProvider({ children }: LanguageProviderProps) {
  const [currentLocale, setCurrentLocale] = useState<Locales>(getInitialLocale);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const i18nContext = useContext(I18nContext);
  // Initialize language and keep document attributes in sync
  useEffect(() => {
    const initializeLanguage = async () => {
      try {
        const localeToUse = getInitialLocale();
        await loadLocaleAsync(localeToUse);
        setCurrentLocale(localeToUse);
        if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
          document.documentElement.lang = localeToUse;
          document.documentElement.dir = localeToUse === 'fa' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
          const skipLink = document.querySelector('.skip-link');
          if (skipLink) {
            skipLink.textContent =
              localeToUse === 'fa' ? 'رفتن به محتوا' : 'Skip to content';
          }
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to initialize language:', error);
      }
    };
    initializeLanguage();
  }, []);
  const setLocale = async (locale: Locales) => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      await loadLocaleAsync(locale);
      setCurrentLocale(locale);
      localStorage.setItem(LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY, locale);
      if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
        document.cookie = `kickzone-language-preference=${locale}; path=/; max-age=31536000; SameSite=Lax`;
        document.documentElement.lang = locale;
        document.documentElement.dir = locale === 'fa' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
        const skipLink = document.querySelector('.skip-link');
        if (skipLink) {
          skipLink.textContent =
            locale === 'fa' ? 'رفتن به محتوا' : 'Skip to content';
        }
      }
      // Update the i18n context if available
      if (i18nContext && i18nContext.setLocale) {
        i18nContext.setLocale(locale);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to change language:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };
  const formatNumber = (num: number | string): string => {
    return formatNumberByLocale(num, currentLocale);
  };
  // Determine if the current locale is RTL
  const isRTL = currentLocale === 'fa';
  const value: LanguageContextType = {
    currentLocale,
    setLocale,
    availableLocales: AVAILABLE_LOCALES,
    isLoading,
    formatNumber,
    isRTL,
  };
  return (
    <LanguageContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </LanguageContext.Provider>
  );
}
export function useLanguageContext(): LanguageContextType {
  const context = useContext(LanguageContext);
  if (context === undefined) {
    throw new Error(
      'useLanguageContext must be used within a LanguageProvider'
    );
  }
  return context;
}
</file>

<file path="libs/shared/shared-i18n/src/lib/language-detector.ts">
import { LocaleDetector } from 'typesafe-i18n/detectors';
import type { Locales } from './locales/i18n-types';
export const LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY = 'kickzone-language-preference';
export const DEFAULT_LOCALE: Locales = 'fa';
const SUPPORTED_LOCALES: Locales[] = ['en', 'fa'];
/** First-visit default is Farsi; only a saved preference overrides it. */
export function getInitialLocale(): Locales {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return DEFAULT_LOCALE;
  }
  try {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem(LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY) as Locales | null;
    if (stored && SUPPORTED_LOCALES.includes(stored)) {
      return stored;
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('Failed to read language from localStorage:', error);
  }
  return DEFAULT_LOCALE;
}
export const localStorageDetector: LocaleDetector = (): string[] => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return [];
  }
  try {
    const storedLanguage = localStorage.getItem(LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY);
    return storedLanguage ? [storedLanguage] : [];
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('Failed to read language from localStorage:', error);
    return [];
  }
};

}
/**
 * Hook that provides MaterialReactTable localization using the current language context
 * @returns MRT_Localization object for MaterialReactTable
 */
export function useTableLocalization(): Partial<MRT_Localization> {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  return createTableLocalization(LL);
}

export function RTLThemeProvider({ children }: RTLThemeProviderProps) {
  const { currentLocale } = useLanguageContext();
  const themeState = useUIStore((s) => s.theme);
  const mode = themeState.mode;
  const isRTL = currentLocale === 'fa';
  const direction = isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
  const fontFamily = isRTL ? farsiStack : latinStack;

    if (isRTL) {
      return createCache({
        key: 'muirtl',
        stylisPlugins: [prefixer, rtlPlugin],
      });

    return createCache({
      key: 'muiltr',
      stylisPlugins: [prefixer],
    });

    document.documentElement.dir = direction;
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('dir', direction);
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('lang', currentLocale);
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', mode);
    document.documentElement.setAttribute(
      'data-locale',
      currentLocale === 'fa' ? 'fa' : 'en'

    let link = document.getElementById(FONT_LINK_ID) as HTMLLinkElement | null;

      link = document.createElement('link');
      link.id = FONT_LINK_ID;
      link.rel = 'stylesheet';
      document.head.appendChild(link);

export function useThemeContext(): ThemeContextType {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (context === undefined) {
    throw new Error('useThemeContext must be used within a RTLThemeProvider');
  }
  return context;
}

<file path="libs/shared/shared-i18n/src/lib/use-page-title.ts">
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useI18nContext } from '../lib/locales/i18n-react';
/**
 * Hook to set the page title with the site name from i18n.
 * @param titleGetter - A function that returns the translated page title (without site name)
 */
export function usePageTitle(titleGetter?: () => string) {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  useEffect(() => {
    const pageTitle = titleGetter ? titleGetter() : '';
    const title = pageTitle
      ? `${LL.appNames.siteName()} - ${pageTitle}`
      : LL.appNames.siteName();
    document.title = title;
  }, [LL, titleGetter]);
}

/**
 * Database Seed Script for Basic Categories
 *
 * Inserts common catalog categories with English and Farsi names.
 * Safe to re-run (skips existing slugs, only adds missing translations).
 *
 * Prefer letting the API seed these on startup (CategoryService.onModuleInit).
 * Use this script only if you need to seed without starting the API:
 *   npx ts-node server/src/lib/seed-categories.ts
 */
import { DataSource } from 'typeorm';
import { Category } from '../../../libs/server/entities/src/lib/category.entity';
import { Translation } from '../../../libs/server/entities/src/lib/translation.entity';
import { BASIC_CATEGORIES } from '../../../libs/server/services/src/lib/category.service';
async function seedCategories() {
  const dataSource = new DataSource({
    type: 'postgres',
    host: process.env.DB_HOST || 'localhost',
    port: 5432,
    username: process.env.DB_USERNAME || 'postgres',
    password: process.env.DB_PASSWORD || 'postgres',
    database: process.env.DB_NAME || 'kickzone',
    entities: [Category, Translation],
    synchronize: false,
  });
  await dataSource.initialize();
  console.log('✅ Database connected');
  const categoryRepo = dataSource.getRepository(Category);
  const translationRepo = dataSource.getRepository(Translation);
  try {
    let created = 0;
    for (const basic of BASIC_CATEGORIES) {
      let category = await categoryRepo.findOne({
        where: { slug: basic.slug },
      });
      if (!category) {
        category = await categoryRepo.save(
          categoryRepo.create({
            slug: basic.slug,
            sortOrder: basic.sortOrder,
            isActive: true,
          })
        );
        created += 1;
        console.log(`✅ Created category ${basic.name.en} (${basic.slug})`);
      } else {
        console.log(
          `ℹ️  Category ${basic.name.en} (${basic.slug}) already exists`
        );
      }
      for (const [locale, value] of [
        ['en', basic.name.en],
        ['fa', basic.name.fa],
      ] as const) {
        const existing = await translationRepo.findOne({
          where: {
            entityType: 'category',
            entityId: category.id,
            locale,
            fieldName: 'name',
          },
        });
        if (!existing) {
          await translationRepo.save(
            translationRepo.create({
              entityType: 'category',
              entityId: category.id,
              locale,
              fieldName: 'name',
              value,
              isAutoTranslated: false,
            })
          );
        }
      }
    }
    console.log(`\n✅ Category seeding completed (${created} new categor(y/ies))`);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('❌ Error seeding categories:', error);
  } finally {
    await dataSource.destroy();
    console.log('\n✅ Database connection closed');
  }
}
seedCategories().catch((error) => {
  console.error('❌ Fatal error:', error);
  process.exit(1);
});

<file path="server/src/lib/seed-colors.ts">
/**
 * Database Seed Script for Basic Colors
 *
 * Inserts common catalog colors with English and Farsi names.
 * Safe to re-run (skips existing hex codes, upserts translations).
 *
 * Prefer letting the API seed these on startup (ColorService.onModuleInit).
 * Use this script only if you need to seed without starting the API:
 *   npx ts-node server/src/lib/seed-colors.ts
 */
import { DataSource } from 'typeorm';
import { Color } from '../../../libs/server/entities/src/lib/color.entity';
import { Translation } from '../../../libs/server/entities/src/lib/translation.entity';
import { BASIC_COLORS } from '../../../libs/server/services/src/lib/color.service';
function normalizeHex(hexCode: string): string {
  const trimmed = hexCode.trim();
  return trimmed.startsWith('#')
    ? trimmed.toUpperCase()
    : `#${trimmed.toUpperCase()}`;
}
async function seedColors() {
  const dataSource = new DataSource({
    type: 'postgres',
    host: process.env.DB_HOST || 'localhost',
    port: 5432,
    username: process.env.DB_USERNAME || 'postgres',
    password: process.env.DB_PASSWORD || 'postgres',
    database: process.env.DB_NAME || 'kickzone',
    entities: [Color, Translation],
    synchronize: false,
  });
  await dataSource.initialize();
  console.log('✅ Database connected');
  const colorRepo = dataSource.getRepository(Color);
  const translationRepo = dataSource.getRepository(Translation);
  try {
    let created = 0;
    for (const basic of BASIC_COLORS) {
      const hexCode = normalizeHex(basic.hexCode);
      let color = await colorRepo.findOne({ where: { hexCode } });
      if (!color) {
        color = await colorRepo.save(
          colorRepo.create({
            hexCode,
            sortOrder: basic.sortOrder,
            isActive: true,
          })
        );
        created += 1;
        console.log(`✅ Created color ${basic.name.en} (${hexCode})`);
      } else {
        console.log(`ℹ️  Color ${basic.name.en} (${hexCode}) already exists`);
      }
      for (const [locale, value] of [
        ['en', basic.name.en],
        ['fa', basic.name.fa],
      ] as const) {
        const existing = await translationRepo.findOne({
          where: {
            entityType: 'color',
            entityId: color.id,
            locale,
            fieldName: 'name',
          },
        });
        if (!existing) {
          await translationRepo.save(
            translationRepo.create({
              entityType: 'color',
              entityId: color.id,
              locale,
              fieldName: 'name',
              value,
              isAutoTranslated: false,
            })
          );
        }
      }
    }
    console.log(`\n✅ Color seeding completed (${created} new color(s))`);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('❌ Error seeding colors:', error);
  } finally {
    await dataSource.destroy();
    console.log('\n✅ Database connection closed');
  }
}
seedColors().catch((error) => {
  console.error('❌ Fatal error:', error);
  process.exit(1);
});

<file path="server/src/lib/seed-currencies.ts">
/**
 * Database Seed Script for Currencies
 *
 * This script initializes the database with:
 * - USD (US Dollar) as the base currency
 * - IRR row used for Farsi display / ZarinPal (amounts stored as Toman / تومان)
 * - Initial exchange rate: 1 USD = 50,000 Toman (adjust as needed)
 * - Currency preferences: fa → IRR, en → USD
 *
 * Run this script once after setting up the database:
 * ts-node server/src/lib/seed-currencies.ts
 */
import { DataSource } from 'typeorm';
import { Currency } from '../../../libs/server/entities/src/lib/currency.entity';
import { ExchangeRate } from '../../../libs/server/entities/src/lib/exchange-rate.entity';
import { CurrencyPreference } from '../../../libs/server/entities/src/lib/currency-preference.entity';
async function seedCurrencies() {
  // Create database connection
  const dataSource = new DataSource({
    type: 'postgres',
    host: process.env.DB_HOST || 'localhost',
    port: 5432,
    username: process.env.DB_USERNAME || 'postgres',
    password: process.env.DB_PASSWORD || 'postgres',
    database: process.env.DB_NAME || 'kickzone',
    entities: [Currency, ExchangeRate, CurrencyPreference],
    synchronize: false,
  });
  await dataSource.initialize();
  console.log('✅ Database connected');
  const currencyRepo = dataSource.getRepository(Currency);
  const exchangeRateRepo = dataSource.getRepository(ExchangeRate);
  const preferenceRepo = dataSource.getRepository(CurrencyPreference);
  try {
    // 1. Create USD (Base Currency)
    let usd = await currencyRepo.findOne({ where: { code: 'USD' } });
    if (!usd) {
      usd = currencyRepo.create({
        code: 'USD',
        name: 'US Dollar',
        symbol: '$',
        decimalPlaces: 2,
        isActive: true,
        isBaseCurrency: true,
      });
      await currencyRepo.save(usd);
      console.log('✅ Created USD currency');
    } else {
      console.log('ℹ️  USD currency already exists');
    }
    // 2. Create IRR row used for Farsi display / ZarinPal amounts.
    // NOTE: We label the code IRR but store values as Toman (تومان), matching
    // ZarinPal's IRT unit. Do not treat these amounts as Rials.
    let irr = await currencyRepo.findOne({ where: { code: 'IRR' } });
    if (!irr) {
      irr = currencyRepo.create({
        code: 'IRR',
        name: 'Iranian Toman (stored as IRR)',
        symbol: 'تومان',
        decimalPlaces: 0, // No decimal places for Toman
        isActive: true,
        isBaseCurrency: false,
      });
      await currencyRepo.save(irr);
      console.log('✅ Created IRR currency (Toman amounts)');
    } else {
      console.log('ℹ️  IRR currency already exists');
    }
    // 3. Set initial exchange rate (USD → Toman under IRR code)
    // NOTE: Adjust this rate according to current market rates
    const existingRate = await exchangeRateRepo.findOne({
      where: {
        fromCurrencyId: usd.id,
        toCurrencyId: irr.id,
      },
    });
    if (!existingRate) {
      const exchangeRate = exchangeRateRepo.create({
        fromCurrencyId: usd.id,
        toCurrencyId: irr.id,
        rate: 50000, // 1 USD = 50,000 Toman (adjust as needed)
        effectiveDate: new Date(),
        notes: 'Initial exchange rate - seed data (Toman under IRR code)',
      });
      await exchangeRateRepo.save(exchangeRate);
      console.log(
        '✅ Created initial USD→IRR exchange rate: 1 USD = 50,000 Toman'
      );
    } else {
      console.log('ℹ️  Exchange rate already exists');
    }
    // 4. Set currency preferences
    // Farsi (fa) → Iranian Rial
    let faPreference = await preferenceRepo.findOne({
      where: { locale: 'fa' },
    });
    if (!faPreference) {
      faPreference = preferenceRepo.create({
        locale: 'fa',
        currencyId: irr.id,
        isActive: true,
      });
      await preferenceRepo.save(faPreference);
      console.log('✅ Created preference: fa → IRR');
    } else {
      console.log('ℹ️  Farsi preference already exists');
    }
    // English (en) → US Dollar
    let enPreference = await preferenceRepo.findOne({
      where: { locale: 'en' },
    });
    if (!enPreference) {
      enPreference = preferenceRepo.create({
        locale: 'en',
        currencyId: usd.id,
        isActive: true,
      });
      await preferenceRepo.save(enPreference);
      console.log('✅ Created preference: en → USD');
    } else {
      console.log('ℹ️  English preference already exists');
    }
    console.log('\n✅ Currency seeding completed successfully!');
    console.log('\nSummary:');
    console.log('- Base currency: USD');
    console.log('- Available currencies: USD, IRR');
    console.log('- Exchange rate: 1 USD = 50,000 Toman');
    console.log('- Locale preferences: fa→IRR, en→USD');
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('❌ Error seeding currencies:', error);
  } finally {
    await dataSource.destroy();
    console.log('\n✅ Database connection closed');
  }
}
// Run the seed function
seedCurrencies().catch((error) => {
  console.error('❌ Fatal error:', error);
  process.exit(1);
});
</file>

import { DataSource } from 'typeorm';

    type: 'postgres',
    host: process.env.DB_HOST || 'localhost',
    port: 5432,
    username: process.env.DB_USERNAME || 'postgres',
    password: process.env.DB_PASSWORD || 'postgres',

    entities: [SiteLanguage],
    synchronize: false,
  });
  await dataSource.initialize();
  console.log('✅ Database connected');
  const langRepo = dataSource.getRepository(SiteLanguage);
  try {
    for (const basic of BASIC_LANGUAGES) {
      let lang = await langRepo.findOne({ where: { code: basic.code } });

      } else {
        console.log(`ℹ️  Site language ${basic.code} already exists`);
      }
    }
    console.log('✅ Site languages seeding complete');
  } catch (err) {

import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
import { vi } from 'vitest';
// jsdom does not implement canvas; lottie-web crashes without this stub.

import { Test } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { DataSource } from 'typeorm';
import { PaymentResolver } from '@kickzone-workspace/resolvers';
import { CurrencyService } from '@kickzone-workspace/services';
import { AppModule } from './app.module';
/**
 * Compiles the real AppModule so Nest's DI graph is checked without a database.
 * Repository factories only need a DataSource-shaped object at construction time.
 */
describe('AppModule dependency graph', () => {
  jest.setTimeout(30000);
  it('constructs PaymentResolver with CurrencyService', async () => {
    const dataSource = {
      options: { type: 'postgres' },
      entityMetadatas: [],
      isInitialized: true,
      manager: {},
      initialize: jest.fn(),
      destroy: jest.fn(),
      getRepository: jest.fn().mockReturnValue({}),
      getTreeRepository: jest.fn(),
      getMongoRepository: jest.fn(),
    };
    const moduleRef = await Test.createTestingModule({
      imports: [AppModule],
    })
      .overrideProvider(DataSource)
      .useValue(dataSource)
      .compile();
    const resolver = moduleRef.get(PaymentResolver);
    const currencyService = moduleRef.get(CurrencyService);
    expect(resolver).toBeInstanceOf(PaymentResolver);
    expect(
      (resolver as unknown as { currencyService: CurrencyService })
        .currencyService
    ).toBe(currencyService);
    await moduleRef.close();
  });
});

<file path="apps/kickzone-api/src/app/global-validation-pipe.spec.ts">
import { BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { readFileSync } from 'fs';
import { join } from 'path';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from '@kickzone-workspace/resolvers';
import {
  addToCartSchema,
  createBrandSchema,
  createProductSchema,
  createSellerSchema,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import {
  AddToCartInput,
  CreateBrandInput,
  CreateProductInput,
  CreateSellerInput,
  ProductVariantInput,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
/**
 * The global class-validator ValidationPipe was removed (V9). Arguments are now
 * validated per resolver argument by ZodValidationPipe with the shared schemas.
 */
describe('Global Validation Pipe (replaced by per-argument Zod pipes)', () => {
  it('main.ts no longer registers a global validation pipe', () => {
    const main = readFileSync(join(__dirname, '..', 'main.ts'), 'utf8');
    expect(main).not.toMatch(/useGlobalPipes|ValidationPipe/);
  });
  describe('valid inputs pass through unchanged (fields not stripped)', () => {
    it('should pass AddToCartInput unchanged', () => {
      const input: AddToCartInput = { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 2 };
      expect(new ZodValidationPipe(addToCartSchema).transform(input)).toEqual(input);
    });
    it.each([
      { slug: 'nike', sortOrder: 5 },
      { slug: 'adidas', sortOrder: 10 },
    ])('should pass CreateBrandInput %p unchanged', (input: CreateBrandInput) => {
      expect(new ZodValidationPipe(createBrandSchema).transform(input)).toEqual(input);
    });
  });
  describe('product and seller rules', () => {
    const productPipe = new ZodValidationPipe(createProductSchema);
    const product = (weight: number): CreateProductInput => ({
      name: 'X',
      sku: 'S',
      categoryIds: [1],
      variants: [{ size: 'M', colorIds: [1], weight } as ProductVariantInput],
    });
    it('should reject CreateProductInput with invalid weight (0) via BadRequestException', () => {
      expect(() => productPipe.transform(product(0))).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });
    it('should resolve CreateProductInput with valid weight (1.5)', () => {
      expect(productPipe.transform(product(1.5))).toEqual(product(1.5));
    });
    const sellerPipe = new ZodValidationPipe(createSellerSchema);
    const seller = {
      name: 'John',
      lastName: 'Doe',
      username: 'johndoe',
      email: 'john@example.com',
      password: 'password123',
    };
    it('should reject CreateSellerInput with empty storeName via BadRequestException', () => {
      const input: CreateSellerInput = { ...seller, storeName: '' };
      expect(() => sellerPipe.transform(input)).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });
    it('should reject CreateSellerInput with missing storeName via BadRequestException', () => {
      expect(() => sellerPipe.transform(seller)).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });
  });
});

<file path="apps/kickzone-api/src/app/order-inputs.validation.spec.ts">
import { BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from '@kickzone-workspace/resolvers';
import { createOrderSchema } from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import { CreateOrderInput, CreateOrderItemInput } from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
describe('Order Inputs Validation', () => {
  const pipe = new ZodValidationPipe(createOrderSchema);
  const validOrderItem: CreateOrderItemInput = {
    productId: 'prod-1',
    productName: 'Test Product',
    quantity: 1,
    unitPrice: 10.0,
    totalPrice: 10.0,
  };
  const validOrderBase = {
    customerEmail: 'customer@example.com',
    customerPhone: '+1234567890',
    customerName: 'John Doe',
    shippingAddress: '123 Main St',
    city: 'New York',
    state: 'NY',
    zipCode: '10001',
    country: 'USA',
    sellerId: 1,
  };
  it('should reject CreateOrderInput with quantity 0 via BadRequestException', () => {
    const input: CreateOrderInput = {
      ...validOrderBase,
      items: [{ ...validOrderItem, quantity: 0 }], // invalid: must be >= 1
    };
    expect(() => pipe.transform(input)).toThrow(BadRequestException);
  });
  it('should reject CreateOrderInput with quantity 1.5 via BadRequestException', () => {
    const input: CreateOrderInput = {
      ...validOrderBase,
      items: [{ ...validOrderItem, quantity: 1.5 }], // invalid: must be integer
    };
    expect(() => pipe.transform(input)).toThrow(BadRequestException);
  });
  it('should resolve CreateOrderInput with quantity 1 and valid fields', () => {
    const input: CreateOrderInput = { ...validOrderBase, items: [validOrderItem] };
    expect(pipe.transform(input)).toEqual(input);
  });
});

<file path="apps/kickzone-api/src/app/seller-product-inputs.validation.spec.ts">
import { BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from '@kickzone-workspace/resolvers';
import { createSellerProductSchema, updateSellerProductSchema } from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import { CreateSellerProductInput, UpdateSellerProductInput } from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
describe('Seller Product Inputs Validation', () => {
  const createPipe = new ZodValidationPipe(createSellerProductSchema);
  const updatePipe = new ZodValidationPipe(updateSellerProductSchema);
  const validCreateBase: CreateSellerProductInput = {
    productInfoId: 1,
    price: 100,
    costPrice: 50,
    discount: 10,
    stockQuantity: 5,
  };
  describe('CreateSellerProductInput', () => {
    it('should resolve valid base input', () => {
      expect(createPipe.transform(validCreateBase)).toEqual(validCreateBase);
    });
    it.each([
      ['discount 101', { discount: 101 }],
      ['discount -1', { discount: -1 }],
      ['price 0', { price: 0 }],
      ['costPrice -1', { costPrice: -1 }],
      ['stockQuantity 1.5', { stockQuantity: 1.5 }],
    ])('should reject %s via BadRequestException', (_label, patch) => {
      const input: CreateSellerProductInput = { ...validCreateBase, ...patch };
      expect(() => createPipe.transform(input)).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });
    it.each([
      ['discount 100', { discount: 100 }],
      ['stockQuantity 0', { stockQuantity: 0 }],
    ])('should resolve %s', (_label, patch) => {
      const input: CreateSellerProductInput = { ...validCreateBase, ...patch };
      expect(createPipe.transform(input)).toEqual(input);
    });
  });
  describe('UpdateSellerProductInput', () => {
    it('should reject discount 150 via BadRequestException', () => {
      const input: UpdateSellerProductInput = { id: 'sp-1', discount: 150 };
      expect(() => updatePipe.transform(input)).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });
    it('should resolve with only id', () => {
      const input: UpdateSellerProductInput = { id: 'sp-1' };
      expect(updatePipe.transform(input)).toEqual(input);
    });
    it('should resolve with stockQuantity 0', () => {
      const input: UpdateSellerProductInput = { id: 'sp-1', stockQuantity: 0 };
      expect(updatePipe.transform(input)).toEqual(input);
    });
  });
});

<file path="apps/kickzone-api/src/main.ts">
import { Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import { NestExpressApplication } from '@nestjs/platform-express';
import { Logger as PinoLogger } from 'nestjs-pino';
import { join } from 'path';
import { AppModule } from './app/app.module';
import cookieParser from 'cookie-parser';
import graphqlUploadExpress from 'graphql-upload/graphqlUploadExpress.js';
import helmet from 'helmet';
type HotModule = {
  hot?: {
    accept: () => void;
    dispose: (callback: () => void) => void;
  };
};
declare const module: HotModule;
async function bootstrap() {
  // In production we run behind nginx and terminate TLS there,
  // so the NestJS app should use plain HTTP.
  const app = await NestFactory.create<NestExpressApplication>(AppModule, {
    bufferLogs: true,
  });
  app.useLogger(app.get(PinoLogger));
  console.log('this is module', module);
  if (module.hot) {
    Logger.log('HOT2');
    module.hot.accept();
    module.hot.dispose(() => app.close());
  }
  // CORS configuration - supports both development and production subdomains
  const allowedOrigins = [
    // Development origins (127.0.0.1 preferred; localhost kept for browser redirects)
    'https://127.0.0.1:4300',
    'https://127.0.0.1:4400',
    'https://127.0.0.1:4500',
    'https://localhost:4300',
    'https://localhost:4400',
    'https://localhost:4500',
    'https://studio.apollographql.com',
    // Production origins
    'https://saintbala.com',
    'https://www.saintbala.com',
    'https://admins.saintbala.com',
    'https://seller.saintbala.com',
    'https://masterskey.store',
    'https://www.masterskey.store',
    'https://admins.masterskey.store',
    'https://seller.masterskey.store',
  ];
  // Add additional origins from environment variable if provided
  if (process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS) {
    allowedOrigins.push(...process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS.split(','));
  }
  app.enableCors({
    origin: allowedOrigins,
    credentials: true,
    methods: 'GET,HEAD,PUT,PATCH,POST,DELETE,OPTIONS',
    // allowedHeaders: 'Content-Type,Authorization',
  });
  app.use(cookieParser());
  // Security headers (tuned for API behind nginx)
  app.use(
    helmet({
      contentSecurityPolicy: false, // APIs don’t need CSP; disable to avoid misconfig
      crossOriginResourcePolicy: { policy: 'cross-origin' },
      hsts: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? undefined : false,
    })
  );
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
    app.use(
      helmet.hsts({
        maxAge: 15552000, // 180 days
        includeSubDomains: true,
        preload: false,
      })
    );
  }
  // Add graphql-upload middleware
  app.use(
    graphqlUploadExpress({
      maxFileSize: 10000000, // 10 MB
      maxFiles: 10,
    })
  );
  app.useStaticAssets(join(process.cwd(), 'uploads'), {
    prefix: '/uploads/',
  });
  const globalPrefix = 'api';
  app.setGlobalPrefix(globalPrefix);
  const port = process.env.API_PORT || 3000;
  await app.listen(port, '127.0.0.1');
  Logger.log(
    `🚀 Application is running on: http://127.0.0.1:${port}/${globalPrefix}`
  );
}
bootstrap();

      ...ProductInfoFields

import { useMutation, useQuery } from '@apollo/client/react';

  useMutation: vi.fn(),
}));
// Mock GraphQL queries

  UPDATE_ORDER_STATUS_MUTATION: 'UPDATE_ORDER_STATUS_MUTATION',
}));

          endCursor: 'cursor123',
        },

      variables: {

    } as unknown as ReturnType<typeof useQuery>);
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useAdminsSellers());
    expect(result.current.error).toBe(mockError);
  });
  it('should return empty array and zero count when no sellers data', () => {
    vi.mocked(useQuery).mockReturnValue({
      data: null,
      loading: false,
      error: null,
      refetch: vi.fn(),
      fetchMore: vi.fn(),
    } as unknown as ReturnType<typeof useQuery>);
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useAdminsSellers());
    expect(result.current.sellers).toEqual([]);
    expect(result.current.totalCount).toBe(0);
  });
});

import { gql } from '@apollo/client';
export const SELLER_FIELDS = gql`
  fragment SellerFields on SellerInfo {
    id
    storeName
    phone
    address
    isActive
    canManageCatalog
    shippingFee
    shippingPaymentMode
    user {
      id
      name
      lastName
      username
      email
    }
  }
`;
export const GET_SELLERS = gql`
  query GetSellers($filter: SellerFilterInput) {
    sellers(filter: $filter) {
      edges {
        node {
          ...SellerFields
        }
        cursor
      }
      pageInfo {
        hasNextPage
        endCursor
      }
      totalCount
    }
  }
  ${SELLER_FIELDS}
`;
export const CREATE_SELLER = gql`
  mutation CreateSeller($createSellerInput: CreateSellerInput!) {
    createSeller(createSellerInput: $createSellerInput) {
      ...SellerFields
    }
  }
  ${SELLER_FIELDS}
`;
export const UPDATE_SELLER = gql`
  mutation UpdateSeller($updateSellerInput: UpdateSellerInput!) {
    updateSeller(updateSellerInput: $updateSellerInput) {
      ...SellerFields
    }
  }
  ${SELLER_FIELDS}
`;
export const TOGGLE_SELLER_ACTIVE = gql`
  mutation ToggleSellerActive($id: Int!) {
    toggleSellerActive(id: $id) {
      id
      isActive
    }
  }
`;
export const INITIATE_SELLER_PASSWORD_SETUP = gql`
  mutation InitiateSellerPasswordSetup($email: String!, $baseUrl: String!) {
    initiatePasswordSetup(email: $email, baseUrl: $baseUrl)
  }
`;

<file path="libs/client/admins/screens/admin-seller-orders/src/lib/admin-seller-orders.status-schema.spec.ts">
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import { ORDER_STATUSES, updateOrderStatusSchema } from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
describe('order status dialog uses the shared Zod schema', () => {
  it('accepts every GraphQL order status', () => {
    const statuses = Object.values(KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus);
    expect([...statuses].sort()).toEqual([...ORDER_STATUSES].sort());
    for (const status of statuses) {
      expect(updateOrderStatusSchema.safeParse({ id: 'order-1', status }).success).toBe(true);
    }
  });
  it('rejects a missing order id or an unknown status', () => {
    expect(updateOrderStatusSchema.safeParse({ id: '', status: 'PENDING' }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(updateOrderStatusSchema.safeParse({ id: 'order-1', status: 'LOST' }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});
