type Order = KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Order;
const formatDate = (dateString: string) => {
  return new Date(dateString).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
  });
};
const CANONICAL_PANTS_SIZE_RE = /^[1-9]\d?x[1-9]\d?$/;
const displayItemSize = (size?: string | null): string => {
  if (!size) return '';
  const t = size.trim();
  return CANONICAL_PANTS_SIZE_RE.test(t)
    ? formatSizeLabel(SizeKind.Pants, t) || size
    : size;
};
export function AdminSellerOrders() {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  usePageTitle(() => LL.pageTitles.adminOrders());
  const { isRTL, currentLocale } = useLanguageContext();
  const [selectedStatus, setSelectedStatus] = useState<
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus | undefined
  >(undefined);
  const [selectedSellerId, setSelectedSellerId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [statusDialogOpen, setStatusDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedOrder, setSelectedOrder] = useState<Order | null>(null);
  const [newStatus, setNewStatus] = useState<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus>(
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Pending
  );
  const statusForm = useForm<UpdateOrderStatusInput>({
    values: { id: selectedOrder?.id ?? '', status: newStatus },
    resolver: zodResolver(updateOrderStatusSchema),
    mode: 'onSubmit',
  });
  const {
    orders,
    loading: ordersLoading,
    error: ordersError,
    updateOrderStatus,
    updateStatusLoading,
  } = useAdminsOrders({
    first: 100,
    status: selectedStatus,
  });
  const { loading: sellersLoading } = useAdminsSellers();
  const handleStatusChange = useCallback((order: Order) => {
    setSelectedOrder(order);
    setNewStatus(order.status);
    setStatusDialogOpen(true);
  }, []);
  const handleUpdateStatus = async () => {
    if (!selectedOrder || !newStatus) return;
    if (!(await statusForm.trigger())) return;
    try {
      await updateOrderStatus(selectedOrder.id, newStatus);
      setStatusDialogOpen(false);
      setSelectedOrder(null);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error updating order status:', error);
    }
  };
  // Filter orders by seller if seller filter is applied
  const filteredOrders = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedSellerId) return orders;
    return orders.filter(
      (order: Order) => order.sellerId === parseInt(selectedSellerId, 10)
    );
  }, [orders, selectedSellerId]);
  const columns: MRT_ColumnDef<Order>[] = useMemo(() => {
    const dataColumns: MRT_ColumnDef<Order>[] = [
      {
        accessorKey: 'orderNumber',
        header: LL.orders.orderNumber(),
        size: 100,
        Cell: ({ cell }) => `#${cell.getValue<string>()}`,
      },
      {
        accessorKey: 'trackingNumber',
        header: LL.orders.tracking(),
        size: 150,
        Cell: ({ cell }) => (
          <Box

      },

                                      .filter(Boolean)
                                      .join(' - ')}
                                  </Typography>
                                </TableCell>
                              )}
                              <TableCell
                                sx={{
                                  textAlign: isRTL ? 'left' : 'right',
                                }}
                              >
                                <PriceDisplay
                                  priceInUSD={item.unitPrice}
                                  showSymbol={true}
                                  showOriginal={false}
                                />
                              </TableCell>
                              <TableCell
                                sx={{
                                  textAlign: isRTL ? 'left' : 'right',
                                  fontWeight: 600,
                                }}
                              >
                                <PriceDisplay
                                  priceInUSD={item.totalPrice}
                                  showSymbol={true}
                                  showOriginal={false}
                                />
                              </TableCell>
                            </TableRow>
                          )
                        )}
                      </TableBody>
                    </Table>
                  </TableContainer>
                </Box>
              </Box>
            ),
          }}
        />
        {/* Status Change Dialog */}
        <Dialog
          open={statusDialogOpen}
          onClose={() => setStatusDialogOpen(false)}
          maxWidth="sm"
          fullWidth
        >
          <DialogTitle>{LL.orders.changeOrderStatus()}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogFormContent>
            <FormControl fullWidth>
              <InputLabel>{LL.form.newStatus()}</InputLabel>
              <Select
                value={newStatus}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setNewStatus(
                    e.target.value as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus
                  )
                }
                label={LL.form.newStatus()}
              >
                <MenuItem value={KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Pending}>
                  {LL.orders.pending()}
                </MenuItem>
                <MenuItem value={KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Confirmed}>
                  {LL.orders.confirmed()}
                </MenuItem>
                <MenuItem value={KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Processing}>
                  {LL.orders.processing()}
                </MenuItem>
                <MenuItem value={KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Shipped}>
                  {LL.orders.shipped()}
                </MenuItem>
                <MenuItem value={KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Delivered}>
                  {LL.orders.delivered()}
                </MenuItem>
                <MenuItem value={KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Cancelled}>
                  {LL.orders.cancelled()}
                </MenuItem>
                <MenuItem value={KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Refunded}>
                  {LL.orders.refunded()}
                </MenuItem>
              </Select>
            </FormControl>
          </DialogFormContent>
          <DialogActions>
            <Button
              onClick={() => setStatusDialogOpen(false)}
              disabled={updateStatusLoading}
            >
              {LL.button.cancel()}
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="contained"
              onClick={handleUpdateStatus}
              loading={updateStatusLoading}
            >
              {LL.button.updateStatus()}
            </Button>
          </DialogActions>
        </Dialog>
      </GlassmorphismContainer>
    </AdminsLayout>
  );
}
export default AdminSellerOrders;

<file path="libs/client/admins/screens/currency-management/src/lib/currency-management.tsx">
import { AdminsLayout } from '@kickzone-workspace/admins-layout';
import { useI18nContext, usePageTitle } from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
import { GlassmorphismContainer } from '@kickzone-workspace/glassmorphism-container';
import { getLtrTextFieldProps } from '@kickzone-workspace/language-components';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Card from '@mui/material/Card';
import CardContent from '@mui/material/CardContent';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import TextField from '@mui/material/TextField';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import MenuItem from '@mui/material/MenuItem';
import Table from '@mui/material/Table';
import TableBody from '@mui/material/TableBody';
import TableCell from '@mui/material/TableCell';
import TableContainer from '@mui/material/TableContainer';
import TableHead from '@mui/material/TableHead';
import TableRow from '@mui/material/TableRow';
import Stack from '@mui/material/Stack';
import { useTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';
import { useAdminsCurrencyManagement } from '@kickzone-workspace/admins-currency-management-hooks';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import {
  exchangeRateFormSchema,
  type ExchangeRateFormInput,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
export function CurrencyManagement() {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  usePageTitle(() => LL.pageTitles.adminCurrency());
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isDark = theme.palette.mode === 'dark';
  const cardSx = {
    mb: 3,
    backgroundColor: isDark
      ? 'rgba(20, 20, 24, 0.9)'
      : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92)',
    border: `1px solid ${
      isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.08)'
    }`,
    boxShadow: isDark ? '0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.45)' : undefined,
  };
  const {
    selectedFromCurrency,
    setSelectedFromCurrency,
    selectedToCurrency,
    setSelectedToCurrency,
    newRate,
    setNewRate,
    notes,
    setNotes,
    locale,
    setLocale,
    currencyCode,
    setCurrencyCode,
    currencies,
    currentRate,
    history,
    preferences,
    settingRate,
    settingPreference,
    handleSetExchangeRate,
    handleSetCurrencyPreference,
  } = useAdminsCurrencyManagement();
  const rateForm = useForm<ExchangeRateFormInput>({
    values: { rate: newRate, notes },
    resolver: zodResolver(exchangeRateFormSchema),
    mode: 'onSubmit',
  });
  const rateError = rateForm.formState.errors.rate;
  const submitExchangeRate = async () => {
    if (!(await rateForm.trigger())) return;
    handleSetExchangeRate();
  };
  return (
    <AdminsLayout>
      <GlassmorphismContainer
        containerSx={{ maxWidth: '1200px', margin: '0 auto' }}
      >
        <Typography
          variant="h4"
          component="h1"
          gutterBottom
          sx={{ mb: 3, fontWeight: 600 }}
        >
          {LL.currency.title()}
        </Typography>
        {/* Current Exchange Rates */}
        <Box sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
          <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom sx={{ fontWeight: 600, mb: 2 }}>
            {LL.currency.currentExchangeRate()}
          </Typography>
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={2} alignItems="center" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
            <TextField
              select
              value={selectedFromCurrency}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedFromCurrency(e.target.value)}
              size="small"
              sx={{ minWidth: 200 }}
              disabled={currencies.length === 0}
            >
              {currencies.map((currency) => (
                <MenuItem key={currency.code} value={currency.code}>
                  {currency.code} - {currency.name}
                </MenuItem>
              ))}
            </TextField>
            <Typography>→</Typography>
            <TextField
              select
              value={selectedToCurrency}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedToCurrency(e.target.value)}
              size="small"
              sx={{ minWidth: 200 }}
              disabled={currencies.length === 0}
            >
              {currencies.map((currency) => (
                <MenuItem key={currency.code} value={currency.code}>
                  {currency.code} - {currency.name}
                </MenuItem>
              ))}
            </TextField>
          </Stack>
          {currentRate && (
            <Stack spacing={0.5} sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
              <Typography
                variant="body1"
                sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'text.primary' }}
              >
                {LL.currency.currentRate()}: 1 {selectedFromCurrency} ={' '}
                {currentRate.rate} {selectedToCurrency}
              </Typography>
              <Typography
                variant="caption"
                sx={{
                  color: isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.65)' : 'text.secondary',
                }}
              >
                {LL.currency.lastUpdated()}:{' '}
                {new Date(currentRate.effectiveDate).toLocaleString()}
              </Typography>
            </Stack>
          )}
        </Box>
        {/* Set New Exchange Rate */}
        <Card sx={cardSx}>
          <CardContent>
            <Typography
              variant="h6"
              gutterBottom
              sx={{ fontWeight: 600, mb: 2 }}
            >
              {LL.currency.setNewExchangeRate()}
            </Typography>
            <Stack spacing={2}>
              <TextField
                label={`${LL.currency.newRate()} (1 ${selectedFromCurrency} = ? ${selectedToCurrency})`}
                type="number"
                value={newRate}
                onChange={(e) => setNewRate(e.target.value)}
                placeholder={LL.currency.enterExchangeRate()}
                error={Boolean(rateError)}
                helperText={rateError ? LL.currency.enterExchangeRate() : undefined}
                fullWidth
                {...getLtrTextFieldProps()}
                slotProps={{
                  htmlInput: { dir: 'ltr', step: 0.000001 },
                }}
              />
              <TextField
                label={`${LL.currency.notes()} (${LL.optional()})`}
                value={notes}
                onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
                placeholder={LL.currency.reasonForRateChange()}
                multiline
                rows={3}
                fullWidth
              />
              <Button
                variant="contained"
                onClick={submitExchangeRate}
                loading={settingRate}
                disabled={currencies.length === 0 || !selectedFromCurrency || !selectedToCurrency}
                sx={{ alignSelf: 'flex-start' }}
              >
                {LL.currency.setExchangeRate()}
              </Button>
            </Stack>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        {/* Exchange Rate History */}
        <Card sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
          <CardContent>
            <Typography
              variant="h6"
              gutterBottom
              sx={{ fontWeight: 600, mb: 2 }}
            >
              {LL.currency.exchangeRateHistory()} ({selectedFromCurrency} →{' '}
              {selectedToCurrency})
            </Typography>
            {history.length === 0 ? (
              <Typography color="text.secondary">
                {LL.currency.noHistoryAvailable()}
              </Typography>
            ) : (
              <TableContainer sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                <Table>
                  <TableHead>
                    <TableRow>
                      <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                        {LL.currency.date()}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                        {LL.currency.rate()}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                        {LL.currency.notes()}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                        {LL.currency.updatedBy()}
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHead>
                  <TableBody>
                    {history.map((rate) => (
                      <TableRow key={rate.id}>
                        <TableCell>
                          {new Date(rate.effectiveDate).toLocaleString()}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>{rate.rate}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>{rate.notes || '-'}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>{rate.createdBy?.name || '-'}</TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    ))}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
              </TableContainer>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        {/* Currency Preferences (Locale → Currency Mapping) */}
        <Card sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
          <CardContent>
            <Typography
              variant="h6"
              gutterBottom
              sx={{ fontWeight: 600, mb: 2 }}
            >
              {LL.currency.currencyPreferences()}
            </Typography>
            <Stack spacing={2}>
              <TextField
                label={LL.currency.locale()}
                value={locale}
                onChange={(e) => setLocale(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g., fa, en, en-US"
                fullWidth
                {...getLtrTextFieldProps()}
              />
              <TextField
                select
                label={LL.currency.currency()}
                value={currencyCode}
                onChange={(e) => setCurrencyCode(e.target.value)}
                fullWidth
                disabled={currencies.length === 0}
              >
                {currencies.map((currency) => (
                  <MenuItem key={currency.code} value={currency.code}>
                    {currency.code} - {currency.name}
                  </MenuItem>
                ))}
              </TextField>
              <Button
                variant="contained"
                onClick={handleSetCurrencyPreference}
                loading={settingPreference}
                disabled={currencies.length === 0 || !currencyCode}
                sx={{ alignSelf: 'flex-start' }}
              >
                {LL.currency.setPreference()}
              </Button>
            </Stack>
            <Typography
              variant="subtitle1"
              sx={{ mt: 3, mb: 2, fontWeight: 600 }}
            >
              {LL.currency.currentPreferences()}
            </Typography>
            {preferences.length === 0 ? (
              <Typography color="text.secondary">
                {LL.currency.noPreferencesSet()}
              </Typography>
            ) : (
              <TableContainer>
                <Table>
                  <TableHead>
                    <TableRow>
                      <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                        {LL.currency.locale()}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                        {LL.currency.currency()}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                        {LL.currency.symbol()}
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHead>
                  <TableBody>
                    {preferences.map((pref) => (
                      <TableRow key={pref.id}>
                        <TableCell>{pref.locale}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          {pref.currency.code} - {pref.currency.name}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>{pref.currency.symbol}</TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    ))}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
              </TableContainer>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </GlassmorphismContainer>
    </AdminsLayout>
  );
}
export default CurrencyManagement;

<file path="libs/client/admins/screens/login/src/lib/AdminsLogin.tsx">
import { AdminsLayout } from '@kickzone-workspace/admins-layout';
import { colors } from '@kickzone-workspace/colors';
import { useI18nContext, usePageTitle } from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
import { mapApolloErrorToTranslationKey } from '@kickzone-workspace/translations';
import LockOutlined from '@mui/icons-material/LockOutlined';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Container from '@mui/material/Container';
import CssBaseline from '@mui/material/CssBaseline';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import TextField from '@mui/material/TextField';
import { PasswordTextField } from '@kickzone-workspace/password-field';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { useAdminLogin } from '@kickzone-workspace/admins-auth-hooks';
import { getLtrTextFieldProps } from '@kickzone-workspace/language-components';
import type { FieldError } from 'react-hook-form';
import {
  adminLoginFormSchema,
  type AdminLoginFormValues,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
export function AdminsLogin() {
  const { loginAdmin, adminsLoginLoading, adminsLoginError } = useAdminLogin();
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  usePageTitle(() => LL.pageTitles.adminLogin());
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm<AdminLoginFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(adminLoginFormSchema),
    mode: 'onSubmit',
    defaultValues: {
      email: '',
      password: '',
    },
  });
  const fieldErrorText = (error: FieldError | undefined): string => {
    if (!error || !error.type) return '';
    return LL.errors.requiredFields();
  };
  const onValidSubmit = async (values: AdminLoginFormValues) => {
    loginAdmin({ email: values.email, password: values.password });
  };
  const getDisplayError = () => {
    if (!adminsLoginError) return null;
    return LL.errors[mapApolloErrorToTranslationKey(adminsLoginError)]();
  };
  return (
    <AdminsLayout>
      <Container component="main" maxWidth="xs">
        <CssBaseline />
        <Paper
          elevation={3}
          sx={{
            marginTop: 8,
            padding: 4,
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            alignItems: 'center',
            borderRadius: 2,
          }}
        >
          <LockOutlined sx={{ fontSize: 40, color: colors.main }} />
          <Typography
            component="h1"
            variant="h5"
            sx={{ mt: 2, color: colors.text }}
          >
            {LL.authorization.signIn()}
          </Typography>
          <Box component="form" onSubmit={handleSubmit(onValidSubmit)} noValidate sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
            <TextField
              margin="normal"
              required
              fullWidth
              id="email"
              label={LL.form.email()}
              autoComplete="email"
              autoFocus
              error={!!errors.email}
              helperText={errors.email ? fieldErrorText(errors.email) : undefined}
              {...register('email')}
              {...getLtrTextFieldProps()}
            />
            <PasswordTextField
              margin="normal"
              required
              fullWidth
              label={LL.form.password()}
              id="password"
              autoComplete="current-password"
              error={!!errors.password}
              helperText={errors.password ? fieldErrorText(errors.password) : undefined}
              {...register('password')}
            />
            <Button
              type="submit"
              fullWidth
              variant="contained"
              loading={adminsLoginLoading}
              sx={{
                mt: 3,
                mb: 2,
                backgroundColor: colors.main,
                '&:hover': { backgroundColor: colors.hoverMain },
              }}
            >
              {LL.authorization.signIn()}
            </Button>
            {adminsLoginError && (
              <Typography color="error" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                {getDisplayError()}
              </Typography>
            )}
          </Box>
        </Paper>
      </Container>
    </AdminsLayout>
  );
}
export default AdminsLogin;
</file>

import React, { type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { AdminsLogin } from './AdminsLogin';
import { vi, describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
import { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
// Mock the layout component
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/admins-layout', () => ({
  AdminsLayout: ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => (
    <div data-testid="admins-layout">{children}</div>
  ),
}));
// Mock the auth hook
const mockLoginAdmin = vi.fn();
const mockUseAdminLogin = vi.fn();
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/admins-auth-hooks', () => ({
  useAdminLogin: () => mockUseAdminLogin(),
}));
// Mock the error message utility
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/translations', () => ({
  mapApolloErrorToTranslationKey: (_error: unknown) =>
    'auth.invalid-credentials',
}));
// Mock the i18n context
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n', () => ({
  useI18nContext: () => ({
    LL: {
      pageTitles: {
        adminLogin: () => 'Admin Login',
      },
      authorization: {
        signIn: () => 'Sign In',
      },
      form: {
        email: () => 'Email',
        password: () => 'Password',
      },
      errors: {
        'auth.invalid-credentials': () => 'Invalid credentials',
        requiredFields: () => 'Please fill in all required fields',
      },
    },
  }),
  usePageTitle: vi.fn(),
}));
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/language-components', () => ({
  getLtrTextFieldProps: () => ({}),
}));
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/password-field', () => ({
  PasswordTextField: ({
    label,
    ...props
  }: {
    label: string;
    value?: string;
    onChange?: (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
  }) => (
    <input
      aria-label={label}
      type="password"
      {...props}
    />
  ),
}));
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/colors', () => ({
  colors: {
    main: '#1976d2',
    text: '#333333',
    hoverMain: '#1565c0',
  },
}));
describe('AdminsLogin (zod/RHF validation)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockUseAdminLogin.mockReturnValue({
      loginAdmin: mockLoginAdmin,
      adminsLoginLoading: false,
      adminsLoginError: null,
    });
  });
  const renderComponent = () => {
    return render(
      <BrowserRouter>
        <AdminsLogin />
      </BrowserRouter>
    );
  };
  it('empty submit -> loginAdmin NOT called and requiredFields text shown', async () => {
    renderComponent();
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign In' });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    // RHF validates on submit - wait for errors to appear
    await waitFor(() => {
      const errorMessages = screen.getAllByText('Please fill in all required fields');
      expect(errorMessages.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    });
    // loginAdmin should NOT be called
    expect(mockLoginAdmin).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('"  admin@example.com  " + "abc" -> loginAdmin({ email: "admin@example.com", password: "abc" }) once', async () => {
    renderComponent();
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Email/i);
    const passwordInput = screen.getByLabelText(/^Password/i);
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign In' });
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: '  admin@example.com  ' } });
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'abc' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockLoginAdmin).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(mockLoginAdmin).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ email: 'admin@example.com', password: 'abc' });
    });
  });
});

    renderEditor();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Manage Colors' }));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add New Color' }));
  };
  it('does not create a color without a name', async () => {
    openNewColor();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByLabelText('Color Name')).toHaveAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true'));
    expect(mockCreateColor).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('does not create a color with an invalid hex code', async () => {
    openNewColor();
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Color Name'), { target: { value: 'Green' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Hex Code'), { target: { value: 'green' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByLabelText('Hex Code')).toHaveAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true'));
    expect(mockCreateColor).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('creates a color with a valid name and hex code', async () => {
    openNewColor();
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Color Name'), { target: { value: 'Green' } });
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Hex Code'), { target: { value: '#00ff00' } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockCreateColor).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Green', '#00ff00'));
  });
});

describe('AdminProductEditor pants range (P3 locked)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockUseParams.mockReturnValue({ id: undefined });
    mockUseProductById.mockReturnValue({ product: null, refetch: mockRefetchProduct });
  });
  // Helper to fill common form fields for pants variant
  const fillPantsForm = async () => {
    // Select Pants size kind
    const sizeKindSelect = screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Size type/i });
    fireEvent.mouseDown(sizeKindSelect);
    const pantsOption = await screen.findByRole('option', { name: /Pants/i });
    fireEvent.click(pantsOption);
    // Select color
    const colorInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Color/i);
    fireEvent.focus(colorInput);
    fireEvent.keyDown(colorInput, { key: 'ArrowDown' });
    const redOption = await screen.findByText('Red');
    fireEvent.click(redOption);
    // Fill weight
    const weightInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Weight/i);
    fireEvent.change(weightInput, { target: { value: '300' } });
    // Fill product name, sku, category
    const nameInput = screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Product Name' });
    fireEvent.change(nameInput, { target: { value: 'Test Pants' } });
    const skuInput = screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'SKU' });
    fireEvent.change(skuInput, { target: { value: 'TEST-PANTS' } });
    const categoryInput = screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Category/i });
    fireEvent.focus(categoryInput);
    fireEvent.keyDown(categoryInput, { key: 'ArrowDown' });
    const categoryOption = await screen.findByText('Category 1');
    fireEvent.click(categoryOption);
  };
  it('T1 waist 0, inseam 34 -> submit -> snackbar error and no create call', async () => {
    renderEditor();
    await fillPantsForm();
    // Enter waist = 0, inseam = 34
    const waistInput = screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: /Waist/i });
    fireEvent.change(waistInput, { target: { value: '0' } });
    const inseamInput = screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: /Inseam/i });
    fireEvent.change(inseamInput, { target: { value: '34' } });
    // Submit
    fireEvent.submit(screen.getByLabelText('Product Editor Form'));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockShowSnackbar).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'Please fill in all product variant fields',
        { severity: 'error' }
      );
    });
    expect(mockCreateProductWithInfos).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('T2 waist 100, inseam 34 -> submit -> snackbar error and no create call', async () => {
    renderEditor();
    await fillPantsForm();
    // Enter waist = 100, inseam = 34
    const waistInput = screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: /Waist/i });
    fireEvent.change(waistInput, { target: { value: '100' } });
    const inseamInput = screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: /Inseam/i });
    fireEvent.change(inseamInput, { target: { value: '34' } });
    // Submit
    fireEvent.submit(screen.getByLabelText('Product Editor Form'));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockShowSnackbar).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'Please fill in all product variant fields',
        { severity: 'error' }
      );
    });
    expect(mockCreateProductWithInfos).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('T3 waist 32, inseam 150 -> submit -> snackbar error and no create call', async () => {
    renderEditor();
    await fillPantsForm();
    // Enter waist = 32, inseam = 150
    const waistInput = screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: /Waist/i });
    fireEvent.change(waistInput, { target: { value: '32' } });
    const inseamInput = screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: /Inseam/i });
    fireEvent.change(inseamInput, { target: { value: '150' } });
    // Submit
    fireEvent.submit(screen.getByLabelText('Product Editor Form'));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockShowSnackbar).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'Please fill in all product variant fields',
        { severity: 'error' }
      );
    });
    expect(mockCreateProductWithInfos).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('T4 waist 32.5, inseam 34 -> submit -> snackbar error and no create call', async () => {
    renderEditor();
    await fillPantsForm();
    // Enter waist = 32.5, inseam = 34
    const waistInput = screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: /Waist/i });
    fireEvent.change(waistInput, { target: { value: '32.5' } });
    const inseamInput = screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: /Inseam/i });
    fireEvent.change(inseamInput, { target: { value: '34' } });
    // Submit
    fireEvent.submit(screen.getByLabelText('Product Editor Form'));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockShowSnackbar).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'Please fill in all product variant fields',
        { severity: 'error' }
      );
    });
    expect(mockCreateProductWithInfos).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('T5 waist 32, inseam 34 -> create called with size 32x34 and sizeKind Pants', async () => {
    mockCreateProductWithInfos.mockResolvedValue({
      product: { id: 1, name: 'Test Pants' },
      productInfos: [{ id: 10, size: '32x34', colors: [{ id: 1 }], weight: 300 }],
    });
    renderEditor();
    await fillPantsForm();
    // Enter waist = 32, inseam = 34
    const waistInput = screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: /Waist/i });
    fireEvent.change(waistInput, { target: { value: '32' } });
    const inseamInput = screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: /Inseam/i });
    fireEvent.change(inseamInput, { target: { value: '34' } });
    // Submit
    fireEvent.submit(screen.getByLabelText('Product Editor Form'));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockCreateProductWithInfos).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(mockCreateProductWithInfos).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.any(Object),
        expect.arrayContaining([
          expect.objectContaining({
            size: '32x34',
            sizeKind: 'Pants',
          }),
        ])
      );
    });
  });
  it('T6 Waist and Inseam spinbuttons have attribute min=1 and max=99', async () => {
    renderEditor();
    // Select Pants size kind
    const sizeKindSelect = screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Size type/i });
    fireEvent.mouseDown(sizeKindSelect);
    const pantsOption = await screen.findByRole('option', { name: /Pants/i });
    fireEvent.click(pantsOption);
    const waistInput = screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: /Waist/i });
    const inseamInput = screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: /Inseam/i });
    expect(waistInput).toHaveAttribute('min', '1');
    expect(waistInput).toHaveAttribute('max', '99');
    expect(inseamInput).toHaveAttribute('min', '1');
    expect(inseamInput).toHaveAttribute('max', '99');
  });
  it('T7 enter waist 32 and inseam 34 (hidden-size-input value 32x34), then clear waist to empty -> hidden-size-input value empty', async () => {
    renderEditor();
    // Select Pants size kind
    const sizeKindSelect = screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Size type/i });
    fireEvent.mouseDown(sizeKindSelect);
    const pantsOption = await screen.findByRole('option', { name: /Pants/i });
    fireEvent.click(pantsOption);
    // Enter waist = 32
    const waistInput = screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: /Waist/i });
    fireEvent.change(waistInput, { target: { value: '32' } });
    // Enter inseam = 34
    const inseamInput = screen.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: /Inseam/i });
    fireEvent.change(inseamInput, { target: { value: '34' } });
    // Hidden size input should have composite value
    const hiddenSize = screen.getByTestId('hidden-size-input');
    expect(hiddenSize).toHaveValue('32x34');
    // Clear waist
    fireEvent.change(waistInput, { target: { value: '' } });
    // Hidden size input should now be empty
    expect(hiddenSize).toHaveValue('');
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/admins/screens/translation-management/src/lib/AdminTranslationManagement.tsx">
import * as React from 'react';
import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import {
  translationNameFormSchema,
  type TranslationNameFormInput,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Tabs from '@mui/material/Tabs';
import Tab from '@mui/material/Tab';
import Table from '@mui/material/Table';
import TableBody from '@mui/material/TableBody';
import TableCell from '@mui/material/TableCell';
import TableContainer from '@mui/material/TableContainer';
import TableHead from '@mui/material/TableHead';
import TableRow from '@mui/material/TableRow';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import IconButton from '@mui/material/IconButton';
import VisibilityIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Visibility';
import Dialog from '@mui/material/Dialog';
import DialogTitle from '@mui/material/DialogTitle';
import DialogActions from '@mui/material/DialogActions';
import TextField from '@mui/material/TextField';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import { useQuery } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { gql } from '@apollo/client';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import { useSnackbarContext } from '@kickzone-workspace/snackbar-hook';
import { AdminsLayout } from '@kickzone-workspace/admins-layout';
import { GlassmorphismContainer } from '@kickzone-workspace/glassmorphism-container';
import { DialogFormContent } from '@kickzone-workspace/language-components';
import {
  useTranslationsManagement,
  useEntityTranslations,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/translations-management-hook';
import { useI18nContext, usePageTitle } from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
import { TranslateToOtherLanguagesButton } from './TranslateToOtherLanguagesButton';
// GraphQL queries
const GET_CATEGORIES = gql`
  query GetCategories {
    categories {
      id
      slug
      sortOrder
      isActive
      name
    }
  }
`;
const GET_COLORS = gql`
  query GetColors {
    colors {
      id
      hexCode
      sortOrder
      isActive
      name
    }
  }
`;
const GET_BRANDS = gql`
  query GetBrands {
    brands {
      id
      slug
      sortOrder
      isActive
      name
    }
  }
`;
interface TabPanelProps {
  children?: React.ReactNode;
  index: number;
  value: number;
}
function TabPanel(props: TabPanelProps) {
  const { children, value, index, ...other } = props;
  return (
    <div
      role="tabpanel"
      hidden={value !== index}
      id={`translation-tabpanel-${index}`}
      aria-labelledby={`translation-tab-${index}`}
      {...other}
    >
      {value === index && <Box sx={{ p: 3 }}>{children}</Box>}
    </div>
  );
}
interface TranslationsModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  entityType: 'category' | 'color' | 'brand';
  entityId: number;
  entityName: string;
  onRefetchReady?: (refetch: () => void) => void;
  onSaveSuccess?: () => void;
}
function TranslationsModal({
  open,
  onClose,
  entityType,
  entityId,
  entityName,
  onRefetchReady,
  onSaveSuccess,
}: TranslationsModalProps) {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  const { showSnackbar } = useSnackbarContext();
  const { setTranslation } = useTranslationsManagement();
  const { translations, loading, refetch } = useEntityTranslations(
    entityType,
    entityId
  );
  const [editingLocale, setEditingLocale] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editValue, setEditValue] = useState('');
  const [isSavingTranslation, setIsSavingTranslation] = useState(false);
  const translationForm = useForm<TranslationNameFormInput>({
    values: { value: editValue },
    resolver: zodResolver(translationNameFormSchema),
    mode: 'onSubmit',
  });
  const valueError = translationForm.formState.errors.value;
  // Expose refetch function to parent component
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (onRefetchReady && refetch) {
      onRefetchReady(refetch);
    }
  }, [onRefetchReady, refetch]);
  const locales = ['en', 'fa', 'ar'];
  const localeNames = {
    en: 'English',
    fa: 'Farsi (فارسی)',
    ar: 'Arabic (العربية)',
  };
  const handleEdit = (locale: string, currentValue: string) => {
    setEditingLocale(locale);
    setEditValue(currentValue);
  };
  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!editingLocale) return;
    if (!(await translationForm.trigger())) return;
    setIsSavingTranslation(true);
    try {
      await setTranslation(
        entityType,
        entityId,
        editingLocale,
        'name',
        editValue,
        false
      );
      showSnackbar(
        LL.admin.translationManagement.translationSavedSuccessfully(),
        { severity: 'success' }
      );
      setEditingLocale(null);
      setEditValue('');
      // Refetch translations to update the displayed values
      await refetch();
      // Notify parent to refetch main queries
      if (onSaveSuccess) {
        onSaveSuccess();
      }
    } catch {
      showSnackbar(LL.admin.translationManagement.failedToSaveTranslation(), {
        severity: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setIsSavingTranslation(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onClose={onClose} maxWidth="md" fullWidth>
      <DialogTitle>
        {LL.admin.translationManagement.translationsFor({
          entityType,
          entityName,
        })}
      </DialogTitle>
      <DialogFormContent>
        {loading ? (
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', p: 3 }}>
            <CircularProgress />
          </Box>
        ) : (
          <Table>
            <TableHead>
              <TableRow>
                <TableCell>
                  {LL.admin.translationManagement.language()}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  {LL.admin.translationManagement.translation()}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{LL.table.actions()}</TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHead>
            <TableBody>
              {locales.map((locale) => {
                const value = translations.get(locale) || '';
                const isEditing = editingLocale === locale;
                return (
                  <TableRow key={locale}>
                    <TableCell>
                      <Typography fontWeight="bold">
                        {localeNames[locale as keyof typeof localeNames]}
                      </Typography>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      {isEditing ? (
                        <TextField
                          fullWidth
                          value={editValue}
                          onChange={(e) => setEditValue(e.target.value)}
                          error={Boolean(valueError)}
                          autoFocus
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <Typography>
                          {value ||
                            LL.admin.translationManagement.noTranslation()}
                        </Typography>
                      )}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      {isEditing ? (
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 1 }}>
                          <Button
                            size="small"
                            onClick={handleSave}
                            variant="contained"
                            loading={isSavingTranslation}
                          >
                            {LL.button.save()}
                          </Button>
                          <Button
                            size="small"
                            onClick={() => setEditingLocale(null)}
                            disabled={isSavingTranslation}
                          >
                            {LL.button.cancel()}
                          </Button>
                        </Box>
                      ) : (
                        <Button
                          size="small"
                          onClick={() => handleEdit(locale, value)}
                        >
                          {LL.button.edit()}
                        </Button>
                      )}
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                );
              })}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        )}
      </DialogFormContent>
      <DialogActions>
        <Button onClick={onClose}>{LL.button.close()}</Button>
      </DialogActions>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
export function AdminTranslationManagement() {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  usePageTitle(() => LL.pageTitles.adminTranslations());
  const { showSnackbar } = useSnackbarContext();
  const { bulkTranslate } = useTranslationsManagement();
  const [tabValue, setTabValue] = useState(0);
  const [translationsModal, setTranslationsModal] = useState<{
    open: boolean;
    entityType: 'category' | 'color' | 'brand';
    entityId: number;
    entityName: string;
  } | null>(null);
  const translationsRefetchRef = React.useRef<Map<string, () => void>>(
    new Map()
  );
  const {
    data: categoriesData,
    loading: categoriesLoading,
    refetch: refetchCategories,
  } = useQuery<Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'categories'>>(GET_CATEGORIES);
  const {
    data: colorsData,
    loading: colorsLoading,
    refetch: refetchColors,
  } = useQuery<Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'colors'>>(GET_COLORS);
  const {
    data: brandsData,
    loading: brandsLoading,
    refetch: refetchBrands,
  } = useQuery<Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'brands'>>(GET_BRANDS);
  const handleBulkTranslate = useCallback(
    async (
      entityType: 'category' | 'color' | 'brand',
      entityIds: number[],
      sourceLocale: string,
      targetLocales: string[]
    ) => {
      try {
        await bulkTranslate(entityType, entityIds, sourceLocale, targetLocales);
        showSnackbar(
          LL.admin.translationManagement.bulkTranslationCompletedSuccessfully(),
          {
            severity: 'success',
          }
        );
        // Refetch translations for the affected entities
        entityIds.forEach((entityId) => {
          const key = `${entityType}:${entityId}`;
          const refetch = translationsRefetchRef.current.get(key);
          if (refetch) {
            refetch();
          }
        });
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Bulk translation failed:', err);
        showSnackbar(LL.admin.translationManagement.bulkTranslationFailed(), {
          severity: 'error',
        });
      }
    },
    [bulkTranslate, showSnackbar, LL.admin.translationManagement]
  );
  const handleRefetchReady = useCallback(
    (entityType: string, entityId: number, refetch: () => void) => {
      const key = `${entityType}:${entityId}`;
      translationsRefetchRef.current.set(key, refetch);
    },
    []
  );
  return (
    <AdminsLayout>
      <GlassmorphismContainer fullHeight>
        <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
          {LL.admin.translationManagement.title()}
        </Typography>
        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
          {LL.admin.translationManagement.description()}
        </Typography>
        <Paper sx={{ width: '100%' }}>
          <Tabs
            value={tabValue}
            onChange={(_, newValue) => setTabValue(newValue)}
            aria-label="translation tabs"
          >
            <Tab label={LL.admin.translationManagement.categories()} />
            <Tab label={LL.admin.translationManagement.brands()} />
            <Tab label={LL.admin.translationManagement.colors()} />
          </Tabs>
          <TabPanel value={tabValue} index={0}>
            <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
              {LL.admin.translationManagement.categoryTranslations()}
            </Typography>
            {categoriesLoading ? (
              <Typography>{LL.table.loadingCategories()}</Typography>
            ) : (
              <TableContainer>
                <Table>
                  <TableHead>
                    <TableRow>
                      <TableCell>{LL.table.categoryEnglish()}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{LL.table.slug()}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{LL.table.status()}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{LL.table.view()}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{LL.table.actions()}</TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHead>
                  <TableBody>
                    {categoriesData?.categories?.map((category) => (
                      <TableRow key={category?.id}>
                        <TableCell>
                          <Typography>{category?.name}</Typography>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>{category?.slug}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <Chip
                            label={
                              category?.isActive
                                ? LL.table.active()
                                : LL.table.inactive()
                            }
                            color={category?.isActive ? 'success' : 'default'}
                            size="small"
                          />
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <IconButton
                            size="small"
                            onClick={() =>
                              category?.id &&
                              setTranslationsModal({
                                open: true,
                                entityType: 'category',
                                entityId: category.id,
                                entityName: category.name,
                              })
                            }
                          >
                            <VisibilityIcon />
                          </IconButton>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <TranslateToOtherLanguagesButton
                            onClick={() =>
                              category?.id &&
                              handleBulkTranslate(
                                'category',
                                [category.id],
                                'en',
                                ['fa', 'ar']
                              )
                            }
                          />
                        </TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    ))}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
              </TableContainer>
            )}
          </TabPanel>
          <TabPanel value={tabValue} index={1}>
            <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
              {LL.admin.translationManagement.brandTranslations()}
            </Typography>
            {brandsLoading ? (
              <Typography>
                {LL.admin.translationManagement.loadingBrands()}
              </Typography>
            ) : (
              <TableContainer>
                <Table>
                  <TableHead>
                    <TableRow>
                      <TableCell>
                        {LL.admin.translationManagement.brandEnglish()}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{LL.table.slug()}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{LL.table.status()}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{LL.table.view()}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{LL.table.actions()}</TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHead>
                  <TableBody>
                    {brandsData?.brands?.map((brand) => (
                      <TableRow key={brand?.id}>
                        <TableCell>
                          <Typography>{brand?.name}</Typography>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>{brand?.slug}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <Chip
                            label={
                              brand?.isActive
                                ? LL.table.active()
                                : LL.table.inactive()
                            }
                            color={brand?.isActive ? 'success' : 'default'}
                            size="small"
                          />
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <IconButton
                            size="small"
                            onClick={() =>
                              brand?.id &&
                              setTranslationsModal({
                                open: true,
                                entityType: 'brand',
                                entityId: brand.id,
                                entityName: brand.name,
                              })
                            }
                          >
                            <VisibilityIcon />
                          </IconButton>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <TranslateToOtherLanguagesButton
                            onClick={() =>
                              brand?.id &&
                              handleBulkTranslate(
                                'brand',
                                [brand.id],
                                'en',
                                ['fa', 'ar']
                              )
                            }
                          />
                        </TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    ))}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
              </TableContainer>
            )}
          </TabPanel>
          <TabPanel value={tabValue} index={2}>
            <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
              {LL.admin.translationManagement.colorTranslations()}
            </Typography>
            {colorsLoading ? (
              <Typography>
                {LL.admin.translationManagement.loadingColors()}
              </Typography>
            ) : (
              <TableContainer>
                <Table>
                  <TableHead>
                    <TableRow>
                      <TableCell>
                        {LL.admin.translationManagement.colorEnglish()}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        {LL.admin.translationManagement.hexCode()}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{LL.table.status()}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{LL.table.view()}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{LL.table.actions()}</TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHead>
                  <TableBody>
                    {colorsData?.colors?.map((color) => (
                      <TableRow key={color?.id}>
                        <TableCell>
                          <Box
                            sx={{
                              display: 'flex',
                              alignItems: 'center',
                              gap: 1,
                            }}
                          >
                            <Box
                              sx={{
                                width: 20,
                                height: 20,
                                backgroundColor: color?.hexCode,
                                border: '1px solid #ccc',
                                borderRadius: '4px',
                              }}
                            />
                            <Typography>{color?.name}</Typography>
                          </Box>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <Typography fontFamily="monospace">
                            {color?.hexCode}
                          </Typography>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <Chip
                            label={
                              color?.isActive
                                ? LL.table.active()
                                : LL.table.inactive()
                            }
                            color={color?.isActive ? 'success' : 'default'}
                            size="small"
                          />
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <IconButton
                            size="small"
                            onClick={() =>
                              color?.id &&
                              setTranslationsModal({
                                open: true,
                                entityType: 'color',
                                entityId: color.id,
                                entityName: color.name,
                              })
                            }
                          >
                            <VisibilityIcon />
                          </IconButton>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <TranslateToOtherLanguagesButton
                            onClick={() =>
                              color?.id &&
                              handleBulkTranslate('color', [color.id], 'en', [
                                'fa',
                                'ar',
                              ])
                            }
                          />
                        </TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    ))}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
              </TableContainer>
            )}
          </TabPanel>
        </Paper>
        {translationsModal && (
          <TranslationsModal
            open={translationsModal.open}
            onClose={() => setTranslationsModal(null)}
            entityType={translationsModal.entityType}
            entityId={translationsModal.entityId}
            entityName={translationsModal.entityName}
            onRefetchReady={(refetch) =>
              handleRefetchReady(
                translationsModal.entityType,
                translationsModal.entityId,
                refetch
              )
            }
            onSaveSuccess={() => {
              if (translationsModal.entityType === 'category') {
                refetchCategories();
              } else if (translationsModal.entityType === 'brand') {
                refetchBrands();
              } else {
                refetchColors();
              }
            }}
          />
        )}
      </GlassmorphismContainer>
    </AdminsLayout>
  );
}

      });
      renderWithProviders(<Headerbar />);
      expect(screen.getByText('Alice Smith')).toBeInTheDocument();

    beforeEach(() => {
      setupMobileViewport();
    });
    it('hides header menu button on mobile when all items are handled in the tabbar', () => {
      // Guest where every visible item is handled in the tabbar. Favorites is a drawer-only
      // item for guests (not in the default guest tabbar), so it must be listed here too.
      mockUseCustomersAuth.mockReturnValue({
        user: null,
        logout: mockLogout,
      });
      renderWithProviders(
        <Headerbar handledInTabbarIds={['home', 'cart', 'favorites', 'login']} />
      );
      // Menu button should NOT be rendered!
      expect(screen.queryByLabelText('menu')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    it('shows header menu button on mobile when unhandled items exist', () => {
      // User is logged in: Logout is not in default tabbar
      mockUseCustomersAuth.mockReturnValue({
        user: { id: '1', name: 'Bob Smith', email: 'bob@example.com' },
        logout: mockLogout,
      });
      renderWithProviders(<Headerbar />);
      // Menu button SHOULD be rendered
      expect(screen.getByLabelText('menu')).toBeInTheDocument();

      fireEvent.click(screen.getByLabelText('menu'));

      expect(screen.queryByText('My Orders')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.queryByText('Language Settings')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    it('shows header menu button on mobile when custom drawerItems are passed', () => {
      mockUseCustomersAuth.mockReturnValue({
        user: null,
        logout: mockLogout,
      });
      renderWithProviders(
        <Headerbar
          handledInTabbarIds={['home', 'cart', 'login']}
          drawerItems={<div data-testid="custom-drawer-item">Help & Support</div>}
        />
      );

      expect(screen.getByLabelText('menu')).toBeInTheDocument();
      fireEvent.click(screen.getByLabelText('menu'));
      expect(screen.getByTestId('custom-drawer-item')).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByText('Help & Support')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    it('shows unhandled items in drawer when tabbar only handles subset', () => {
      mockUseCustomersAuth.mockReturnValue({
        user: { id: '1', name: 'Bob Smith', email: 'bob@example.com' },
        logout: mockLogout,
      });
      // Tabbar only handles home and cart
      renderWithProviders(
        <Headerbar handledInTabbarIds={['home', 'cart']} />
      );
      expect(screen.getByLabelText('menu')).toBeInTheDocument();
      fireEvent.click(screen.getByLabelText('menu'));
      // Orders and Profile were not handled in tabbar, so they must be in header menu!
      expect(screen.getByText('Profile')).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByText('My Orders')).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByText('Logout')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    it('calls logout when logout button in drawer is clicked', () => {
      mockUseCustomersAuth.mockReturnValue({
        user: { id: '1', name: 'Bob Smith', email: 'bob@example.com' },
        logout: mockLogout,
      });
      renderWithProviders(<Headerbar />);
      fireEvent.click(screen.getByLabelText('menu'));
      fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('Logout'));
      expect(mockLogout).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });
  });
});

import React from 'react';
import { render, screen, fireEvent } from '@testing-library/react';
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { MemoryRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
import { CustomersProductCard, toFarsiDigits } from './CustomersProductCard';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n', () => ({
  useI18nContext: () => ({
    LL: {
      customer: {
        productCard: {
          addToCart: () => 'افزودن به سبد',
          addedToCart: () => 'به سبد اضافه شد',
          selectSize: () => 'انتخاب سایز',
          colorways: () => 'رنگ‌بندی',
          onlyLeft: (count: { count: number }) => `تنها ${count.count} عدد باقی مانده`,
          outOfStock: () => 'ناموجود',
          quickView: () => 'مشاهده سریع',
        },
      },
    },
  }),
  useLanguageContext: () => ({
    currentLocale: 'fa',
    formatNumber: (n: number | string) => String(n),
  }),
}));
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/price-display', () => ({
  PriceDisplay: ({ priceInUSD }: { priceInUSD: number }) => (
    <span data-testid="price-display">{priceInUSD} تومان</span>
  ),
}));
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/customer-cart-store', () => ({
  useCartStore: (selector?: (state: { items: unknown[] }) => unknown) => {
    const state = { items: [] };
    return selector ? selector(state) : state;
  },
}));
const baseProduct: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product = {
  id: 101,
  name: 'Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG',
  description: 'Iconic basketball shoe',
  categories: [{ id: 1, name: 'کفش ورزشی', createdAt: '', updatedAt: '' }],
  productInfos: [
    {

describe('CustomersProductCard - pants size display', () => {
  it('T1: pants sizeKind shows W32/L34 format (fa locale)', () => {
    const pantsProduct: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product = {
      ...baseProduct,
      productInfos: [
        {
          ...baseProduct.productInfos[0],
          id: 201,
          size: '32x34',
          sizeKind: 'PANTS',
        },
        {
          ...baseProduct.productInfos[1],
          id: 202,
          size: '30x32',
          sizeKind: 'PANTS',
        },
      ],
      sellerProducts: [
        {
          ...baseProduct.sellerProducts[0],
          id: 301,
          productInfoId: 201,
        },
        {
          ...baseProduct.sellerProducts[1],
          id: 302,
          productInfoId: 202,
        },
      ],
    } as unknown as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product;
    render(
      <MemoryRouter>
        <CustomersProductCard product={pantsProduct} onAddToCart={vi.fn()} />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    expect(screen.getAllByText(toFarsiDigits('W32/L34')).length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(screen.getAllByText(toFarsiDigits('W30/L32')).length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(txt()).not.toContain('32x34');
    expect(txt()).not.toContain(toFarsiDigits('32x34'));
    expect(txt()).not.toContain('30x32');
    expect(txt()).not.toContain(toFarsiDigits('30x32'));
  });
  it('T2: footwear sizeKind unchanged (fa locale)', () => {
    const footwearProduct: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product = {
      ...baseProduct,
      productInfos: [
        {
          ...baseProduct.productInfos[0],
          id: 201,
          size: '42',
          sizeKind: 'FOOTWEAR',
        },
        {
          ...baseProduct.productInfos[1],
          id: 202,
          size: '43',
          sizeKind: 'FOOTWEAR',
        },
      ],
      sellerProducts: [
        {
          ...baseProduct.sellerProducts[0],
          id: 301,
          productInfoId: 201,
        },
        {
          ...baseProduct.sellerProducts[1],
          id: 302,
          productInfoId: 202,
        },
      ],
    } as unknown as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product;
    render(
      <MemoryRouter>
        <CustomersProductCard product={footwearProduct} onAddToCart={vi.fn()} />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    expect(screen.getAllByText(toFarsiDigits('42')).length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(screen.getAllByText(toFarsiDigits('43')).length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(txt()).not.toContain('W' + toFarsiDigits('42'));
    expect(txt()).not.toContain('W۴۲');
  });
  it('T3: apparel sizeKind unchanged (fa locale)', () => {
    const apparelProduct: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product = {

    expect(screen.getAllByText('L').length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
  });
  it('T4: sizeKind missing (undefined) renders raw size (fa locale)', () => {
    const noKindProduct: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product = {

        {

    render(
      <MemoryRouter>

      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    expect(screen.getAllByText(toFarsiDigits('32x34')).length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
  });
  it('T5: selection value stays raw for pants (fa locale)', () => {
    const pantsProduct: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product = {
      ...baseProduct,
      productInfos: [
        {
          ...baseProduct.productInfos[0],
          id: 201,
          size: '30x32',
          sizeKind: 'PANTS',
        },
        {
          ...baseProduct.productInfos[1],
          id: 202,
          size: '32x34',
          sizeKind: 'PANTS',
        },
      ],
      sellerProducts: [
        {
          ...baseProduct.sellerProducts[0],
          id: 301,
          productInfoId: 201,
        },
        {
          ...baseProduct.sellerProducts[1],
          id: 302,
          productInfoId: 202,
        },
      ],
    } as unknown as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product;
    const handleAddToCart = vi.fn();
    render(
      <MemoryRouter>
        <CustomersProductCard product={pantsProduct} onAddToCart={handleAddToCart} />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    // Click the first chip (W30/L32)
    const firstChip = screen.getByText(toFarsiDigits('W30/L32'));
    fireEvent.click(firstChip);
    // Click the add-to-cart button (same pattern as existing spec)
    const addButtons = screen.getAllByRole('button');
    const addToCartButton = addButtons.find(
      (btn) =>
        btn.textContent?.includes('افزودن به سبد') ||
        btn.getAttribute('aria-label')?.includes('افزودن به سبد')
    );
    expect(addToCartButton).toBeDefined();
    if (addToCartButton) {
      fireEvent.click(addToCartButton);
    }
    // Check that onAddToCart was called with raw size '30x32'
    const calls = JSON.stringify(handleAddToCart.mock.calls);
    expect(calls).toContain('30x32');
    expect(calls).not.toContain('W30/L32');
  });
  // T6: 4XL apparel size displays correctly (fa locale)
  it('T6: renders 4XL apparel size immediately after 3XL', () => {
    const apparelProduct: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product = {
      ...baseProduct,
      productInfos: [
        {
          ...baseProduct.productInfos[0],
          id: 201,
          size: '3XL',
          sizeKind: 'APPAREL',
        },
        {
          ...baseProduct.productInfos[1],
          id: 202,
          size: '4XL',
          sizeKind: 'APPAREL',
        },
      ],
      sellerProducts: [
        {
          ...baseProduct.sellerProducts[0],
          id: 301,
          productInfoId: 201,
        },
        {
          ...baseProduct.sellerProducts[1],
          id: 302,
          productInfoId: 202,
        },
      ],
    } as unknown as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product;
    render(
      <MemoryRouter>
        <CustomersProductCard product={apparelProduct} onAddToCart={vi.fn()} />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    // Both 3XL and 4XL should be displayed (with Persian digits)
    const xxxlPersian = toFarsiDigits('3XL'); // '۳XL'
    const fourXLPersian = toFarsiDigits('4XL'); // '۴XL'
    expect(screen.getByText(xxxlPersian)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText(fourXLPersian)).toBeInTheDocument();
    // 4XL should appear after 3XL in the size chips
    const sizeChips = screen.getAllByText(new RegExp(`(${xxxlPersian}|${fourXLPersian})`));
    expect(sizeChips.length).toBe(2);
    // Verify order: 3XL appears before 4XL in the DOM
    const bodyText = document.body.textContent || '';
    const xxxlIndex = bodyText.indexOf(xxxlPersian);
    const fourXLIndex = bodyText.indexOf(fourXLPersian);
    expect(xxxlIndex).toBeLessThan(fourXLIndex);
  });
});

    it('calls onAddVariantToCart only when both callbacks provided and variant exists', () => {
      const handleAddToCart = vi.fn();
      const handleAddVariantToCart = vi.fn();
      render(
        <MemoryRouter>
          <CustomersProductCard
            product={mockProduct}
            onAddToCart={handleAddToCart}
            onAddVariantToCart={handleAddVariantToCart}

      const addToCartButton = addButtons.find(
        (btn) =>
          btn.textContent?.includes('افزودن به سبد') ||
          btn.getAttribute('aria-label')?.includes('افزودن به سبد')
      );
      expect(addToCartButton).toBeDefined();
      if (addToCartButton) {
        fireEvent.click(addToCartButton);
        // onAddVariantToCart should be called once (activeVariant exists)
        expect(handleAddVariantToCart).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
        // onAddToCart should NOT be called
        expect(handleAddToCart).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    });
    it('calls onAddToCart only when onAddVariantToCart is not provided', () => {
      const handleAddToCart = vi.fn();
      render(
        <MemoryRouter>
          <CustomersProductCard
            product={mockProduct}
            onAddToCart={handleAddToCart}
          />
        </MemoryRouter>
      );
      const addButtons = screen.getAllByRole('button');
      const addToCartButton = addButtons.find(
        (btn) =>
          btn.textContent?.includes('افزودن به سبد') ||
          btn.getAttribute('aria-label')?.includes('افزودن به سبد')
      );
      expect(addToCartButton).toBeDefined();
      if (addToCartButton) {
        fireEvent.click(addToCartButton);
        expect(handleAddToCart).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      }
    });
    it('calls onAddToCart when onAddVariantToCart provided but no active variant', () => {
      const handleAddToCart = vi.fn();
      const handleAddVariantToCart = vi.fn();
      // Product with no sellerProducts so no activeVariant
      const productNoVariant: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product = {
        ...mockProduct,
        sellerProducts: [],
        productInfos: [
          {
            id: 201,
            productId: 101,
            sku: 'AJ1-HIGH-01',
            size: '42',
            colors: [{ id: 1, name: 'Black', hexCode: '#000000', createdAt: '', updatedAt: '' }],
            images: ['https://example.com/aj1.jpg'],
            createdAt: '',
            updatedAt: '',
          },
        ],
      };
      render(
        <MemoryRouter>
          <CustomersProductCard
            product={productNoVariant}
            onAddToCart={handleAddToCart}
            onAddVariantToCart={handleAddVariantToCart}
          />
        </MemoryRouter>
      );
      const addButtons = screen.getAllByRole('button');
      const addToCartButton = addButtons.find(
        (btn) =>
          btn.textContent?.includes('افزودن به سبد') ||
          btn.getAttribute('aria-label')?.includes('افزودن به سبد')
      );
      expect(addToCartButton).toBeDefined();
      if (addToCartButton) {
        fireEvent.click(addToCartButton);
        // onAddVariantToCart should NOT be called (no activeVariant)
        expect(handleAddVariantToCart).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
        // onAddToCart should be called
        expect(handleAddToCart).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      }
    });
  });
});

import { gql } from '@apollo/client';
export const GET_CART_QUERY = gql`
  query GetCart {
    myCart {
      id
      userId
      subtotal
      total
      createdAt
      updatedAt
      items {
        id
        cartId
        productId
        productName
        productImage
        quantity
        unitPrice
        totalPrice
        color
        size
        sellerId
        productInfoId
        sellerProductId
        availableStock
      }
    }
  }
`;
export const GET_SELLERS_BY_IDS_QUERY = gql`
  query GetSellersByIds($filter: SellerFilterInput) {
    sellers(filter: $filter) {
      edges {
        node {
          id
          shippingFee
          shippingPaymentMode
        }
      }
    }
  }
`;
// Alias for backward compatibility with existing code
export const GET_MY_CART_QUERY = GET_CART_QUERY;
export const GET_PRODUCTS_QUERY = gql`
  query GetProducts($filter: ProductFilterInput) {
    products(filter: $filter) {
      edges {
        cursor
        node {
          id
          name
          sku
          description
          archived
          productInfos {
            id
            size
            sizeKind
            colors {
              id
              name
              hexCode
            }
            weight
            images
          }
          categories {
            id
            name
            slug
          }
          sellerProducts {
            id
            price
            costPrice
            discount
            stockQuantity
            productInfoId
            boxLess
            seller {
              id
              shippingFee
              shippingPaymentMode
            }
          }
        }
      }
      pageInfo {
        hasNextPage
        hasPreviousPage
        endCursor
      }
      totalCount
    }
  }
`;
export const DISTINCT_PRODUCT_SIZES_QUERY = gql`
  query DistinctProductSizes($sizeKind: SizeKind) {
    distinctProductSizes(sizeKind: $sizeKind)
  }
`;
export const GET_MY_ORDERS_QUERY = gql`
  query GetMyOrders($first: Int = 10, $after: String) {
    myOrders(first: $first, after: $after) {
      id
      orderNumber
      customerEmail
      customerPhone
      customerName
      shippingAddress
      city
      state
      zipCode
      country
      status
      subtotal
      shippingCost
      total
      notes
      trackingNumber
      createdAt
      updatedAt
      sellerPhone
      sellerAddress
      shippingMethod
      shippingPaymentMode
      items {
        id
        productId
        productName
        productImage
        quantity
        unitPrice
        totalPrice
        color
        size
        originalPrice
        discountPercentage
        productInfoId
        sellerProductId
      }
    }
  }
`;
/**
 * Calculate shipping cost using smart shipping logic
 * Returns total shipping cost with breakdown per seller
 */
export const CALCULATE_SHIPPING_COST_QUERY = gql`
  query CalculateShippingCost(
    $cartSubtotal: Float!
    $sellerShippingFees: [SellerShippingInfoInput!]!
  ) {
    calculateShippingCost(
      cartSubtotal: $cartSubtotal
      sellerShippingFees: $sellerShippingFees
    ) {
      totalShippingCost
      freeShippingApplied
      strategyUsed
      shippingBreakdown {
        sellerId
        originalFee
        appliedFee
      }
    }

<file path="libs/client/customers/hooks/cart/src/lib/getDiscountedUnitPrice.spec.ts">
import { describe, expect, it } from '@jest/globals';
import { getDiscountedUnitPrice } from './getDiscountedUnitPrice';
describe('getDiscountedUnitPrice', () => {
  it('returns price rounded to 2dp when no discount', () => {
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(100, 0)).toBe(100);
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(100.123, 0)).toBe(100.12);
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(100.126, 0)).toBe(100.13);
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(100, undefined)).toBe(100);
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(100, null)).toBe(100);
  });
  it('applies 20% discount and rounds to 2dp', () => {
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(100, 20)).toBe(80);
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(100.123, 20)).toBe(80.1);
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(99.99, 20)).toBe(79.99);
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(50, 20)).toBe(40);
  });
  it('handles rounding edge cases to 2dp', () => {
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(100, 33)).toBe(67);
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(100, 33.33)).toBe(66.67);
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(100, 10)).toBe(90);
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(10, 50)).toBe(5);
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(0.01, 10)).toBe(0.01);
  });
  it('handles null/undefined discount as no discount', () => {
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(100, undefined)).toBe(100);
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(100, null)).toBe(100);
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(100, NaN)).toBe(100);
  });
  it('handles null/undefined price as 0', () => {
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(null, 20)).toBe(0);
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(undefined, 20)).toBe(0);
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(NaN, 20)).toBe(0);
  });
  it('handles negative discount as no discount', () => {
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(100, -10)).toBe(100);
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(100, -5)).toBe(100);
  });
  it('handles 100% discount', () => {
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(100, 100)).toBe(0);
  });
  it('handles discount over 100%', () => {
    expect(getDiscountedUnitPrice(100, 150)).toBe(-50);
  });
});
