<file path="libs/client/customers/hooks/cart/src/lib/getDiscountedUnitPrice.ts">
/**
 * Calculate the discounted unit price matching server-side computation.
 * Server computes: Number((price * (1 - (discount || 0) / 100)).toFixed(2))
 * @param price - Base price in USD
 * @param discount - Discount percentage (e.g., 20 for 20%)
 * @returns Discounted price rounded to 2 decimal places
 */
export function getDiscountedUnitPrice(
  price: number | null | undefined,
  discount: number | null | undefined
): number {
  const basePrice = Number(price) || 0;
  const discountPercent = Number(discount) || 0;
  if (discountPercent <= 0) {
    return Number(basePrice.toFixed(2));
  }
  const discounted = basePrice * (1 - discountPercent / 100);
  return Number(discounted.toFixed(2));
}

<file path="libs/client/customers/hooks/cart/src/lib/useCartService.ts">
import { useMutation, useQuery } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { useEffect, useRef, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  ADD_TO_CART_MUTATION,
  UPDATE_CART_ITEM_MUTATION,
  REMOVE_FROM_CART_MUTATION,
  CLEAR_CART_MUTATION,
  GET_MY_CART_QUERY,
  GET_SELLERS_BY_IDS_QUERY,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-graphql';
import {
  useCartStore,
  CartItem,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-cart-store';
import { useCustomersAuth } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-auth-context';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
/**
 * Cart service that bridges client Zustand store with server GraphQL mutations
 * Handles synchronization between local state and server state
 */
export function useCustomersCartService() {
  const { user } = useCustomersAuth();
  const isLoggedIn = !!user;
  const prevIsLoggedInRef = useRef<boolean | null>(null);
  // Server mutations
  const [addToCartMutation] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'addToCart'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationAddToCartArgs
  >(ADD_TO_CART_MUTATION, {
    refetchQueries: [{ query: GET_MY_CART_QUERY }],
  });
  const [updateCartItemMutation] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'updateCartItem'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationUpdateCartItemArgs
  >(UPDATE_CART_ITEM_MUTATION, {
    refetchQueries: [{ query: GET_MY_CART_QUERY }],
  });
  const [removeFromCartMutation] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'removeFromCart'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationRemoveFromCartArgs
  >(REMOVE_FROM_CART_MUTATION, {
    refetchQueries: [{ query: GET_MY_CART_QUERY }],
  });
  const [clearCartMutation] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'clearCart'>
  >(CLEAR_CART_MUTATION, {
    refetchQueries: [{ query: GET_MY_CART_QUERY }],
  });
  // Load user's cart from server when they log in
  const {
    data: serverCartData,
    loading: cartLoading,
    error: cartError,
  } = useQuery<Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'myCart'>>(GET_MY_CART_QUERY, {
    skip: !isLoggedIn,
  });
  // Extract unique seller IDs from cart items
  const sellerIds = useMemo(() => {
    if (!serverCartData?.myCart?.items) {
      return [];
    }
    const ids = new Set<number>();
    serverCartData.myCart.items.forEach((item) => {
      const sellerId = parseInt(item.sellerId, 10);
      if (!isNaN(sellerId) && sellerId > 0) {
        ids.add(sellerId);
      }
    });
    return Array.from(ids);
  }, [serverCartData]);
  // Fetch seller shipping fees
  const {
    data: sellersData,
    loading: sellersLoading,
    error: sellersError,
  } = useQuery<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'sellers'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.QuerySellersArgs
  >(GET_SELLERS_BY_IDS_QUERY, {
    variables: {
      filter:
        sellerIds.length > 0
          ? ({ ids: sellerIds } as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SellerFilterInput)
          : undefined,
    },
    skip: !isLoggedIn || sellerIds.length === 0,
  });
  // Create a map of sellerId -> shippingFee
  const sellerShippingFeeMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<number, number>();
    if (sellersData?.sellers?.edges) {
      sellersData.sellers.edges.forEach((edge) => {
        if (edge?.node?.id !== undefined) {
          // Convert ID to number (GraphQL might return it as string or number)
          const sellerId =
            typeof edge.node.id === 'string'
              ? parseInt(edge.node.id, 10)
              : edge.node.id;
          const shippingFee = edge.node.shippingFee ?? 0;
          if (!isNaN(sellerId)) {
            map.set(sellerId, shippingFee);
          }
        }
      });
    }
    return map;
  }, [sellersData]);
  // Create a map of sellerId -> shippingPaymentMode
  const sellerShippingModeMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<number, 'PAY_ON_DELIVERY' | 'PAY_ONLINE'>();
    if (sellersData?.sellers?.edges) {
      sellersData.sellers.edges.forEach((edge) => {
        if (edge?.node?.id !== undefined) {
          const sellerId =
            typeof edge.node.id === 'string'
              ? parseInt(edge.node.id, 10)
              : edge.node.id;
          const shippingPaymentMode =
            (edge.node.shippingPaymentMode as 'PAY_ON_DELIVERY' | 'PAY_ONLINE') ||
            'PAY_ON_DELIVERY';
          if (!isNaN(sellerId)) {
            map.set(sellerId, shippingPaymentMode);
          }
        }
      });
    }
    return map;
  }, [sellersData]);
  // Handle login state changes
  // Only clear cart when user actually logs OUT (not when they're just not logged in)
  // This allows unauthenticated users to maintain their local cart for guest checkout
  useEffect(() => {
    const prevIsLoggedIn = prevIsLoggedInRef.current;
    if (prevIsLoggedIn === null) {
      // Initial mount - don't clear cart, just track the state
      prevIsLoggedInRef.current = isLoggedIn;
      return;
    }
    if (prevIsLoggedIn === true && isLoggedIn === false) {
      // User logged out - clear local cart to prevent showing other users' items
      useCartStore.getState().clearCart();
    }
    // If user is not logged in from the start, keep their local cart
    // If user logs in, server cart will be loaded via useQuery and synced below
    prevIsLoggedInRef.current = isLoggedIn;
  }, [isLoggedIn]);
  // Sync server cart data to local Zustand store
  const syncServerCartToLocal = useCallback(
    (serverCart: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Cart) => {
      // If server cart is empty, clear local cart
      if (!serverCart.items || serverCart.items.length === 0) {
        useCartStore.getState().clearCart();
        return;
      }
      // Get current local items to preserve shipping fees if seller data hasn't loaded yet
      const currentLocalItems = useCartStore.getState().items;
      const localItemsMap = new Map<string, CartItem>();
      currentLocalItems.forEach((item) => {
        // Use sellerProductId as key since it's unique per seller-product combination
        const key = `${item.sellerId}-${item.sellerProductId}`;
        localItemsMap.set(key, item);
      });
      const localItems: CartItem[] = serverCart.items.map(
        (item: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.CartItem) => {
          const sellerIdNum = parseInt(item.sellerId, 10);
          // Try to get shipping fee from sellerShippingFeeMap first (authoritative source)
          let shippingFee = sellerShippingFeeMap.get(sellerIdNum);
          // If map doesn't have this seller yet (undefined), preserve from existing local item
          // This handles the case where seller data hasn't loaded yet
          if (shippingFee === undefined) {
            const key = `${item.sellerId}-${item.sellerProductId}`;
            const existingItem = localItemsMap.get(key);
            if (existingItem && existingItem.sellerShippingFee !== undefined) {
              shippingFee = existingItem.sellerShippingFee;
            } else {
              // No data available, default to 0
              shippingFee = 0;
            }
          }
          // If shippingFee is 0 from map, use it (seller explicitly has no fee)
          // Get shipping payment mode from sellerShippingModeMap
          let shippingMode = sellerShippingModeMap.get(sellerIdNum);
          if (shippingMode === undefined) {
            const key = `${item.sellerId}-${item.sellerProductId}`;
            const existingItem = localItemsMap.get(key);
            shippingMode =
              existingItem?.sellerShippingPaymentMode ?? 'PAY_ON_DELIVERY';
          }
          const cartItem: CartItem = {
            id: item.id,
            productId: item.productId,
            productName: item.productName,
            productImage: item.productImage || null,
            quantity: item.quantity,
            unitPrice: item.unitPrice,
            totalPrice: item.totalPrice,
            color: item.color || null,
            size: item.size || null,
            sellerId: item.sellerId,
            sellerName: '', // Not displayed to customers
            sellerShippingFee: shippingFee,
            sellerShippingPaymentMode: shippingMode,
            productInfoId: item.productInfoId || '',
            sellerProductId: item.sellerProductId || item.productId,
            availableStock: item.availableStock || 0,
          };
          return cartItem;
        }
      );
      // Update local store with server data
      useCartStore.getState().setItems(localItems);
    },
    [sellerShippingFeeMap, sellerShippingModeMap]
  );
  // Sync server cart to local store when data changes or seller shipping fees are loaded
  useEffect(() => {
    if (serverCartData?.myCart) {
      // If we have seller IDs but sellers are still loading, wait for them
      // Otherwise, sync immediately (for empty carts or when seller data is ready)
      if (sellerIds.length === 0 || !sellersLoading) {
        syncServerCartToLocal(serverCartData.myCart);
      }
    }
  }, [
    serverCartData,
    syncServerCartToLocal,
    sellerShippingFeeMap,
    sellersLoading,
    sellerIds.length,
  ]);
  // Add item to cart (both local and server)
  const addItem = async (itemData: Omit<CartItem, 'id' | 'totalPrice'>) => {
    // Always update local store immediately for instant UI feedback
    useCartStore.getState().addItem(itemData);
    // If logged in, also sync to server
    if (isLoggedIn) {
      try {
        await addToCartMutation({
          variables: {
            addToCartInput: {
              sellerProductId: itemData.sellerProductId,
              quantity: itemData.quantity,
            },
          },
        });
      } catch (error) {
        // Revert local change on server failure to maintain consistency
        useCartStore.getState().removeItem(itemData.sellerProductId);
        const structuredError = new Error(
          `Failed to add item to server cart: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}`
        );
        console.error('[useCartService] addItem server sync failed:', structuredError);
        throw structuredError;
      }
    }
  };
  // Update item quantity (both local and server)
  const updateItemQuantity = async (itemId: string, quantity: number) => {
    // Capture previous state for potential rollback
    const previousState = useCartStore.getState().items.find((item) => item.id === itemId);
    const previousQuantity = previousState?.quantity ?? 0;
    // Update local store immediately
    useCartStore.getState().updateItemQuantity(itemId, quantity);
    // If logged in, also sync to server
    if (isLoggedIn) {
      try {
        await updateCartItemMutation({
          variables: {
            itemId,
            updateInput: { quantity },
          },
        });
      } catch (error) {
        // Rollback local change on server failure
        if (previousState) {
          useCartStore.getState().updateItemQuantity(itemId, previousQuantity);
        } else {
          useCartStore.getState().removeItem(itemId);
        }
        const structuredError = new Error(
          `Failed to update item quantity on server: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}`
        );
        console.error('[useCartService] updateItemQuantity server sync failed:', structuredError);
        throw structuredError;
      }
    }
  };
  // Remove item from cart (both local and server)
  const removeItem = async (itemId: string) => {
    // Capture removed item for potential rollback
    const removedItem = useCartStore.getState().items.find((item) => item.id === itemId);
    // Update local store immediately
    useCartStore.getState().removeItem(itemId);
    // If logged in, also sync to server
    if (isLoggedIn) {
      try {
        await removeFromCartMutation({
          variables: { itemId },
        });
      } catch (error) {
        // Rollback local change on server failure
        if (removedItem) {
          useCartStore.getState().addItem({
            productId: removedItem.productId,
            productName: removedItem.productName,
            productImage: removedItem.productImage,
            quantity: removedItem.quantity,
            unitPrice: removedItem.unitPrice,
            color: removedItem.color,
            size: removedItem.size,
            sellerId: removedItem.sellerId,
            sellerName: removedItem.sellerName,
            sellerShippingFee: removedItem.sellerShippingFee,
            sellerShippingPaymentMode:
              removedItem.sellerShippingPaymentMode ?? 'PAY_ON_DELIVERY',
            productInfoId: removedItem.productInfoId,
            sellerProductId: removedItem.sellerProductId,
            availableStock: removedItem.availableStock,
          });
        }
        const structuredError = new Error(
          `Failed to remove item from server cart: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}`
        );
        console.error('[useCartService] removeItem server sync failed:', structuredError);
        throw structuredError;
      }
    }
  };
  // Clear cart (both local and server)
  const clearCart = async () => {
    // Capture current items for potential rollback
    const currentItems = [...useCartStore.getState().items];
    // Update local store immediately
    useCartStore.getState().clearCart();
    // If logged in, also sync to server
    if (isLoggedIn) {
      try {
        await clearCartMutation();
      } catch (error) {
        // Rollback local change on server failure
        if (currentItems.length > 0) {
          useCartStore.getState().setItems(currentItems);
        }
        const structuredError = new Error(
          `Failed to clear server cart: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}`
        );
        console.error('[useCartService] clearCart server sync failed:', structuredError);
        throw structuredError;
      }
    }
  };
  return {
    addItem,
    updateItemQuantity,
    removeItem,
    clearCart,
    isLoggedIn,
    cartLoading,
  };
}
</file>

<file path="libs/client/customers/hooks/orders/src/lib/customers-orders-hook.tsx">
import { useQuery } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { GET_MY_ORDERS_QUERY } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-graphql';
// Define Order type based on GraphQL schema
interface Order {
  id: string;
  orderNumber: string;
  customerEmail: string;
  customerPhone: string;
  customerName: string;
  shippingAddress: string;
  city: string;
  state: string;
  zipCode: string;
  country: string;
  status: string;
  subtotal: number;
  shippingCost: number;
  total: number;
  notes?: string;
  trackingNumber?: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  shippingMethod?: string;
  shippingPaymentMode?: 'PAY_ON_DELIVERY' | 'PAY_ONLINE';
  items: OrderItem[];
}
interface OrderItem {
  id: string;
  productId: string;
  productName: string;
  productImage?: string;
  quantity: number;
  unitPrice: number;
  totalPrice: number;
  color?: string;
  size?: string;
}
interface GetMyOrdersData {
  myOrders: Order[];
}
interface GetMyOrdersVariables {
  first?: number;
  after?: string;
}
export function useCustomersOrders({
  first = 50,
  after,
}: {
  first?: number;
  after?: string;
} = {}) {
  const { data, loading, error, refetch, fetchMore } = useQuery<
    GetMyOrdersData,
    GetMyOrdersVariables
  >(GET_MY_ORDERS_QUERY, {
    variables: { first, after },
    fetchPolicy: 'cache-and-network',
  });
  const loadMore = () => {
    if (data?.myOrders && data.myOrders.length > 0) {
      const lastOrder = data.myOrders[data.myOrders.length - 1];
      return fetchMore({
        variables: {
          after: lastOrder.id,
        },
      });
    }
  };
  return {
    orders: data?.myOrders || [],
    loading,
    error,
    refetch,
    loadMore,
  };
}

/** Localized contact form messages: [English, Persian]. */
const CONTACT_MESSAGES = {
  fullName: ['Please enter your full name', 'لطفاً نام و نام خانوادگی خود را وارد کنید'],
  email: ['Please enter your email address', 'لطفاً آدرس ایمیل خود را وارد کنید'],
  emailInvalid: ['Please enter a valid email address', 'فرمت آدرس ایمیل نامعتبر است'],
  subject: ['Please enter a subject', 'لطفاً موضوع پیام را وارد کنید'],
  message: ['Please write your message or inquiry', 'لطفاً متن پیام یا درخواست خود را بنویسید'],
} as const;
type ContactMessageKey = keyof typeof CONTACT_MESSAGES;
/** react-hook-form resolver over the shared contact schema with the existing messages. */
export const createContactResolver =
  (isEn: boolean): Resolver<ContactFormInput> =>
  async (values) => {
    const result = contactFormSchema.safeParse(values);
    if (result.success) return { values, errors: {} };
    const errors: Record<string, { type: string; message: string }> = {};
    for (const issue of result.error.issues) {
      const field = String(issue.path[0] ?? '');
      if (!field || errors[field]) continue;
      const key: ContactMessageKey | undefined =
        field === 'email' && issue.code !== 'too_small'
          ? 'emailInvalid'
          : field in CONTACT_MESSAGES
          ? (field as ContactMessageKey)
          : undefined;
      if (!key) continue;
      const [en, fa] = CONTACT_MESSAGES[key];
      errors[field] = { type: issue.code, message: isEn ? en : fa };
    }
    return { values: {}, errors: errors as FieldErrors<ContactFormInput> };
  };
const INQUIRY_TYPES = [
  {

<file path="libs/client/customers/screens/contact/src/lib/customer-contact.validation.spec.tsx">
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { createContactResolver } from './customer-contact';
const opts = { shouldUseNativeValidation: false, fields: {} };
const valid = {
  fullName: 'Ali Rezaei',
  email: 'ali@example.com',
  phone: '',
  inquiryType: 'AUTHENTICATION',
  subject: 'Serial check',
  message: 'Please verify tag #SB-98421.',
};
describe('contact form uses the shared Zod contact schema', () => {
  it('accepts a valid inquiry', async () => {
    expect((await createContactResolver(true)(valid, undefined, opts)).errors).toEqual({});
  });
  it('distinguishes a missing email from an invalid one', async () => {
    const missing = await createContactResolver(true)({ ...valid, email: ' ' }, undefined, opts);
    expect(missing.errors.email?.message).toBe('Please enter your email address');
    const invalid = await createContactResolver(true)({ ...valid, email: 'ali@x' }, undefined, opts);
    expect(invalid.errors.email?.message).toBe('Please enter a valid email address');
  });
  it('uses the Persian messages when the locale is not English', async () => {
    const res = await createContactResolver(false)({ ...valid, subject: '' }, undefined, opts);
    expect(res.errors.subject?.message).toBeTruthy();
    expect(res.errors.subject?.message).not.toBe('Please enter a subject');
  });
});

    </BrowserRouter>
  );

const mockItem: WishlistItem = {
  id: 42,
  name: 'Structured Technical Trench',
  brand: 'SAINTBALA',
  price: 890,
  productCode: 'SB-TR-042',
  primaryImage: 'https://images.example.com/trench.jpg',
};
describe('CustomerFavorites - shared product card', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockLocale = 'en';
    mockUseProductById.mockImplementation((id: number) => ({
      product: { id, name: 'Structured Technical Trench' },
      loading: false,
      error: null,
    }));
    useWishlistStore.setState({
      items: [],
      isLoading: false,
      error: null,
      lastUpdated: null,
    });
    window.matchMedia = vi.fn().mockImplementation((query) => ({
      matches: false,
      media: query,
      onchange: null,
      addListener: vi.fn(),
      removeListener: vi.fn(),
      addEventListener: vi.fn(),
      removeEventListener: vi.fn(),
      dispatchEvent: vi.fn(),
    }));
  });
  it('renders one shared product card per saved item, loading each product by id', () => {
    useWishlistStore.getState().addItem(mockItem);
    useWishlistStore.getState().addItem({ ...mockItem, id: 43, name: 'Runner' });
    renderWithProviders(<CustomerFavorites />);
    expect(screen.getByTestId('shared-product-card-42')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByTestId('shared-product-card-43')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(mockUseProductById).toHaveBeenCalledWith(42);
    expect(mockUseProductById).toHaveBeenCalledWith(43);
    expect(screen.queryByText('$890')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('renders nothing for an item whose product is not loaded', () => {
    mockUseProductById.mockReturnValue({ product: undefined, loading: true, error: null });
    useWishlistStore.getState().addItem(mockItem);
    renderWithProviders(<CustomerFavorites />);
    expect(screen.queryByTestId('shared-product-card-42')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('removes the item when the shared card heart is toggled', () => {
    useWishlistStore.getState().addItem(mockItem);
    renderWithProviders(<CustomerFavorites />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByTestId('favorite-toggle-42'));
    expect(useWishlistStore.getState().items).toHaveLength(0);
  });
});

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useQuery } from '@apollo/client/react';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Card from '@mui/material/Card';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';

import TableContainer from '@mui/material/TableContainer';
import TableHead from '@mui/material/TableHead';
import TableRow from '@mui/material/TableRow';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import Alert from '@mui/material/Alert';
import Accordion from '@mui/material/Accordion';
import AccordionSummary from '@mui/material/AccordionSummary';
import AccordionDetails from '@mui/material/AccordionDetails';
import Divider from '@mui/material/Divider';
import ExpandMore from '@mui/icons-material/ExpandMore';
import ShoppingBagOutlined from '@mui/icons-material/ShoppingBagOutlined';
import { useTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';
import { CustomersLayout } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-layout';
import { GET_MY_ORDERS_QUERY } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-graphql';
import {
  useI18nContext,
  useLanguageContext,
  usePageTitle,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
import { PriceDisplay } from '@kickzone-workspace/price-display';
import { OrderStatusChip } from '@kickzone-workspace/order-status-chip';
import { CUSTOMER_ROUTES } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-routes';
import { GlassmorphismContainer } from '@kickzone-workspace/glassmorphism-container';
import { useCustomersAuth } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-auth-context';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import { formatSizeLabel, SizeKind } from '@kickzone-workspace/product-sizes';
interface OrderItem {
  id: string;
  productId: string;
  productName: string;
  productImage: string | null;
  quantity: number;
  unitPrice: number;
  totalPrice: number;
  color: string | null;
  size: string | null;
}
interface Order {
  id: string;
  orderNumber: string;
  customerEmail: string;
  customerPhone: string;
  customerName: string;
  shippingAddress: string;
  city: string;
  state: string;
  zipCode: string;
  country: string;
  status: string;
  subtotal: number;
  shippingCost: number;
  total: number;
  notes: string | null;
  trackingNumber: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  shippingMethod?: string;
  shippingPaymentMode?: 'PAY_ON_DELIVERY' | 'PAY_ONLINE';
  items: OrderItem[];
}
interface OrdersData {
  myOrders: Order[];
}
const CANONICAL_PANTS_SIZE_RE = /^[1-9]\d?x[1-9]\d?$/;
const displayOrderItemSize = (size?: string | null): string => {
  if (!size) return '';
  const trimmed = size.trim();
  return CANONICAL_PANTS_SIZE_RE.test(trimmed)
    ? formatSizeLabel(SizeKind.Pants, trimmed) || size
    : size;
};
export function CustomerOrders() {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  usePageTitle(() => LL.pageTitles.orders());
  const { currentLocale } = useLanguageContext();
  const { user } = useCustomersAuth();
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isDark = theme.palette.mode === 'dark';
  const goldColor = isDark ? '#c5b89a' : '#7c6d48';
  const [expandedOrder, setExpandedOrder] = useState<string | false>(false);
  const formatDate = (dateString: string) => {
    return new Date(dateString).toLocaleDateString(currentLocale, {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'long',
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    });
  };
  // Only fetch orders if user is a customer
  const isCustomer = user?.role === KickzoneGraphqlTypes.UserRole.Customer;
  const {
    data: ordersData,
    loading: ordersLoading,
    error: ordersError,
  } = useQuery<OrdersData>(GET_MY_ORDERS_QUERY, {
    variables: { first: 50 },
    fetchPolicy: 'cache-and-network',
    skip: !isCustomer, // Skip query if user is not a customer
  });
  const handleExpandOrder = (orderId: string) => {
    setExpandedOrder(expandedOrder === orderId ? false : orderId);
  };
  if (ordersLoading) {
    return (
      <CustomersLayout>
        <Box
          display="flex"
          justifyContent="center"
          alignItems="center"
          minHeight="400px"
        >
          <CircularProgress />
        </Box>
      </CustomersLayout>
    );
  }
  // Check if user is not a customer
  if (user && !isCustomer) {
    return (
      <CustomersLayout>
        <GlassmorphismContainer fullHeight>
          <Alert severity="error">{LL.orders.onlyForCustomers()}</Alert>
        </GlassmorphismContainer>
      </CustomersLayout>
    );
  }
  if (ordersError) {
    // Check for the specific seller error message
    const isSellerError = ordersError.message.includes(
      'Sellers should use mySellerOrders query instead'
    );
    return (
      <CustomersLayout>
        <GlassmorphismContainer fullHeight>
          <Alert severity="error">
            {isSellerError
              ? LL.orders.onlyForCustomers()

            filter: 'blur(75px)',

            },

        <Box

            height: { xs: 260, sm: 400, md: 460 },
            borderRadius: '50%',
            background: isDark
              ? 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(140, 120, 80, 0.12) 0%, rgba(100, 85, 55, 0.02) 65%, transparent 70%)'
              : 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(245, 230, 215, 0.5) 0%, rgba(240, 220, 200, 0.18) 60%, transparent 70%)',

                      {/* Order Items */}
                      <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>

                      </Typography>
                      <TableContainer component={Paper} variant="outlined">

                                          {[item.color, displayOrderItemSize(item.size)]

                                <TableCell>
                                  <PriceDisplay
                                    priceInUSD={item.unitPrice}
                                    showSymbol={true}
                                    showOriginal={false}
                                  />
                                </TableCell>
                                <TableCell>
                                  <PriceDisplay
                                    priceInUSD={item.totalPrice}
                                    showSymbol={true}
                                    showOriginal={false}
                                  />
                                </TableCell>
                              </TableRow>
                            ))}
                          </TableBody>
                        </Table>
                      </TableContainer>
                    </Box>
                  </AccordionDetails>
                </Accordion>
              </Card>
            ))}
          </Box>
        )}
        </Box>
      </Box>
    </CustomersLayout>
  );
}
export default CustomerOrders;

/**
 * ZarinPal Payment Gateway helpers (client)
 *
 * Official API (v4): https://www.zarinpal.com/docs/paymentGateway/connectToGateway.html
 * Live docs MCP: https://www.zarinpal.com/docs/mcp
 *
 * Payment request/verify run on the Nest server (ZARINPAL_MERCHANT_ID).
 * This module keeps gateway URL fallbacks, types, and Persian error messages.
 */
export interface ZarinPalPaymentRequest {
  merchant_id: string;
  /** Amount in the unit of `currency` (IRT = Toman, IRR = Rial) */
  amount: number;
  callback_url: string;
  description: string;
  metadata?: {
    mobile?: string;
    email?: string;
    order_id?: string;
    order_ids?: string;
  };
  /** IRR = Rial, IRT = Toman. Kickzone uses IRT. */
  currency?: 'IRR' | 'IRT';
  referrer_id?: string;
}
export interface ZarinPalPaymentResponse {
  data: {
    code: number;
    message: string;
    authority: string;
    fee_type?: string;
    fee?: number;
  };
  errors: Array<{
    code: number;
    message: string;
  }>;
}
export interface ZarinPalVerificationRequest {
  merchant_id: string;
  /** Must match the amount used in the original request */
  amount: number;
  authority: string;
}
export interface ZarinPalVerificationResponse {
  data: {
    code: number;
    message: string;
    ref_id?: number;
    card_pan?: string;
    card_hash?: string;
    fee_type?: string;
    fee?: number;
  };
  errors: Array<{
    code: number;
    message: string;
  }>;
}
export const ZARINPAL_GATEWAY_URL = 'https://payment.zarinpal.com/pg/StartPay';
export const ZARINPAL_SANDBOX_GATEWAY_URL =
  'https://sandbox.zarinpal.com/pg/StartPay';
/**
 * Client-side sandbox flag used only as a fallback if GraphQL gateway URL fails.
 * Server sandbox is controlled by ZARINPAL_SANDBOX / NODE_ENV.
 */
export function isZarinPalSandbox(): boolean {
  const metaEnv = (import.meta as unknown as { env?: Record<string, string | undefined> }).env;
  const sandboxEnv = metaEnv?.VITE_ZARINPAL_SANDBOX;
  if (sandboxEnv === undefined || sandboxEnv === '') {
    return true;
  }
  return sandboxEnv === 'true';
}

/** Profile field names that differ from the checkout (shipping) field names. */
const PROFILE_TO_SHIPPING_FIELD: Record<string, string> = {
  phone: 'customerPhone',
  address: 'shippingAddress',
};
type ProfileIssue = {
  code: string;
  path: PropertyKey[];
  input?: unknown;
  errors?: ProfileIssue[][];
};
type ProfileSchema = {
  safeParse: (
    data: unknown,
    params: { reportInput: boolean }
  ) => { success: true } | { success: false; error: { issues: ProfileIssue[] } };
};
/** Maps a shared profile-schema issue to the existing localized validation message. */
export const profileIssueMessage = (
  issue: ProfileIssue,
  LL: TranslationFunctions
): string => {
  const field = String(issue.path[0] ?? '');
  // Clearable fields are "'' or a valid value": report the valid-value branch.
  const inner =
    issue.code === 'invalid_union'
      ? issue.errors?.[issue.errors.length - 1]?.[0] ?? issue
      : issue;
  return shippingIssueMessage(
    { code: inner.code, input: inner.input, path: [PROFILE_TO_SHIPPING_FIELD[field] ?? field] },
    LL
  );
};
/** react-hook-form resolver for the shared profile schemas (digits normalized first). */
export const createProfileResolver =
  <T extends FieldValues>(schema: ProfileSchema, LL: TranslationFunctions): Resolver<T> =>
  async (values) => {
    const normalized: Record<string, unknown> = { ...values };
    for (const key of ['phone', 'zipCode']) {
      const v = normalized[key];
      if (typeof v === 'string') normalized[key] = toEnglishDigits(v).trim();
    }
    const result = schema.safeParse(normalized, { reportInput: true });
    if (result.success) return { values, errors: {} };
    const errors: Record<string, { type: string; message: string }> = {};
    for (const issue of result.error.issues) {
      const field = String(issue.path[0] ?? '');
      if (field && !errors[field]) {
        errors[field] = { type: issue.code, message: profileIssueMessage(issue, LL) };
      }
    }
    return { values: {}, errors: errors as FieldErrors<T> };
  };
export function CustomerProfile() {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  usePageTitle(() => LL.customerProfile.pageTitle());
  const { currentLocale } = useLanguageContext();
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isDark = theme.palette.mode === 'dark';
  const isRtl = currentLocale === 'fa';
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { showSnackbar } = useSnackbar();
  const { user, logout } = useCustomersAuth();
  const isLoggedIn = Boolean(user);
  // Active Navigation Tab: 0 = Profile & Address, 1 = Security
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<number>(0);
  // Modals state
  const [editProfileOpen, setEditProfileOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editAddressOpen, setEditAddressOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editPreferencesOpen, setEditPreferencesOpen] = useState(false);
  // Query: My Profile (includes preferred sizing from database)
  const { data: profileData, refetch: refetchProfile } = useQuery<{
    myProfile: {
      id: string;
      userId: string;
      phone?: string | null;
      address?: string | null;
      city?: string | null;
      state?: string | null;
      zipCode?: string | null;
      country?: string | null;
      clothingSize?: string | null;
      shoeSize?: string | null;
    };
  }>(GET_MY_PROFILE, {
    fetchPolicy: 'cache-and-network',
    skip: !isLoggedIn,
  });
  // Mutation: Update My Profile
  const [updateProfileMutation, { loading: updatingProfile }] =
    useMutation(UPDATE_MY_PROFILE);
  // Profile Form state
  const [profileForm, setProfileForm] = useState({
    name: user?.name || '',
    lastName: user?.lastName || '',
    phone: profileData?.myProfile?.phone || '',
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    if (user || profileData?.myProfile) {
      setProfileForm((prev) => {
        const nextName = user?.name || prev.name;
        const nextLastName = user?.lastName || prev.lastName;
        const nextPhone = profileData?.myProfile?.phone || prev.phone;
        if (
          prev.name === nextName &&
          prev.lastName === nextLastName &&
          prev.phone === nextPhone
        ) {
          return prev;
        }
        return {
          name: nextName,
          lastName: nextLastName,
          phone: nextPhone,
        };
      });
    }
  }, [user, profileData]);
  // Address Form state matching backend fields
  const [addressForm, setAddressForm] = useState({
    state: profileData?.myProfile?.state || '',
    city: profileData?.myProfile?.city || '',
    zipCode: profileData?.myProfile?.zipCode || '',
    address: profileData?.myProfile?.address || '',
    phone: profileData?.myProfile?.phone || '',
    country: profileData?.myProfile?.country || 'ایران',
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    if (profileData?.myProfile) {
      const p = profileData.myProfile;
      setAddressForm({
        state: p.state || '',
        city: p.city || '',
        zipCode: p.zipCode || '',
        address: p.address || '',
        phone: p.phone || '',
        country: p.country || 'ایران',
      });
    }
  }, [profileData]);
  // Preferred Sizing Form state
  const [prefForm, setPrefForm] = useState({
    clothingSize: profileData?.myProfile?.clothingSize || '',
    shoeSize: profileData?.myProfile?.shoeSize || '',
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    if (profileData?.myProfile) {
      setPrefForm({
        clothingSize: profileData.myProfile.clothingSize || '',
        shoeSize: profileData.myProfile.shoeSize || '',
      });
    }
  }, [profileData]);
  // Address display data (placeholders when not logged in)
  const currentAddress = (isLoggedIn && profileData?.myProfile?.address) || '';
  const currentCity = (isLoggedIn && profileData?.myProfile?.city) || '';
  const currentState = (isLoggedIn && profileData?.myProfile?.state) || '';
  const currentZipCode = (isLoggedIn && profileData?.myProfile?.zipCode) || '';
  const currentCountry = (isLoggedIn && profileData?.myProfile?.country) || '';
  const currentPhone = (isLoggedIn && profileData?.myProfile?.phone) || '';
  const hasAddress = Boolean(
    isLoggedIn && (currentAddress || currentCity || currentState || currentZipCode)
  );
  // Preferred sizing display data from service
  const currentClothingSize =
    (isLoggedIn && profileData?.myProfile?.clothingSize) || '';
  const currentShoeSize =
    (isLoggedIn && profileData?.myProfile?.shoeSize) || '';
  const displayClothingSize = isLoggedIn
    ? currentClothingSize || '—'
    : '—';
  const displayShoeSize = isLoggedIn ? currentShoeSize || '—' : '—';
  // Display user info (only placeholders if not logged in)
  const displayName = isLoggedIn && user?.name
    ? `${user.name} ${user.lastName || ''}`.trim()
    : '—';
  const displayEmail = isLoggedIn && user?.email ? user.email : '—';
  const displayPhone = isLoggedIn && currentPhone ? currentPhone : '—';
  const displayRole = isLoggedIn
    ? LL.customerProfile.customerAccount()
    : LL.customerProfile.guestAccount();
  // Handle Copy Email
  const handleCopyEmail = () => {
    if (isLoggedIn && displayEmail !== '—') {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(displayEmail);
      showSnackbar(LL.customerProfile.emailCopied(), { severity: 'success' });
    }
  };
  // Open Edit Address Modal
  const handleOpenEditAddress = () => {
    if (!isLoggedIn) return;
    setAddressForm({
      state: currentState,
      city: currentCity,
      zipCode: toEnglishDigits(currentZipCode),
      address: currentAddress,
      phone: toEnglishDigits(currentPhone || profileForm.phone),
      country: currentCountry || 'ایران',
    });
    setEditAddressOpen(true);

    mode: 'onSubmit',
  });
  const phoneRhf = useForm<ProfilePhoneFormInput>({

    resolver: phoneResolver,

  });

  const phoneErrors = phoneRhf.formState.errors;
  // Save Address Modal Action
  const handleSaveAddress = async () => {
    if (!isLoggedIn) return;

                      <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '12px', color: colors.textSecondary, mt: 0.25, fontFamily: isRtl ? farsiFont : 'inherit' }}>

                    component={RouterLink}
                    to={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.ORDERS}

                    {LL.customerProfile.goToOrders()}
                  </Button>
                </Box>
              </Grid>
            </Grid>
          )}
          {/* TAB 1: Account Security & Authentication */}
          {activeTab === 1 && (
            <Box
              sx={{

                variant="h6"

<file path="libs/client/customers/screens/customer-profile/src/lib/customer-profile.validation.spec.tsx">
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import type { TranslationFunctions } from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
import {
  profileAddressFormSchema,
  profilePhoneFormSchema,
  type ProfileAddressFormInput,
  type ProfilePhoneFormInput,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import { createProfileResolver } from './customer-profile';
// Every LL.validation.<field>.<rule>() returns "<field>.<rule>".
const makeLL = (prefix: string[] = []): unknown =>
  new Proxy(() => prefix.slice(1).join('.'), {
    get: (_t, key) => makeLL([...prefix, String(key)]),
  });
const LL = makeLL() as TranslationFunctions;
const opts = { shouldUseNativeValidation: false, fields: {} };
describe('customer profile forms use the shared Zod profile schemas', () => {
  const address = createProfileResolver<ProfileAddressFormInput>(profileAddressFormSchema, LL);
  const phone = createProfileResolver<ProfilePhoneFormInput>(profilePhoneFormSchema, LL);
  it('accepts a valid address with Persian digits and allows blank (cleared) fields', async () => {
    const res = await address(
      { state: '', city: '', address: '', zipCode: '۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹۰', phone: '09128884422', country: '' },
      undefined,
      opts
    );
    expect(res.errors).toEqual({});
  });
  it('reports localized messages for invalid fields, mapped to the checkout rules', async () => {
    const res = await address(
      { state: 'T', city: 'Tehran', address: 'ab', zipCode: '12', phone: 'xx', country: 'Iran' },
      undefined,
      opts
    );
    expect(res.errors['state']?.message).toBe('state.minLength');
    expect(res.errors['address']?.message).toBe('address.minLength');
    expect(res.errors['zipCode']?.message).toBe('zipCode.minLength');
    expect(res.errors['phone']?.message).toBe('phone.invalid');
    expect(res.errors['city']).toBeUndefined();
  });
  it('validates the personal-info phone', async () => {
    expect((await phone({ phone: '0912 888 4422' }, undefined, opts)).errors).toEqual({});
    expect((await phone({ phone: 'abc' }, undefined, opts)).errors['phone']?.message).toBe('phone.invalid');
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/customers/screens/customer-shopping-cart/src/lib/build-order-confirmation-data.spec.ts">
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { buildOrderConfirmationData } from './build-order-confirmation-data';
function createMockOrder(overrides: Partial<Parameters<typeof buildOrderConfirmationData>[0][0]> = {}) {
  return {
    id: 'order-1',
    orderNumber: 'ORD-1001',
    trackingNumber: 'TRK-1001',
    customerEmail: 'test@example.com',
    customerPhone: '09121234567',
    customerName: 'Test User',
    shippingAddress: '123 Test St',
    city: 'Tehran',
    state: 'Tehran',
    zipCode: '1234567890',
    country: 'Iran',
    subtotal: 100,
    shippingCost: 10,
    total: 110,
    notes: 'Test notes',
    createdAt: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
    items: [
      {
        productId: 'prod-1',
        productName: 'Product 1',
        productImage: '/img1.jpg',
        quantity: 2,
        unitPrice: 50,
        totalPrice: 100,
        color: '#121212',
        size: 'L',
      },
    ],
    ...overrides,
  };
}
describe('buildOrderConfirmationData', () => {
  it('returns null for empty array', () => {
    expect(buildOrderConfirmationData([])).toBeNull();
  });
  it('returns null for array with only null/undefined', () => {
    expect(buildOrderConfirmationData([null, undefined])).toBeNull();
  });
  it('builds confirmation data from a single order', () => {
    const order = createMockOrder();
    const result = buildOrderConfirmationData([order]);
    expect(result).not.toBeNull();
    expect(result?.id).toBe('order-1');
    expect(result?.orderNumber).toBe('ORD-1001');
    expect(result?.trackingNumber).toBe('TRK-1001');
    expect(result?.customerEmail).toBe('test@example.com');
    expect(result?.customerPhone).toBe('09121234567');
    expect(result?.customerName).toBe('Test User');
    expect(result?.shippingAddress).toBe('123 Test St');
    expect(result?.city).toBe('Tehran');
    expect(result?.state).toBe('Tehran');
    expect(result?.zipCode).toBe('1234567890');
    expect(result?.country).toBe('Iran');
    expect(result?.subtotal).toBe(100);
    expect(result?.shippingCost).toBe(10);
    expect(result?.total).toBe(110);
    expect(result?.notes).toBe('Test notes');
    expect(result?.createdAt).toBe('2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z');
    expect(result?.items).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(result?.items[0].productId).toBe('prod-1');
    expect(result?.items[0].productName).toBe('Product 1');
    expect(result?.items[0].quantity).toBe(2);
    expect(result?.items[0].unitPrice).toBe(50);
    expect(result?.items[0].totalPrice).toBe(100);
    expect(result?.items[0].color).toBe('#121212');
    expect(result?.items[0].size).toBe('L');
    expect(result?.sellerOrders).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(result?.sellerOrders?.[0]).toEqual({
      id: 'order-1',
      orderNumber: 'ORD-1001',
      total: 110,
      trackingNumber: 'TRK-1001',
    });
  });
  it('concatenates items and sums totals from two seller orders', () => {
    const order1 = createMockOrder({
      id: 'order-1',
      orderNumber: 'ORD-1001',
      trackingNumber: 'TRK-1001',
      subtotal: 100,
      shippingCost: 10,
      total: 110,
      items: [
        {
          productId: 'prod-1',
          productName: 'Product 1',
          productImage: '/img1.jpg',
          quantity: 2,
          unitPrice: 50,
          totalPrice: 100,
          color: '#121212',
          size: 'L',
        },
      ],
    });
    const order2 = createMockOrder({
      id: 'order-2',
      orderNumber: 'ORD-1002',
      trackingNumber: 'TRK-1002',
      subtotal: 200,
      shippingCost: 15,
      total: 215,
      items: [
        {
          productId: 'prod-2',
          productName: 'Product 2',
          productImage: '/img2.jpg',
          quantity: 1,
          unitPrice: 200,
          totalPrice: 200,
          color: '#333333',
          size: 'M',
        },
        {
          productId: 'prod-3',
          productName: 'Product 3',
          productImage: '/img3.jpg',
          quantity: 3,
          unitPrice: 30,
          totalPrice: 90,
          color: null,
          size: null,
        },
      ],
    });
    const result = buildOrderConfirmationData([order1, order2]);
    expect(result).not.toBeNull();
    // First order's customer/address info used
    expect(result?.id).toBe('order-1');
    expect(result?.orderNumber).toBe('ORD-1001');
    expect(result?.trackingNumber).toBe('TRK-1001');
    // Items concatenated
    expect(result?.items).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(result?.items[0].productId).toBe('prod-1');
    expect(result?.items[1].productId).toBe('prod-2');
    expect(result?.items[2].productId).toBe('prod-3');
    // Totals summed
    expect(result?.subtotal).toBe(300); // 100 + 200
    expect(result?.shippingCost).toBe(25); // 10 + 15
    expect(result?.total).toBe(325); // 110 + 215
    // sellerOrders has both
    expect(result?.sellerOrders).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(result?.sellerOrders?.[0]).toEqual({
      id: 'order-1',
      orderNumber: 'ORD-1001',
      total: 110,
      trackingNumber: 'TRK-1001',
    });
    expect(result?.sellerOrders?.[1]).toEqual({
      id: 'order-2',
      orderNumber: 'ORD-1002',
      total: 215,
      trackingNumber: 'TRK-1002',
    });
  });
  it('ignores null/undefined entries in the input array', () => {
    const order = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-1', orderNumber: 'ORD-1001' });
    const result = buildOrderConfirmationData([null, order, undefined]);
    expect(result).not.toBeNull();
    expect(result?.id).toBe('order-1');
    expect(result?.orderNumber).toBe('ORD-1001');
    expect(result?.items).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(result?.sellerOrders).toHaveLength(1);
  });
  it('handles items with null color and size', () => {
    const order = createMockOrder({
      items: [
        {
          productId: 'prod-1',
          productName: 'Product 1',
          productImage: '/img1.jpg',
          quantity: 1,
          unitPrice: 50,
          totalPrice: 50,
          color: null,
          size: null,
        },
      ],
    });
    const result = buildOrderConfirmationData([order]);
    expect(result).not.toBeNull();
    expect(result?.items[0].color).toBeUndefined();
    expect(result?.items[0].size).toBeUndefined();
  });
  it('handles trackingNumber being null', () => {
    const order = createMockOrder({ trackingNumber: null as unknown as string });
    const result = buildOrderConfirmationData([order]);
    expect(result).not.toBeNull();
    expect(result?.trackingNumber).toBeNull();
    expect(result?.sellerOrders?.[0].trackingNumber).toBeNull();
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/customers/screens/customer-shopping-cart/src/lib/build-order-confirmation-data.ts">
/**
 * Builds order confirmation data from createOrder mutation results.
 * Pure function with no side effects - suitable for testing.
 */
import type { OrderData, OrderItem } from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-order-confirmation';
// Type for the createOrder mutation result (as returned by the server)
export interface CreateOrderResult {
  id: string;
  orderNumber: string;
  trackingNumber: string;
  customerEmail: string;
  customerPhone: string;
  customerName: string;
  shippingAddress: string;
  city: string;
  state: string;
  zipCode: string;
  country: string;
  subtotal: number;
  shippingCost: number;
  total: number;
  notes: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  items: Array<{
    productId: string;
    productName: string;
    productImage: string | null;
    quantity: number;
    unitPrice: number;
    totalPrice: number;
    color: string | null;
    size: string | null;
  }>;
}
// Extended OrderData with optional sellerOrders for multi-seller display
export interface OrderConfirmationData extends OrderData {
  sellerOrders?: Array<{
    id: string;
    orderNumber: string;
    total: number;
    trackingNumber?: string | null;
  }>;
}
/**
 * Maps a server order item to the OrderItem type used by the confirmation page.
 */
function mapOrderItem(item: CreateOrderResult['items'][0]): OrderItem {
  return {
    productId: item.productId,
    productName: item.productName,
    productImage: item.productImage,
    quantity: item.quantity,
    unitPrice: item.unitPrice,
    totalPrice: item.totalPrice,
    color: item.color ?? undefined,
    size: item.size ?? undefined,
  };
}
/**
 * Builds order confirmation data from an array of createOrder results.
 *
 * @param orders - Array of fulfilled createOrder mutation results
 * @returns OrderConfirmationData compatible with CustomerOrderConfirmation page, or null if input is empty
 *
 * Behavior:
 * - Uses customer/address/id/orderNumber/trackingNumber/createdAt/notes from the FIRST order
 * - Concatenates all items from all orders
 * - Sums subtotal, shippingCost, total across all orders
 * - Creates sellerOrders array with one entry per order
 * - Ignores null/undefined entries in the input array
 * - Returns null for empty input (after filtering)
 */
export function buildOrderConfirmationData(
  orders: Array<CreateOrderResult | null | undefined>
): OrderConfirmationData | null {
  // Filter out null/undefined entries
  const validOrders = orders.filter((o): o is CreateOrderResult => o != null);
  if (validOrders.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }
  const firstOrder = validOrders[0];
  // Concatenate all items from all orders
  const allItems = validOrders.flatMap((order) => order.items.map(mapOrderItem));
  // Sum totals across all orders
  const subtotal = validOrders.reduce((sum, order) => sum + order.subtotal, 0);
  const shippingCost = validOrders.reduce((sum, order) => sum + order.shippingCost, 0);
  const total = validOrders.reduce((sum, order) => sum + order.total, 0);
  // Build sellerOrders array
  const sellerOrders = validOrders.map((order) => ({
    id: order.id,
    orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
    total: order.total,
    trackingNumber: order.trackingNumber ?? null,
  }));
  return {
    id: firstOrder.id,
    orderNumber: firstOrder.orderNumber,
    trackingNumber: firstOrder.trackingNumber,
    customerEmail: firstOrder.customerEmail,
    customerPhone: firstOrder.customerPhone,
    customerName: firstOrder.customerName,
    shippingAddress: firstOrder.shippingAddress,
    city: firstOrder.city,
    state: firstOrder.state,
    zipCode: firstOrder.zipCode,
    country: firstOrder.country,
    subtotal,
    shippingCost,
    total,
    items: allItems,
    notes: firstOrder.notes,
    createdAt: firstOrder.createdAt,
    sellerOrders,
  };
}

describe('CustomerSignup - Zod/RHF Integration', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockUseCustomersRegister.mockReturnValue({
      handleRegister: mockHandleRegister,
      registerLoading: false,
    });
  });
  const renderComponent = () => {
    return render(
      <BrowserRouter>
        <CustomerSignup />
      </BrowserRouter>
    );
  };
  const fillForm = async (
    name: string,
    email: string,
    password: string,
    confirmPassword: string
  ) => {
    const nameInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Full Name/i);
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i);
    const passwordInputs = screen.getAllByLabelText(/^Password/i);
    const passwordInput = passwordInputs[0];
    const confirmPasswordInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Confirm Password/i);
    fireEvent.change(nameInput, { target: { value: name } });
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: email } });
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: password } });
    fireEvent.change(confirmPasswordInput, { target: { value: confirmPassword } });
  };
  it('should show passwordTooShort error and NOT call handleRegister when password is 7 characters', async () => {
    renderComponent();
    await fillForm('John Doe', 'john@example.com', 'short7c', 'short7c');
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create Account' });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Password must be at least 8 characters long')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    expect(mockHandleRegister).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('should show passwordsDoNotMatch error and NOT call handleRegister when passwords mismatch', async () => {
    renderComponent();
    await fillForm('John Doe', 'john@example.com', 'password123', 'different');
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create Account' });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Passwords do not match')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    expect(mockHandleRegister).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('should call handleRegister with trimmed values when valid input with whitespace', async () => {
    mockHandleRegister.mockResolvedValue({});
    renderComponent();
    await fillForm('  Ann  ', '  ann@example.com  ', 'validPassword123', 'validPassword123');
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create Account' });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockHandleRegister).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Ann', 'ann@example.com', 'validPassword123');
    });
    expect(mockHandleRegister).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
});

import React, { useState } from 'react';

import { customerForgotPasswordFormSchema, type CustomerForgotPasswordFormValues } from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';

import { GlassmorphismContainer } from '@kickzone-workspace/glassmorphism-container';
import { getLtrTextFieldProps } from '@kickzone-workspace/language-components';
import type { FieldError } from 'react-hook-form';
export function CustomerForgotPassword() {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  usePageTitle(() => LL.pageTitles.forgotPassword());
  const { showSnackbar } = useSnackbar();
  const { handleForgotPassword, forgotPasswordLoading } =
    useCustomersForgotPassword();
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isDark = theme.palette.mode === 'dark';
  const isRtl = theme.direction === 'rtl';
  const goldColor = isDark ? '#c5b89a' : '#7c6d48';
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm<CustomerForgotPasswordFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(customerForgotPasswordFormSchema),
    mode: 'onSubmit',
    defaultValues: {
      email: '',
    },
  });
  const fieldErrorText = (error: FieldError | undefined): string => {
    if (!error || !error.type) return '';
    // For required, invalid_type, too_big, invalid_string (email), etc.
    return LL.errors.requiredFields();
  };
  const onValidSubmit = async (values: CustomerForgotPasswordFormValues) => {
    try {
      const baseUrl = window.location.origin;
      await handleForgotPassword(values.email, baseUrl);
      setSubmitted(true);
      showSnackbar(LL.authorization.resetLinkSent(), {
        severity: 'success',
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const { translationKey, rawMessage } = getErrorMessage(error as Error);
      const errorMessage = translationKey
        ? LL.errors[translationKey]()
        : rawMessage || LL.errors.unknown();
      showSnackbar(errorMessage, { severity: 'error' });
    }
  };
  const onInvalidSubmit = () => {
    showSnackbar(LL.errors.requiredFields(), { severity: 'error' });
  };
  return (
    <CustomersLayout>
      <Box
        sx={{
          minHeight: 'calc(100vh - 120px)',
          width: '100%',
          position: 'relative',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          pt: { xs: 8, sm: 10 },
          pb: { xs: 8, sm: 10 },
          px: 2,
          overflow: 'hidden',
        }}
      >
        {/* Ambient liquid lighting glow orbs */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: { xs: '5%', md: '10%' },
            right: { xs: '-5%', md: '15%' },
            width: { xs: 260, sm: 400, md: 480 },
            height: { xs: 260, sm: 400, md: 480 },
            borderRadius: '50%',
            background: isDark
              ? 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.15) 0%, rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.02) 65%, transparent 70%)'
              : 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(230, 215, 185, 0.55) 0%, rgba(240, 230, 205, 0.2) 60%, transparent 70%)',
            filter: 'blur(70px)',
            pointerEvents: 'none',
            zIndex: 0,
            animation: 'floatOrb 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate',
            '@keyframes floatOrb': {
              '0%': { transform: 'translate(0, 0) scale(1)' },
              '100%': { transform: 'translate(-30px, 35px) scale(1.08)' },
            },
          }}
        />
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            bottom: { xs: '5%', md: '8%' },
            left: { xs: '-5%', md: '12%' },
            width: { xs: 240, sm: 380, md: 440 },
            height: { xs: 240, sm: 380, md: 440 },
            borderRadius: '50%',
            background: isDark
              ? 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(140, 120, 80, 0.12) 0%, rgba(100, 85, 55, 0.02) 65%, transparent 70%)'
              : 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(245, 230, 215, 0.5) 0%, rgba(240, 220, 200, 0.18) 60%, transparent 70%)',
            filter: 'blur(80px)',
            pointerEvents: 'none',
            zIndex: 0,
            animation: 'floatOrb2 16s ease-in-out infinite alternate',
            '@keyframes floatOrb2': {
              '0%': { transform: 'translate(0, 0) scale(1)' },
              '100%': { transform: 'translate(35px, -25px) scale(1.06)' },

            }}
            containerSx={{

                ? 'rgba(24, 24, 22, 0.82) !important'
                : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88) !important',
              backgroundImage: isDark
                ? 'linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(28, 28, 24, 0.85) 0%, rgba(20, 20, 18, 0.75) 50%, rgba(15, 15, 14, 0.85) 100%) !important'

              border: isDark
                ? '1px solid rgba(240, 239, 235, 0.12) !important'
                : '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) !important',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(28px) saturate(190%) !important',
              WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(28px) saturate(190%) !important',
              boxShadow: isDark
                ? '0 24px 64px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), inset 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14), inset 0 -1px 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important'
                : '0 24px 60px -12px rgba(180, 165, 140, 0.25), 0 0 0 1px rgba(143, 132, 104, 0.1), inset 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95), inset 0 -1px 1px 0 rgba(143, 132, 104, 0.08) !important',

                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                background: isDark
                  ? 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.22) 0%, rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.06) 100%)'
                  : 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(168, 152, 112, 0.22) 0%, rgba(168, 152, 112, 0.08) 100%)',
                border: isDark
                  ? '1px solid rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.4)'
                  : '1px solid rgba(143, 132, 104, 0.35)',
                boxShadow: isDark
                  ? '0 12px 28px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), 0 0 20px rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.2), inset 0 1px 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)'
                  : '0 10px 24px -4px rgba(168, 152, 112, 0.25), inset 0 1px 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)',
                backdropFilter: 'blur(16px)',
                WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(16px)',
                color: goldColor,
                mb: 2,

            </Box>
            {/* Brand Sub-label */}
            <Typography
              variant="caption"
              sx={{

    ...mockHomePageData,
    all: {
      ...mockHomePageData.all,
      edges: mockHomePageData.all.edges.map((e) => ({
        node: {
          ...e.node,
          productInfos: e.node.productInfos && e.node.productInfos.length > 0
            ? [{ ...e.node.productInfos[0], size: s }]
            : [{ size: s }],
        } as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product,
      })),
    },
  };
}

import { gql } from '@apollo/client';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import { resolveProductBrand } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-product-card';
import { getCustomerBrandRoute } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-routes';
export const HOME_PAGE_QUERY = gql`
  query HomePage {
    all: products(filter: { first: 200, onlyInStock: true, onlyWithSellers: true, archivedStatus: ACTIVE }) {
      totalCount
      edges {
        node {
          id
          name
          sku
          brandId
          brand {
            id
            slug
            name
          }
          categories {
            id
            slug
            name
          }
          productInfos {
            id
            size
            sizeKind
            images
            colors {
              id
              name
              hexCode
            }
          }
          sellerProducts {
            id
            productInfoId
            price
            discount
            stockQuantity
            seller {
              id
              shippingFee
              shippingPaymentMode
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    categories {
      id
      slug
      name
    }
    rate: currentExchangeRate(fromCurrencyCode: "USD", toCurrencyCode: "IRR") {
      rate
    }
  }
`;
export interface HomePageData {
  all?: {
    totalCount: number;
    edges: Array<{
      node: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product;
    }>;
  };
  categories?: Array<{
    id: number;
    slug: string;
    name: string;
  }>;
  rate?: {
    rate: number;
  };
}
/**
 * Format a number into Persian digits with thousand separators
 */
export function toPersianDigits(n: number | string): string {
  const num = typeof n === 'string' ? parseFloat(n) : n;
  if (isNaN(num)) return String(n);
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('fa-IR').format(num);
}
/**
 * Format price in Toman
 */
export function formatTomanPrice(
  usdPrice: number,
  rate = 270000,
  discount = 0,
  currencyLabel = 'تومان',
  locale: 'fa' | 'en' = 'fa'
): string {
  const finalUSD = discount > 0 ? usdPrice * (1 - discount / 100) : usdPrice;
  const toman = Math.round(finalUSD * rate);
  return `${new Intl.NumberFormat(locale === 'fa' ? 'fa-IR' : 'en-US').format(toman)} ${currencyLabel}`;
}
export type HomeCategory = {
  id: number;
  slug: string;
  name: string;
};
/** Resolve a category display name from API (locale-aware) with slug fallback. */
export function resolveCategoryLabel(
  slug: string,
  categories: HomeCategory[] | undefined,
  fallback: string
): string {
  const match = categories?.find(
    (c) => (c.slug || '').toLowerCase() === slug.toLowerCase()
  );
  if (match?.name) {
    return match.name;
  }
  return fallback;
}
/**
 * Check whether a product is strictly in-stock with active sellers
 */
export function isProductInStock(product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product): boolean {
  if (!product.sellerProducts || product.sellerProducts.length === 0) return false;
  return product.sellerProducts.some(
    (sp) => sp.seller && (sp.stockQuantity || 0) > 0
  );
}
/**
 * Check if product belongs to women category
 */
export function isWomenProduct(product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product): boolean {
  const cats = product.categories || [];
  return cats.some((c) => {
    const slug = (c.slug || '').toLowerCase();
    const name = (c.name || '').toLowerCase();
    return (
      slug === 'women' ||
      slug === 'womens' ||
      slug.includes('women') ||
      name.includes('زنانه') ||
      name.includes('women')
    );
  });
}
/**
 * Check if product belongs to men category
 */
export function isMenProduct(product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product): boolean {
  if (isWomenProduct(product)) {
    return false;
  }
  const cats = product.categories || [];
  return cats.some((c) => {
    const slug = (c.slug || '').toLowerCase();
    const name = (c.name || '').toLowerCase();
    return (
      slug === 'men' ||
      slug === 'mens' ||
      /\bmen\b/i.test(slug) ||
      name.includes('مردانه') ||
      /\bmen\b/i.test(name)
    );
  });
}
/**
 * Look up a product by SKU (case-insensitive) or by ID
 */
export function findProduct(
  products: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product[],
  skuOrId: string | number
): KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product | undefined {
  if (typeof skuOrId === 'number') {
    return products.find((p) => p.id === skuOrId);
  }
  const clean = skuOrId.trim().toUpperCase();
  // match SKU
  const bySku = products.find(
    (p) => (p.sku || '').trim().toUpperCase() === clean
  );
  if (bySku) return bySku;
  // match ID string
  const numId = parseInt(clean, 10);
  if (!isNaN(numId)) {
    return products.find((p) => p.id === numId);
  }
  return undefined;
}
/**
 * Derives all required home page sections data
 */
export function selectHomePageData(data?: HomePageData | null) {
  const rawList = data?.all?.edges?.map((e) => e.node) || [];
  // Filter only products that are in stock
  const allInStock = rawList.filter(isProductInStock);
  const exchangeRate = data?.rate?.rate || 270000;
  // 1. Curated Hero Products
  // Right: DX2324-531 or id 26
  const heroRight =
    findProduct(allInStock, 'DX2324-531') ||
    findProduct(allInStock, 26) ||
    allInStock.find(isWomenProduct);
  // Center: FV7247-010 or id 91
  const heroCenter =
    findProduct(allInStock, 'FV7247-010') ||
    findProduct(allInStock, 91) ||
    allInStock[0];
  // Left: HV0959-020 or id 77
  const heroLeft =
    findProduct(allInStock, 'HV0959-020') ||
    findProduct(allInStock, 77) ||
    allInStock.find(isMenProduct);
  // Set of IDs used in hero
  const heroIds = new Set<number>(
    [heroRight?.id, heroCenter?.id, heroLeft?.id].filter(
      (id): id is number => typeof id === 'number'
    )
  );
  // Category Bento Items
  // Big Jordan: FZ1919-366
  const bentoJordan = findProduct(allInStock, 'FZ1919-366');
  // Women: DX0397-277
  const bentoWomen = findProduct(allInStock, 'DX0397-277');
  // Men: IF2934-010
  const bentoMen = findProduct(allInStock, 'IF2934-010');
  // Hoodies: DM3330-646
  const bentoHoodies = findProduct(allInStock, 'DM3330-646');
  // Pants: FD7212-340
  const bentoPants = findProduct(allInStock, 'FD7212-340');
  // Counts live compute per category
  let jordanCount = 0;
  let womenCount = 0;
  let menCount = 0;
  let hoodiesCount = 0;
  let pantsCount = 0;
  allInStock.forEach((p) => {
    const brandName = resolveProductBrand(p).toLowerCase();
    if (brandName === 'jordan' || p.brand?.slug === 'jordan') jordanCount++;
    const cats = p.categories || [];
    let isPWomen = false;
    let isPHoodie = false;
    let isPPant = false;
    cats.forEach((c) => {
      const slug = (c.slug || '').toLowerCase();
      const name = (c.name || '').toLowerCase();
      if (
        slug === 'women' ||
        slug === 'womens' ||
        slug.includes('women') ||
        name.includes('زنانه') ||
        name.includes('women')
      ) {
        isPWomen = true;
      }
      if (
        slug.includes('hoodie') ||
        name.includes('hoodie') ||
        name.includes('هودی')
      ) {
        isPHoodie = true;
      }
      if (
        slug.includes('pant') ||
        slug.includes('jogger') ||
        slug.includes('trouser') ||
        slug.includes('sweatpant') ||
        name.includes('pant') ||
        name.includes('jogger') ||
        name.includes('trouser') ||
        name.includes('sweatpant') ||
        name.includes('شلوار') ||
        name.includes('اسلش')
      ) {
        isPPant = true;
      }
    });
    const productNameLower = (p.name || '').toLowerCase();
    if (
      productNameLower.includes('pant') ||
      productNameLower.includes('jogger') ||
      productNameLower.includes('trouser') ||
      productNameLower.includes('sweatpant') ||
      p.name?.includes('شلوار') ||
      p.name?.includes('اسلش')
    ) {
      isPPant = true;
    }
    const isPMen =
      !isPWomen &&
      cats.some((c) => {
        const slug = (c.slug || '').toLowerCase();
        const name = (c.name || '').toLowerCase();
        return (
          slug === 'men' ||
          slug === 'mens' ||
          /\bmen\b/i.test(slug) ||
          name.includes('مردانه') ||
          /\bmen\b/i.test(name)
        );
      });
    if (isPWomen) womenCount++;
    if (isPMen) menCount++;
    if (isPHoodie) hoodiesCount++;
    if (isPPant) pantsCount++;
  });
  const bentoData = {
    jordan: { product: bentoJordan, count: jordanCount },
    women: { product: bentoWomen, count: womenCount },
    men: { product: bentoMen, count: menCount },
    hoodies: { product: bentoHoodies, count: hoodiesCount },
    pants: { product: bentoPants, count: pantsCount },
  };
  // 4. Brand Blocks
  // Nike
  const nikeMedia = findProduct(allInStock, 'FB8008-063');
  const nikeMini = [
    findProduct(allInStock, 'DX2324-531'),
    findProduct(allInStock, 'BV0507-100'),
  ].filter((p): p is KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product => Boolean(p));
  // Jordan
  const jordanMedia = findProduct(allInStock, 'DQ7544-662');
  const jordanMini = [
    findProduct(allInStock, 'CJ0921-011'),
    findProduct(allInStock, 'DA9854-091'),
  ].filter((p): p is KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product => Boolean(p));
  // Adidas (FL0147 only; HM2137 is out of stock so never show it)
  const adidasMedia = findProduct(allInStock, 'FL0147');
  const adidasMini = [findProduct(allInStock, 'FL0147')].filter(
    (p): p is KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product => Boolean(p)
  );
  const brandBlocksData = [
    {
      brand: 'NIKE',
      mediaProduct: nikeMedia,
      lineKey: 'nike' as const,
      miniProducts: nikeMini,
      link: getCustomerBrandRoute('nike'),
    },
    {
      brand: 'JORDAN',
      mediaProduct: jordanMedia,
      lineKey: 'jordan' as const,
      miniProducts: jordanMini,
      link: getCustomerBrandRoute('jordan'),
    },
    {
      brand: 'ADIDAS',
      mediaProduct: adidasMedia,
      lineKey: 'adidas' as const,
      miniProducts: adidasMini,
      link: getCustomerBrandRoute('adidas'),
    },
  ];
  const brandBlockIds = new Set<number>();
  brandBlocksData.forEach((b) => {
    if (b.mediaProduct?.id) brandBlockIds.add(b.mediaProduct.id);
    b.miniProducts.forEach((p) => brandBlockIds.add(p.id));
  });
  // New Arrivals (Newest by highest product id first)
  // Exclude products used in hero and brand blocks
  const excludedIds = new Set<number>([
    ...Array.from(heroIds),
    ...Array.from(brandBlockIds),
  ]);
  const sortedByIdDesc = [...allInStock].sort((a, b) => b.id - a.id);
  const availableWomen = sortedByIdDesc.filter(
    (p) => isWomenProduct(p) && !excludedIds.has(p.id)
  );
  const availableMen = sortedByIdDesc.filter(
    (p) => isMenProduct(p) && !excludedIds.has(p.id)
  );
  const newestWomen4 = availableWomen.slice(0, 4);
  const newestMen4 = availableMen.slice(0, 4);
  // Interleave women, men, women, men... (8 total)
  const interleaved8: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product[] = [];
  const maxLen = Math.max(newestWomen4.length, newestMen4.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < maxLen; i++) {
    if (newestWomen4[i]) interleaved8.push(newestWomen4[i]);
    if (newestMen4[i]) interleaved8.push(newestMen4[i]);
  }
  const newArrivals = {
    all: interleaved8,
    women: newestWomen4,
    men: newestMen4,
  };
  // 6. Picks Rail Products (max 10 in-stock in specified order)
  const picksOrderSKUs = [
    'DD5094-133',
    'DC5276-596',
    'CZ8528-397',
    'DR1025-247',
    'CN3000-100',
    'DZ6026-448',
    'CK0160-010',
    'DQ6304-010',
    '682852-355',
    'DR6171-063',
  ];
  const usedSoFar = new Set<number>([
    ...Array.from(excludedIds),
    ...interleaved8.map((p) => p.id),
  ]);
  const picksList: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product[] = [];
  picksOrderSKUs.forEach((sku) => {
    const found = findProduct(allInStock, sku);
    if (found && !usedSoFar.has(found.id)) {
      picksList.push(found);
      usedSoFar.add(found.id);
    }
  });
  // Fill up to 10 if fewer remain
  if (picksList.length < 10) {
    for (const p of sortedByIdDesc) {
      if (!usedSoFar.has(p.id)) {
        picksList.push(p);
        usedSoFar.add(p.id);
        if (picksList.length >= 10) break;
      }
    }
  }
  return {
    exchangeRate,
    categories: (data?.categories || []) as HomeCategory[],
    hero: {
      right: heroRight,
      center: heroCenter,
      left: heroLeft,
    },
    bento: bentoData,
    brandBlocks: brandBlocksData,
    newArrivals,
    picks: picksList,
  };
}
</file>

              <Box

                  display: 'flex',
                  justifyContent: isRtl ? 'flex-start' : 'flex-end',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  mt: -0.5,
                }}
              >
                <Link
                  component={RouterLink}
                  to={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.FORGOT_PASSWORD}
                  variant="body2"
                  sx={{
                    color: goldColor,
                    textDecoration: 'none',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    fontSize: '0.84rem',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
                    '&:hover': {
                      color: isDark ? '#ffffff' : '#1a1a19',
                      textDecoration: 'underline',
                    },
                  }}
                >
                  {LL.authorization.forgotPassword()}
                </Link>
              </Box>
              <Button
                type="submit"
                fullWidth
                variant="contained"
                loading={loginLoading}
                endIcon={
                  !loginLoading &&
                  (isRtl ? (
                    <ArrowBackRounded
                      sx={{
                        fontSize: 18,
                        transition: 'transform 0.2s ease',
                      }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <ArrowForwardRounded
                      sx={{
                        fontSize: 18,
                        transition: 'transform 0.2s ease',
                      }}
                    />
                  ))
                }
                sx={{
                  mt: 1.5,
                  mb: 1,
                  py: 1.4,
                  borderRadius: '9999px',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  fontSize: '0.94rem',
                  letterSpacing: isRtl ? 0 : '0.03em',
                  textTransform: 'none',
                  position: 'relative',
                  overflow: 'hidden',
                  backdropFilter: 'blur(20px) saturate(190%)',
                  WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(20px) saturate(190%)',
                  transition:
                    'all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275)',
                  ...(isDark
                    ? {
                        background:
                          'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.96) 0%, rgba(181, 171, 147, 0.94) 100%)',
                        color: '#121210',
                        border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)',
                        boxShadow:
                          '0 10px 28px -4px rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.45), inset 0 1px 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)',
                        '&:hover': {
                          background:
                            'linear-gradient(135deg, #ddd4bf 0%, #c5b89a 100%)',
                          boxShadow:
                            '0 14px 34px -4px rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.6), inset 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)',
                          transform: 'translateY(-2px)',
                          '& .MuiButton-endIcon': {
                            transform: isRtl
                              ? 'translateX(-3px)'
                              : 'translateX(3px)',
                          },
                        },
                      }
                    : {
                        background:
                          'linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a19 0%, #2a2a28 100%)',
                        color: '#faf9f7',
                        border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                        boxShadow:
                          '0 10px 28px -4px rgba(26, 26, 25, 0.32), inset 0 1px 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)',
                        '&:hover': {
                          background:
                            'linear-gradient(135deg, #2e2e2c 0%, #3e3e3b 100%)',
                          boxShadow:
                            '0 14px 34px -4px rgba(26, 26, 25, 0.45), inset 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)',
                          transform: 'translateY(-2px)',
                          '& .MuiButton-endIcon': {
                            transform: isRtl
                              ? 'translateX(-3px)'
                              : 'translateX(3px)',
                          },
                        },
                      }),
                  '&:active': {
                    transform: 'translateY(0)',
                  },
                  '&.Mui-disabled': {
                    opacity: 0.65,
                  },
                }}
              >
                {LL.authorization.signIn()}
              </Button>
            </Box>
          </GlassmorphismContainer>
        </Container>
      </Box>
