<file path="libs/client/customers/screens/login/src/lib/CustomersLoginScreen.zod.spec.tsx">
import React, { type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { CustomersLogin } from './CustomersLoginScreen';
import { vi, describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
import { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
// Mock the layout component
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/customers-layout', () => ({
  CustomersLayout: ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => (
    <div data-testid="customers-layout">{children}</div>
  ),
}));
// Mock the auth hook
const mockHandleLogin = vi.fn();
const mockUseCustomersLogin = vi.fn();
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/customers-auth-hooks', () => ({
  useCustomersLogin: () => mockUseCustomersLogin(),
}));
const mockShowSnackbar = vi.fn();
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/snackbar-hook', () => ({
  useSnackbar: () => ({
    showSnackbar: mockShowSnackbar,
  }),
}));
// Mock the error message utility
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/translations', () => ({
  getErrorMessage: (error: Error) => {
    if (error.message.includes('wrong password')) {
      return { translationKey: 'wrongEmailOrPassword' };
    }
    return { rawMessage: error.message };
  },
}));
// Mock the i18n context
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n', () => ({
  useI18nContext: () => ({
    LL: {
      pageTitles: {
        login: () => 'Sign In',
      },
      messages: {
        welcome: () => 'Welcome back!',
      },
      authorization: {
        signIn: () => 'Sign In',
        signUp: () => 'Sign Up',
        dontHaveAccount: () => "Don't have an account?",
        forgotPassword: () => 'Forgot Password',
        wrongEmailOrPassword: () => 'Incorrect credentials',
        createAccount: () => 'Create Account',
      },
      form: {
        email: () => 'Email Address',
        password: () => 'Password',
      },
      errors: {
        wrongEmailOrPassword: () => 'Incorrect credentials',
        requiredFields: () => 'Please fill in all required fields',
      },
    },
  }),
  usePageTitle: vi.fn(),
}));
// Mock React Router
const mockNavigate = vi.fn();
vi.mock('react-router-dom', async () => {
  const actual: Record<string, unknown> = await vi.importActual(
    'react-router-dom'
  );
  return {
    ...actual,
    useNavigate: () => mockNavigate,
    useLocation: () => ({ state: { from: '/checkout' } }),
    Link: ({ to, children }: { to: string; children: ReactNode }) => (
      <a href={to}>{children}</a>
    ),
  };
});
describe('CustomersLogin (zod/RHF validation)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockUseCustomersLogin.mockReturnValue({
      handleLogin: mockHandleLogin,
      loginLoading: false,
    });
  });
  const renderComponent = () => {
    return render(
      <BrowserRouter>
        <CustomersLogin />
      </BrowserRouter>
    );
  };
  it('empty submit -> handleLogin NOT called and requiredFields text shown', async () => {
    renderComponent();
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign In' });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    // RHF validates on submit - wait for errors to appear
    await waitFor(() => {
      const errorMessages = screen.getAllByText('Please fill in all required fields');
      expect(errorMessages.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    });
    // handleLogin should NOT be called
    expect(mockHandleLogin).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('"  ann@example.com  " + "abc" -> handleLogin("ann@example.com","abc") once', async () => {
    mockHandleLogin.mockResolvedValue({});
    renderComponent();
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i);
    const passwordInput = screen.getByLabelText(/^Password/i);
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign In' });
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: '  ann@example.com  ' } });
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'abc' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockHandleLogin).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(mockHandleLogin).toHaveBeenCalledWith('ann@example.com', 'abc');
      expect(mockShowSnackbar).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Welcome back!', {
        severity: 'success',
      });
      expect(mockNavigate).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/checkout', { replace: true });
    });
  });
});

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams, Link as RouterLink } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { CustomersLayout } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-layout';
import { useI18nContext, usePageTitle } from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
import { CUSTOMER_ROUTES } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-routes';
import { useSnackbar } from '@kickzone-workspace/snackbar-hook';
import { useCustomersResetPassword } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-auth-hooks';
import { getErrorMessage } from '@kickzone-workspace/translations';
import { customerResetPasswordFormSchema, type CustomerResetPasswordFormValues } from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import LockResetOutlined from '@mui/icons-material/LockResetOutlined';
import ArrowBackRounded from '@mui/icons-material/ArrowBackRounded';
import ArrowForwardRounded from '@mui/icons-material/ArrowForwardRounded';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import { PasswordTextField } from '@kickzone-workspace/password-field';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Container from '@mui/material/Container';
import CssBaseline from '@mui/material/CssBaseline';
import Alert from '@mui/material/Alert';
import { useTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';
import { GlassmorphismContainer } from '@kickzone-workspace/glassmorphism-container';
export function CustomerResetPassword() {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  usePageTitle(() => LL.pageTitles.resetPassword());
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { token } = useParams<{ token: string }>();
  const { showSnackbar } = useSnackbar();
  const { handleResetPassword, resetPasswordLoading } =
    useCustomersResetPassword();
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isDark = theme.palette.mode === 'dark';
  const isRtl = theme.direction === 'rtl';
  const goldColor = isDark ? '#c5b89a' : '#7c6d48';
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
  } = useForm<CustomerResetPasswordFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(customerResetPasswordFormSchema),
    mode: 'onSubmit',
    defaultValues: {
      password: '',
      confirmPassword: '',
    },
  });
  const onValidSubmit = async (values: CustomerResetPasswordFormValues) => {
    if (!token) {
      setError(LL.authorization.invalidToken());
      return;
    }
    try {
      await handleResetPassword(token, values.password);
      showSnackbar(LL.authorization.passwordResetSuccess(), {
        severity: 'success',
      });
      navigate(CUSTOMER_ROUTES.HOME);
    } catch (error) {
      const { translationKey, rawMessage } = getErrorMessage(error as Error);
      const errorMessage = translationKey
        ? LL.errors[translationKey]()
        : rawMessage || LL.authorization.invalidToken();
      setError(errorMessage);
      showSnackbar(errorMessage, { severity: 'error' });
    }
  };
  const onInvalidSubmit = (errors: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    // Check for confirmPassword mismatch first (priority)
    const confirmPasswordError = errors.confirmPassword as
      | { type?: string; message?: string }
      | undefined;
    if (
      confirmPasswordError &&
      confirmPasswordError.type === 'custom' &&
      confirmPasswordError.message === 'passwordsDoNotMatch'
    ) {
      setError(LL.authorization.passwordsDoNotMatch());
      return;
    }
    // Check for password issues (too_small, etc.)
    const passwordError = errors.password as
      | { type?: string; message?: string }
      | undefined;
    if (passwordError && passwordError.type === 'too_small') {
      setError(LL.authorization.passwordTooShort());
      return;
    }
    // Fallback
    setError(LL.errors.requiredFields());
  };
  return (
    <CustomersLayout>
      <Box
        sx={{
          minHeight: 'calc(100vh - 120px)',
          width: '100%',
          position: 'relative',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          pt: { xs: 8, sm: 10 },
          pb: { xs: 8, sm: 10 },
          px: 2,
          overflow: 'hidden',
        }}
      >
        {/* Ambient liquid lighting glow orbs */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: { xs: '5%', md: '10%' },
            right: { xs: '-5%', md: '15%' },
            width: { xs: 260, sm: 400, md: 480 },
            height: { xs: 260, sm: 400, md: 480 },
            borderRadius: '50%',
            background: isDark
              ? 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.15) 0%, rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.02) 65%, transparent 70%)'
              : 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(230, 215, 185, 0.55) 0%, rgba(240, 230, 205, 0.2) 60%, transparent 70%)',
            filter: 'blur(70px)',
            pointerEvents: 'none',
            zIndex: 0,
            animation: 'floatOrb 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate',
            '@keyframes floatOrb': {
              '0%': { transform: 'translate(0, 0) scale(1)' },
              '100%': { transform: 'translate(-30px, 35px) scale(1.08)' },
            },
          }}
        />
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            bottom: { xs: '5%', md: '8%' },
            left: { xs: '-5%', md: '12%' },
            width: { xs: 240, sm: 380, md: 440 },
            height: { xs: 240, sm: 380, md: 440 },
            borderRadius: '50%',
            background: isDark
              ? 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(140, 120, 80, 0.12) 0%, rgba(100, 85, 55, 0.02) 65%, transparent 70%)'
              : 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(245, 230, 215, 0.5) 0%, rgba(240, 220, 200, 0.18) 60%, transparent 70%)',
            filter: 'blur(80px)',
            pointerEvents: 'none',
            zIndex: 0,
            animation: 'floatOrb2 16s ease-in-out infinite alternate',
            '@keyframes floatOrb2': {
              '0%': { transform: 'translate(0, 0) scale(1)' },
              '100%': { transform: 'translate(35px, -25px) scale(1.06)' },
            },
          }}
        />
        <Container
          component="main"
          maxWidth="xs"
          sx={{ position: 'relative', zIndex: 1, p: 0 }}
        >
          <CssBaseline />
          <GlassmorphismContainer
            wrapperSx={{
              p: 0,
              width: '100%',
              maxWidth: 460,
              mx: 'auto',
            }}
            containerSx={{
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              alignItems: 'center',
              borderRadius: '28px !important',
              p: { xs: 3, sm: 4.5 },
              width: '100%',
              backgroundColor: isDark
                ? 'rgba(24, 24, 22, 0.82) !important'
                : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88) !important',
              backgroundImage: isDark
                ? 'linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(28, 28, 24, 0.85) 0%, rgba(20, 20, 18, 0.75) 50%, rgba(15, 15, 14, 0.85) 100%) !important'
                : 'linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92) 0%, rgba(250, 248, 244, 0.80) 50%, rgba(245, 242, 236, 0.88) 100%) !important',
              border: isDark
                ? '1px solid rgba(240, 239, 235, 0.12) !important'
                : '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) !important',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(28px) saturate(190%) !important',
              WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(28px) saturate(190%) !important',
              boxShadow: isDark
                ? '0 24px 64px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), inset 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14), inset 0 -1px 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important'
                : '0 24px 60px -12px rgba(180, 165, 140, 0.25), 0 0 0 1px rgba(143, 132, 104, 0.1), inset 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95), inset 0 -1px 1px 0 rgba(143, 132, 104, 0.08) !important',
            }}
          >
            {/* Specular top edge highlight */}
            <Box
              sx={{
                position: 'absolute',
                top: 0,
                left: '12%',
                right: '12%',
                height: '1px',
                background: isDark
                  ? 'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.6) 50%, transparent 100%)'
                  : 'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(143, 132, 104, 0.45) 50%, transparent 100%)',
                filter: 'blur(0.5px)',
              }}
            />
            {/* Floating Liquid Glass Icon Badge */}
            <Box
              sx={{
                width: 64,
                height: 64,
                borderRadius: '20px',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                background: isDark
                  ? 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.22) 0%, rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.06) 100%)'
                  : 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(168, 152, 112, 0.22) 0%, rgba(168, 152, 112, 0.08) 100%)',
                border: isDark
                  ? '1px solid rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.4)'
                  : '1px solid rgba(143, 132, 104, 0.35)',
                boxShadow: isDark
                  ? '0 12px 28px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), 0 0 20px rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.2), inset 0 1px 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)'
                  : '0 10px 24px -4px rgba(168, 152, 112, 0.25), inset 0 1px 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)',
                backdropFilter: 'blur(16px)',
                WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(16px)',
                color: goldColor,
                mb: 2,
                transition: 'all 0.3s ease',
                '&:hover': {
                  transform: 'translateY(-2px) scale(1.03)',
                },
              }}
            >
              <LockResetOutlined sx={{ fontSize: 32 }} />
            </Box>
            {/* Brand Sub-label */}
            <Typography
              variant="caption"
              sx={{
                textTransform: 'uppercase',
                letterSpacing: '0.24em',
                fontWeight: 700,
                fontSize: '0.72rem',
                color: isDark ? '#c5b89a' : '#8f8468',
                mb: 0.75,
              }}
            >
              SAINTBALA
            </Typography>
            {/* Main Title Heading */}
            <Typography
              component="h1"
              variant="h5"
              sx={{
                fontWeight: 700,
                letterSpacing: isRtl ? 0 : '-0.02em',
                fontSize: { xs: '1.5rem', sm: '1.75rem' },
                color: isDark ? '#f0efeb' : '#1a1a19',
                textAlign: 'center',
                mb: 1,
              }}
            >
              {LL.authorization.resetPassword()}
            </Typography>
            {/* Subtitle */}
            <Typography
              variant="body2"
              sx={{
                color: isDark ? '#a8a69f' : '#6b7280',
                textAlign: 'center',
                maxWidth: 340,
                mb: 3,
                fontSize: '0.86rem',
                lineHeight: 1.5,
              }}
            >
              {LL.authorization.enterNewPassword()}
            </Typography>
            {error && (
              <Alert
                severity="error"
                sx={{
                  width: '100%',
                  mb: 2,
                  borderRadius: '16px',
                  backgroundColor: isDark
                    ? 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)'
                    : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.08)',
                  backdropFilter: 'blur(12px)',
                }}
              >
                {error}
              </Alert>
            )}
            <Box
              component="form"
              onSubmit={handleSubmit(onValidSubmit, onInvalidSubmit)}
              noValidate
              sx={{
                width: '100%',
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                gap: 2,
              }}
            >
              <PasswordTextField
                required
                fullWidth
                size="small"
                label={LL.form.password()}
                id="password"
                autoComplete="new-password"
                autoFocus
                {...register('password', { onChange: () => setError('') })}
              />
              <PasswordTextField
                required
                fullWidth
                size="small"
                label={LL.authorization.confirmPassword()}
                id="confirmPassword"
                autoComplete="new-password"
                error={!!error && error === LL.authorization.passwordsDoNotMatch()}
                {...register('confirmPassword', { onChange: () => setError('') })}
              />
              {/* Submit Button */}
              <Button
                type="submit"
                fullWidth
                variant="contained"
                loading={resetPasswordLoading}
                sx={{
                  mt: 1.5,
                  mb: 0.5,
                  py: 1.4,
                  borderRadius: '9999px',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  fontSize: '0.94rem',

                  textTransform: 'none',
                  position: 'relative',
                  overflow: 'hidden',

                  WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(20px) saturate(190%)',
                  transition:
                    'all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275)',
                  ...(isDark
                    ? {
                        background:
                          'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.96) 0%, rgba(181, 171, 147, 0.94) 100%)',
                        color: '#121210',
                        border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)',
                        boxShadow:
                          '0 10px 28px -4px rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.45), inset 0 1px 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)',
                        '&:hover': {
                          background:
                            'linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 0%, rgba(210, 198, 170, 0.98) 100%)',
                          transform: 'translateY(-2px) scale(1.01)',
                          boxShadow:
                            '0 14px 34px -4px rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.6), inset 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)',
                        },
                      }
                    : {
                        background:
                          'linear-gradient(135deg, #1f1f1d 0%, #121210 100%)',
                        color: '#ffffff',
                        border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                        boxShadow:
                          '0 10px 24px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28), inset 0 1px 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35)',
                        '&:hover': {
                          background:
                            'linear-gradient(135deg, #2c2c28 0%, #050505 100%)',
                          transform: 'translateY(-2px) scale(1.01)',
                          boxShadow:
                            '0 14px 30px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.38), inset 0 1px 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)',
                        },
                      }),
                }}
              >
                {LL.authorization.resetPassword()}
              </Button>
              {/* Back to Login Button */}
              <Button
                fullWidth
                component={RouterLink}
                to={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.LOGIN}
                startIcon={
                  isRtl ? (
                    <ArrowForwardRounded sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                  ) : (
                    <ArrowBackRounded sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />

                }
                sx={{

import React, { type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { CustomerResetPassword } from './customer-reset-password';
import { vi, describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
import { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
// Mock the layout component
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/customers-layout', () => ({
  CustomersLayout: ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => (
    <div data-testid="customers-layout">{children}</div>
  ),
}));
// Mock the auth hook
const mockHandleResetPassword = vi.fn();
const mockUseCustomersResetPassword = vi.fn();
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/customers-auth-hooks', () => ({
  useCustomersResetPassword: () => mockUseCustomersResetPassword(),
}));
const mockShowSnackbar = vi.fn();
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/snackbar-hook', () => ({
  useSnackbar: () => ({
    showSnackbar: mockShowSnackbar,
  }),
}));
// Mock the error message utility
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/translations', () => ({
  getErrorMessage: (error: Error) => {
    if (error.message.includes('Invalid token')) {
      return { translationKey: 'invalidToken' };
    }
    return { rawMessage: error.message };
  },
}));
// Mock the i18n context with passwordTooShort
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n', () => ({
  useI18nContext: () => ({
    LL: {
      pageTitles: {
        resetPassword: () => 'Reset Password',
      },
      authorization: {
        resetPassword: () => 'Reset Password',
        enterNewPassword: () => 'Enter your new password below.',
        confirmPassword: () => 'Confirm Password',
        passwordsDoNotMatch: () => 'Passwords do not match',
        passwordTooShort: () => 'Password must be at least 8 characters long',
        invalidToken: () => 'Invalid or expired reset token.',
        passwordResetSuccess: () => 'Password has been reset successfully.',
        backToLogin: () => 'Back to Login',
      },
      form: {
        password: () => 'Password',
      },
      errors: {
        invalidToken: () => 'Invalid or expired reset token. Please request a new password reset.',
        unknown: () => 'An unknown error occurred. Please try again.',
      },
      status: {
        error: () => 'Error',
      },
    },
  }),
  usePageTitle: vi.fn(),
}));
// Mock React Router
const mockNavigate = vi.fn();
vi.mock('react-router-dom', async () => {
  const actual: Record<string, unknown> = await vi.importActual(
    'react-router-dom'
  );
  return {
    ...actual,
    useNavigate: () => mockNavigate,
    useParams: () => ({ token: 'valid-reset-token' }),
    Link: ({ to, children }: { to: string; children: ReactNode }) => (
      <a href={to}>{children}</a>
    ),
  };
});
describe('CustomerResetPassword - Zod/RHF Integration', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockUseCustomersResetPassword.mockReturnValue({
      handleResetPassword: mockHandleResetPassword,
      resetPasswordLoading: false,
    });
  });
  const renderComponent = () => {
    return render(
      <BrowserRouter>
        <CustomerResetPassword />
      </BrowserRouter>
    );
  };
  it('mismatch -> passwordsDoNotMatch text, handleResetPassword NOT called', async () => {
    renderComponent();
    const passwordInputs = screen.getAllByLabelText(/^Password/i);
    const passwordInput = passwordInputs[0];
    const confirmPasswordInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Confirm Password/i);
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reset Password' });
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'password123' } });
    fireEvent.change(confirmPasswordInput, { target: { value: 'different' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Passwords do not match')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    expect(mockHandleResetPassword).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('7-char matching -> passwordTooShort text, handleResetPassword NOT called', async () => {
    renderComponent();
    const passwordInputs = screen.getAllByLabelText(/^Password/i);
    const passwordInput = passwordInputs[0];
    const confirmPasswordInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Confirm Password/i);
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reset Password' });
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'short7c' } });
    fireEvent.change(confirmPasswordInput, { target: { value: 'short7c' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Password must be at least 8 characters long')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    expect(mockHandleResetPassword).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('valid -> handleResetPassword(token, pw) once', async () => {
    mockHandleResetPassword.mockResolvedValue({});
    renderComponent();
    const passwordInputs = screen.getAllByLabelText(/^Password/i);
    const passwordInput = passwordInputs[0];
    const confirmPasswordInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Confirm Password/i);
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reset Password' });
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'validPassword123' } });
    fireEvent.change(confirmPasswordInput, { target: { value: 'validPassword123' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockHandleResetPassword).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(mockHandleResetPassword).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'valid-reset-token',
        'validPassword123'
      );
    });
  });

<file path="libs/client/customers/validations/src/lib/shipping-validation.shared.spec.ts">
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import type { TranslationFunctions } from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
import { shippingAddressSchema } from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import { createShippingInfoSchema, validateShippingInfo } from './shipping-validation';
const keys: Record<string, string[]> = {
  name: ['required', 'minLength', 'maxLength', 'invalidCharacters'],
  email: ['required', 'maxLength', 'invalid'],
  phone: ['required', 'invalid'],
  address: ['required', 'minLength', 'maxLength'],
  city: ['required', 'minLength', 'maxLength', 'invalidCharacters'],
  state: ['required', 'minLength', 'maxLength', 'invalidCharacters'],
  zipCode: ['required', 'minLength', 'maxLength', 'invalidCharacters'],
  country: ['required', 'minLength', 'maxLength', 'invalidCharacters'],
  notes: ['maxLength'],
  general: ['error'],
};
const validation = Object.fromEntries(
  Object.entries(keys).map(([group, names]) => [
    group,
    Object.fromEntries(names.map((n) => [n, () => `${group}.${n}`])),
  ])
);
const LL = { validation } as unknown as TranslationFunctions;
const valid = {
  customerName: 'Ali Rezaei',
  customerEmail: '',
  customerPhone: '09123456789',
  shippingAddress: 'Valiasr St, No 12',
  city: 'Tehran',
  state: 'Tehran',
  zipCode: '1987654321',
  country: 'Iran',
  notes: '',
};
describe('checkout shipping validation uses the shared schema', () => {
  it('client schema extends the shared shippingAddressSchema fields', () => {
    const clientShape = Object.keys(createShippingInfoSchema(LL).shape);
    for (const key of Object.keys(shippingAddressSchema.shape)) {
      expect(clientShape).toContain(key);
    }
  });
  it('accepts what the server accepts', () => {
    expect(validateShippingInfo(valid, LL).isValid).toBe(true);
    expect(shippingAddressSchema.safeParse(valid).success).toBe(true);
  });
  it.each([
    ['customerName', '', 'name.required'],
    ['customerName', 'A', 'name.minLength'],
    ['customerName', 'Ali123', 'name.invalidCharacters'],
    ['customerEmail', 'nope', 'email.invalid'],
    ['customerPhone', '', 'phone.required'],
    ['customerPhone', '12', 'phone.invalid'],
    ['shippingAddress', '', 'address.required'],
    ['shippingAddress', 'ab', 'address.minLength'],
    ['city', 'T1', 'city.invalidCharacters'],
    ['state', '', 'state.required'],
    ['zipCode', '12', 'zipCode.minLength'],
    ['zipCode', '12#45', 'zipCode.invalidCharacters'],
    ['country', 'I', 'country.minLength'],
    ['notes', 'x'.repeat(501), 'notes.maxLength'],
  ])('maps %s=%j to the localized %s message', (field, value, message) => {
    const result = validateShippingInfo({ ...valid, [field]: value }, LL);
    expect(result.isValid).toBe(false);
    expect(result.errors[field]).toBe(message);
  });
  it('trims values in the validated data', () => {
    const result = validateShippingInfo({ ...valid, city: '  Tehran  ' }, LL);
    expect(result.validatedData?.city).toBe('Tehran');
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/customers/validations/src/lib/shipping-validation.ts">
import { z } from 'zod';
import {
  optionalEmailSchema,
  shippingAddressSchema,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import type { TranslationFunctions } from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
export type ShippingInfoFormData = {
  customerName: string;
  customerEmail?: string;
  customerPhone: string;
  shippingAddress: string;
  city: string;
  state: string;
  zipCode: string;
  country: string;
  notes?: string;
};
export interface ShippingInfoValidationErrors {
  [key: string]: string | undefined;
}
/**
 * Checkout shipping schema: the shared server-side order/shipping rules
 * (`shippingAddressSchema`) plus client-only fields. Email may be omitted for guests.
 */
export const createShippingInfoSchema = (LL: TranslationFunctions) =>
  shippingAddressSchema.extend({
    customerEmail: optionalEmailSchema.optional(),
    notes: z
      .string()
      .max(500, LL.validation.notes.maxLength())
      .optional()
      .or(z.literal('')),
  });
type ShippingIssue = {
  code: string;
  path?: PropertyKey[];
  input?: unknown;
};
const isBlank = (input: unknown) =>
  input === undefined || input === null || String(input).trim() === '';
/** Maps a shared-schema issue to the existing localized checkout message. */
export const shippingIssueMessage = (
  issue: ShippingIssue,
  LL: TranslationFunctions
): string => {
  const field = String(issue.path?.[0] ?? '');
  const v = LL.validation;
  const kind =
    issue.code === 'invalid_type' || (issue.code === 'too_small' && isBlank(issue.input))
      ? 'required'
      : issue.code === 'too_small'
      ? 'min'
      : issue.code === 'too_big'
      ? 'max'
      : 'format';
  switch (field) {
    case 'customerName':
      return kind === 'required'
        ? v.name.required()
        : kind === 'min'
        ? v.name.minLength()
        : kind === 'max'
        ? v.name.maxLength()
        : v.name.invalidCharacters();
    case 'customerEmail':
      return kind === 'max' ? v.email.maxLength() : v.email.invalid();
    case 'customerPhone':
      return isBlank(issue.input) ? v.phone.required() : v.phone.invalid();
    case 'shippingAddress':
      return kind === 'required'
        ? v.address.required()
        : kind === 'max'
        ? v.address.maxLength()
        : v.address.minLength();
    case 'city':
      return kind === 'required'
        ? v.city.required()
        : kind === 'min'
        ? v.city.minLength()
        : kind === 'max'
        ? v.city.maxLength()
        : v.city.invalidCharacters();
    case 'state':
      return kind === 'required'
        ? v.state.required()
        : kind === 'min'
        ? v.state.minLength()
        : kind === 'max'
        ? v.state.maxLength()
        : v.state.invalidCharacters();
    case 'zipCode':
      return kind === 'required'
        ? v.zipCode.required()
        : kind === 'min'
        ? v.zipCode.minLength()
        : kind === 'max'
        ? v.zipCode.maxLength()
        : v.zipCode.invalidCharacters();
    case 'country':
      return kind === 'required'
        ? v.country.required()
        : kind === 'max'
        ? v.country.maxLength()
        : v.country.minLength();
    case 'notes':
      return v.notes.maxLength();
    default:
      return v.general.error();
  }
};
/**
 * Converts Persian (۰-۹) and Arabic (٠-٩) digits to standard English ASCII digits (0-9).
 */
export const toEnglishDigits = (value: string): string => {
  if (!value) return '';
  return value
    .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (d) => String.fromCharCode(d.charCodeAt(0) - 1728))
    .replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (d) => String.fromCharCode(d.charCodeAt(0) - 1584));
};
export const validateShippingInfo = (
  data: Partial<ShippingInfoFormData>,
  LL: TranslationFunctions
): {
  isValid: boolean;
  errors: ShippingInfoValidationErrors;
  validatedData?: ShippingInfoFormData;
} => {
  try {
    const normalizedData: Partial<ShippingInfoFormData> = {
      ...data,
      zipCode: data.zipCode ? toEnglishDigits(data.zipCode).trim() : data.zipCode,
      customerPhone: data.customerPhone
        ? toEnglishDigits(data.customerPhone).trim()
        : data.customerPhone,
    };
    const schema = createShippingInfoSchema(LL);
    const validatedData = schema.parse(normalizedData, {
      error: (issue) => shippingIssueMessage(issue, LL),
    });
    return {
      isValid: true,
      errors: {},
      validatedData,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
      const errors: ShippingInfoValidationErrors = {};
      error.issues.forEach((err) => {
        if (err.path.length > 0) {
          const fieldName = err.path[0] as string;
          // Keep the first (most specific) message, e.g. "required" for an empty field.
          if (!errors[fieldName]) errors[fieldName] = err.message;
        }
      });
      return {
        isValid: false,
        errors,
      };
    }
    // Fallback for unexpected errors
    return {
      isValid: false,
      errors: {
        general: LL.validation.general.error(),
      },
    };
  }
};
// Helper function to get field-specific error message
export const getFieldError = (
  errors: ShippingInfoValidationErrors,
  fieldName: string
): string | undefined => {
  return errors[fieldName];
};
// Helper function to check if form is valid for submission
export const isFormValidForSubmission = (
  data: Partial<ShippingInfoFormData>,
  LL: TranslationFunctions
): boolean => {
  const { isValid } = validateShippingInfo(data, LL);
  return isValid;
};

<file path="libs/client/customers/zustand/customer-cart-store/src/lib/customer-cart-store.spec.ts">
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { useCartStore, type CartItem } from './customer-cart-store';
const baseItem = {
  productId: 'p1',
  productName: 'Shoe',
  productImage: null,
  quantity: 1,
  unitPrice: 100,
  color: 'Red',
  size: '42',
  sellerId: 's1',
  sellerName: 'Store',
  sellerShippingFee: 10,
  productInfoId: 'pi1',
  sellerProductId: 'sp1',
  availableStock: 5,
};
describe('useCartStore', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    useCartStore.setState({
      items: [],
      isLoading: false,
      error: null,
      lastUpdated: null,
    });
  });
  it('adds a new item and computes total price', () => {
    useCartStore.getState().addItem(baseItem);
    const items = useCartStore.getState().items;
    expect(items).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(items[0].totalPrice).toBe(100);
    expect(useCartStore.getState().getTotalItems()).toBe(1);
    expect(useCartStore.getState().getTotalPrice()).toBe(100);
  });
  it('merges quantity when the same productInfo is added again and clamps to availableStock', () => {
    useCartStore.getState().addItem(baseItem);
    useCartStore.getState().addItem({ ...baseItem, quantity: 2 });
    const items = useCartStore.getState().items;
    expect(items).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(items[0].quantity).toBe(3);
    expect(items[0].totalPrice).toBe(300);
    // Try adding more than availableStock (stock is 5, currently 3)
    useCartStore.getState().addItem({ ...baseItem, quantity: 5 });
    expect(useCartStore.getState().items[0].quantity).toBe(5);
    expect(useCartStore.getState().items[0].totalPrice).toBe(500);
  });
  it('updates and removes items, respecting availableStock limit', () => {
    useCartStore.getState().addItem(baseItem);
    const id = useCartStore.getState().items[0].id;
    useCartStore.getState().updateItemQuantity(id, 4);
    expect(useCartStore.getState().items[0].totalPrice).toBe(400);
    // Clamps to availableStock (5)
    useCartStore.getState().updateItemQuantity(id, 10);
    expect(useCartStore.getState().items[0].quantity).toBe(5);
    expect(useCartStore.getState().items[0].totalPrice).toBe(500);
    useCartStore.getState().removeItem(id);
    expect(useCartStore.getState().items).toHaveLength(0);
  });
  it('clears the cart and tracks sellers', () => {
    useCartStore.getState().addItem(baseItem);
    useCartStore.getState().addItem({
      ...baseItem,
      productId: 'p2',
      productInfoId: 'pi2',
      sellerId: 's2',
      sellerName: 'Other',
    });
    expect(useCartStore.getState().getUniqueSellers()).toEqual(
      expect.arrayContaining(['s1', 's2'])
    );
    useCartStore.getState().clearCart();
    expect(useCartStore.getState().items).toHaveLength(0);
  });
  it('looks up items by productInfo', () => {
    useCartStore.getState().addItem(baseItem);
    const found = useCartStore
      .getState()
      .getItemByProductInfo('p1', 'pi1') as CartItem;
    expect(found.productName).toBe('Shoe');
    expect(
      useCartStore.getState().getItemByProductInfo('missing', 'x')
    ).toBeUndefined();
  });
  it('keeps distinct line items for different size or color variants of the same product', () => {
    useCartStore.getState().addItem({ ...baseItem, size: '42', color: 'Black' });
    useCartStore.getState().addItem({ ...baseItem, size: '43', color: 'Black' });
    useCartStore.getState().addItem({ ...baseItem, size: '42', color: 'White' });
    const items = useCartStore.getState().items;
    expect(items).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(items.map((i) => `${i.size}-${i.color}`)).toEqual([
      '42-Black',
      '43-Black',
      '42-White',
    ]);
  });
  it('removes only the specified item when removing by id without affecting other items', () => {
    useCartStore.getState().addItem({ ...baseItem, size: '42' });
    useCartStore.getState().addItem({ ...baseItem, size: '43' });
    useCartStore.getState().addItem({ ...baseItem, size: '44' });
    const items = useCartStore.getState().items;
    expect(items).toHaveLength(3);
    const secondItemId = items[1].id;
    useCartStore.getState().removeItem(secondItemId);
    const remaining = useCartStore.getState().items;
    expect(remaining).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(remaining.find((i) => i.id === secondItemId)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(remaining[0].size).toBe('42');
    expect(remaining[1].size).toBe('44');
  });
  it('addMultipleItems ignores items with quantity <= 0 and clamps to availableStock', () => {
    const itemsData = [
      { ...baseItem, quantity: 2, availableStock: 5 }, // valid
      { ...baseItem, productId: 'p2', productInfoId: 'pi2', quantity: 0, availableStock: 5 }, // zero quantity - should be ignored
      { ...baseItem, productId: 'p3', productInfoId: 'pi3', quantity: -3, availableStock: 5 }, // negative quantity - should be ignored
      { ...baseItem, productId: 'p4', productInfoId: 'pi4', quantity: 1.5, availableStock: 5 }, // float - should be truncated to 1
      { ...baseItem, productId: 'p5', productInfoId: 'pi5', quantity: 10, availableStock: 3 }, // exceeds stock - should be clamped to 3
      { ...baseItem, productId: 'p6', productInfoId: 'pi6', quantity: NaN, availableStock: 5 }, // NaN - should be ignored
    ];
    useCartStore.getState().addMultipleItems(itemsData as Parameters<ReturnType<typeof useCartStore.getState>['addMultipleItems']>[0]);
    const items = useCartStore.getState().items;
    // Only 3 items should be added: p1 (qty 2), p4 (qty 1), p5 (qty 3 clamped)
    expect(items).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(items[0].productId).toBe('p1');
    expect(items[0].quantity).toBe(2);
    expect(items[0].totalPrice).toBe(200);
    expect(items[1].productId).toBe('p4');
    expect(items[1].quantity).toBe(1);
    expect(items[1].totalPrice).toBe(100);
    expect(items[2].productId).toBe('p5');
    expect(items[2].quantity).toBe(3); // clamped to availableStock
    expect(items[2].totalPrice).toBe(300);
  });
});

import { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react';
import { vi } from 'vitest';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import type { useSellerOrders as UseSellerOrdersFn } from './useSellerOrders';
import { UPDATE_ORDER_TRACKING_MUTATION, UPDATE_ORDER_MUTATION } from '@kickzone-workspace/sellers-graphql';
// Mock Apollo Client
const mockApolloUseQuery = vi.fn();
const mockApolloUseMutation = vi.fn();
vi.mock('@apollo/client/react', () => ({
  useQuery: (...args: unknown[]) => mockApolloUseQuery(...args),
  useMutation: (...args: unknown[]) => mockApolloUseMutation(...args),

// Mock sellers-graphql exports
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/sellers-graphql', () => ({

  UPDATE_ORDER_MUTATION: 'UPDATE_ORDER_MUTATION_DOC',
  UPDATE_ORDER_TRACKING_MUTATION: 'UPDATE_ORDER_TRACKING_MUTATION_DOC',
  GET_ORDER_DETAILS_QUERY: 'GET_ORDER_DETAILS_QUERY_DOC',
}));
// Load the REAL hook after mocks are in place
const { useSellerOrders: realUseSellerOrders } = await vi.importActual<{
  useSellerOrders: typeof UseSellerOrdersFn;
}>('@kickzone-workspace/orders-hook');
describe('useSellerOrders - updateTrackingNumber', () => {
  const mockRefetch = vi.fn();
  const mockFetchMore = vi.fn();
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockApolloUseQuery.mockReset();
    mockApolloUseMutation.mockReset();
    mockRefetch.mockReset();
    mockFetchMore.mockReset();
  });
  it('calls UPDATE_ORDER_TRACKING_MUTATION with correct variables and returns updated order', async () => {
    const mockUpdateOrderTrackingMutate = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
      data: {
        updateOrderTracking: {
          id: 'order-1',
          trackingNumber: 'TRK1',
          updatedAt: '2024-01-15T10:30:00Z',
        },
      },
    });
    mockApolloUseMutation
      .mockReturnValueOnce([vi.fn(), { loading: false }]) // updateOrderStatus
      .mockReturnValueOnce([mockUpdateOrderTrackingMutate, { loading: false }]); // updateOrderTracking
    mockApolloUseQuery.mockReturnValue({
      data: { mySellerOrders: { edges: [], pageInfo: { hasNextPage: false, endCursor: null } } },
      loading: false,
      error: undefined,
      refetch: mockRefetch,
      fetchMore: mockFetchMore,
    });
    const { result } = renderHook(() => realUseSellerOrders({ first: 10, status: 'ALL' }));
    let returnedOrder: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Order | undefined;
    await act(async () => {
      returnedOrder = await result.current.updateTrackingNumber('order-1', 'TRK1');
    });
    // Assert UPDATE_ORDER_TRACKING_MUTATION was called with correct variables
    expect(mockUpdateOrderTrackingMutate).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      variables: { id: 'order-1', trackingNumber: 'TRK1' },
    });
    // Assert UPDATE_ORDER_MUTATION's mutate fn was NOT called
    // The second call to useMutation should be for UPDATE_ORDER_TRACKING_MUTATION
    const trackingMutationCall = mockApolloUseMutation.mock.calls[1];
    expect(trackingMutationCall[0]).toBe(UPDATE_ORDER_TRACKING_MUTATION);
    // The first call to useMutation should be for UPDATE_ORDER_STATUS_MUTATION
    const statusMutationCall = mockApolloUseMutation.mock.calls[0];
    expect(statusMutationCall[0]).toBe('UPDATE_ORDER_STATUS_MUTATION_DOC');
    // Verify the returned order
    expect(returnedOrder).toEqual({
      id: 'order-1',
      trackingNumber: 'TRK1',
      updatedAt: '2024-01-15T10:30:00Z',
    });
    // Assert hook result still exposes updateTrackingNumber and updateOrderLoading
    expect(typeof result.current.updateTrackingNumber).toBe('function');
    expect(typeof result.current.updateOrderLoading).toBe('boolean');
  });
  it('does not call UPDATE_ORDER_MUTATION when updateTrackingNumber is invoked', async () => {
    const mockUpdateOrderTrackingMutate = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
      data: {
        updateOrderTracking: {
          id: 'order-2',
          trackingNumber: 'TRK2',
          updatedAt: '2024-01-15T11:00:00Z',
        },
      },
    });
    mockApolloUseMutation
      .mockReturnValueOnce([vi.fn(), { loading: false }]) // updateOrderStatus
      .mockReturnValueOnce([mockUpdateOrderTrackingMutate, { loading: false }]); // updateOrderTracking
    mockApolloUseQuery.mockReturnValue({
      data: { mySellerOrders: { edges: [], pageInfo: { hasNextPage: false, endCursor: null } } },
      loading: false,
      error: undefined,
      refetch: mockRefetch,
      fetchMore: mockFetchMore,
    });
    const { result } = renderHook(() => realUseSellerOrders({ first: 10, status: 'ALL' }));
    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.updateTrackingNumber('order-2', 'TRK2');
    });
    // Verify UPDATE_ORDER_TRACKING_MUTATION was used (second useMutation call)
    expect(mockApolloUseMutation).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(mockApolloUseMutation.mock.calls[1][0]).toBe(UPDATE_ORDER_TRACKING_MUTATION);
    // Verify UPDATE_ORDER_MUTATION was NOT used for tracking
    const allMutationDocs = mockApolloUseMutation.mock.calls.map((call) => call[0]);
    expect(allMutationDocs).not.toContain(UPDATE_ORDER_MUTATION);
    expect(allMutationDocs).not.toContain('UPDATE_ORDER_MUTATION_DOC');
    // Assert hook result still exposes updateTrackingNumber and updateOrderLoading
    expect(typeof result.current.updateTrackingNumber).toBe('function');
    expect(typeof result.current.updateOrderLoading).toBe('boolean');
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/sellers/hooks/orders/src/lib/useSellerOrders.ts">
import { useQuery, useMutation } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import {
  GET_MY_ORDERS_QUERY,
  UPDATE_ORDER_STATUS_MUTATION,
  UPDATE_ORDER_TRACKING_MUTATION,
  GET_ORDER_DETAILS_QUERY,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/sellers-graphql';
export function useSellerOrders({
  first = 10,
  after,
  status,
}: {
  first?: number;
  after?: string;
  status?: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus | 'ALL';
} = {}) {
  // Normalize status: 'ALL' or undefined means no server-side filter
  const statusVariable = status && status !== 'ALL' ? status : undefined;
  const { data, loading, error, refetch, fetchMore } = useQuery<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'mySellerOrders'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.QueryMySellerOrdersArgs
  >(GET_MY_ORDERS_QUERY, {
    variables: { first, after, ...(statusVariable ? { status: statusVariable } : {}) },
    notifyOnNetworkStatusChange: true,
    fetchPolicy: 'cache-and-network',
  });
  type SellerOrder = KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SellerOrder;
  const orders: SellerOrder[] =
    data?.mySellerOrders?.edges
      ?.map((edge) => edge?.node as SellerOrder | undefined)
      .filter((node): node is SellerOrder => Boolean(node)) || [];
  const [updateOrderStatusMutation, { loading: updateStatusLoading }] =
    useMutation<
      Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'updateOrderStatus'>,
      KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationUpdateOrderStatusArgs
    >(UPDATE_ORDER_STATUS_MUTATION, {
      refetchQueries: [
        {
          query: GET_MY_ORDERS_QUERY,
          variables: { first, ...(statusVariable ? { status: statusVariable } : {}) },
        },
      ],
    });
  const [updateOrderMutation, { loading: updateOrderLoading }] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'updateOrderTracking'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationUpdateOrderTrackingArgs
  >(UPDATE_ORDER_TRACKING_MUTATION, {
    refetchQueries: [
      {
        query: GET_MY_ORDERS_QUERY,
        variables: { first, ...(statusVariable ? { status: statusVariable } : {}) },
      },
    ],
  });
  const updateOrderStatus = async (
    orderId: string,
    newStatus: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus
  ) => {
    const response = await updateOrderStatusMutation({
      variables: {
        updateOrderStatusInput: {
          id: orderId,
          status: newStatus,
        },
      },
    });
    return response.data?.updateOrderStatus;
  };
  const updateTrackingNumber = async (
    orderId: string,
    trackingNumber: string
  ) => {
    const response = await updateOrderMutation({
      variables: {
        id: orderId,
        trackingNumber,
      },
    });
    return response.data?.updateOrderTracking;
  };
  const loadMore = () => {
    const endCursor = data?.mySellerOrders?.pageInfo?.endCursor;
    if (!endCursor) return;
    return fetchMore({
      variables: {
        after: endCursor,
        ...(statusVariable ? { status: statusVariable } : {}),
      },
    });
  };
  // Filter orders by status on the client side if status filter is provided
  const filteredOrders = statusVariable
    ? orders.filter((order: SellerOrder) => order.status === statusVariable)
    : orders;
  return {
    orders: filteredOrders,
    loading,
    error,
    refetch,
    loadMore,
    updateOrderStatus,
    updateTrackingNumber,
    updateStatusLoading,
    updateOrderLoading,
  };
}
export function useOrderDetails(orderId: string) {
  const { data, loading, error, refetch } = useQuery<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'order'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.QueryOrderArgs
  >(GET_ORDER_DETAILS_QUERY, {
    variables: { id: orderId },
    skip: !orderId,
  });
  return {
    order: data?.order,
    loading,
    error,
    refetch,
  };
}

<file path="libs/client/sellers/screens/login/src/lib/SellersLogin.tsx">
import { colors } from '@kickzone-workspace/colors';
import { SellersLayout } from '@kickzone-workspace/sellers-layout';
import { useI18nContext, usePageTitle } from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
import { getErrorMessage } from '@kickzone-workspace/translations';
import LockOutlined from '@mui/icons-material/LockOutlined';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Container from '@mui/material/Container';
import CssBaseline from '@mui/material/CssBaseline';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import TextField from '@mui/material/TextField';
import { PasswordTextField } from '@kickzone-workspace/password-field';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { useSellerLogin } from '@kickzone-workspace/sellers-auth-hooks';
import { getLtrTextFieldProps } from '@kickzone-workspace/language-components';
import type { FieldError } from 'react-hook-form';
import {
  sellerLoginFormSchema,
  type SellerLoginFormValues,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
export function SellersLogin() {
  const { loginSeller, sellersLoginLoading, sellersLoginError } =
    useSellerLogin();
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  usePageTitle(() => LL.pageTitles.sellerLogin());
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm<SellerLoginFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(sellerLoginFormSchema),
    mode: 'onSubmit',
    defaultValues: {
      email: '',
      password: '',
    },
  });
  const fieldErrorText = (error: FieldError | undefined): string => {
    if (!error || !error.type) return '';
    return LL.errors.requiredFields();
  };
  const onValidSubmit = async (values: SellerLoginFormValues) => {
    loginSeller({ email: values.email, password: values.password });
  };
  // Get translated error message
  const getDisplayError = () => {
    if (!sellersLoginError) return null;
    const { translationKey, rawMessage } = getErrorMessage(sellersLoginError);
    return translationKey
      ? LL.errors[translationKey]()
      : rawMessage || LL.errors.unknown();
  };
  return (
    <SellersLayout>
      <Container component="main" maxWidth="xs">
        <CssBaseline />
        <Paper
          elevation={3}
          sx={{
            marginTop: 8,
            padding: 4,
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            alignItems: 'center',
            borderRadius: 2,
          }}
        >
          <LockOutlined sx={{ fontSize: 40, color: colors.main }} />
          <Typography
            component="h1"
            variant="h5"
            sx={{ mt: 2, color: colors.text }}
          >
            {LL.authorization.signIn()}
          </Typography>
          <Box component="form" onSubmit={handleSubmit(onValidSubmit)} noValidate sx={{ mt: 3 }}>
            <TextField
              margin="normal"
              required
              fullWidth
              id="email"
              label={LL.form.email()}
              autoComplete="email"
              autoFocus
              error={!!errors.email}
              helperText={errors.email ? fieldErrorText(errors.email) : undefined}
              {...register('email')}
              {...getLtrTextFieldProps()}
            />
            <PasswordTextField
              margin="normal"
              required
              fullWidth
              label={LL.form.password()}
              id="password"
              autoComplete="current-password"
              error={!!errors.password}
              helperText={errors.password ? fieldErrorText(errors.password) : undefined}
              {...register('password')}
            />
            <Button
              type="submit"
              fullWidth
              variant="contained"
              loading={sellersLoginLoading}
              sx={{
                mt: 3,
                mb: 2,
                backgroundColor: colors.main,
                '&:hover': { backgroundColor: colors.hoverMain },
              }}
            >
              {LL.authorization.signIn()}
            </Button>
            {sellersLoginError && (
              <Typography color="error" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                {getDisplayError()}
              </Typography>
            )}
          </Box>
        </Paper>
      </Container>
    </SellersLayout>
  );
}
export default SellersLogin;
</file>

import React, { type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { SellersLogin } from './SellersLogin';

  ),

const mockLoginSeller = vi.fn();
const mockUseSellerLogin = vi.fn();
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/sellers-auth-hooks', () => ({
  useSellerLogin: () => mockUseSellerLogin(),
}));
// Mock the error message utility
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/translations', () => ({
  getErrorMessage: (error: Error) => {
    if (error.message.includes('wrong password')) {
      return { translationKey: 'wrongEmailOrPassword' };
    }
    return { rawMessage: error.message };
  },
}));
// Mock the i18n context
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n', () => ({
  useI18nContext: () => ({
    LL: {
      pageTitles: {
        sellerLogin: () => 'Seller Sign In',
      },
      authorization: {
        signIn: () => 'Sign In',
      },
      form: {
        email: () => 'Email Address',
        password: () => 'Password',
      },
      errors: {
        wrongEmailOrPassword: () => 'Incorrect credentials',
        requiredFields: () => 'Please fill in all required fields',
        unknown: () => 'Unknown error',
      },
    },
  }),
  usePageTitle: vi.fn(),
}));
describe('SellersLogin (zod/RHF validation)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockUseSellerLogin.mockReturnValue({
      loginSeller: mockLoginSeller,
      sellersLoginLoading: false,
      sellersLoginError: null,
    });
  });
  const renderComponent = () => {
    return render(
      <BrowserRouter>
        <SellersLogin />
      </BrowserRouter>
    );
  };
  it('empty submit -> loginSeller NOT called and requiredFields text shown', async () => {
    renderComponent();
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign In' });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    // RHF validates on submit - wait for errors to appear
    await waitFor(() => {
      const errorMessages = screen.getAllByText('Please fill in all required fields');
      expect(errorMessages.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    });
    // loginSeller should NOT be called
    expect(mockLoginSeller).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('"  ann@example.com  " + "abc" -> loginSeller({ email: "ann@example.com", password: "abc" }) once (legacy short password allowed)', async () => {
    renderComponent();
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Email Address/i);
    const passwordInput = screen.getByLabelText(/^Password/i);
    const submitButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign In' });
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: '  ann@example.com  ' } });
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'abc' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockLoginSeller).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(mockLoginSeller).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ email: 'ann@example.com', password: 'abc' });
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/sellers/screens/seller-orders/src/lib/seller-orders-screen.status-schema.spec.ts">
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import { ORDER_STATUSES, updateOrderStatusSchema } from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
describe('order status dialog uses the shared Zod schema', () => {
  it('accepts every GraphQL order status', () => {
    const statuses = Object.values(KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus);
    expect([...statuses].sort()).toEqual([...ORDER_STATUSES].sort());
    for (const status of statuses) {
      expect(updateOrderStatusSchema.safeParse({ id: 'order-1', status }).success).toBe(true);
    }
  });
  it('rejects a missing order id or an unknown status', () => {
    expect(updateOrderStatusSchema.safeParse({ id: '', status: 'PENDING' }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(updateOrderStatusSchema.safeParse({ id: 'order-1', status: 'LOST' }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/sellers/screens/seller-orders/src/lib/seller-status-transitions.spec.ts">
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import { getSellerAllowedNextStatuses } from './seller-status-transitions';
describe('getSellerAllowedNextStatuses', () => {
  it('returns [Pending] for PENDING (no seller transition)', () => {
    const allowed = getSellerAllowedNextStatuses(KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Pending);
    expect(allowed).toEqual([KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Pending]);
  });
  it('returns [Confirmed, Processing] for CONFIRMED', () => {
    const allowed = getSellerAllowedNextStatuses(KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Confirmed);
    expect(allowed).toEqual([
      KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Confirmed,
      KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Processing,
    ]);
  });
  it('returns [Processing, Shipped] for PROCESSING', () => {
    const allowed = getSellerAllowedNextStatuses(KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Processing);
    expect(allowed).toEqual([
      KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Processing,
      KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Shipped,
    ]);
  });
  it('returns [Shipped, Delivered] for SHIPPED', () => {
    const allowed = getSellerAllowedNextStatuses(KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Shipped);
    expect(allowed).toEqual([
      KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Shipped,
      KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Delivered,
    ]);
  });
  it('returns [Delivered] for DELIVERED (terminal, no next)', () => {
    const allowed = getSellerAllowedNextStatuses(KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Delivered);
    expect(allowed).toEqual([KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Delivered]);
  });
  it('returns [Cancelled] for CANCELLED (terminal, no next)', () => {
    const allowed = getSellerAllowedNextStatuses(KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Cancelled);
    expect(allowed).toEqual([KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Cancelled]);
  });
  it('returns [Refunded] for REFUNDED (terminal, no next)', () => {
    const allowed = getSellerAllowedNextStatuses(KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Refunded);
    expect(allowed).toEqual([KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Refunded]);
  });
  it('never returns Cancelled as a next status for any input', () => {
    const allStatuses = Object.values(KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus);
    for (const status of allStatuses) {
      const allowed = getSellerAllowedNextStatuses(status);
      // If there's a next status (index 1), it must not be Cancelled
      if (allowed.length > 1) {
        expect(allowed[1]).not.toBe(KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Cancelled);
      }
      // The current status itself could be Cancelled, but that's at index 0
      // The assertion is that Cancelled never appears as a *next* status
      for (let i = 1; i < allowed.length; i++) {
        expect(allowed[i]).not.toBe(KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Cancelled);
      }
    }
  });
  it('never returns Refunded as a next status for any input', () => {
    const allStatuses = Object.values(KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus);
    for (const status of allStatuses) {
      const allowed = getSellerAllowedNextStatuses(status);
      for (let i = 1; i < allowed.length; i++) {
        expect(allowed[i]).not.toBe(KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Refunded);
      }
    }
  });
  it('never returns Confirmed as a next status for any input', () => {
    const allStatuses = Object.values(KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus);
    for (const status of allStatuses) {
      const allowed = getSellerAllowedNextStatuses(status);
      for (let i = 1; i < allowed.length; i++) {
        expect(allowed[i]).not.toBe(KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Confirmed);
      }
    }
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/sellers/screens/seller-orders/src/lib/seller-status-transitions.ts">
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
const SELLER_NEXT_STATUS: Partial<Record<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus, KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus>> = {
  [KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Confirmed]: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Processing,
  [KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Processing]: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Shipped,
  [KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Shipped]: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Delivered,
};
/**
 * Returns the allowed statuses a seller can transition to from the current status.
 * The first element is always the current status (no-op).
 * The second element (if present) is the single next status the server accepts.
 * If no next status exists, returns only [current].
 */
export function getSellerAllowedNextStatuses(current: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus): KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus[] {
  const next = SELLER_NEXT_STATUS[current];
  return next ? [current, next] : [current];
}

<file path="libs/client/sellers/screens/setup-password/src/lib/SellersSetupPassword.tsx">
import { SellersLayout } from '@kickzone-workspace/sellers-layout';
import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useSetupPassword } from '@kickzone-workspace/sellers-auth-hooks';
import { useI18nContext, usePageTitle } from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
import { PasswordTextField } from '@kickzone-workspace/password-field';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import Container from '@mui/material/Container';
import Alert from '@mui/material/Alert';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import LockOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LockOutlined';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import {
  sellerSetupPasswordFormSchema,
  type SellerSetupPasswordFormValues,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
export const SellersSetupPassword = () => {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  usePageTitle(() => LL.pageTitles.sellerSetupPassword());
  const { token } = useParams();
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const { setupPassword, setupPasswordLoading, setupPasswordError } =
    useSetupPassword();
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
  } = useForm<SellerSetupPasswordFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(sellerSetupPasswordFormSchema),
    mode: 'onSubmit',
    defaultValues: {
      password: '',
      confirmPassword: '',
    },
  });
  const onValidSubmit = async (values: SellerSetupPasswordFormValues) => {
    if (token) {
      setupPassword(token, values.password);
    }
  };
  const onInvalidSubmit = (errors: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    // Check for confirmPassword mismatch first (priority)
    const confirmPasswordError = errors.confirmPassword as
      | { type?: string; message?: string }
      | undefined;
    if (
      confirmPasswordError &&
      confirmPasswordError.type === 'custom' &&
      confirmPasswordError.message === 'passwordsDoNotMatch'
    ) {
      setError(LL.authorization.passwordsDoNotMatch());
      return;
    }
    // Check for password issues (too_small, etc.)
    const passwordError = errors.password as
      | { type?: string; message?: string }
      | undefined;
    if (passwordError && passwordError.type === 'too_small') {
      setError(LL.authorization.passwordTooShort());
      return;
    }
    // Fallback
    setError(LL.errors.requiredFields());
  };
  return (
    <SellersLayout>
      <Container component="main" maxWidth="sm">
        <Box
          sx={{
            minHeight: '100vh',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            py: 4,
          }}
        >
          <Paper
            elevation={3}
            sx={{
              p: 4,
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              alignItems: 'center',
              borderRadius: 2,
              backgroundColor: 'background.paper',
            }}
          >
            <Box
              sx={{
                width: 40,
                height: 40,
                borderRadius: '50%',
                backgroundColor: 'primary.main',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                mb: 2,
              }}
            >
              <LockOutlinedIcon sx={{ color: 'white' }} />
            </Box>
            <Typography
              component="h1"
              variant="h5"
              sx={{ mb: 3, fontWeight: 600 }}
            >
              {LL.authorization.setupPasswordTitle()}
            </Typography>
            <Typography
              variant="body2"
              color="text.secondary"
              sx={{ mb: 3, textAlign: 'center' }}
            >
              {LL.authorization.setupPasswordDescription()}
            </Typography>
            <Box
              component="form"
              onSubmit={handleSubmit(onValidSubmit, onInvalidSubmit)}
              noValidate
              sx={{ width: '100%' }}
            >
              <Grid container spacing={2}>
                <Grid size={12}>
                  <PasswordTextField
                    required
                    fullWidth
                    label={LL.authorization.newPassword()}
                    {...register('password', { onChange: () => setError('') })}
                  />
                </Grid>
                <Grid size={12}>
                  <PasswordTextField
                    required
                    fullWidth
                    label={LL.authorization.confirmNewPassword()}
                    error={!!error && error === LL.authorization.passwordsDoNotMatch()}
                    {...register('confirmPassword', { onChange: () => setError('') })}
                  />
                </Grid>
              </Grid>
              {(error || setupPasswordError) && (
                <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mt: 2, mb: 2 }}>
                  {error || setupPasswordError?.message}
                </Alert>
              )}
              <Button
                type="submit"
                fullWidth
                variant="contained"
                disabled={setupPasswordLoading}
                sx={{
                  mt: 3,
                  mb: 2,
                  py: 1.5,
                  textTransform: 'none',
                  fontSize: '1rem',
                  fontWeight: 600,
                }}
              >
                {setupPasswordLoading ? (
                  <CircularProgress size={24} color="inherit" />
                ) : (
                  LL.authorization.setPassword()
                )}
              </Button>
              <Typography
                variant="body2"
                color="text.secondary"
                sx={{ mt: 2, textAlign: 'center' }}
              >
                {LL.authorization.passwordRequirements()}
              </Typography>
            </Box>
          </Paper>
        </Box>
      </Container>
    </SellersLayout>
  );
};
export default SellersSetupPassword;
</file>

  return {
    ...actual,
    useParams: () => ({ token: 'tok-1' }),
  };
});
describe('SellersSetupPassword (zod/RHF validation)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockUseSetupPassword.mockReturnValue({
      setupPassword: mockSetupPassword,
      setupPasswordLoading: false,
      setupPasswordError: null,
    });
  });
  const renderComponent = () => {
    return render(
      <BrowserRouter>
        <SellersSetupPassword />
      </BrowserRouter>
    );
  };
  const getPasswordInput = () => {
    const inputs = screen.getAllByLabelText(/New Password/i);
    return inputs.find((input) => input.name === 'password') as HTMLInputElement;
  };
  const getConfirmPasswordInput = () => {
    const inputs = screen.getAllByLabelText(/Confirm New Password/i);
    return inputs.find((input) => input.name === 'confirmPassword') as HTMLInputElement;
  };
  const getSubmitButton = () => screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Set Password' });
  it('mismatch -> passwordsDoNotMatch text, setupPassword NOT called', async () => {
    renderComponent();
    const passwordInput = getPasswordInput();
    const confirmPasswordInput = getConfirmPasswordInput();
    const submitButton = getSubmitButton();
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'password123' } });
    fireEvent.change(confirmPasswordInput, { target: { value: 'different123' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Passwords do not match')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    expect(mockSetupPassword).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('7-char matching -> passwordTooShort text, setupPassword NOT called', async () => {
    renderComponent();
    const passwordInput = getPasswordInput();
    const confirmPasswordInput = getConfirmPasswordInput();
    const submitButton = getSubmitButton();
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'pass123' } });
    fireEvent.change(confirmPasswordInput, { target: { value: 'pass123' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Password must be at least 8 characters')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    expect(mockSetupPassword).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('valid 8+ -> setupPassword(token, pw) once (mock useParams token "tok-1")', async () => {
    mockSetupPassword.mockResolvedValue({});
    renderComponent();
    const passwordInput = getPasswordInput();
    const confirmPasswordInput = getConfirmPasswordInput();
    const submitButton = getSubmitButton();
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'password123' } });
    fireEvent.change(confirmPasswordInput, { target: { value: 'password123' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockSetupPassword).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(mockSetupPassword).toHaveBeenCalledWith('tok-1', 'password123');
    });
  });
  it('typing after an error clears the error text', async () => {
    renderComponent();
    const passwordInput = getPasswordInput();
    const confirmPasswordInput = getConfirmPasswordInput();
    const submitButton = getSubmitButton();
    // First submit with mismatch to trigger error
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'password123' } });
    fireEvent.change(confirmPasswordInput, { target: { value: 'different123' } });
    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Passwords do not match')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    // Now type in password field - error should clear
    fireEvent.change(passwordInput, { target: { value: 'newpassword123' } });
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.queryByText('Passwords do not match')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/shared/components/rtl-table-utils/src/lib/rtl-table-props.ts">
import type { MRT_RowData, MRT_TableOptions } from 'material-react-table';
/**
 * Props for RTL table configuration
 */
export interface RTLTablePropsConfig {
  alignment: 'left' | 'right' | 'center';
  isFarsi: boolean;
}
function contentJustify(alignment: 'left' | 'right' | 'center') {
  if (alignment === 'right') return 'flex-end';
  if (alignment === 'center') return 'center';
  return 'flex-start';
}
/**
 * Gets MaterialReactTable props with RTL alignment support.
 * Aligns header labels and body cells the same way so values sit under titles in Farsi.
 */
export function getRTLTableProps<T extends MRT_RowData>(
  config: RTLTablePropsConfig
): Partial<MRT_TableOptions<T>> {
  const { alignment, isFarsi } = config;
  const justify = contentJustify(alignment);
  return {
    enableColumnActions: false,
    muiTablePaperProps: {
      sx: {
        direction: isFarsi ? 'rtl' : 'ltr',
      },
    },
    muiTableContainerProps: {
      sx: {
        direction: isFarsi ? 'rtl' : 'ltr',
      },
    },
    muiTableProps: {
      sx: {
        direction: isFarsi ? 'rtl' : 'ltr',
      },
    },
    muiTableHeadCellProps: {
      align: alignment,
      sx: {
        textAlign: alignment,
        verticalAlign: 'middle',
        '& .Mui-TableHeadCell-Content': {
          justifyContent: justify,
          width: '100%',
        },
        '& .Mui-TableHeadCell-Content-Labels': {
          justifyContent: justify,
          width: '100%',
          flex: '1 1 auto',
        },
        '& .Mui-TableHeadCell-Content-Wrapper': {
          textAlign: alignment,
          width: '100%',
          overflow: 'visible',
        },
        '& .MuiTableSortLabel-root': {
          width: '100%',
          justifyContent: justify,
          flexDirection: isFarsi ? 'row-reverse' : 'row',
        },
        // Keep sort icon from shifting the label away from body cell text
        '& .MuiTableSortLabel-icon': {
          marginLeft: isFarsi ? 0 : '4px',
          marginRight: isFarsi ? '4px' : 0,
        },
      },
    },
    muiTableBodyCellProps: {
      align: alignment,
      sx: {
        textAlign: alignment,
        verticalAlign: 'middle',
        '& > *': {
          textAlign: alignment,
        },
        '& .MuiBox-root': {
          textAlign: alignment,
        },
        '& .MuiTypography-root': {
          textAlign: alignment,
        },
      },
    },
  };
}
/**
 * Gets RTL-aligned column props for MaterialReactTable columns
 * @param alignment Text alignment ('left' | 'right' | 'center')
 * @returns Object with muiTableBodyCellProps and muiTableHeadCellProps
 */
export function getRTLColumnProps(alignment: 'left' | 'right' | 'center') {
  const justify = contentJustify(alignment);
  return {
    muiTableBodyCellProps: {
      align: alignment,
      sx: {
        textAlign: alignment,
        verticalAlign: 'middle',
        '& > *': {
          textAlign: alignment,
        },
      },
    },
    muiTableHeadCellProps: {
      align: alignment,
      sx: {
        textAlign: alignment,
        verticalAlign: 'middle',
        '& .Mui-TableHeadCell-Content': {
          justifyContent: justify,
          width: '100%',
        },
        '& .Mui-TableHeadCell-Content-Labels': {
          justifyContent: justify,
          width: '100%',
        },
        '& .Mui-TableHeadCell-Content-Wrapper': {
          textAlign: alignment,
          width: '100%',
        },
      },
    },
  };
}

import { renderHook, act, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { useExchangeRate } from './useExchangeRate';
import * as apolloReact from '@apollo/client/react';
vi.mock('@apollo/client/react', () => ({
  useQuery: vi.fn(),
  gql: vi.fn((strings: TemplateStringsArray) => strings.join('')),

describe('useExchangeRate', () => {
  const fromCurrencyCode = 'USD';
  const toCurrencyCode = 'IRR';
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
  });
  describe('Missing Exchange Rate Test', () => {
    it('should return rate=0 and hasValidRate=false when currentExchangeRate is null', () => {
      vi.mocked(apolloReact.useQuery).mockReturnValue({
        data: { currentExchangeRate: null },
        loading: false,
        error: undefined,
        refetch: vi.fn(),
      } as unknown as ReturnType<typeof apolloReact.useQuery>);
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useExchangeRate({ fromCurrencyCode, toCurrencyCode }));
      expect(result.current.loading).toBe(false);
      expect(result.current.rate).toBe(0);
      expect(result.current.hasValidRate).toBe(false);
      expect(result.current.exchangeRate).toBeNull();
    });
    it('should return rate=0 and hasValidRate=false when currentExchangeRate is undefined', () => {
      vi.mocked(apolloReact.useQuery).mockReturnValue({
        data: { currentExchangeRate: undefined },
        loading: false,
        error: undefined,
        refetch: vi.fn(),
      } as unknown as ReturnType<typeof apolloReact.useQuery>);
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useExchangeRate({ fromCurrencyCode, toCurrencyCode }));
      expect(result.current.rate).toBe(0);
      expect(result.current.hasValidRate).toBe(false);
    });
    it('should return rate=0 and hasValidRate=false when rate property is missing', () => {
      vi.mocked(apolloReact.useQuery).mockReturnValue({
        data: { currentExchangeRate: { fromCurrency: { code: 'USD' }, toCurrency: { code: 'IRR' } } },
        loading: false,
        error: undefined,
        refetch: vi.fn(),
      } as unknown as ReturnType<typeof apolloReact.useQuery>);
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useExchangeRate({ fromCurrencyCode, toCurrencyCode }));
      expect(result.current.rate).toBe(0);
      expect(result.current.hasValidRate).toBe(false);
    });
  });
  describe('Rate Equal to 1 Test', () => {
    it('should return hasValidRate=false when rate is exactly 1', () => {
      vi.mocked(apolloReact.useQuery).mockReturnValue({
        data: { currentExchangeRate: { rate: 1, fromCurrency: { code: 'USD' }, toCurrency: { code: 'IRR' } } },
        loading: false,
        error: undefined,
        refetch: vi.fn(),
      } as unknown as ReturnType<typeof apolloReact.useQuery>);
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useExchangeRate({ fromCurrencyCode, toCurrencyCode }));
      expect(result.current.rate).toBe(0);
      expect(result.current.hasValidRate).toBe(false);
      expect(result.current.exchangeRate?.rate).toBe(1);
    });
    it('should return hasValidRate=false when rate is 1.0 (float)', () => {
      vi.mocked(apolloReact.useQuery).mockReturnValue({
        data: { currentExchangeRate: { rate: 1.0, fromCurrency: { code: 'USD' }, toCurrency: { code: 'IRR' } } },
        loading: false,
        error: undefined,
        refetch: vi.fn(),
      } as unknown as ReturnType<typeof apolloReact.useQuery>);
