      expect(result.current.hasValidRate).toBe(false);
    });
  });
  describe('Rate Less Than or Equal to 1 Tests', () => {

  describe('Valid Exchange Rate Tests', () => {

      vi.mocked(apolloReact.useQuery).mockReturnValue({

        error: undefined,

      expect(result.current.rate).toBe(65000);
      expect(result.current.hasValidRate).toBe(true);
      expect(result.current.exchangeRate?.rate).toBe(65000);

      const testRates = [50000, 55000, 60000, 65000, 70000, 100000];
      for (const rate of testRates) {
        vi.clearAllMocks();
        vi.mocked(apolloReact.useQuery).mockReturnValue({
          data: { currentExchangeRate: { rate, fromCurrency: { code: 'USD' }, toCurrency: { code: 'IRR' } } },
          loading: false,
          error: undefined,

        const { result } = renderHook(() => useExchangeRate({ fromCurrencyCode, toCurrencyCode }));

        expect(result.current.hasValidRate).toBe(true);
      }

      vi.mocked(apolloReact.useQuery).mockReturnValue({
        data: { currentExchangeRate: { rate: 65000.5, fromCurrency: { code: 'USD' }, toCurrency: { code: 'IRR' } } },
        loading: false,
        error: undefined,
        refetch: vi.fn(),
      } as unknown as ReturnType<typeof apolloReact.useQuery>);
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useExchangeRate({ fromCurrencyCode, toCurrencyCode }));
      expect(result.current.rate).toBe(65000.5);
      expect(result.current.hasValidRate).toBe(true);
    });
  });
  describe('Loading and Error States', () => {
    it('should return loading=true initially', () => {
      vi.mocked(apolloReact.useQuery).mockReturnValue({
        data: { currentExchangeRate: { rate: 60000 } },
        loading: true,
        error: undefined,
        refetch: vi.fn(),
      } as unknown as ReturnType<typeof apolloReact.useQuery>);
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useExchangeRate({ fromCurrencyCode, toCurrencyCode }));
      expect(result.current.loading).toBe(true);
    });
    it('should return error when GraphQL query fails', () => {
      const testError = new Error('Network error');
      vi.mocked(apolloReact.useQuery).mockReturnValue({
        data: undefined,
        loading: false,
        error: testError,
        refetch: vi.fn(),
      } as unknown as ReturnType<typeof apolloReact.useQuery>);
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useExchangeRate({ fromCurrencyCode, toCurrencyCode }));
      expect(result.current.error).toBe(testError);
      expect(result.current.rate).toBe(0);
      expect(result.current.hasValidRate).toBe(false);
    });
  });
  describe('Skip Option', () => {
    it('should skip query when skip=true', () => {
      vi.mocked(apolloReact.useQuery).mockReturnValue({
        data: undefined,
        loading: false,
        error: undefined,
        refetch: vi.fn(),
      } as unknown as ReturnType<typeof apolloReact.useQuery>);
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useExchangeRate({ fromCurrencyCode, toCurrencyCode, skip: true }));
      expect(result.current.loading).toBe(false);
      expect(result.current.rate).toBe(0);
      expect(result.current.hasValidRate).toBe(false);
    });
    it('should skip query when fromCurrencyCode === toCurrencyCode', () => {
      vi.mocked(apolloReact.useQuery).mockReturnValue({
        data: undefined,
        loading: false,
        error: undefined,
        refetch: vi.fn(),
      } as unknown as ReturnType<typeof apolloReact.useQuery>);
      const { result } = renderHook(() => useExchangeRate({ fromCurrencyCode: 'USD', toCurrencyCode: 'USD' }));
      expect(result.current.loading).toBe(false);
      expect(result.current.rate).toBe(0);
      expect(result.current.hasValidRate).toBe(false);
    });
  });
  describe('Refetch', () => {
    it('should refetch and update rate when refetch is called', async () => {
      // First call returns rate 60000, second call returns rate 65000
      let callCount = 0;
      const mockUseQuery = vi.mocked(apolloReact.useQuery);
      mockUseQuery.mockImplementation(() => {
        callCount++;
        if (callCount === 1) {
          return {
            data: { currentExchangeRate: { rate: 60000 } },
            loading: false,
            error: undefined,
            refetch: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ data: { currentExchangeRate: { rate: 65000 } } }),
          } as unknown as ReturnType<typeof apolloReact.useQuery>;
        }
        return {
          data: { currentExchangeRate: { rate: 65000 } },
          loading: false,
          error: undefined,
          refetch: vi.fn(),
        } as unknown as ReturnType<typeof apolloReact.useQuery>;
      });
      const { result, rerender } = renderHook(() => useExchangeRate({ fromCurrencyCode, toCurrencyCode }));
      expect(result.current.rate).toBe(60000);
      await act(async () => {
        await result.current.refetch();
      });
      // Re-render to get updated data from the second mock implementation
      rerender();
      await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.rate).toBe(65000));
      expect(result.current.hasValidRate).toBe(true);
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/controllers/src/lib/order.controller.ts">
import {
  Controller,
  Get,
  Post,
  Put,
  Delete,
  Body,
  Param,
  Query,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { OrderService } from '@kickzone-workspace/services';
import {
  CreateOrderInput,
  UpdateOrderInput,
  UpdateOrderStatusInput,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
import { Order, OrderStatus } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { HttpAuthGuard } from '@kickzone-workspace/guards';
import { CurrentUser, type AuthenticatedUser } from '@kickzone-workspace/decorators';
@Controller('orders')
@UseGuards(HttpAuthGuard)
export class OrderController {
  constructor(private readonly orderService: OrderService) {}
  @Get()
  async getOrders(
    @Query('first') first = '10',
    @Query('after') after?: string,
    @Query('sellerId') sellerId?: string,
    @Query('status') status?: OrderStatus
  ) {
    const result = await this.orderService.findAll(
      parseInt(first),
      after,
      sellerId,
      status
    );
    return result;
  }
  @Get(':id')
  async getOrder(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return this.orderService.findOne(id);
  }
  @Get('seller/:sellerId')
  async getSellerOrders(
    @Param('sellerId') sellerId: string,
    @Query('first') first = '10',
    @Query('after') after?: string,
    @Query('status') status?: OrderStatus
  ) {
    const result = await this.orderService.findAll(
      parseInt(first),
      after,
      sellerId,
      status
    );
    return result;
  }
  @Get('admin/seller/:sellerId')
  async adminGetSellerOrders(
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
    @Param('sellerId') sellerId: string,
    @Query('first') first = '10',
    @Query('after') after?: string,
    @Query('status') status?: OrderStatus
  ) {
    // Admin can view any seller's orders
    const result = await this.orderService.findAll(
      parseInt(first),
      after,
      sellerId,
      status
    );
    return result;
  }
  @Get('admin/all')
  async adminGetAllOrders(
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
    @Query('first') first = '10',
    @Query('after') after?: string,
    @Query('status') status?: OrderStatus
  ) {
    // Admin can view all orders from all sellers
    const result = await this.orderService.findAll(
      parseInt(first),
      after,
      undefined,
      status
    );
    return result;
  }
  @Get('my/orders')
  async getMyOrders(
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
    @Query('first') first = '10',
    @Query('after') after?: string
  ) {
    const result = await this.orderService.getOrdersBySeller(
      user.id,
      parseInt(first),
      after
    );
    return result;
  }
  @Post()
  async createOrder(@Body() createOrderInput: CreateOrderInput) {
    return this.orderService.createOrder(createOrderInput);
  }
  @Put(':id')
  async updateOrder(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Body() updateOrderInput: UpdateOrderInput
  ) {
    return this.orderService.updateOrder(id, updateOrderInput);
  }
  @Put(':id/status')
  async updateOrderStatus(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Body() updateOrderStatusInput: UpdateOrderStatusInput
  ) {
    return this.orderService.updateOrderStatus(
      id,
      updateOrderStatusInput.status
    );
  }
  @Delete(':id')
  async deleteOrder(@Param('id') id: string) {
    await this.orderService.deleteOrder(id);
    return { success: true };
  }
}

/**
 * The request user exposed by @CurrentUser() on routes guarded by GraphqlAuthGuard / HttpAuthGuard.
 * Only the fields that resolvers and controllers read are declared.

export interface AuthenticatedUser {
  id: string;
  email?: string;
  sub?: string;
  role?: string;
  userType?: string;
}
/** A request user that may be absent (unguarded routes or defensive helpers). */
export type OptionalAuthenticatedUser = AuthenticatedUser | null | undefined;

  createBrandSchema,
  optionalDisplayNameSchema,
  updateBrandSchema,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from './zod-validation.pipe';
@Resolver(() => Brand)
export class BrandResolver {
  constructor(
    private translationService: TranslationService,
    private brandService: BrandService
  ) {}
  @Query(() => [Brand])
  async brands(
    @Args('onlyWithProducts', { type: () => Boolean, nullable: true })
    onlyWithProducts?: boolean
  ): Promise<Brand[]> {
    return this.brandService.getBrands({
      onlyWithProducts: onlyWithProducts === true,
    });
  }
  @Query(() => Brand, { nullable: true })
  async brand(
    @Args('id', { type: () => Int }) id: number
  ): Promise<Brand | null> {
    return this.brandService.getBrandById(id);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Brand)
  @UseGuards(CatalogGuard)
  async createBrand(
    @Args('input', new ZodValidationPipe(createBrandSchema)) input: CreateBrandInput,
    @Args(
      'name',
      { nullable: true },
      new ZodValidationPipe(optionalDisplayNameSchema)
    )
    name?: string
  ): Promise<Brand> {
    return this.brandService.createBrand(input, name);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Brand)
  @UseGuards(CatalogGuard)
  async updateBrand(
    @Args('input', new ZodValidationPipe(updateBrandSchema)) input: UpdateBrandInput,
    @Args(
      'name',
      { nullable: true },
      new ZodValidationPipe(optionalDisplayNameSchema)
    )
    name?: string,
    @Context() context?: { req: { locale?: string } }
  ): Promise<Brand> {
    return this.brandService.updateBrand(
      input,
      name,
      context?.req?.locale || 'en'
    );
  }
  @Mutation(() => Boolean)
  @UseGuards(CatalogGuard)
  async deleteBrand(
    @Args('id', { type: () => Int }) id: number
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    return this.brandService.deleteBrand(id);
  }
  @ResolveField(() => String)
  async name(
    @Parent() brand: Brand,
    @Context() context: { req: { locale?: string } }
  ): Promise<string> {
    const locale = context.req.locale || 'en';
    return this.translationService.getTranslation(
      'brand',
      brand.id,
      locale,
      'name',
      brand.slug
    );
  }
}

<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/currency-translation-validation.spec.ts">
import { BadRequestException, PipeTransform, Type } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ROUTE_ARGS_METADATA } from '@nestjs/common/constants';
import { CurrencyResolver } from './currency.resolver';
import { TranslationResolver } from './translation.resolver';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from './zod-validation.pipe';
type ParamMeta = { index: number; pipes?: PipeTransform[] };
function zodPipe(cls: Type<unknown>, method: string, argIndex: number): PipeTransform {
  const raw = (Reflect.getMetadata(ROUTE_ARGS_METADATA, cls, method) ?? {}) as Record<string, ParamMeta>;
  const param = Object.values(raw).find((p) => p.index === argIndex);
  const pipe = param?.pipes?.find((p) => p instanceof ZodValidationPipe);
  if (!pipe) throw new Error(`no ZodValidationPipe on ${method} arg ${argIndex}`);
  return pipe;
}
const run = (cls: Type<unknown>, method: string, index: number, value: unknown) =>
  zodPipe(cls, method, index).transform(value, { type: 'body' });
describe('currency and translation argument validation', () => {
  it('validates currency create/update', () => {
    expect(() =>
      run(CurrencyResolver, 'createCurrency', 0, { code: 'USD', name: 'US Dollar', symbol: '$', decimalPlaces: 2 })
    ).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => run(CurrencyResolver, 'createCurrency', 0, { code: '$$', name: 'x', symbol: '$', decimalPlaces: 2 })).toThrow(
      BadRequestException
    );
    expect(() => run(CurrencyResolver, 'updateCurrency', 1, { decimalPlaces: -1 })).toThrow(BadRequestException);
  });
  it('validates exchange rates and currency preferences', () => {
    expect(() =>
      run(CurrencyResolver, 'setExchangeRate', 0, { fromCurrencyCode: 'USD', toCurrencyCode: 'IRR', rate: 600000 })
    ).not.toThrow();
    expect(() =>
      run(CurrencyResolver, 'setExchangeRate', 0, { fromCurrencyCode: 'USD', toCurrencyCode: 'IRR', rate: -1 })
    ).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    expect(() => run(CurrencyResolver, 'setCurrencyPreference', 0, 'fa')).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => run(CurrencyResolver, 'setCurrencyPreference', 1, 'IR-R')).toThrow(BadRequestException);
  });
  it('validates translations', () => {
    const t = { entityType: 'product', entityId: 1, locale: 'fa', fieldName: 'name', value: 'کفش' };
    expect(() => run(TranslationResolver, 'setTranslation', 0, t)).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => run(TranslationResolver, 'setTranslation', 0, { ...t, fieldName: '' })).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    expect(() =>
      run(TranslationResolver, 'bulkTranslateEntities', 0, {
        entityType: 'product', entityIds: [1], sourceLocale: 'en', targetLocales: ['fa'],
      })
    ).not.toThrow();
  });
});

  @Field({ nullable: true })
  code?: string;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  name?: string;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  symbol?: string;
  @Field(() => Int, { nullable: true })
  decimalPlaces?: number;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  isActive?: boolean;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  isBaseCurrency?: boolean;
}
@InputType()
export class SetExchangeRateInput {
  @Field()
  fromCurrencyCode: string;
  @Field()
  toCurrencyCode: string;
  @Field(() => Float)
  rate: number;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  effectiveDate?: Date;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  notes?: string;
}
// =============== Resolver ===============
@Resolver(() => Currency)
export class CurrencyResolver {
  constructor(private readonly currencyService: CurrencyService) {}
  // =============== Queries (Public/Protected) ===============
  @Query(() => [Currency])
  async currencies(): Promise<Currency[]> {
    return this.currencyService.findAllCurrencies();
  }
  @Query(() => Currency, { nullable: true })
  async currency(
    @Args('id', { type: () => Int }) id: number
  ): Promise<Currency | null> {
    return this.currencyService.findCurrencyById(id);
  }
  @Query(() => Currency, { nullable: true })
  async currencyByCode(@Args('code') code: string): Promise<Currency | null> {
    return this.currencyService.findCurrencyByCode(code);
  }
  @Query(() => ExchangeRate, { nullable: true })
  async currentExchangeRate(
    @Args('fromCurrencyCode') fromCurrencyCode: string,
    @Args('toCurrencyCode') toCurrencyCode: string
  ): Promise<ExchangeRate | null> {
    return this.currencyService.getCurrentExchangeRate(
      fromCurrencyCode,
      toCurrencyCode
    );
  }
  @Query(() => [ExchangeRate])
  async exchangeRateHistory(
    @Args('fromCurrencyCode') fromCurrencyCode: string,
    @Args('toCurrencyCode') toCurrencyCode: string,
    @Args('limit', { type: () => Int, nullable: true }) limit?: number
  ): Promise<ExchangeRate[]> {
    return this.currencyService.getExchangeRateHistory(
      fromCurrencyCode,
      toCurrencyCode,
      limit || 10
    );
  }
  @Query(() => [CurrencyPreference])
  async currencyPreferences(): Promise<CurrencyPreference[]> {
    return this.currencyService.findAllCurrencyPreferences();
  }
  @Query(() => CurrencyPreference, { nullable: true })
  async currencyPreferenceByLocale(
    @Args('locale') locale: string
  ): Promise<CurrencyPreference | null> {
    return this.currencyService.findCurrencyPreferenceByLocale(locale);
  }
  // =============== Mutations (Admin Only) ===============
  @Mutation(() => Currency)
  @UseGuards(RolesGuard)
  @SetMetadata('roles', [UserRole.ADMIN])
  async createCurrency(
    @Args('input', new ZodValidationPipe(createCurrencySchema))
    input: CreateCurrencyInput
  ): Promise<Currency> {
    return this.currencyService.createCurrency(input);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Currency)
  @UseGuards(RolesGuard)
  @SetMetadata('roles', [UserRole.ADMIN])
  async updateCurrency(
    @Args('id', { type: () => Int }) id: number,
    @Args('input', new ZodValidationPipe(updateCurrencySchema))
    input: UpdateCurrencyInput
  ): Promise<Currency> {
    return this.currencyService.updateCurrency(id, input);
  }
  @Mutation(() => ExchangeRate)
  @UseGuards(RolesGuard)
  @SetMetadata('roles', [UserRole.ADMIN])
  async setExchangeRate(
    @Args('input', new ZodValidationPipe(setExchangeRateSchema))
    input: SetExchangeRateInput,
    @CurrentUser() user?: User
  ): Promise<ExchangeRate> {
    return this.currencyService.setExchangeRate({
      ...input,
      createdById: user?.id,
    });
  }
  @Mutation(() => CurrencyPreference)
  @UseGuards(RolesGuard)
  @SetMetadata('roles', [UserRole.ADMIN])
  async setCurrencyPreference(
    @Args('locale', new ZodValidationPipe(languageCodeSchema)) locale: string,
    @Args('currencyCode', new ZodValidationPipe(currencyCodeSchema))
    currencyCode: string
  ): Promise<CurrencyPreference> {
    return this.currencyService.setCurrencyPreference(locale, currencyCode);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Boolean)
  @UseGuards(RolesGuard)
  @SetMetadata('roles', [UserRole.ADMIN])
  async deleteCurrencyPreference(
    @Args('id', { type: () => Int }) id: number
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    return this.currencyService.deleteCurrencyPreference(id);
  }
}

import { BadRequestException, PipeTransform } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ROUTE_ARGS_METADATA } from '@nestjs/common/constants';
import { CustomerProfileResolver } from './customer-profile.resolver';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from './zod-validation.pipe';
type ParamMeta = { index: number; pipes?: PipeTransform[] };
function zodPipe(method: string, argIndex: number): PipeTransform {
  const raw = (Reflect.getMetadata(ROUTE_ARGS_METADATA, CustomerProfileResolver, method) ?? {}) as Record<
    string,
    ParamMeta
  >;
  const param = Object.values(raw).find((p) => p.index === argIndex);
  const pipe = param?.pipes?.find((p) => p instanceof ZodValidationPipe);
  if (!pipe) throw new Error(`no ZodValidationPipe on ${method} arg ${argIndex}`);
  return pipe;
}
describe('CustomerProfileResolver argument validation', () => {
  const pipe = () => zodPipe('updateMyProfile', 1);
  const run = (value: unknown) => pipe().transform(value, { type: 'body' });
  it('accepts valid and blank profile updates', () => {
    expect(() => run({ phone: '09121234567', city: 'Tehran' })).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => run({ state: '', zipCode: '' })).not.toThrow();
  });
  it('rejects an invalid phone or postal code', () => {
    expect(() => run({ phone: '12' })).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    expect(() => run({ zipCode: '1#' })).toThrow(BadRequestException);
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/order-validation.spec.ts">
import { BadRequestException, PipeTransform } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ROUTE_ARGS_METADATA } from '@nestjs/common/constants';
import { OrderStatus } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { ORDER_STATUSES } from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import { OrderResolver } from './order.resolver';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from './zod-validation.pipe';
type ParamMeta = { index: number; pipes?: PipeTransform[] };
function zodPipe(method: string, argIndex: number): PipeTransform {
  const raw = (Reflect.getMetadata(ROUTE_ARGS_METADATA, OrderResolver, method) ?? {}) as Record<
    string,
    ParamMeta
  >;
  const param = Object.values(raw).find((p) => p.index === argIndex);
  const pipe = param?.pipes?.find((p) => p instanceof ZodValidationPipe);
  if (!pipe) throw new Error(`no ZodValidationPipe on ${method} arg ${argIndex}`);
  return pipe;
}
const run = (pipe: PipeTransform, value: unknown) =>
  pipe.transform(value, { type: 'body' });
const item = {
  productId: '101',
  sellerProductId: '301',
  productName: 'Air Jordan 1',
  productImage: null,
  quantity: 1,
  unitPrice: 100,
  totalPrice: 100,
  color: null,
  size: '42',
};
const order = {
  customerName: 'Ali Rezaei',
  customerEmail: '',
  customerPhone: '09121234567',
  shippingAddress: 'Valiasr St, No 12',
  city: 'Tehran',
  state: 'Tehran',
  zipCode: '1234567890',
  country: 'Iran',
  sellerId: 1,
  items: [item],
  notes: '[GuestToken: abc]',
  shippingCost: 0,
};
describe('OrderResolver argument validation pipes', () => {
  it('shared ORDER_STATUSES match the OrderStatus entity enum', () => {
    expect([...ORDER_STATUSES].sort()).toEqual(Object.values(OrderStatus).sort());
  });
  it('createOrder validates createOrderInput', () => {
    const pipe = zodPipe('createOrder', 0);
    expect(() => run(pipe, order)).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => run(pipe, { ...order, items: [] })).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    expect(() => run(pipe, { ...order, customerPhone: '1' })).toThrow(BadRequestException);
  });
  it('updateOrder validates id and updateOrderInput', () => {
    expect(() => run(zodPipe('updateOrder', 1), '')).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    const input = zodPipe('updateOrder', 2);
    expect(() => run(input, { city: 'Shiraz' })).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => run(input, { zipCode: '1' })).toThrow(BadRequestException);
  });
  it('updateOrder pipe keeps items so the resolver can reject item rewrites', () => {
    const out = run(zodPipe('updateOrder', 2), { items: [item] }) as { items?: unknown[] };
    expect(out.items).toHaveLength(1);
  });
  it('updateOrderStatus validates id and status', () => {
    const pipe = zodPipe('updateOrderStatus', 1);
    expect(() => run(pipe, { id: 'o-1', status: 'SHIPPED' })).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => run(pipe, { id: 'o-1', status: 'LOST' })).toThrow(BadRequestException);
  });
  it('cancelPendingOrder and deleteOrder reject an empty id', () => {
    expect(() => run(zodPipe('cancelPendingOrder', 1), ' ')).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    expect(() => run(zodPipe('deleteOrder', 1), '')).toThrow(BadRequestException);
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/payment.resolver.integration.spec.ts">
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { PaymentResolver } from './payment.resolver';
import { PaymentService, OrderService, CurrencyService } from '@kickzone-workspace/services';
import { OrderStatus } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  ZarinPalPaymentRequestInput,
  ZarinPalVerificationRequestInput,
} from './payment.resolver';
describe('PaymentResolver Integration Tests', () => {
  let resolver: PaymentResolver;
  let paymentService: jest.Mocked<PaymentService>;
  let orderService: jest.Mocked<OrderService>;
  let currencyService: jest.Mocked<CurrencyService>;
  const mockPaymentService = {
    requestPayment: jest.fn(),
    verifyPayment: jest.fn(),
    getGatewayUrl: jest.fn(),
  };
  const mockOrderService = {
    confirmOrderPayment: jest.fn(),
    cancelPendingOrder: jest.fn(),
    findOne: jest.fn(),
    setPaymentIntent: jest.fn(),
    findOrdersByPaymentAuthority: jest.fn(),
    updateOrderStatus: jest.fn(),
  };
  const mockCurrencyService = {
    getCurrentExchangeRate: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue({ rate: 1000 }),
  };
  beforeEach(async () => {
    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        PaymentResolver,
        {
          provide: PaymentService,
          useValue: mockPaymentService,
        },
        {
          provide: OrderService,
          useValue: mockOrderService,
        },
        {
          provide: CurrencyService,
          useValue: mockCurrencyService,
        },
      ],
    }).compile();
    resolver = module.get<PaymentResolver>(PaymentResolver);
    paymentService = module.get(PaymentService);
    orderService = module.get(OrderService);
    currencyService = module.get(CurrencyService);
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
    mockCurrencyService.getCurrentExchangeRate.mockResolvedValue({ rate: 1000 });
  });
  describe('Full Payment Flow Integration', () => {
    const orderId = 'order-123';
    const authority = 'A00000000000000000000000000000000000000';
    const amount = 100000; // 100,000 Toman
    const paymentRequestInput: ZarinPalPaymentRequestInput = {
      amount,
      callback_url: 'https://example.com/payment/callback',
      description: 'Test Order Payment',
      currency: 'IRT',
      mobile: '09123456789',
      email: 'test@example.com',
      order_id: orderId,
    };
    const mockOrder = {
      id: orderId,
      status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
      total: 100, // USD, so 100 * 1000 = 100000 IRT amount
      paymentAuthority: authority,
      paymentAmount: amount,
      paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
      items: [
        {
          id: 'item-1',
          productId: 'product-1',
          sellerProductId: 'seller-product-1',
          quantity: 2,
        },
      ],
    };
    describe('Successful Payment Flow', () => {
      it('should complete full payment flow: request → verify → confirm order', async () => {
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(mockOrder as never);
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([mockOrder] as never);
        orderService.setPaymentIntent.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
        // Step 1: Request payment
        paymentService.requestPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          data: {
            code: 100,
            message: 'Success',
            authority,
            fee_type: 'Merchant',
            fee: 0,
          },
          errors: [],
        } as never);
        const requestResult = await resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(paymentRequestInput);
        expect(paymentService.requestPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
          amount: paymentRequestInput.amount,
          callback_url: paymentRequestInput.callback_url,
          description: paymentRequestInput.description,
          currency: 'IRT',
          metadata: {
            mobile: paymentRequestInput.mobile,
            email: paymentRequestInput.email,
            order_id: paymentRequestInput.order_id,
          },
        });
        expect(requestResult.code).toBe(100);
        expect(requestResult.authority).toBe(authority);
        // Step 2: Verify payment (successful)
        const verificationInput: ZarinPalVerificationRequestInput = {
          amount,
          authority,
          order_id: orderId,
        };
        const confirmedOrder = {
          ...mockOrder,
          status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED,
        };
        paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          data: {
            code: 100,
            message: 'Payment verified',
            ref_id: 123456789,
            card_pan: '1234-****-****-5678',
            fee_type: 'Merchant',
            fee: 0,
          },
          errors: [],
        } as never);
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(mockOrder as never);
        orderService.setPaymentIntent.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
        orderService.confirmOrderPayment.mockResolvedValue(
          confirmedOrder as never
        );
        const verifyResult = await resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(verificationInput);
        expect(paymentService.verifyPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
          amount: verificationInput.amount,
          authority: verificationInput.authority,
        });
        expect(verifyResult.code).toBe(100);
        expect(verifyResult.ref_id).toBe(123456789);
        // Verify order was confirmed (stock decreased)
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith(orderId);
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      });
      it('should handle payment verification code 101 (already verified)', async () => {
        const verificationInput: ZarinPalVerificationRequestInput = {
          amount,
          authority,
          order_id: orderId,
        };
        paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          data: {
            code: 101,
            message: 'Payment already verified',
            ref_id: 123456789,
          },
          errors: [],
        } as never);
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(mockOrder as never);
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([mockOrder] as never);
        orderService.setPaymentIntent.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
        orderService.confirmOrderPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          ...mockOrder,
          status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED,
        } as never);
        const verifyResult = await resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(verificationInput);
        expect(verifyResult.code).toBe(101);
        // Order should still be confirmed even with code 101
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith(orderId);
      });
    });
    describe('Failed Payment Flow', () => {
      it('should cancel order when payment verification fails', async () => {
        const verificationInput: ZarinPalVerificationRequestInput = {
          amount,
          authority,
          order_id: orderId,
        };
        // Payment verification fails
        paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          data: {
            code: -11,
            message: 'Payment not found',
          },
          errors: [],
        } as never);
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(mockOrder as never);
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([mockOrder] as never);
        orderService.setPaymentIntent.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
        orderService.cancelPendingOrder.mockResolvedValue({
          ...mockOrder,
          status: OrderStatus.CANCELLED,
        } as never);
        const verifyResult = await resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(verificationInput);
        expect(verifyResult.code).toBe(-11);
        // Order should be cancelled
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).toHaveBeenCalledWith(orderId);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
        // Order should NOT be confirmed
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
      it('should cancel order when payment verification returns non-success code', async () => {
        const verificationInput: ZarinPalVerificationRequestInput = {
          amount,
          authority,
          order_id: orderId,
        };
        // Payment verification fails with different error code
        paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          data: {
            code: -10,
            message: 'Invalid amount',
          },
          errors: [],
        } as never);
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(mockOrder as never);
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([mockOrder] as never);
        orderService.setPaymentIntent.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
        orderService.cancelPendingOrder.mockResolvedValue({
          ...mockOrder,
          status: OrderStatus.CANCELLED,
        } as never);
        const verifyResult = await resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(verificationInput);
        expect(verifyResult.code).toBe(-10);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).toHaveBeenCalledWith(orderId);
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
    });
    describe('Payment Flow Without Order ID', () => {
      it('should reject verification when order_id is not provided', async () => {
        const verificationInput: ZarinPalVerificationRequestInput = {
          amount,
          authority,
          // order_id is undefined
        };
        paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          data: {
            code: 100,
            message: 'Payment verified',
            ref_id: 123456789,
          },
          errors: [],
        } as never);
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([] as never);
        await expect(
          resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(verificationInput)
        ).rejects.toThrow('No orders found for this payment authority');
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
    });
    describe('Error Handling in Order Confirmation', () => {
      it('should return success: false with ref_id when order confirmation fails but payment was verified', async () => {
        const verificationInput: ZarinPalVerificationRequestInput = {
          amount,
          authority,
          order_id: orderId,
        };
        paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          data: {
            code: 100,
            message: 'Payment verified',
            ref_id: 123456789,
          },
          errors: [],
        } as never);
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(mockOrder as never);
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([mockOrder] as never);
        orderService.setPaymentIntent.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
        // Order confirmation fails
        orderService.confirmOrderPayment.mockRejectedValue(
          new Error('Order confirmation failed')
        );
        const verifyResult = await resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(verificationInput);
        // Payment was captured but order confirmation failed - returns code 100 but success: false
        expect(verifyResult.code).toBe(100);
        expect(verifyResult.ref_id).toBe(123456789);
        expect(verifyResult.success).toBe(false);
        expect(verifyResult.message).toContain('Order confirmation failed');
        // Order confirmation was attempted
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith(orderId);
      });
      it('should still return failure if order cancellation fails but payment failed', async () => {
        const verificationInput: ZarinPalVerificationRequestInput = {
          amount,
          authority,
          order_id: orderId,
        };
        // Payment verification fails
        paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          data: {
            code: -11,
            message: 'Payment not found',
          },
          errors: [],
        } as never);
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(mockOrder as never);
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([mockOrder] as never);
        orderService.setPaymentIntent.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
        // Order cancellation fails
        orderService.cancelPendingOrder.mockRejectedValue(
          new Error('Order cancellation failed')
        );
        const verifyResult = await resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(verificationInput);
        // Payment verification should still return failure
        expect(verifyResult.code).toBe(-11);
        // Order cancellation was attempted
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).toHaveBeenCalledWith(orderId);
      });
    });
    describe('Gateway URL Generation', () => {
      it('should return correct gateway URL for given authority', async () => {
        const authority = 'A00000000000000000000000000000000000000';
        const expectedUrl = `https://sandbox.zarinpal.com/pg/StartPay/${authority}`;
        paymentService.getGatewayUrl.mockReturnValue(expectedUrl);
        const result = await resolver.getZarinPalGatewayUrl(
          { id: 'user-1' } as never,
          authority
        );
        expect(paymentService.getGatewayUrl).toHaveBeenCalledWith(authority);
        expect(result.url).toBe(expectedUrl);
      });
    });
  });
  describe('Payment Request Integration', () => {
    const createPendingOrder = (
      orderId: string,
      total: number,
      paymentCurrency: 'IRT' | 'IRR' = 'IRT'
    ) => ({
      id: orderId,
      status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
      total: total / 1000, // USD, so total * 1000 = paymentAmount (IRT)
      paymentAuthority: 'A00000000000000000000000000000000000000',
      paymentAmount: total,
      paymentCurrency,
      items: [],
    });
    it('should handle payment request with all optional fields', async () => {
      const input: ZarinPalPaymentRequestInput = {
        amount: 50000,
        callback_url: 'https://example.com/callback',
        description: 'Order #123',
        currency: 'IRT',
        mobile: '09123456789',
        email: 'customer@example.com',
        order_id: 'order-123',
      };
      paymentService.requestPayment.mockResolvedValue({
        data: {
          code: 100,
          message: 'Success',
          authority: 'A00000000000000000000000000000000000000',
          fee_type: 'Merchant',
          fee: 0,
        },
        errors: [],
      } as never);
      orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue({
        ...createPendingOrder(input.order_id!, input.amount),
      } as never);
      orderService.setPaymentIntent.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
      const result = await resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(input);
      expect(paymentService.requestPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        amount: input.amount,
        callback_url: input.callback_url,
        description: input.description,
        currency: 'IRT',
        metadata: {
          mobile: input.mobile,
          email: input.email,
          order_id: input.order_id,
        },
      });
      expect(result.code).toBe(100);
      expect(result.authority).toBeDefined();
    });
    it('should handle payment request with minimal required fields', async () => {
      const input: ZarinPalPaymentRequestInput = {
        amount: 50000,
        callback_url: 'https://example.com/callback',
        description: 'Order #123',
        order_id: 'order-456',
      };
      paymentService.requestPayment.mockResolvedValue({
        data: {
          code: 100,
          message: 'Success',
          authority: 'A00000000000000000000000000000000000000',
        },
      } as never);
      orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue({
        ...createPendingOrder(input.order_id!, input.amount),
      } as never);
      orderService.setPaymentIntent.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
      const result = await resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(input);
      expect(paymentService.requestPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        amount: input.amount,
        callback_url: input.callback_url,
        description: input.description,
        currency: 'IRT', // Default currency
        metadata: {
          mobile: undefined,
          email: undefined,
          order_id: input.order_id,
        },
      });
      expect(result.code).toBe(100);
    });
    it('should use IRR currency when specified', async () => {
      const input: ZarinPalPaymentRequestInput = {
        amount: 5000000,
        callback_url: 'https://example.com/callback',
        description: 'Order #123',
        currency: 'IRR',
        order_id: 'order-789',
      };
      paymentService.requestPayment.mockResolvedValue({
        data: {
          code: 100,
          message: 'Success',
          authority: 'A00000000000000000000000000000000000000',
        },
      } as never);
      orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue({
        ...createPendingOrder(input.order_id!, input.amount, 'IRR'),
      } as never);
      orderService.setPaymentIntent.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
      await resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(input);
      expect(paymentService.requestPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          currency: 'IRR',
        })
      );
    });
  });
  describe('Multi-Seller Batch Payment Flow (requestZarinPalPayment → verifyZarinPalPayment)', () => {
    const authority = 'A00000000000000000000000000000000000000';
    const createBatchOrder = (
      orderId: string,
      totalUsd: number,
      customerEmail: string,
      status: OrderStatus = OrderStatus.PENDING,
      items: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [
        {
          id: `item-${orderId}`,
          productId: `product-${orderId}`,
          sellerProductId: `seller-product-${orderId}`,
          quantity: 1,
          sellerProduct: { id: `seller-product-${orderId}`, stockQuantity: 10 },
        },
      ]
    ) => ({
      id: orderId,
      status,
      total: totalUsd, // USD
      paymentAuthority: authority,
      paymentAmount: totalUsd * 1000, // IRT
      paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
      customerEmail,
      items,
      orderNumber: `ORD-${orderId}`,
    });
    const basePaymentInput: ZarinPalPaymentRequestInput = {
      amount: 100000, // 100 USD * 1000 = 100000 IRT
      callback_url: 'https://example.com/payment/callback',
      description: 'Batch Payment for Multiple Orders',
      currency: 'IRT',
      mobile: '09123456789',
      email: 'buyer@example.com',
      orderIds: ['order-1', 'order-2'],
    };
    beforeEach(() => {
      mockCurrencyService.getCurrentExchangeRate.mockResolvedValue({ rate: 1000 });
    });
    it('should request and verify batch payment for orders with same customer email (case-insensitive)', async () => {
      const order1 = createBatchOrder('order-1', 60, 'Buyer@Example.com');
      const order2 = createBatchOrder('order-2', 40, 'buyer@example.com');
      // Step 1: Request batch payment
      orderService.findOne
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(order1 as never)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(order2 as never);
      orderService.setPaymentIntent.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
      paymentService.requestPayment.mockResolvedValue({
        data: {
          code: 100,
          message: 'Success',
          authority,
          fee_type: 'Merchant',
          fee: 0,
        },
        errors: [],
      } as never);
      const requestResult = await resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(basePaymentInput);
      expect(requestResult.code).toBe(100);
      expect(requestResult.authority).toBe(authority);
      // setPaymentIntent should be called for BOTH orders with expectedBatchAmount
      expect(orderService.setPaymentIntent).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
      expect(orderService.setPaymentIntent).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          orderId: 'order-1',
          authority,
          amount: 100000, // (60 + 40) * 1000 = 100000 IRT
        })
      );
      expect(orderService.setPaymentIntent).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          orderId: 'order-2',
          authority,
          amount: 100000,
        })
      );
      // Step 2: Verify batch payment (successful)
      const verificationInput: ZarinPalVerificationRequestInput = {
        amount: 100000,
        authority,
        // order_id not provided - should find by authority
      };
      paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
        data: {
          code: 100,
          message: 'Payment verified',
          ref_id: 999888,
          card_pan: '1234-****-****-5678',
          fee_type: 'Merchant',
          fee: 0,
        },
        errors: [],
      } as never);
      orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1, order2] as never);
      orderService.setPaymentIntent.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
      orderService.confirmOrderPayment
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ ...order1, status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED } as never)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ ...order2, status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED } as never);
      const verifyResult = await resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(verificationInput);
      // verifyPayment is called with firstOrder.paymentAmount (order-1's individual amount: 60 * 1000 = 60000)
      expect(paymentService.verifyPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        amount: 60000,
        authority,
      });
      // Both orders confirmed in deterministic id ASC order
      expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
      expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(1, 'order-1');
      expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(2, 'order-2');
      expect(verifyResult.code).toBe(100);
      expect(verifyResult.ref_id).toBe(999888);
      expect(verifyResult.success).toBe(true);
      expect(verifyResult.orderIds).toEqual(['order-1', 'order-2']);
      expect(verifyResult.orderId).toBe('order-1');
      expect(verifyResult.orderNumber).toContain('order-1');
      expect(verifyResult.orderNumber).toContain('order-2');
    });
    it('should reject batch payment when orderIds belong to different customer emails', async () => {
      const order1 = createBatchOrder('order-1', 60, 'buyer1@example.com');
      const order2 = createBatchOrder('order-2', 40, 'buyer2@example.com');
      orderService.findOne
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(order1 as never)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(order2 as never);
      await expect(resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(basePaymentInput)).rejects.toThrow(
        'All orders in a batch must belong to the same customer'
      );
      expect(orderService.setPaymentIntent).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(paymentService.requestPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('should reject batch payment when one order is missing', async () => {
      const order1 = createBatchOrder('order-1', 60, 'buyer@example.com');
      // order-2 is missing (returns null)
      orderService.findOne
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(order1 as never)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(null as never);
      await expect(resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(basePaymentInput)).rejects.toThrow(
        'Order(s) not found: order-2'
      );
      expect(orderService.setPaymentIntent).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(paymentService.requestPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('should reject batch payment when one order is not PENDING', async () => {
      const order1 = createBatchOrder('order-1', 60, 'buyer@example.com');
      const order2 = createBatchOrder('order-2', 40, 'buyer@example.com', OrderStatus.CONFIRMED);
      orderService.findOne
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(order1 as never)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(order2 as never);
      await expect(resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(basePaymentInput)).rejects.toThrow(
        "Order(s) order-2 are not in PENDING status and cannot be paid"
      );
      expect(orderService.setPaymentIntent).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(paymentService.requestPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('should reject batch payment when client amount deviates beyond tolerance', async () => {
      const order1 = createBatchOrder('order-1', 60, 'buyer@example.com');
      const order2 = createBatchOrder('order-2', 40, 'buyer@example.com');
      orderService.findOne
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(order1 as never)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(order2 as never);
      orderService.setPaymentIntent.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
      // Expected: (60 + 40) * 1000 = 100000 IRT
      // Tolerance: max(10, 2 * 2) = 10 Tomans
      // Client sends 100050 (diff = 50 > 10) - should reject
      const badInput: ZarinPalPaymentRequestInput = {
        ...basePaymentInput,
        amount: 100050,
      };
      await expect(resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(badInput)).rejects.toThrow(
        'Payment amount does not match batch order total'
      );
      expect(paymentService.requestPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('should accept batch payment when client amount is within tolerance', async () => {
      const order1 = createBatchOrder('order-1', 60, 'buyer@example.com');
      const order2 = createBatchOrder('order-2', 40, 'buyer@example.com');
      orderService.findOne
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(order1 as never)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(order2 as never);
      orderService.setPaymentIntent.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
      // Expected: 100000, Tolerance: 10
      // Client sends 100005 (diff = 5 <= 10) - should accept
      const goodInput: ZarinPalPaymentRequestInput = {
        ...basePaymentInput,
        amount: 100005,
      };
      paymentService.requestPayment.mockResolvedValue({
        data: {
          code: 100,
          message: 'Success',
          authority,
          fee_type: 'Merchant',
          fee: 0,
        },
        errors: [],
      } as never);
      const requestResult = await resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(goodInput);
      expect(requestResult.code).toBe(100);
      expect(paymentService.requestPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          amount: 100000, // Server uses server-computed amount
        })
      );
    });
  });
  describe('FX Rate Fail-Closed Integration', () => {
    const singleOrderInput: ZarinPalPaymentRequestInput = {
      amount: 100000,
      callback_url: 'https://example.com/callback',
      description: 'Single Order Payment',
      currency: 'IRT',
      order_id: 'order-single',

      paymentAmount: totalUsd * 1000,
      paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
      customerEmail: 'buyer@example.com',
      items: [],
    });
    beforeEach(() => {

        createPendingOrder(singleOrderInput.order_id!, 100) as never
      );
      orderService.setPaymentIntent.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
    });
    it('should reject requestZarinPalPayment when getCurrentExchangeRate returns rate: 0', async () => {

    });

      await expect(resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(singleOrderInput)).rejects.toThrow(
        'Exchange rate is not configured or invalid. Cannot process ZarinPal payment.'

      await expect(resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(singleOrderInput)).rejects.toThrow(
        'Exchange rate is not configured or invalid. Cannot process ZarinPal payment.'
      );

      await expect(resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(singleOrderInput)).rejects.toThrow(
        'Exchange rate is not configured or invalid. Cannot process ZarinPal payment.'
      );

  describe('High7 Fail-Closed + Sibling Rollback Integration', () => {
    const authority = 'A00000000000000000000000000000000000000';
    const createOrderForRollback = (
      orderId: string,
      totalUsd: number,
      sellerProductId: string,
      stockQuantity: number
    ) => ({
      id: orderId,
      status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
      total: totalUsd,
      paymentAuthority: authority,
      paymentAmount: totalUsd * 1000,
      paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
      customerEmail: 'buyer@example.com',
      items: [
        {
          id: `item-${orderId}`,
          productId: `product-${orderId}`,
          sellerProductId,
          quantity: 1,
          sellerProduct: { id: sellerProductId, stockQuantity },
        },
      ],
      orderNumber: `ORD-${orderId}`,
    });
    const verificationInput: ZarinPalVerificationRequestInput = {
      amount: 100000,
      authority,
      // order_id not provided
    };
    beforeEach(() => {
      mockCurrencyService.getCurrentExchangeRate.mockResolvedValue({ rate: 1000 });
    });
    it('should reject verification during pre-verify stock check when sibling order has insufficient stock', async () => {
      const order1 = createOrderForRollback('order-1', 60, 'sp-1', 10);
      const order2 = createOrderForRollback('order-2', 40, 'sp-2', 0); // Out of stock
      // Find orders by authority returns both orders
      orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1, order2] as never);
      orderService.setPaymentIntent.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
      // Payment verification would succeed (code 100) but pre-verify stock check fails first
      paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
        data: {
          code: 100,
          message: 'Payment verified',
          ref_id: 999888,
          card_pan: '1234-****-****-5678',
          fee_type: 'Merchant',
          fee: 0,
        },
        errors: [],
      } as never);
      // Should throw BadRequestException during pre-verify stock check
      await expect(resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(verificationInput)).rejects.toThrow(
        'Insufficient stock for product sp-2: required 1, available 0'
      );
      // verifyPayment should NOT be called because pre-verify stock check fails first
      expect(paymentService.verifyPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(orderService.updateOrderStatus).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('should roll back order-1 when order-2 confirmation fails with insufficient stock (stock available during pre-check but fails at confirmation)', async () => {
      const order1 = createOrderForRollback('order-1', 60, 'sp-1', 10);
      const order2 = createOrderForRollback('order-2', 40, 'sp-2', 10); // Stock available during pre-check
      // Find orders by authority returns both orders
      orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1, order2] as never);
      orderService.setPaymentIntent.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
      // Payment verification succeeds (code 100)
      paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
        data: {
          code: 100,
          message: 'Payment verified',
          ref_id: 999888,
          card_pan: '1234-****-****-5678',
          fee_type: 'Merchant',
          fee: 0,
        },
        errors: [],
      } as never);
      // order-1 confirms successfully, order-2 fails with insufficient stock at confirmation time
      orderService.confirmOrderPayment
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ ...order1, status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED } as never)
        .mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('Insufficient stock for product sp-2'));
      // Rollback via updateOrderStatus for order-1
      orderService.updateOrderStatus.mockResolvedValue({ ...order1, status: OrderStatus.CANCELLED } as never);
      const verifyResult = await resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(verificationInput);
      // Payment was captured but order confirmation failed for order-2
      expect(verifyResult.code).toBe(100);
      expect(verifyResult.ref_id).toBe(999888);
      expect(verifyResult.success).toBe(false);
      expect(verifyResult.message).toContain('Insufficient stock');
      // order-1 was confirmed then rolled back
      expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
      expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(1, 'order-1');
      expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(2, 'order-2');
      // Rollback called for order-1
      expect(orderService.updateOrderStatus).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1', OrderStatus.CANCELLED);
      // Response includes all order info
      expect(verifyResult.orderIds).toEqual(['order-1', 'order-2']);
      expect(verifyResult.orderId).toBe('order-1');
    });
  });
  describe('Code 101 Idempotency Integration', () => {
    const authority = 'A00000000000000000000000000000000000000';
    const createConfirmedOrder = (orderId: string, totalUsd: number, stockReserved = true) => ({
      id: orderId,
      status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED,
      total: totalUsd,
      paymentAuthority: authority,
      paymentAmount: totalUsd * 1000,
      paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
      customerEmail: 'buyer@example.com',
      stockReserved,
      items: [],
      orderNumber: `ORD-${orderId}`,
    });
    const createPendingOrder = (orderId: string, totalUsd: number) => ({
      id: orderId,
      status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
      total: totalUsd,
      paymentAuthority: authority,
      paymentAmount: totalUsd * 1000,
      paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
      customerEmail: 'buyer@example.com',
      items: [
        {
          id: `item-${orderId}`,
          productId: `product-${orderId}`,
          sellerProductId: `seller-product-${orderId}`,
          quantity: 1,
          sellerProduct: { id: `seller-product-${orderId}`, stockQuantity: 10 },
        },
      ],
      orderNumber: `ORD-${orderId}`,
    });
    const verificationInput: ZarinPalVerificationRequestInput = {
      amount: 100000,
      authority,
    };
    beforeEach(() => {
      mockCurrencyService.getCurrentExchangeRate.mockResolvedValue({ rate: 1000 });
    });
    it('should return success: true without calling confirmOrderPayment when all orders already CONFIRMED with stockReserved', async () => {
      const order1 = createConfirmedOrder('order-1', 60, true);
      const order2 = createConfirmedOrder('order-2', 40, true);
      orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1, order2] as never);
      paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
        data: {
          code: 101,
          message: 'Payment already verified',
          ref_id: 999888,
        },
        errors: [],
      } as never);
      const verifyResult = await resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(verificationInput);
      // confirmOrderPayment should NOT be called
      expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(verifyResult.code).toBe(101);
      expect(verifyResult.success).toBe(true);
      expect(verifyResult.ref_id).toBe(999888);
      expect(verifyResult.orderIds).toEqual(['order-1', 'order-2']);
    });
    it('should call confirmOrderPayment ONLY for PENDING order when mixed CONFIRMED and PENDING with code 101', async () => {
      const order1 = createConfirmedOrder('order-1', 60, true); // Already confirmed
      const order2 = createPendingOrder('order-2', 40); // Still pending
      orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1, order2] as never);
      orderService.setPaymentIntent.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
      orderService.confirmOrderPayment.mockResolvedValue({ ...order2, status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED } as never);
      paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
        data: {
          code: 101,
          message: 'Payment already verified',
          ref_id: 999888,
        },
        errors: [],
      } as never);
      const verifyResult = await resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(verificationInput);
      // confirmOrderPayment should be called ONLY for order-2
      expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-2');
      expect(verifyResult.code).toBe(101);
      expect(verifyResult.success).toBe(true);
      expect(verifyResult.ref_id).toBe(999888);
      expect(verifyResult.orderIds).toEqual(['order-1', 'order-2']);
    });
  });
  describe('Guest & Authenticated cancelPendingZarinPalOrder Integration', () => {
    const authority = 'A00000000000000000000000000000000000000';
    const createOrder = (
      orderId: string,
      status: OrderStatus = OrderStatus.PENDING,
      paymentAuthority: string = authority
    ) => ({
      id: orderId,
      status,
      total: 100,
      paymentAuthority,
      paymentAmount: 100000,
      paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
      customerEmail: 'buyer@example.com',
      items: [],
      orderNumber: `ORD-${orderId}`,
    });
    beforeEach(() => {
      mockCurrencyService.getCurrentExchangeRate.mockResolvedValue({ rate: 1000 });
    });
    it('should cancel all PENDING sibling orders matching authority when Status=NOK', async () => {
      const order1 = createOrder('order-1');
      const order2 = createOrder('order-2');
      // order3 is not included - only PENDING orders should be in the matched list for cancellation
      orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1, order2] as never);
      orderService.cancelPendingOrder
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ ...order1, status: OrderStatus.CANCELLED } as never)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({ ...order2, status: OrderStatus.CANCELLED } as never);
      const result = await resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(undefined, authority);
      expect(result).toBe(true);
      expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
      expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(1, 'order-1');
      expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(2, 'order-2');
    });
    it('should be idempotent for already-CANCELLED orders', async () => {
      const order1 = createOrder('order-1', OrderStatus.CANCELLED);
      const order2 = createOrder('order-2', OrderStatus.CANCELLED);
      orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1, order2] as never);
      const result = await resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(undefined, authority);
      expect(result).toBe(true);
      expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('should throw BadRequestException when authority is empty string', async () => {
      await expect(resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(undefined, '')).rejects.toThrow(
        BadRequestException
      );
      await expect(resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(undefined, '   ')).rejects.toThrow(
        BadRequestException
      );
    });
    it('should throw BadRequestException when orderId has different paymentAuthority', async () => {
      const orderByAuthority = createOrder('order-1', OrderStatus.PENDING, authority);
      const orderById = createOrder('order-2', OrderStatus.PENDING, 'DIFFERENT_AUTHORITY');
      orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([orderByAuthority] as never);
      orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(orderById as never);
      await expect(
        resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder('order-2', authority)
      ).rejects.toThrow('Order does not match the provided payment authority');
    });
    it('should throw BadRequestException when order is already CONFIRMED', async () => {
      const order1 = createOrder('order-1', OrderStatus.CONFIRMED);
      orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1] as never);
      await expect(
        resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(undefined, authority)
      ).rejects.toThrow(
        `Cannot cancel order order-1 with status ${OrderStatus.CONFIRMED}. Only PENDING orders can be cancelled.`
      );
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/product-validation.spec.ts">
import { BadRequestException, PipeTransform } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ROUTE_ARGS_METADATA } from '@nestjs/common/constants';
import { ProductResolver } from './product.resolver';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from './zod-validation.pipe';
type ParamMeta = { index: number; pipes?: PipeTransform[] };
function zodPipe(method: string, argIndex: number): PipeTransform {
  const raw = (Reflect.getMetadata(ROUTE_ARGS_METADATA, ProductResolver, method) ?? {}) as Record<
    string,
    ParamMeta
  >;
  const param = Object.values(raw).find((p) => p.index === argIndex);
  const pipe = param?.pipes?.find((p) => p instanceof ZodValidationPipe);
  if (!pipe) throw new Error(`no ZodValidationPipe on ${method} arg ${argIndex}`);
  return pipe;
}
const run = (method: string, value: unknown) => zodPipe(method, 0).transform(value, { type: 'body' });
describe('ProductResolver argument validation', () => {
  const variant = { size: '42', colorIds: [1], weight: 0.8 };
  const product = { name: 'Air Max', sku: 'AM-1', categoryIds: [2], variants: [variant] };
  it('validates createProduct and updateProduct inputs', () => {
    expect(() => run('createProduct', product)).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => run('createProduct', { ...product, name: '' })).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    expect(() => run('updateProduct', { ...product, id: 1 })).not.toThrow();
    expect(() =>
      run('updateProduct', { ...product, id: 1, variants: [{ ...variant, weight: -1 }] })
    ).toThrow(BadRequestException);
  });
  it('validates createProductInfo input', () => {
    expect(() =>
      run('createProductInfo', { productId: 1, size: '42', sizeKind: 'FOOTWEAR', colorIds: [1], weight: 1 })
    ).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => run('createProductInfo', { productId: 1 })).toThrow(BadRequestException);
  });
});

import { ProductResolver } from './product.resolver';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import { FileUpload } from './product.resolver';
import { Readable } from 'stream';
jest.mock('fs');
jest.mock('@kickzone-workspace/services');
interface MockWriteStream {
  on: jest.Mock;
  once: jest.Mock;
  removeListener: jest.Mock;
  emit: jest.Mock;
  end: jest.Mock;
  write: jest.Mock;
}
interface MockSellerService {
  [key: string]: unknown;
}
describe('ProductResolver', () => {
  let resolver: ProductResolver;
  let mockProductService: {
    addImagesToProductInfo: jest.Mock;
    removeImageFromProductInfo: jest.Mock;
  };
  let mockSellerService: MockSellerService;
  const uploadDir = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'uploads', 'products');
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
    mockProductService = {
      addImagesToProductInfo: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
      removeImageFromProductInfo: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
    };
    mockSellerService = {};
    resolver = new ProductResolver(
      mockProductService as never,
      mockSellerService as never
    );
    (fs.existsSync as jest.Mock).mockReturnValue(true);
    (fs.mkdirSync as jest.Mock).mockImplementation(jest.fn());
    (fs.unlinkSync as jest.Mock).mockImplementation(jest.fn());
    (fs.createWriteStream as jest.Mock).mockImplementation((): MockWriteStream => {
      const mockWriteStream: MockWriteStream = {
        on: jest.fn((_event: string, cb: () => void) => {
          if (_event === 'finish') {
            setImmediate(cb);
          }
          return mockWriteStream;
        }),
        once: jest.fn((_event: string, cb: () => void) => {
          if (_event === 'finish') {
            setImmediate(cb);
          }
          return mockWriteStream;
        }),
        removeListener: jest.fn((_arg: unknown) => {
          return mockWriteStream;
        }),
        emit: jest.fn((_arg: unknown) => {
          return true;
        }),
        end: jest.fn(),
        write: jest.fn(),
      };
      return mockWriteStream;
    });
  });
  describe('uploadProductInfoImages', () => {
    const createMockFile = (filename: string): Promise<FileUpload> => {
      const readable = new Readable({
        read() {
          this.push(null);
        },
      });
      return Promise.resolve({
        filename,
        mimetype: 'image/jpeg',
        encoding: '7bit',
        createReadStream: () => readable,
      });
    };
    it('sanitizes traversal filename like "../../evil.js" to safe basename and writes inside uploadDir', async () => {
      const files = [createMockFile('../../evil.js')];
      const result = await resolver.uploadProductInfoImages(1, files);
      expect(result).toHaveLength(1);
      const savedPath = (fs.createWriteStream as jest.Mock).mock.calls[0][0];
      expect(savedPath).toContain('uploads' + path.sep + 'products' + path.sep);
      expect(savedPath).not.toContain('..');
      expect(result[0]).toMatch(/\/uploads\/products\/\d+-evil\.js$/);
      expect(result[0].split('/uploads/products/')[1]).not.toContain('/');
    });
    it('sanitizes traversal filename with backslashes like "..\\..\\x" to safe basename and writes inside uploadDir', async () => {
      const files = [createMockFile('..\\..\\x')];
      const result = await resolver.uploadProductInfoImages(1, files);
      expect(result).toHaveLength(1);
      const savedPath = (fs.createWriteStream as jest.Mock).mock.calls[0][0];
      expect(savedPath).toContain('uploads' + path.sep + 'products' + path.sep);
      expect(savedPath).not.toContain('..');
      expect(result[0]).toMatch(/\/uploads\/products\/\d+-x$/);
      expect(result[0].split('/uploads/products/')[1]).not.toContain('/');
    });
    it('sanitizes special characters in filename', async () => {
      const files = [createMockFile('my file@#$.jpg')];
      const result = await resolver.uploadProductInfoImages(1, files);
      expect(result).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(result[0]).toMatch(/\/uploads\/products\/\d+-my_file___\.jpg$/);
    });
    it('falls back to "file" for empty or only-dots filename', async () => {
      const files = [createMockFile('...')];
      const result = await resolver.uploadProductInfoImages(1, files);
      expect(result).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(result[0]).toMatch(/\/uploads\/products\/\d+-file$/);
    });
    it('returns URL with no path traversal after /uploads/products/', async () => {
      const files = [createMockFile('normal.jpg')];
      const result = await resolver.uploadProductInfoImages(1, files);
      expect(result).toHaveLength(1);
      const urlPart = result[0].split('/uploads/products/')[1];
      expect(urlPart).not.toContain('/');
      expect(urlPart).not.toContain('..');
    });
  });
  describe('removeProductInfoImage', () => {
    it('rejects traversal imageName like "../../etc/passwd" and does not call unlinkSync or removeImageFromProductInfo', async () => {
      const result = await resolver.removeProductInfoImage(1, '../../etc/passwd');
      expect(result).toBe(false);
      expect(fs.unlinkSync).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(mockProductService.removeImageFromProductInfo).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('rejects traversal imageName with backslashes like "..\\..\\x" and does not call unlinkSync or removeImageFromProductInfo', async () => {
      const result = await resolver.removeProductInfoImage(1, '..\\..\\x');
      expect(result).toBe(false);
      expect(fs.unlinkSync).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(mockProductService.removeImageFromProductInfo).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('rejects empty imageName', async () => {
      const result = await resolver.removeProductInfoImage(1, '');
      expect(result).toBe(false);
      expect(fs.unlinkSync).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(mockProductService.removeImageFromProductInfo).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('rejects "." as imageName', async () => {
      const result = await resolver.removeProductInfoImage(1, '.');
      expect(result).toBe(false);
      expect(fs.unlinkSync).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(mockProductService.removeImageFromProductInfo).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('rejects ".." as imageName', async () => {
      const result = await resolver.removeProductInfoImage(1, '..');
      expect(result).toBe(false);
      expect(fs.unlinkSync).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(mockProductService.removeImageFromProductInfo).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('rejects imageName that differs from basename (contains path separators)', async () => {
      const result = await resolver.removeProductInfoImage(1, 'subdir/file.jpg');
      expect(result).toBe(false);
      expect(fs.unlinkSync).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(mockProductService.removeImageFromProductInfo).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('unlinks file inside uploads/products and calls removeImageFromProductInfo with correct URL for normal name', async () => {
      const result = await resolver.removeProductInfoImage(1, 'a.jpg');
      expect(result).toBe(true);
      expect(fs.unlinkSync).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        path.resolve(uploadDir, 'a.jpg')
      );
      expect(mockProductService.removeImageFromProductInfo).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        1,
        '/uploads/products/a.jpg'
      );
    });
    it('returns false and does not call service if fs.unlinkSync throws', async () => {
      (fs.unlinkSync as jest.Mock).mockImplementationOnce(() => {
        throw new Error('EACCES');
      });
      const result = await resolver.removeProductInfoImage(1, 'a.jpg');
      expect(result).toBe(false);
      expect(mockProductService.removeImageFromProductInfo).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('returns false and does not call service if removeImageFromProductInfo throws', async () => {
      mockProductService.removeImageFromProductInfo.mockRejectedValueOnce(
        new Error('DB error')
      );
      const result = await resolver.removeProductInfoImage(1, 'a.jpg');
      expect(result).toBe(false);
      expect(fs.unlinkSync).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        path.resolve(uploadDir, 'a.jpg')
      );
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/query-args-validation.spec.ts">
import { BadRequestException, PipeTransform, Type } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ROUTE_ARGS_METADATA } from '@nestjs/common/constants';
import { OrderResolver } from './order.resolver';
import { ProductResolver } from './product.resolver';
import { SellerResolver } from './seller-info.resolver';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from './zod-validation.pipe';
type ParamMeta = { index: number; pipes?: PipeTransform[] };
function zodPipe(cls: Type<unknown>, method: string, argIndex: number): PipeTransform {
  const raw = (Reflect.getMetadata(ROUTE_ARGS_METADATA, cls, method) ?? {}) as Record<string, ParamMeta>;
  const param = Object.values(raw).find((p) => p.index === argIndex);
  const pipe = param?.pipes?.find((p) => p instanceof ZodValidationPipe);
  if (!pipe) throw new Error(`no ZodValidationPipe on ${method} arg ${argIndex}`);
  return pipe;
}
const run = (cls: Type<unknown>, method: string, index: number, value: unknown) =>
  zodPipe(cls, method, index).transform(value, { type: 'body' });
describe('pagination, id and filter argument validation', () => {
  it.each([
    ['orders', 1, 2],
    ['myOrders', 1, 2],
    ['mySellerOrders', 1, 2],
    ['adminSellerOrders', 2, 3],
    ['allSellerOrders', 1, 2],
  ])('OrderResolver.%s bounds first/after', (method, firstIdx, afterIdx) => {
    expect(() => run(OrderResolver, method, firstIdx, 10)).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => run(OrderResolver, method, firstIdx, 0)).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    expect(() => run(OrderResolver, method, firstIdx, 1000)).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    expect(() => run(OrderResolver, method, afterIdx, undefined)).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => run(OrderResolver, method, afterIdx, 'x'.repeat(501))).toThrow(BadRequestException);
  });
  it('validates order ids, seller ids and tracking numbers', () => {
    expect(() => run(OrderResolver, 'order', 1, 'order-1')).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => run(OrderResolver, 'order', 1, ' ')).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    expect(() => run(OrderResolver, 'orders', 3, undefined)).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => run(OrderResolver, 'adminSellerOrders', 1, '')).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    expect(() => run(OrderResolver, 'updateOrderTracking', 1, 'order-1')).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => run(OrderResolver, 'updateOrderTracking', 2, 'TRK123')).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => run(OrderResolver, 'updateOrderTracking', 2, 'x'.repeat(101))).toThrow(BadRequestException);
  });
  it('validates product and seller filters', () => {
    const many = Array.from({ length: 101 }, (_, i) => i);
    expect(() => run(ProductResolver, 'products', 0, undefined)).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => run(ProductResolver, 'products', 0, { first: 200, onlyInStock: true })).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => run(ProductResolver, 'products', 0, { ids: many })).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    expect(() => run(ProductResolver, 'sellerProductsForMe', 1, { first: 500 })).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    expect(() => run(SellerResolver, 'sellers', 1, { ids: [1, 2] })).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => run(SellerResolver, 'sellers', 1, { ids: many })).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    expect(() => run(SellerResolver, 'sellers', 2, 100)).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => run(SellerResolver, 'sellerProductsForMe', 1, { sortOrder: 'up' })).toThrow(BadRequestException);
  });
});

import { BadRequestException, PipeTransform } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ROUTE_ARGS_METADATA } from '@nestjs/common/constants';
import { SellerResolver } from './seller-info.resolver';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from './zod-validation.pipe';
type ParamMeta = { index: number; pipes?: PipeTransform[] };
function zodPipe(method: string, argIndex: number): PipeTransform {
  const raw = (Reflect.getMetadata(ROUTE_ARGS_METADATA, SellerResolver, method) ?? {}) as Record<
    string,
    ParamMeta
  >;
  const param = Object.values(raw).find((p) => p.index === argIndex);
  const pipe = param?.pipes?.find((p) => p instanceof ZodValidationPipe);
  if (!pipe) throw new Error(`no ZodValidationPipe on ${method} arg ${argIndex}`);
  return pipe;
}
const run = (method: string, index: number, value: unknown) =>
  zodPipe(method, index).transform(value, { type: 'body' });
describe('SellerResolver argument validation', () => {
  const product = { productInfoId: 3, price: 150, costPrice: 100, discount: 10, stockQuantity: 2 };
  it('validates seller create/update inputs', () => {
    expect(() =>
      run('createSeller', 0, {
        name: 'A', lastName: 'B', username: 'ab', email: 'a@b.co', password: 'x', storeName: 'S',
      })
    ).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => run('createSeller', 0, { name: 'A' })).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    expect(() => run('updateSeller', 0, { id: 1, email: 'bad' })).toThrow(BadRequestException);
  });
  it.each([
    ['createSellerProduct', 1],
    ['createMySellerProduct', 1],
  ])('%s validates the product input', (method, index) => {

    expect(() => run(method, index, { ...product, discount: 150 })).toThrow(BadRequestException);
  });
  it.each([
    ['updateSellerProduct', 1],
    ['updateMySellerProduct', 1],
  ])('%s validates the product update', (method, index) => {
    expect(() => run(method, index, { id: 'sp1', price: 10 })).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => run(method, index, { id: 'sp1', stockQuantity: -1 })).toThrow(BadRequestException);
