            position: 0,
            color: mockColors[1],
            productInfo: null as unknown as ProductInfo,
          } as ProductInfoColor,
        ],
        colors: [mockColors[1]],
      };
      productInfoRepo.create.mockReturnValue(adminCreatedVariant);
      productInfoRepo.save.mockResolvedValue(adminCreatedVariant);
      productRepo.save.mockResolvedValue(productOwnedBySeller);
      const refreshedProduct: Product = {
        ...productOwnedBySeller,
        productInfos: [adminCreatedVariant],
      };
      productRepo.findOne.mockImplementation(
        async (options?: FindOneOptions<Product>) => {
          const relations = options?.relations as string[] | undefined;
          const where = options?.where as { id?: number } | undefined;
          if (relations?.includes('descriptions')) {
            return refreshedProduct;
          }
          if (where?.id === 300) {
            return productOwnedBySeller;
          }
          return null;
        }
      );
      const updateInput: UpdateProductInput = {
        id: 300,
        name: 'SAINTBALA Oversized Tee',
        sku: 'SB-TEE-01',
        categoryIds: [],
        variants: [
          {
            size: 'XL',
            sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
            colorIds: [2],
            weight: 300,
            images: ['https://cdn.saintbala.com/tee-xl.jpg'],
          },
        ],
      };
      const result = await service.updateProduct(updateInput, adminUser);
      // Verify admin update succeeded and variant persisted with generated ID
      expect(result.productInfos).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(result.productInfos[0].id).toBe(701);
      expect(result.productInfos[0].size).toBe('XL');
      expect(result.productInfos[0].colors).toContainEqual(mockColors[1]);
      expect(productInfoRepo.create).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          size: 'XL',
          weight: 300,
        })
      );
      expect(productInfoRepo.save).toHaveBeenCalledWith(adminCreatedVariant);
    });
    it('rejects with 400 Bad Request when submitting an invalid variant and does not persist', async () => {
      const adminUser = {
        id: 1,
        role: UserRole.ADMIN,
        username: 'admin',
      } as unknown as User;
      const targetProduct: Product = {
        id: 400,
        name: 'SAINTBALA Track Pants',
        sku: 'SB-TRACK-01',
        categories: [],
        productInfos: [],
        sellerProducts: [],
        archived: false,
      } as unknown as Product;
      productRepo.findOne.mockImplementation(
        async (options?: FindOneOptions<Product>) => {
          const where = options?.where as { id?: number } | undefined;
          if (where?.id === 400) {
            return targetProduct;
          }
          return null;
        }
      );
      // 1. Negative stock quantity
      const negativeStockInput: UpdateProductInput = {
        id: 400,
        name: 'SAINTBALA Track Pants',
        sku: 'SB-TRACK-01',
        categoryIds: [],
        variants: [
          {
            size: 'M',
            sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
            colorIds: [1],
            weight: 400,
            stockQuantity: -5,
          },
        ],
      };
      await expect(
        service.updateProduct(negativeStockInput, adminUser)
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
      await expect(
        service.updateProduct(negativeStockInput, adminUser)
      ).rejects.toThrow('Stock quantity cannot be negative.');
      // 2. Missing colors
      const missingColorsInput: UpdateProductInput = {
        id: 400,
        name: 'SAINTBALA Track Pants',
        sku: 'SB-TRACK-01',
        categoryIds: [],
        variants: [
          {
            size: 'M',
            sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
            colorIds: [],
            weight: 400,
          },
        ],
      };
      await expect(
        service.updateProduct(missingColorsInput, adminUser)
      ).rejects.toThrow('Variant must have at least one color.');
      // 3. Negative price
      const negativePriceInput: UpdateProductInput = {
        id: 400,
        name: 'SAINTBALA Track Pants',
        sku: 'SB-TRACK-01',
        categoryIds: [],
        variants: [
          {
            size: 'M',
            sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
            colorIds: [1],
            weight: 400,
            price: -50,
          },
        ],
      };
      await expect(
        service.updateProduct(negativePriceInput, adminUser)
      ).rejects.toThrow('Price cannot be negative.');
      // 4. Invalid size
      const invalidSizeInput: UpdateProductInput = {
        id: 400,
        name: 'SAINTBALA Track Pants',
        sku: 'SB-TRACK-01',
        categoryIds: [],
        variants: [
          {
            size: 'NON_EXISTENT_SIZE',
            sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
            colorIds: [1],
            weight: 400,
          },
        ],
      };
      await expect(
        service.updateProduct(invalidSizeInput, adminUser)
      ).rejects.toThrow('Invalid apparel size. Use XS–4XL.');
      // Assert no variant was persisted
      expect(productInfoRepo.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/seller-info.service.ts">
import { Injectable, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import {
  SellerInfo,
  SellerProduct,
  ProductInfo,
  User,
  UserRole,
  ShippingPaymentMode,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import {
  CreateSellerInput,
  UpdateSellerInput,
  CreateSellerProductInput,
  UpdateSellerProductInput,
  SellerFilterInput,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
import * as bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
import { formatProductInfoColorNames } from './product-info-colors.util';
@Injectable()
export class SellerService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(SellerInfo)
    private sellerRepository: Repository<SellerInfo>,
    @InjectRepository(SellerProduct)
    private sellerProductRepository: Repository<SellerProduct>,
    @InjectRepository(ProductInfo)
    private productInfoRepository: Repository<ProductInfo>,
    @InjectRepository(User)
    private userRepository: Repository<User>,
    private authService: AuthService
  ) {}
  private assertValidSellerProductNumbers(values: {
    price?: number;
    costPrice?: number | null;
    discount?: number;
    stockQuantity?: number;
  }): void {
    if (values.price !== undefined) {
      if (!Number.isFinite(values.price) || values.price <= 0) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Price must be a positive number');
      }
    }
    if (values.costPrice !== undefined && values.costPrice !== null) {
      if (!Number.isFinite(values.costPrice) || values.costPrice < 0) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Cost price must be zero or greater');
      }
    }
    if (values.discount !== undefined) {
      if (!Number.isFinite(values.discount) || values.discount < 0 || values.discount > 100) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Discount must be between 0 and 100');
      }
    }
    if (values.stockQuantity !== undefined) {
      if (!Number.isInteger(values.stockQuantity) || values.stockQuantity < 0) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Stock quantity must be a non-negative integer');
      }
    }
  }
  async create(createSellerInput: CreateSellerInput): Promise<SellerInfo> {
    // Check if email already exists
    const existingUser = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: { email: createSellerInput.email },
    });
    if (existingUser) {
      throw new Error('Email already exists');
    }
    // Create user with hashed password
    const hashedPassword = await bcrypt.hash(createSellerInput.password, 10);
    const user = this.userRepository.create({
      name: createSellerInput.name,
      lastName: createSellerInput.lastName,
      username: createSellerInput.username,
      email: createSellerInput.email,
      password: hashedPassword,
      role: UserRole.SELLER,
    });
    await this.userRepository.save(user);
    // Create seller info
    const newSeller = this.sellerRepository.create({
      storeName: createSellerInput.storeName,
      phone: createSellerInput.phone,
      address: createSellerInput.address,
      shippingFee: createSellerInput.shippingFee ?? 0,
      shippingPaymentMode:
        createSellerInput.shippingPaymentMode ??
        ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ON_DELIVERY,
      canManageCatalog: createSellerInput.canManageCatalog ?? false,
      user,
    });
    const savedSeller = await this.sellerRepository.save(newSeller);
    // Initiate password setup
    try {
      const baseUrl =
        process.env['SELLERS_FRONTEND_URL'] || 'https://127.0.0.1:4500';
      await this.authService.initiatePasswordSetup(user.email, baseUrl);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        `Failed to initiate password setup for ${user.email}:`,
        error
      );
    }
    return savedSeller;
  }
  async findAll(filter?: SellerFilterInput): Promise<[SellerInfo[], number]> {
    const query = this.sellerRepository
      .createQueryBuilder('seller')
      .leftJoinAndSelect('seller.user', 'user');
    if (filter?.searchTerm) {
      query.andWhere(
        '(LOWER(user.name) LIKE :searchTerm OR LOWER(seller.storeName) LIKE :searchTerm OR LOWER(user.email) LIKE :searchTerm)',
        { searchTerm: `%${filter.searchTerm.toLowerCase()}%` }
      );
    }
    if (filter?.isActive !== undefined) {
      query.andWhere('seller.isActive = :isActive', {
        isActive: filter.isActive,
      });
    }
    if (filter?.ids && filter.ids.length > 0) {
      query.andWhere('seller.id IN (:...ids)', { ids: filter.ids });
    }
    const totalCount = await query.getCount();
    if (filter?.first) {
      query.take(filter.first);
    }
    if (filter?.after) {
      query.skip(parseInt(filter.after, 10));
    }
    const sellers = await query.getMany();
    return [sellers, totalCount];
  }
  findOne(id: number): Promise<SellerInfo | null> {
    return this.sellerRepository.findOne({
      where: { id },
      relations: ['user'],
    });
  }
  async findOneByUserId(userId: string): Promise<SellerInfo | null> {
    return this.sellerRepository.findOne({
      where: { user: { id: userId } },
      relations: ['user', 'sellerProducts'],
    });
  }
  async update(
    updateSellerInput: UpdateSellerInput
  ): Promise<SellerInfo | null> {
    const seller = await this.findOne(updateSellerInput.id);
    if (!seller) {
      throw new Error('Seller not found');
    }
    // Update user info if provided
    if (
      updateSellerInput.name ||
      updateSellerInput.username ||
      updateSellerInput.email
    ) {
      const user = seller.user;
      if (updateSellerInput.name) user.name = updateSellerInput.name;
      if (updateSellerInput.username)
        user.username = updateSellerInput.username;
      if (updateSellerInput.email) user.email = updateSellerInput.email;
      await this.userRepository.save(user);
    }
    // Update seller info
    if (updateSellerInput.storeName)
      seller.storeName = updateSellerInput.storeName;
    if (updateSellerInput.phone) seller.phone = updateSellerInput.phone;
    if (updateSellerInput.address) seller.address = updateSellerInput.address;
    if (updateSellerInput.shippingFee !== undefined)
      seller.shippingFee = updateSellerInput.shippingFee;
    if (updateSellerInput.shippingPaymentMode !== undefined)
      seller.shippingPaymentMode = updateSellerInput.shippingPaymentMode;
    if (updateSellerInput.isActive !== undefined)
      seller.isActive = updateSellerInput.isActive;
    if (updateSellerInput.canManageCatalog !== undefined)
      seller.canManageCatalog = updateSellerInput.canManageCatalog;
    return this.sellerRepository.save(seller);
  }
  async toggleActive(id: number): Promise<SellerInfo | null> {
    const seller = await this.findOne(id);
    if (!seller) {
      throw new Error('Seller not found');
    }
    seller.isActive = !seller.isActive;
    return this.sellerRepository.save(seller);
  }
  async createSellerProduct(
    sellerId: number,
    input: CreateSellerProductInput,
    allowRecommended = false
  ): Promise<SellerProduct> {
    this.assertValidSellerProductNumbers({
      price: input.price,
      costPrice: input.costPrice,
      discount: input.discount,
      stockQuantity: input.stockQuantity,
    });
    // Load productInfo with product relation
    const productInfo = await this.productInfoRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: input.productInfoId },
      relations: ['product', 'colorLinks', 'colorLinks.color'],
    });
    if (!productInfo) {
      throw new Error('Product variant not found');
    }
    if (!productInfo.product) {
      throw new Error('Product not found for this variant');
    }
    // Load seller
    const seller = await this.sellerRepository.findOneBy({ id: sellerId });
    if (!seller) {
      throw new Error('Seller not found');
    }
    // Check if seller already has a SellerProduct for this ProductInfo (unique constraint)
    const existingSellerProduct = await this.sellerProductRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        seller: { id: sellerId },
        productInfoId: productInfo.id,
      },
    });
    if (existingSellerProduct) {
      throw new Error(
        `You already have a listing for this product variant (${
          productInfo.size
        } - ${
          formatProductInfoColorNames(productInfo.colorLinks) || 'No color'
        }). Please update the existing listing instead.`
      );
    }
    // Create new SellerProduct
    const sellerProduct = this.sellerProductRepository.create({
      seller,
      product: productInfo.product,
      productInfo,
      productInfoId: productInfo.id, // Always use the actual productInfo.id
      price: input.price,
      costPrice: input.costPrice,
      discount: input.discount,
      stockQuantity: input.stockQuantity,
      recommended: allowRecommended ? input.recommended ?? false : false,
      boxLess: input.boxLess ?? false,
    });
    console.log(
      `[SellerService] Creating sellerProduct: sellerId=${sellerId}, productId=${productInfo.product.id}, productInfoId=${productInfo.id}`
    );
    try {
      const saved = await this.sellerProductRepository.save(sellerProduct);
      console.log(
        `[SellerService] ✓ SellerProduct ${saved.id} created with productInfoId=${saved.productInfoId}`
      );
      return saved;
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      // Handle unique constraint violation
      const errorMessage =
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
      const errorCode = (error as { code?: string })?.code;
      if (errorCode === '23505' || errorMessage.includes('unique')) {
        throw new Error(
          `You already have a listing for this product variant. Please update the existing listing instead.`
        );
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }
  async updateSellerProduct(
    sellerId: number,
    input: UpdateSellerProductInput,
    allowRecommended = false
  ): Promise<SellerProduct> {
    const sellerProduct = await this.sellerProductRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: input.id },
      relations: ['seller', 'product', 'productInfo'],
    });
    if (!sellerProduct) throw new Error('Seller product not found');
    if (sellerProduct.seller.id !== sellerId) throw new Error('Unauthorized');
    this.assertValidSellerProductNumbers({
      price: input.price,
      costPrice: input.costPrice,
      discount: input.discount,
      stockQuantity: input.stockQuantity,
    });
    // If productInfoId is being updated, load the productInfo relation
    if (
      input.productInfoId !== undefined &&
      input.productInfoId !== sellerProduct.productInfoId
    ) {
      const productInfo = await this.productInfoRepository.findOne({
        where: { id: input.productInfoId },
        relations: ['product'],
      });
      if (!productInfo) throw new Error('Product variant not found');
      if (!productInfo.product)
        throw new Error('Product not found for this variant');
      console.log(
        `[SellerService] Updating sellerProduct ${sellerProduct.id}: productInfoId ${sellerProduct.productInfoId} -> ${input.productInfoId}`
      );
      // Update both the relation and the ID
      sellerProduct.productInfo = productInfo;
      sellerProduct.productInfoId = productInfo.id; // Use actual productInfo.id to ensure consistency
      sellerProduct.product = productInfo.product; // Ensure product is also updated
    }
    // Update other fields
    if (input.price !== undefined) sellerProduct.price = input.price;
    if (input.costPrice !== undefined)
      sellerProduct.costPrice = input.costPrice;
    if (input.discount !== undefined) sellerProduct.discount = input.discount;
    if (input.stockQuantity !== undefined)
      sellerProduct.stockQuantity = input.stockQuantity;
    if (allowRecommended && input.recommended !== undefined) {
      sellerProduct.recommended = input.recommended;
    }
    if (input.boxLess !== undefined) {
      sellerProduct.boxLess = input.boxLess;
    }
    return this.sellerProductRepository.save(sellerProduct);
  }
  async findSellerProductById(
    sellerProductId: string,
    sellerId: number
  ): Promise<SellerProduct | null> {
    return this.sellerProductRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        id: sellerProductId,
        seller: { id: sellerId },
      },
      relations: [
        'product',
        'productInfo',
        'productInfo.colorLinks',
        'productInfo.colorLinks.color',
        'product.productInfos',
        'product.categories',
      ],
    });
  }
}

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/shipping-calculation.service.ts">
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import {
  PlatformSettings,
  ShippingStrategy,
  ShippingPaymentMode,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
export interface SellerShippingInfo {
  sellerId: string | number;
  shippingFee: number;
  sellerName?: string;
  shippingPaymentMode?: ShippingPaymentMode | string;
}
export interface ShippingCalculationResult {
  totalShippingCost: number;
  shippingBreakdown: Array<{
    sellerId: string | number;
    sellerName?: string;
    originalFee: number;
    appliedFee: number;
  }>;
  freeShippingApplied: boolean;
  strategyUsed: ShippingStrategy;
}
export function applyShippingMethodMultiplier(
  baseFee: number,
  shippingMethod?: string | null
): number {
  const normalized = String(shippingMethod || 'vip').toLowerCase();
  const safeBase = Number.isFinite(Number(baseFee)) && Number(baseFee) > 0 ? Number(baseFee) : 0;
  if (normalized === 'pickup') {
    return 0;
  }
  if (normalized === 'express') {
    return Math.round(safeBase * 0.45 * 100) / 100;
  }
  return Math.round(safeBase * 100) / 100;
}
@Injectable()
export class ShippingCalculationService {
  private defaultSettings: Partial<PlatformSettings> = {
    freeShippingThreshold: 500.0, // Temporarily increased to test shipping fees
    freeShippingEnabled: false, // Temporarily disabled to test shipping fees
    shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.TIERED_DISCOUNT,
    additionalSellerDiscount: 0.5, // 50% discount
    additionalSellerFixedFee: undefined,
    maxShippingCap: 15.0,
    maxShippingCapEnabled: true,
  };
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(PlatformSettings)
    private platformSettingsRepository: Repository<PlatformSettings>
  ) {}
  /**
   * Calculate shipping costs for multi-seller cart
   * Implements smart shipping strategies similar to Amazon/eBay
   * PAY_ON_DELIVERY sellers are excluded from online shipping calculation
   */
  async calculateShippingCost(
    cartSubtotal: number,
    sellerShippingFees: SellerShippingInfo[]
  ): Promise<ShippingCalculationResult> {
    // Get platform settings or use defaults
    const settings = await this.getPlatformSettings();
    // Separate PAY_ON_DELIVERY and PAY_ONLINE sellers
    // Only explicitly PAY_ON_DELIVERY (case-insensitive) are treated as COD; missing/undefined = PAY_ONLINE (legacy behavior)
    const onlineSellers = sellerShippingFees.filter(
      (s) =>
        s.shippingPaymentMode !== undefined &&
        s.shippingPaymentMode !== null &&
        String(s.shippingPaymentMode).toUpperCase() === ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ON_DELIVERY
          ? false
          : true
    );
    // Check for free shipping threshold (applies only to online sellers)
    if (
      settings.freeShippingEnabled &&
      settings.freeShippingThreshold &&
      cartSubtotal >= settings.freeShippingThreshold
    ) {
      return {
        totalShippingCost: 0,
        shippingBreakdown: sellerShippingFees.map((seller) => ({
          sellerId: seller.sellerId,
          sellerName: seller.sellerName,
          originalFee: Number(seller.shippingFee) || 0,
          appliedFee: 0,
        })),
        freeShippingApplied: true,
        strategyUsed: settings.shippingStrategy,
      };
    }
    // Calculate shipping based on strategy for ONLINE sellers only
    let onlineBreakdown: ShippingCalculationResult['shippingBreakdown'] = [];
    let totalShippingCost = 0;
    const computeStrategy = (
      sellers: SellerShippingInfo[]
    ): ShippingCalculationResult['shippingBreakdown'] => {
      switch (settings.shippingStrategy) {
        case ShippingStrategy.FULL_SUM:
          return sellers.map((seller) => ({
            sellerId: seller.sellerId,
            sellerName: seller.sellerName,
            originalFee: Number(seller.shippingFee) || 0,
            appliedFee: Number(seller.shippingFee) || 0,
          }));
        case ShippingStrategy.TIERED_DISCOUNT: {
          return sellers.map((seller, index) => {
            const originalFee = Number(seller.shippingFee) || 0;
            if (index === 0) {
              return {
                sellerId: seller.sellerId,
                sellerName: seller.sellerName,
                originalFee,
                appliedFee: originalFee,
              };
            } else {
              const discount = settings.additionalSellerDiscount || 0;
              const appliedFee = originalFee * (1 - discount);
              return {
                sellerId: seller.sellerId,
                sellerName: seller.sellerName,
                originalFee,
                appliedFee: Math.max(0, Math.round(appliedFee * 100) / 100),
              };
            }
          });
        }
        case ShippingStrategy.TIERED_FIXED: {
          const fixedFee = Number(settings.additionalSellerFixedFee) || 0;
          return sellers.map((seller, index) => {
            const originalFee = Number(seller.shippingFee) || 0;
            if (index === 0) {
              return {
                sellerId: seller.sellerId,
                sellerName: seller.sellerName,
                originalFee,
                appliedFee: originalFee,
              };
            } else {
              return {
                sellerId: seller.sellerId,
                sellerName: seller.sellerName,
                originalFee,
                appliedFee: Math.round(fixedFee * 100) / 100,
              };
            }
          });
        }
        case ShippingStrategy.HIGHEST_ONLY: {
          const fees = sellers.map((s) => Number(s.shippingFee) || 0);
          const highestFee = Math.max(...fees, 0);
          return sellers.map((seller, index) => {
            const originalFee = Number(seller.shippingFee) || 0;
            return {
              sellerId: seller.sellerId,
              sellerName: seller.sellerName,
              originalFee,
              appliedFee: index === 0 ? Math.round(highestFee * 100) / 100 : 0,
            };
          });
        }
        case ShippingStrategy.AVERAGE: {
          const fees = sellers.map((s) => Number(s.shippingFee) || 0);
          const averageFee =
            fees.reduce((sum, fee) => sum + fee, 0) / (fees.length || 1);
          const roundedAverage = Math.round(averageFee * 100) / 100;
          return sellers.map((seller, index) => {
            const originalFee = Number(seller.shippingFee) || 0;
            return {
              sellerId: seller.sellerId,
              sellerName: seller.sellerName,
              originalFee,
              appliedFee: index === 0 ? roundedAverage : 0,
            };
          });
        }
        default:
          return sellers.map((seller) => ({
            sellerId: seller.sellerId,
            sellerName: seller.sellerName,
            originalFee: Number(seller.shippingFee) || 0,
            appliedFee: Number(seller.shippingFee) || 0,
          }));
      }
    };
    if (onlineSellers.length > 0) {
      onlineBreakdown = computeStrategy(onlineSellers);
      totalShippingCost = onlineBreakdown.reduce(
        (sum, item) => sum + item.appliedFee,
        0
      );
    }
    // Apply maximum shipping cap if enabled (only to online sellers)
    if (
      settings.maxShippingCapEnabled &&
      settings.maxShippingCap &&
      totalShippingCost > settings.maxShippingCap
    ) {
      const capRatio = settings.maxShippingCap / totalShippingCost;
      onlineBreakdown = onlineBreakdown.map((item) => ({
        ...item,
        appliedFee: Math.round(item.appliedFee * capRatio * 100) / 100,
      }));
      totalShippingCost = Math.round(settings.maxShippingCap * 100) / 100;
    }
    // Merge COD sellers with 0 fees, preserving original order
    const breakdownMap = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const item of onlineBreakdown) {
      breakdownMap.set(String(item.sellerId), item.appliedFee);
    }
    const finalBreakdown = sellerShippingFees.map((seller) => {
      const isCod =
        seller.shippingPaymentMode !== undefined &&
        seller.shippingPaymentMode !== null &&
        String(seller.shippingPaymentMode).toUpperCase() === ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ON_DELIVERY;
      const originalFee = Number(seller.shippingFee) || 0;
      const appliedFee = isCod ? 0 : breakdownMap.get(String(seller.sellerId)) ?? 0;
      return {
        sellerId: seller.sellerId,
        sellerName: seller.sellerName,
        originalFee: isCod ? 0 : Math.round(originalFee * 100) / 100,
        appliedFee: Math.round(appliedFee * 100) / 100,
      };
    });
    return {
      totalShippingCost: Math.round(totalShippingCost * 100) / 100,
      shippingBreakdown: finalBreakdown,
      freeShippingApplied: false,
      strategyUsed: settings.shippingStrategy,
    };
  }
  /**
   * Get platform settings or return defaults
   */
  private async getPlatformSettings(): Promise<PlatformSettings> {
    try {
      // Try to get settings (assuming single row with id = 1)
      const settings = await this.platformSettingsRepository.findOne({
        where: { id: 1 },
      });
      if (settings) {
        return settings;
      }
      // Return defaults with required fields
      return {
        id: 1,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.TIERED_DISCOUNT,
        freeShippingEnabled: true,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: true,
        ...this.defaultSettings,
      } as PlatformSettings;
    } catch (_error) {
      // If table doesn't exist or error, return defaults
      return {
        id: 1,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.TIERED_DISCOUNT,
        freeShippingEnabled: true,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: true,
        ...this.defaultSettings,
      } as PlatformSettings;
    }
  }
  /**
   * Get or create platform settings (for admin use)
   */
  async getOrCreateSettings(): Promise<PlatformSettings> {
    try {
      let settings = await this.platformSettingsRepository.findOne({
        where: { id: 1 },
      });
      if (!settings) {
        // Create default settings
        settings = this.platformSettingsRepository.create({
          ...this.defaultSettings,
          id: 1,
        } as PlatformSettings);
        settings = await this.platformSettingsRepository.save(settings);
      }
      return settings;
    } catch (_error) {
      // If error, return defaults
      return {
        id: 1,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.TIERED_DISCOUNT,
        freeShippingEnabled: true,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: true,
        ...this.defaultSettings,
      } as PlatformSettings;
    }
  }
  /**
   * Update platform settings (admin only)
   */
  async updateSettings(
    updates: Partial<PlatformSettings>
  ): Promise<PlatformSettings> {
    const settings = await this.getOrCreateSettings();
    Object.assign(settings, updates);
    return this.platformSettingsRepository.save(settings);
  }
}

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/token.service.spec.ts">
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { DataSource } from 'typeorm';
import { TokenService } from './token.service';
import { createHash } from 'crypto';
describe('TokenService', () => {
  let service: TokenService;
  let mockDataSource: Partial<DataSource>;
  let queryMock: jest.Mock;
  const setupServiceWithDb = async (): Promise<TokenService> => {
    queryMock = jest.fn();
    mockDataSource = { query: queryMock };
    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        TokenService,
        { provide: DataSource, useValue: mockDataSource },
      ],
    }).compile();
    service = module.get(TokenService);
    // Mock the table initialization to succeed immediately
    queryMock.mockResolvedValueOnce([]);
    await service.onModuleInit();
    // Reset mock after initialization
    queryMock.mockReset();
    return service;
  };
  const setupServiceWithoutDb = (): TokenService => {
    return new TokenService(undefined as never);
  };
  afterEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
    if (service) {
      service.clearMemoryStore();
    }
  });
  describe('generateToken', () => {
    it('generates a 64-character hex token', async () => {
      const serviceWithoutDb = setupServiceWithoutDb();
      const token = await serviceWithoutDb.generateToken('user-1', 'test@example.com', 'CUSTOMER', 'password_reset');
      expect(token).toMatch(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
    });
    it('stores token in memory when no DataSource', async () => {
      const serviceWithoutDb = setupServiceWithoutDb();
      const token = await serviceWithoutDb.generateToken('user-1', 'test@example.com', 'CUSTOMER', 'password_reset');
      const result = await serviceWithoutDb.validateToken(token);
      expect(result).toEqual({
        userId: 'user-1',
        email: 'test@example.com',
        userType: 'CUSTOMER',
        tokenType: 'password_reset',
        expiresAt: expect.any(Date),
      });
    });
    it('stores hashed token in database when DataSource available', async () => {
      await setupServiceWithDb();
      // Mock INSERT
      queryMock.mockResolvedValueOnce([]);
      const token = await service.generateToken('user-1', 'test@example.com', 'CUSTOMER', 'password_reset');
      expect(queryMock).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.stringContaining('INSERT INTO auth_action_tokens'),
        expect.arrayContaining([
          expect.stringMatching(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/), // SHA-256 hash
          'user-1',
          'test@example.com',
          'CUSTOMER',
          'password_reset',
          expect.any(Date),
        ])
      );
      // Verify it's the SHA-256 hash of the token, not the raw token
      const insertCall = queryMock.mock.calls.find(call =>
        call[0].includes('INSERT INTO auth_action_tokens')
      );
      const storedHash = insertCall?.[1]?.[0];
      const expectedHash = createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex');
      expect(storedHash).toBe(expectedHash);
    });
  });
  describe('validateToken', () => {
    it('returns null for non-existent token (in-memory)', async () => {
      const serviceWithoutDb = setupServiceWithoutDb();
      const result = await serviceWithoutDb.validateToken('nonexistent-token');
      expect(result).toBeNull();
    });
    it('returns null and deletes expired token (in-memory)', async () => {
      const serviceWithoutDb = setupServiceWithoutDb();
      const token = await serviceWithoutDb.generateToken('user-1', 'test@example.com', 'CUSTOMER', 'password_reset');
      // Manually expire the token
      const stored = serviceWithoutDb['tokens'].get(token);
      if (!stored) throw new Error('expected token to be stored');
      stored.expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() - 1000);
      const result = await serviceWithoutDb.validateToken(token);
      expect(result).toBeNull();
    });
    it('validates and consumes token in database (single-use)', async () => {
      await setupServiceWithDb();
      const token = 'a'.repeat(64);
      const tokenHash = createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex');
      const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 3600000);
      // Mock DELETE RETURNING for first validation (success)
      queryMock.mockResolvedValueOnce([{
        user_id: 'user-1',
        email: 'test@example.com',
        user_type: 'CUSTOMER',
        token_type: 'password_reset',
        expires_at: expiresAt.toISOString(),
      }]);
      // Mock DELETE RETURNING for second validation (already consumed)
      queryMock.mockResolvedValueOnce([]);
      // First validation should succeed
      const result1 = await service.validateToken(token);
      expect(result1).toEqual({
        userId: 'user-1',
        email: 'test@example.com',
        userType: 'CUSTOMER',
        tokenType: 'password_reset',
        expiresAt: expect.any(Date),
      });
      // Second validation should fail (token consumed)
      const result2 = await service.validateToken(token);
      expect(result2).toBeNull();
      // Verify DELETE ... RETURNING was called with correct hash
      expect(queryMock).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.stringContaining('DELETE FROM auth_action_tokens'),
        [tokenHash]
      );
    });
    it('returns null for expired token in database', async () => {
      await setupServiceWithDb();
      const token = 'b'.repeat(64);
      // Mock DELETE RETURNING empty (expired)
      queryMock.mockResolvedValueOnce([]);
      const result = await service.validateToken(token);
      expect(result).toBeNull();
    });
    it('falls back to in-memory when database query fails', async () => {
      await setupServiceWithDb();
      // Mock DB query to fail
      queryMock.mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('DB connection failed'));
      // Add token to in-memory store directly
      const token = 'fallback-token-' + 'c'.repeat(48); // 64 chars
      service['tokens'].set(token, {
        userId: 'user-1',
        email: 'test@example.com',
        userType: 'CUSTOMER',
        tokenType: 'password_reset',
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000),
      });
      const result = await service.validateToken(token);
      expect(result).toEqual({
        userId: 'user-1',
        email: 'test@example.com',
        userType: 'CUSTOMER',
        tokenType: 'password_reset',
        expiresAt: expect.any(Date),
      });
    });
  });
  describe('Cross-Instance / Process Restart Persistence', () => {
    it('allows a new TokenService instance to validate a token created by another instance (shared DB)', async () => {
      // Instance 1 creates token
      await setupServiceWithDb();
      queryMock.mockResolvedValueOnce([]); // INSERT
      const token1 = await service.generateToken('user-1', 'test@example.com', 'CUSTOMER', 'password_reset');
      // Instance 2 (new service with same DataSource)
      const service2 = new TokenService(mockDataSource as DataSource);
      // Mock table init for instance 2
      queryMock.mockResolvedValueOnce([]);
      await service2.onModuleInit();
      queryMock.mockReset();
      const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 3600000);
      // Mock validation for instance 2
      queryMock
        .mockResolvedValueOnce([{
          user_id: 'user-1',
          email: 'test@example.com',
          user_type: 'CUSTOMER',
          token_type: 'password_reset',
          expires_at: expiresAt.toISOString(),
        }]) // First validation succeeds
        .mockResolvedValueOnce([]); // Second validation fails (consumed)
      // Instance 2 validates the token
      const result = await service2.validateToken(token1);
      expect(result).toEqual({
        userId: 'user-1',
        email: 'test@example.com',
        userType: 'CUSTOMER',
        tokenType: 'password_reset',
        expiresAt: expect.any(Date),
      });
      // Token is consumed, second validation fails
      const result2 = await service2.validateToken(token1);
      expect(result2).toBeNull();
    });
  });
  describe('SHA-256 Hash-at-Rest', () => {
    it('hashToken produces correct SHA-256 hash', () => {
      const serviceWithoutDb = setupServiceWithoutDb();
      const plainToken = 'plaintext-token-for-testing';
      const expectedHash = createHash('sha256').update(plainToken).digest('hex');
      const hash = serviceWithoutDb['hashToken'](plainToken);
      expect(hash).toBe(expectedHash);
      expect(hash).not.toBe(plainToken);
      expect(hash).toMatch(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
    });
    it('stores only SHA-256 hash in database, never plaintext', async () => {
      await setupServiceWithDb();
      queryMock.mockResolvedValueOnce([]); // INSERT
      const token = await service.generateToken('user-1', 'test@example.com', 'CUSTOMER', 'password_reset');
      const insertCall = queryMock.mock.calls.find(call =>
        call[0].includes('INSERT INTO auth_action_tokens')
      );
      const storedHash = insertCall?.[1]?.[0];
      const tokenHash = createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex');
      expect(storedHash).toBe(tokenHash);
      expect(storedHash).not.toBe(token);
    });
  });
  describe('Single-Use / Replay Prevention', () => {
    it('consumes token on first validation, rejects replay (database)', async () => {
      await setupServiceWithDb();
      const token = 'replay-token-' + 'e'.repeat(51); // 64 chars
      const tokenHash = createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex');
      const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 3600000);
      queryMock
        .mockResolvedValueOnce([{
          user_id: 'user-1',
          email: 'test@example.com',
          user_type: 'CUSTOMER',
          token_type: 'password_reset',
          expires_at: expiresAt.toISOString(),
        }]) // First validation
        .mockResolvedValueOnce([]); // Replay attempt
      await service.validateToken(token);
      const replayResult = await service.validateToken(token);
      expect(replayResult).toBeNull();
      expect(queryMock).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2); // 2x DELETE
    });
    it('in-memory store also prevents replay', async () => {
      const serviceWithoutDb = setupServiceWithoutDb();
      const token = await serviceWithoutDb.generateToken('user-1', 'test@example.com', 'CUSTOMER', 'password_reset');
      const result1 = await serviceWithoutDb.validateToken(token);
      expect(result1).not.toBeNull();
      const result2 = await serviceWithoutDb.validateToken(token);
      expect(result2).toBeNull();
    });
  });
  describe('Expiration', () => {
    it('rejects expired token in database', async () => {
      await setupServiceWithDb();
      const token = 'expired-token-' + 'f'.repeat(50); // 64 chars
      // Mock DELETE RETURNING empty (expired)
      queryMock.mockResolvedValueOnce([]);
      const result = await service.validateToken(token);
      expect(result).toBeNull();
    });
    it('rejects expired token in memory and cleans up', async () => {
      const serviceWithoutDb = setupServiceWithoutDb();
      const token = await serviceWithoutDb.generateToken('user-1', 'test@example.com', 'CUSTOMER', 'password_reset');
      // Expire the token
      const stored = serviceWithoutDb['tokens'].get(token);
      if (!stored) throw new Error('expected token to be stored');
      stored.expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() - 1000);
      const result = await serviceWithoutDb.validateToken(token);
      expect(result).toBeNull();
      expect(serviceWithoutDb['tokens'].has(token)).toBe(false);
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/translation.service.ts">
import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, In } from 'typeorm';
import { Translation } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import axios from 'axios';
export interface TranslationInput {
  entityType: string;
  entityId: number;
  locale: string;
  fieldName: string;
  value: string;
  isAutoTranslated?: boolean;
  translatedBy?: number;
}
export interface BulkTranslationInput {
  entityType: string;
  entityIds: number[];
  sourceLocale: string;
  targetLocales: string[];
}
/** Request body for the LibreTranslate /translate endpoint. */
interface LibreTranslateRequestBody {
  q: string;
  source: string;
  target: string;
  format?: 'text' | 'html';
  api_key?: string;
}
@Injectable()
export class TranslationService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(TranslationService.name);
  private readonly translateApiUrl: string;
  private readonly apiKey: string | undefined;
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Translation)
    private translationRepository: Repository<Translation>
  ) {
    // Use LibreTranslate - free and open source translation API
    // You can use the public instance or self-host your own
    this.translateApiUrl =
      process.env['LIBRE_TRANSLATE_URL'] ||
      'https://libretranslate.com/translate';
    // API key is optional (only needed for public LibreTranslate instance)
    this.apiKey = process.env['LIBRE_TRANSLATE_API_KEY'];
    this.logger.log('🌍 LibreTranslate configured');
    this.logger.log(`📡 API URL: ${this.translateApiUrl}`);
    if (this.apiKey) {
      this.logger.log('🔑 API key configured');
    } else {
      this.logger.warn('⚠️  No API key - translations may fail');
      this.logger.warn(
        '💡 Get API key from: https://portal.libretranslate.com'
      );
      this.logger.log(
        '💡 OR self-host: docker run -ti --rm -p 5000:5000 libretranslate/libretranslate'
      );
    }
  }
  /**
   * Get translation with fallback support
   */
  async getTranslation(
    entityType: string,
    entityId: number,
    locale: string,
    fieldName: string,
    fallback?: string
  ): Promise<string> {
    try {
      const translation = await this.translationRepository.findOne({
        where: { entityType, entityId, locale, fieldName },
      });
      return translation?.value || fallback || '';
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(
        `Failed to get translation: ${entityType}:${entityId}:${locale}:${fieldName}`,
        error
      );
      return fallback || '';
    }
  }
  /**
   * Get multiple translations at once for performance
   */
  async getTranslations(
    entityType: string,
    entityIds: number[],
    locale: string,
    fieldName: string
  ): Promise<Map<number, string>> {
    try {
      const translations = await this.translationRepository.find({
        where: {
          entityType,
          entityId: In(entityIds),
          locale,
          fieldName,
        },
      });
      const result = new Map<number, string>();
      translations.forEach((t) => result.set(t.entityId, t.value));
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(
        `Failed to get translations: ${entityType}:${entityIds}:${locale}:${fieldName}`,
        error
      );
      return new Map();
    }
  }
  /**
   * Set translation (upsert operation)
   */
  async setTranslation(input: TranslationInput): Promise<Translation> {
    try {
      const existing = await this.translationRepository.findOne({
        where: {
          entityType: input.entityType,
          entityId: input.entityId,
          locale: input.locale,
          fieldName: input.fieldName,
        },
      });
      if (existing) {
        existing.value = input.value;
        existing.isAutoTranslated = input.isAutoTranslated || false;
        existing.translatedBy = input.translatedBy;
        return this.translationRepository.save(existing);
      }
      return this.translationRepository.save({
        entityType: input.entityType,
        entityId: input.entityId,
        locale: input.locale,
        fieldName: input.fieldName,
        value: input.value,
        isAutoTranslated: input.isAutoTranslated || false,
        translatedBy: input.translatedBy,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(
        `Failed to set translation: ${input.entityType}:${input.entityId}:${input.locale}:${input.fieldName}`,
        error
      );
      throw error;
    }
  }
  /**
   * Bulk translate entities to multiple languages
   */
  async bulkTranslateEntities(input: BulkTranslationInput): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.logger.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════');
      this.logger.log('🌍 BULK TRANSLATION STARTED');
      this.logger.log(`📦 Entity Type: ${input.entityType}`);
      this.logger.log(`🆔 Entity IDs: [${input.entityIds.join(', ')}]`);
      this.logger.log(`🔤 Source Locale: ${input.sourceLocale}`);
      this.logger.log(`🎯 Target Locales: [${input.targetLocales.join(', ')}]`);
      this.logger.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════');
      // Get source translations
      const sourceTranslations = await this.translationRepository.find({
        where: {
          entityType: input.entityType,
          entityId: In(input.entityIds),
          locale: input.sourceLocale,
        },
      });
      this.logger.log(
        `✅ Found ${sourceTranslations.length} source translations for ${
          input.entityType
        } entities ${input.entityIds.join(', ')} in locale ${
          input.sourceLocale
        }`
      );
      if (sourceTranslations.length === 0) {
        this.logger.warn(
          `No source translations found for ${
            input.entityType
          } entities ${input.entityIds.join(', ')} in locale ${
            input.sourceLocale
          }`
        );
        return;
      }
      // Group by entity ID for batch processing
      const translationsByEntity = new Map<number, Translation[]>();
      sourceTranslations.forEach((t) => {
        if (!translationsByEntity.has(t.entityId)) {
          translationsByEntity.set(t.entityId, []);
        }
        const entityTranslations = translationsByEntity.get(t.entityId);
        if (entityTranslations) {
          entityTranslations.push(t);
        }
      });
      // Process each entity
      let successCount = 0;
      let skipCount = 0;
      let errorCount = 0;
      for (const [entityId, translations] of translationsByEntity) {
        this.logger.log(`\n📝 Processing Entity ID: ${entityId}`);
        for (const sourceTranslation of translations) {
          this.logger.log(
            `  📄 Field: ${sourceTranslation.fieldName} = "${sourceTranslation.value}"`
          );
          for (const targetLocale of input.targetLocales) {
            // Check if translation already exists
            const exists = await this.translationRepository.findOne({
              where: {
                entityType: input.entityType,
                entityId,
                locale: targetLocale,
                fieldName: sourceTranslation.fieldName,
              },
            });
            // Skip if translation exists AND is not a placeholder from failed translation
            const isPlaceholder =
              exists &&
              (exists.value.startsWith('[') ||
                exists.value.includes('[فارسی]') ||
                exists.value.includes('[العربية]'));
            if (exists && !isPlaceholder) {
              this.logger.log(
                `    ⏭️  Skipping ${targetLocale}: Translation already exists`
              );
              skipCount++;
              continue;
            }
            if (isPlaceholder) {
              this.logger.log(
                `    🔄 Replacing placeholder translation in ${targetLocale}...`
              );
            }
            try {
              this.logger.log(`    🔄 Translating to ${targetLocale}...`);
              const translatedValue = await this.autoTranslate(
                sourceTranslation.value,
                targetLocale
              );
              await this.setTranslation({
                entityType: input.entityType,
                entityId,
                locale: targetLocale,
                fieldName: sourceTranslation.fieldName,
                value: translatedValue,
                isAutoTranslated: true,
              });
              this.logger.log(
                `    ✅ SUCCESS: "${sourceTranslation.value}" → "${translatedValue}" (${targetLocale})`
              );
              successCount++;
            } catch (error) {
              this.logger.error(
                `    ❌ FAILED: ${input.entityType}:${entityId}:${sourceTranslation.fieldName} to ${targetLocale}`,
                error
              );
              errorCount++;
            }
          }
        }
      }
      this.logger.log('\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════');
      this.logger.log('📊 BULK TRANSLATION SUMMARY');
      this.logger.log(`✅ Successful: ${successCount}`);
      this.logger.log(`⏭️  Skipped (already exist): ${skipCount}`);
      this.logger.log(`❌ Failed: ${errorCount}`);
      this.logger.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════\n');
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('Bulk translation failed', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }
  /**
   * Get all translations for an entity
   */
  async getEntityTranslations(
    entityType: string,
    entityId: number
  ): Promise<Map<string, Map<string, string>>> {
    try {
      const translations = await this.translationRepository.find({
        where: { entityType, entityId },
      });
      const result = new Map<string, Map<string, string>>();
      translations.forEach((t) => {
        if (!result.has(t.fieldName)) {
          result.set(t.fieldName, new Map());
        }
        const fieldMap = result.get(t.fieldName);
        if (fieldMap) {
          fieldMap.set(t.locale, t.value);
        }
      });
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(
        `Failed to get entity translations: ${entityType}:${entityId}`,
        error
      );
      return new Map();
    }
  }
  /**
   * Delete translations for an entity
   */
  async deleteEntityTranslations(
    entityType: string,
    entityId: number
  ): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.translationRepository.delete({
        entityType,
        entityId,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(
        `Failed to delete entity translations: ${entityType}:${entityId}`,
        error
      );
      throw error;
    }
  }
  /**
   * Get translation statistics
   */
  async getTranslationStats(entityType: string): Promise<{
    totalEntities: number;
    translatedEntities: number;
    locales: string[];
    fieldNames: string[];
  }> {
    try {
      const translations = await this.translationRepository.find({
        where: { entityType },
      });
      const entityIds = new Set(translations.map((t) => t.entityId));
      const locales = new Set(translations.map((t) => t.locale));
      const fieldNames = new Set(translations.map((t) => t.fieldName));
      return {
        totalEntities: entityIds.size,
        translatedEntities: entityIds.size,
        locales: Array.from(locales),
        fieldNames: Array.from(fieldNames),
      };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(
        `Failed to get translation stats: ${entityType}`,
        error
      );
      return {
        totalEntities: 0,
        translatedEntities: 0,
        locales: [],
        fieldNames: [],
      };
    }
  }
  /**
   * Auto-translate text using LibreTranslate API (free and open source)
   */
  private async autoTranslate(
    text: string,
    targetLanguage: string
  ): Promise<string> {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      // Map locale codes to LibreTranslate language codes
      const langMap: Record<string, string> = {
        en: 'en',
        fa: 'fa', // Persian/Farsi
        ar: 'ar', // Arabic
        es: 'es',
        fr: 'fr',
        de: 'de',
        zh: 'zh',
        ja: 'ja',
        ko: 'ko',
        ru: 'ru',
        pt: 'pt',
        it: 'it',
        nl: 'nl',
        pl: 'pl',
        tr: 'tr',
      };
      const targetLang = langMap[targetLanguage] || targetLanguage;
      this.logger.log(
        `🔄 Calling LibreTranslate API: "${text}" → ${targetLang}`
      );
      // Prepare request body
      const requestBody: LibreTranslateRequestBody = {
        q: text,
        source: 'en', // Assuming source is always English
        target: targetLang,
        format: 'text',
      };
      // Add API key if available
      if (this.apiKey) {
        requestBody.api_key = this.apiKey;
      }
      // Call LibreTranslate API
      const response = await axios.post(this.translateApiUrl, requestBody, {
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        timeout: 10000, // 10 second timeout
      });
      const translatedText = response.data.translatedText;
      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;
      this.logger.log(
        `✅ LibreTranslate Response (${duration}ms): "${translatedText}"`
      );
      return translatedText;
    } catch (error) {
      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;
      this.logger.error('═══════════════════════════════════════════════');
      this.logger.error('❌ LIBRETRANSLATE API ERROR');
      this.logger.error(`Duration: ${duration}ms`);
      this.logger.error(`Target Language: ${targetLanguage}`);
      this.logger.error(`Text: "${text}"`);
      if (axios.isAxiosError(error)) {
        this.logger.error(`Status: ${error.response?.status}`);
        this.logger.error(`Response: ${JSON.stringify(error.response?.data)}`);
        this.logger.error(`Message: ${error.message}`);
      } else if (error instanceof Error) {
        this.logger.error(`Error Message: ${error.message}`);
        this.logger.error(`Error Name: ${error.name}`);
        if (error.stack) {
          this.logger.error(`Stack: ${error.stack.split('\n')[0]}`);
        }
      }
      this.logger.error('═══════════════════════════════════════════════');
      // Fallback: return original text with language indicator
      const languageNames: Record<string, string> = {
        en: 'English',
        fa: 'فارسی',
        ar: 'العربية',
        es: 'Español',
        fr: 'Français',
        de: 'Deutsch',
        zh: '中文',
        ja: '日本語',
        ko: '한국어',
        ru: 'Русский',
      };
      const languageName =
        languageNames[targetLanguage] || targetLanguage.toUpperCase();
      const fallbackText = `[${languageName}] ${text}`;
      this.logger.warn(`⚠️  Using fallback text: "${fallbackText}"`);
      return fallbackText;
    }
  }
  /**
   * Validate translation input
   */
  private validateTranslationInput(input: TranslationInput): void {
    if (
      !input.entityType ||
      !input.entityId ||
      !input.locale ||
      !input.fieldName ||
      !input.value
    ) {
      throw new Error('Invalid translation input: missing required fields');
    }
    if (input.value.length > 10000) {
      throw new Error('Translation value too long (max 10000 characters)');
    }
  }
}

<file path="libs/shared/product-sizes/src/lib/product-sizes.spec.ts">
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  APPAREL_SIZES,
  euToUs,
  expandFilterSizes,
  formatPantsSize,
  formatSizeLabel,
  FootwearSizeSystem,
  inferSizeKindFromRaw,
  isPantsSizeKind,
  normalizeSizeCode,
  parsePantsSize,
  SizeKind,
  sortSizeCodes,
  usToEuCodes,
} from './product-sizes';
describe('product-sizes', () => {
  it('normalizes apparel letters', () => {
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Apparel, 'm')).toBe('M');
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Apparel, 'xxxl')).toBe('XXXL');
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Apparel, 'invalid')).toBeNull();
  });
  it('normalizes footwear EU codes and drops .0', () => {
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Footwear, '42.0')).toBe('42');
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Footwear, '42,5')).toBe('42.5');
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Footwear, '99')).toBeNull();
  });
  it('round-trips chart EU↔US entries', () => {
    expect(euToUs('42')).toBe('9');
    expect(euToUs('42.5')).toBe('9.5');
    expect(usToEuCodes('9')).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['42', '41.5']));
    expect(usToEuCodes('9.5')).toEqual(['42.5']);
  });
  it('expands US filter selections to canonical EU codes', () => {
    expect(
      expandFilterSizes(SizeKind.Footwear, FootwearSizeSystem.Us, ['9.5'])
    ).toEqual(['42.5']);
    expect(
      expandFilterSizes(SizeKind.Footwear, FootwearSizeSystem.Eu, ['42', '42.5'])
    ).toEqual(['42', '42.5']);
    expect(
      expandFilterSizes(SizeKind.Apparel, FootwearSizeSystem.Eu, ['m', 'L'])
    ).toEqual(['M', 'L']);
  });
  it('formats size labels', () => {
    expect(formatSizeLabel(SizeKind.Apparel, 'M')).toBe('M');
    expect(formatSizeLabel('Apparel' as SizeKind, 'M')).toBe('M');
    expect(
      formatSizeLabel(SizeKind.Footwear, '42', FootwearSizeSystem.Eu)
    ).toBe('EU 42');
    expect(
      formatSizeLabel('Footwear' as SizeKind, '42', FootwearSizeSystem.Eu)
    ).toBe('EU 42');
    expect(
      formatSizeLabel(SizeKind.Footwear, '42', FootwearSizeSystem.Us)
    ).toBe('US 9');
  });
  it('infers size kind from raw legacy values', () => {
    expect(inferSizeKindFromRaw('xl')).toEqual({
      sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
      size: 'XL',
    });
    expect(inferSizeKindFromRaw('42.5')).toEqual({
      sizeKind: SizeKind.Footwear,
      size: '42.5',
    });
  });
  it('exposes apparel letter list in order', () => {
    expect(APPAREL_SIZES).toEqual([
      'XS',
      'S',
      'M',
      'L',
      'XL',
      'XXL',
      'XXXL',
      '4XL',
    ]);
  });
  it('includes 4XL immediately after XXXL in apparel sizes', () => {
    const xxxlIndex = APPAREL_SIZES.indexOf('XXXL');
    const fourXlIndex = APPAREL_SIZES.indexOf('4XL');
    expect(xxxlIndex).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    expect(fourXlIndex).toBe(xxxlIndex + 1);
  });
  it('identifies 4XL as apparel size kind', () => {
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Apparel, '4xl')).toBe('4XL');
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Apparel, ' 4XL ')).toBe('4XL');
    expect(inferSizeKindFromRaw('4xl')).toEqual({
      sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
      size: '4XL',
    });
    expect(inferSizeKindFromRaw('4XL')).toEqual({
      sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
      size: '4XL',
    });
  });
  it('sorts unsorted apparel sizes with 4XL after XXXL', () => {
    const unsorted = ['4XL', 'M', 'XXXL', 'S', 'XXL'];
    const sorted = sortSizeCodes(SizeKind.Apparel, unsorted);
    expect(sorted).toEqual(['S', 'M', 'XXL', 'XXXL', '4XL']);
  });
  it('sorts mixed sizes with 4XL after XXXL and before footwear/pants', () => {
    const mixed = [
      '42', // footwear EU
      '4XL',
      'XXXL',
      '32x34', // pants
      'M',
      '42.5', // footwear EU
      'XXL',
    ];
    const sorted = sortSizeCodes(SizeKind.Apparel, mixed.filter((s) => normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Apparel, s)));
    expect(sorted).toEqual(['M', 'XXL', 'XXXL', '4XL']);
  });
  // ── Pants / composite sizing (Waist x Inseam) ──────────────────────
  it('parses pants composite sizes in multiple formats', () => {
    expect(parsePantsSize('32x34')).toEqual({ waist: 32, inseam: 34 });
    expect(parsePantsSize('34 X 32')).toEqual({ waist: 34, inseam: 32 });
    expect(parsePantsSize('W32/L34')).toEqual({ waist: 32, inseam: 34 });
    expect(parsePantsSize('32/34')).toEqual({ waist: 32, inseam: 34 });
    expect(parsePantsSize('  32 x 34  ')).toEqual({ waist: 32, inseam: 34 });
    expect(parsePantsSize('M')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePantsSize('42')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePantsSize('')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePantsSize('abc')).toBeNull();
  });
  it('formats pants canonical code', () => {
    expect(formatPantsSize(32, 34)).toBe('32x34');
    expect(formatPantsSize(34, 32)).toBe('34x32');
  });
  it('isPantsSizeKind detects PANTS', () => {
    expect(isPantsSizeKind(SizeKind.Pants)).toBe(true);
    expect(isPantsSizeKind('PANTS')).toBe(true);
    expect(isPantsSizeKind('pants')).toBe(true);
    expect(isPantsSizeKind(SizeKind.Apparel)).toBe(false);
    expect(isPantsSizeKind(SizeKind.Footwear)).toBe(false);
    expect(isPantsSizeKind(undefined)).toBe(false);
    expect(isPantsSizeKind(null)).toBe(false);
  });
  it('normalizes pants size codes', () => {
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Pants, '32x34')).toBe('32x34');
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Pants, '34 X 32')).toBe('34x32');
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Pants, 'W32/L34')).toBe('32x34');
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Pants, 'M')).toBeNull();
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Pants, '')).toBeNull();
  });
  it('infers pants size kind from raw composite values', () => {
    expect(inferSizeKindFromRaw('32x34')).toEqual({
      sizeKind: SizeKind.Pants,
      size: '32x34',
    });
    expect(inferSizeKindFromRaw('34x32')).toEqual({
      sizeKind: SizeKind.Pants,
      size: '34x32',
    });
    expect(inferSizeKindFromRaw('W32/L34')).toEqual({
      sizeKind: SizeKind.Pants,
      size: '32x34',
    });
  });
  it('sorts pants sizes by waist then inseam', () => {
    expect(sortSizeCodes(SizeKind.Pants, ['34x32', '32x34', '32x30'])).toEqual([
      '32x30',
      '32x34',
      '34x32',
    ]);
    expect(sortSizeCodes(SizeKind.Pants, ['40x34', '32x34', '32x30'])).toEqual([
      '32x30',
      '32x34',
      '40x34',
    ]);
  });
  it('expands pants filter selections to canonical codes', () => {
    expect(
      expandFilterSizes(SizeKind.Pants, FootwearSizeSystem.Eu, [
        '32x34',
        '34 X 32',
      ])
    ).toEqual(['32x34', '34x32']);
    expect(
      expandFilterSizes(SizeKind.Pants, FootwearSizeSystem.Eu, ['invalid'])
    ).toEqual([]);
    expect(expandFilterSizes(SizeKind.Pants, FootwearSizeSystem.Eu, [])).toEqual(
      []
    );
  });
  it('formats pants size labels', () => {
    expect(formatSizeLabel(SizeKind.Pants, '32x34')).toBe('W32/L34');
    expect(formatSizeLabel(SizeKind.Pants, '34x32')).toBe('W34/L32');
    expect(formatSizeLabel('Pants' as SizeKind, '32x34')).toBe('W32/L34');
  });
  // ── Backward compatibility: apparel & footwear unchanged ──────────
  it('apparel sizes still normalize correctly', () => {
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Apparel, 'm')).toBe('M');
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Apparel, 'xxxl')).toBe('XXXL');
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Apparel, 'invalid')).toBeNull();
  });
  it('footwear sizes still normalize correctly', () => {
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Footwear, '42.0')).toBe('42');
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Footwear, '42,5')).toBe('42.5');
    expect(normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Footwear, '99')).toBeNull();
  });
  it('inference still classifies legacy apparel and footwear', () => {
    expect(inferSizeKindFromRaw('xl')).toEqual({
      sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
      size: 'XL',
    });
    expect(inferSizeKindFromRaw('42.5')).toEqual({
      sizeKind: SizeKind.Footwear,
      size: '42.5',
    });
    expect(inferSizeKindFromRaw('M')).toEqual({
      sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
      size: 'M',
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/shared/product-sizes/src/lib/product-sizes.ts">
export enum SizeKind {
  Apparel = 'APPAREL',
  Footwear = 'FOOTWEAR',
  Pants = 'PANTS',
}
export enum FootwearSizeSystem {
  Eu = 'EU',
  Us = 'US',
}
export const APPAREL_SIZES = [
  'XS',
  'S',
  'M',
  'L',
  'XL',
  'XXL',
  'XXXL',
  '4XL',
] as const;
export type ApparelSizeCode = (typeof APPAREL_SIZES)[number];
/** EU adult unisex list: 35–50 inclusive, half steps. */
export const FOOTWEAR_EU_SIZES: string[] = (() => {
  const sizes: string[] = [];
  for (let n = 35; n <= 50; n += 0.5) {
    sizes.push(normalizeFootwearEuCode(String(n)));
  }
  return sizes;
})();
/**
 * Adult unisex EU → US men's approximation chart.
 * Half EU sizes map to the nearest listed US step.
 */
const EU_TO_US: Record<string, number> = {
  '35': 4,
  '35.5': 4.5,
  '36': 5,
  '36.5': 5.5,
  '37': 6,
  '37.5': 6.5,
  '38': 6.5,
  '38.5': 7,
  '39': 7,
  '39.5': 7.5,
  '40': 7.5,
  '40.5': 8,
  '41': 8.5,
  '41.5': 9,
  '42': 9,
  '42.5': 9.5,
  '43': 10,
  '43.5': 10.5,
  '44': 10.5,
  '44.5': 11,
  '45': 11.5,
  '45.5': 12,
  '46': 12,
  '46.5': 12.5,
  '47': 13,
  '47.5': 13.5,
  '48': 14,
  '48.5': 14.5,
  '49': 15,
  '49.5': 15.5,
  '50': 16,
};
function formatUsCode(n: number): string {
  return Number.isInteger(n) ? String(n) : n.toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '');
}
/** Unique sorted US codes derived from the chart. */
export const FOOTWEAR_US_SIZES: string[] = Array.from(
  new Set(Object.values(EU_TO_US).map(formatUsCode))
).sort((a, b) => Number(a) - Number(b));
export function normalizeFootwearEuCode(raw: string): string {
  const n = Number(String(raw).trim().replace(',', '.'));
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) {
    return String(raw).trim();
  }
  // Drop trailing .0; keep .5
  if (Number.isInteger(n)) {
    return String(n);
  }
  const rounded = Math.round(n * 2) / 2;
  if (Number.isInteger(rounded)) {
    return String(rounded);
  }
  return rounded.toFixed(1);
}
function isValidPantsDimension(value: number | string | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (typeof value === 'number') {
    return Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 1 && value <= 99;
  }
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    const trimmed = value.trim();
    if (!/^[1-9]\d?$/.test(trimmed)) {
      return false;
    }
    const num = Number(trimmed);
    return Number.isInteger(num) && num >= 1 && num <= 99;
  }
  return false;
}
export function parsePantsSize(
  raw: string | null | undefined,
): { waist: number; inseam: number } | null {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string') {
    return null;
  }
  const trimmed = raw.trim();
  if (!trimmed) {
    return null;
  }
  const match =
    /^(?:[wW]\s*)?([1-9]\d?)(?:\s*[xX×*/]\s*(?:[lL]\s*)?|\s*-\s*[lL]\s*|\s+[lL]\s*|[lL]\s*)([1-9]\d?)$/.exec(
      trimmed,
    );
  if (!match) {
    return null;
  }
  const [, waistRaw, inseamRaw] = match;
  if (!isValidPantsDimension(waistRaw) || !isValidPantsDimension(inseamRaw)) {
    return null;
  }
  return {
    waist: Number(waistRaw),
    inseam: Number(inseamRaw),
  };
}
/** Canonical pants composite: "waistxinseam" e.g. "32x34". */
export function formatPantsSize(
  waist: number | string | null | undefined,
  inseam: number | string | null | undefined,
): string {
  if (!isValidPantsDimension(waist) || !isValidPantsDimension(inseam)) {
    return '';
  }
  const w = Number(String(waist).trim());
  const l = Number(String(inseam).trim());
  return `${w}x${l}`;
}
export function isApparelSizeCode(code: string): code is ApparelSizeCode {
  return (APPAREL_SIZES as readonly string[]).includes(code.toUpperCase());
}
export function isFootwearEuCode(code: string): boolean {
  return FOOTWEAR_EU_SIZES.includes(normalizeFootwearEuCode(code));
}
export function isApparelSizeKind(kind?: SizeKind | string | null): boolean {
  return String(kind ?? '').trim().toUpperCase() === SizeKind.Apparel;
}
export function isFootwearSizeKind(kind?: SizeKind | string | null): boolean {
  return String(kind ?? '').trim().toUpperCase() === SizeKind.Footwear;
}
export function isPantsSizeKind(kind?: SizeKind | string | null): boolean {
  return String(kind ?? '').trim().toUpperCase() === SizeKind.Pants;
}
export function normalizeSizeCode(
  kind: SizeKind | string,
  raw: string
): string | null {
  const trimmed = String(raw ?? '').trim();
  if (!trimmed) {
    return null;
  }
  if (isApparelSizeKind(kind)) {
    const upper = trimmed.toUpperCase();
    return isApparelSizeCode(upper) ? upper : null;
  }
  if (isPantsSizeKind(kind)) {
    const parsed = parsePantsSize(trimmed);
    return parsed ? formatPantsSize(parsed.waist, parsed.inseam) : null;
  }
  const eu = normalizeFootwearEuCode(trimmed);
  return isFootwearEuCode(eu) ? eu : null;
}
export function euToUs(euCode: string): string | null {
  const eu = normalizeFootwearEuCode(euCode);
  const us = EU_TO_US[eu];
  return us === undefined ? null : formatUsCode(us);
}
export function usToEuCodes(usCode: string): string[] {
  const target = Number(String(usCode).trim().replace(',', '.'));
  if (!Number.isFinite(target)) {
    return [];
  }
  return Object.entries(EU_TO_US)
    .filter(([, us]) => us === target)
    .map(([eu]) => eu);
}
export function formatSizeLabel(
  kind: SizeKind | string,
  canonicalCode: string,
  system: FootwearSizeSystem = FootwearSizeSystem.Eu
): string {
  if (isApparelSizeKind(kind)) {
    return canonicalCode;
  }
  if (isPantsSizeKind(kind)) {
    const trimmed = String(canonicalCode ?? '').trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
      return '';
    }
    const parsed = parsePantsSize(trimmed);
    return parsed ? `W${parsed.waist}/L${parsed.inseam}` : trimmed;
  }
  if (system === FootwearSizeSystem.Us) {
    const us = euToUs(canonicalCode);
    return us ? `US ${us}` : `EU ${canonicalCode}`;
  }
  return `EU ${canonicalCode}`;
}
/**
 * Expand UI filter selections into canonical ProductInfo.size codes for SQL IN.
 * Apparel: selections are already letters.
 * Footwear: if system is US, map each US size to one or more EU codes.
 */
export function expandFilterSizes(
  kind: SizeKind | string,
  system: FootwearSizeSystem,
  selected: string[]
): string[] {
  if (!selected.length) {
    return [];
  }
  if (isApparelSizeKind(kind)) {
    return selected
      .map((s) => normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Apparel, s))
      .filter((s): s is string => !!s);
  }
  if (isPantsSizeKind(kind)) {
    return Array.from(
      new Set(
        selected
          .map((s) => normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Pants, s))
          .filter((s): s is string => !!s),
      ),
    );
  }
  if (system === FootwearSizeSystem.Eu) {
    return selected
      .map((s) => normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Footwear, s))
      .filter((s): s is string => !!s);
  }
  const euCodes = new Set<string>();
  for (const us of selected) {
    for (const eu of usToEuCodes(us)) {
      euCodes.add(eu);
    }
  }
  return Array.from(euCodes);
}
export function inferSizeKindFromRaw(raw: string): {
  sizeKind: SizeKind;
  size: string;
} {
  const trimmed = String(raw ?? '').trim();
  if (!trimmed) {
    return { sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel, size: '' };
  }
  const apparel = normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Apparel, trimmed);
  if (apparel) {
    return { sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel, size: apparel };
  }
  const footwear = normalizeSizeCode(SizeKind.Footwear, trimmed);
  if (footwear) {
    return { sizeKind: SizeKind.Footwear, size: footwear };
  }
  const pants = parsePantsSize(trimmed);
  if (pants) {
    return {
      sizeKind: SizeKind.Pants,
      size: formatPantsSize(pants.waist, pants.inseam),
    };
  }
  // Numeric-ish → treat as footwear raw; otherwise apparel raw
  if (/^\d+([.,]\d+)?$/.test(trimmed)) {
    return {
      sizeKind: SizeKind.Footwear,
      size: normalizeFootwearEuCode(trimmed),
    };
  }
  return { sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel, size: trimmed.toUpperCase() };
}
export function sortSizeCodes(kind: SizeKind | string, codes: string[]): string[] {
  if (isApparelSizeKind(kind)) {
    return [...codes].sort(
      (a, b) =>
        APPAREL_SIZES.indexOf(a as ApparelSizeCode) -
        APPAREL_SIZES.indexOf(b as ApparelSizeCode)
    );
  }
  if (isPantsSizeKind(kind)) {
    return [...codes].sort((a, b) => {
      const pa = parsePantsSize(a);
      const pb = parsePantsSize(b);
      if (!pa || !pb) {
        return 0;
      }
      if (pa.waist !== pb.waist) {
        return pa.waist - pb.waist;
      }
      return pa.inseam - pb.inseam;
    });
  }
  return [...codes].sort(
    (a, b) => Number(normalizeFootwearEuCode(a)) - Number(normalizeFootwearEuCode(b))
  );
}

<file path="libs/shared/validation/src/lib/apollo-error.ts">
/** Minimal structural shape of an Apollo/GraphQL client error, for narrowing unknown catch values. */
export interface GraphQLErrorItemLike {
  message: string;
  path?: readonly (string | number)[];
  extensions?: { message?: string; [key: string]: unknown };
}
export interface NetworkErrorLike extends Error {
  statusCode?: number;
  statusText?: string;
  result?: Record<string, unknown>;
}
export interface ApolloErrorLike {
  message?: string;
  graphQLErrors?: readonly GraphQLErrorItemLike[];
  networkError?: NetworkErrorLike | null;
}
export function isApolloErrorLike(err: unknown): err is ApolloErrorLike {
  return (
    typeof err === 'object' &&
    err !== null &&
    ('graphQLErrors' in err || 'networkError' in err)
  );
}
/** Returns the value typed as ApolloErrorLike when it carries Apollo error fields, otherwise undefined. */
export function asApolloErrorLike(err: unknown): ApolloErrorLike | undefined {
  return isApolloErrorLike(err) ? err : undefined;
}

      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });

      expect(result.success).toBe(false);

    });
    it('trims email and preserves case', () => {
      const result = sellerLoginFormSchema.safeParse({
        email: '  Ann@Example.com  ',
        password: 'abc',
      });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data.email).toBe('Ann@Example.com');
        expect(result.data.password).toBe('abc');
      }
    });
    it('rejects empty password', () => {
      const result = sellerLoginFormSchema.safeParse({
        email: 'ann@example.com',
        password: '',
      });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('rejects 129-char password', () => {
      const result = sellerLoginFormSchema.safeParse({
        email: 'ann@example.com',
        password: 'a'.repeat(129),

      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('accepts 128-char password', () => {
      const result = sellerLoginFormSchema.safeParse({
        email: 'ann@example.com',
        password: 'a'.repeat(128),
      });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
    });
  });
  describe('sellerSetupPasswordFormSchema behavior mirrors customerResetPasswordFormSchema', () => {
    it('accepts valid 8+ char password with matching confirm', () => {
      const result = sellerSetupPasswordFormSchema.safeParse({
        password: 'password123',
        confirmPassword: 'password123',
      });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data.password).toBe('password123');
        expect(result.data.confirmPassword).toBe('password123');
      }
    });
    it('rejects password/confirmPassword mismatch with issue on confirmPassword path', () => {
      const result = sellerSetupPasswordFormSchema.safeParse({
        password: 'password123',
        confirmPassword: 'different123',
      });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
      if (!result.success) {
        const confirmPasswordIssue = result.error.issues.find(
          (issue) => issue.path[0] === 'confirmPassword'
        );
        expect(confirmPasswordIssue).toBeDefined();
        expect(confirmPasswordIssue?.message).toBe('passwordsDoNotMatch');
      }
    });
    it('rejects 7-char password (min 8)', () => {
      const result = sellerSetupPasswordFormSchema.safeParse({
        password: 'pass123',
        confirmPassword: 'pass123',
      });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('accepts 128-char password', () => {
      const maxPassword = 'a'.repeat(128);
      const result = sellerSetupPasswordFormSchema.safeParse({
        password: maxPassword,
        confirmPassword: maxPassword,
      });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);

      const result = sellerSetupPasswordFormSchema.safeParse({
        password: longPassword,
        confirmPassword: longPassword,
      });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);

      const result = emailSchema.safeParse(longEmail);
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);

import { z } from 'zod';
import { VALIDATION_LIMITS } from './limits';
import { trimmedString } from './primitives';
export const USER_ROLES = ['ADMIN', 'SELLER', 'CUSTOMER'] as const;
export const emailSchema = z.string().trim().max(254).pipe(z.email());
export const loginPasswordSchema = z.string().min(1).max(VALIDATION_LIMITS.password.max);
export const newPasswordSchema = z
  .string()
  .min(VALIDATION_LIMITS.password.min)
  .max(VALIDATION_LIMITS.password.max);
export const personNameSchema = trimmedString(1, 100);
export const usernameSchema = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .min(3)
  .max(50)
  .regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$/);
export const tokenSchema = z.string().trim().min(1).max(512);
export const baseUrlSchema = z.url({ protocol: /^https?$/ }).max(2048);
export const userRoleSchema = z.enum(USER_ROLES);
export const createUserSchema = z.object({
  name: personNameSchema,
  lastName: personNameSchema,
  username: usernameSchema,
  email: emailSchema,
  password: newPasswordSchema,
  role: userRoleSchema,
});
export type CreateUserData = z.infer<typeof createUserSchema>;
export type EmailData = z.infer<typeof emailSchema>;
export type LoginPasswordData = z.infer<typeof loginPasswordSchema>;
export type NewPasswordData = z.infer<typeof newPasswordSchema>;
export type PersonNameData = z.infer<typeof personNameSchema>;
export type UsernameData = z.infer<typeof usernameSchema>;
export type TokenData = z.infer<typeof tokenSchema>;
export type BaseUrlData = z.infer<typeof baseUrlSchema>;
export type UserRoleData = z.infer<typeof userRoleSchema>;

import { contactFormSchema } from './contact';
const valid = {
  fullName: 'Ali Rezaei',
  email: 'ali@example.com',
  phone: '',
  inquiryType: 'AUTHENTICATION',
  subject: 'Serial check',
  message: 'Please verify tag #SB-98421.',
};
const fieldsWithErrors = (value: unknown) => {
  const r = contactFormSchema.safeParse(value);
  return r.success ? [] : [...new Set(r.error.issues.map((i) => String(i.path[0])))];
};
describe('contactFormSchema', () => {
  it('accepts a complete message with an optional phone', () => {
    expect(fieldsWithErrors(valid)).toEqual([]);
    expect(fieldsWithErrors({ ...valid, phone: undefined })).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('requires name, email, subject and message (whitespace counts as empty)', () => {
    expect(
      fieldsWithErrors({ ...valid, fullName: ' ', email: '', subject: '', message: '  ' })
    ).toEqual(['fullName', 'email', 'subject', 'message']);
  });
  it('rejects an invalid email and over-long text', () => {
    expect(fieldsWithErrors({ ...valid, email: 'ali@example' })).toEqual(['email']);
    expect(fieldsWithErrors({ ...valid, message: 'x'.repeat(5001) })).toEqual(['message']);
  });
});

import { z } from 'zod';
export const CONTACT_LIMITS = {
  fullName: { max: 100 },
  email: { max: 254 },
  phone: { max: 30 },
  inquiryType: { max: 50 },
  subject: { max: 200 },
  message: { max: 5000 },
} as const;
/** Same pattern the contact form has always used. */
export const CONTACT_EMAIL_PATTERN = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
const requiredText = (max: number) => z.string().trim().min(1).max(max);
/** Customer contact (concierge) form. */
export const contactFormSchema = z.object({
  fullName: requiredText(CONTACT_LIMITS.fullName.max),
  email: requiredText(CONTACT_LIMITS.email.max).regex(CONTACT_EMAIL_PATTERN),
  phone: z.string().trim().max(CONTACT_LIMITS.phone.max).optional(),
  inquiryType: requiredText(CONTACT_LIMITS.inquiryType.max),
  subject: requiredText(CONTACT_LIMITS.subject.max),
  message: requiredText(CONTACT_LIMITS.message.max),
});
export type ContactFormInput = z.input<typeof contactFormSchema>;
export type ContactFormData = z.output<typeof contactFormSchema>;
