<file path="libs/shared/validation/src/lib/errors.spec.ts">
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { toValidationIssues } from './errors';
describe('errors', () => {
  describe('toValidationIssues', () => {
    it('returns path, code, message for nested object failure', () => {
      const schema = z.object({
        a: z.object({
          b: z.string(),
        }),
      });
      const result = schema.safeParse({ a: { b: 1 } });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
      if (!result.success) {
        const issues = toValidationIssues(result.error);
        expect(issues).toHaveLength(1);
        expect(issues[0].path).toBe('a.b');
        expect(issues[0].code).toBe('invalid_type');
        expect(typeof issues[0].message).toBe('string');
        expect(issues[0].message.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      }
    });
    it('returns empty path for root level failure', () => {
      const schema = z.string();
      const result = schema.safeParse(123);
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
      if (!result.success) {
        const issues = toValidationIssues(result.error);
        expect(issues).toHaveLength(1);
        expect(issues[0].path).toBe('');
        expect(issues[0].code).toBe('invalid_type');
      }
    });
    it('returns multiple issues for multiple failures', () => {
      const schema = z.object({
        x: z.string(),
        y: z.number(),
      });
      const result = schema.safeParse({ x: 1, y: 'two' });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
      if (!result.success) {
        const issues = toValidationIssues(result.error);
        expect(issues).toHaveLength(2);
        const paths = issues.map((i) => i.path).sort();
        expect(paths).toEqual(['x', 'y']);
      }
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/shared/validation/src/lib/errors.ts">
import { z } from 'zod';
export interface ValidationIssue {
  path: string;
  message: string;
  code: string;
}
export function toValidationIssues(error: z.ZodError): ValidationIssue[] {
  return error.issues.map((issue) => ({
    path: issue.path.join('.'),
    message: issue.message,
    code: issue.code,
  }));
}

  shippingAddress: 'Valiasr St, No 12',
  city: 'Tehran',
  state: 'Tehran',
  zipCode: '1234567890',
  country: 'Iran',
};
const item = {
  productId: '101',
  sellerProductId: '301',
  productName: 'Air Jordan 1',
  productImage: null,
  quantity: 2,
  unitPrice: 100,
  totalPrice: 200,
  color: 'Black',
  size: '42',
};
const order = { ...shipping, sellerId: 1, items: [item], notes: '', shippingCost: 0 };
describe('shippingAddressSchema', () => {
  it('accepts a valid address with an empty optional email', () => {
    expect(shippingAddressSchema.safeParse(shipping).success).toBe(true);
  });
  it('accepts Farsi letters in name, city and state', () => {
    const fa = { ...shipping, customerName: 'علی رضایی', city: 'تهران', state: 'تهران' };
    expect(shippingAddressSchema.safeParse(fa).success).toBe(true);
  });
  it('accepts a valid email and keeps its case', () => {
    const r = shippingAddressSchema.parse({ ...shipping, customerEmail: ' Ali@Example.com ' });
    expect(r.customerEmail).toBe('Ali@Example.com');
  });
  it.each([
    ['customerName', 'A'],
    ['customerName', 'Ali123'],
    ['customerEmail', 'not-an-email'],
    ['customerPhone', '12'],
    ['customerPhone', 'abc-defg-hij'],
    ['shippingAddress', 'ab'],
    ['city', 'T1'],
    ['state', ''],
    ['zipCode', '12'],
    ['zipCode', '12#45'],
    ['country', 'I'],
  ])('rejects invalid %s=%j', (field, value) => {
    expect(shippingAddressSchema.safeParse({ ...shipping, [field]: value }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  it('trims surrounding whitespace', () => {
    const r = shippingAddressSchema.parse({ ...shipping, city: '  Tehran  ' });
    expect(r.city).toBe('Tehran');
  });
});
describe('createOrderSchema', () => {
  it('accepts a valid order, including a guest-token note', () => {
    const r = createOrderSchema.safeParse({ ...order, notes: '[GuestToken: abc]' });
    expect(r.success).toBe(true);
  });
  it('rejects an order without items', () => {
    expect(createOrderSchema.safeParse({ ...order, items: [] }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  it('rejects sellerId 0, negative shipping cost and negative prices', () => {
    expect(createOrderSchema.safeParse({ ...order, sellerId: 0 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(createOrderSchema.safeParse({ ...order, shippingCost: -1 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(
      createOrderSchema.safeParse({ ...order, items: [{ ...item, unitPrice: -5 }] }).success
    ).toBe(false);
  });
  it('rejects item quantity 0 and above the cart cap', () => {
    expect(createOrderSchema.safeParse({ ...order, items: [{ ...item, quantity: 0 }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(createOrderSchema.safeParse({ ...order, items: [{ ...item, quantity: 1000 }] }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  it('allows a missing shipping cost and notes', () => {
    const { notes: _n, shippingCost: _s, ...rest } = order;
    expect(createOrderSchema.safeParse(rest).success).toBe(true);
  });
});
describe('updateOrderSchema', () => {
  it('accepts an empty patch and all-null fields', () => {
    expect(updateOrderSchema.safeParse({}).success).toBe(true);
    expect(
      updateOrderSchema.safeParse({ city: null, notes: null, trackingNumber: null, items: null }).success
    ).toBe(true);
  });
  it('keeps items so the resolver can still reject item rewrites', () => {
    const r = updateOrderSchema.parse({ items: [item] });
    expect(r.items).toHaveLength(1);
  });
  it('rejects an invalid field in the patch', () => {
    expect(updateOrderSchema.safeParse({ zipCode: '1' }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(updateOrderSchema.safeParse({ trackingNumber: '' }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});
describe('updateOrderStatusSchema', () => {
  it('accepts every known status', () => {
    for (const status of ORDER_STATUSES) {
      expect(updateOrderStatusSchema.safeParse({ id: 'o-1', status }).success).toBe(true);
    }
  });
  it('rejects unknown status and empty id', () => {
    expect(updateOrderStatusSchema.safeParse({ id: 'o-1', status: 'LOST' }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(updateOrderStatusSchema.safeParse({ id: ' ', status: 'PENDING' }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

<file path="libs/shared/validation/src/lib/primitives.spec.ts">
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  passwordSchema,
  trackingNumberSchema,
  positiveIntSchema,
  percentSchema,
  idSchema,
} from './primitives';
import { VALIDATION_LIMITS } from './limits';
describe('primitives', () => {
  describe('passwordSchema', () => {
    it('fails for 7 chars', () => {
      const result = passwordSchema.safeParse('a'.repeat(7));
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('passes for 8 chars', () => {
      const result = passwordSchema.safeParse('a'.repeat(8));
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
    });
    it('fails for 129 chars', () => {
      const result = passwordSchema.safeParse('a'.repeat(129));
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
  });
  describe('trackingNumberSchema', () => {
    it('trims and parses TRK1', () => {
      const result = trackingNumberSchema.safeParse('  TRK1  ');
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data).toBe('TRK1');
      }
    });
    it('fails for whitespace only', () => {
      const result = trackingNumberSchema.safeParse('   ');
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('fails for 101 chars', () => {
      const result = trackingNumberSchema.safeParse('a'.repeat(101));
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('passes for 100 chars', () => {
      const result = trackingNumberSchema.safeParse('a'.repeat(100));
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
    });
  });
  describe('positiveIntSchema', () => {
    it('fails for 0', () => {
      const result = positiveIntSchema.safeParse(0);
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('fails for -1', () => {
      const result = positiveIntSchema.safeParse(-1);
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('fails for 1.5', () => {
      const result = positiveIntSchema.safeParse(1.5);
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('passes for 1', () => {
      const result = positiveIntSchema.safeParse(1);
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
    });
  });
  describe('percentSchema', () => {
    it('fails for -1', () => {
      const result = percentSchema.safeParse(-1);
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('fails for 101', () => {
      const result = percentSchema.safeParse(101);
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('passes for 0', () => {
      const result = percentSchema.safeParse(0);
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
    });
    it('passes for 100', () => {
      const result = percentSchema.safeParse(100);
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
    });
  });
  describe('idSchema', () => {
    it('fails for empty string', () => {
      const result = idSchema.safeParse('');
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('fails for whitespace only', () => {
      const result = idSchema.safeParse('  ');
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
  });
  describe('VALIDATION_LIMITS', () => {
    it('password limits match literals', () => {
      expect(VALIDATION_LIMITS.password.min).toBe(8);
      expect(VALIDATION_LIMITS.password.max).toBe(128);
    });
    it('trackingNumber limits match literals', () => {
      expect(VALIDATION_LIMITS.trackingNumber.min).toBe(1);
      expect(VALIDATION_LIMITS.trackingNumber.max).toBe(100);
    });
    it('cartQuantity limits match literals', () => {
      expect(VALIDATION_LIMITS.cartQuantity.min).toBe(1);
    });
    it('discountPercent limits match literals', () => {
      expect(VALIDATION_LIMITS.discountPercent.min).toBe(0);
      expect(VALIDATION_LIMITS.discountPercent.max).toBe(100);
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/shared/validation/src/lib/primitives.ts">
import { z } from 'zod';
import { VALIDATION_LIMITS } from './limits';
export function trimmedString(min: number, max: number) {
  return z.string().trim().min(min).max(max);
}
export const passwordSchema = z
  .string()
  .min(VALIDATION_LIMITS.password.min)
  .max(VALIDATION_LIMITS.password.max);
export const trackingNumberSchema = trimmedString(
  VALIDATION_LIMITS.trackingNumber.min,
  VALIDATION_LIMITS.trackingNumber.max
);
export const positiveIntSchema = z.number().int().min(1);
export const percentSchema = z.number().min(0).max(100);
export const idSchema = z.string().trim().min(1);

import { z } from 'zod';
import { shippingAddressSchema, shippingPhoneSchema } from './order';
export const PROFILE_LIMITS = {
  clothingSize: { max: 20 },
  shoeSize: { max: 20 },
  favorites: { max: 20000 },
} as const;
/** Profile fields may be cleared: accept an empty string or a valid value. */
const clearable = <T extends z.ZodType<string>>(schema: T) =>
  z.union([z.literal(''), schema]).nullish();
const shape = shippingAddressSchema.shape;
export const updateCustomerProfileSchema = z.object({
  phone: clearable(shippingPhoneSchema),
  address: clearable(shape.shippingAddress),
  city: clearable(shape.city),
  state: clearable(shape.state),
  zipCode: clearable(shape.zipCode),
  country: clearable(shape.country),
  clothingSize: z.string().trim().max(PROFILE_LIMITS.clothingSize.max).nullish(),
  shoeSize: z.string().trim().max(PROFILE_LIMITS.shoeSize.max).nullish(),
  favorites: z.string().max(PROFILE_LIMITS.favorites.max).nullish(),
});
/** Profile screen: address modal. */
export const profileAddressFormSchema = z.object({
  state: clearable(shape.state),
  city: clearable(shape.city),
  address: clearable(shape.shippingAddress),
  zipCode: clearable(shape.zipCode),
  phone: clearable(shippingPhoneSchema),
  country: clearable(shape.country),
});
/** Profile screen: personal info modal (only the phone is editable). */
export const profilePhoneFormSchema = z.object({
  phone: clearable(shippingPhoneSchema),
});
export type UpdateCustomerProfileData = z.output<typeof updateCustomerProfileSchema>;
export type ProfileAddressFormInput = z.input<typeof profileAddressFormSchema>;
export type ProfilePhoneFormInput = z.input<typeof profilePhoneFormSchema>;

import {
  cursorSchema,
  optionalIdSchema,
  paginationFirstSchema,
  productFilterSchema,
  sellerFilterSchema,
} from './query';
const ok = (s: { safeParse: (v: unknown) => { success: boolean } }, v: unknown) => s.safeParse(v).success;
describe('query argument schemas', () => {
  it('bounds page sizes and cursors', () => {
    for (const n of [1, 10, 100, 200]) expect(ok(paginationFirstSchema, n)).toBe(true);
    for (const n of [0, -1, 201, 2.5]) expect(ok(paginationFirstSchema, n)).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(cursorSchema, undefined)).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(cursorSchema, 'x'.repeat(501))).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(optionalIdSchema, null)).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(optionalIdSchema, ' ')).toBe(false);
  });
  it('accepts the filters the storefront sends today', () => {
    expect(ok(productFilterSchema, undefined)).toBe(true);
    expect(
      ok(productFilterSchema, {
        first: 200,
        onlyInStock: true,
        onlyWithSellers: true,
        archivedStatus: 'ACTIVE',
        categorySlugs: ['t-shirts', 'sneakers'],
        brands: ['nike'],
        sortOrder: 'desc',
        productInfoFilter: { size: ['42'], colorId: [1, 2] },
      })
    ).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(sellerFilterSchema, { ids: [1, 2], first: 100 })).toBe(true);
  });
  it('rejects oversized filter arrays and bad sort orders', () => {
    const many = Array.from({ length: 101 }, (_, i) => i);
    expect(ok(productFilterSchema, { ids: many })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(productFilterSchema, { productInfoFilter: { colorId: many } })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(productFilterSchema, { sortOrder: 'sideways' })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(sellerFilterSchema, { ids: many })).toBe(false);
  });
});

<file path="libs/shared/validation/src/lib/query.ts">
import { z } from 'zod';
import { idSchema } from './primitives';
/** Query argument limits (largest client page size today is 200). */
export const QUERY_LIMITS = {
  first: { min: 1, max: 200 },
  cursor: { max: 500 },
  filterArray: { max: 100 },
  text: { max: 200 },
  sort: { max: 50 },
} as const;
export const paginationFirstSchema = z
  .number()
  .int()
  .min(QUERY_LIMITS.first.min)
  .max(QUERY_LIMITS.first.max);
export const cursorSchema = z.string().max(QUERY_LIMITS.cursor.max).nullish();
export const optionalIdSchema = idSchema.nullish();
const text = z.string().max(QUERY_LIMITS.text.max);
const list = <T extends z.ZodType>(item: T) => z.array(item).max(QUERY_LIMITS.filterArray.max).nullish();
const flag = z.boolean().nullish();
export const productInfoFilterSchema = z.object({
  size: list(text),
  sizeKind: z.string().nullish(),
  price: list(z.number()),
  costPrice: list(z.number()),
  colorId: list(z.number().int()),
  weight: list(z.number()),
  discount: list(z.number()),
  stockQuantity: list(z.number().int()),
});
export const productFilterSchema = z
  .object({
    category: text.nullish(),
    categorySlugs: list(text),
    brand: text.nullish(),
    brands: list(text),
    ids: list(z.number().int()),
    searchTerm: text.nullish(),
    productInfoFilter: productInfoFilterSchema.nullish(),
    categoryIds: list(z.number().int()),
    first: paginationFirstSchema.nullish(),
    after: cursorSchema,
    categoryId: z.number().int().nullish(),
    sort: z.string().max(QUERY_LIMITS.sort.max).nullish(),
    sortOrder: z.enum(['asc', 'desc']).nullish(),
    archivedStatus: z.string().nullish(),
    sellerId: z.number().int().nullish(),
    onlyWithSellers: flag,
    onlyInStock: flag,
    onlyDiscounted: flag,
  })
  .nullish();
export const sellerFilterSchema = z
  .object({
    searchTerm: text.nullish(),
    isActive: flag,
    ids: list(z.number().int()),
    first: paginationFirstSchema.nullish(),
    after: cursorSchema,
  })
  .nullish();

import {
  categoryFormSchema,
  colorFormSchema,
  createBrandSchema,
  createColorSchema,
  createSiteLanguageSchema,

  updateColorSchema,
  updateSiteLanguageSchema,

const ok = (s: { safeParse: (v: unknown) => { success: boolean } }, v: unknown) => s.safeParse(v).success;
describe('taxonomy schemas', () => {
  it('accepts slugs built from names, including Persian ones', () => {
    expect(ok(createBrandSchema, { slug: 't-shirts', sortOrder: 0 })).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(createBrandSchema, { slug: 'کفش-ورزشی' })).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(updateBrandSchema, { id: 1, slug: null, isActive: false })).toBe(true);
  });
  it('rejects blank or spaced slugs', () => {
    expect(ok(createBrandSchema, { slug: '  ' })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(createBrandSchema, { slug: 'a b' })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(updateBrandSchema, { slug: 'x' })).toBe(false);
  });
  it('validates hex colors', () => {
    for (const hex of ['#fff', '#00FF00', '#1A1A1A80']) expect(ok(createColorSchema, { hexCode: hex })).toBe(true);
    for (const hex of ['red', '#12345', '00ff00']) expect(ok(updateColorSchema, { hexCode: hex })).toBe(false);
  });
  it('validates site languages', () => {
    expect(ok(createSiteLanguageSchema, { code: 'fa', name: 'Farsi', nativeName: 'فارسی', isRTL: true })).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(createSiteLanguageSchema, { code: 'pt-BR', name: 'Portuguese', nativeName: 'Português' })).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(createSiteLanguageSchema, { code: 'f', name: 'x', nativeName: 'x' })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(updateSiteLanguageSchema, { name: '' })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(updateSiteLanguageSchema, { isActive: false })).toBe(true);
  });
  it('validates the optional name argument and the admin modals', () => {
    expect(ok(optionalDisplayNameSchema, null)).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(optionalDisplayNameSchema, 'x'.repeat(101))).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(categoryFormSchema, { name: ' ' })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(colorFormSchema, { name: 'Green', hexCode: '#00ff00' })).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(colorFormSchema, { name: 'Green', hexCode: 'green' })).toBe(false);
  });
});

import { z } from 'zod';
export const TAXONOMY_LIMITS = {
  slug: { max: 100 },
  name: { max: 100 },
  languageCode: { max: 10 },
} as const;
/** `#rgb`, `#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa`. */
export const HEX_COLOR_PATTERN = /^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}|[0-9a-fA-F]{6}|[0-9a-fA-F]{8})$/;
/** Slugs are built from names (lowercase, spaces to hyphens), so only blanks and whitespace are rejected. */
export const slugSchema = z.string().trim().min(1).max(TAXONOMY_LIMITS.slug.max).regex(/^\S+$/);
export const displayNameSchema = z.string().trim().min(1).max(TAXONOMY_LIMITS.name.max);
/** Optional translated name argument (`name`) on brand/category/color mutations. */
export const optionalDisplayNameSchema = z.string().trim().max(TAXONOMY_LIMITS.name.max).nullish();
export const hexColorSchema = z.string().trim().regex(HEX_COLOR_PATTERN);
const sortOrder = z.number().int().nullish();
const flag = z.boolean().nullish();
export const createBrandSchema = z.object({ slug: slugSchema, sortOrder });
export const updateBrandSchema = z.object({
  id: z.number().int(),
  slug: slugSchema.nullish(),
  sortOrder,
  isActive: flag,
});
export const createCategorySchema = createBrandSchema;
export const updateCategorySchema = updateBrandSchema;
export const createColorSchema = z.object({ hexCode: hexColorSchema, sortOrder });
export const updateColorSchema = z.object({ hexCode: hexColorSchema, sortOrder, isActive: flag });
export const languageCodeSchema = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .min(2)
  .max(TAXONOMY_LIMITS.languageCode.max)
  .regex(/^[A-Za-z]{2,3}(?:[-_][A-Za-z0-9]{2,8})*$/);
export const createSiteLanguageSchema = z.object({
  code: languageCodeSchema,
  name: displayNameSchema,
  nativeName: displayNameSchema,
  isRTL: flag,
  isActive: flag,
  isDefault: flag,
});
export const updateSiteLanguageSchema = z.object({
  name: displayNameSchema.nullish(),
  nativeName: displayNameSchema.nullish(),
  isRTL: flag,
  isActive: flag,
  isDefault: flag,
});
/** Admin category modal. */
export const categoryFormSchema = z.object({ name: displayNameSchema });
/** Admin color modal. */
export const colorFormSchema = z.object({ name: displayNameSchema, hexCode: hexColorSchema });
export type CategoryFormInput = z.input<typeof categoryFormSchema>;
export type ColorFormInput = z.input<typeof colorFormSchema>;

<file path="apps/kickzone-api/src/app/update-order-input.validation.spec.ts">
import { BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from '@kickzone-workspace/resolvers';
import { updateOrderSchema } from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import { UpdateOrderInput, UpdateOrderItemInput } from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
describe('UpdateOrderInput Validation', () => {
  const pipe = new ZodValidationPipe(updateOrderSchema);
  const validUpdateOrderItem: UpdateOrderItemInput = {
    productId: 'prod-1',
    productName: 'Test Product',
    quantity: 1,
    unitPrice: 10.0,
    totalPrice: 10.0,
  };
  it('should resolve UpdateOrderInput with only trackingNumber (no items)', () => {
    const input: UpdateOrderInput = { trackingNumber: 'T1' };
    expect(pipe.transform(input)).toEqual(input);
  });
  it('should resolve UpdateOrderInput with trackingNumber and items: null', () => {
    const input: UpdateOrderInput = { trackingNumber: 'T1', items: null };
    expect(pipe.transform(input)).toEqual(input);
  });
  it('should reject UpdateOrderInput with items containing quantity 0 via BadRequestException', () => {
    const input: UpdateOrderInput = {
      items: [{ ...validUpdateOrderItem, quantity: 0 }], // invalid: must be >= 1
    };
    expect(() => pipe.transform(input)).toThrow(BadRequestException);
  });
  it('should resolve UpdateOrderInput with items containing quantity 1 and valid fields', () => {
    const input: UpdateOrderInput = { items: [validUpdateOrderItem] };
    expect(pipe.transform(input)).toEqual(input);
  });
});
</file>

<file path="libs/client/admins/components/footer/src/lib/admins-footer.spec.tsx">
import React from 'react';
import { render } from '@testing-library/react';
import { vi } from 'vitest';
import { AdminsFooter } from './admins-footer';
import { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
// Any LL key not listed explicitly falls back to a function returning its key path,
// so the render smoke test does not break each time the footer uses a new translation.
const { withKeyFallback } = vi.hoisted(() => {
  const withKeyFallback = (base: unknown, path = ''): unknown =>
    new Proxy(typeof base === 'function' ? base : () => path, {
      get: (_t, k) =>
        typeof k === 'symbol'
          ? undefined
          : withKeyFallback(
              base && typeof base === 'object' ? (base as Record<string, unknown>)[k] : undefined,
              path ? `${path}.${String(k)}` : String(k)
            ),
    });
  return { withKeyFallback };
});
// Mock the i18n context
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n', () => ({
  SITE_NAME: 'SAINTBALA',
  useI18nContext: () => ({
    LL: withKeyFallback({
      appNames: {
        siteName: () => 'SAINTBALA',
      },
      navigation: {
        adminPanel: () => 'Admin Panel',
        languageSettings: () => 'Language Settings',
      },
      form: {
        currentLanguage: () => 'Current Language',
      },
    }),
  }),
  useLanguageContext: () => ({
    currentLocale: 'en',
    availableLocales: [{ code: 'en', name: 'English', nativeName: 'English' }],
  }),
}));
test('renders AdminsFooter', () => {
  const { container } = render(
    <BrowserRouter>
      <AdminsFooter />
    </BrowserRouter>
  );
  expect(container).toBeTruthy();
});

// Any LL key not listed explicitly falls back to a function returning its key path,
// so tests do not break each time the headerbar uses a new translation key.
const { withKeyFallback } = vi.hoisted(() => {
  const withKeyFallback = (base: unknown, path = ''): unknown =>
    new Proxy(typeof base === 'function' ? base : () => path, {
      get: (_t, k) =>
        typeof k === 'symbol'
          ? undefined
          : withKeyFallback(
              base && typeof base === 'object' ? (base as Record<string, unknown>)[k] : undefined,

      theme: { mode: 'light' },

}));

  );

    useLocation: () => ({
      pathname: '/products',

});
const theme = createTheme();
const renderWithProviders = (component: React.ReactElement) => {
  return render(
    <BrowserRouter>
      <ThemeProvider theme={theme}>{component}</ThemeProvider>
    </BrowserRouter>
  );
};
describe('AdminsHeaderbar', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockUseAdminsAuthContext.mockReturnValue({
      admin: {
        id: '1',
        name: 'Test Admin',
        email: 'admin@test.com',
        role: 'ADMIN',
      },
      setAdmin: mockSetAdmin,
      logoutAdmin: mockLogoutAdmin,
    });
  });
  // jsdom has no matchMedia; stub it so useMediaQuery sees a mobile (true) or desktop (false) viewport.
  const originalMatchMedia = window.matchMedia;
  const setViewportMatches = (matches: boolean) => {

      matches,
      media: query,
      onchange: null,
      addListener: vi.fn(),
      removeListener: vi.fn(),
      addEventListener: vi.fn(),
      removeEventListener: vi.fn(),
      dispatchEvent: vi.fn(),
    }));
  };

  it('should render successfully with the site wordmark linking home', () => {

  it('should display admin name when logged in', () => {
    renderWithProviders(<AdminsHeaderbar />);
    expect(screen.getByText('Test Admin')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should show logout button when logged in', () => {
    renderWithProviders(<AdminsHeaderbar />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('Test Admin'));
    expect(screen.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Logout' })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should show the main navigation links when logged in', () => {
    renderWithProviders(<AdminsHeaderbar />);
    const nav = screen.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'home.nav.mainAria' });
    expect(within(nav).getByRole('link', { name: 'Products' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(nav).getByRole('link', { name: 'All Seller Orders' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(nav).getByRole('link', { name: 'Sellers' })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should call logout functions when logout button is clicked', () => {
    renderWithProviders(<AdminsHeaderbar />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('Test Admin'));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Logout' }));
    expect(mockLogoutAdmin).toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockSetAdmin).toHaveBeenCalledWith(null);
  });
  it('should toggle drawer when menu button is clicked', () => {
    renderWithProviders(<AdminsHeaderbar />);
    // Customers is a drawer-only item, so it is absent until the drawer opens
    expect(screen.queryByText('Customers')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByLabelText('menu'));
    expect(screen.getByText('Customers')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should show drawer navigation items', () => {
    renderWithProviders(<AdminsHeaderbar />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByLabelText('menu'));
    // Drawer-only items
    expect(screen.getByText('Add New Product')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Customers')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Currency')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Translations')).toBeInTheDocument();
    // Items shown both in the main nav and in the drawer
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Products')).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(screen.getAllByText('All Seller Orders')).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Sellers')).toHaveLength(2);
  });
  it('should show a single login button when admin is not logged in', () => {
    mockUseAdminsAuthContext.mockReturnValue({
      admin: null,
      setAdmin: mockSetAdmin,
      logoutAdmin: mockLogoutAdmin,
    });
    renderWithProviders(<AdminsHeaderbar />);
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Login')).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(screen.queryByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Logout' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText('Test Admin')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should handle mobile viewport behavior', () => {
    setViewportMatches(true);
    renderWithProviders(<AdminsHeaderbar />);
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'SAINTBALA' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    // Centre navigation is hidden on narrow screens
    expect(screen.queryByRole('navigation', { name: 'home.nav.mainAria' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    // Logged-in admin still has items not covered by the tabbar, so the menu button stays
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('menu')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should hide the menu button on mobile when every item is handled by the tabbar', () => {
    setViewportMatches(true);
    mockUseAdminsAuthContext.mockReturnValue({
      admin: null,
      setAdmin: mockSetAdmin,
      logoutAdmin: mockLogoutAdmin,
    });
    // Logged out, the only visible item is login, which the default tabbar handles
    renderWithProviders(<AdminsHeaderbar />);
    expect(screen.queryByLabelText('menu')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('should handle desktop viewport behavior', () => {
    setViewportMatches(false);
    renderWithProviders(<AdminsHeaderbar />);
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'SAINTBALA' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'home.nav.mainAria' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    // The menu button is always available on desktop
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('menu')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

  });

    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Product Name')).toBeInTheDocument();

      screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Manage Categories' })

    expect(
      screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Manage Colors' })
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('shows a validation error when required fields are missing', async () => {
    renderEditor();
    fireEvent.submit(screen.getByLabelText('Product Editor Form'));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockShowSnackbar).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'Please fill in all required fields',
        { severity: 'error' }
      );
    });
  });
  it('adds another variant row', () => {
    renderEditor();

    expect(addVariant).toBeInTheDocument();
    fireEvent.click(addVariant);
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Product Editor Form')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('offers apparel and footwear size kind selects instead of free-text size', () => {
    renderEditor();
    expect(
      screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /Size type/i })
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /^Size$/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      screen.queryByRole('textbox', { name: /^Size$/i })
    ).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('opens the new category modal', async () => {
    renderEditor();
    fireEvent.click(
      screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Manage Categories' })
    );
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add New Category' }));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByLabelText('Category Name')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });
  it('opens the color modal and creates a color', async () => {
    renderEditor();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Manage Colors' }));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add New Color' }));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByTestId('sketch-picker'));
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Color Name'), {
      target: { value: 'Green' },
    });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockCreateColor).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Green', '#00ff00');
    });
  });
  it('loads existing product when an id is present', async () => {
    mockUseParams.mockReturnValue({ id: '1' });
    mockUseProductById.mockReturnValue({
      product: {
        id: 1,
        name: 'Existing Product',
        sku: 'SKU-001',
        categories: [{ id: 1, name: 'Category 1' }],
        description: 'Existing Description',
        productInfos: [
          {
            id: 10,
            size: 'M',
            sizeKind: 'APPAREL',
            colors: [{ id: 1, name: 'Red', hexCode: '#ff0000' }],
            weight: 100,
            images: [],

    });
    renderEditor();
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByDisplayValue('Existing Product')).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByDisplayValue('SKU-001')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });
  it('submits ALL chosen colors from the input to the product, not just the first one', async () => {
    mockCreateProductWithInfos.mockResolvedValue({
      product: { id: 1, name: 'Multi-Color Shoe' },
      productInfos: [
        {
          id: 10,
          size: 'M',
          colors: [
            { id: 1, name: 'Red', hexCode: '#ff0000' },
            { id: 2, name: 'Blue', hexCode: '#0000ff' },
          ],
        },
      ],
    });
    const { container } = renderEditor();
    // Fill product details
    const nameInput = container.querySelector('#product-name') as HTMLInputElement;
    fireEvent.change(nameInput, {
      target: { value: 'Multi-Color Shoe' },
    });
    const skuInput = container.querySelector('#product-sku') as HTMLInputElement;
    fireEvent.change(skuInput, {
      target: { value: 'SHOE-MULTI-01' },
    });
    // Select category
    const categoryInput = container.querySelector('#categories-autocomplete') as HTMLInputElement;
    fireEvent.focus(categoryInput);
    fireEvent.keyDown(categoryInput, { key: 'ArrowDown' });
    const categoryOption = await screen.findByText('Category 1');
    fireEvent.click(categoryOption);
    // Select size
    const sizeSelect = screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /^Size$/i });
    fireEvent.mouseDown(sizeSelect);
    const sizeOption = await screen.findByRole('option', { name: 'M' });
    fireEvent.click(sizeOption);
    // Select first color (Red)
    const colorInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Color/i);
    fireEvent.focus(colorInput);
    fireEvent.keyDown(colorInput, { key: 'ArrowDown' });
    const redOption = await screen.findByText('Red');
    fireEvent.click(redOption);
    // Select second color (Blue)
    fireEvent.focus(colorInput);
    fireEvent.keyDown(colorInput, { key: 'ArrowDown' });
    const blueOption = await screen.findByText('Blue');
    fireEvent.click(blueOption);
    // Fill weight
    const weightInput = container.querySelector(
      'input[name="weight"]'
    ) as HTMLInputElement;
    fireEvent.change(weightInput, {
      target: { value: '300' },
    });
    // Submit form
    fireEvent.submit(screen.getByLabelText('Product Editor Form'));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockCreateProductWithInfos).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });
    expect(mockCreateProductWithInfos).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({
        name: 'Multi-Color Shoe',
        sku: 'SHOE-MULTI-01',
        categoryIds: [1],
      }),
      [
        expect.objectContaining({
          size: 'M',
          colorIds: [1, 2], // Verifies BOTH colors are set, not just the first one [1]
          weight: 300,
        }),
      ]
    );
  });
  it('allows defining product descriptions in multiple languages (English and Farsi)', async () => {
    mockCreateProductWithInfos.mockResolvedValue({
      product: { id: 2, name: 'Multilingual Shoe' },
      productInfos: [
        {
          id: 20,
          size: 'M',
          colors: [{ id: 1, name: 'Red', hexCode: '#ff0000' }],
        },
      ],
    });
    const { container } = renderEditor();
    // Verify tabs for languages are present
    expect(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: /فارسی/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: /English/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    // Fill Farsi description on active default tab
    const farsiDescInput = screen.getByTestId('product-description-fa');
    fireEvent.change(farsiDescInput, {
      target: { value: 'کفش ورزشی عالی' },
    });
    // Switch to English tab
    const englishTab = screen.getByRole('tab', { name: /English/i });
    fireEvent.click(englishTab);
    // Fill English description
    const englishDescInput = screen.getByTestId('product-description-en');
    fireEvent.change(englishDescInput, {
      target: { value: 'Great athletic shoe' },
    });
    // Fill required product details
    const nameInput = container.querySelector(
      '#product-name'
    ) as HTMLInputElement;
    fireEvent.change(nameInput, { target: { value: 'Multilingual Shoe' } });
    const skuInput = container.querySelector(
      '#product-sku'
    ) as HTMLInputElement;
    fireEvent.change(skuInput, { target: { value: 'SHOE-MULTI-LANG' } });
    // Select category
    const categoryInput = container.querySelector(
      '#categories-autocomplete'
    ) as HTMLInputElement;
    fireEvent.focus(categoryInput);
    fireEvent.keyDown(categoryInput, { key: 'ArrowDown' });
    const categoryOption = await screen.findByText('Category 1');
    fireEvent.click(categoryOption);
    // Select size
    const sizeSelect = screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: /^Size$/i });
    fireEvent.mouseDown(sizeSelect);
    const sizeOption = await screen.findByRole('option', { name: 'M' });
    fireEvent.click(sizeOption);
    // Select color
    const colorInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Color/i);
    fireEvent.focus(colorInput);
    fireEvent.keyDown(colorInput, { key: 'ArrowDown' });
    const redOption = await screen.findByText('Red');
    fireEvent.click(redOption);
    // Fill weight
    const weightInput = container.querySelector(
      'input[name="weight"]'
    ) as HTMLInputElement;
    fireEvent.change(weightInput, { target: { value: '250' } });
    // Submit form
    fireEvent.submit(screen.getByLabelText('Product Editor Form'));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockCreateProductWithInfos).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });
    expect(mockCreateProductWithInfos).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({
        name: 'Multilingual Shoe',
        sku: 'SHOE-MULTI-LANG',
        categoryIds: [1],
        descriptions: expect.arrayContaining([
          expect.objectContaining({
            languageId: 1,
            languageCode: 'fa',
            description: 'کفش ورزشی عالی',
          }),
          expect.objectContaining({
            languageId: 2,
            languageCode: 'en',
            description: 'Great athletic shoe',
          }),
        ]),
      }),
      expect.any(Array)
    );
  });
  it('dispatches the correct variant payload when adding a new variant to an existing product, calls refetch, and only shows success on confirmed server response', async () => {
    mockUseParams.mockReturnValue({ id: '10' });
    const existingProduct = {
      id: 10,
      name: 'SAINTBALA Luxury Hoodie',
      sku: 'SB-HOOD-LUX',
      categories: [{ id: 1, name: 'Category 1' }],
      description: 'Existing Description',
      productInfos: [
        {
          id: 101,
          size: 'M',
          sizeKind: 'APPAREL',
          colors: [{ id: 1, name: 'Red', hexCode: '#ff0000' }],
          weight: 500,
          images: ['https://cdn.saintbala.com/existing.jpg'],
        },
      ],
    };
    mockUseProductById.mockReturnValue({
      product: existingProduct,
      refetch: mockRefetchProduct,
    });
    mockUpdateProduct.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      id: 10,
      name: 'SAINTBALA Luxury Hoodie',
      sku: 'SB-HOOD-LUX',
      productInfos: [
        {
          id: 101,
          size: 'M',
          sizeKind: 'APPAREL',
          colors: [{ id: 1, name: 'Red', hexCode: '#ff0000' }],
          weight: 500,
          images: ['https://cdn.saintbala.com/existing.jpg'],
        },
        {
          id: 202,
          size: 'L',
          sizeKind: 'APPAREL',
          colors: [{ id: 2, name: 'Blue', hexCode: '#0000ff' }],
          weight: 550,
          images: [],
        },
      ],
    });
    renderEditor();
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(
        screen.getByDisplayValue('SAINTBALA Luxury Hoodie')
      ).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    // Add a new variant row
    const addVariant = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add Variant' });
    fireEvent.click(addVariant);
    // Find all size selects (should now be 2)
    const sizeSelects = screen.getAllByRole('combobox', { name: /^Size$/i });
    expect(sizeSelects).toHaveLength(2);
    fireEvent.mouseDown(sizeSelects[1]);
    const sizeOption = await screen.findByRole('option', { name: 'L' });
    fireEvent.click(sizeOption);
    // Select color for the second variant
    const colorInputs = screen.getAllByLabelText(/Color/i);
    fireEvent.focus(colorInputs[1]);
    fireEvent.keyDown(colorInputs[1], { key: 'ArrowDown' });
    const blueOption = await screen.findByText('Blue');
    fireEvent.click(blueOption);
    // Fill weight for the second variant
    const weightInputs = screen.getAllByLabelText(/Weight/i);
    fireEvent.change(weightInputs[1], {
      target: { value: '550' },
    });
    // Submit form
    fireEvent.submit(screen.getByLabelText('Product Editor Form'));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockUpdateProduct).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });
    expect(mockUpdateProduct).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({
        id: 10,
        name: 'SAINTBALA Luxury Hoodie',
        sku: 'SB-HOOD-LUX',
        variants: [
          expect.objectContaining({
            id: 101,
            size: 'M',
            // GraphQL schema.gql enum is Apparel/Footwear/Pants — NOT APPAREL
            sizeKind: 'Apparel',
            colorIds: [1],
            weight: 500,
          }),
          expect.objectContaining({
            id: undefined, // New variant has no server ID yet
            size: 'L',

/** Normalize API / GraphQL casing (Apparel vs APPAREL) to product-sizes enum values. */
function resolveSizeKind(kind?: string | SizeKind | null): SizeKind {
  if (isPantsSizeKind(kind)) return SizeKind.Pants;
  if (isFootwearSizeKind(kind)) return SizeKind.Footwear;
  return SizeKind.Apparel;
}
/**
 * Convert product-sizes SizeKind values (APPAREL/FOOTWEAR/PANTS) to GraphQL
 * SizeKind enum names (Apparel/Footwear/Pants) from schema.gql.
 * Sending uppercase values makes GraphQL reject the mutation, so create/update
 * never persists variants (product shell saved, variants missing / wiped).
 */
function toGraphQLSizeKind(kind: SizeKind): KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SizeKind {
  if (isPantsSizeKind(kind)) {
    return KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SizeKind.Pants;
  }
  if (isFootwearSizeKind(kind)) {
    return KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SizeKind.Footwear;
  }
  return KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SizeKind.Apparel;
}
/** Convert GraphQL SizeKind (Apparel/Footwear/Pants) to product-sizes SizeKind. */
function fromGraphQLSizeKind(kind: string | undefined): SizeKind | undefined {
  if (!kind) return undefined;
  return resolveSizeKind(kind);
}
/** Keep multi-select Autocomplete open after picks; avoid mobile blur closing it mid-selection. */
function useMultiSelectAutocompleteOpen() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const ignoreNextBlurRef = useRef(false);
  const onOpen = useCallback(() => setOpen(true), []);
  const onClose = useCallback(
    (_event: React.SyntheticEvent, reason: string) => {
      if (reason === 'selectOption' || reason === 'removeOption') {
        return;
      }
      if (reason === 'blur' && ignoreNextBlurRef.current) {
        ignoreNextBlurRef.current = false;
        return;
      }
      setOpen(false);
    },
    []
  );
  const markSelection = useCallback(() => {
    ignoreNextBlurRef.current = true;
  }, []);
  return { open, onOpen, onClose, markSelection };
}

} as const;
interface CategoryModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSubmit: (name: string) => void;
  initialName?: string;
  title: string;
  isLoading?: boolean;
  LL: ReturnType<typeof useI18nContext>['LL'];
}
const CategoryModal = ({
  open,
  onClose,
  onSubmit,
  initialName = '',
  title,
  isLoading = false,
  LL,
}: CategoryModalProps) => {
  const [categoryName, setCategoryName] = useState(initialName);
  useEffect(() => {
    setCategoryName(initialName);
  }, [initialName]);
  const categoryForm = useForm<CategoryFormInput>({
    values: { name: categoryName },
    resolver: zodResolver(categoryFormSchema),
    mode: 'onSubmit',
  });
  const nameError = categoryForm.formState.errors.name;
  const handleSubmit = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!(await categoryForm.trigger())) return;
    onSubmit(categoryName);
    setCategoryName('');
    onClose();
  }, [categoryForm, categoryName, onSubmit, onClose]);
  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onClose={onClose} maxWidth="lg">
      <DialogTitle>{title}</DialogTitle>
      <DialogFormContent>
        <TextField
          autoFocus
          margin="dense"
          label={LL.form.categoryName()}
          fullWidth
          value={categoryName}
          onChange={(e) => setCategoryName(e.target.value)}
          error={Boolean(nameError)}
        />
      </DialogFormContent>
      <DialogActions>
        <Button onClick={onClose}>{LL.button.cancel()}</Button>
        <Button
          onClick={handleSubmit}
          loading={isLoading}
          variant="contained"
          color="primary"
        >
          {LL.button.save()}
        </Button>
      </DialogActions>
    </Dialog>
  );
};

    idx: number,
    name: keyof Omit<
      ProductInfoState,
      | 'colors'
      | 'images'
      | 'imagePreviews'
      | 'uploadedImageUrls'
      | 'createdId'
      | 'isUploading'
      | 'newImages'
      | 'newImagePreviews'
    >,
    value: unknown
  ) => void;
  onColorsChange: (idx: number, colors: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Color[]) => void;
  availableColors: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Color[];
  onRemove: (idx: number) => void;
  onRemoveImage: (infoIdx: number, imageIdx: number) => void;
  disableRemove: boolean;
  onUploadSelectedImages: (infoIdx: number) => void;
  setProductInfos: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<ProductInfoState[]>>;
  onManageColors?: () => void;
  manageColorsDisabled?: boolean;
}
const ProductInfoCard = React.memo(
  ({
    info,
    idx,
    onChange,
    onColorsChange,
    availableColors,
    onRemove,
    onRemoveImage,
    disableRemove,
    onUploadSelectedImages,
    setProductInfos,
    onManageColors,
    manageColorsDisabled = false,
    LL,
  }: ProductInfoCardProps & {
    LL: ReturnType<typeof useI18nContext>['LL'];
  }) => {
    // Only allow image selection when editing (product info is already created)
    const isSelectImagesDisabled = info.isUploading || !info.createdId;
    const theme = useTheme();
    const isMobile = useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.down('md'));
    const colorsAutocomplete = useMultiSelectAutocompleteOpen();
    const uploadButton = (
      <Button
        component="label"
        variant="contained"
        startIcon={<AddPhotoAlternateIcon />}
        disabled={isSelectImagesDisabled}
      >
        {info.isUploading ? LL.status.uploading() : LL.products.selectImages()}
        <VisuallyHiddenInput
          type="file"
          multiple
          accept="image/*"
          onChange={(e) => {
            const files = Array.from(e.target.files || []);
            if (files.length > 0) {
              // Create preview URLs for selected files
              const newImagePreviews = files.map((file) => ({
                file,
                url: URL.createObjectURL(file),
              }));
              // Update the product info state with new images
              setProductInfos((prev) => {
                const updated = [...prev];
                updated[idx].newImages = [...updated[idx].newImages, ...files];
                updated[idx].newImagePreviews = [
                  ...updated[idx].newImagePreviews,
                  ...newImagePreviews,
                ];
                return updated;
              });
            }
            // Reset the value so the same file can be selected again
            e.target.value = '';
          }}
          disabled={isSelectImagesDisabled}
        />
      </Button>
    );
    return (
      <Paper
        elevation={0}
        sx={{
          mb: 2,
          p: 2,
          position: 'relative',
          backgroundColor:
            theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
              ? 'rgba(18, 18, 22, 0.88)'
              : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96)',
          border:
            theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
              ? '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)'
              : '1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)',
          borderRadius: '16px',
          boxShadow:
            theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
              ? '0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)'
              : '0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)',
        }}
      >
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: { xs: 'column', md: 'row' },
            gap: 2,
            flexWrap: { xs: 'nowrap', md: 'wrap' },
          }}
        >
          <Box
            sx={{
              minWidth: 180,
              width: '100%',
              flex: { md: 1 },
              mb: { xs: 2, md: 0 },
            }}
          >
            <Autocomplete
              multiple
              disableCloseOnSelect
              openOnFocus
              clearOnBlur={false}
              open={colorsAutocomplete.open}
              onOpen={colorsAutocomplete.onOpen}
              onClose={colorsAutocomplete.onClose}
              options={availableColors}
              getOptionLabel={(option) => option.name}
              isOptionEqualToValue={(option, value) => option.id === value.id}
              value={info.colors}
              onChange={(_e, newValue, reason) => {
                if (reason === 'selectOption' || reason === 'removeOption') {
                  colorsAutocomplete.markSelection();
                }
                onColorsChange(idx, newValue);
              }}
              filterSelectedOptions
              slotProps={{
                listbox: multiSelectListboxSlotProps,
              }}
              renderOption={(props, option) => {
                const { key, ...otherProps } = props;
                return (
                  <li key={key} {...otherProps}>
                    <Box
                      sx={{
                        display: 'flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        gap: 1,
                      }}
                    >
                      <Box
                        sx={{
                          width: 16,
                          height: 16,
                          borderRadius: '50%',
                          backgroundColor: option.hexCode,
                          border: '1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.2)',
                          flexShrink: 0,
                        }}
                      />
                      {option.name}
                    </Box>
                  </li>
                );
              }}
              renderInput={(params) => (
                <TextField
                  {...params}
                  label={LL.form.color()}
                  required
                  slotProps={{
                    htmlInput: {
                      ...params.inputProps,
                      required: info.colors.length === 0,
                    },
                  }}
                />
              )}
              sx={{ width: '100%' }}
            />
            {onManageColors ? (
              <Button
                variant="outlined"
                onClick={onManageColors}
                disabled={manageColorsDisabled}
                sx={{ mt: 1 }}
                fullWidth={isMobile}
              >
                {LL.colorManagement.manageColors()}
              </Button>
            ) : null}
          </Box>
          <FormControl
            required
            sx={{
              flex: 1,
              minWidth: 120,
              width: isMobile ? '100%' : undefined,
            }}
          >
            <InputLabel id={`size-kind-${idx}`}>
              {LL.products.sizeKind()}
            </InputLabel>
            <Select
              labelId={`size-kind-${idx}`}
              label={LL.products.sizeKind()}
              value={info.sizeKind}
              onChange={(e: SelectChangeEvent) => {
                const nextKind = resolveSizeKind(e.target.value);
                onChange(idx, 'sizeKind', nextKind);
                onChange(idx, 'size', '');
                onChange(idx, 'waist', undefined);
                onChange(idx, 'inseam', undefined);
              }}
            >
              <MenuItem value={SizeKind.Apparel}>
                {LL.products.sizeKindApparel()}
              </MenuItem>
              <MenuItem value={SizeKind.Footwear}>
                {LL.products.sizeKindFootwear()}
              </MenuItem>
              <MenuItem value={SizeKind.Pants}>
                {LL.products.sizeKindPants()}
              </MenuItem>
            </Select>
          </FormControl>
          {isPantsSizeKind(info.sizeKind) ? (
            // Pants: standalone waist/inseam fields (avoid nesting under Size FormControl label)
            <Box
              sx={{
                display: 'flex',
                gap: { xs: 1, sm: 2 },
                flex: 1,
                minWidth: { xs: '100%', sm: 280 },
                width: isMobile ? '100%' : undefined,
                flexWrap: { xs: 'wrap', sm: 'nowrap' },
              }}
            >
              <TextField
                name="waist"
                type="number"
                required
                label={LL.products.waist?.() || 'Waist'}
                value={info.waist ?? ''}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const waist =
                    e.target.value === '' ? undefined : Number(e.target.value);
                  onChange(idx, 'waist', waist);
                  if (waist !== undefined && info.inseam !== undefined) {
                    onChange(idx, 'size', formatPantsSize(waist, info.inseam));
                  } else {
                    onChange(idx, 'size', '');
                  }
                }}
                placeholder={LL.products.waistPlaceholder?.() || '32'}
                inputProps={{ min: 1, max: 99, step: 1 }}
                {...getLtrTextFieldProps({
                  flex: 1,
                  minWidth: { xs: '100%', sm: 130 },
                  sx: {
                    '& .MuiInputLabel-root': {
                      whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                    },
                  },
                })}
              />
              <TextField
                name="inseam"
                type="number"
                required
                label={LL.products.inseam?.() || 'Inseam'}
                value={info.inseam ?? ''}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const inseam =
                    e.target.value === '' ? undefined : Number(e.target.value);
                  onChange(idx, 'inseam', inseam);
                  if (inseam !== undefined && info.waist !== undefined) {
                    onChange(idx, 'size', formatPantsSize(info.waist, inseam));
                  } else {
                    onChange(idx, 'size', '');
                  }
                }}
                placeholder={LL.products.inseamPlaceholder?.() || '34'}
                inputProps={{ min: 1, max: 99, step: 1 }}
                {...getLtrTextFieldProps({
                  flex: 1,
                  minWidth: { xs: '100%', sm: 130 },
                  sx: {
                    '& .MuiInputLabel-root': {
                      whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                    },
                  },
                })}
              />
              {/* Hidden composite size for form/tests — synced from waist/inseam */}
              <input
                type="hidden"
                name="size"
                value={info.size}
                data-testid="hidden-size-input"
              />
            </Box>
          ) : (
            <FormControl
              required
              sx={{
                flex: 1,
                minWidth: 120,
                width: isMobile ? '100%' : undefined,
              }}
            >
              <InputLabel id={`size-value-${idx}`}>
                {LL.products.size()}
              </InputLabel>
              <Select
                labelId={`size-value-${idx}`}
                label={LL.products.size()}
                value={info.size}
                onChange={(e: SelectChangeEvent) =>
                  onChange(idx, 'size', e.target.value)
                }
              >
                {/* Keeps empty value valid without showing a closed-select placeholder */}
                <MenuItem value="" sx={{ display: 'none' }} />
                {(isFootwearSizeKind(info.sizeKind)
                  ? FOOTWEAR_EU_SIZES
                  : APPAREL_SIZES
                ).map((code) => (
                  <MenuItem key={code} value={code}>
                    {isFootwearSizeKind(info.sizeKind)
                      ? `EU ${code}${
                          euToUs(code) ? ` (US ${euToUs(code)})` : ''
                        }`
                      : code}
                  </MenuItem>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </FormControl>
          )}
          <TextField
            label={LL.products.weight()}
            name="weight"
            type="number"
            value={info.weight}
            onChange={(
              e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement>
            ) => onChange(idx, 'weight', e.target.value)}
            required
            {...getLtrTextFieldProps({
              flex: 1,
              minWidth: 100,
              width: isMobile ? '100%' : undefined,
            })}
          />
        </Box>
        <Box sx={{ mt: 2, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 2 }}>
          {info.createdId && uploadButton}
          <IconButton
            onClick={() => onRemove(idx)}
            color="error"
            aria-label="Remove variant"
            sx={{ ml: 1 }}
            disabled={disableRemove}
          >
            <DeleteIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Box>
        <ImagePreviewContainer>
          {/* Selected (not yet uploaded) images */}
          {info.newImagePreviews.length > 0 && (
            <Box sx={{ width: '100%' }}>
              <Typography
                variant="subtitle2"
                color="text.secondary"
                sx={{ mb: 1 }}
              >
                {LL.products.selectedImagesNotUploaded()}
              </Typography>
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 2 }}>
                {info.newImagePreviews.map((previewObj, imageIdx) => (
                  <ImagePreviewCard key={imageIdx}>
                    <CardMedia
                      component="img"
                      height="140"
                      image={previewObj.url}
                      alt={`Selected image ${imageIdx + 1}`}
                    />
                    <CardActions>
                      <IconButton
                        size="small"
                        onClick={() => onRemoveImage(idx, imageIdx)}
                        sx={{ color: 'error.main' }}
                        aria-label="Delete selected image"
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </CardActions>
                  </ImagePreviewCard>
                ))}
              </Box>
              <Button
                variant="contained"
                color="primary"
                sx={{ mt: 1 }}
                onClick={() => {
                  onUploadSelectedImages(idx);
                }}
                disabled={
                  info.isUploading ||
                  info.newImages.length === 0 ||
                  !info.createdId
                }
              >
                {info.isUploading
                  ? LL.status.uploading()
                  : LL.products.uploadImages()}
              </Button>
            </Box>
          )}
          {/* Uploaded images from server */}
          {info.uploadedImageUrls.length > 0 && (
            <Box sx={{ width: '100%', mt: 2 }}>
              <Typography
                variant="subtitle2"
                color="text.secondary"
                sx={{ mb: 1 }}
              >
                {LL.products.uploadedImages()}
              </Typography>
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 2 }}>
                {info.uploadedImageUrls.map(
                  (preview: string, imageIdx: number) => (
                    <ImagePreviewCard key={imageIdx}>
                      <CardMedia
                        component="img"
                        height="140"
                        image={resolveProductImageUrl(preview)}
                        alt={`Product variant image ${imageIdx + 1}`}
                      />
                      <CardActions>
                        <IconButton
                          size="small"
                          onClick={() =>
                            onRemoveImage(
                              idx,
                              info.newImagePreviews.length + imageIdx
                            )
                          }
                          sx={{ color: 'error.main' }}
                          aria-label="Delete uploaded image"
                        >
                          <DeleteIcon />
                        </IconButton>
                      </CardActions>
                    </ImagePreviewCard>
                  )
                )}
              </Box>
            </Box>
          )}
        </ImagePreviewContainer>
      </Paper>
    );
  }
);
interface ColorModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSubmit: (id: number | null, name: string, hexCode: string) => void;
  initialColor?: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Color | null;
  title: string;
  isLoading?: boolean;
  LL: ReturnType<typeof useI18nContext>['LL'];
}
const ColorModal = ({
  open,
  onClose,
  onSubmit,
  initialColor = null,
  title,
  isLoading = false,
  LL,
}: ColorModalProps) => {
  const [colorName, setColorName] = useState(initialColor?.name || '');
  const [hexCode, setHexCode] = useState(initialColor?.hexCode || '#ffffff');
  useEffect(() => {
    setColorName(initialColor?.name || '');
    setHexCode(initialColor?.hexCode || '#ffffff');
  }, [initialColor]);
  const colorForm = useForm<ColorFormInput>({
    values: { name: colorName, hexCode },
    resolver: zodResolver(colorFormSchema),
    mode: 'onSubmit',
  });
  const colorErrors = colorForm.formState.errors;
  const handleSubmit = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!(await colorForm.trigger())) return;
    onSubmit(initialColor?.id || null, colorName, hexCode);
    // Reset fields for new colors (when initialColor is null)
    if (!initialColor) {
      setColorName('');
      setHexCode('#ffffff');
    }
    onClose();
  }, [colorForm, initialColor, colorName, hexCode, onSubmit, onClose]);
  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onClose={onClose} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
      <DialogTitle>{title}</DialogTitle>
      <DialogFormContent>
        <TextField
          autoFocus
          margin="dense"
          label={LL.colorManagement.colorName()}
          fullWidth
          value={colorName}
          onChange={(e) => setColorName(e.target.value)}
          error={Boolean(colorErrors.name)}
        />
        <TextField
          margin="dense"
          label={LL.colorManagement.hexCode()}
          fullWidth
          value={hexCode}
          onChange={(e) => setHexCode(e.target.value)}
          error={Boolean(colorErrors.hexCode)}
          {...getLtrTextFieldProps()}
        />
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
          <SketchPicker
            color={hexCode}
            onChangeComplete={(color: ColorResult) => setHexCode(color.hex)}
          />
        </Box>
      </DialogFormContent>
      <DialogActions>
        <Button onClick={onClose} disabled={isLoading}>
          {LL.button.cancel()}
        </Button>
        <Button
          onClick={handleSubmit}
          disabled={isLoading}
          loading={isLoading}
          variant="contained"
          color="primary"
        >
          {LL.button.save()}
        </Button>
      </DialogActions>
    </Dialog>
  );
};
interface DeleteColorModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onConfirm: () => void;
  colorName: string;
  isLoading?: boolean;
  LL: ReturnType<typeof useI18nContext>['LL'];
}
const DeleteColorModal = ({
  open,
  onClose,
  onConfirm,
  colorName,
  isLoading = false,
  LL,
}: DeleteColorModalProps) => {
  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onClose={onClose} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
      <DialogTitle sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
        <WarningIcon color="warning" />
        {LL.colorManagement.deleteColor()}
      </DialogTitle>
      <DialogFormContent>
        <Typography>
          {LL.colorManagement.deleteColorConfirm({ name: colorName })}
        </Typography>
      </DialogFormContent>
      <DialogActions>
        <Button onClick={onClose}>{LL.button.cancel()}</Button>
        <Button
          onClick={onConfirm}
          loading={isLoading}
          variant="contained"
          color="error"
        >
          {LL.button.delete()}
        </Button>
      </DialogActions>
    </Dialog>
  );
};
interface ManageColorsModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  colors: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Color[];
  onAdd: () => void;
  onEdit: (color: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Color) => void;
  onDelete: (color: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Color) => void;
  isLoading?: boolean;
  LL: ReturnType<typeof useI18nContext>['LL'];
}
const ManageColorsModal = ({
  open,
  onClose,
  colors,
  onAdd,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  isLoading = false,
  LL,
}: ManageColorsModalProps) => {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) {
      setSearch('');
    }
  }, [open]);
  const filteredColors = colors.filter((color) =>
    color.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.trim().toLowerCase())
  );
  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onClose={onClose} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
      <DialogTitle>{LL.colorManagement.manageColors()}</DialogTitle>
      <DialogFormContent>
        <TextField
          fullWidth
          size="small"
          label={LL.colorManagement.searchColors()}
          value={search}
          onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
          sx={{ mb: 2 }}
        />
        <Button
          variant="outlined"
          startIcon={<AddIcon />}
          onClick={onAdd}
          sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          disabled={isLoading}
          fullWidth
        >
          {LL.colorManagement.addNewColor()}
        </Button>
        <Box sx={{ maxHeight: 360, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
          {filteredColors.map((color) => (
            <Box
              key={color.id}
              sx={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                p: 1,
                borderBottom: '1px solid',
                borderColor: 'divider',
              }}
            >
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    width: 20,
                    height: 20,
                    backgroundColor: color.hexCode,
                    mr: 1,
                    border: '1px solid #ccc',
                  }}
                />
                <Typography>{color.name}</Typography>
              </Box>
              <Box>
                <IconButton
                  size="small"
                  onClick={() => onEdit(color)}
                  aria-label={LL.colorManagement.editColor()}
                >
                  <EditIcon fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
                <IconButton
                  size="small"
                  onClick={() => onDelete(color)}
                  color="error"
                  aria-label={LL.colorManagement.deleteColor()}
                >
                  <DeleteIcon fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
              </Box>
            </Box>
          ))}
        </Box>
      </DialogFormContent>
      <DialogActions>
        <Button onClick={onClose}>{LL.button.cancel()}</Button>
      </DialogActions>
    </Dialog>
  );
};
interface ManageCategoriesModalProps {

  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');

    if (!open) {
      setSearch('');

        >
