              <Box>
                <IconButton
                  size="small"
                  onClick={() => onEdit(category)}
                  aria-label={LL.categories.editCategory()}
                >
                  <EditIcon fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
                <IconButton
                  size="small"
                  onClick={() => onDelete(category)}
                  color="error"
                  aria-label={LL.categories.deleteCategory()}
                >
                  <DeleteIcon fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
              </Box>
            </Box>
          ))}
        </Box>
      </DialogFormContent>
      <DialogActions>
        <Button onClick={onClose}>{LL.button.cancel()}</Button>
      </DialogActions>
    </Dialog>
  );
};
type LayoutComponentType = React.ComponentType<{ children: React.ReactNode }>;
export type CreatedCatalogProduct = {
  product: { id: number; name: string; sku?: string | null };
  productInfos: Array<{
    id: number;
    size: string;
    sizeKind?: SizeKind;
    weight: number;
    colors?: Array<{
      id: number;
      name: string;
      hexCode: string;
    }> | null;
  }>;
};
export interface AdminProductEditorProps {
  LayoutComponent?: LayoutComponentType;
  /** Render without page chrome so it can be nested in another screen. */
  embedded?: boolean;
  /** After a new catalog product is created, call this instead of resetting the form. */
  onCreated?: (result: CreatedCatalogProduct) => void;
}
export function AdminProductEditor({
  LayoutComponent = AdminsLayout,
  embedded = false,
  onCreated,
}: AdminProductEditorProps = {}) {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  usePageTitle(() =>
    embedded
      ? LL.pageTitles.sellerManageProduct()
      : LL.pageTitles.adminProductEditor()
  );
  const { id } = useParams<{ id?: string }>();
  const productIdNum = id ? Number(id) : undefined;
  const { product: loadedProduct, refetch: refetchProduct } =
    useProductById(productIdNum);
  const { siteLanguages } = useSiteLanguages();
  const languagesToDisplay = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (siteLanguages && siteLanguages.length > 0) {
      return siteLanguages;
    }
    return [
      {
        id: '1',
        code: 'fa',
        name: 'Persian',
        nativeName: 'فارسی',
        isRTL: true,
        isActive: true,
        isDefault: true,
      },
      {
        id: '2',
        code: 'en',
        name: 'English',
        nativeName: 'English',
        isRTL: false,
        isActive: true,
        isDefault: false,
      },
    ];
  }, [siteLanguages]);
  const [activeDescTab, setActiveDescTab] = useState('fa');
  const [descriptions, setDescriptions] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [product, setProduct] = useState({
    name: '',
    sku: '',
    categoryIds: [] as number[],
    brandId: null as number | null,
    description: '',
  });
  const [productInfos, setProductInfos] = useState<ProductInfoState[]>([
    {
      productId: 0,
      size: '',
      sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
      colors: [],
      weight: 0,
      images: [],
      imagePreviews: [],
      uploadedImageUrls: [],
      createdId: null,
      isUploading: false,
      newImages: [],
      newImagePreviews: [],
    },
  ]);
  const [, setCreatedProductInfoIds] = useState<(number | null)[]>([null]);
  // Shared Zod rules (react-hook-form) for the required product and variant fields.
  const editorValues = useMemo<ProductEditorFormInput>(
    () => ({
      name: product.name,
      sku: product.sku,
      categoryIds: product.categoryIds,
      variants: productInfos.map((info) => ({
        // Pants need both waist and inseam (which ensures the size is set).
        size: isPantsSizeKind(info.sizeKind)
          ? info.waist !== undefined && info.inseam !== undefined
            ? formatPantsSize(info.waist, info.inseam)
            : ''
          : info.size,
        colorIds: info.colors.map((c) => c.id),
        weight: Number(info.weight) || 0,
      })),
    }),
    [product, productInfos]
  );
  const editorForm = useForm<ProductEditorFormInput>({
    values: editorValues,
    resolver: zodResolver(productEditorFormSchema),
    mode: 'onSubmit',
  });
  const [isManageCategoriesModalOpen, setIsManageCategoriesModalOpen] =
    useState(false);
  const [isNewCategoryModalOpen, setIsNewCategoryModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isEditCategoryModalOpen, setIsEditCategoryModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<{
    id: number;
    name: string;
  } | null>(null);
  const [isDeleteCategoryModalOpen, setIsDeleteCategoryModalOpen] =
    useState(false);
  const [categoryToDelete, setCategoryToDelete] = useState<{
    id: number;
    name: string;
  } | null>(null);
  const [deleteImageModal, setDeleteImageModal] = useState<{
    open: boolean;
    infoIdx: number | null;
    imageIdx: number | null;
    imageType: 'preview' | 'uploaded' | null;
    isLoading: boolean;
  }>({
    open: false,
    infoIdx: null,
    imageIdx: null,
    imageType: null,
    isLoading: false,
  });
  const [isManageColorsModalOpen, setIsManageColorsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isNewColorModalOpen, setIsNewColorModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isEditColorModalOpen, setIsEditColorModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedColor, setSelectedColor] =
    useState<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Color | null>(null);
  const [isDeleteColorModalOpen, setIsDeleteColorModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [colorToDelete, setColorToDelete] = useState<{
    id: number;
    name: string;
  } | null>(null);
  const { categories, getCategoriesLoading } = useCategoriesQuery();
  const { brands, getBrandsLoading } = useBrandsQuery();
  const {
    createCategory,
    updateCategory,
    deleteCategory,
    isCreatingCategory,
    isUpdatingCategory,
    isDeletingCategory,
  } = useCategories();
  const {
    createProductWithInfos,
    uploadProductInfoImages,
    removeProductInfoImage,
    isCreatingProduct,
    updateProduct,
  } = useProducts();
  const { showSnackbar } = useSnackbarContext();
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isMobile = useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.down('md'));
  const categoriesAutocomplete = useMultiSelectAutocompleteOpen();
  const {
    colors: availableColors,
    createColor,
    updateColor,
    deleteColor,
    loading: colorMutationsLoading,
  } = useColors();
  const slugify = useCallback(
    (name: string) => name.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/\s+/g, '-'),
    []
  );
  const resetDeleteImageModal = useCallback(() => {
    setDeleteImageModal({
      open: false,
      infoIdx: null,
      imageIdx: null,
      imageType: null,
      isLoading: false,
    });
  }, []);
  // Fetch product if editing
  useEffect(() => {
    if (productIdNum && loadedProduct) {
      const descMap: Record<string, string> = {};
      if (loadedProduct.descriptions && loadedProduct.descriptions.length > 0) {
        loadedProduct.descriptions.forEach((d) => {
          if (d?.language?.code && d?.description) {
            descMap[d.language.code] = d.description;
          }
        });
      } else if (loadedProduct.description) {
        descMap['fa'] = loadedProduct.description;
        descMap['en'] = loadedProduct.description;
      }
      setDescriptions(descMap);
      setProduct({
        name: loadedProduct.name,
        sku: loadedProduct.sku || '',
        categoryIds: loadedProduct.categories.map((cat) => cat.id),
        brandId: loadedProduct.brandId ?? loadedProduct.brand?.id ?? null,
        description: loadedProduct.description || '',
      });
      setProductInfos(
        loadedProduct.productInfos.map((info) => {
          const sizeKind = resolveSizeKind(info.sizeKind);
          const base = {
            productId: loadedProduct.id,
            size: info.size,
            sizeKind,
            colors: info.colors || [],
            weight: info.weight,
            images: [],
            imagePreviews: [],
            uploadedImageUrls: info.images || [],
            createdId: info.id,
            isUploading: false,
            newImages: [],
            newImagePreviews: [],
          };
          // Parse pants composite size for waist/inseam fields
          if (isPantsSizeKind(sizeKind) && info.size) {
            const parsed = parsePantsSize(info.size);
            if (parsed) {
              return { ...base, waist: parsed.waist, inseam: parsed.inseam };
            }
          }
          return base;
        })
      );
      setCreatedProductInfoIds(
        loadedProduct.productInfos.map((info) => info.id)
      );
    }
  }, [
    productIdNum,
    loadedProduct?.id,
    loadedProduct?.name,
    loadedProduct?.sku,
    loadedProduct?.description,
    loadedProduct?.categories,
    loadedProduct?.productInfos,
    loadedProduct,
  ]);
  // Handlers for product fields
  const handleProductChange = useCallback(
    (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      const { name, value } = e.target;
      setProduct((prev) => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
    },
    []
  );
  const handleDescriptionChange = useCallback(
    (langCode: string, value: string) => {
      setDescriptions((prev) => ({ ...prev, [langCode]: value }));
    },
    []
  );
  const handleDescTabChange = useCallback(
    (_event: React.SyntheticEvent, newLocale: string) => {
      setActiveDescTab(newLocale);
    },
    []
  );
  // Handlers for product info fields
  const handleProductInfoChange = useCallback(
    (
      index: number,
      name: keyof Omit<
        ProductInfoState,
        | 'colors'
        | 'images'
        | 'imagePreviews'
        | 'uploadedImageUrls'
        | 'createdId'
        | 'isUploading'
        | 'newImages'
        | 'newImagePreviews'
      >,
      value: unknown
    ) => {
      setProductInfos((prev) => {
        const updated = [...prev];
        updated[index] = { ...updated[index], [name]: value };
        return updated;
      });
    },
    []
  );
  // Add a new ProductInfo variant
  const handleAddProductInfo = useCallback(() => {
    setProductInfos((prev) => [
      ...prev,
      {
        productId: 0,
        size: '',
        sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
        waist: undefined,
        inseam: undefined,
        colors: [],
        weight: 0,
        images: [],
        imagePreviews: [],
        uploadedImageUrls: [],
        createdId: null,
        isUploading: false,
        newImages: [],
        newImagePreviews: [],
      } as ProductInfoState,
    ]);
    setCreatedProductInfoIds((prev) => [...prev, null]);
  }, []);
  // Remove a ProductInfo variant
  const handleRemoveProductInfo = useCallback((index: number) => {
    setProductInfos((prev) => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
    setCreatedProductInfoIds((prev) => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  }, []);
  // Handle product creation
  const handleSubmit = useCallback(
    async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      try {
        // Validate required fields
        if (!(await editorForm.trigger(['name', 'sku', 'categoryIds']))) {
          showSnackbar('Please fill in all required fields', {
            severity: 'error',
          });
          return;
        }
        if (!(await editorForm.trigger('variants'))) {
          showSnackbar('Please fill in all product variant fields', {
            severity: 'error',
          });
          return;
        }
        const descriptionList = languagesToDisplay
          .map((lang) => ({
            languageId: Number(lang.id),
            languageCode: lang.code,
            description: descriptions[lang.code]?.trim() || '',
          }))
          .filter((d) => d.description !== '');
        const primaryDesc =
          descriptions[activeDescTab]?.trim() ||
          descriptions['fa']?.trim() ||
          descriptions['en']?.trim() ||
          Object.values(descriptions).find((v) => v?.trim())?.trim() ||
          (product.description === '' ? null : product.description);
        if (productIdNum) {
          // Editing existing product
          const variantsPayload: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductVariantInput[] =
            productInfos.map((info) => ({
              id: info.createdId || undefined,
              size:
                isPantsSizeKind(info.sizeKind) &&
                info.waist != null &&
                info.inseam != null
                  ? formatPantsSize(info.waist, info.inseam)
                  : info.size,
              sizeKind: toGraphQLSizeKind(info.sizeKind),
              colorIds: info.colors.map((c) => c.id),
              weight: Number(info.weight),
              images:
                info.uploadedImageUrls && info.uploadedImageUrls.length > 0
                  ? info.uploadedImageUrls
                  : undefined,
            }));
          const updated = await updateProduct({
            id: productIdNum,
            name: product.name,
            sku: product.sku.trim(),
            categoryIds: product.categoryIds,
            brandId: product.brandId,
            description: primaryDesc,
            descriptions: descriptionList,
            variants: variantsPayload,
          });
          // Upload new images for any variants
          if (updated?.productInfos) {
            for (let i = 0; i < productInfos.length; i++) {
              const info = productInfos[i];
              const serverInfo = updated.productInfos[i];
              const variantId = serverInfo?.id || info.createdId;
              if (variantId && info.newImages && info.newImages.length > 0) {
                try {
                  await uploadProductInfoImages(variantId, info.newImages);
                } catch (imgErr) {
                  console.error('Failed to upload variant images:', imgErr);
                }
              }
            }
          }
          // Invalidate and refetch product query to ensure synchronized state
          await refetchProduct?.();
          // Sync state with server response
          if (updated?.productInfos) {
            setCreatedProductInfoIds(updated.productInfos.map((pi) => pi.id));
            setProductInfos((prev) =>
              prev.map((info, i) => {
                const serverInfo = updated.productInfos[i];
                return {
                  ...info,
                  createdId: serverInfo?.id ?? info.createdId,
                  uploadedImageUrls:
                    serverInfo?.images ?? info.uploadedImageUrls,
                  newImages: [],
                  newImagePreviews: [],
                };
              })
            );
          }
          showSnackbar('Product updated successfully', { severity: 'success' });
        } else {
          // Create product and all product infos
          const created = await createProductWithInfos(
            {
              name: product.name,
              sku: product.sku.trim(),
              categoryIds: product.categoryIds,
              brandId: product.brandId,
              description: primaryDesc,
              descriptions:
                descriptionList.length > 0 ? descriptionList : undefined,
            },
            productInfos.map((info) => ({
              size:
                isPantsSizeKind(info.sizeKind) &&
                info.waist != null &&
                info.inseam != null
                  ? formatPantsSize(info.waist, info.inseam)
                  : info.size,
              sizeKind: toGraphQLSizeKind(info.sizeKind),
              colorIds: info.colors.map((c) => c.id),
              weight: Number(info.weight),
            }))
          );
          setCreatedProductInfoIds(created.productInfos.map((pi) => pi.id));
          setProductInfos((prev) =>
            prev.map((info, i) => ({
              ...info,
              createdId: created.productInfos[i]?.id || null,
            }))
          );
          showSnackbar('Product created successfully', { severity: 'success' });
          if (onCreated) {
            onCreated({
              product: created.product,
              productInfos: created.productInfos.map((pi) => ({
                ...pi,
                sizeKind: fromGraphQLSizeKind(pi.sizeKind),
              })),
            });
            return;
          }
          // Reset form to initial state
          setDescriptions({});
          setProduct({
            name: '',
            sku: '',
            categoryIds: [],
            brandId: null,
            description: '',
          });
          setProductInfos([
            {
              productId: 0,
              size: '',
              sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
              colors: [],
              weight: 0,
              images: [],
              imagePreviews: [],
              uploadedImageUrls: [],
              createdId: null,
              isUploading: false,
              newImages: [],
              newImagePreviews: [],
            },
          ]);
          setCreatedProductInfoIds([null]);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        const message = (error as Error).message;
        if (message.includes('already exists')) {
          showSnackbar(message, { severity: 'error' });
        } else {
          showSnackbar((error as Error).message, { severity: 'error' });
        }
      }
    },
    [
      editorForm,
      product,
      productInfos,
      createProductWithInfos,
      updateProduct,
      uploadProductInfoImages,
      refetchProduct,
      showSnackbar,
      productIdNum,
      onCreated,
      languagesToDisplay,
      descriptions,
      activeDescTab,
    ]
  );
  const handleDeleteCategory = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!categoryToDelete) return;
    try {
      await deleteCategory(categoryToDelete.id);
      setIsDeleteCategoryModalOpen(false);
      setCategoryToDelete(null);
      showSnackbar('Category deleted successfully', { severity: 'success' });
    } catch (error) {
      const message = (error as Error).message;
      showSnackbar(message, { severity: 'error' });
    }
  }, [categoryToDelete, deleteCategory, showSnackbar]);
  const handleOpenDeleteCategoryModal = useCallback(
    (category: { id: number; name: string }) => {
      setCategoryToDelete(category);
      setIsDeleteCategoryModalOpen(true);
    },
    []
  );
  const handleCloseDeleteCategoryModal = useCallback(() => {
    setIsDeleteCategoryModalOpen(false);
    setCategoryToDelete(null);
  }, []);
  const handleRemoveSelectedImage = useCallback(
    (infoIdx: number, imageIdx: number) => {
      setProductInfos((prev) => {
        const updated = [...prev];
        updated[infoIdx].newImages.splice(imageIdx, 1);
        updated[infoIdx].newImagePreviews.splice(imageIdx, 1);
        return updated;
      });
    },
    []
  );
  const handleConfirmDeleteImage = useCallback(async () => {
    if (
      deleteImageModal.infoIdx === null ||
      deleteImageModal.imageIdx === null ||
      !deleteImageModal.imageType
    ) {
      resetDeleteImageModal();
      return;
    }
    // Set loading state
    setDeleteImageModal((prev) => ({ ...prev, isLoading: true }));
    const { infoIdx, imageIdx, imageType } = deleteImageModal;
    if (imageType === 'preview') {
      // Remove selected image (not yet uploaded)
      handleRemoveSelectedImage(infoIdx, imageIdx);
      setDeleteImageModal({
        open: false,
        infoIdx: null,
        imageIdx: null,
        imageType: null,
        isLoading: false,
      });
    } else if (imageType === 'uploaded') {
      // Remove uploaded image from server
      const info = productInfos[infoIdx];
      if (!info.createdId || !info.uploadedImageUrls[imageIdx]) {
        resetDeleteImageModal();
        return;
      }
      const imageUrl = info.uploadedImageUrls[imageIdx];
      const imageName = imageUrl.split('/').pop();
      if (!imageName) {
        resetDeleteImageModal();
        return;
      }
      try {
        await removeProductInfoImage(info.createdId, imageName);
        // Update local state immediately
        setProductInfos((prev) => {
          const updated = [...prev];
          updated[infoIdx].uploadedImageUrls.splice(imageIdx, 1);
          return updated;
        });
        showSnackbar('Image removed successfully', { severity: 'success' });
      } catch (error) {
        showSnackbar((error as Error).message, { severity: 'error' });
      } finally {
        resetDeleteImageModal();
      }
    }
  }, [
    deleteImageModal,
    handleRemoveSelectedImage,
    removeProductInfoImage,
    productInfos,
    showSnackbar,
    resetDeleteImageModal,
  ]);
  const handleCloseDeleteImageModal = useCallback(() => {
    resetDeleteImageModal();
  }, [resetDeleteImageModal]);
  const handleOpenEditColorModal = useCallback(
    (color: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Color) => {
      setSelectedColor(color);
      setIsEditColorModalOpen(true);
    },
    []
  );
  const handleCloseColorModal = useCallback(() => {
    setIsNewColorModalOpen(false);
    setIsEditColorModalOpen(false);
    setSelectedColor(null);
  }, []);
  const handleSaveColor = useCallback(
    async (id: number | null, name: string, hexCode: string) => {
      try {
        if (id) {
          await updateColor(id, name, hexCode);
          showSnackbar('Color updated successfully', { severity: 'success' });
        } else {
          await createColor(name, hexCode);
          showSnackbar('Color created successfully', { severity: 'success' });
        }
        handleCloseColorModal();
      } catch (error) {
        showSnackbar((error as Error).message, { severity: 'error' });
      }
    },
    [createColor, updateColor, showSnackbar, handleCloseColorModal]
  );
  const handleDeleteColor = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!colorToDelete) return;
    try {
      await deleteColor(colorToDelete.id);
      setIsDeleteColorModalOpen(false);
      setColorToDelete(null);
      showSnackbar('Color deleted successfully', { severity: 'success' });
    } catch (error) {
      showSnackbar((error as Error).message, { severity: 'error' });
    }
  }, [colorToDelete, deleteColor, showSnackbar]);
  const handleOpenDeleteColorModal = useCallback(
    (color: { id: number; name: string }) => {
      setColorToDelete(color);
      setIsDeleteColorModalOpen(true);
    },
    []
  );
  const handleCloseDeleteColorModal = useCallback(() => {
    setIsDeleteColorModalOpen(false);
    setColorToDelete(null);
  }, []);
  const handleUploadSelectedImages = useCallback(
    async (infoIdx: number) => {
      const info = productInfos[infoIdx];
      if (!info.newImages.length || !info.createdId) {
        return;
      }
      setProductInfos((prev) => {
        const updated = [...prev];
        updated[infoIdx].isUploading = true;
        return updated;
      });
      try {
        const uploadedImages = await uploadProductInfoImages(
          info.createdId,
          info.newImages
        );
        // Update local state immediately with the uploaded images
        setProductInfos((prev) => {
          const updated = [...prev];
          updated[infoIdx].newImages = [];
          updated[infoIdx].newImagePreviews = [];
          updated[infoIdx].isUploading = false;
          // Add the newly uploaded images to the uploadedImageUrls array
          if (uploadedImages && uploadedImages.length > 0) {
            updated[infoIdx].uploadedImageUrls = [
              ...updated[infoIdx].uploadedImageUrls,
              ...uploadedImages,
            ];
          }
          return updated;
        });
        showSnackbar('Images uploaded successfully', { severity: 'success' });
      } catch (error) {
        setProductInfos((prev) => {
          const updated = [...prev];
          updated[infoIdx].isUploading = false;
          return updated;
        });
        showSnackbar((error as Error).message, { severity: 'error' });
      }
    },
    [productInfos, uploadProductInfoImages, showSnackbar]
  );
  const formAndTitle = (
    <>
      {!embedded && (
        <Typography
          variant="h5"
          sx={{ mb: 3, color: theme.palette.text.primary }}
        >
          {productIdNum ? LL.products.editProduct() : LL.products.addProduct()}
        </Typography>
      )}
      <form aria-label="Product Editor Form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
        <Grid container spacing={3} sx={{ height: '100%' }}>
          {/* Left Side - Basic Product Info */}
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
            <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
              {LL.products.productDetails()}
            </Typography>
            <Paper
              elevation={0}
              sx={{
                mb: 2,
                p: 2,
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                gap: 2,
                backgroundColor:
                  theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
                    ? 'rgba(18, 18, 22, 0.88)'
                    : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96)',
                border:
                  theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
                    ? '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)'
                    : '1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)',
                borderRadius: '16px',
                boxShadow:
                  theme.palette.mode === 'dark'
                    ? '0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)'
                    : '0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)',
              }}
            >
              <TextField
                id="product-name"
                slotProps={{
                  input: { 'aria-label': 'Product Name' },
                }}
                fullWidth
                label={LL.form.productName()}
                name="name"
                value={product.name}
                onChange={handleProductChange}
                required
              />
              <TextField
                id="product-sku"
                fullWidth
                label={LL.form.sku()}
                name="sku"
                value={product.sku}
                onChange={handleProductChange}
                required
                {...getLtrTextFieldProps()}
                slotProps={{
                  htmlInput: { dir: 'ltr', 'aria-label': 'SKU' },
                }}
              />
              <Box>
                <Autocomplete
                  multiple
                  disableCloseOnSelect
                  openOnFocus
                  clearOnBlur={false}
                  open={categoriesAutocomplete.open}
                  onOpen={categoriesAutocomplete.onOpen}
                  onClose={categoriesAutocomplete.onClose}
                  id="categories-autocomplete"
                  options={categories || []}
                  getOptionLabel={(option) => option.name}
                  value={
                    categories?.filter((cat) =>
                      product.categoryIds.includes(cat.id)
                    ) || []
                  }
                  onChange={(_e, newValue, reason) => {
                    if (
                      reason === 'selectOption' ||
                      reason === 'removeOption'
                    ) {
                      categoriesAutocomplete.markSelection();
                    }
                    setProduct((prev) => ({
                      ...prev,
                      categoryIds: newValue.map((category) => category.id),
                    }));
                  }}
                  loading={getCategoriesLoading}
                  renderInput={(params) => (
                    <TextField
                      {...params}
                      label={LL.form.category()}
                      slotProps={{
                        input: {
                          ...params.InputProps,
                          'aria-label': 'Category',
                        },
                      }}
                    />
                  )}
                  isOptionEqualToValue={(option, value) =>
                    option.id === value.id
                  }
                  filterSelectedOptions
                  slotProps={{
                    listbox: multiSelectListboxSlotProps,
                  }}
                />
                <Button
                  variant="outlined"
                  onClick={() => setIsManageCategoriesModalOpen(true)}
                  sx={{ mt: 1 }}
                  fullWidth={isMobile}
                >
                  {LL.categories.manageCategories()}
                </Button>
              </Box>
              <Box>
                <Autocomplete
                  id="brand-autocomplete"
                  options={brands || []}
                  getOptionLabel={(option) => option.name}
                  value={
                    brands?.find((b) => b.id === product.brandId) || null
                  }
                  onChange={(_e, newValue) => {
                    setProduct((prev) => ({
                      ...prev,
                      brandId: newValue?.id ?? null,
                    }));
                  }}
                  loading={getBrandsLoading}
                  renderInput={(params) => (
                    <TextField
                      {...params}
                      label={LL.form.brand()}
                      slotProps={{
                        input: {
                          ...params.InputProps,
                          'aria-label': 'Brand',
                        },
                      }}
                    />
                  )}
                  isOptionEqualToValue={(option, value) =>
                    option.id === value.id
                  }
                />
              </Box>
              <Box sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                <Typography
                  variant="subtitle2"
                  sx={{ mb: 1, fontWeight: 600, color: 'text.secondary' }}
                >
                  {LL.form.description()}
                </Typography>
                <Tabs
                  value={activeDescTab}
                  onChange={handleDescTabChange}
                  variant="scrollable"
                  scrollButtons="auto"
                  sx={{ borderBottom: 1, borderColor: 'divider', mb: 1.5 }}
                >
                  {languagesToDisplay.map((lang) => {
                    const hasContent = Boolean(descriptions[lang.code]?.trim());
                    return (
                      <Tab
                        key={lang.code}
                        value={lang.code}
                        label={
                          <Box
                            sx={{
                              display: 'flex',
                              alignItems: 'center',
                              gap: 0.75,
                            }}
                          >
                            <span>
                              {lang.nativeName} ({lang.name})
                            </span>
                            {hasContent && (
                              <Chip
                                size="small"
                                label="✓"
                                color="success"
                                sx={{
                                  height: 18,
                                  fontSize: '0.7rem',
                                  px: 0.25,
                                }}
                              />
                            )}
                          </Box>
                        }
                      />
                    );
                  })}
                </Tabs>
                {languagesToDisplay.map((lang) => {
                  if (activeDescTab !== lang.code) return null;
                  return (
                    <TextField
                      key={lang.code}
                      id={`product-description-${lang.code}`}
                      label={`${LL.form.description()} (${lang.nativeName})`}
                      name={`description-${lang.code}`}
                      value={descriptions[lang.code] || ''}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        handleDescriptionChange(lang.code, e.target.value)
                      }
                      fullWidth
                      multiline
                      minRows={3}
                      maxRows={8}
                      dir={lang.isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}
                      slotProps={{
                        htmlInput: {
                          'data-testid': `product-description-${lang.code}`,
                        },
                      }}
                      placeholder={
                        lang.isRTL
                          ? 'توضیحات محصول را به زبان فارسی وارد کنید...'
                          : 'Enter product description in English...'
                      }
                      helperText={
                        lang.isDefault
                          ? 'زبان پیش‌فرض سایت / Default site language'
                          : undefined
                      }
                    />
                  );
                })}
              </Box>
            </Paper>
          </Grid>
          {/* Right Side - ProductInfos Section */}
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
            <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
              {LL.products.productVariants()}
            </Typography>
            {productInfos.map((info, idx) => (
              <ProductInfoCard
                key={idx}
                info={info}
                idx={idx}
                onChange={handleProductInfoChange}
                onColorsChange={(idx, colors: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Color[]) =>
                  setProductInfos((prev) => {
                    const updated = [...prev];
                    updated[idx] = { ...updated[idx], colors };
                    return updated;
                  })
                }
                availableColors={
                  (availableColors as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Color[])?.filter(
                    (color): color is KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Color =>
                      color != null
                  ) || []
                }
                onManageColors={
                  idx === 0 ? () => setIsManageColorsModalOpen(true) : undefined
                }
                manageColorsDisabled={colorMutationsLoading}
                onRemove={handleRemoveProductInfo}
                disableRemove={productInfos.length === 1}
                onRemoveImage={(infoIdx: number, imageIdx: number) => {
                  const info = productInfos[infoIdx];
                  // Check if it's a selected image (newImagePreviews) or uploaded image (uploadedImageUrls)
                  if (imageIdx < info.newImagePreviews.length) {
                    // It's a selected image - show confirmation modal
                    setDeleteImageModal({
                      open: true,
                      infoIdx,
                      imageIdx,
                      imageType: 'preview',
                      isLoading: false,
                    });
                  } else {
                    // It's an uploaded image - show confirmation modal
                    const actualImageIdx =
                      imageIdx - info.newImagePreviews.length;
                    setDeleteImageModal({
                      open: true,
                      infoIdx,
                      imageIdx: actualImageIdx,
                      imageType: 'uploaded',
                      isLoading: false,
                    });
                  }
                }}
                onUploadSelectedImages={handleUploadSelectedImages}
                setProductInfos={setProductInfos}
                LL={LL}
              />
            ))}
            <Button
              variant="outlined"
              startIcon={<AddIcon />}
              onClick={handleAddProductInfo}
              sx={{ mt: 2 }}
              disabled={isCreatingProduct}
              fullWidth={isMobile}
            >
              {LL.products.addVariant()}
            </Button>
          </Grid>
          {/* Save Button */}
          <Grid size={12} sx={{ mt: 'auto' }}>
            <Box
              sx={{
                display: 'flex',
                justifyContent: { xs: 'stretch', md: 'flex-end' },
              }}
            >
              <Button
                type="submit"
                variant="contained"
                color="primary"
                sx={{ textTransform: 'none' }}
                loading={isCreatingProduct}
                fullWidth={isMobile}
              >
                {LL.products.saveProduct()}
              </Button>
            </Box>
          </Grid>
        </Grid>
      </form>
    </>
  );
  const modals = (
    <>
      <ManageCategoriesModal
        open={isManageCategoriesModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsManageCategoriesModalOpen(false)}
        categories={categories || []}
        onAdd={() => setIsNewCategoryModalOpen(true)}
        onEdit={(category) => {
          setSelectedCategory(category);
          setIsEditCategoryModalOpen(true);
        }}
        onDelete={handleOpenDeleteCategoryModal}
        isLoading={
          isCreatingCategory || isUpdatingCategory || isDeletingCategory
        }
        LL={LL}
      />
      <CategoryModal
        open={isNewCategoryModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsNewCategoryModalOpen(false)}
        onSubmit={async (name) => {
          try {
            const slug = slugify(name);
            await createCategory(slug, 0, name);
            setIsNewCategoryModalOpen(false);
            showSnackbar('Category created successfully', {
              severity: 'success',
            });
          } catch (error) {
            const message = (error as Error).message;
            if (message.includes('already exists')) {
              showSnackbar(message, { severity: 'error' });
            } else {
              showSnackbar((error as Error).message, { severity: 'error' });
            }
          }
        }}
        title={LL.categories.addCategory()}
        isLoading={isCreatingCategory}
        LL={LL}
      />
      <CategoryModal
        open={isEditCategoryModalOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsEditCategoryModalOpen(false);
          setSelectedCategory(null);
        }}
        onSubmit={async (name) => {
          try {
            if (selectedCategory) {
              const slug = slugify(name);
              await updateCategory(
                selectedCategory.id,
                slug,
                undefined,
                undefined,
                name
              );
            }
            setIsEditCategoryModalOpen(false);
            setSelectedCategory(null);
            showSnackbar('Category updated successfully', {
              severity: 'success',
            });
          } catch (error) {
            const message = (error as Error).message;
            if (message.includes('already exists')) {
              showSnackbar(message, { severity: 'error' });
            } else {
              showSnackbar((error as Error).message, { severity: 'error' });
            }
          }
        }}
        initialName={selectedCategory?.name || ''}
        title={LL.categories.editCategory()}
        isLoading={isUpdatingCategory}
        LL={LL}
      />
      <DeleteCategoryModal
        open={isDeleteCategoryModalOpen}
        onClose={handleCloseDeleteCategoryModal}
        onConfirm={handleDeleteCategory}
        categoryName={categoryToDelete?.name || ''}
        isLoading={isDeletingCategory}
        LL={LL}
      />
      <DeleteImageModal
        open={deleteImageModal.open}
        onClose={handleCloseDeleteImageModal}
        onConfirm={handleConfirmDeleteImage}
        imageType={
          deleteImageModal.imageType === 'preview' ? 'preview' : 'uploaded'
        }
        isLoading={deleteImageModal.isLoading}
        LL={LL}
      />
      <ManageColorsModal
        open={isManageColorsModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsManageColorsModalOpen(false)}
        colors={
          (availableColors as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Color[])?.filter(
            (color): color is KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Color => color != null
          ) || []
        }
        onAdd={() => {
          setSelectedColor(null);
          setIsNewColorModalOpen(true);
        }}
        onEdit={handleOpenEditColorModal}
        onDelete={handleOpenDeleteColorModal}
        isLoading={colorMutationsLoading}
        LL={LL}
      />
      <ColorModal
        open={isNewColorModalOpen || isEditColorModalOpen}
        onClose={handleCloseColorModal}
        onSubmit={handleSaveColor}
        initialColor={selectedColor}
        title={
          selectedColor
            ? LL.colorManagement.editColor()
            : LL.colorManagement.addNewColor()
        }
        isLoading={colorMutationsLoading}
        LL={LL}
      />
      <DeleteColorModal
        open={isDeleteColorModalOpen}
        onClose={handleCloseDeleteColorModal}
        onConfirm={handleDeleteColor}
        colorName={colorToDelete?.name || ''}
        isLoading={colorMutationsLoading}
        LL={LL}
      />
    </>
  );
  if (embedded) {
    return (
      <>
        {formAndTitle}
        {modals}
      </>
    );
  }
  return (
    <LayoutComponent>
      <GlassmorphismContainer>{formAndTitle}</GlassmorphismContainer>
      {modals}
    </LayoutComponent>
  );
}
export default AdminProductEditor;
</file>

import {
  sellerCreateFormSchema,
  sellerEditFormSchema,
  type SellerCreateFormInput,
  type SellerEditFormInput,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
type Seller = NonNullable<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SellerInfo>;
type CreateSellerInput = KickzoneGraphqlTypes.CreateSellerInput;
type SellerFilterInput = KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SellerFilterInput;
// Form validation uses 'PAY_ON_DELIVERY' | 'PAY_ONLINE' (matches server enum)
type ShippingPaymentMode = 'PAY_ON_DELIVERY' | 'PAY_ONLINE';
// Use Omit to avoid conflict with GraphQL enum type in CreateSellerInput
type SellerFormData = Omit<Partial<CreateSellerInput>, 'shippingPaymentMode'> & { 
  canManageCatalog?: boolean;
  shippingPaymentMode?: ShippingPaymentMode;
};
export const SellerManagement = () => {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  usePageTitle(() => LL.pageTitles.adminSellers());
  const { isRTL } = useLanguageContext();
  const { alignment, isFarsi, currentLocale } = useTableAlignment();
  // Convert Western numerals to Farsi numerals
  const toFarsiNumber = (num: number | string): string => {
    const farsiDigits = ['۰', '۱', '۲', '۳', '۴', '۵', '۶', '۷', '۸', '۹'];
    return String(num).replace(/\d/g, (digit) => farsiDigits[parseInt(digit)]);
  };
  // Format numbers in strings for Farsi locale
  const formatNumbersInString = (str: string): string => {
    if (currentLocale !== 'fa') return str;
    return str.replace(/\d+/g, (match) => toFarsiNumber(match));
  };
  // Use built-in MaterialReactTable localizations and merge with custom overrides
  const baseLocalization =
    currentLocale === 'fa'
      ? MRT_Localization_FA
      : currentLocale === 'en'
      ? MRT_Localization_EN
      : MRT_Localization_EN; // Fallback to English
  // Merge with custom translations and format numbers
  const tableLocalization: Partial<MRT_Localization> = {
    ...baseLocalization,
    // Override sort strings with correct Farsi word order
    // MaterialReactTable expects string templates with {column} placeholder
    sortByColumnAsc: formatNumbersInString(
      LL.tableMenu.sortByColumnAsc({ column: '{column}' })
    ),
    sortByColumnDesc: formatNumbersInString(
      LL.tableMenu.sortByColumnDesc({ column: '{column}' })
    ),
    sortedByColumnAsc: formatNumbersInString(
      LL.tableMenu.sortedByColumnAsc({ column: '{column}' })
    ),
    sortedByColumnDesc: formatNumbersInString(
      LL.tableMenu.sortedByColumnDesc({ column: '{column}' })
    ),
  };
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<SellerFilterInput>({
    isActive: true,
  });
  const {
    createSeller,
    updateSeller,
    toggleSellerActive,
    initiateSellerPasswordSetup,
    isCreatingSeller,
    isUpdatingSeller,
    isTogglingSellerActive,
  } = useAdminsSellers(filter);
  const env = (
    import.meta as unknown as {
      env: {
        VITE_SELLERS_BASE_URL?: string;
        VITE_SELLERS_FRONTEND_URL?: string;
      };
    }
  ).env;
  const sellersPortalBaseUrl =
    env.VITE_SELLERS_BASE_URL ||
    env.VITE_SELLERS_FRONTEND_URL ||
    'https://seller.saintbala.com'; // default to prod host to avoid localhost links in prod builds
  const [resendingSellerId, setResendingSellerId] = useState<number | null>(
    null
  );
  const { sellers, isLoadingSellers, sellersError, refetchSellers } =
    useAdminsSellersQuery(filter);
  const sellersData = useMemo(
    () => sellers?.edges?.map((edge) => edge.node) || [],
    [sellers]
  );
  const [createModalOpen, setCreateModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editModalOpen, setEditModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [deleteModalOpen, setDeleteModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedSeller, setSelectedSeller] = useState<Seller | null>(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<SellerFormData>({});
  const sellerFormValues = {
    name: formData.name ?? '',
    lastName: formData.lastName ?? '',
    username: formData.username ?? '',
    email: formData.email ?? '',
    storeName: formData.storeName ?? '',
    phone: formData.phone,
    address: formData.address,
    shippingFee: formData.shippingFee,
    canManageCatalog: formData.canManageCatalog,
    shippingPaymentMode: formData.shippingPaymentMode ?? 'PAY_ON_DELIVERY',
  };
  const createForm = useForm<SellerCreateFormInput>({
    values: sellerFormValues,
    resolver: zodResolver(sellerCreateFormSchema),
    mode: 'onSubmit',
  });
  const editForm = useForm<SellerEditFormInput>({
    values: sellerFormValues,
    resolver: zodResolver(sellerEditFormSchema),
    mode: 'onSubmit',
  });
  const sellerErrors = editModalOpen
    ? editForm.formState.errors
    : createForm.formState.errors;
  const [usernameConfirmation, setUsernameConfirmation] = useState('');
  const [needsReconfirmation, setNeedsReconfirmation] = useState(false);
  const { showSnackbar } = useSnackbar();
  // Refetch sellers when filter changes
  useEffect(() => {
    refetchSellers();
  }, [filter, refetchSellers]);
  // Handle query errors (non-auth errors)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (sellersError) {
      console.error('Sellers query error:', sellersError);
      // Only show snackbar for non-authentication errors
      // Authentication errors are handled by Apollo client error link
      if (
        !sellersError.message.includes('Forbidden') &&
        !sellersError.message.includes('Unauthorized') &&
        !sellersError.message.includes('Authentication')
      ) {
        showSnackbar(`Error loading sellers: ${sellersError.message}`, {
          severity: 'error',
        });
      }
    }
  }, [sellersError, showSnackbar]);
  const columns: MRT_ColumnDef<Seller>[] = useMemo(() => {
    const dataColumns: MRT_ColumnDef<Seller>[] = [
      createRTLTextColumn<Seller>('user.name', LL.table.name(), { alignment }),
      createRTLTextColumn<Seller>('user.lastName', LL.table.lastName(), {
        alignment,
      }),
      createRTLTextColumn<Seller>('user.username', LL.table.username(), {
        alignment,
      }),
      createRTLTextColumn<Seller>('user.email', LL.table.email(), {
        alignment,
      }),
      createRTLTextColumn<Seller>('storeName', LL.table.storeName(), {
        alignment,
      }),
      createRTLTextColumn<Seller>('phone', LL.table.phone(), { alignment }),
      createRTLTextColumn<Seller>('address', LL.table.address(), { alignment }),
      {
        accessorKey: 'shippingFee',
        header: 'Shipping Fee',
        ...getRTLColumnProps(alignment),
        Cell: ({ row }) => `$${row.original.shippingFee?.toFixed(2) || '0.00'}`,
      },
      {
        accessorKey: 'shippingPaymentMode',
        header: currentLocale === 'fa' ? 'نحوه پرداخت ارسال' : 'Shipping Payment',
        ...getRTLColumnProps(alignment),
        Cell: ({ row }) =>
          row.original.shippingPaymentMode === 'PAY_ONLINE'
            ? currentLocale === 'fa'
              ? 'پرداخت آنلاین'
              : 'Pay Online'
            : currentLocale === 'fa'
            ? 'پرداخت در محل (پست)'
            : 'Pay on Delivery',
      },
      {
        ...createRTLStatusColumn<Seller>('isActive', LL.table.status(), {
          alignment,
          activeColor: 'success.main',
          inactiveColor: 'error.main',
          getIsActive: (row) => row.isActive,
        }),
        Cell: ({ row }) => {
          const statusText = row.original.isActive
            ? LL.table.active()
            : LL.table.inactive();
          return (
            <RTLStatusCell
              alignment={alignment}
              value={statusText}
              isActive={row.original.isActive}
              activeColor="success.main"
              inactiveColor="error.main"
            />
          );
        },
      },
      {
        accessorKey: 'canManageCatalog',
        header: 'Catalog Manager',
        ...getRTLColumnProps(alignment),
        Cell: ({ row }) => (row.original.canManageCatalog ? 'Yes' : 'No'),
      },
    ];
    const actionsColumn: MRT_ColumnDef<Seller> = {
      id: 'actions',
      header: LL.table.actions(),
      ...getRTLColumnProps(alignment),
      Cell: ({ row }) => (
        <Box
          sx={{

        >
          <Tooltip title={LL.button.edit()}>
            <IconButton

                setSelectedSeller(row.original);
                setFormData({
                  name: row.original.user.name,
                  lastName: row.original.user.lastName || '',
                  username: row.original.user.username,
                  email: row.original.user.email,
                  storeName: row.original.storeName,
                  phone: row.original.phone,
                  address: row.original.address,
                  shippingFee: row.original.shippingFee,
                  canManageCatalog: row.original.canManageCatalog,
                  shippingPaymentMode: row.original.shippingPaymentMode || 'PAY_ON_DELIVERY',

            >

          </Tooltip>
          <Tooltip title={LL.authorization.resendPasswordEmail()}>
            <span>
              <IconButton
                disabled={resendingSellerId === row.original.id}
                onClick={async () => {
                  setResendingSellerId(row.original.id);
                  try {
                    await initiateSellerPasswordSetup({
                      variables: {
                        email: row.original.user.email,
                        baseUrl: sellersPortalBaseUrl,
                      },
                    });
                    showSnackbar(LL.authorization.passwordEmailSent(), {
                      severity: 'success',
                    });
                  } catch (error) {
                    const err = error as Error;
                    showSnackbar(err.message, { severity: 'error' });
                  } finally {
                    setResendingSellerId(null);
                  }
                }}
              >
                <MarkEmailReadIcon />
              </IconButton>
            </span>
          </Tooltip>
          <Tooltip
            title={
              row.original.isActive
                ? LL.authorization.deactivateSeller()
                : LL.authorization.activateSeller()
            }
          >
            <IconButton
              onClick={() => {
                setSelectedSeller(row.original);
                setDeleteModalOpen(true);
                setUsernameConfirmation('');
                setNeedsReconfirmation(false);
              }}
              color={row.original.isActive ? 'error' : 'success'}
            >
              {row.original.isActive ? <PersonOffIcon /> : <GroupAddIcon />}
            </IconButton>
          </Tooltip>
        </Box>
      ),
    };
    // For RTL languages, put actions column last (right side)
    // For LTR languages, put actions column last (right side) as well
    return [...dataColumns, actionsColumn];
  }, [
    LL,
    isRTL,
    alignment,
    initiateSellerPasswordSetup,
    resendingSellerId,
    sellersPortalBaseUrl,
    showSnackbar,
  ]);
  const handleDeleteConfirm = async () => {
    if (!selectedSeller) return;
    if (!needsReconfirmation) {
      setNeedsReconfirmation(true);
      return;
    }
    try {
      await toggleSellerActive({ variables: { id: selectedSeller.id } });
      setDeleteModalOpen(false);
      setSelectedSeller(null);
      setUsernameConfirmation('');
      setNeedsReconfirmation(false);
      showSnackbar('Seller status updated successfully', {
        severity: 'success',
      });
      refetchSellers();
    } catch (err) {
      const error = err as Error;
      showSnackbar(error.message, {
        severity: 'error',
      });
    }
  };
  const handleUsernameConfirmationChange = (
    e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>
  ) => {
    setUsernameConfirmation(e.target.value);
  };
  const isDeleteEnabled =
    selectedSeller && usernameConfirmation === selectedSeller.user.username;
  const table = useMaterialReactTable<Seller>({
    columns,
    data: sellersData,
    state: { isLoading: isLoadingSellers },
    enableRowActions: false, // Disable built-in row actions to prevent duplicate actions column
    enableColumnOrdering: false, // Disable manual column ordering to respect our order
    localization: tableLocalization,
    ...getRTLTableProps({ alignment, isFarsi }),
    renderTopToolbarCustomActions: () => (
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 1 }}>
        <Button
          color="primary"
          onClick={() => {
            setFormData({});
            setCreateModalOpen(true);
          }}
          startIcon={<AddIcon />}
          variant="contained"
        >
          {LL.button.addSeller()}
        </Button>
        <Button
          color={filter.isActive ? 'error' : 'success'}
          onClick={() =>
            setFilter((prev: SellerFilterInput) => ({
              ...prev,
              isActive: !prev.isActive,
            }))
          }
          variant="outlined"
        >
          {filter.isActive ? LL.button.showInactive() : LL.button.showActive()}
        </Button>
      </Box>
    ),
  });
  const handleCreateSubmit = async () => {
    try {
      if (!(await createForm.trigger())) return;
      const rawFee = formData.shippingFee as number | string | undefined | null;
      const shippingFeeValue =
        rawFee === undefined || rawFee === null || rawFee === ''
          ? 0
          : Number(rawFee);
      await createSeller({
        variables: {
          createSellerInput: {
            ...formData,
            shippingFee: Number.isFinite(shippingFeeValue)
              ? shippingFeeValue
              : 0,
            canManageCatalog: formData.canManageCatalog ?? false,
            // Form string literal -> generated GraphQL enum type (same values)
            shippingPaymentMode: (formData.shippingPaymentMode ?? 'PAY_ON_DELIVERY') as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ShippingPaymentMode,
            password: 'defaultPassword123',
          } as CreateSellerInput,
        },
      });
      setCreateModalOpen(false);
      setFormData({});
    } catch (err) {
      const error = err as Error;
      showSnackbar(error.message, {
        severity: 'error',
      });
    }
  };
  const handleEditSubmit = async () => {
    if (!selectedSeller) return;
    if (!(await editForm.trigger())) return;
    try {
      await updateSeller({
        variables: {
          updateSellerInput: {
            id: selectedSeller.id,
            name: formData.name || undefined,
            lastName: formData.lastName || undefined,
            username: formData.username || undefined,
            email: formData.email || undefined,
            storeName: formData.storeName || undefined,
            phone: formData.phone || undefined,
            address: formData.address || undefined,
            shippingFee:
              formData.shippingFee !== undefined
                ? Number(formData.shippingFee)
                : undefined,
            canManageCatalog: formData.canManageCatalog,
            // Form string literal -> generated GraphQL enum type (same values)
            shippingPaymentMode: formData.shippingPaymentMode as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ShippingPaymentMode,
          },
        },
      });
      setEditModalOpen(false);
      setSelectedSeller(null);
      setFormData({});
    } catch (err) {
      const error = err as Error;
      showSnackbar(error.message, {
        severity: 'error',
      });
    }
  };
  const handleInputChange = (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const { name, value, type, checked } = e.target;
    setFormData((prev: SellerFormData) => ({
      ...prev,
      [name]: type === 'checkbox' ? checked : value,
    }));
  };
  const renderForm = () => (
    <>
      <TextField
        fullWidth
        required
        name="name"
        label={LL.table.name()}
        value={formData.name || ''}
        error={Boolean(sellerErrors.name)}
        onChange={handleInputChange}
      />
      <TextField
        fullWidth
        required
        name="lastName"
        label={LL.table.lastName()}
        value={formData.lastName || ''}
        error={Boolean(sellerErrors.lastName)}
        onChange={handleInputChange}
      />
      <TextField
        fullWidth
        required
        name="username"
        label={LL.table.username()}
        value={formData.username || ''}
        error={Boolean(sellerErrors.username)}
        onChange={handleInputChange}
        {...getLtrTextFieldProps()}
      />
      <TextField
        fullWidth
        required
        name="email"
        label={LL.table.email()}
        type="email"
        value={formData.email || ''}
        error={Boolean(sellerErrors.email)}
        onChange={handleInputChange}
        {...getLtrTextFieldProps()}
      />
      <TextField
        fullWidth
        required
        name="storeName"
        label={LL.table.storeName()}
        value={formData.storeName || ''}
        error={Boolean(sellerErrors.storeName)}
        onChange={handleInputChange}
      />
      <TextField
        fullWidth
        required
        name="phone"
        label={LL.table.phone()}
        value={formData.phone || ''}
        onChange={handleInputChange}
        {...getLtrTextFieldProps()}
      />
      <TextField
        fullWidth
        required
        name="address"
        label={LL.table.address()}
        value={formData.address || ''}
        onChange={handleInputChange}
      />
      <TextField
        fullWidth
        name="shippingFee"
        label="Shipping Fee ($)"
        type="number"
        value={formData.shippingFee || ''}
        error={Boolean(sellerErrors.shippingFee)}
        onChange={handleInputChange}
        sx={getLtrTextFieldProps().sx}
        slotProps={{
          htmlInput: {
            dir: 'ltr',
            step: '0.01',
            min: '0',
          },
        }}
      />
      <FormControlLabel
        control={
          <Switch
            checked={formData.canManageCatalog ?? false}
            onChange={handleInputChange}
            name="canManageCatalog"
          />
        }
        label="Can manage catalog (define products)"
      />
      <FormControlLabel
        control={
          <Switch
            checked={formData.shippingPaymentMode === 'PAY_ONLINE'}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setFormData((prev: SellerFormData) => ({
                ...prev,
                shippingPaymentMode: e.target.checked ? 'PAY_ONLINE' : 'PAY_ON_DELIVERY',
              }));
            }}
            data-testid="seller-shipping-payment-mode-switch"
            name="shippingPaymentMode"
          />
        }
        label={
          currentLocale === 'fa'
            ? 'دریافت آنلاین هزینه ارسال (در غیر این صورت: پرداخت در محل به پست)'
            : 'Charge shipping online (otherwise: Pay on Delivery)'
        }
      />
    </>
  );
  return (
    <AdminsLayout>
      <GlassmorphismContainer fullHeight>
        <MaterialReactTable
          table={table}
          key={`seller-table-${isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}`}
        />
        {/* Create Modal */}
        <Dialog
          open={createModalOpen}
          onClose={() => !isCreatingSeller && setCreateModalOpen(false)}
          maxWidth="sm"
          fullWidth
        >
          <DialogTitle>Create New Seller</DialogTitle>
          <DialogFormContent>{renderForm()}</DialogFormContent>
          <DialogActions>
            <Button
              onClick={() => setCreateModalOpen(false)}
              disabled={isCreatingSeller}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              onClick={handleCreateSubmit}
              variant="contained"
              color="primary"
              loading={isCreatingSeller}
            >
              Create
            </Button>
          </DialogActions>
        </Dialog>
        {/* Edit Modal */}
        <Dialog
          open={editModalOpen}
          onClose={() => !isUpdatingSeller && setEditModalOpen(false)}
          maxWidth="sm"
          fullWidth
        >
          <DialogTitle>Edit Seller</DialogTitle>
          <DialogFormContent>{renderForm()}</DialogFormContent>
          <DialogActions>
            <Button
              onClick={() => setEditModalOpen(false)}
              disabled={isUpdatingSeller}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              onClick={handleEditSubmit}
              variant="contained"
              color="primary"
              loading={isUpdatingSeller}
            >
              Save
            </Button>
          </DialogActions>
        </Dialog>
        {/* Delete Confirmation Modal */}
        <Dialog
          open={deleteModalOpen}
          onClose={() => {
            setDeleteModalOpen(false);
            setSelectedSeller(null);
            setUsernameConfirmation('');
            setNeedsReconfirmation(false);
          }}
          maxWidth="sm"
          fullWidth
        >
          <DialogTitle>
            {needsReconfirmation
              ? `Final Confirmation to ${
                  selectedSeller?.isActive ? 'Deactivate' : 'Activate'
                }`
              : `Confirm ${
                  selectedSeller?.isActive ? 'Deactivation' : 'Activation'
                }`}
          </DialogTitle>
          <DialogFormContent>
            <Alert
              severity={selectedSeller?.isActive ? 'error' : 'success'}
            >
              <Typography variant="subtitle1" fontWeight="bold">
                {selectedSeller?.isActive
                  ? 'Warning: This action will deactivate the seller account!'
                  : 'This action will reactivate the seller account.'}
              </Typography>
              <Typography>
                You are about to{' '}
                {selectedSeller?.isActive ? 'deactivate' : 'activate'} the
                seller account for{' '}
                <strong>{selectedSeller?.user.username}</strong>.
              </Typography>
            </Alert>
            <Typography>
              {LL.authorization.confirmAction()}{' '}
              <strong>{selectedSeller?.user.username}</strong>
            </Typography>
            <TextField
              fullWidth
              label={LL.authorization.enterUsername()}
              value={usernameConfirmation}
              onChange={handleUsernameConfirmationChange}
              error={usernameConfirmation !== '' && !isDeleteEnabled}
              helperText={
                usernameConfirmation !== '' && !isDeleteEnabled
                  ? LL.authorization.usernameMismatch()
                  : ''
              }
              {...getLtrTextFieldProps()}
            />
          </DialogFormContent>
          <DialogActions>
            <Button
              onClick={() => {
                setDeleteModalOpen(false);
                setSelectedSeller(null);
                setUsernameConfirmation('');
                setNeedsReconfirmation(false);
              }}
              disabled={isTogglingSellerActive}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              onClick={handleDeleteConfirm}
              variant="contained"
              color={selectedSeller?.isActive ? 'error' : 'success'}
              disabled={!isDeleteEnabled}
              loading={isTogglingSellerActive}
            >
              {needsReconfirmation
                ? 'Reconfirm'
                : selectedSeller?.isActive
                ? 'Deactivate Anyway'
                : 'Activate Anyway'}
            </Button>
          </DialogActions>
        </Dialog>
      </GlassmorphismContainer>
    </AdminsLayout>
  );
};
export default SellerManagement;
</file>

const API_BASE_URL =
  (import.meta as unknown as { env?: Record<string, string> }).env?.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '';
const resolveImageUrl = (img?: string | null) => {
  if (!img) return null;
  if (img.startsWith('http://') || img.startsWith('https://')) return img;
  if (img.startsWith('//')) return `https:${img}`;
  if (img.startsWith('/')) {
    const base =
      API_BASE_URL && API_BASE_URL.startsWith('http')
        ? API_BASE_URL
        : typeof window !== 'undefined'
        ? window.location.origin
        : '';
    return `${base}${img}`;
  }
  return img;
};
export function extractBrand(productName: string, fallback = 'Nike'): string {
  const normalized = (productName || '').trim();
  const brands = [
    'Nike',
    'Jordan',
    'Adidas',
    'Puma',
    'New Balance',
    'Under Armour',
    'Reebok',
    'Asics',
    'Converse',
    'Vans',
  ];
  for (const b of brands) {
    if (new RegExp(`^${b}\\b`, 'i').test(normalized)) {
      return b;
    }
  }
  const firstWord = normalized.split(/\s+/)[0];
  if (firstWord && /^[A-Za-z]+$/.test(firstWord)) {
    return firstWord.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + firstWord.slice(1).toLowerCase();
  }
  return fallback;
}
export function resolveProductBrand(
  product: {
    name: string;
    brand?: { name?: string | null; slug?: string | null } | null;
  },
  fallback = 'Nike'
): string {
  if (product.brand?.name?.trim()) return product.brand.name.trim();
  return extractBrand(product.name, fallback);
}
export function formatToman(priceUSD: number, rate = 270000, discount = 0): string {
  const finalUSD = discount > 0 ? priceUSD * (1 - discount / 100) : priceUSD;
  const toman = Math.round(finalUSD * rate);
  return `${new Intl.NumberFormat('fa-IR').format(toman)} تومان`;
}
export const toFarsiDigits = (val: string | number): string => {
  const farsiDigits = ['۰', '۱', '۲', '۳', '۴', '۵', '۶', '۷', '۸', '۹'];
  return String(val).replace(/\d/g, (d) => farsiDigits[parseInt(d, 10)]);
};

export interface ProductCardProps {
  product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product;
  to?: string;
  variant?: 'standard' | 'compact';
  appearance?: 'default' | 'glass';
  onAddToCart?: (product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product) => void;
  onAddVariantToCart?: (variant: {
    product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product;
    productInfo: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductInfo;
    sellerProduct: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.SellerProduct;
  }) => void;
  onCardClick?: (product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product) => void;
  isFavorite?: boolean;
  onToggleFavorite?: (productId: string | number) => void;
  exchangeRate?: number;
  index?: number;
  discountOverride?: number;
  isRecommended?: boolean;
  isBoxLess?: boolean;
}
export const CustomersProductCard: React.FC<ProductCardProps> = ({
  product,
  to,
  variant = 'standard',
  appearance = 'default',
  onAddToCart,
  onAddVariantToCart,
  onCardClick,
  isFavorite = false,
  onToggleFavorite,
  exchangeRate,
  index = 0,
}) => {
  const productDetailsUrl = to || getCustomerProductDetailsRoute(product.id);
  const [selectedSize, setSelectedSize] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isAddedRecently, setIsAddedRecently] = useState(false);
  const addedTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  const { currentLocale } = useLanguageContext();
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isDark = theme.palette.mode === 'dark';
  const isEn = currentLocale === 'en';
  const isRTL = currentLocale === 'fa';
  const isCompact = variant === 'compact';
  const wishlistIsFav = useIsFavorite(product.id);
  const toggleWishlist = useToggleFavorite();
  const effectiveIsFavorite =
    isFavorite !== undefined && isFavorite !== false
      ? isFavorite
      : wishlistIsFav;
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (addedTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(addedTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);
  // Filter in-stock variants
  const inStockVariants = useMemo(() => {
    if (!product.productInfos || !product.sellerProducts) return [];
    return product.productInfos
      .map((info) => {
        const sellers = (product.sellerProducts || []).filter(
          (sp) =>
            (sp.productInfoId === info.id || sp.productInfo?.id === info.id) &&
            sp.seller &&
            sp.stockQuantity > 0
        );
        if (sellers.length === 0) return null;
        // pick cheapest
        const sorted = [...sellers].sort((a, b) => {
          const pA = a.discount > 0 ? a.price * (1 - a.discount / 100) : a.price;
          const pB = b.discount > 0 ? b.price * (1 - b.discount / 100) : b.price;
          return pA - pB;
        });
        return {
          productInfo: info,
          sellerProduct: sorted[0],
          price: sorted[0].price,
          discount: sorted[0].discount || 0,
          stockQuantity: sorted[0].stockQuantity || 0,
        };
      })
      .filter((v): v is NonNullable<typeof v> => v !== null);
  }, [product]);
  // Extract available sizes
  const availableSizes = useMemo(() => {
    const list: string[] = [];
    inStockVariants.forEach((v) => {
      if (v.productInfo.size && !list.includes(v.productInfo.size)) {
        list.push(v.productInfo.size);
      }
    });
    return list;
  }, [inStockVariants]);
  // Map size -> sizeKind for display formatting (display-only; values/keys/selection stay raw)
  const sizeKindBySize = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, string | null | undefined>();
    inStockVariants.forEach((v) => {
      if (v.productInfo.size && !map.has(v.productInfo.size)) {
        map.set(v.productInfo.size, v.productInfo.sizeKind);
      }
    });
    return map;
  }, [inStockVariants]);
  const displaySize = (sz: string): string =>
    isPantsSizeKind(sizeKindBySize.get(sz))
      ? formatSizeLabel(SizeKind.Pants, sz) || sz
      : sz;
  // Ensure default selected size
  useEffect(() => {
    if (availableSizes.length > 0) {
      if (!selectedSize || !availableSizes.includes(selectedSize)) {
        setSelectedSize(availableSizes[0]);
      }
    } else {
      setSelectedSize(null);
    }
  }, [availableSizes, selectedSize]);
  // Active selected variant
  const activeVariant = useMemo(() => {
    if (inStockVariants.length === 0) {
      const fallbackInfo = product.productInfos?.[0];
      const fallbackSeller = product.sellerProducts?.[0];
      if (fallbackInfo && fallbackSeller) {
        return {
          productInfo: fallbackInfo,
          sellerProduct: fallbackSeller,
          price: fallbackSeller.price,
          discount: fallbackSeller.discount || 0,
          stockQuantity: fallbackSeller.stockQuantity || 0,
        };
      }
      return null;
    }
    if (selectedSize) {
      const found = inStockVariants.find((v) => v.productInfo.size === selectedSize);
      if (found) return found;
    }
    return inStockVariants[0];
  }, [inStockVariants, selectedSize, product.productInfos, product.sellerProducts]);
  // Images
  const images = useMemo(() => {
    const list: string[] = [];
    if (activeVariant?.productInfo?.images) {
      activeVariant.productInfo.images.forEach((img) => {
        const u = resolveImageUrl(img);
        if (u) list.push(u);
      });
    }
    if (list.length === 0 && product.productInfos) {
      product.productInfos.forEach((pi) => {
        pi.images?.forEach((img) => {
          const u = resolveImageUrl(img);
          if (u && !list.includes(u)) list.push(u);
        });
      });
    }
    return list;
  }, [activeVariant, product.productInfos]);
  const isCamoPants = useMemo(() => {
    const n = (product.name || '').toLowerCase();
    return (
      (n.includes('tech fleece') && n.includes('camo')) ||

    if (first && !first.includes('placeholder.com')) {
      return first;
    }
    return null;
  }, [isCamoPants, images]);
  const secondaryImage =
    images.length > 1 && !images[1].includes('placeholder.com')
      ? images[1]
      : null;
  // Eyebrow Brand & Category
  const brand = useMemo(
    () => resolveProductBrand(product),
    [product]
  );
  const { typeLabel, genderLabel } = useMemo(() => {
    let t = '';
    let g = '';
    const cats = product.categories || [];
    for (const c of cats) {
      const slug = (c.slug || '').toLowerCase();
      const name = (c.name || '').toLowerCase();
      if (slug === 'women' || name.includes('زنانه')) {
        g = isEn ? (LL?.products?.card?.women ? LL.products.card.women() : 'Women') : 'زنانه';
      } else if (slug === 'men' || name.includes('مردانه')) {
        g = isEn ? (LL?.products?.card?.men ? LL.products.card.men() : 'Men') : 'مردانه';

  const eyebrowText = useMemo(() => {

      }

    } else if (onAddToCart) {
      onAddToCart(product);
    }

  const handleCardClick = () => {

      onCardClick(product);
    }
  };
  const cardColorName =
    firstColor?.name ||
    (isEn
      ? LL?.products?.card?.original
        ? LL.products.card.original()
        : 'Original'
      : 'اورجینال');

    ? LL?.products?.card?.productCode

    : isEn
    ? LL?.products?.card?.addFavorite

  const cartButtonAriaLabel = isEn
    ? LL?.products?.card?.addToCartShort
      ? LL.products.card.addToCartShort()
      : 'Add to cart'
    : 'افزودن به سبد';
  if (appearance === 'glass') {
    return (
      <Box
        className="rv"
        style={{ '--d': index % 4 } as React.CSSProperties}
        sx={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
      >
        <Box
          className="lg-card"
          onClick={handleCardClick}
          sx={{
            cursor: 'pointer',
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            height: '100%',
            borderRadius: { xs: '32px', sm: '28px' },
            p: { xs: '12px', sm: '16px' },
            position: 'relative',
            fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',
            transition: 'box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.1,1), transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.1,1)',
            '@media (hover: hover)': {

                '& .card-glass-img': {
                  transform: 'scale(1.05)',
                },
              },
            },
          }}

            }}

                {sizeLabel}
              </Typography>
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 0.5 }}>

                        setSelectedSize(sz);

export function getMultiColorDiscBackground(
  colors?: Array<{ hexCode?: string | null; name?: string | null } | string | null | undefined> | null
): string {
  if (!colors || colors.length === 0) return 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12)';
  const hexes = colors
    .map((c) => (typeof c === 'string' ? c : c?.hexCode))
    .filter((h): h is string => Boolean(h && h.trim()));
  if (hexes.length === 0) return 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12)';
  if (hexes.length === 1) return hexes[0];
  const step = 100 / hexes.length;
  const stops = hexes.map((hex, i) => `${hex} ${i * step}% ${(i + 1) * step}%`);
  return `conic-gradient(${stops.join(', ')})`;
}

  return {
    ...actual,
    useCustomersCartService: () => ({ addItem: vi.fn() }),
    useWishlistSync: vi.fn(),
    getDiscountedUnitPrice: (price: number, discount: number) => {
      const basePrice = Number(price) || 0;
      const discountPercent = Number(discount) || 0;
      if (discountPercent <= 0) {
        return Number(basePrice.toFixed(2));
      }
      const discounted = basePrice * (1 - discountPercent / 100);
      return Number(discounted.toFixed(2));
    },
  };
});

import React from 'react';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Container from '@mui/material/Container';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import FavoriteIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Favorite';
import DeleteOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutline';
import ShoppingBagOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ShoppingBagOutlined';
import { Link as RouterLink } from 'react-router-dom';
import { CustomersLayout } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-layout';
import { CustomersProductCard } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-product-card';
import { useProductById } from '@kickzone-workspace/products-hook';
import { useCustomersCartService, getDiscountedUnitPrice } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-cart-hook';
import {
  CUSTOMER_ROUTES,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-routes';
import {
  useLanguageContext,
  usePageTitle,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
import {
  useWishlistItems,
  useRemoveFromWishlist,
  useClearWishlist,
  WishlistItem,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-wishlist-store';
function FavoriteProductItem({
  item,
  onRemove,
}: {
  item: WishlistItem;
  onRemove: (itemId: WishlistItem['id']) => void;
}) {
  const { product } = useProductById(Number(item.id));
  const { addItem } = useCustomersCartService();
  if (!product) return null;
  return (
    <CustomersProductCard
      product={product}
      variant="compact"
      isFavorite
      onToggleFavorite={() => onRemove(item.id)}
      onAddVariantToCart={({ productInfo, sellerProduct }) => {
        addItem({
          productId: String(product.id),
          productName: product.name,
          productImage: productInfo.images?.[0] || null,
          quantity: 1,
          unitPrice: getDiscountedUnitPrice(sellerProduct.price, sellerProduct.discount),
          color: productInfo.colors?.[0]?.hexCode || productInfo.colors?.[0]?.name || null,
          size: productInfo.size || null,
          sellerId: String(sellerProduct.seller?.id || 1),
          sellerName: '',
          sellerShippingFee: sellerProduct.seller?.shippingFee || 0,
          productInfoId: String(productInfo.id),
          sellerProductId: String(sellerProduct.id),
          availableStock: sellerProduct.stockQuantity || 1,
        });
      }}
    />
  );
}
export function CustomerFavorites() {

  });

    const testOrderData = {
      ...orderData,
      items: [
        { ...baseItem, color: 'Blue', size: '42' },
      ],
    };
    render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[{ pathname: '/', state: { orderData: testOrderData } }]}>
        <CustomerOrderConfirmation />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    expect(screen.getByText(/Blue.*42/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText('W42')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
