    const testOrderData = {
      ...orderData,
      items: [
        { ...baseItem, color: 'Green', size: 'XL' },
      ],
    };
    render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[{ pathname: '/', state: { orderData: testOrderData } }]}>
        <CustomerOrderConfirmation />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    expect(screen.getByText(/Green.*XL/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText(/W\d+\/L\d+/)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('T4: leaves lookalike 32/34 untouched', () => {
    const testOrderData = {
      ...orderData,
      items: [
        { ...baseItem, color: 'Gray', size: '32/34' },
      ],
    };
    render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[{ pathname: '/', state: { orderData: testOrderData } }]}>
        <CustomerOrderConfirmation />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    expect(screen.getByText(/Gray.*32\/34/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText('W32/L34')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('T5: renders color only when size is null, no dangling separator', () => {
    const testOrderData = {
      ...orderData,
      items: [
        { ...baseItem, color: 'Red', size: null },
      ],
    };
    render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[{ pathname: '/', state: { orderData: testOrderData } }]}>
        <CustomerOrderConfirmation />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    // The text node should equal 'Red' exactly (no trailing ' • ')
    const redText = screen.getByText('Red');
    expect(redText.textContent).toBe('Red');
  });
  // T6: 4XL apparel size displays correctly
  it('T6: renders 4XL apparel size immediately after 3XL', () => {
    const testOrderData = {
      ...orderData,
      items: [
        { ...baseItem, color: 'Black', size: '3XL' },
        { ...baseItem, color: 'White', size: '4XL' },
      ],
    };
    render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[{ pathname: '/', state: { orderData: testOrderData } }]}>
        <CustomerOrderConfirmation />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    // Both 3XL and 4XL should be displayed
    expect(screen.getByText(/Black.*3XL/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText(/White.*4XL/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    // 4XL should appear after 3XL in the document
    const bodyText = document.body.textContent || '';
    const xxxlIndex = bodyText.indexOf('3XL');
    const fourXLIndex = bodyText.indexOf('4XL');
    expect(xxxlIndex).toBeLessThan(fourXLIndex);
  });
});

    const { baseElement } = render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[{ pathname: '/', state: { orderData } }]}>
        <CustomerOrderConfirmation />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    expect(baseElement).toBeTruthy();
  });
  it('should render successfully with sellerOrders', () => {
    const { baseElement } = render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[{ pathname: '/', state: { orderData: orderDataWithSellerOrders } }]}>
        <CustomerOrderConfirmation />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    expect(baseElement).toBeTruthy();
  });
  it('should return null (and redirect) when orderData is absent', () => {
    const { baseElement } = render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[{ pathname: '/' }]}>
        <CustomerOrderConfirmation />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    // When no orderData in state, component returns null (redirect handled by useEffect)
    expect(baseElement.querySelector('[data-testid="customers-layout"]')).toBeFalsy();
  });
});

import { formatSizeLabel, SizeKind } from '@kickzone-workspace/product-sizes';
export interface OrderItem {
  productId: string;
  productName: string;
  productImage?: string | null;
  quantity: number;
  unitPrice: number;
  totalPrice: number;
  color?: string | null;
  size?: string | null;
}
export interface OrderData {
  id: string;
  orderNumber: string;
  trackingNumber: string;
  customerEmail: string;
  customerPhone: string;
  customerName: string;
  shippingAddress: string;
  city: string;
  state: string;
  zipCode: string;
  country: string;
  subtotal: number;
  shippingCost: number;
  total: number;
  shippingMethod?: string;
  shippingPaymentMode?: 'PAY_ON_DELIVERY' | 'PAY_ONLINE';
  items: OrderItem[];
  notes?: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  // Optional seller orders for multi-seller checkout display
  sellerOrders?: Array<{
    id: string;
    orderNumber: string;
    total: number;
    trackingNumber?: string | null;
    shippingMethod?: string;
    shippingPaymentMode?: 'PAY_ON_DELIVERY' | 'PAY_ONLINE';
  }>;
}
const CANONICAL_PANTS_SIZE_RE = /^[1-9]\d?x[1-9]\d?$/;
const displayOrderItemSize = (size?: string | null): string => {
  if (!size) return '';
  const trimmed = size.trim();
  return CANONICAL_PANTS_SIZE_RE.test(trimmed)
    ? formatSizeLabel(SizeKind.Pants, trimmed) || size
    : size;
};

                        <PriceDisplay
                          priceInUSD={orderData.subtotal}

                    <Box
                      sx={{

                        <PriceDisplay

                        />
                      </Typography>

                    <Divider
                      sx={{

                      }}

                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5, mb: 2.5 }}>
                  <Box
                    sx={{

                      alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'center',
                      background: isDark
                        ? 'rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.12)'
                        : 'rgba(143, 132, 104, 0.1)',
                      border: isDark
                        ? '1px solid rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.25)'
                        : '1px solid rgba(143, 132, 104, 0.2)',
                    }}

                    <PlaceOutlined
                      sx={{

                  <Typography
                    variant="h6"
                    sx={{

                    }}
                  >
                    {LL.orderConfirmation.shippingAddress()}
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    p: 2.5,
                    borderRadius: '18px',
                    background: isDark
                      ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)'
                      : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02)',
                    border: isDark
                      ? '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)'
                      : '1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)',
                  }}
                >
                  <Typography
                    variant="body1"
                    sx={{
                      fontWeight: 700,
                      color: isDark ? '#f4f4f2' : '#181816',
                      mb: 0.5,
                    }}
                  >
                    {orderData.customerName}
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mb: 0.25 }}>
                    {orderData.shippingAddress}
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mb: 0.5 }}>
                    {orderData.city}, {orderData.state} {orderData.zipCode} • {orderData.country}
                  </Typography>
                  <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mt: 1.5 }}>
                    <PhoneOutlined sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: isDark ? '#c5b89a' : '#7c6d48' }} />
                    <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>

            {/* Email Confirmation Alert */}
            <Alert
              severity="info"
              icon={<EmailOutlined sx={{ color: isDark ? '#c5b89a' : '#7c6d48' }} />}
              sx={{
                mb: 4,
                borderRadius: '20px',
                backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
                WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
                background: isDark
                  ? 'rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.08)'
                  : 'rgba(143, 132, 104, 0.07)',
                border: isDark
                  ? '1px solid rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.25)'
                  : '1px solid rgba(143, 132, 104, 0.2)',
                color: isDark ? '#f4f4f2' : '#181816',
                '& .MuiAlert-message': {
                  fontWeight: 500,
                },
              }}
            >
              {LL.orderConfirmation.emailConfirmation()}
            </Alert>
            {/* Optional Guest Account Creation Prompt */}
            {!user && (
              <Box
                sx={{
                  mb: 4,
                  p: 3,
                  borderRadius: '20px',
                  background: isDark
                    ? 'rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.08)'
                    : 'rgba(240, 235, 225, 0.6)',
                  border: isDark
                    ? '1px solid rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.3)'
                    : '1px solid rgba(143, 132, 104, 0.25)',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                }}
              >
                <Typography
                  variant="subtitle1"
                  sx={{
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    color: isDark ? '#f4f4f2' : '#181816',
                    mb: 1,
                  }}
                >
                  {LL.orderConfirmation.createAccountPrompt?.() ||
                    'برای پیگیری سریع‌تر سفارش و دسترسی به تاریخچه خرید، حساب کاربری بسازید'}
                </Typography>
                <Typography
                  variant="body2"
                  sx={{
                    color: isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.65)',
                    mb: 2.5,
                  }}
                >
                  {LL.orderConfirmation.createAccountDescription?.() ||
                    'اطلاعات شما از سفارش فعلی ذخیره خواهد شد و نیازی به وارد کردن مجدد اطلاعات در خریدهای بعدی نخواهد بود.'}
                </Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="outlined"
                  component={RouterLink}
                  to={`${CUSTOMER_ROUTES.SIGNUP}?email=${encodeURIComponent(
                    orderData.customerEmail || ''
                  )}&name=${encodeURIComponent(orderData.customerName || '')}`}
                  startIcon={<PersonAddOutlined />}
                  sx={{
                    borderRadius: '9999px',
                    px: 3.5,
                    py: 1,
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    borderColor: isDark ? '#c5b89a' : '#7c6d48',
                    color: isDark ? '#c5b89a' : '#7c6d48',
                    '&:hover': {
                      borderColor: isDark ? '#dfd6c0' : '#5a4e32',
                      background: isDark
                        ? 'rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.12)'
                        : 'rgba(143, 132, 104, 0.1)',

            {/* Action Buttons */}

              sx={{

              <Button
                variant="contained"
                size="large"
                startIcon={<ReceiptLongOutlined />}
                component={RouterLink}
                to={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.ORDERS}
                sx={{
                  borderRadius: '9999px',
                  py: 1.5,
                  px: 4.5,
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  fontSize: '0.98rem',
                  letterSpacing: '0.02em',
                  textTransform: 'none',
                  position: 'relative',
                  overflow: 'hidden',
                  backdropFilter: 'blur(20px) saturate(190%)',
                  WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(20px) saturate(190%)',
                  transition:
                    'all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275)',
                  ...(isDark
                    ? {
                        background:
                          'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.96) 0%, rgba(181, 171, 147, 0.94) 100%)',
                        color: '#121210',
                        border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)',
                        boxShadow:
                          '0 10px 28px -4px rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.45), inset 0 1px 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)',
                        '&:hover': {

                            'linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 0%, rgba(210, 198, 170, 0.98) 100%)',

              <Button
                variant="outlined"

                sx={{

<file path="libs/client/customers/screens/customer-payment/src/lib/customer-payment-callback.tsx">
import React, { useEffect, useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { Link as RouterLink, useNavigate, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import Alert from '@mui/material/Alert';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import CheckCircle from '@mui/icons-material/CheckCircle';
import ErrorOutline from '@mui/icons-material/ErrorOutline';
import { useTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';
import { CustomersLayout } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-layout';
import { GlassmorphismContainer } from '@kickzone-workspace/glassmorphism-container';
import { CUSTOMER_ROUTES } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-routes';
import { useZarinPalPayment } from './use-zarinpal-payment';
import { useCustomersCartMutations } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-cart-hook';
import { useCartStore } from '@kickzone-workspace/customer-cart-store';
/**
 * Payment Callback Screen
 * Handles the return from ZarinPal payment gateway
 * Verifies the payment and redirects accordingly
 *
 * Per ZarinPal docs: only call verify when Status=OK.
 * Status=NOK means the buyer cancelled or the transaction failed.
 */
export function CustomerPaymentCallback() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const [verificationStatus, setVerificationStatus] = useState<
    'pending' | 'success' | 'error' | 'cancelled'
  >('pending');
  const [refId, setRefId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  // Get payment parameters from URL
  const authority = searchParams.get('Authority');
  const status = searchParams.get('Status');
  const orderIdFromUrl = searchParams.get('orderId');
  const orderIdsFromUrl = searchParams.get('orderIds');
  // Get order data from sessionStorage
  const [orderData, setOrderData] = useState<{
    orderId: string;
    orderIds?: string[];
    orderNumber: string;
    amount: number;
    orderConfirmation?: {
      id: string;
      orderNumber: string;
      trackingNumber: string;
      customerEmail: string;
      customerPhone: string;
      customerName: string;
      shippingAddress: string;
      city: string;
      state: string;
      zipCode: string;
      country: string;
      subtotal: number;
      shippingCost: number;
      total: number;
      items: Array<{
        productId: string;
        productName: string;
        productImage?: string | null;
        quantity: number;
        unitPrice: number;
        totalPrice: number;
        color?: string | null;
        size?: string | null;
      }>;
      notes?: string | null;
      createdAt: string;
      sellerOrders?: Array<{
        id: string;
        orderNumber: string;
        total: number;
        trackingNumber?: string | null;
      }>;
    } | null;
  } | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (orderIdFromUrl) {
      const stored = sessionStorage.getItem(`order_${orderIdFromUrl}`);
      if (stored) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
          setOrderData(parsed);
        } catch (e) {
          console.error('Failed to parse order data:', e);
        }
      } else {
        // Fallback: construct orderData from URL parameters when sessionStorage is unavailable
        // (e.g., mobile banking redirect in fresh tab, or only orderIds/Authority present)
        const parsedOrderIds = orderIdsFromUrl
          ? orderIdsFromUrl.split(',').map((id) => id.trim()).filter(Boolean)
          : orderIdFromUrl
            ? [orderIdFromUrl]
            : [];
        const primaryOrderId = orderIdFromUrl || parsedOrderIds[0] || '';
        setOrderData({
          orderId: primaryOrderId,
          orderIds: parsedOrderIds.length > 0 ? parsedOrderIds : undefined,
          orderNumber: '',
          amount: 0,
        });
      }
    }
  }, [orderIdFromUrl, orderIdsFromUrl, authority]);
  // Track if verification has already been attempted to prevent multiple calls
  const verificationAttemptedRef = useRef(false);
  const cartClearedRef = useRef(false);
  // Get cart mutations to clear cart after successful payment
  const { clearCart } = useCustomersCartMutations();
  const clearCartAction = useCartStore((state) => state.clearCart);
  const { verifyPayment, cancelPendingOrder: cancelPendingOrderHook } = useZarinPalPayment({
    onSuccess: async (refId) => {
      // Note: This callback is invoked when the GraphQL mutation succeeds.
      // The actual success/failure is determined by the `success` field in the response.
      // We set a preliminary refId and status here; the component will verify `result.success`
      // after `verifyPayment` returns and update accordingly.
      setRefId(refId);
      setVerificationStatus('success');
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      setErrorMessage(error);
      setVerificationStatus('error');
      // Cart is NOT cleared on error - user can retry payment with same items
    },
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    // Prevent multiple verification attempts
    if (verificationAttemptedRef.current) {
      return;
    }
    // Check if payment was cancelled — do NOT call verify (ZarinPal docs)
    if (status === 'NOK') {
      verificationAttemptedRef.current = true;
      setVerificationStatus('cancelled');
      const orderIdToCancel = orderIdFromUrl || orderData?.orderId;
      const orderIdsToCancel = orderData?.orderIds || (orderIdToCancel ? [orderIdToCancel] : []);
      // Per ZarinPal docs, when Status=NOK, the Authority param is still present
      // Pass authority so guest users without sessionStorage orderId can still cancel
      if (authority || orderIdToCancel) {
        cancelPendingOrderHook({ orderId: orderIdToCancel ?? null, authority: authority! })
          .then((success) => {
            if (!success) {
              console.error('Failed to cancel pending order after NOK - mutation returned false');
            }
            // Clean up sessionStorage for all order IDs after successful cancellation
            for (const oid of orderIdsToCancel) {
              sessionStorage.removeItem(`order_${oid}`);
            }
            if (orderIdFromUrl) {
              sessionStorage.removeItem(`order_${orderIdFromUrl}`);
            }
          })
          .catch((err) => {
            console.error('Failed to cancel pending order after NOK:', err);
            // Don't clear sessionStorage on failure so user can retry
          });
      }
      return;
    }
    // Validate required parameters
    if (!authority || status !== 'OK') {
      setErrorMessage('پارامترهای پرداخت نامعتبر است');
      setVerificationStatus('error');
      verificationAttemptedRef.current = true;
      return;
    }
    // Wait for order data to be loaded
    if (!orderData) {
      return;
    }
    // Mark verification as attempted immediately to prevent race conditions
    verificationAttemptedRef.current = true;
    // Verify payment
    const verify = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await verifyPayment({
          authority,
          amount: orderData.amount,
          order_id: orderData.orderId || undefined, // Pass order_id to confirm order and decrease stock; avoid empty string
        });
        if (!result) {
          // Error already handled by hook
          return;
        }
        // Normalize result for backward compatibility with any test mocks returning a raw number
        const normalizedResult =
          typeof result === 'number'
            ? { success: true, ref_id: result, message: '' }
            : result;
        // CRITICAL: Check the `success` field from the resolver response.
        // Only clear cart and show success when `success === true`.
        // If `success === false` (e.g., gateway captured payment but stock reservation failed),
        // do NOT clear cart, show error state, and display the refId for support/refund.
        if (normalizedResult.success === true) {
          // Clear cart only once after successful payment verification AND order confirmation
          if (!cartClearedRef.current) {
            cartClearedRef.current = true;
            try {
              // Try to clear server cart (requires auth). If it fails, log but don't block.
              await clearCart();
            } catch (error) {
              // Log error but don't fail - payment was successful
              console.error('Failed to clear server cart after payment:', error);
            }
            // Always clear local cart (guest or logged in) after successful payment
            clearCartAction();
          }
          // Clean up sessionStorage for all order IDs after successful payment
          if (orderData?.orderIds) {
            for (const oid of orderData.orderIds) {
              sessionStorage.removeItem(`order_${oid}`);
            }
          }
          if (orderIdFromUrl) {
            sessionStorage.removeItem(`order_${orderIdFromUrl}`);
          }
          // onSuccess callback already set status to 'success' and refId
        } else {
          // Payment was captured by gateway (refId exists) but order confirmation failed
          // Do NOT clear cart. Show error with refId for customer support.
          const errorMsg =
            normalizedResult.message ||
            `Payment was captured by gateway (Ref: ${normalizedResult.ref_id}), but order confirmation failed. Please contact support with this reference ID.`;
          setErrorMessage(errorMsg);
          setVerificationStatus('error');
          // Ensure refId is set for display
          if (normalizedResult.ref_id) {
            setRefId(normalizedResult.ref_id);
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        // Error already handled by hook's onError callback
        console.error('Payment verification error:', err);
      }
    };
    verify();
  }, [
    authority,
    status,
    orderData,
    orderIdFromUrl,
    verifyPayment,
    cancelPendingOrderHook,
  ]);
  const handleContinue = () => {
    if (verificationStatus === 'success' && orderData) {
      // Check if orderConfirmation data is available
      const orderConfirmation = orderData.orderConfirmation;
      if (orderConfirmation) {
        // Navigate to order confirmation with full order data
        navigate(CUSTOMER_ROUTES.ORDER_CONFIRMATION, {
          state: { orderId: orderData.orderId, refId, orderData: orderConfirmation },
        });
      } else {
        // No orderConfirmation data (fresh tab / URL fallback) - navigate to orders page
        navigate(CUSTOMER_ROUTES.ORDERS);
      }
    } else {
      // Navigate to orders page
      navigate(CUSTOMER_ROUTES.ORDERS);
    }
  };
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isDark = theme.palette.mode === 'dark';
  return (
    <CustomersLayout>
      <Box
        sx={{
          position: 'relative',
          minHeight: 'calc(100vh - 120px)',
          overflow: 'hidden',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          py: { xs: 6, md: 10 },
          px: 2,
        }}
      >
        {/* Ambient liquid lighting glow orbs */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: '10%',
            right: '15%',
            width: { xs: 260, sm: 420 },
            height: { xs: 260, sm: 420 },
            borderRadius: '50%',
            background: isDark
              ? 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.15) 0%, rgba(197, 184, 154, 0.02) 65%, transparent 70%)'
              : 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(230, 215, 185, 0.5) 0%, rgba(240, 230, 205, 0.18) 60%, transparent 70%)',
            filter: 'blur(75px)',
            pointerEvents: 'none',
            zIndex: 0,
            animation: 'floatOrb 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate',
            '@keyframes floatOrb': {
              '0%': { transform: 'translate(0, 0) scale(1)' },
              '100%': { transform: 'translate(-30px, 35px) scale(1.08)' },
            },
          }}
        />
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            bottom: '10%',
            left: '12%',
            width: { xs: 240, sm: 380 },
            height: { xs: 240, sm: 380 },
            borderRadius: '50%',
            background: isDark
              ? 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(140, 120, 80, 0.12) 0%, rgba(100, 85, 55, 0.02) 65%, transparent 70%)'
              : 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(245, 230, 215, 0.45) 0%, rgba(240, 220, 200, 0.15) 60%, transparent 70%)',
            filter: 'blur(80px)',
            pointerEvents: 'none',
            zIndex: 0,
            animation: 'floatOrb2 16s ease-in-out infinite alternate',
            '@keyframes floatOrb2': {
              '0%': { transform: 'translate(0, 0) scale(1)' },
              '100%': { transform: 'translate(35px, -25px) scale(1.06)' },
            },
          }}
        />
        <GlassmorphismContainer
          wrapperSx={{
            width: '100%',
            maxWidth: 580,
            mx: 'auto',
            position: 'relative',
            zIndex: 1,
            p: 0,
          }}
          containerSx={{
            p: { xs: 3.5, sm: 5 },
            textAlign: 'center',
            borderRadius: '32px !important',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(30px) saturate(190%)',
            WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(30px) saturate(190%)',
            background: isDark

                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  لطفا چند لحظه شکیبا باشید
                </Typography>

            {verificationStatus === 'success' && (

                  size="large"

    </CustomersLayout>

}

<file path="libs/client/customers/screens/customer-payment/src/lib/use-zarinpal-payment.tsx">
import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useMutation } from '@apollo/client/react';
import {
  REQUEST_ZARINPAL_PAYMENT_MUTATION,
  VERIFY_ZARINPAL_PAYMENT_MUTATION,
  GET_ZARINPAL_GATEWAY_URL_MUTATION,
  CANCEL_PENDING_ZARINPAL_ORDER_MUTATION,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-graphql';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import { asApolloErrorLike } from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import {
  getZarinPalErrorMessage,
  type ZarinPalPaymentRequest,
  type ZarinPalVerificationRequest,
  type CancelPendingOrderVariables,
} from './zarinpal-payment-service';
export interface ZarinPalVerifyResult {
  code: number;
  message: string;
  ref_id?: number | null;
  orderIds?: string[] | null;
  orderId?: string | null;
  orderNumber?: string | null;
  success: boolean;
}
export interface ZarinPalVerifyResponseExtended {
  code: number;
  message: string;
  ref_id?: number | null;
  card_pan?: string;
  card_hash?: string;
  fee_type?: string;
  fee?: number;
  orderIds?: string[] | null;
  orderId?: string | null;
  orderNumber?: string | null;
  success?: boolean;
}
export interface UseZarinPalPaymentOptions {
  onSuccess?: (refId: number) => void;
  onError?: (error: string) => void;
}
export interface UseZarinPalPaymentReturn {
  isRequesting: boolean;
  isVerifying: boolean;
  isCancelling: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  requestPayment: (
    request: Omit<ZarinPalPaymentRequest, 'merchant_id'> & {
      orderIds?: string[];
    }
  ) => Promise<string | null>; // Returns authority or null on error
  verifyPayment: (
    request: Omit<ZarinPalVerificationRequest, 'merchant_id'> & {
      order_id?: string;
    }
  ) => Promise<ZarinPalVerifyResult | null>; // Returns verification result or null on error
  cancelPendingOrder: (
    variables: CancelPendingOrderVariables
  ) => Promise<boolean>; // Returns true on success
  redirectToGateway: (authority: string) => void;
  clearError: () => void;
}
/**
 * React hook for ZarinPal payment integration
 */
export function useZarinPalPayment(
  options?: UseZarinPalPaymentOptions
): UseZarinPalPaymentReturn {
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [requestPaymentMutation, { loading: isRequesting }] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'requestZarinPalPayment'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationRequestZarinPalPaymentArgs
  >(REQUEST_ZARINPAL_PAYMENT_MUTATION);
  const [verifyPaymentMutation, { loading: isVerifying }] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'verifyZarinPalPayment'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationVerifyZarinPalPaymentArgs
  >(VERIFY_ZARINPAL_PAYMENT_MUTATION);
  const [getGatewayUrlMutation] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'getZarinPalGatewayUrl'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationGetZarinPalGatewayUrlArgs
  >(GET_ZARINPAL_GATEWAY_URL_MUTATION);
  const [cancelPendingOrderMutation, { loading: isCancelling }] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'cancelPendingZarinPalOrder'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationCancelPendingZarinPalOrderArgs
  >(CANCEL_PENDING_ZARINPAL_ORDER_MUTATION);
  const requestPayment = useCallback(
    async (
      request: Omit<ZarinPalPaymentRequest, 'merchant_id'> & {
        orderIds?: string[];
      }
    ): Promise<string | null> => {
      setError(null);
      console.log('[PaymentHook] 🚀 Requesting payment:', {
        amount: request.amount,
        currency: request.currency,
        callbackUrl: request.callback_url,
        orderId: request.metadata?.order_id,
        orderIds: request.orderIds,
      });
      try {
        const { data } = await requestPaymentMutation({
          variables: {
            input: {
              amount: Math.round(request.amount), // Ensure integer for GraphQL Int type
              callback_url: request.callback_url,
              description: request.description,
              currency: request.currency || 'IRT',
              mobile: request.metadata?.mobile,
              email: request.metadata?.email,
              order_id: request.metadata?.order_id,
              orderIds: request.orderIds,
            },
          },
        });
        const response = data?.requestZarinPalPayment;
        if (!response) {
          throw new Error('No response from payment service');
        }
        if (response.code === 100 && response.authority) {
          console.log(
            `[PaymentHook] ✅ Payment request successful: authority=${response.authority.substring(
              0,
              20
            )}...`
          );
          return response.authority;
        } else {
          const errorMessage = getZarinPalErrorMessage(response.code);
          console.error(
            `[PaymentHook] ❌ Payment request failed: code=${response.code}, message=${response.message}`
          );
          setError(errorMessage);
          options?.onError?.(errorMessage);
          return null;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        // Extract detailed error message from GraphQL error
        let errorMessage = 'خطا در درخواست پرداخت';
        if (err instanceof Error) {
          errorMessage = err.message;
          // Check for GraphQL errors with more details
          const graphQLError = asApolloErrorLike(err)?.graphQLErrors?.[0];
          if (graphQLError) {
            const detailedMessage =
              graphQLError.message ||
              graphQLError.extensions?.message ||
              err.message;
            errorMessage = detailedMessage;
            console.error('[PaymentHook] ❌ GraphQL error details:', {
              message: graphQLError.message,
              extensions: graphQLError.extensions,
              path: graphQLError.path,
            });
          }
          // Check for network errors
          const networkError = asApolloErrorLike(err)?.networkError;
          if (networkError) {
            console.error('[PaymentHook] ❌ Network error details:', {
              statusCode: networkError.statusCode,
              statusText: networkError.statusText,
              message: networkError.message,
            });
            if (networkError.statusCode === 403) {
              errorMessage =
                'Payment gateway access denied (403). Please check your payment configuration.';
            }
          }
        }
        console.error('[PaymentHook] ❌ Payment request error:', {
          error: err,
          errorMessage,
          errorType: err instanceof Error ? err.constructor.name : typeof err,
        });
        setError(errorMessage);
        options?.onError?.(errorMessage);
        return null;
      }
    },
    [options, requestPaymentMutation]
  );
  const verifyPayment = useCallback(
    async (
      request: Omit<ZarinPalVerificationRequest, 'merchant_id'> & {
        order_id?: string;
      }
    ): Promise<ZarinPalVerifyResult | null> => {
      setError(null);
      try {
        const { data } = await verifyPaymentMutation({
          variables: {
            input: {
              amount: Math.round(request.amount), // Ensure integer for GraphQL Int type
              authority: request.authority,
              // order_id is optional and will be in schema after server restart regenerates GraphQL schema
              ...(request.order_id ? { order_id: request.order_id } : {}),
            } as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ZarinPalVerificationRequestInput & {
              order_id?: string;
            },
          },
        });
        const response = data?.verifyZarinPalPayment as ZarinPalVerifyResponseExtended | null;
        if (!response) {
          throw new Error('No response from payment service');
        }
        // Code 100 means successful payment
        // Code 101 means payment was already verified
        // success field from resolver indicates if order confirmation succeeded
        const isSuccess =
          (response.code === 100 || response.code === 101) &&
          response.success !== false &&
          Boolean(response.ref_id);
        const result: ZarinPalVerifyResult = {
          code: response.code,
          message: response.message,
          ref_id: response.ref_id,
          orderIds: response.orderIds,
          orderId: response.orderId,
          orderNumber: response.orderNumber,
          success: isSuccess,
        };
        if (isSuccess && response.ref_id) {
          options?.onSuccess?.(response.ref_id);
        } else if (!isSuccess) {
          // CRITICAL: For code 100/101 with success=false, the server's response.message
          // contains the actual failure reason (e.g., "Insufficient stock").
          // getZarinPalErrorMessage(100) returns "عملیات با موفقیت انجام شد" (success message!)
          // getZarinPalErrorMessage(101) returns "تراکنش قبلا verify شده است"
          // So we must use response.message for these codes when success === false.
          const isGatewaySuccessCode = response.code === 100 || response.code === 101;
          const errorMessage = isGatewaySuccessCode && response.success === false
            ? response.message
            : getZarinPalErrorMessage(response.code);
          setError(errorMessage);
          options?.onError?.(errorMessage);
        }
        return result;
      } catch (err) {
        const errorMessage =
          err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'خطا در تایید پرداخت';
        setError(errorMessage);
        options?.onError?.(errorMessage);
        return null;
      }
    },
    [options, verifyPaymentMutation]
  );
  const cancelPendingOrder = useCallback(
    async (variables: CancelPendingOrderVariables): Promise<boolean> => {
      setError(null);
      try {
        const { data } = await cancelPendingOrderMutation({
          variables: {
            orderId: variables.orderId,
            authority: variables.authority,
            guestToken: variables.guestToken ?? undefined,
          },
        });
        const result = data?.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder;
        if (result === true) {
          return true;
        } else {
          throw new Error('Cancellation returned false');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        const errorMessage =
          err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'خطا در لغو سفارش معلق';
        setError(errorMessage);
        options?.onError?.(errorMessage);
        return false;
      }
    },
    [options, cancelPendingOrderMutation]
  );
  const redirectToGateway = useCallback(
    async (authority: string) => {
      try {
        const { data } = await getGatewayUrlMutation({
          variables: { authority },
        });
        const url = data?.getZarinPalGatewayUrl?.url;
        if (url) {
          window.location.href = url;
        } else {
          // Fallback - this shouldn't happen but just in case
          throw new Error('No gateway URL returned');
        }
      } catch {
        // Fallback to client-side URL generation if GraphQL fails
        const {
          isZarinPalSandbox,
          ZARINPAL_SANDBOX_GATEWAY_URL,
          ZARINPAL_GATEWAY_URL,
        } = await import('./zarinpal-payment-service');
        const fallbackUrl = isZarinPalSandbox()
          ? `${ZARINPAL_SANDBOX_GATEWAY_URL}/${authority}`
          : `${ZARINPAL_GATEWAY_URL}/${authority}`;
        window.location.href = fallbackUrl;
      }
    },
    [getGatewayUrlMutation]
  );
  const clearError = useCallback(() => {
    setError(null);
  }, []);
  return {
    isRequesting,
    isVerifying,
    isCancelling,
    error,
    requestPayment,
    verifyPayment,
    cancelPendingOrder,
    redirectToGateway,
    clearError,
  };
}

describe('CustomerShoppingCart Pants Size Formatting', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockLocale = 'en';
    mockUser = null;
    mockShippingMethod = 'vip';
    mockIsCheckoutDialogOpen = false;
    mockIsAuthDialogOpen = false;
    mockActiveStep = 0;
    mockCartItems = [
      {
        id: 'cart-item-1',
        productId: 'prod-1',
        productInfoId: 'pi-1',
        sellerProductId: '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111',
        sellerId: '1',
        sellerName: 'SAINTBALA',
        sellerShippingFee: 1.2,
        productName: 'SAINTBALA Monogram Hoodie',
        productImage: '/hoodie.jpg',
        quantity: 2,
        unitPrice: 150,
        totalPrice: 300,
        availableStock: 5,
        color: '#121212',
        size: 'L',
      },
      {
        id: 'cart-item-2',
        productId: 'prod-2',
        productInfoId: 'pi-2',
        sellerProductId: '22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222',
        sellerId: '1',
        sellerName: 'SAINTBALA',
        sellerShippingFee: 1.2,
        productName: 'SAINTBALA Tactical Cargo Pants',
        productImage: '/pants.jpg',
        quantity: 1,
        unitPrice: 120,
        totalPrice: 120,
        availableStock: 3,
        color: '#333333',
        size: 'M',
      },
    ];
    // Reset to default shipping data
    setShippingData({
      calculateShippingCost: {
        totalShippingCost: 1.2,
        freeShippingApplied: false,
        strategyUsed: 'TIERED_DISCOUNT',
        shippingBreakdown: [
          { sellerId: '1', originalFee: 1.2, appliedFee: 1.2 },
        ],
      },
    });
  });
  it('T1 en pants: canonical pants code 32x34 renders as W32/L34, not raw 32x34', () => {
    mockCartItems[1].size = '32x34';
    renderWithProviders();
    expect(screen.getAllByText(/W32\/L34/).length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(body()).not.toContain('32x34');
  });
  it('T2 fa pants: canonical pants code 30x32 renders as W30/L32 in fa locale, not raw 30x32', () => {
    mockLocale = 'fa';
    mockCartItems[1].size = '30x32';
    renderWithProviders();
    expect(body()).toContain('W30/L32');
    expect(body()).not.toContain('30x32');
  });
  it('T3 footwear localization unchanged (fa): footwear size 42 renders as localized digits, not W42', () => {
    mockLocale = 'fa';
    mockCartItems[0].size = '42';
    renderWithProviders();
    // 42 in Farsi digits
    expect(body()).toContain('۴۲');
    expect(body()).not.toContain('W42');
  });
  it('T4 apparel unchanged: default sizes L and M render as-is, no W/L pattern', () => {
    // Default mockCartItems have sizes 'L' and 'M'
    renderWithProviders();
    expect(body()).not.toMatch(/W\d+\/L\d+/);
    expect(screen.getByText('SAINTBALA Monogram Hoodie')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('SAINTBALA Tactical Cargo Pants')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('T5 non-canonical lookalikes NOT reformatted: 32/34 stays 32/34, XL stays XL', () => {
    mockCartItems[1].size = '32/34';
    mockCartItems[0].size = 'XL';
    renderWithProviders();
    expect(body()).toContain('32/34');
    expect(body()).not.toContain('W32/L34');
    expect(body()).toContain('XL');
  });
  // T6: 4XL apparel size displays correctly (en locale)
  it('T6: renders 4XL apparel size immediately after 3XL', () => {
    mockCartItems[0].size = '3XL';
    mockCartItems[1].size = '4XL';
    renderWithProviders();
    // Both 3XL and 4XL should be displayed
    expect(screen.getByText('3XL')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('4XL')).toBeInTheDocument();
    // 4XL should appear after 3XL in the cart items
    const bodyText = body();
    const xxxlIndex = bodyText.indexOf('3XL');
    const fourXLIndex = bodyText.indexOf('4XL');
    expect(xxxlIndex).toBeLessThan(fourXLIndex);
  });
  // T7: 4XL apparel size in fa locale remains as-is (only pure numbers get Persian digits)
  it('T7: renders 4XL apparel size in Persian locale (non-numeric sizes stay as-is)', () => {
    mockLocale = 'fa';
    mockCartItems[0].size = '3XL';
    mockCartItems[1].size = '4XL';
    renderWithProviders();
    // Both 3XL and 4XL should be displayed as-is (non-numeric sizes don't get digit conversion)
    expect(body()).toContain('3XL');
    expect(body()).toContain('4XL');
    // 4XL should appear after 3XL
    const bodyText = body();
    const xxxlIndex = bodyText.indexOf('3XL');
    const fourXLIndex = bodyText.indexOf('4XL');
    expect(xxxlIndex).toBeLessThan(fourXLIndex);
  });
});

<file path="libs/client/customers/screens/home/src/lib/CustomersHomeScreen.tsx">
import React, { useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useQuery } from '@apollo/client/react';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import { CustomersLayout } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-layout';
import { useCustomersCartService, getDiscountedUnitPrice } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-cart-hook';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import {
  HOME_PAGE_QUERY,
  HomePageData,
  selectHomePageData,
} from './home-selectors';
import { useScrollProgress } from './useScrollProgress';
import { HeroSection } from './components/HeroSection';
import { CategoryBentoSection } from './components/CategoryBentoSection';
import { PicksRailSection } from './components/PicksRailSection';
import { TrustStripSection } from './components/TrustStripSection';
import { HomeLoadingScreen } from './components/HomeLoadingScreen';
export interface CustomersHomeProps {
  initialData?: HomePageData;
  mockLoading?: boolean;
}
export function CustomersHome({
  initialData,
  mockLoading,
}: CustomersHomeProps) {
  useScrollProgress();
  const { data: apolloData, loading: apolloLoading } = useQuery<HomePageData>(
    HOME_PAGE_QUERY,
    {
      fetchPolicy: 'cache-first',
      skip: Boolean(initialData),
    }
  );
  const data = initialData || apolloData;
  const loading = mockLoading ?? (apolloLoading && !data);
  const { addItem } = useCustomersCartService();
  const handleAddToCart = useCallback(
    (product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product, preferredSize?: string) => {
      const sp =
        product.sellerProducts?.find((s) => (s.stockQuantity || 0) > 0) ||
        product.sellerProducts?.[0];
      if (!sp) return;
      const pInfo =
        product.productInfos?.find((pi) =>
          preferredSize ? pi.size === preferredSize : true
        ) || product.productInfos?.[0];
      const size = pInfo?.size || preferredSize || null;
      const color = pInfo?.colors?.[0]?.hexCode || pInfo?.colors?.[0]?.name || null;
      const image = pInfo?.images?.[0] || null;
      addItem({
        productId: String(product.id),
        productName: product.name,
        productImage: image,
        quantity: 1,
        unitPrice: getDiscountedUnitPrice(sp.price, sp.discount),
        color,
        size,
        sellerId: String(sp.seller?.id || 1),
        sellerName: '',
        sellerShippingFee: sp.seller?.shippingFee || 0,
        sellerShippingPaymentMode:
          (sp.seller as { shippingPaymentMode?: 'PAY_ON_DELIVERY' | 'PAY_ONLINE' })?.shippingPaymentMode ||
          'PAY_ON_DELIVERY',
        productInfoId: pInfo ? String(pInfo.id) : '',
        sellerProductId: String(sp.id),
        availableStock: sp.stockQuantity || 1,
      });
    },
    [addItem]
  );
  const pageData = useMemo(() => selectHomePageData(data), [data]);
  return (
    <>
      {loading && <HomeLoadingScreen />}
      <CustomersLayout disablePadding={true}>
        <Box
          component="main"
          id="main"
          sx={{
            bgcolor: 'var(--page)',
            color: 'var(--ink)',
            minHeight: '100vh',
            width: '100%',
            overflowX: 'clip',
            position: 'relative',
            fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
          }}
        >
          {!loading && (
            <>
              <HeroSection
                rightProduct={pageData.hero.right}
                centerProduct={pageData.hero.center}
                leftProduct={pageData.hero.left}
              />
              <CategoryBentoSection
                bento={pageData.bento}
                categories={pageData.categories}
              />
              <PicksRailSection
                products={pageData.picks}
                exchangeRate={pageData.exchangeRate}
                onAddItem={handleAddToCart}
              />
              <TrustStripSection />
            </>
          )}
        </Box>
      </CustomersLayout>
    </>
  );
}
export default CustomersHome;

<file path="libs/client/customers/zustand/customer-cart-store/src/lib/customer-cart-store.ts">
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { persist } from 'zustand/middleware';
// Define cart item interface
export interface CartItem {
  id: string;
  productId: string;
  productName: string;
  productImage: string | null;
  quantity: number;
  unitPrice: number;
  totalPrice: number;
  color: string | null;
  size: string | null;
  sellerId: string;
  sellerName: string;
  sellerShippingFee: number; // Seller's shipping fee
  sellerShippingPaymentMode?: 'PAY_ON_DELIVERY' | 'PAY_ONLINE'; // Seller's shipping payment mode
  productInfoId: string;
  sellerProductId: string; // SellerProduct ID for stock management
  availableStock: number; // Available stock quantity
}
// Define cart state interface
export interface CartState {
  items: CartItem[];
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  lastUpdated: string | null;
}
// Define cart actions interface
export interface CartActions {
  // Item management
  addItem: (item: Omit<CartItem, 'id' | 'totalPrice'>) => void;
  removeItem: (itemId: string) => void;
  updateItemQuantity: (itemId: string, quantity: number) => void;
  clearCart: () => void;
  setItems: (items: CartItem[]) => void;
  // Bulk operations
  addMultipleItems: (items: Omit<CartItem, 'id' | 'totalPrice'>[]) => void;
  removeMultipleItems: (itemIds: string[]) => void;
  // State management
  setLoading: (loading: boolean) => void;
  setError: (error: string | null) => void;
  clearError: () => void;
  setLastUpdated: (date: string) => void;
  // Cart synchronization
  syncWithServer: () => Promise<void>;
  loadFromServer: () => Promise<void>;
  // Utility actions
  getItemById: (itemId: string) => CartItem | undefined;
  getItemByProductInfo: (
    productId: string,
    productInfoId: string,
    size?: string | null,
    color?: string | null,
    sellerProductId?: string | null
  ) => CartItem | undefined;
  getTotalItems: () => number;
  getTotalPrice: () => number;
  getTotalBySeller: (sellerId: string) => number;
  getUniqueSellers: () => string[];
}
// Define the complete store type
export type CartStore = CartState & CartActions;
// Helper function to calculate total price
const calculateTotalPrice = (items: CartItem[]): number => {
  return items.reduce((total, item) => total + item.totalPrice, 0);
};
// Helper function to generate unique ID
const generateId = (): string => {
  return Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9) + Date.now().toString(36);
};
// Create the cart store with persistence
export const useCartStore = create<CartStore>()(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      // Initial state
      items: [],
      isLoading: false,
      error: null,
      lastUpdated: null,
      // Item management
      addItem: (itemData) => {
        const existingItem = get().getItemByProductInfo(
          itemData.productId,
          itemData.productInfoId,
          itemData.size,
          itemData.color,
          itemData.sellerProductId
        );
        const maxStock =
          typeof itemData.availableStock === 'number' && itemData.availableStock > 0
            ? itemData.availableStock
            : typeof existingItem?.availableStock === 'number' &&
              existingItem.availableStock > 0
            ? existingItem.availableStock
            : undefined;
        if (existingItem) {
          // If already at or above max stock, prevent adding more
          if (maxStock !== undefined && existingItem.quantity >= maxStock) {
            return;
          }
          const targetQuantity = existingItem.quantity + itemData.quantity;
          const clampedQuantity =
            maxStock !== undefined
              ? Math.min(targetQuantity, maxStock)
              : targetQuantity;
          get().updateItemQuantity(existingItem.id, clampedQuantity);
        } else {
          const clampedQuantity =
            maxStock !== undefined
              ? Math.min(itemData.quantity, maxStock)
              : itemData.quantity;
          if (clampedQuantity <= 0) {
            return;
          }
          // Add new item
          const newItem: CartItem = {
            ...itemData,
            id: generateId(),
            quantity: clampedQuantity,
            totalPrice: itemData.unitPrice * clampedQuantity,
          };
          set((state) => ({
            items: [...state.items, newItem],
            lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
          }));
        }
      },
      removeItem: (itemId: string) => {
        set((state) => {
          const hasDirectIdMatch = state.items.some((item) => item.id === itemId);
          if (hasDirectIdMatch) {
            return {
              items: state.items.filter((item) => item.id !== itemId),
              lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
            };
          }
          return {
            items: state.items.filter(
              (item) =>
                item.id !== itemId &&
                item.sellerProductId !== itemId &&
                item.productId !== itemId
            ),
            lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
          };
        });
      },
      updateItemQuantity: (itemId, quantity) => {
        if (quantity <= 0) {
          get().removeItem(itemId);
          return;
        }
        const existing = get().items.find((item) => item.id === itemId);
        const maxStock = existing?.availableStock;
        const finalQuantity =
          typeof maxStock === 'number' && maxStock > 0
            ? Math.min(quantity, maxStock)
            : quantity;
        set((state) => ({
          items: state.items.map((item) =>
            item.id === itemId
              ? {
                  ...item,
                  quantity: finalQuantity,
                  totalPrice: item.unitPrice * finalQuantity,
                }
              : item
          ),
          lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
        }));
      },
      clearCart: () => {
        set({
          items: [],
          lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
        });
      },
      setItems: (items) => {
        set({
          items,
          lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
        });
      },
      // Bulk operations
      addMultipleItems: (itemsData) => {
        const newItems: CartItem[] = [];
        for (const itemData of itemsData) {
          const rawQty = Math.trunc(Number(itemData.quantity));
          if (!Number.isFinite(rawQty) || rawQty <= 0) {
            continue;
          }
          const maxStock =
            typeof itemData.availableStock === 'number' && itemData.availableStock > 0
              ? itemData.availableStock
              : undefined;
          const clampedQuantity =
            maxStock !== undefined ? Math.min(rawQty, maxStock) : rawQty;
          if (clampedQuantity <= 0) {
            continue;
          }
          newItems.push({
            ...itemData,
            id: generateId(),
            quantity: clampedQuantity,
            totalPrice: itemData.unitPrice * clampedQuantity,
          });
        }
        set((state) => ({
          items: [...state.items, ...newItems],
          lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
        }));
      },
      removeMultipleItems: (itemIds) => {
        set((state) => ({
          items: state.items.filter((item) => !itemIds.includes(item.id)),
          lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
        }));
      },
      // State management
      setLoading: (loading) => {
        set({ isLoading: loading });
      },
      setError: (error) => {
        set({ error });
      },
      clearError: () => {
        set({ error: null });
      },
      setLastUpdated: (date) => {
        set({ lastUpdated: date });
      },
      // Cart synchronization
      syncWithServer: async () => {
        set({ isLoading: true, error: null });
        try {
          // TODO: Replace with actual API call
          const response = await fetch('/api/cart/sync', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ items: get().items }),
          });
          if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error('Failed to sync cart with server');
          }
          const data = await response.json();
          set({
            items: data.items || get().items,
            lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
            isLoading: false,
            error: null,
          });
        } catch (error) {
          set({
            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Sync failed',
            isLoading: false,
          });
        }
      },
      loadFromServer: async () => {
        set({ isLoading: true, error: null });
        try {
          // TODO: Replace with actual API call
          const response = await fetch('/api/cart');
          if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error('Failed to load cart from server');
          }
          const data = await response.json();
          set({
            items: data.items || [],
            lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
            isLoading: false,
            error: null,
          });
        } catch (error) {
          set({
            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Load failed',
            isLoading: false,
          });
        }
      },
      // Utility actions
      getItemById: (itemId) => {
        return get().items.find((item) => item.id === itemId);
      },
      getItemByProductInfo: (
        productId,
        productInfoId,
        size,
        color,
        sellerProductId
      ) => {
        return get().items.find((item) => {
          const matchBase =
            item.productId === productId && item.productInfoId === productInfoId;
          if (!matchBase) return false;
          if (sellerProductId !== undefined && item.sellerProductId !== sellerProductId) {
            return false;
          }
          if (size !== undefined && item.size !== size) {
            return false;
          }
          if (color !== undefined && item.color !== color) {
            return false;
          }
          return true;
        });
      },
      getTotalItems: () => {
        return get().items.reduce((total, item) => total + item.quantity, 0);
      },
      getTotalPrice: () => {
        return calculateTotalPrice(get().items);
      },
      getTotalBySeller: (sellerId) => {
        const sellerItems = get().items.filter(
          (item) => item.sellerId === sellerId
        );
        return calculateTotalPrice(sellerItems);
      },
      getUniqueSellers: () => {
        const sellers = new Set(get().items.map((item) => item.sellerId));
        return Array.from(sellers);
      },
    }),
    {
      name: 'cart-storage',
      // Only persist items and lastUpdated to localStorage
      // This ensures cart persists across browser sessions
      // Cart is cleared on logout via auth context
      partialize: (state) => ({
        items: state.items,
        lastUpdated: state.lastUpdated,
      }),
    }
  )
);
// Cross-tab synchronization via storage events
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  window.addEventListener('storage', (event) => {
    if (event.key === 'cart-storage' && event.newValue) {
      try {
        useCartStore.persist?.rehydrate();
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to rehydrate cart from cross-tab storage event:', err);
      }
    }
  });
}
// Selector hooks for better performance
export const useCartItems = () => useCartStore((state) => state.items);
export const useCartLoading = () => useCartStore((state) => state.isLoading);
export const useCartError = () => useCartStore((state) => state.error);
// Memoized selectors to prevent infinite loops
export const useCartTotal = () => {
  const items = useCartStore((state) => state.items);
  return items.reduce((total, item) => total + item.totalPrice, 0);
};
export const useCartItemCount = () => {
  const items = useCartStore((state) => state.items);
  return items.reduce((total, item) => total + item.quantity, 0);
};
// Individual action hooks to prevent unnecessary re-renders
export const useAddItem = () => useCartStore((state) => state.addItem);
export const useRemoveItem = () => useCartStore((state) => state.removeItem);
export const useUpdateItemQuantity = () =>
  useCartStore((state) => state.updateItemQuantity);
export const useClearCart = () => useCartStore((state) => state.clearCart);
export const useAddMultipleItems = () =>
  useCartStore((state) => state.addMultipleItems);
export const useRemoveMultipleItems = () =>
  useCartStore((state) => state.removeMultipleItems);
export const useSetLoading = () => useCartStore((state) => state.setLoading);
export const useSetError = () => useCartStore((state) => state.setError);
export const useClearError = () => useCartStore((state) => state.clearError);
export const useSetLastUpdated = () =>
  useCartStore((state) => state.setLastUpdated);
export const useSyncWithServer = () =>
  useCartStore((state) => state.syncWithServer);
export const useLoadFromServer = () =>
  useCartStore((state) => state.loadFromServer);
export const useGetItemById = () => useCartStore((state) => state.getItemById);
export const useGetItemByProductInfo = () =>
  useCartStore((state) => state.getItemByProductInfo);
export const useGetTotalItems = () =>
  useCartStore((state) => state.getTotalItems);
export const useGetTotalPrice = () =>
  useCartStore((state) => state.getTotalPrice);
export const useGetTotalBySeller = () =>
  useCartStore((state) => state.getTotalBySeller);
export const useGetUniqueSellers = () =>
  useCartStore((state) => state.getUniqueSellers);
// Memoized actions hook to prevent infinite re-renders
export const useCartActions = () => {
  const addItem = useCartStore((state) => state.addItem);
  const removeItem = useCartStore((state) => state.removeItem);
  const updateItemQuantity = useCartStore((state) => state.updateItemQuantity);
  const clearCart = useCartStore((state) => state.clearCart);
  const addMultipleItems = useCartStore((state) => state.addMultipleItems);
  const removeMultipleItems = useCartStore(
    (state) => state.removeMultipleItems
  );
  const setLoading = useCartStore((state) => state.setLoading);
  const setError = useCartStore((state) => state.setError);
  const clearError = useCartStore((state) => state.clearError);
  const setLastUpdated = useCartStore((state) => state.setLastUpdated);
  const syncWithServer = useCartStore((state) => state.syncWithServer);
  const loadFromServer = useCartStore((state) => state.loadFromServer);
  const getItemById = useCartStore((state) => state.getItemById);
  const getItemByProductInfo = useCartStore(
    (state) => state.getItemByProductInfo
  );
  const getTotalItems = useCartStore((state) => state.getTotalItems);
  const getTotalPrice = useCartStore((state) => state.getTotalPrice);
  const getTotalBySeller = useCartStore((state) => state.getTotalBySeller);
  const getUniqueSellers = useCartStore((state) => state.getUniqueSellers);
  return {
    addItem,
    removeItem,
    updateItemQuantity,
    clearCart,
    addMultipleItems,
    removeMultipleItems,
    setLoading,
    setError,
    clearError,
    setLastUpdated,
    syncWithServer,
    loadFromServer,
    getItemById,
    getItemByProductInfo,
    getTotalItems,
    getTotalPrice,
    getTotalBySeller,
    getUniqueSellers,
  };
};

<file path="libs/client/sellers/components/footer/src/lib/sellers-footer.spec.tsx">
import React from 'react';
import { render } from '@testing-library/react';
import { vi } from 'vitest';
import { SellersFooter } from './sellers-footer';
import { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
// Any LL key not listed explicitly falls back to a function returning its key path,
// so the render smoke test does not break each time the footer uses a new translation.
const { withKeyFallback } = vi.hoisted(() => {
  const withKeyFallback = (base: unknown, path = ''): unknown =>
    new Proxy(typeof base === 'function' ? base : () => path, {
      get: (_t, k) =>
        typeof k === 'symbol'
          ? undefined
          : withKeyFallback(
              base && typeof base === 'object' ? (base as Record<string, unknown>)[k] : undefined,
              path ? `${path}.${String(k)}` : String(k)
            ),
    });
  return { withKeyFallback };
});
// Mock the i18n context
vi.mock('@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n', async () => {
  const actual = await vi.importActual<
    typeof import('@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n')
  >('@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n');
  return {
    ...actual,
    useI18nContext: () => ({
      LL: withKeyFallback({
        appNames: {
          siteName: () => actual.SITE_NAME,
        },
        navigation: {
          sellersPortal: () => 'Sellers Portal',
          languageSettings: () => 'Language Settings',
        },
        form: {
          currentLanguage: () => 'Current Language',
        },
      }),
    }),
    useLanguageContext: () => ({
      currentLocale: 'en',
      availableLocales: [
        { code: 'en', name: 'English', nativeName: 'English' },
      ],
    }),
  };
});
test('renders SellersFooter', () => {
  const { container } = render(
    <BrowserRouter>
      <SellersFooter />
    </BrowserRouter>
  );
  expect(container).toBeTruthy();
});
