<file path="libs/client/sellers/screens/manage-product/src/lib/SellersManageProductScreen.tsx">
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import { useSellersAuthContext } from '@kickzone-workspace/sellers-auth-context';
import { SellersLayout } from '@kickzone-workspace/sellers-layout';
import { useSellersProductManagement } from '@kickzone-workspace/sellers-products-hooks';
import { useSnackbar } from '@kickzone-workspace/snackbar-hook';
import { PriceDisplay } from '@kickzone-workspace/price-display';
import { GlassmorphismContainer } from '@kickzone-workspace/glassmorphism-container';
import { getLtrTextFieldProps } from '@kickzone-workspace/language-components';
import { formatVariantColorNames } from '@kickzone-workspace/client-shared-graphql';
import { formatSizeLabel, isPantsSizeKind, SizeKind } from '@kickzone-workspace/product-sizes';
import Alert from '@mui/material/Alert';
import Autocomplete from '@mui/material/Autocomplete';
import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import Button from '@mui/material/Button';
import Card from '@mui/material/Card';
import CardContent from '@mui/material/CardContent';
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip';
import CircularProgress from '@mui/material/CircularProgress';
import Divider from '@mui/material/Divider';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid';
import TextField from '@mui/material/TextField';
import ToggleButton from '@mui/material/ToggleButton';
import ToggleButtonGroup from '@mui/material/ToggleButtonGroup';
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography';
import FormControlLabel from '@mui/material/FormControlLabel';
import Switch from '@mui/material/Switch';
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import {
  sellerProductFormSchema,
  type SellerProductFormInput,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import { Link as RouterLink, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  useI18nContext,
  useLanguageContext,
  usePageTitle,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/shared-i18n';
import { SELLER_ROUTES } from '@kickzone-workspace/sellers-routes';
import { SellersDefineProductFlow } from './SellersDefineProductFlow';
import { alpha } from '@mui/material/styles';
const displayVariantSize = (info: { size: string; sizeKind?: string | null }): string =>
  isPantsSizeKind(info.sizeKind) ? formatSizeLabel(SizeKind.Pants, info.size) || info.size : info.size;
const initialFormData: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.CreateSellerProductInput = {
  productInfoId: 0,
  price: 0,
  costPrice: 0,
  discount: 0,
  stockQuantity: 0,
  boxLess: false,
};
export function SellersManageProductScreen() {
  const { user, canManageCatalog, sellerInfoLoading } = useSellersAuthContext();
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const { showSnackbar } = useSnackbar();
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  usePageTitle(() => LL.pageTitles.sellerManageProduct());
  const { formatNumber, currentLocale } = useLanguageContext();
  const [formData, setFormData] =
    useState<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.CreateSellerProductInput>(initialFormData);
  const productForm = useForm<SellerProductFormInput>({
    values: formData,
    resolver: zodResolver(sellerProductFormSchema),
    mode: 'onSubmit',
  });
  const productErrors = productForm.formState.errors;
  const [selectedProduct, setSelectedProduct] =
    useState<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product | null>(null);
  const [selectedProductInfo, setSelectedProductInfo] =
    useState<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductInfo | null>(null);
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const [editingProductId, setEditingProductId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const defineRequested = searchParams.get('define') === '1';
  const mode: 'existing' | 'define' =
    canManageCatalog && !isEditing && defineRequested ? 'define' : 'existing';
  // Use the new hook
  const {
    products,
    sellerProduct,
    isManagementLoading,
    isProductsLoading,
    isSellerProductLoading,
    productsError,
    sellerProductError,
    createError,
    updateError,
    createProduct,
    updateProduct,
    getSellerProductById,
  } = useSellersProductManagement();
  // Handle URL parameters for editing - fetch seller product data
  useEffect(() => {
    const sellerProductId = searchParams.get('sellerProductId');
    if (sellerProductId) {
      setIsEditing(true);
      setEditingProductId(sellerProductId);
      // Fetch the seller product data
      getSellerProductById({ variables: { id: sellerProductId } });
    } else {
      setIsEditing(false);
      setEditingProductId(null);
    }
  }, [searchParams, getSellerProductById]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (sellerInfoLoading || canManageCatalog || !defineRequested) {
      return;
    }
    setSearchParams({}, { replace: true });
  }, [sellerInfoLoading, canManageCatalog, defineRequested, setSearchParams]);
  // Handle seller product data when it's loaded
  useEffect(() => {
    if (sellerProduct && isEditing && sellerProduct.productInfo) {
      // Set the product and product info
      setSelectedProduct(sellerProduct.product);
      setSelectedProductInfo(sellerProduct.productInfo);
      // Set the form data
      const newFormData = {
        productInfoId: sellerProduct.productInfo.id,
        price: sellerProduct.price ?? 0,
        costPrice: sellerProduct.costPrice ?? 0,
        discount: sellerProduct.discount ?? 0,
        stockQuantity: sellerProduct.stockQuantity ?? 0,
        boxLess: sellerProduct.boxLess ?? false,
      };
      setFormData(newFormData);
    }
  }, [sellerProduct, isEditing, sellerProductError, isSellerProductLoading]);
  const productOptions = useMemo(() => {
    if (
      isEditing &&
      selectedProduct &&
      !products.some((p) => p.id === selectedProduct.id)
    ) {
      return [selectedProduct, ...products];
    }
    return products;
  }, [isEditing, selectedProduct, products]);
  const variantOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const list = selectedProduct?.productInfos || [];
    if (
      isEditing &&
      selectedProductInfo &&
      !list.some((info) => info.id === selectedProductInfo.id)
    ) {
      return [selectedProductInfo, ...list];
    }
    return list;
  }, [isEditing, selectedProductInfo, selectedProduct?.productInfos]);
  const resetForm = () => {
    setFormData(initialFormData);
    setSelectedProduct(null);
    setSelectedProductInfo(null);
    setIsEditing(false);
    setEditingProductId(null);
  };
  const handleCreateDefinedListings = async (
    listings: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.CreateSellerProductInput[]
  ) => {
    for (const listing of listings) {
      await createProduct(listing);
    }
    showSnackbar(LL.messages.listingsSaved(), {
      severity: 'success',
      duration: 4000,
    });
    resetForm();
    setSearchParams({}, { replace: true });
  };
  const handleProductChange = (
    product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product | null
  ) => {
    setSelectedProduct(product);
    setSelectedProductInfo(null);
    setFormData((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      productInfoId: 0,
    }));
  };
  const handleProductInfoChange = (
    productInfo: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductInfo | null
  ) => {
    setSelectedProductInfo(productInfo);
    setFormData((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      productInfoId: productInfo?.id || 0,
    }));
  };
  const handleInputChange = (
    field: keyof KickzoneGraphqlTypes.CreateSellerProductInput,
    value: string | number | boolean
  ) => {
    let parsed: string | number | boolean = value;
    if (typeof value === 'string') {
      if (field === 'stockQuantity') {
        parsed = value === '' ? 0 : parseInt(value, 10);
        if (isNaN(parsed) || parsed < 0) parsed = 0;
      } else if (
        field === 'price' ||
        field === 'costPrice' ||
        field === 'discount'
      ) {
        parsed = value === '' ? 0 : parseFloat(value);
        if (isNaN(parsed) || parsed < 0) parsed = 0;
      }
    }
    setFormData((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [field]: parsed,
    }));
  };
  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!user?.id) {
      console.error('User not authenticated');
      return;
    }
    if (!formData.productInfoId) {
      console.error('No product variant selected');
      return;
    }
    if (!(await productForm.trigger())) return;
    try {
      if (isEditing && editingProductId) {
        await updateProduct(
          {
            id: editingProductId,
            productInfoId: formData.productInfoId,
            price: formData.price,
            costPrice: formData.costPrice,
            discount: formData.discount,
            stockQuantity: formData.stockQuantity,
            boxLess: formData.boxLess ?? false,
          },
          editingProductId
        );
        showSnackbar(LL.messages.productUpdated(), {
          severity: 'success',
          duration: 4000,
        });
      } else {
        await createProduct(formData);
        showSnackbar(LL.messages.productSaved(), {
          severity: 'success',
          duration: 4000,
        });
        // Reset form after successful creation
        resetForm();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error submitting form:', error);
      // Error handling is already done by the error states in the hook
    }
  };
  const isFormValid = () => sellerProductFormSchema.safeParse(formData).success;
  const isLoading =
    isManagementLoading || isProductsLoading || isSellerProductLoading;
  const finalPrice = (formData.price * (100 - formData.discount)) / 100;
  // Show loading state while products are being fetched
  if (isProductsLoading || (isEditing && isSellerProductLoading)) {
    return (
      <SellersLayout>
        <GlassmorphismContainer
          containerSx={{ maxWidth: 1200, margin: '0 auto' }}
        >
          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'flex',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              alignItems: 'center',
              minHeight: 200,
            }}
          >
            <CircularProgress size={40} />
            <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ ml: 2 }}>
              {LL.products.loadingProducts()}
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </GlassmorphismContainer>
      </SellersLayout>
    );
  }
  return (
    <SellersLayout>
      <GlassmorphismContainer
        containerSx={{ maxWidth: 1200, margin: '0 auto' }}
      >
        <Typography
          variant="h4"
          sx={{
            mb: 4,
            color: 'text.primary',
            fontWeight: 600,
            borderBottom: '1px solid',
            borderColor: 'divider',
            pb: 2,
          }}
        >
          {isEditing ? LL.products.editProduct() : LL.button.addNewProduct()}
        </Typography>
        {canManageCatalog && !isEditing && (
          <Box sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
            <ToggleButtonGroup exclusive fullWidth value={mode} color="primary">
              <ToggleButton
                value="existing"
                component={RouterLink}
                to={SELLER_ROUTES.MANAGE_PRODUCT}
                replace
                sx={{ textTransform: 'none' }}
              >
                {LL.products.sellExistingProduct()}
              </ToggleButton>
              <ToggleButton
                value="define"
                component={RouterLink}
                to={`${SELLER_ROUTES.MANAGE_PRODUCT}?define=1`}
                replace
                sx={{ textTransform: 'none' }}
              >
                {LL.products.defineNewProduct()}
              </ToggleButton>
            </ToggleButtonGroup>
          </Box>
        )}
        {canManageCatalog && !isEditing && mode === 'define' ? (
          <SellersDefineProductFlow
            onCreateListings={handleCreateDefinedListings}
            isSubmitting={isManagementLoading}
          />
        ) : (
          <>
            {(createError ||
              updateError ||
              productsError ||
              sellerProductError) && (
              <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 3, borderRadius: 2 }}>
                {createError?.message ||
                  updateError?.message ||
                  productsError?.message ||
                  sellerProductError?.message}
              </Alert>
            )}
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
              <Grid container spacing={4}>
                {/* Product Selection */}
                <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
                  <Card
                    variant="outlined"
                    sx={{
                      borderRadius: 2,
                      border: '1px solid',
                      borderColor: 'divider',
                      '&:hover': {
                        borderColor: 'primary.main',
                        boxShadow: '0 4px 12px rgba(26,26,25,0.08)',
                      },
                      transition: 'all 0.3s',
                    }}
                  >
                    <CardContent sx={{ p: 3 }}>
                      <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ mb: 2, fontWeight: 500 }}>
                        {LL.products.selectProduct()}
                      </Typography>
                      <Autocomplete
                        options={productOptions}
                        getOptionLabel={(option) => option.name}
                        value={selectedProduct}
                        onChange={(_, newValue) =>
                          handleProductChange(newValue)
                        }
                        isOptionEqualToValue={(option, value) =>
                          option?.id === value?.id
                        }
                        disabled={isEditing || isLoading}
                        renderInput={(params) => (
                          <TextField
                            {...params}
                            label={LL.button.chooseProduct()}
                            required
                            disabled={isEditing || isLoading}
                          />
                        )}
                        renderOption={(props, option) => {
                          const { key, ...otherProps } = props;
                          return (
                            <Box
                              component="li"
                              key={key}
                              {...otherProps}
                              sx={{ py: 1.5 }}
                            >
                              <Box sx={{ width: '100%' }}>
                                <Typography variant="body1" fontWeight={600}>
                                  {option.name}
                                </Typography>
                                <Box
                                  sx={{
                                    display: 'flex',
                                    gap: 0.5,
                                    mt: 0.5,
                                    flexWrap: 'wrap',
                                  }}
                                >
                                  {option.categories.map((cat) => (
                                    <Chip
                                      key={cat.id}
                                      label={cat.name}
                                      size="small"
                                      sx={{
                                        backgroundColor: 'primary.50',
                                        color: 'primary.main',
                                        fontSize: '0.7rem',
                                        height: 20,
                                      }}
                                    />
                                  ))}
                                </Box>
                              </Box>
                            </Box>
                          );
                        }}
                      />
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </Grid>
                {/* Product Variant Selection */}
                {selectedProduct && (
                  <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
                    <Card
                      variant="outlined"
                      sx={{
                        borderRadius: 2,
                        border: '2px solid',
                        borderColor: 'secondary.100',
                        '&:hover': {
                          borderColor: 'secondary.main',
                          boxShadow: '0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)',
                        },
                        transition: 'all 0.3s',
                      }}
                    >
                      <CardContent sx={{ p: 3 }}>
                        <Typography
                          variant="h6"
                          sx={{ mb: 2, fontWeight: 600 }}
                        >
                          {LL.products.selectVariant()}
                        </Typography>
                        <Autocomplete
                          options={variantOptions}
                          getOptionLabel={(option) =>
                            `${displayVariantSize(option)} - ${formatVariantColorNames(
                              option.colors,
                              LL.products.noColorSpecified()
                            )} (${option.weight}kg)`
                          }
                          value={selectedProductInfo}
                          onChange={(_, newValue) =>
                            handleProductInfoChange(newValue)
                          }
                          isOptionEqualToValue={(option, value) =>
                            option?.id === value?.id
                          }
                          disabled={isEditing || isLoading}
                          renderInput={(params) => (
                            <TextField
                              {...params}
                              label={LL.button.chooseVariant()}
                              required
                              disabled={isEditing || isLoading}
                            />
                          )}
                          renderOption={(props, option) => {
                            const { key, ...otherProps } = props;
                            return (
                              <Box
                                component="li"
                                key={key}
                                {...otherProps}
                                sx={{ py: 1.5 }}
                              >
                                <Box
                                  sx={{
                                    display: 'flex',
                                    alignItems: 'center',
                                    gap: 1.5,
                                    width: '100%',
                                  }}
                                >
                                  {option.colors?.map((color) => (
                                    <Box
                                      key={color.id}
                                      sx={{
                                        width: 24,
                                        height: 24,
                                        backgroundColor: color.hexCode,
                                        borderRadius: '50%',
                                        border: '2px solid white',
                                        boxShadow:
                                          '0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)',
                                      }}
                                    />
                                  ))}
                                  <Box sx={{ flex: 1 }}>
                                    <Typography fontWeight={600}>
                                      {displayVariantSize(option)} -{' '}
                                      {formatVariantColorNames(
                                        option.colors,
                                        LL.products.noColorSpecified()
                                      )}
                                    </Typography>
                                    <Typography
                                      variant="caption"
                                      color="text.secondary"
                                    >
                                      {LL.products.weight()}:{' '}
                                      {formatNumber(option.weight)}kg
                                    </Typography>
                                  </Box>
                                </Box>
                              </Box>
                            );
                          }}
                        />
                      </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                  </Grid>
                )}
                {/* Product Details Card */}
                {selectedProduct && selectedProductInfo && (
                  <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
                    <Card
                      variant="outlined"
                      sx={(theme) => ({
                        borderRadius: 2,
                        border: '2px solid',
                        borderColor: 'info.200',
                        background:
                          'linear-gradient(135deg, #f0f4f8 0%, #e8eef5 100%)',
                        ...theme.applyStyles('dark', {
                          background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${alpha(
                            theme.palette.info.main,
                            0.14
                          )} 0%, ${alpha(theme.palette.info.main, 0.04)} 100%)`,
                        }),
                      })}
                    >
                      <CardContent sx={{ p: 3 }}>
                        <Typography
                          variant="h6"
                          sx={{ mb: 3, fontWeight: 600, color: 'info.main' }}
                        >
                          {LL.products.productDetails()}
                        </Typography>
                        <Grid container spacing={2}>
                          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                            <Box sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                              <Typography
                                variant="caption"
                                color="text.secondary"
                                fontWeight={600}
                              >
                                {LL.form.productName()}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="body1" fontWeight={500}>
                                {selectedProduct.name}
                              </Typography>
                            </Box>
                          </Grid>
                          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                            <Box sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                              <Typography
                                variant="caption"
                                color="text.secondary"
                                fontWeight={600}
                              >
                                {LL.products.variant()}
                              </Typography>
                              <Box
                                sx={{
                                  display: 'flex',
                                  alignItems: 'center',
                                  gap: 1,
                                  mt: 0.5,
                                }}
                              >
                                {selectedProductInfo.colors?.map((color) => (
                                  <Box
                                    key={color.id}
                                    sx={{
                                      width: 20,
                                      height: 20,
                                      backgroundColor: color.hexCode,
                                      borderRadius: '50%',
                                      border: '2px solid white',
                                      boxShadow: '0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)',
                                    }}
                                  />
                                ))}
                                <Typography variant="body1" fontWeight={500}>
                                  {displayVariantSize(selectedProductInfo)} -{' '}
                                  {formatVariantColorNames(
                                    selectedProductInfo.colors,
                                    LL.products.noColorSpecified()
                                  )}
                                </Typography>
                              </Box>
                            </Box>
                          </Grid>
                          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                            <Box sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                              <Typography
                                variant="caption"
                                color="text.secondary"
                                fontWeight={600}
                              >
                                {LL.products.weight()}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="body1" fontWeight={500}>
                                {formatNumber(selectedProductInfo.weight)}kg
                              </Typography>
                            </Box>
                          </Grid>
                          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                            <Box>
                              <Typography
                                variant="caption"
                                color="text.secondary"
                                fontWeight={600}
                              >
                                {LL.products.categories()}
                              </Typography>
                              <Box
                                sx={{
                                  display: 'flex',
                                  gap: 0.5,
                                  mt: 0.5,
                                  flexWrap: 'wrap',
                                }}
                              >
                                {selectedProduct.categories.map((cat) => (
                                  <Chip
                                    key={cat.id}
                                    label={cat.name}
                                    size="small"
                                    sx={{
                                      backgroundColor: 'success.50',
                                      color: 'success.main',
                                      fontWeight: 600,
                                    }}
                                  />
                                ))}
                              </Box>
                            </Box>
                          </Grid>
                        </Grid>
                      </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                  </Grid>
                )}
                {/* Pricing and Stock Form */}
                {selectedProductInfo && (
                  <>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
                      <Divider sx={{ my: 2 }} />
                      <Typography
                        variant="h6"
                        sx={{ mb: 3, fontWeight: 600, color: 'primary.main' }}
                      >
                        {LL.products.pricingInformation()}
                      </Typography>
                    </Grid>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                      <TextField
                        fullWidth
                        label={LL.form.price()}
                        type="number"
                        value={formData.price}
                        error={Boolean(productErrors.price)}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          handleInputChange('price', e.target.value)
                        }
                        required
                        disabled={isLoading}
                        {...getLtrTextFieldProps({
                          '& .MuiOutlinedInput-root': {
                            '&:hover fieldset': {
                              borderColor: 'primary.main',
                            },
                          },
                        })}
                        slotProps={{
                          htmlInput: { dir: 'ltr', min: 0, step: 0.01 },
                        }}
                      />
                    </Grid>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                      <TextField
                        fullWidth
                        label={LL.form.costPrice()}
                        type="number"
                        value={formData.costPrice}
                        error={Boolean(productErrors.costPrice)}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          handleInputChange('costPrice', e.target.value)
                        }
                        required
                        disabled={isLoading}
                        {...getLtrTextFieldProps({
                          '& .MuiOutlinedInput-root': {
                            '&:hover fieldset': {
                              borderColor: 'primary.main',
                            },
                          },
                        })}
                        slotProps={{
                          htmlInput: { dir: 'ltr', min: 0, step: 0.01 },
                        }}
                      />
                    </Grid>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                      <TextField
                        fullWidth
                        label={LL.form.discount()}
                        type="number"
                        value={formData.discount}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          handleInputChange('discount', e.target.value)
                        }
                        disabled={isLoading}
                        helperText={LL.products.discountHelper()}
                        {...getLtrTextFieldProps({
                          '& .MuiOutlinedInput-root': {
                            '&:hover fieldset': {
                              borderColor: 'primary.main',
                            },
                          },
                        })}
                        slotProps={{
                          htmlInput: {
                            dir: 'ltr',
                            min: 0,
                            max: 100,
                            step: 0.01,
                          },
                        }}
                      />
                    </Grid>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                      <TextField
                        fullWidth
                        label={LL.form.stockQuantity()}
                        type="number"
                        value={formData.stockQuantity}
                        error={Boolean(productErrors.stockQuantity)}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          handleInputChange('stockQuantity', e.target.value)
                        }
                        required
                        disabled={isLoading}
                        {...getLtrTextFieldProps({
                          '& .MuiOutlinedInput-root': {
                            '&:hover fieldset': {
                              borderColor: 'primary.main',
                            },
                          },
                        })}
                        slotProps={{
                          htmlInput: { dir: 'ltr', min: 0 },
                        }}
                      />
                    </Grid>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
                      <FormControlLabel
                        control={
                          <Switch
                            checked={formData.boxLess ?? false}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              handleInputChange('boxLess', e.target.checked)
                            }
                            disabled={isLoading}
                            color="primary"
                          />
                        }
                        label={LL.products.boxLess()}
                      />
                      <Typography
                        variant="caption"
                        color="text.secondary"
                        display="block"
                      >
                        {LL.products.boxLessHelper()}
                      </Typography>
                    </Grid>
                    {/* Final Price Display */}
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
                      <Card
                        sx={{
                          background:
                            'linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%)',
                          borderRadius: 3,
                          boxShadow: '0 8px 24px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.25)',
                          color: 'white',
                        }}
                      >
                        <CardContent sx={{ p: 3 }}>
                          <Typography
                            variant="h5"
                            sx={{ mb: 2, fontWeight: 700 }}
                          >
                            {LL.products.finalPriceAfterDiscount()}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box
                            sx={{
                              display: 'flex',
                              alignItems: 'baseline',
                              gap: 2,
                              mb: 2,
                            }}
                          >
                            <Typography variant="h3" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
                              ${formatNumber(finalPrice.toFixed(2))}
                            </Typography>
                            {currentLocale === 'fa' && (
                              <Box
                                sx={{
                                  px: 2,
                                  py: 1,
                                  bgcolor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)',
                                  borderRadius: 2,
                                  fontSize: '1.5rem',
                                  fontWeight: 700,
                                }}
                              >
                                <PriceDisplay
                                  priceInUSD={finalPrice}
                                  showSymbol={true}
                                  showOriginal={false}
                                />
                              </Box>
                            )}
                          </Box>
                          <Divider
                            sx={{ my: 2, borderColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)' }}
                          />
                          <Box
                            sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 3, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}
                          >
                            <Box>
                              <Typography
                                variant="caption"
                                sx={{ opacity: 0.8 }}
                              >
                                {LL.products.original()}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="h6" fontWeight={600}>
                                ${formatNumber(formData.price)}
                                {currentLocale === 'fa' && (
                                  <Box
                                    component="span"
                                    sx={{
                                      ml: 1,
                                      fontSize: '0.9rem',
                                      opacity: 0.9,
                                    }}
                                  >
                                    (
                                    <PriceDisplay
                                      priceInUSD={formData.price}
                                      showSymbol={true}
                                      showOriginal={false}
                                    />
                                    )
                                  </Box>
                                )}
                              </Typography>
                            </Box>
                            <Box>
                              <Typography
                                variant="caption"
                                sx={{ opacity: 0.8 }}
                              >
                                {LL.products.discount()}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="h6" fontWeight={600}>
                                {formatNumber(formData.discount)}%
                              </Typography>
                            </Box>
                            <Box>
                              <Typography
                                variant="caption"
                                sx={{ opacity: 0.8 }}
                              >
                                {LL.products.savings()}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="h6" fontWeight={600}>
                                $
                                {formatNumber(
                                  (formData.price - finalPrice).toFixed(2)
                                )}
                                {currentLocale === 'fa' && (
                                  <Box
                                    component="span"
                                    sx={{
                                      ml: 1,
                                      fontSize: '0.9rem',
                                      opacity: 0.9,
                                    }}
                                  >
                                    (
                                    <PriceDisplay
                                      priceInUSD={formData.price - finalPrice}
                                      showSymbol={true}
                                      showOriginal={false}
                                    />
                                    )
                                  </Box>
                                )}
                              </Typography>
                            </Box>
                          </Box>
                        </CardContent>
                      </Card>
                    </Grid>
                  </>
                )}
                {/* Action Buttons */}
                <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
                  <Box
                    sx={{
                      display: 'flex',
                      gap: 2,
                      justifyContent: 'flex-end',
                      pt: 2,
                    }}
                  >
                    <Button
                      variant="outlined"
                      onClick={resetForm}
                      disabled={isLoading}
                      size="large"
                      sx={{
                        borderRadius: 2,
                        textTransform: 'none',
                        fontWeight: 600,
                        px: 4,
                      }}
                    >
                      {LL.button.clear()}
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      type="submit"
                      variant="contained"
                      color="primary"
                      disabled={!isFormValid()}
                      loading={isLoading}
                      size="large"
                      sx={{
                        borderRadius: 2,
                        textTransform: 'none',
                        fontWeight: 600,
                        px: 4,
                        boxShadow: 'none',
                        '&:hover': {
                          boxShadow: 'none',
                        },
                      }}
                    >
                      {isEditing
                        ? LL.button.updateProduct()
                        : LL.button.addProduct()}
                    </Button>
                  </Box>
                </Grid>
              </Grid>
            </form>
          </>
        )}
      </GlassmorphismContainer>
    </SellersLayout>
  );
}
export default SellersManageProductScreen;

    });

      const pendingOrder = {
        id: 'ORD-PENDING-1',
        orderNumber: 'ORD-PENDING-1',
        status: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Pending,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),

        sellerId: 1,

        shippingCost: 10,
        trackingNumber: 'TRACK-1',

        notes: '',
      };
      const confirmedOrder = {
        id: 'ORD-CONFIRMED-2',
        orderNumber: 'ORD-CONFIRMED-2',
        status: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Confirmed,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        sellerId: 1,
        total: 200,
        subtotal: 180,
        shippingCost: 20,
        trackingNumber: 'TRACK-2',
        items: [{ id: 'item-2', orderId: 'ORD-CONFIRMED-2', productId: 'p2', productName: 'Product 2', quantity: 1, unitPrice: 200, totalPrice: 200 }],
        notes: '',
      };
      const allOrders = [pendingOrder, confirmedOrder];
      // Use mockImplementation to dynamically filter based on status argument
      mockUseSellerOrders.mockImplementation((args: { status?: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus | 'ALL' }) => {
        const status = args?.status;
        const filteredOrders = status && status !== 'ALL'
          ? allOrders.filter((o) => o.status === status)
          : allOrders;
        return {
          orders: filteredOrders,
          loading: false,
          error: null,
          updateOrderStatus: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
          updateStatusLoading: false,
        };
      });
      renderWithTheme(<SellerOrdersScreen />);
      // Verify initial state - both orders visible (status is undefined initially)
      expect(screen.getByText(/ORD-PENDING-1/)).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByText(/ORD-CONFIRMED-2/)).toBeInTheDocument();
      // Switch to PENDING - find the native Select input and fire change event
      const select = screen.getByTestId('ArrowDropDownIcon').closest('div')?.querySelector('input[aria-hidden="true"]') as HTMLInputElement;
      expect(select).toBeInTheDocument();
      fireEvent.change(select, { target: { value: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Pending } });
      // Verify hook called with PENDING status
      expect(mockUseSellerOrders).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ status: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Pending }));
      // Check only PENDING visible (mockImplementation filters automatically)
      expect(screen.getByText(/ORD-PENDING-1/)).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.queryByText(/ORD-CONFIRMED-2/)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
      // Switch back to ALL (empty string value)
      fireEvent.change(select, { target: { value: '' } });
      // Verify hook called with undefined status (ALL)
      expect(mockUseSellerOrders).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ status: undefined }));
      // Both orders visible again
      expect(screen.getByText(/ORD-PENDING-1/)).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByText(/ORD-CONFIRMED-2/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });
});

  { cursor: 'c-1', node: { id: '1', orderNumber: 'ORD-1', status: 'PENDING' } },
  { cursor: 'c-2', node: { id: '2', orderNumber: 'ORD-2', status: 'CONFIRMED' } },
  { cursor: 'c-3', node: { id: '3', orderNumber: 'ORD-3', status: 'SHIPPED' } },

];
describe('Heavy 7: real useSellerOrders hook unit tests - Locked Tests 1-5', () => {
  const mockRefetch = jest.fn();
  const mockFetchMore = jest.fn();
  const mockUpdateOrderStatusMutate = jest.fn();
  const mockUpdateOrderMutate = jest.fn();
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockApolloUseQuery.mockReset();
    mockApolloUseMutation.mockReset();
    mockRefetch.mockReset();
    mockFetchMore.mockReset();
    mockUpdateOrderStatusMutate.mockReset();
    mockUpdateOrderMutate.mockReset();
    mockApolloUseMutation
      .mockReturnValueOnce([mockUpdateOrderStatusMutate, { loading: false }])
      .mockReturnValueOnce([mockUpdateOrderMutate, { loading: false }]);
  });
  // Locked Test 1
  it('returns all orders when status=ALL and omits status variable', () => {
    mockApolloUseQuery.mockReturnValue({
      data: {
        mySellerOrders: {
          edges: mixedStatusEdges,
          pageInfo: { hasNextPage: false, endCursor: 'c-4' },
        },
      },
      loading: false,
      error: undefined,
      refetch: mockRefetch,
      fetchMore: mockFetchMore,
    });
    const result = realUseSellerOrders({ first: 10, status: 'ALL' });
    const queryOptions = mockApolloUseQuery.mock.calls[0][1];
    expect(queryOptions.variables).toEqual({ first: 10, after: undefined });
    expect('status' in queryOptions.variables).toBe(false);
    expect(result.orders).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(result.orders.map((o: { status: string }) => o.status)).toEqual(['PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'SHIPPED', 'CANCELLED']);
  });
  // Locked Test 2
  it('returns all orders when status=undefined and omits status variable', () => {
    mockApolloUseQuery.mockReturnValue({
      data: {
        mySellerOrders: {
          edges: mixedStatusEdges,
          pageInfo: { hasNextPage: false, endCursor: 'c-4' },
        },
      },
      loading: false,
      error: undefined,
      refetch: mockRefetch,
      fetchMore: mockFetchMore,
    });
    const result = realUseSellerOrders({ first: 10, status: undefined });
    const queryOptions = mockApolloUseQuery.mock.calls[0][1];
    expect(queryOptions.variables).toEqual({ first: 10, after: undefined });
    expect('status' in queryOptions.variables).toBe(false);
    expect(result.orders).toHaveLength(4);
  });
  // Locked Test 3
  it('filters by CONFIRMED status, includes status in query/mutation/fetchMore', () => {
    mockApolloUseQuery.mockReturnValue({
      data: {
        mySellerOrders: {
          edges: [{ cursor: 'c-confirmed-1', node: { id: '2', orderNumber: 'ORD-2', status: 'CONFIRMED' } }],
          pageInfo: { hasNextPage: true, endCursor: 'cursor-confirmed-1' },
        },
      },
      loading: false,
      error: undefined,
      refetch: mockRefetch,
      fetchMore: mockFetchMore,
    });
    const result = realUseSellerOrders({ first: 10, status: 'CONFIRMED' as NonNullable<Parameters<typeof UseSellerOrdersFn>[0]>['status'] });
    expect(mockApolloUseQuery).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      GET_MY_ORDERS_QUERY,
      expect.objectContaining({
        variables: { first: 10, after: undefined, status: 'CONFIRMED' },
      })
    );
    expect(mockApolloUseMutation).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'UPDATE_ORDER_STATUS_MUTATION_DOC',
      expect.objectContaining({
        refetchQueries: [{ query: GET_MY_ORDERS_QUERY, variables: { first: 10, status: 'CONFIRMED' } }],
      })
    );
    expect(result.orders).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(result.orders[0].status).toBe('CONFIRMED');
    result.loadMore();
    expect(mockFetchMore).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ variables: { after: 'cursor-confirmed-1', status: 'CONFIRMED' } });
  });
  // Locked Test 4
  it('loadMore preserves status filter (ALL omits status, SHIPPED includes status)', () => {
    // Part 1: status = ALL
    mockApolloUseQuery.mockReturnValue({
      data: {
        mySellerOrders: {
          edges: mixedStatusEdges,
          pageInfo: { hasNextPage: true, endCursor: 'cursor-123' },
        },
      },
      loading: false,
      error: undefined,
      refetch: mockRefetch,
      fetchMore: mockFetchMore,
    });
    const allResult = realUseSellerOrders({ first: 10, status: 'ALL' });
    allResult.loadMore();
    expect(mockFetchMore).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith({ variables: { after: 'cursor-123' } });
    expect('status' in mockFetchMore.mock.calls[0][0].variables).toBe(false);
    // Part 2: status = SHIPPED
    mockApolloUseMutation.mockReset();
    mockApolloUseMutation
      .mockReturnValueOnce([mockUpdateOrderStatusMutate, { loading: false }])
      .mockReturnValueOnce([mockUpdateOrderMutate, { loading: false }]);
    mockFetchMore.mockReset();
    mockApolloUseQuery.mockReturnValue({
      data: {
        mySellerOrders: {
          edges: [{ cursor: 'c-shipped-1', node: { id: '3', orderNumber: 'ORD-3', status: 'SHIPPED' } }],
          pageInfo: { hasNextPage: true, endCursor: 'cursor-123' },
        },
      },
      loading: false,
      error: undefined,
      refetch: mockRefetch,
      fetchMore: mockFetchMore,
    });
    const shippedResult = realUseSellerOrders({ first: 10, status: 'SHIPPED' as NonNullable<Parameters<typeof UseSellerOrdersFn>[0]>['status'] });
    shippedResult.loadMore();
    expect(mockFetchMore).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith({ variables: { after: 'cursor-123', status: 'SHIPPED' } });
  });
  // Locked Test 5
  it('loadMore returns undefined and does not call fetchMore when hasNextPage=false', () => {
    mockApolloUseQuery.mockReturnValue({
      data: {
        mySellerOrders: {
          edges: mixedStatusEdges,
          pageInfo: { hasNextPage: false, endCursor: null },
        },
      },
      loading: false,
      error: undefined,
      refetch: mockRefetch,
      fetchMore: mockFetchMore,
    });
    const result = realUseSellerOrders({ first: 10, status: 'ALL' });
    const loadMoreReturn = result.loadMore();
    expect(loadMoreReturn).toBeUndefined();
    expect(mockFetchMore).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

import React, { useState } from 'react';

  updateOrderStatusSchema,
  type UpdateOrderStatusInput,

import { formatSizeLabel, SizeKind } from '@kickzone-workspace/product-sizes';
const CANONICAL_PANTS_SIZE_RE = /^[1-9]\d?x[1-9]\d?$/;
const displayItemSize = (size?: string | null): string => {
  if (!size) return '';
  const t = size.trim();
  return CANONICAL_PANTS_SIZE_RE.test(t) ? formatSizeLabel(SizeKind.Pants, t) || size : size;
};
export function SellerOrdersScreen() {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  usePageTitle(() => LL.pageTitles.sellerOrders());
  const { currentLocale, formatNumber, isRTL } = useLanguageContext();
  const [expandedOrder, setExpandedOrder] = useState<string | false>(false);
  const [selectedStatus, setSelectedStatus] = useState<
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus | undefined
  >(undefined);
  const [statusDialogOpen, setStatusDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedOrderId, setSelectedOrderId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [newStatus, setNewStatus] = useState<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus>(
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Pending
  );
  const [currentOrderStatus, setCurrentOrderStatus] = useState<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus>(
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Pending
  );
  // Format date according to locale
  const formatDate = (dateString: string) => {
    return new Date(dateString).toLocaleDateString(currentLocale, {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'long',
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    });
  };
  const {
    orders,
    loading: ordersLoading,
    error: ordersError,
    updateOrderStatus,
    updateStatusLoading,
  } = useSellerOrders({
    first: 50,
    status: selectedStatus,
  });
  const statusForm = useForm<UpdateOrderStatusInput>({
    values: { id: selectedOrderId ?? '', status: newStatus },
    resolver: zodResolver(updateOrderStatusSchema),
    mode: 'onSubmit',
  });
  const handleExpandOrder = (orderId: string) => {
    setExpandedOrder(expandedOrder === orderId ? false : orderId);
  };

      (status as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus) || undefined
    );
  };
  const handleStatusChange = (orderId: string, currentStatus: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus) => {
    setSelectedOrderId(orderId);
    setCurrentOrderStatus(currentStatus);
    const allowed = getSellerAllowedNextStatuses(currentStatus);
    setNewStatus(allowed[1] ?? allowed[0] ?? currentStatus);
    setStatusDialogOpen(true);
  };
  const handleUpdateStatus = async () => {
    if (!selectedOrderId || !newStatus) return;
    if (!(await statusForm.trigger())) return;
    try {
      await updateOrderStatus(selectedOrderId, newStatus);
      setStatusDialogOpen(false);
      setSelectedOrderId(null);
      setNewStatus(KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Pending);

      console.error('Error updating order status:', error);
    }

                                            {(item.color || item.size) && (

                                                variant="caption"
                                                color="text.secondary"
                                              >

                                                  .filter(Boolean)
                                                  .join(' - ')}
                                              </Typography>
                                            )}
                                          </Box>
                                        </Box>
                                      </TableCell>
                                      <TableCell>
                                        {formatNumber(item.quantity)}
                                      </TableCell>
                                      <TableCell>
                                        $
                                        {formatNumber(

                                        )}
                                      </TableCell>
                                      <TableCell>
                                        $
                                        {formatNumber(
                                          item.totalPrice.toFixed(2)
                                        )}
                                      </TableCell>
                                    </>
                                  )}
                                </TableRow>
                              )
                            )}

                        </Table>
                      </TableContainer>
                    </Box>
                  </AccordionDetails>
                </Accordion>
              </Card>
            ))}
          </Box>
        )}
        {/* Status Change Dialog */}
        <Dialog
          open={statusDialogOpen}
          onClose={() => setStatusDialogOpen(false)}
          maxWidth="sm"
          fullWidth
        >
          <DialogTitle>{LL.orders.changeOrderStatus()}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogFormContent>
            <FormControl fullWidth>
              <InputLabel>{LL.form.newStatus()}</InputLabel>
              <Select
                value={newStatus}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setNewStatus(
                    e.target.value as KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus
                  )
                }
                label={LL.form.newStatus()}
              >
                {getSellerAllowedNextStatuses(currentOrderStatus).map((status) => (
                  <MenuItem key={status} value={status}>
                    {status === KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Pending && LL.orders.pending()}
                    {status === KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Confirmed && LL.orders.confirmed()}
                    {status === KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Processing && LL.orders.processing()}
                    {status === KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Shipped && LL.orders.shipped()}
                    {status === KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Delivered && LL.orders.delivered()}
                    {status === KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Cancelled && LL.orders.cancelled()}
                    {status === KickzoneGraphqlTypes.OrderStatus.Refunded && LL.orders.refunded()}
                  </MenuItem>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </FormControl>
          </DialogFormContent>
          <DialogActions>
            <Button
              onClick={() => setStatusDialogOpen(false)}
              disabled={updateStatusLoading}
            >
              {LL.button.cancel()}
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="contained"
              onClick={handleUpdateStatus}
              loading={updateStatusLoading}
              disabled={newStatus === currentOrderStatus || updateStatusLoading}
            >
              {LL.button.updateStatus()}
            </Button>
          </DialogActions>
        </Dialog>
      </GlassmorphismContainer>
    </SellersLayout>
  );
}
export default SellerOrdersScreen;

<file path="libs/client/shared/hooks/products/src/lib/useProducts.ts">
import { useMutation, useQuery, useApolloClient } from '@apollo/client/react';
import { KickzoneGraphqlTypes } from '@kickzone-workspace/codegen';
import { useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  CREATE_PRODUCT,
  CREATE_PRODUCT_INFO,
  UPLOAD_PRODUCT_INFO_IMAGES,
  REMOVE_PRODUCT_INFO_IMAGE,
  PRODUCTS_QUERY,
  PRODUCT_BY_ID_QUERY,
  ARCHIVE_PRODUCT_MUTATION,
  DELETE_PRODUCT_MUTATION,
  UPDATE_PRODUCT,
} from './products.graphql';
export function useProductsQuery({
  search,
  categoryId,
  category,
  categorySlugs,
  brand,
  brands,
  size,
  sizes,
  sort = '',
  sortOrder = 'asc',
  pageSize = 12,
  archivedStatus = KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductArchivedStatus.Active,
  sellerId,
  onlyWithSellers,
  onlyInStock,
  onlyDiscounted,
}: {
  search: string;
  categoryId?: number;
  category?: string;
  categorySlugs?: string[];
  brand?: string;
  brands?: string[];
  size?: string;
  sizes?: string[];
  sort?: string;
  sortOrder?: 'asc' | 'desc';
  pageSize?: number;
  archivedStatus?: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductArchivedStatus;
  sellerId?: number;
  onlyWithSellers?: boolean;
  onlyInStock?: boolean;
  onlyDiscounted?: boolean;
}) {
  const buildFilter = useCallback(
    (after?: string) => ({
      searchTerm: search || undefined,
      categoryId: categoryId || undefined,
      category: category || undefined,
      categorySlugs:
        categorySlugs && categorySlugs.length > 0 ? categorySlugs : undefined,
      brand: brand || undefined,
      brands: brands && brands.length > 0 ? brands : undefined,
      productInfoFilter:
        size || (sizes && sizes.length > 0)
          ? { size: size ? [size] : sizes }
          : undefined,
      first: pageSize,
      after,
      sort,
      sortOrder,
      archivedStatus,
      sellerId,
      onlyWithSellers,
      onlyInStock,
      onlyDiscounted,
    }),
    [
      search,
      categoryId,
      category,
      categorySlugs,
      brand,
      size,
      sizes,
      pageSize,
      sort,
      sortOrder,
      archivedStatus,
      sellerId,
      onlyWithSellers,
      onlyInStock,
      onlyDiscounted,
      brands,
    ]
  );
  const { data, loading, error, fetchMore, refetch, networkStatus } = useQuery<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'products'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.QueryProductsArgs
  >(PRODUCTS_QUERY, {
    variables: {
      filter: buildFilter(),
    },
    notifyOnNetworkStatusChange: true,
  });
  const products =
    data?.products?.edges?.map(
      (e: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.ProductEdge) => e.node
    ) || [];
  const pageInfo = data?.products?.pageInfo;
  const totalCount = data?.products?.totalCount || 0;
  const loadMore = useCallback(() => {
    if (pageInfo?.hasNextPage) {
      return fetchMore({
        variables: {
          filter: buildFilter(pageInfo.endCursor ?? undefined),
        },
        updateQuery: (prev, { fetchMoreResult }) => {
          if (!fetchMoreResult?.products) return prev;
          const existingEdges = prev.products?.edges || [];
          const newEdges = fetchMoreResult.products?.edges || [];
          const existingIds = new Set(
            existingEdges.map((e) => e?.node?.id)
          );
          const uniqueNewEdges = newEdges.filter(
            (e) => e?.node?.id != null && !existingIds.has(e.node.id)
          );
          return {
            ...prev,
            products: {
              ...fetchMoreResult.products,
              edges: [...existingEdges, ...uniqueNewEdges],
            },
          };
        },
      });
    }
  }, [fetchMore, pageInfo, buildFilter]);
  return {
    products,
    loading,
    error,
    loadMore,
    hasNextPage: Boolean(pageInfo?.hasNextPage),
    totalCount,
    refetch,
    isFetchingMore: networkStatus === 3,
  };
}
export const useProducts = () => {
  const client = useApolloClient();
  const [createProductMutation, { loading: isCreatingProduct }] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'createProduct'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationCreateProductArgs
  >(CREATE_PRODUCT);
  const [createProductInfoMutation, { loading: isCreatingProductInfo }] =
    useMutation<
      Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'createProductInfo'>,
      KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationCreateProductInfoArgs
    >(CREATE_PRODUCT_INFO);
  const [uploadProductInfoImagesMutation] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'uploadProductInfoImages'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationUploadProductInfoImagesArgs
  >(UPLOAD_PRODUCT_INFO_IMAGES);
  const [removeProductInfoImageMutation] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'removeProductInfoImage'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationRemoveProductInfoImageArgs
  >(REMOVE_PRODUCT_INFO_IMAGE);
  const [archiveProductMutation, { loading: isArchivingProduct }] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'archiveProduct'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationArchiveProductArgs
  >(ARCHIVE_PRODUCT_MUTATION);
  const [deleteProductMutation, { loading: isDeletingProduct }] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'deleteProduct'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationDeleteProductArgs
  >(DELETE_PRODUCT_MUTATION);
  const [updateProductMutation] = useMutation<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Mutation, 'updateProduct'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.MutationUpdateProductArgs
  >(UPDATE_PRODUCT);
  const createProductWithInfos = useCallback(
    async (
      productInput: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.CreateProductInput,
      productInfos: Omit<
        KickzoneGraphqlTypes.CreateProductInfoInput,
        'productId'
      >[]
    ) => {
      const { data: productData } = await createProductMutation({
        variables: {
          input: productInput,
        },
      });
      if (!productData?.createProduct?.id) {
        throw new Error('Failed to create product');
      }
      const createdProductInfos = [];
      for (const info of productInfos) {
        const { data: productInfoData } = await createProductInfoMutation({
          variables: {
            input: {
              ...info,
              productId: productData.createProduct.id,
            },
          },
        });
        if (productInfoData?.createProductInfo?.productInfos) {
          // The createProductInfo mutation returns the full product with all productInfos
          // We need to find the newly created productInfo from the array
          // Since we're creating them sequentially, the last one in the array should be the new one
          const newProductInfo =
            productInfoData.createProductInfo.productInfos[
              productInfoData.createProductInfo.productInfos.length - 1
            ];
          if (newProductInfo) {
            createdProductInfos.push(newProductInfo);
          }
        }
      }
      // Evict and refetch all products queries to ensure the new product appears in the list
      // This handles all possible filter combinations
      client.cache.evict({ fieldName: 'products' });
      client.cache.gc();
      return {
        product: productData.createProduct,
        productInfos: createdProductInfos,
      };
    },
    [createProductMutation, createProductInfoMutation, client]
  );
  const uploadProductInfoImages = useCallback(
    async (productInfoId: number, files: File[]) => {
      const { data } = await uploadProductInfoImagesMutation({
        variables: {
          productInfoId,
          files,
        },
      });
      const result = data?.uploadProductInfoImages || [];
      return result;
    },
    [uploadProductInfoImagesMutation]
  );
  const removeProductInfoImage = useCallback(
    async (productInfoId: number, imageName: string) => {
      const { data } = await removeProductInfoImageMutation({
        variables: {
          productInfoId,
          imageName,
        },
      });
      const result = data?.removeProductInfoImage;
      return result;
    },
    [removeProductInfoImageMutation]
  );
  const archiveProduct = useCallback(
    async (id: number) => {
      const { data } = await archiveProductMutation({ variables: { id } });
      return data?.archiveProduct;
    },
    [archiveProductMutation]
  );
  const deleteProduct = useCallback(
    async (id: number) => {
      const { data } = await deleteProductMutation({ variables: { id } });
      client.cache.evict({ fieldName: 'products' });
      client.cache.gc();
      return data?.deleteProduct ?? false;
    },
    [deleteProductMutation, client]
  );
  const updateProduct = useCallback(
    async (input: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.UpdateProductInput) => {
      const { data } = await updateProductMutation({
        variables: { input },
      });
      if (input.id) {
        client.cache.evict({
          id: client.cache.identify({ __typename: 'Product', id: input.id }),
        });
      }
      client.cache.evict({ fieldName: 'products' });
      client.cache.evict({ fieldName: 'product' });
      client.cache.gc();
      return data?.updateProduct;
    },
    [updateProductMutation, client]
  );
  return {
    createProductWithInfos,
    uploadProductInfoImages,
    removeProductInfoImage,
    isCreatingProduct: isCreatingProduct || isCreatingProductInfo,
    archiveProduct,
    isArchivingProduct,
    deleteProduct,
    isDeletingProduct,
    updateProduct,
  };
};
export function useProductById(id: number | undefined) {
  const isValidId = typeof id === 'number' && !isNaN(id) && id > 0;
  const { data, loading, error, refetch } = useQuery<
    Pick<KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Query, 'product'>,
    KickzoneGraphqlTypes.QueryProductArgs
  >(PRODUCT_BY_ID_QUERY, {
    variables: { id: isValidId ? id : 0 },
    skip: !isValidId,
  });
  return { product: data?.product, loading, error, refetch };
}

import { ObjectType, Field, ID, Float, Int } from '@nestjs/graphql';
import { Order, OrderItem, OrderStatus } from './order.entity';
import { ShippingPaymentMode } from './seller-info.entity';
const GUEST_TOKEN_TAG_RE = /\s*\[GuestToken:\s*[^\]]+\]/g;
export function stripGuestTokenFromNotes(notes?: string | null): string | undefined {
  if (notes === undefined || notes === null) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const cleaned = notes.replace(GUEST_TOKEN_TAG_RE, '').trim();
  return cleaned;
}
@ObjectType()
export class SellerOrder {
  @Field(() => ID)
  id: string;
  @Field(() => String)
  orderNumber: string;
  @Field(() => OrderStatus)
  status: OrderStatus;
  @Field(() => Float)
  subtotal: number;
  @Field(() => Float)
  shippingCost: number;
  @Field(() => String, { defaultValue: 'vip' })
  shippingMethod?: string;
  @Field(() => ShippingPaymentMode, {
    defaultValue: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ON_DELIVERY,
  })
  shippingPaymentMode?: ShippingPaymentMode;
  @Field(() => Float)
  total: number;
  @Field(() => String, { nullable: true })
  notes?: string;
  @Field(() => String, { nullable: true })
  trackingNumber?: string;
  @Field(() => Date)
  createdAt: Date;
  @Field(() => Date)
  updatedAt: Date;
  @Field(() => Int)
  sellerId: number;
  // Seller snapshot fields
  @Field(() => String, { nullable: true })
  sellerStoreName?: string;
  @Field(() => String, { nullable: true })
  sellerPhone?: string;
  @Field(() => String, { nullable: true })
  sellerAddress?: string;
  @Field(() => [OrderItem])
  items: OrderItem[];
}
// Helper function to convert Order to SellerOrder (removes customer PII)
export function toSellerOrder(order: Order): SellerOrder {
  return {
    id: order.id,
    orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
    status: order.status,
    subtotal: order.subtotal,
    shippingCost: order.shippingCost,
    shippingMethod: order.shippingMethod || 'vip',
    shippingPaymentMode:
      order.shippingPaymentMode || ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ON_DELIVERY,
    total: order.total,
    notes: stripGuestTokenFromNotes(order.notes),
    trackingNumber: order.trackingNumber,
    createdAt: order.createdAt,
    updatedAt: order.updatedAt,
    sellerId: order.sellerId,
    sellerStoreName: order.sellerStoreName,
    sellerPhone: order.sellerPhone,
    sellerAddress: order.sellerAddress,
    items: order.items || [],
  };
}

<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/auth-validation.spec.ts">
import { BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ROUTE_ARGS_METADATA } from '@nestjs/common/constants';
import { AuthResolver } from './auth.resolver';
import { UserResolver } from './user.resolver';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from './zod-validation.pipe';
import { UserRole } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { userRoleSchema } from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import type { ZodType } from 'zod';
type ParamMetadata = { index: number; pipes?: unknown[] };
describe('Auth/User resolver argument validation pipes', () => {
  function getParamMetadata(target: object, methodName: string) {
    const args = Reflect.getMetadata(ROUTE_ARGS_METADATA, target.constructor, methodName) ?? {};
    return Object.values(args) as ParamMetadata[];
  }
  function findPipeForArg(paramMetadata: ParamMetadata[], argIndex: number): ZodValidationPipe<ZodType> | undefined {
    const param = paramMetadata.find((p) => p.index === argIndex);
    return param?.pipes?.find((pipe): pipe is ZodValidationPipe<ZodType> => pipe instanceof ZodValidationPipe);
  }
  describe('AuthResolver', () => {
    describe('login', () => {
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for email (arg 0)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'login');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 0);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for password (arg 1)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'login');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('email pipe validates correctly', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'login');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 0) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType<{ email: string }>>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('  TEST@EXAMPLE.COM  ')).not.toThrow();
        const result = pipe.transform('  TEST@EXAMPLE.COM  ');
        expect(result).toBe('TEST@EXAMPLE.COM');
      });
      it('email pipe rejects invalid email', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'login');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 0) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('not-an-email')).toThrow(BadRequestException);
      });
      it('password pipe accepts short legacy password', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'login');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('abc')).not.toThrow();
      });
      it('password pipe rejects empty', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'login');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('')).toThrow(BadRequestException);
      });
    });
    describe('register', () => {
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for name (arg 0)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'register');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 0);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for email (arg 1)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'register');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for password (arg 2)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'register');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 2);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('password pipe rejects 7 chars (register uses newPasswordSchema)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'register');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 2) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('short7')).toThrow(BadRequestException);
      });
      it('password pipe accepts 8 chars', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'register');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 2) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('validPass')).not.toThrow();
      });
    });
    describe('forgotPassword', () => {
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for email (arg 0)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'forgotPassword');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 0);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for baseUrl (arg 1)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'forgotPassword');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('baseUrl pipe accepts https URL', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'forgotPassword');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('https://kickzone.ir/x')).not.toThrow();
      });
      it('baseUrl pipe rejects javascript: protocol', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'forgotPassword');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('javascript:alert(1)')).toThrow(BadRequestException);
      });
    });
    describe('initiatePasswordSetup', () => {
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for email (arg 0)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'initiatePasswordSetup');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 0);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for baseUrl (arg 1)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'initiatePasswordSetup');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
    });
    describe('resetPassword', () => {
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for token (arg 0)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'resetPassword');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 0);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for newPassword (arg 1)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'resetPassword');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('token pipe rejects whitespace only', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'resetPassword');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 0) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('  ')).toThrow(BadRequestException);
      });
      it('newPassword pipe rejects 7 chars', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'resetPassword');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('short7')).toThrow(BadRequestException);
      });
    });
    describe('setupPassword', () => {
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for token (arg 0)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'setupPassword');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 0);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for newPassword (arg 1)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'setupPassword');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
    });
  });
  describe('UserResolver', () => {
    describe('createUser', () => {
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for createUserInput (arg 0)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(UserResolver.prototype, 'createUser');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 0);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('pipe validates createUserInput correctly', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(UserResolver.prototype, 'createUser');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 0) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType<{ email: string }>>;
        const validInput = {
          name: 'John',
          lastName: 'Doe',
          username: 'john_doe',
          email: 'john@example.com',
          password: 'securePassword123',
          role: 'CUSTOMER',
        };
        expect(() => pipe.transform(validInput)).not.toThrow();
        const result = pipe.transform(validInput);
        expect(result.email).toBe('john@example.com');
      });
      it('pipe rejects invalid role', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(UserResolver.prototype, 'createUser');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 0) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType>;
        const invalidInput = {
          name: 'John',
          lastName: 'Doe',
          username: 'john_doe',
          email: 'john@example.com',
          password: 'securePassword123',
          role: 'ROOT',
        };
        expect(() => pipe.transform(invalidInput)).toThrow(BadRequestException);
      });
    });
    describe('adminCreateUser', () => {
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for createUserInput (arg 0)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(UserResolver.prototype, 'adminCreateUser');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 0);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
    });
  });
  describe('userRoleSchema sync with UserRole enum', () => {
    it('userRoleSchema.options equals Object.values(UserRole) sorted', () => {
      const schemaOptions = [...userRoleSchema.options].sort();
      const enumValues = Object.values(UserRole).sort();
      expect(schemaOptions).toEqual(enumValues);
    });
  });
});
