<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/auth.resolver.spec.ts">
import { UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Response, Request } from 'express';
import { AuthResolver } from './auth.resolver';
import {
  ACCESS_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS,
  REFRESH_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/services';
import { User, UserRole } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { GraphqlAuthGuard, RolesGuard } from '@kickzone-workspace/guards';
describe('AuthResolver', () => {
  let resolver: AuthResolver;
  let authService: {
    validateUser: jest.Mock;
    login: jest.Mock;
    refresh: jest.Mock;
    revokeRefreshTokenByRaw: jest.Mock;
    verifyToken: jest.Mock;
    register: jest.Mock;
  };
  let res: {
    cookie: jest.Mock;
    clearCookie: jest.Mock;
  };
  const mockUser = {
    id: 'user-1',
    email: 'user@test.com',
    role: UserRole.CUSTOMER,
    name: 'Test',
  } as User;
  beforeEach(() => {
    authService = {
      validateUser: jest.fn(),
      login: jest.fn(),
      refresh: jest.fn(),
      revokeRefreshTokenByRaw: jest.fn(),
      verifyToken: jest.fn(),
      register: jest.fn(),
    };
    res = {
      cookie: jest.fn(),
      clearCookie: jest.fn(),
    };
    resolver = new AuthResolver(authService as never);
  });
  const expectAuthCookies = (access: string, refresh: string) => {
    expect(res.cookie).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'access_token',
      access,
      expect.objectContaining({
        httpOnly: true,
        secure: true,
        sameSite: 'none',
        path: '/',
        maxAge: ACCESS_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS,
      })
    );
    expect(res.cookie).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'refresh_token',
      refresh,
      expect.objectContaining({
        httpOnly: true,
        secure: true,
        sameSite: 'none',
        path: '/',
        maxAge: REFRESH_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS,
      })
    );
  };
  describe('login', () => {
    it('sets access and refresh cookies on successful login', async () => {
      authService.validateUser.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);
      authService.login.mockResolvedValue({
        access_token: 'access-1',
        refresh_token: 'refresh-1',
      });
      const result = await resolver.login('user@test.com', 'secret', {
        res: res as unknown as Response,
      });
      expect(result).toBe(mockUser);
      expectAuthCookies('access-1', 'refresh-1');
    });
    it('throws when credentials are invalid', async () => {
      authService.validateUser.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(
        resolver.login('bad@test.com', 'wrong', {
          res: res as unknown as Response,
        })
      ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(UnauthorizedException);
      expect(res.cookie).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
  describe('register', () => {
    it('auto-logs in and sets both cookies', async () => {
      authService.register.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);
      authService.login.mockResolvedValue({
        access_token: 'access-2',
        refresh_token: 'refresh-2',
      });
      const result = await resolver.register(
        'Test',
        'user@test.com',
        'secret',
        { res: res as unknown as Response }
      );
      expect(result).toBe(mockUser);
      expectAuthCookies('access-2', 'refresh-2');
    });
  });
  describe('refresh', () => {
    it('rotates tokens and sets new cookies', async () => {
      authService.refresh.mockResolvedValue({
        access_token: 'access-new',
        refresh_token: 'refresh-new',
      });
      const result = await resolver.refresh({
        req: {
          cookies: { refresh_token: 'refresh-old' },
        } as unknown as Request,
        res: res as unknown as Response,
      });
      expect(result).toBe(true);
      expect(authService.refresh).toHaveBeenCalledWith('refresh-old');
      expectAuthCookies('access-new', 'refresh-new');
    });
    it('clears cookies and throws when refresh cookie is missing', async () => {
      await expect(
        resolver.refresh({
          req: { cookies: {} } as unknown as Request,
          res: res as unknown as Response,
        })
      ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(UnauthorizedException);
      expect(res.clearCookie).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'access_token',
        expect.objectContaining({ httpOnly: true, path: '/' })
      );
      expect(res.clearCookie).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'refresh_token',
        expect.objectContaining({ httpOnly: true, path: '/' })
      );
    });
    it('clears cookies when refresh fails', async () => {
      authService.refresh.mockRejectedValue(
        new UnauthorizedException('Invalid or expired refresh token')
      );
      await expect(
        resolver.refresh({
          req: {
            cookies: { refresh_token: 'bad' },
          } as unknown as Request,
          res: res as unknown as Response,
        })
      ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(UnauthorizedException);
      expect(res.clearCookie).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
  describe('logout', () => {
    it('revokes refresh token and clears both cookies', async () => {
      const result = await resolver.logout({
        req: {
          cookies: { refresh_token: 'refresh-1' },
        } as unknown as Request,
        res: res as unknown as Response,
      });
      expect(result).toBe(true);
      expect(authService.revokeRefreshTokenByRaw).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'refresh-1'
      );
      expect(res.clearCookie).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'access_token',
        expect.any(Object)
      );
      expect(res.clearCookie).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'refresh_token',
        expect.any(Object)
      );
    });
  });
  describe('me', () => {
    it('returns user when access token is valid', async () => {
      authService.verifyToken.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);
      const result = await resolver.me({
        req: {
          cookies: { access_token: 'access-ok' },
        } as unknown as Request,
        res: res as unknown as Response,
      });
      expect(result).toBe(mockUser);
      expect(authService.refresh).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('silently refreshes when access token is expired but refresh is valid', async () => {
      authService.verifyToken
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(null)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(mockUser);
      authService.refresh.mockResolvedValue({
        access_token: 'access-new',
        refresh_token: 'refresh-new',
      });
      const result = await resolver.me({
        req: {
          cookies: {
            access_token: 'access-expired',
            refresh_token: 'refresh-ok',
          },
        } as unknown as Request,
        res: res as unknown as Response,
      });
      expect(authService.refresh).toHaveBeenCalledWith('refresh-ok');
      expectAuthCookies('access-new', 'refresh-new');
      expect(result).toBe(mockUser);
    });
    it('returns null when both tokens are missing', async () => {
      const result = await resolver.me({
        req: { cookies: {} } as unknown as Request,
        res: res as unknown as Response,
      });
      expect(result).toBeNull();
    });
    it('clears cookies and returns null when refresh fails', async () => {
      authService.verifyToken.mockResolvedValue(null);
      authService.refresh.mockRejectedValue(new UnauthorizedException());
      const result = await resolver.me({
        req: {
          cookies: { refresh_token: 'bad' },
        } as unknown as Request,
        res: res as unknown as Response,
      });
      expect(result).toBeNull();
      expect(res.clearCookie).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
  describe('initiatePasswordSetup guards', () => {
    it('has GraphqlAuthGuard and RolesGuard in correct order with ADMIN role', () => {
      const guards = Reflect.getMetadata('__guards__', AuthResolver.prototype.initiatePasswordSetup);
      expect(guards).toEqual([GraphqlAuthGuard, RolesGuard]);
      const roles = Reflect.getMetadata('roles', AuthResolver.prototype.initiatePasswordSetup);
      expect(roles).toEqual([UserRole.ADMIN]);
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/auth.resolver.ts">
import { Resolver, Mutation, Args, Context, Query } from '@nestjs/graphql';
import {
  ACCESS_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS,
  AuthService,
  REFRESH_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/services';
import { User, UserRole } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { Response, Request } from 'express';
import { UnauthorizedException, UseGuards, SetMetadata } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from './zod-validation.pipe';
import {
  emailSchema,
  loginPasswordSchema,
  newPasswordSchema,
  personNameSchema,
  baseUrlSchema,
  tokenSchema,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import { GraphqlAuthGuard, RolesGuard } from '@kickzone-workspace/guards';
const COOKIE_BASE = {
  httpOnly: true,
  secure: true,
  sameSite: 'none' as const,
  path: '/',
};
function setAuthCookies(
  res: Response,
  accessToken: string,
  refreshToken: string
): void {
  res.cookie('access_token', accessToken, {
    ...COOKIE_BASE,
    maxAge: ACCESS_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS,
  });
  res.cookie('refresh_token', refreshToken, {
    ...COOKIE_BASE,
    maxAge: REFRESH_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS,
  });
}
function clearAuthCookies(res: Response): void {
  res.clearCookie('access_token', COOKIE_BASE);
  res.clearCookie('refresh_token', COOKIE_BASE);
}
@Resolver()
export class AuthResolver {
  constructor(private authService: AuthService) {}
  @Mutation(() => User)
  async login(
    @Args('email', new ZodValidationPipe(emailSchema)) email: string,
    @Args('password', new ZodValidationPipe(loginPasswordSchema)) password: string,
    @Context() context: { res: Response }
  ): Promise<User> {
    const user = await this.authService.validateUser(email, password);
    if (!user) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException();
    }
    const { access_token, refresh_token } = await this.authService.login(user);
    setAuthCookies(context.res, access_token, refresh_token);
    return user;
  }
  @Query(() => User, { nullable: true })
  async me(
    @Context() context: { req: Request; res: Response }
  ): Promise<User | null> {
    const accessToken = context.req.cookies?.['access_token'];
    if (accessToken) {
      const user = await this.authService.verifyToken(accessToken);
      if (user) {
        return user;
      }
    }
    // Access JWT missing/expired — try refresh cookie so page reloads keep the session
    const rawRefreshToken = context.req.cookies?.['refresh_token'];
    if (!rawRefreshToken) {
      return null;
    }
    try {
      const { access_token, refresh_token } =
        await this.authService.refresh(rawRefreshToken);
      setAuthCookies(context.res, access_token, refresh_token);
      return this.authService.verifyToken(access_token);
    } catch {
      clearAuthCookies(context.res);
      return null;
    }
  }
  @Mutation(() => Boolean)
  async refresh(
    @Context() context: { req: Request; res: Response }
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const rawRefreshToken = context.req.cookies?.['refresh_token'];
    if (!rawRefreshToken) {
      clearAuthCookies(context.res);
      throw new UnauthorizedException('No refresh token');
    }
    try {
      const { access_token, refresh_token } =
        await this.authService.refresh(rawRefreshToken);
      setAuthCookies(context.res, access_token, refresh_token);
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      clearAuthCookies(context.res);
      throw error;
    }
  }
  @Mutation(() => Boolean)
  async logout(
    @Context() context: { req: Request; res: Response }
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const rawRefreshToken = context.req.cookies?.['refresh_token'];
    await this.authService.revokeRefreshTokenByRaw(rawRefreshToken);
    clearAuthCookies(context.res);
    return true;
  }
  @Mutation(() => Boolean)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
  @SetMetadata('roles', [UserRole.ADMIN])
  async initiatePasswordSetup(
    @Args('email', new ZodValidationPipe(emailSchema)) email: string,
    @Args('baseUrl', new ZodValidationPipe(baseUrlSchema)) baseUrl: string
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    await this.authService.initiatePasswordSetup(email, baseUrl);
    return true;
  }
  @Mutation(() => User)
  async setupPassword(
    @Args('token', new ZodValidationPipe(tokenSchema)) token: string,
    @Args('newPassword', new ZodValidationPipe(newPasswordSchema)) newPassword: string
  ): Promise<User> {
    return this.authService.setupPassword(token, newPassword);
  }
  @Mutation(() => User)
  async register(
    @Args('name', new ZodValidationPipe(personNameSchema)) name: string,
    @Args('email', new ZodValidationPipe(emailSchema)) email: string,
    @Args('password', new ZodValidationPipe(newPasswordSchema)) password: string,
    @Context() context: { res: Response }
  ): Promise<User> {
    const user = await this.authService.register(name, email, password);
    // Auto-login after registration
    const { access_token, refresh_token } = await this.authService.login(user);
    setAuthCookies(context.res, access_token, refresh_token);
    return user;
  }
  @Mutation(() => Boolean)
  async forgotPassword(
    @Args('email', new ZodValidationPipe(emailSchema)) email: string,
    @Args('baseUrl', new ZodValidationPipe(baseUrlSchema)) baseUrl: string
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    await this.authService.initiateForgotPassword(email, baseUrl);
    return true;
  }
  @Mutation(() => User)
  async resetPassword(
    @Args('token', new ZodValidationPipe(tokenSchema)) token: string,
    @Args('newPassword', new ZodValidationPipe(newPasswordSchema)) newPassword: string
  ): Promise<User> {
    return this.authService.resetPassword(token, newPassword);
  }
}

import { BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ROUTE_ARGS_METADATA } from '@nestjs/common/constants';
import { CartResolver } from './cart.resolver';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from './zod-validation.pipe';
import { idSchema, addToCartSchema } from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import type { ZodType } from 'zod';
type ParamMetadata = { index: number; pipes?: unknown[] };
describe('Cart resolver argument validation pipes', () => {
  function getParamMetadata(target: object, methodName: string) {
    const args = Reflect.getMetadata(ROUTE_ARGS_METADATA, target.constructor, methodName) ?? {};
    return Object.values(args) as ParamMetadata[];
  }
  function findPipeForArg(paramMetadata: ParamMetadata[], argIndex: number): ZodValidationPipe<ZodType> | undefined {
    const param = paramMetadata.find((p) => p.index === argIndex);
    return param?.pipes?.find((pipe): pipe is ZodValidationPipe<ZodType> => pipe instanceof ZodValidationPipe);
  }
  describe('CartResolver', () => {
    describe('addToCart', () => {
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for addToCartInput (arg 1)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(CartResolver.prototype, 'addToCart');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('addToCart pipe rejects quantity 0 with BadRequestException', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(CartResolver.prototype, 'addToCart');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType<{ sellerProductId: string; quantity: number }>>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform({ sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 0 })).toThrow(BadRequestException);
      });
      it('addToCart pipe accepts valid input', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(CartResolver.prototype, 'addToCart');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType<{ sellerProductId: string; quantity: number }>>;
        const validInput = { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 1 };
        expect(() => pipe.transform(validInput)).not.toThrow();
        const result = pipe.transform(validInput);
        expect(result.sellerProductId).toBe('sp-1');
        expect(result.quantity).toBe(1);
      });
    });
    describe('updateCartItem', () => {
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for itemId (arg 1)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(CartResolver.prototype, 'updateCartItem');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for updateInput (arg 2)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(CartResolver.prototype, 'updateCartItem');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 2);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('updateInput pipe accepts all-null', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(CartResolver.prototype, 'updateCartItem');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 2) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType<{ sellerProductId: string; quantity: number }>>;
        const allNullInput = { quantity: null, color: null, size: null };
        expect(() => pipe.transform(allNullInput)).not.toThrow();
        const result = pipe.transform(allNullInput);
        expect(result).toEqual({ quantity: null, color: null, size: null });
      });
      it('itemId pipe rejects whitespace only', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(CartResolver.prototype, 'updateCartItem');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType<{ sellerProductId: string; quantity: number }>>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('  ')).toThrow(BadRequestException);
      });
      it('itemId pipe accepts valid id', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(CartResolver.prototype, 'updateCartItem');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType<{ sellerProductId: string; quantity: number }>>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('item-123')).not.toThrow();
        const result = pipe.transform('item-123');
        expect(result).toBe('item-123');
      });
    });
    describe('removeFromCart', () => {
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for itemId (arg 1)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(CartResolver.prototype, 'removeFromCart');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('itemId pipe rejects whitespace only', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(CartResolver.prototype, 'removeFromCart');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType<{ sellerProductId: string; quantity: number }>>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('  ')).toThrow(BadRequestException);
      });
      it('itemId pipe accepts valid id', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(CartResolver.prototype, 'removeFromCart');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType<{ sellerProductId: string; quantity: number }>>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('item-123')).not.toThrow();
        const result = pipe.transform('item-123');
        expect(result).toBe('item-123');
      });
    });
  });
  describe('schema imports sync with primitives', () => {
    it('addToCartSchema uses idSchema for sellerProductId', () => {
      const result = addToCartSchema.safeParse({ sellerProductId: '  sp-1  ', quantity: 1 });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data.sellerProductId).toBe('sp-1');
      }
    });
    it('updateCartItemSchema uses idSchema for itemId validation', () => {
      const result = idSchema.safeParse('  item-123  ');
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data).toBe('item-123');
      }
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/cart.resolver.ts">
import {
  Resolver,
  Query,
  Mutation,
  Args,
  ResolveField,
  Parent,
} from '@nestjs/graphql';
import { UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Cart, CartItem } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import {
  AddToCartInput,
  UpdateCartItemInput,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
import { CartService } from '@kickzone-workspace/services';
import { GraphqlAuthGuard } from '@kickzone-workspace/guards';
import { CurrentUser, type AuthenticatedUser } from '@kickzone-workspace/decorators';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from './zod-validation.pipe';
import {
  addToCartSchema,
  updateCartItemSchema,
  idSchema,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
@Resolver(() => Cart)
export class CartResolver {
  constructor(private readonly cartService: CartService) {}
  @Query(() => Cart)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard)
  async myCart(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    return this.cartService.getCart(user.id);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Cart)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard)
  async addToCart(
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
    @Args('addToCartInput', new ZodValidationPipe(addToCartSchema)) addToCartInput: AddToCartInput
  ) {
    return this.cartService.addToCart(user.id, addToCartInput);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Cart)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard)
  async updateCartItem(
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
    @Args('itemId', { type: () => String }, new ZodValidationPipe(idSchema)) itemId: string,
    @Args('updateInput', new ZodValidationPipe(updateCartItemSchema)) updateInput: UpdateCartItemInput
  ) {
    return this.cartService.updateCartItem(user.id, itemId, updateInput);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Cart)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard)
  async removeFromCart(
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
    @Args('itemId', { type: () => String }, new ZodValidationPipe(idSchema)) itemId: string
  ) {
    return this.cartService.removeFromCart(user.id, itemId);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Cart)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard)
  async clearCart(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    return this.cartService.clearCart(user.id);
  }
  @ResolveField(() => [CartItem])
  async items(@Parent() cart: Cart) {
    return cart.items;
  }
}

      email: 'admin@example.com',
      username: 'admin',
      role: UserRole.ADMIN,
      ...overrides,
    });

    id: 'order-1',
    orderNumber: 'ORD-123',
    status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
    subtotal: 100,
    shippingCost: 10,
    total: 110,
    notes: 'Test order',
    trackingNumber: 'TRACK-123',
    createdAt: new Date('2024-01-01'),
    updatedAt: new Date('2024-01-01'),

        quantity: 2,
        unitPrice: 50,
        totalPrice: 100,
        sellerProductId: 'seller-prod-1',
      } as OrderItem,
    ],
    ...overrides,
  });
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockOrderService = {
      findOne: jest.fn(),
      updateOrderStatus: jest.fn(),
    };
    mockSellerService = {
      findOneByUserId: jest.fn(),
    };
    resolver = new OrderResolver(
      mockOrderService as never,
      mockSellerService as never
    );
  });
  describe('updateOrderStatus - Seller allowed transitions', () => {
    const mockSellerInfo = createMockSellerInfo({ id: 1, user: { id: 'seller-user-1' } as never });
    beforeEach(() => {
      mockSellerService.findOneByUserId.mockResolvedValue(mockSellerInfo);
    });
    // Valid forward transitions: CONFIRMED->PROCESSING, PROCESSING->SHIPPED, SHIPPED->DELIVERED
    it.each([
      ['CONFIRMED -> PROCESSING', OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, OrderStatus.PROCESSING],
      ['PROCESSING -> SHIPPED', OrderStatus.PROCESSING, OrderStatus.SHIPPED],
      ['SHIPPED -> DELIVERED', OrderStatus.SHIPPED, OrderStatus.DELIVERED],
    ])('allows owning SELLER to move %s', async (_, fromStatus, toStatus) => {
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: fromStatus });
      const updatedOrder = createMockOrder({ status: toStatus });
      // SellerOrder should not have customerEmail
      const updatedSellerOrder = toSellerOrder(updatedOrder);
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      mockOrderService.updateOrderStatus.mockResolvedValue(updatedOrder);
      const user = createMockSellerUser({ id: 'seller-user-1' });
      const result = await resolver.updateOrderStatus(user, { id: 'order-1', status: toStatus });
      expect(mockSellerService.findOneByUserId).toHaveBeenCalledWith('seller-user-1');
      expect(mockOrderService.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateOrderStatus).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1', toStatus);
      // Result should be redacted SellerOrder (no customerEmail)
      expect(result).toEqual(updatedSellerOrder);
      expect((result as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)['customerEmail']).toBeUndefined();
    });
  });
  describe('updateOrderStatus - Seller rejected transitions', () => {
    const mockSellerInfo = createMockSellerInfo({ id: 1, user: { id: 'seller-user-1' } as never });
    beforeEach(() => {
      mockSellerService.findOneByUserId.mockResolvedValue(mockSellerInfo);
    });
    // Rejected transitions for owning SELLER
    it.each([
      ['PENDING -> CONFIRMED', OrderStatus.PENDING, OrderStatus.CONFIRMED],
      ['PENDING -> CANCELLED', OrderStatus.PENDING, OrderStatus.CANCELLED],
      ['CONFIRMED -> CANCELLED', OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, OrderStatus.CANCELLED],
      ['CONFIRMED -> REFUNDED', OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, OrderStatus.REFUNDED],
      ['SHIPPED -> REFUNDED', OrderStatus.SHIPPED, OrderStatus.REFUNDED],
      ['DELIVERED -> REFUNDED', OrderStatus.DELIVERED, OrderStatus.REFUNDED],
      ['CONFIRMED -> SHIPPED (skip)', OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, OrderStatus.SHIPPED],
      ['PROCESSING -> CONFIRMED (backwards)', OrderStatus.PROCESSING, OrderStatus.CONFIRMED],
      ['CONFIRMED -> CONFIRMED (no-op)', OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, OrderStatus.CONFIRMED],
      ['DELIVERED -> PROCESSING (backwards)', OrderStatus.DELIVERED, OrderStatus.PROCESSING],
    ])('rejects owning SELLER %s with BadRequestException and does not call service', async (_, fromStatus, toStatus) => {
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: fromStatus });
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      const user = createMockSellerUser({ id: 'seller-user-1' });
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderStatus(user, { id: 'order-1', status: toStatus })
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderStatus(user, { id: 'order-1', status: toStatus })
      ).rejects.toThrow(`Sellers can only move orders through fulfilment steps (CONFIRMED->PROCESSING->SHIPPED->DELIVERED); ${fromStatus} -> ${toStatus} is not allowed`);
      expect(mockSellerService.findOneByUserId).toHaveBeenCalledWith('seller-user-1');
      expect(mockOrderService.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateOrderStatus).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
  describe('updateOrderStatus - Non-owning seller rejected', () => {
    it('rejects non-owning SELLER on CONFIRMED->PROCESSING with ForbiddenException', async () => {
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, sellerId: 1 });
      const otherSellerInfo = createMockSellerInfo({ id: 999, user: { id: 'other-seller-user' } as never });
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      mockSellerService.findOneByUserId.mockResolvedValue(otherSellerInfo);
      const user = createMockSellerUser({ id: 'other-seller-user' });
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderStatus(user, { id: 'order-1', status: OrderStatus.PROCESSING })
      ).rejects.toThrow(ForbiddenException);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderStatus(user, { id: 'order-1', status: OrderStatus.PROCESSING })
      ).rejects.toThrow('You can only update status for your own seller orders');
      expect(mockSellerService.findOneByUserId).toHaveBeenCalledWith('other-seller-user');
      expect(mockOrderService.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateOrderStatus).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
  describe('updateOrderStatus - JWT shape { sub, userType: "seller" }', () => {
    const mockSellerInfo = createMockSellerInfo({ id: 1, user: { id: 's-user' } as never });
    beforeEach(() => {
      mockSellerService.findOneByUserId.mockResolvedValue(mockSellerInfo);
    });
    it('allows owning SELLER with { sub, userType: "seller" } CONFIRMED->PROCESSING', async () => {
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, sellerId: 1 });
      const updatedOrder = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.PROCESSING });
      const updatedSellerOrder = toSellerOrder(updatedOrder);
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      mockOrderService.updateOrderStatus.mockResolvedValue(updatedOrder);
      const user = { sub: 's-user', userType: 'seller' } as never;
      const result = await resolver.updateOrderStatus(user, { id: 'order-1', status: OrderStatus.PROCESSING });
      expect(mockSellerService.findOneByUserId).toHaveBeenCalledWith('s-user');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateOrderStatus).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1', OrderStatus.PROCESSING);
      expect(result).toEqual(updatedSellerOrder);
      expect((result as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)['customerEmail']).toBeUndefined();
    });
  });
  describe('updateOrderStatus - ADMIN unchanged', () => {
    const mockOrder = createMockOrder({ sellerId: 1 });
    const mockSellerInfo = createMockSellerInfo({ id: 1, user: { id: 'seller-user-1' } as never });
    beforeEach(() => {
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(mockOrder);
      mockSellerService.findOneByUserId.mockResolvedValue(mockSellerInfo);
    });
    it.each([
      ['PENDING -> CONFIRMED', OrderStatus.PENDING, OrderStatus.CONFIRMED],
      ['CONFIRMED -> REFUNDED', OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, OrderStatus.REFUNDED],
      ['PENDING -> CANCELLED', OrderStatus.PENDING, OrderStatus.CANCELLED],
      ['DELIVERED -> REFUNDED', OrderStatus.DELIVERED, OrderStatus.REFUNDED],
    ])('allows ADMIN %s (service called, full Order returned)', async (_, fromStatus, toStatus) => {
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: fromStatus });
      const updatedOrder = createMockOrder({ status: toStatus });
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      mockOrderService.updateOrderStatus.mockResolvedValue(updatedOrder);
      const user = createMockAdminUser();
      const result = await resolver.updateOrderStatus(user, { id: 'order-1', status: toStatus });
      expect(mockOrderService.updateOrderStatus).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1', toStatus);
      expect(result).toEqual(updatedOrder);
      expect((result as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)['customerEmail']).toBeDefined(); // Full Order returned for ADMIN
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/seller-info.resolver.spec.ts">
import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core';
import { ExecutionContext } from '@nestjs/common';
import { RolesGuard } from '@kickzone-workspace/guards';
import { SellerResolver } from './seller-info.resolver';
import { SellerService, ProductService } from '@kickzone-workspace/services';
import { ShippingPaymentMode, UserRole } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
jest.mock('@nestjs/graphql', () => {
  const actual = jest.requireActual('@nestjs/graphql');
  return {
    ...actual,
    GqlExecutionContext: {
      create: jest.fn((ctx: ExecutionContext) => ({
        getContext: () => ctx.switchToHttp().getRequest(),
      })),
    },
  };
});
describe('SellerResolver - Admin-Only shippingPaymentMode Guard & Mutation', () => {
  const reflector = new Reflector();
  const guard = new RolesGuard(reflector);
  function mockGqlContext(user?: { id: string; role: UserRole }) {
    return {
      getHandler: () => SellerResolver.prototype.updateSeller,
      switchToHttp: () => ({
        getRequest: () => ({ req: { user } }),
      }),
    } as unknown as ExecutionContext;
  }
  it('allows only ADMIN role to invoke updateSeller (which toggles shippingPaymentMode)', () => {
    expect(
      guard.canActivate(mockGqlContext({ id: '1', role: UserRole.ADMIN })),
    ).toBe(true);
    expect(
      guard.canActivate(mockGqlContext({ id: '2', role: UserRole.SELLER })),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      guard.canActivate(mockGqlContext({ id: '3', role: UserRole.CUSTOMER })),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(guard.canActivate(mockGqlContext(undefined))).toBe(false);
  });
  it('forwards shippingPaymentMode update to SellerService.update', async () => {
    const sellerService = {
      update: jest.fn(async (input) => ({
        id: input.id,
        storeName: 'Selected Seller',
        shippingFee: 12,
        shippingPaymentMode: input.shippingPaymentMode,
      })),
    };
    const resolver = new SellerResolver(
      sellerService as unknown as SellerService,
      {} as unknown as ProductService
    );
    const updated = await resolver.updateSeller({
      id: 7,
      shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ONLINE,
    });
    expect(sellerService.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      id: 7,
      shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ONLINE,
    });
    expect(updated?.shippingPaymentMode).toBe(ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ONLINE);
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/cart.service.null-relations.spec.ts">
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { getRepositoryToken } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, DeepPartial, SaveOptions } from 'typeorm';
import { CartService } from './cart.service';
import { Cart, CartItem, SellerProduct } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
type PrivateMethods = Record<string, (...args: unknown[]) => Promise<unknown>>;
describe('CartService - null relation guards', () => {
  let service: CartService;
  let cartRepository: jest.Mocked<Repository<Cart>>;
  let cartItemRepository: jest.Mocked<Repository<CartItem>>;
  let sellerProductRepository: jest.Mocked<Repository<SellerProduct>>;
  const mockSellerProduct = (overrides: Partial<SellerProduct> = {}): SellerProduct => ({
    id: 'sp-1',
    price: 99.95,
    discount: 10,
    stockQuantity: 100,
    product: { id: 1, name: 'Test Product' } as never,
    productInfo: {
      id: 'pi-1',
      images: ['image.jpg'],
      colorLinks: [],
      size: 'M',
    } as never,
    seller: { id: 's-1', storeName: 'Test Store' } as unknown as SellerProduct['seller'],
    productInfoId: 1,
    ...overrides,
  }) as never;
  const mockCart = (overrides: Partial<Cart> = {}): Cart => ({
    id: 'cart-1',
    userId: 'user-1',
    subtotal: 0,
    total: 0,
    items: [],
    createdAt: new Date(),
    updatedAt: new Date(),
    user: { id: 'user-1' } as never,
    ...overrides,
  }) as never;
  const mockCartItem = (overrides: Partial<CartItem> = {}): CartItem => ({
    id: 'ci-1',
    cartId: 'cart-1',
    productId: '1',
    productName: 'Test Product',
    productImage: 'image.jpg',
    quantity: 2,
    unitPrice: 89.96,
    totalPrice: 179.92,
    color: '#ff0000',
    size: 'M',
    sellerId: 's-1',
    sellerName: 'Test Store',
    productInfoId: 'pi-1',
    sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
    availableStock: 100,
    ...overrides,
  }) as never;
  beforeEach(async () => {
    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        CartService,
        {
          provide: getRepositoryToken(Cart),
          useValue: {
            findOne: jest.fn(),
            create: jest.fn(),
            save: jest.fn(),
          },
        },
        {
          provide: getRepositoryToken(CartItem),
          useValue: {
            findOne: jest.fn(),
            create: jest.fn(),
            save: jest.fn(),
            remove: jest.fn(),
          },
        },
        {
          provide: getRepositoryToken(SellerProduct),
          useValue: {
            findOne: jest.fn(),
          },
        },
      ],
    }).compile();
    service = module.get<CartService>(CartService);
    cartRepository = module.get(getRepositoryToken(Cart));
    cartItemRepository = module.get(getRepositoryToken(CartItem));
    sellerProductRepository = module.get(getRepositoryToken(SellerProduct));
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
  });
  describe('addToCart with missing product relation', () => {
    it('should reject with NotFoundException when sellerProduct.product is null', async () => {
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({ product: null as never });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      cartItemRepository.save.mockImplementation((item: DeepPartial<CartItem>, _options?: SaveOptions) => Promise.resolve(item as DeepPartial<CartItem> & CartItem));
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      await expect(
        service.addToCart('user-1', { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 1 })
      ).rejects.toThrow(NotFoundException);
      await expect(
        service.addToCart('user-1', { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 1 })
      ).rejects.toThrow('Product for SellerProduct sp-1 not found');
      // Verify it's not a TypeError
      try {
        await service.addToCart('user-1', { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 1 });
      } catch (e) {
        expect(e).not.toBeInstanceOf(TypeError);
        expect(e).toBeInstanceOf(NotFoundException);
      }
      // cartItemRepository.save should NOT be called
      expect(cartItemRepository.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
  describe('addToCart with missing seller relation', () => {
    it('should reject with NotFoundException when sellerProduct.seller is null', async () => {
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({ seller: null as never });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      cartItemRepository.save.mockImplementation((item: DeepPartial<CartItem>, _options?: SaveOptions) => Promise.resolve(item as DeepPartial<CartItem> & CartItem));
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      await expect(
        service.addToCart('user-1', { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 1 })
      ).rejects.toThrow(NotFoundException);
      await expect(
        service.addToCart('user-1', { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 1 })
      ).rejects.toThrow('Seller for SellerProduct sp-1 not found');
      // Verify it's not a TypeError
      try {
        await service.addToCart('user-1', { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 1 });
      } catch (e) {
        expect(e).not.toBeInstanceOf(TypeError);
        expect(e).toBeInstanceOf(NotFoundException);
      }
      // cartItemRepository.save should NOT be called
      expect(cartItemRepository.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
  describe('addToCart with valid product and seller', () => {
    it('should add item successfully when both product and seller are present', async () => {
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({ stockQuantity: 100 });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      cartItemRepository.save.mockImplementation((item: DeepPartial<CartItem>, _options?: SaveOptions) => Promise.resolve(item as DeepPartial<CartItem> & CartItem));
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      const result = await service.addToCart('user-1', {
        sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
        quantity: 1,
      });
      // cartItemRepository.save should be called
      expect(cartItemRepository.save).toHaveBeenCalled();
      const savedItem = cartItemRepository.save.mock.calls[0][0];
      expect(savedItem.quantity).toBe(1);
      expect(savedItem.unitPrice).toBe(89.96); // 99.95 - (99.95 * 10 / 100) = 89.955 -> 89.96
      expect(savedItem.totalPrice).toBe(89.96); // 1 * 89.96
      expect(savedItem.productId).toBe('1');
      expect(savedItem.productName).toBe('Test Product');
      expect(savedItem.sellerId).toBe('s-1');
      expect(savedItem.sellerName).toBe('Test Store');
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/cart.service.spec.ts">
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { getRepositoryToken } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, DeepPartial, SaveOptions } from 'typeorm';
import { CartService } from './cart.service';
import { Cart, CartItem, SellerProduct } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { NotFoundException, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
type PrivateMethods = Record<string, (...args: unknown[]) => Promise<unknown>>;
describe('CartService', () => {
  let service: CartService;
  let cartRepository: jest.Mocked<Repository<Cart>>;
  let cartItemRepository: jest.Mocked<Repository<CartItem>>;
  let sellerProductRepository: jest.Mocked<Repository<SellerProduct>>;
  const mockSellerProduct = (overrides: Partial<SellerProduct> = {}): SellerProduct => ({
    id: 'sp-1',
    price: 99.95,
    discount: 10,
    stockQuantity: 100,
    product: { id: 1, name: 'Test Product' } as never,
    productInfo: {
      id: 'pi-1',
      images: ['image.jpg'],
      colorLinks: [],
      size: 'M',
    } as never,
    seller: { id: 's-1', storeName: 'Test Store' } as unknown as SellerProduct['seller'],
    productInfoId: 1,
    ...overrides,
  }) as never;
  const mockCart = (overrides: Partial<Cart> = {}): Cart => ({
    id: 'cart-1',
    userId: 'user-1',
    subtotal: 0,
    total: 0,
    items: [],
    createdAt: new Date(),
    updatedAt: new Date(),
    user: { id: 'user-1' } as never,
    ...overrides,
  }) as never;
  const mockCartItem = (overrides: Partial<CartItem> = {}): CartItem => ({
    id: 'ci-1',
    cartId: 'cart-1',
    productId: '1',
    productName: 'Test Product',
    productImage: 'image.jpg',
    quantity: 2,
    unitPrice: 89.96,
    totalPrice: 179.92,
    color: '#ff0000',
    size: 'M',
    sellerId: 's-1',
    sellerName: 'Test Store',
    productInfoId: 'pi-1',
    sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
    availableStock: 100,
    ...overrides,
  }) as never;
  beforeEach(async () => {
    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        CartService,
        {
          provide: getRepositoryToken(Cart),
          useValue: {
            findOne: jest.fn(),
            create: jest.fn(),
            save: jest.fn(),
          },
        },
        {
          provide: getRepositoryToken(CartItem),
          useValue: {
            findOne: jest.fn(),
            create: jest.fn(),
            save: jest.fn(),
            remove: jest.fn(),
          },
        },
        {
          provide: getRepositoryToken(SellerProduct),
          useValue: {
            findOne: jest.fn(),
          },
        },
      ],
    }).compile();
    service = module.get<CartService>(CartService);
    cartRepository = module.get(getRepositoryToken(Cart));
    cartItemRepository = module.get(getRepositoryToken(CartItem));
    sellerProductRepository = module.get(getRepositoryToken(SellerProduct));
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
  });
  describe('toDecimalNumber (private helper via public behavior)', () => {
    it('should coerce numeric strings to numbers', async () => {
      // This tests the private toDecimalNumber via recalculateCartTotals
      const cart = mockCart({
        items: [
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: '10.00' as never }),
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: '20.00' as never }),
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: '15.55' as never }),
        ],
      });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      // Access private method via public recalculateCartTotals
      await service['recalculateCartTotals']('cart-1');
      expect(cart.subtotal).toBe(45.55);
      expect(typeof cart.subtotal).toBe('number');
      expect(cart.total).toBe(45.55);
    });
    it('should handle empty cart', async () => {
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      await service['recalculateCartTotals']('cart-1');
      expect(cart.subtotal).toBe(0);
      expect(cart.total).toBe(0);
      expect(typeof cart.subtotal).toBe('number');
    });
    it('should handle non-finite values gracefully', async () => {
      const cart = mockCart({
        items: [
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: '10.00' as never }),
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: NaN as never }),
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: Infinity as never }),
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: null as never }),
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: undefined as never }),
        ],
      });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      await service['recalculateCartTotals']('cart-1');
      expect(cart.subtotal).toBe(10.00);
      expect(typeof cart.subtotal).toBe('number');
    });
    it('should correctly sum quantities as integers', async () => {
      const cart = mockCart({
        items: [
          mockCartItem({ quantity: 2, totalPrice: '10.00' as never }),
          mockCartItem({ quantity: '3' as never, totalPrice: '20.00' as never }), // quantity as string
          mockCartItem({ quantity: 1.9, totalPrice: '15.55' as never }), // quantity as float
        ],
      });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      await service['recalculateCartTotals']('cart-1');
      // totalItems should be 2 + 3 + 1 = 6 (truncated)
      // We can't directly test totalItems since it's not stored, but we verify no crash
      expect(cart.subtotal).toBe(45.55);
    });
  });
  describe('addToCart', () => {
    it('should calculate finalPrice correctly with string price and discount from Postgres', async () => {
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({
        price: '99.95' as never, // string from Postgres
        discount: '10' as never, // string from Postgres
      });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      cartItemRepository.save.mockImplementation((item: DeepPartial<CartItem>, _options?: SaveOptions) => Promise.resolve(item as DeepPartial<CartItem> & CartItem));
      // Spy on recalculateCartTotals to avoid double mocking
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      const result = await service.addToCart('user-1', {
        sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
        quantity: 2,
      });
      // finalPrice = 99.95 - (99.95 * 10 / 100) = 89.955 -> rounded to 89.96
      const savedItem = cartItemRepository.save.mock.calls[0][0];
      expect(savedItem.unitPrice).toBe(89.96);
      expect(typeof savedItem.unitPrice).toBe('number');
      expect(savedItem.totalPrice).toBe(179.92); // 2 * 89.96
      expect(typeof savedItem.totalPrice).toBe('number');
    });
    it('should handle zero discount', async () => {
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({
        price: '50.00' as never,
        discount: '0' as never,
      });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      cartItemRepository.save.mockImplementation((item: DeepPartial<CartItem>, _options?: SaveOptions) => Promise.resolve(item as DeepPartial<CartItem> & CartItem));
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      await service.addToCart('user-1', {
        sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
        quantity: 1,
      });
      const savedItem = cartItemRepository.save.mock.calls[0][0];
      expect(savedItem.unitPrice).toBe(50.00);
      expect(savedItem.totalPrice).toBe(50.00);
    });
    it('should handle missing discount (null/undefined)', async () => {
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({
        price: '50.00' as never,
        discount: null as never,
      });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      cartItemRepository.save.mockImplementation((item: DeepPartial<CartItem>, _options?: SaveOptions) => Promise.resolve(item as DeepPartial<CartItem> & CartItem));
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      await service.addToCart('user-1', {
        sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
        quantity: 1,
      });
      const savedItem = cartItemRepository.save.mock.calls[0][0];
      expect(savedItem.unitPrice).toBe(50.00);
      expect(savedItem.totalPrice).toBe(50.00);
    });
    it('should update existing item quantity and recalculate totalPrice with coercion', async () => {
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({
        price: '100.00' as never,
        discount: '20' as never,
      });
      const existingItem = mockCartItem({
        id: 'ci-existing',
        quantity: 1,
        unitPrice: 80.00,
        totalPrice: '80.00' as never, // string from Postgres
        sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
      });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [existingItem] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      cartItemRepository.save.mockImplementation((item: DeepPartial<CartItem>, _options?: SaveOptions) => Promise.resolve(item as DeepPartial<CartItem> & CartItem));
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      await service.addToCart('user-1', {
        sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
        quantity: 2, // Adding 2 more
      });
      // Should update existing item: quantity = 1 + 2 = 3
      // unitPrice = 100 - (100 * 20 / 100) = 80
      // totalPrice = 3 * 80 = 240
      const savedItem = cartItemRepository.save.mock.calls[0][0];
      expect(savedItem.quantity).toBe(3);
      expect(savedItem.unitPrice).toBe(80.00);
      expect(savedItem.totalPrice).toBe(240.00);
    });
    it('should throw NotFoundException when sellerProduct not found', async () => {
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(
        service.addToCart('user-1', { sellerProductId: 'sp-999', quantity: 1 })
      ).rejects.toThrow(NotFoundException);
    });
    it('should throw NotFoundException when insufficient stock', async () => {
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({ stockQuantity: 5 });
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      await expect(
        service.addToCart('user-1', { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 10 })
      ).rejects.toThrow(NotFoundException);
    });
    it('should refresh unitPrice and totalPrice when sellerProduct price/discount changed on existing item', async () => {
      // Initial state: product price 100, discount 20 -> unitPrice 80
      const sellerProductInitial = mockSellerProduct({
        price: '100.00' as never,
        discount: '20' as never,
        stockQuantity: 100,
      });
      const existingItem = mockCartItem({
        id: 'ci-existing',
        quantity: 1,
        unitPrice: 80.00,
        totalPrice: '80.00' as never,
        sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
        availableStock: 100,
      });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [existingItem] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProductInitial);
      cartItemRepository.save.mockImplementation((item: DeepPartial<CartItem>, _options?: SaveOptions) => Promise.resolve(item as DeepPartial<CartItem> & CartItem));
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      // First addToCart - adds 1 more to existing item (qty becomes 2)
      await service.addToCart('user-1', {
        sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
        quantity: 1,
      });
      // Now sellerProduct price changed to 150, discount 10 -> new unitPrice = 135
      const sellerProductChanged = mockSellerProduct({
        price: '150.00' as never,
        discount: '10' as never,
        stockQuantity: 100,
      });
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProductChanged);
      // Add more quantity - should refresh price (adds 2 more, qty becomes 4)
      await service.addToCart('user-1', {
        sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
        quantity: 2,
      });
      const savedItem = cartItemRepository.save.mock.calls[1][0];
      // quantity = 1 (existing) + 1 (first add) + 2 (second add) = 4
      // new unitPrice = 150 - (150 * 10 / 100) = 135
      // totalPrice = 4 * 135 = 540
      expect(savedItem.quantity).toBe(4);
      expect(savedItem.unitPrice).toBe(135.00);
      expect(savedItem.totalPrice).toBe(540.00);
      expect(savedItem.availableStock).toBe(100);
    });
  });
  describe('updateCartItem', () => {
    it('should coerce quantity and recalculate totalPrice with string unitPrice from Postgres', async () => {
      const cartItem = mockCartItem({
        id: 'ci-1',
        quantity: 2,
        unitPrice: '89.96' as never, // string from Postgres
        totalPrice: '179.92' as never,
        sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
      });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [cartItem] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartItemRepository.save.mockImplementation((item: DeepPartial<CartItem>, _options?: SaveOptions) => Promise.resolve(item as DeepPartial<CartItem> & CartItem));
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({ stockQuantity: 100 });
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      await service.updateCartItem('user-1', 'ci-1', { quantity: 5 });
      const savedItem = cartItemRepository.save.mock.calls[0][0];
      expect(savedItem.quantity).toBe(5);
      expect(savedItem.unitPrice).toBe(89.96);
      expect(typeof savedItem.unitPrice).toBe('number');
      expect(savedItem.totalPrice).toBe(449.8); // 5 * 89.96
      expect(typeof savedItem.totalPrice).toBe('number');
    });
    it('should handle string quantity input', async () => {
      const cartItem = mockCartItem({
        id: 'ci-1',
        quantity: 2,
        unitPrice: 50.00,
        totalPrice: '100.00' as never,
      });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [cartItem] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartItemRepository.save.mockImplementation((item: DeepPartial<CartItem>, _options?: SaveOptions) => Promise.resolve(item as DeepPartial<CartItem> & CartItem));
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      // quantity comes as string from GraphQL
      await service.updateCartItem('user-1', 'ci-1', { quantity: '3' as never });
      const savedItem = cartItemRepository.save.mock.calls[0][0];
      expect(savedItem.quantity).toBe(3);
      expect(savedItem.totalPrice).toBe(150.00);
    });
    it('should throw NotFoundException when cart item not found', async () => {
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      await expect(
        service.updateCartItem('user-1', 'ci-999', { quantity: 1 })
      ).rejects.toThrow(NotFoundException);
    });
    it('should throw NotFoundException when insufficient stock for update', async () => {
      const cartItem = mockCartItem({
        id: 'ci-1',
        sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
      });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [cartItem] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({ stockQuantity: 5 });
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      await expect(
        service.updateCartItem('user-1', 'ci-1', { quantity: 10 })
      ).rejects.toThrow(NotFoundException);
    });
    it('should throw BadRequestException when quantity is negative (legacy test updated)', async () => {
      const cartItem = mockCartItem({ id: 'ci-1', sellerProductId: 'sp-1' });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [cartItem] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({ stockQuantity: 100 });
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      await expect(
        service.updateCartItem('user-1', 'ci-1', { quantity: -5 })
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });
    it('should refresh unitPrice from sellerProduct when sellerProduct exists', async () => {
      const cartItem = mockCartItem({
        id: 'ci-1',
        quantity: 2,
        unitPrice: 50.00,
        totalPrice: '100.00' as never,
        sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
      });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [cartItem] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartItemRepository.save.mockImplementation((item: DeepPartial<CartItem>, _options?: SaveOptions) => Promise.resolve(item as DeepPartial<CartItem> & CartItem));
      // sellerProduct has new price/discount
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({
        price: '200.00' as never,
        discount: '25' as never, // 200 - 50 = 150
        stockQuantity: 50,
      });
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      await service.updateCartItem('user-1', 'ci-1', { quantity: 3 });
      const savedItem = cartItemRepository.save.mock.calls[0][0];
      // unitPrice refreshed to 150 (200 - 25%)
      expect(savedItem.unitPrice).toBe(150.00);
      expect(savedItem.quantity).toBe(3);
      expect(savedItem.totalPrice).toBe(450.00); // 3 * 150
      expect(savedItem.availableStock).toBe(50);
    });
    it('should throw BadRequestException when quantity is 0', async () => {
      const cartItem = mockCartItem({ id: 'ci-1', sellerProductId: 'sp-1' });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [cartItem] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({ stockQuantity: 100 });
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      await expect(
        service.updateCartItem('user-1', 'ci-1', { quantity: 0 })
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });
    it('should throw BadRequestException when quantity is negative', async () => {
      const cartItem = mockCartItem({ id: 'ci-1', sellerProductId: 'sp-1' });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [cartItem] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({ stockQuantity: 100 });
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      await expect(
        service.updateCartItem('user-1', 'ci-1', { quantity: -5 })
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });
    it('should throw BadRequestException when quantity is a float (1.5)', async () => {
      const cartItem = mockCartItem({ id: 'ci-1', sellerProductId: 'sp-1' });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [cartItem] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({ stockQuantity: 100 });
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      await expect(
        service.updateCartItem('user-1', 'ci-1', { quantity: 1.5 })
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });
  });
  describe('removeFromCart', () => {
    it('should remove item and recalculate totals', async () => {
      const cartItem = mockCartItem({ id: 'ci-1' });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [cartItem] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartItemRepository.remove.mockResolvedValue(cartItem);
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      await service.removeFromCart('user-1', 'ci-1');
      expect(cartItemRepository.remove).toHaveBeenCalledWith(cartItem);
    });
    it('should throw NotFoundException when item not found', async () => {
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      await expect(service.removeFromCart('user-1', 'ci-999')).rejects.toThrow(
        NotFoundException
      );
    });
  });
  describe('clearCart', () => {
    it('should clear all items and reset totals to 0', async () => {
      const cartItems = [mockCartItem({ id: 'ci-1' }), mockCartItem({ id: 'ci-2' })];
      const cart = mockCart({
        items: cartItems,
        subtotal: 100,
        total: 100,
      });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartItemRepository.remove.mockResolvedValue({} as never);
      // Mock the second findOne call for the fresh cart
      const freshCart = mockCart({ items: [], subtotal: 0, total: 0 });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce(cart).mockResolvedValueOnce(freshCart);
      const result = await service.clearCart('user-1');
      expect(cartItemRepository.remove).toHaveBeenCalledWith(cartItems);
      expect(result.subtotal).toBe(0);
      expect(result.total).toBe(0);
      expect(result.items).toEqual([]);
    });
    it('should handle already empty cart', async () => {
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [], subtotal: 0, total: 0 });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      const freshCart = mockCart({ items: [], subtotal: 0, total: 0 });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce(cart).mockResolvedValueOnce(freshCart);
      const result = await service.clearCart('user-1');
      expect(result.subtotal).toBe(0);
      expect(result.total).toBe(0);
    });
  });
  describe('getCart', () => {
    it('should return cart from getOrCreateCart', async () => {
      const cart = mockCart({ id: 'cart-1' });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      const result = await service.getCart('user-1');
      expect(result).toBe(cart);
    });
  });
  describe('roundMoney (private helper via public behavior)', () => {
    it('should round to 2 decimal places correctly', async () => {
      // Test various floating point edge cases
      const cart = mockCart({
        items: [
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: '10.005' as never }), // Should round to 10.01
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: '20.004' as never }), // Should round to 20.00
        ],
      });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      await service['recalculateCartTotals']('cart-1');
      // 10.005 + 20.004 = 30.009 -> rounded to 30.01
      expect(cart.subtotal).toBe(30.01);
    });
    it('should handle floating point drift', async () => {
      // 0.1 + 0.2 = 0.30000000000000004 in JS
      const cart = mockCart({
        items: [
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: '0.1' as never }),
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: '0.2' as never }),
        ],
      });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      await service['recalculateCartTotals']('cart-1');
      expect(cart.subtotal).toBe(0.3);
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/cart.service.ts">
import { Injectable, NotFoundException, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { Cart, CartItem, SellerProduct } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import {
  AddToCartInput,
  UpdateCartItemInput,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
import { serializeProductInfoColorHexes } from './product-info-colors.util';
@Injectable()
export class CartService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Cart)
    private cartRepository: Repository<Cart>,
    @InjectRepository(CartItem)
    private cartItemRepository: Repository<CartItem>,
    @InjectRepository(SellerProduct)
    private sellerProductRepository: Repository<SellerProduct>
  ) {}
  /**
   * Safely coerces any value (including Postgres numeric strings) to a finite number.
   * Returns 0 for non-finite values (NaN, Infinity, null, undefined, non-numeric strings).
   */
  private toDecimalNumber(value: unknown): number {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
  }
  /**
   * Rounds a monetary value to 2 decimal places to avoid floating-point drift.
   * Uses the standard "round half up" with Number.EPSILON correction.
   */
  private roundMoney(value: number): number {
    return Math.round((value + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100;
  }
  async getOrCreateCart(userId: string): Promise<Cart> {
    let cart = await this.cartRepository.findOne({
      where: { userId },
      relations: ['items', 'items.product'],
    });
    if (!cart) {
      cart = this.cartRepository.create({
        userId,
        subtotal: 0,
        total: 0,
      });
      await this.cartRepository.save(cart);
    }
    return cart;
  }
  async addToCart(
    userId: string,
    addToCartInput: AddToCartInput
  ): Promise<Cart> {
    // Validate quantity: must be a positive integer
    const quantity = Number(addToCartInput.quantity);
    if (!Number.isInteger(quantity) || quantity <= 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Quantity must be a positive integer');
    }
    // Fetch the SellerProduct from database to get all product info
    const sellerProduct = await this.sellerProductRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: addToCartInput.sellerProductId },
      relations: [
        'product',
        'productInfo',
        'productInfo.colorLinks',
        'productInfo.colorLinks.color',
        'seller',
      ],
    });
    if (!sellerProduct) {
      throw new NotFoundException(
        `SellerProduct with ID ${addToCartInput.sellerProductId} not found`
      );
    }
    if (!sellerProduct.product) {
      throw new NotFoundException(
        `Product for SellerProduct ${addToCartInput.sellerProductId} not found`
      );
    }
    if (!sellerProduct.seller) {
      throw new NotFoundException(
        `Seller for SellerProduct ${addToCartInput.sellerProductId} not found`
      );
    }
    const cart = await this.getOrCreateCart(userId);
    // Check if item already exists in cart
    const existingItem = cart.items.find(
      (item) => item.sellerProductId === addToCartInput.sellerProductId
    );
    const currentQty = existingItem?.quantity || 0;
    const requestedTotal = currentQty + addToCartInput.quantity;
    // Check stock availability including what is already in the cart
    if (sellerProduct.stockQuantity < requestedTotal) {
      throw new NotFoundException(
        `Insufficient stock. Available: ${sellerProduct.stockQuantity}, Already in cart: ${currentQty}, Requested: ${addToCartInput.quantity}`
      );
    }
    // Calculate final price after discount - coerce Postgres numeric strings to numbers
    const price = this.toDecimalNumber(sellerProduct.price);
    const discount = this.toDecimalNumber(sellerProduct.discount);
    const finalPrice = this.roundMoney(
      discount > 0 ? price - (price * discount) / 100 : price
    );
    if (existingItem) {
      // Update quantity and refresh catalog price/stock
      existingItem.quantity = Math.max(
        0,
        Math.trunc(this.toDecimalNumber(existingItem.quantity)) +
          Math.max(0, Math.trunc(this.toDecimalNumber(addToCartInput.quantity)))
      );
      existingItem.unitPrice = finalPrice;
      existingItem.availableStock = sellerProduct.stockQuantity;
      existingItem.totalPrice = this.roundMoney(
        this.toDecimalNumber(existingItem.quantity) * finalPrice
      );
      await this.cartItemRepository.save(existingItem);
    } else {
      // Add new item with data from database
      const cartItem = new CartItem();
      cartItem.cartId = cart.id;
      cartItem.productId = sellerProduct.product.id.toString();
      cartItem.productName = sellerProduct.product.name;
      cartItem.productImage = sellerProduct.productInfo?.images?.[0];
      cartItem.quantity = Math.max(0, Math.trunc(this.toDecimalNumber(addToCartInput.quantity)));
      cartItem.unitPrice = finalPrice;
      cartItem.totalPrice = this.roundMoney(
        this.toDecimalNumber(cartItem.quantity) * finalPrice
      );
      cartItem.color = serializeProductInfoColorHexes(
        sellerProduct.productInfo?.colorLinks
      );
      cartItem.size = sellerProduct.productInfo?.size;
      cartItem.sellerId = sellerProduct.seller.id.toString();
      cartItem.sellerName = sellerProduct.seller.storeName;
      cartItem.productInfoId = sellerProduct.productInfo?.id.toString();
      cartItem.sellerProductId = sellerProduct.id;
      cartItem.availableStock = sellerProduct.stockQuantity;
      await this.cartItemRepository.save(cartItem);
    }
    // Recalculate cart totals
    await this.recalculateCartTotals(cart.id);
    return this.getOrCreateCart(userId);
  }
  async updateCartItem(
    userId: string,
    itemId: string,
    updateInput: UpdateCartItemInput
  ): Promise<Cart> {
    const cart = await this.getOrCreateCart(userId);
    const cartItem = cart.items.find((item) => item.id === itemId);
    if (!cartItem) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Cart item not found');
    }
    if (updateInput.quantity !== undefined && updateInput.quantity !== null) {
      const requestedQuantity = Number(updateInput.quantity);
      if (!Number.isInteger(requestedQuantity) || requestedQuantity <= 0) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Quantity must be a positive integer');
      }
      if (cartItem.sellerProductId) {
        const sellerProduct = await this.sellerProductRepository.findOne({
          where: { id: cartItem.sellerProductId },
        });
        if (sellerProduct) {
          if (requestedQuantity > this.toDecimalNumber(sellerProduct.stockQuantity)) {
            throw new NotFoundException(
              `Insufficient stock. Available: ${this.toDecimalNumber(sellerProduct.stockQuantity)}, Requested: ${requestedQuantity}`
            );
          }
          const price = this.toDecimalNumber(sellerProduct.price);
          const discount = this.toDecimalNumber(sellerProduct.discount);
          cartItem.unitPrice = this.roundMoney(
            discount > 0 ? price - (price * discount) / 100 : price
          );
          cartItem.availableStock = sellerProduct.stockQuantity;
        }
      }
      cartItem.quantity = requestedQuantity;
      cartItem.unitPrice = this.roundMoney(this.toDecimalNumber(cartItem.unitPrice));
      cartItem.totalPrice = this.roundMoney(
        this.toDecimalNumber(cartItem.quantity) *
          this.toDecimalNumber(cartItem.unitPrice)
      );
    }
    await this.cartItemRepository.save(cartItem);
    // Recalculate cart totals
    await this.recalculateCartTotals(cart.id);
    return this.getOrCreateCart(userId);
  }
  async removeFromCart(userId: string, itemId: string): Promise<Cart> {
    const cart = await this.getOrCreateCart(userId);
    const cartItem = cart.items.find((item) => item.id === itemId);
    if (!cartItem) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Cart item not found');
    }
    await this.cartItemRepository.remove(cartItem);
    // Recalculate cart totals
    await this.recalculateCartTotals(cart.id);
    return this.getOrCreateCart(userId);
  }
  async clearCart(userId: string): Promise<Cart> {
    const cart = await this.getOrCreateCart(userId);
    // Remove all items using the entities (more reliable than delete query)
    if (cart.items && cart.items.length > 0) {
      await this.cartItemRepository.remove(cart.items);
    }
    // Reset cart totals
    cart.subtotal = 0;
    cart.total = 0;
    cart.items = []; // Clear items array
    await this.cartRepository.save(cart);
    // Verify it's actually cleared
    const freshCart = await this.getOrCreateCart(userId);
    return freshCart;
  }
  async getCart(userId: string): Promise<Cart> {
    return this.getOrCreateCart(userId);
  }
  private async recalculateCartTotals(cartId: string): Promise<void> {
    const cart = await this.cartRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: cartId },
      relations: ['items'],
    });
    if (!cart) return;
    const totalAmount = this.roundMoney(
      cart.items.reduce(
        (sum, item) => sum + this.toDecimalNumber(item.totalPrice),
        0
      )
    );
    const totalItems = cart.items.reduce(
      (sum, item) =>
        sum + Math.max(0, Math.trunc(this.toDecimalNumber(item.quantity))),
      0
    );
    cart.subtotal = totalAmount;
    cart.total = totalAmount; // No shipping cost for cart
    await this.cartRepository.save(cart);
  }
}

    it('should throw NotFoundException if order does not exist', async () => {

    });
    it('should accept tracking number with whitespace (validation done in resolver)', async () => {
      // Service does not validate length/whitespace - that's done in resolver
      // Service just trims and saves

    it('should preserve all other order fields unchanged', async () => {

      orderRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(existingOrder);
      orderRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(updatedOrder);

      expect(result.subtotal).toBe(existingOrder.subtotal);
      expect(result.shippingCost).toBe(existingOrder.shippingCost);
      expect(result.total).toBe(existingOrder.total);
      expect(result.status).toBe(existingOrder.status);
      expect(result.stockReserved).toBe(existingOrder.stockReserved);
      expect(result.paymentAmount).toBe(existingOrder.paymentAmount);
      expect(result.paymentCurrency).toBe(existingOrder.paymentCurrency);
      expect(result.paymentAuthority).toBe(existingOrder.paymentAuthority);
      expect(result.sellerStoreName).toBe(existingOrder.sellerStoreName);
      expect(result.sellerPhone).toBe(existingOrder.sellerPhone);
      expect(result.sellerAddress).toBe(existingOrder.sellerAddress);
      expect(result.notes).toBe(existingOrder.notes);

      // updatedAt may be updated by the database
    });
  });

import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { getRepositoryToken } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, In, FindOneOptions } from 'typeorm';
import { BadRequestException, ForbiddenException } from '@nestjs/common';

  Brand,
  Category,
  Color,
  OrderItem,
  Product,
  ProductInfo,
  ProductInfoColor,
  SellerInfo,
  SellerProduct,
  ProductDescription,
  SiteLanguage,

describe('ProductService - multi-select storefront filters', () => {
  let service: ProductService;
  let productRepo: jest.Mocked<Repository<Product>>;
  let productInfoRepo: jest.Mocked<Repository<ProductInfo>>;
  let productInfoColorRepo: jest.Mocked<Repository<ProductInfoColor>>;
  let colorRepo: jest.Mocked<Repository<Color>>;
