  const makeQueryBuilder = () => {
    const qb: Record<string, jest.Mock> = {};
    const chain = [
      'leftJoinAndSelect',
      'leftJoin',
      'addSelect',
      'where',
      'andWhere',
      'orWhere',
      'orderBy',
      'addOrderBy',
      'take',
      'skip',
      'setParameter',
      'setParameters',
    ];
    chain.forEach((m) => {
      qb[m] = jest.fn().mockReturnValue(qb);
    });
    qb['getCount'] = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(0);
    qb['getMany'] = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue([]);
    qb['getManyAndCount'] = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue([[], 0]);
    return qb;
  };
  const whereCalls = (qb: Record<string, jest.Mock>) =>
    qb['andWhere'].mock.calls as Array<[string, Record<string, unknown>?]>;
  const allSqlCalls = (qb: Record<string, jest.Mock>) => {
    const calls: Array<[string, Record<string, unknown>?]> = [];
    calls.push(...(qb['andWhere'].mock.calls as Array<[string, Record<string, unknown>?]>));
    calls.push(...(qb['orderBy'].mock.calls as Array<[string, Record<string, unknown>?]>));
    calls.push(...(qb['addOrderBy'].mock.calls as Array<[string, Record<string, unknown>?]>));
    return calls;
  };
  it('matches products in ANY of the listed category slugs with one lowercased IN clause', async () => {
    const qb = makeQueryBuilder();
    productRepo.createQueryBuilder.mockReturnValue(qb as never);
    await service.getProducts({ categorySlugs: ['Men', 'T-Shirts'] });
    const catCalls = whereCalls(qb).filter(([sql]) => sql.includes('product_categories_categories'));
    expect(catCalls).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(catCalls[0][0]).toContain('IN (:...catSlugs)');
    expect(catCalls[0][1]).toEqual({ catSlugs: ['men', 't-shirts'] });
  });
  it('categorySlugs filter uses correct join table and column names (LOCKED)', async () => {
    const qb = makeQueryBuilder();
    productRepo.createQueryBuilder.mockReturnValue(qb as never);
    await service.getProducts({ categorySlugs: ['Men', 'T-Shirts'] });
    const catCalls = whereCalls(qb).filter(([sql]) => sql.includes('product_categories_categories'));
    expect(catCalls).toHaveLength(1);
    const sql = catCalls[0][0];
    // Must contain correct table/column names
    expect(sql).toContain('product_categories_categories');
    expect(sql).toContain('JOIN categories c');
    expect(sql).toContain('categoriesId');
    expect(sql).toContain('LOWER(c.slug) IN (:...catSlugs)');
    // Must NOT contain old/bad names
    expect(sql).not.toContain('product_category ');
    expect(sql).not.toContain('categoryId');
    expect(sql).not.toContain('c.name');
  });
  it('filters by ANY of the listed brands with a lowercased IN clause', async () => {
    const qb = makeQueryBuilder();
    productRepo.createQueryBuilder.mockReturnValue(qb as never);
    await service.getProducts({ brands: ['Nike', 'JORDAN'] });
    const brandCalls = whereCalls(qb).filter(([sql]) => sql.includes('brandSlugs'));
    expect(brandCalls).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(brandCalls[0][0]).toBe('LOWER(brand.slug) IN (:...brandSlugs)');
    expect(brandCalls[0][1]).toEqual({ brandSlugs: ['nike', 'jordan'] });
  });
  it('adds no brand or category-slug clauses when the arrays are empty', async () => {
    const qb = makeQueryBuilder();
    productRepo.createQueryBuilder.mockReturnValue(qb as never);
    await service.getProducts({ brands: [], categorySlugs: [] });
    const calls = whereCalls(qb).filter(
      ([sql]) => sql.includes('brandSlugs') || sql.includes('product_categories_categories')
    );
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(0);
  });
  it('keeps the single brand filter working', async () => {
    const qb = makeQueryBuilder();
    productRepo.createQueryBuilder.mockReturnValue(qb as never);
    await service.getProducts({ brand: 'Nike' });
    expect(qb['andWhere']).toHaveBeenCalledWith('LOWER(brand.slug) = :brandSlug', {
      brandSlug: 'nike',
    });
  });
  it('getProducts productInfoFilter does not reference removed ProductInfo columns', async () => {
    const qb = makeQueryBuilder();
    productRepo.createQueryBuilder.mockReturnValue(qb as never);
    await service.getProducts({
      productInfoFilter: {
        price: [100],
        costPrice: [50],
        discount: [10],
        stockQuantity: [5],
      },
    });
    const sqls = allSqlCalls(qb).map(([sql]) => sql);
    const forbidden = [
      'productInfo.price',
      'productInfo.costPrice',
      'productInfo.discount',
      'productInfo.stockQuantity',
    ];
    for (const f of forbidden) {
      expect(sqls.some((s) => s.includes(f))).toBe(false);
    }
    // Should use sellerProduct alias for price/costPrice/discount/stockQuantity
    const whereCallsList = whereCalls(qb);
    expect(whereCallsList.some(([sql, params]) => sql === 'sellerProduct.price IN (:...price)' && JSON.stringify(params?.['price']) === JSON.stringify([100]))).toBe(true);
    expect(whereCallsList.some(([sql, params]) => sql === 'sellerProduct.costPrice IN (:...costPrice)' && JSON.stringify(params?.['costPrice']) === JSON.stringify([50]))).toBe(true);
    expect(whereCallsList.some(([sql, params]) => sql === 'sellerProduct.discount IN (:...discount)' && JSON.stringify(params?.['discount']) === JSON.stringify([10]))).toBe(true);
    expect(whereCallsList.some(([sql, params]) => sql === 'sellerProduct.stockQuantity IN (:...stockQuantity)' && JSON.stringify(params?.['stockQuantity']) === JSON.stringify([5]))).toBe(true);
  });
  it('getProducts sort by color uses color.hexCode not color.name', async () => {
    const qb = makeQueryBuilder();
    productRepo.createQueryBuilder.mockReturnValue(qb as never);
    await service.getProducts({ sort: 'color' });
    const sqls = allSqlCalls(qb).map(([sql]) => sql);
    expect(sqls.some((s) => s.includes('color.name'))).toBe(false);
    expect(sqls.some((s) => s.includes('color.hexCode'))).toBe(true);
  });
  describe('getSellerProducts', () => {
    it('productInfoFilter does not reference removed ProductInfo columns', async () => {
      const qb = makeQueryBuilder();
      productRepo.createQueryBuilder.mockReturnValue(qb as never);
      await service.getSellerProducts(1, {
        productInfoFilter: {
          price: [100],
          costPrice: [50],
          discount: [10],
          stockQuantity: [5],
        },
      });
      const sqls = allSqlCalls(qb).map(([sql]) => sql);
      const forbidden = [
        'productInfo.price',
        'productInfo.costPrice',
        'productInfo.discount',
        'productInfo.stockQuantity',
      ];
      for (const f of forbidden) {
        expect(sqls.some((s) => s.includes(f))).toBe(false);
      }
      // Should use sellerProduct alias for price/costPrice/discount/stockQuantity
      const whereCallsList = whereCalls(qb);
      expect(whereCallsList.some(([sql, params]) => sql === 'sellerProduct.price IN (:...price)' && JSON.stringify(params?.['price']) === JSON.stringify([100]))).toBe(true);
      expect(whereCallsList.some(([sql, params]) => sql === 'sellerProduct.costPrice IN (:...costPrice)' && JSON.stringify(params?.['costPrice']) === JSON.stringify([50]))).toBe(true);
      expect(whereCallsList.some(([sql, params]) => sql === 'sellerProduct.discount IN (:...discount)' && JSON.stringify(params?.['discount']) === JSON.stringify([10]))).toBe(true);
      expect(whereCallsList.some(([sql, params]) => sql === 'sellerProduct.stockQuantity IN (:...stockQuantity)' && JSON.stringify(params?.['stockQuantity']) === JSON.stringify([5]))).toBe(true);
    });
    it('sort by color uses color.hexCode not color.name', async () => {
      const qb = makeQueryBuilder();
      productRepo.createQueryBuilder.mockReturnValue(qb as never);
      await service.getSellerProducts(1, { sort: 'color' });
      const sqls = allSqlCalls(qb).map(([sql]) => sql);
      expect(sqls.some((s) => s.includes('color.name'))).toBe(false);
      expect(sqls.some((s) => s.includes('color.hexCode'))).toBe(true);
    });
  });
});

import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { getRepositoryToken } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { ShippingCalculationService, applyShippingMethodMultiplier } from './shipping-calculation.service';
import { PlatformSettings, ShippingStrategy, ShippingPaymentMode } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
describe('ShippingCalculationService', () => {
  let service: ShippingCalculationService;
  let mockSettingsRepository: jest.Mocked<Repository<PlatformSettings>>;
  const mockSettings: PlatformSettings = {
    id: 1,
    freeShippingEnabled: true,
    freeShippingThreshold: 100,
    shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.TIERED_DISCOUNT,
    additionalSellerDiscount: 0.5,
    additionalSellerFixedFee: 2.5,
    maxShippingCapEnabled: true,
    maxShippingCap: 15,
    createdAt: new Date(),
    updatedAt: new Date(),
  } as PlatformSettings;
  beforeEach(async () => {
    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        ShippingCalculationService,
        {
          provide: getRepositoryToken(PlatformSettings),
          useValue: {
            findOne: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(mockSettings),
            create: jest.fn().mockReturnValue(mockSettings),
            save: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(mockSettings),
          },
        },
      ],
    }).compile();
    service = module.get<ShippingCalculationService>(ShippingCalculationService);
    mockSettingsRepository = module.get(getRepositoryToken(PlatformSettings));
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
  });
  describe('Free Shipping', () => {
    it('should return totalShippingCost: 0 and appliedFee: 0 for all sellers when free shipping threshold is met', async () => {
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 5.0, sellerName: 'Seller 1' },
        { sellerId: '2', shippingFee: 3.0, sellerName: 'Seller 2' },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(150, sellerFees);
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(0);
      expect(result.freeShippingApplied).toBe(true);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown).toHaveLength(2);
      result.shippingBreakdown.forEach((item) => {
        expect(item.appliedFee).toBe(0);
        expect(item.originalFee).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
      });
    });
    it('should return originalFee as number even when shippingFee is 0', async () => {
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 0, sellerName: 'Free Ship Seller' },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(150, sellerFees);
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(0);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].originalFee).toBe(0);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].appliedFee).toBe(0);
    });
  });
  describe('Zero Shipping Fee Sellers', () => {
    it('should return 0 for seller with shippingFee: 0 (regular customer)', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 0, sellerName: 'Free Ship Seller' },
        { sellerId: '2', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Paid Ship Seller' },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown.find((s) => s.sellerId === '1')?.appliedFee).toBe(0);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown.find((s) => s.sellerId === '2')?.appliedFee).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });
    it('should return 0 for seller with shippingFee: 0 (VIP customer with TIERED_DISCOUNT)', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.TIERED_DISCOUNT,
        additionalSellerDiscount: 0.5,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 0, sellerName: 'First Seller Free' },
        { sellerId: '2', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Second Seller' },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      // First seller (index 0) pays full fee = 0
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].appliedFee).toBe(0);
      // Second seller gets 50% discount on 10 = 5
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[1].appliedFee).toBe(5);
    });
    it('should return 0 for seller with shippingFee: 0 in FULL_SUM strategy', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.FULL_SUM,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 0, sellerName: 'Free Seller' },
        { sellerId: '2', shippingFee: 5, sellerName: 'Paid Seller' },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(5);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown.find((s) => s.sellerId === '1')?.appliedFee).toBe(0);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown.find((s) => s.sellerId === '2')?.appliedFee).toBe(5);
    });
  });
  describe('Regular Shipping Fees', () => {
    it('should return correct fee for seller with shippingFee: 10 in FULL_SUM', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.FULL_SUM,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Seller 1' },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(10);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].appliedFee).toBe(10);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].originalFee).toBe(10);
    });
    it('should apply TIERED_DISCOUNT correctly for VIP customer', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.TIERED_DISCOUNT,
        additionalSellerDiscount: 0.5,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: false, // Disable cap to test full calculation
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'First Seller' },
        { sellerId: '2', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Second Seller' },
        { sellerId: '3', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Third Seller' },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      // First seller: 10 (full)
      // Second: 10 * 0.5 = 5
      // Third: 10 * 0.5 = 5
      // Total: 20
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(20);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].appliedFee).toBe(10);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[1].appliedFee).toBe(5);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[2].appliedFee).toBe(5);
    });
    it('should apply TIERED_FIXED correctly', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.TIERED_FIXED,
        additionalSellerFixedFee: 2.5,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: false, // Disable cap to test full calculation
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'First Seller' },
        { sellerId: '2', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Second Seller' },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].appliedFee).toBe(10);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[1].appliedFee).toBe(2.5);
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(12.5);
    });
    it('should apply HIGHEST_ONLY correctly', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.HIGHEST_ONLY,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: false,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 5, sellerName: 'Seller 1' },
        { sellerId: '2', shippingFee: 15, sellerName: 'Seller 2' },
        { sellerId: '3', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Seller 3' },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(15);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].appliedFee).toBe(15);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[1].appliedFee).toBe(0);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[2].appliedFee).toBe(0);
    });
    it('should apply AVERAGE correctly', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.AVERAGE,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: false,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Seller 1' },
        { sellerId: '2', shippingFee: 20, sellerName: 'Seller 2' },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      // Average = (10 + 20) / 2 = 15
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(15);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].appliedFee).toBe(15);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[1].appliedFee).toBe(0);
    });
  });
  describe('Rounding and Number Coercion', () => {
    it('should round all returned values to 2 decimal places', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.TIERED_DISCOUNT,
        additionalSellerDiscount: 0.33, // Creates non-round numbers
        maxShippingCapEnabled: false,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 10.123, sellerName: 'Seller 1' },
        { sellerId: '2', shippingFee: 5.456, sellerName: 'Seller 2' },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      // Check totalShippingCost is rounded
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(Math.round(result.totalShippingCost * 100) / 100);
      // Check each breakdown item is rounded
      result.shippingBreakdown.forEach((item) => {
        expect(item.originalFee).toBe(Math.round(item.originalFee * 100) / 100);
        expect(item.appliedFee).toBe(Math.round(item.appliedFee * 100) / 100);
      });
    });
    it('should coerce null/undefined shippingFee to 0', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.FULL_SUM,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: false,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: null as never, sellerName: 'Seller 1' },
        { sellerId: '2', shippingFee: undefined as never, sellerName: 'Seller 2' },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(0);
      result.shippingBreakdown.forEach((item) => {
        expect(item.originalFee).toBe(0);
        expect(item.appliedFee).toBe(0);
      });
    });
  });
  describe('Max Shipping Cap', () => {
    it('should apply max shipping cap and round results', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.FULL_SUM,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: true,
        maxShippingCap: 10,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 20, sellerName: 'Seller 1' },
        { sellerId: '2', shippingFee: 15, sellerName: 'Seller 2' },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(10); // Capped at 10
      // Each fee should be proportionally reduced and rounded
      result.shippingBreakdown.forEach((item) => {
        expect(item.appliedFee).toBe(Math.round(item.appliedFee * 100) / 100);
      });
    });
  });
  describe('PAY_ON_DELIVERY vs PAY_ONLINE behavior', () => {
    it('should treat explicit PAY_ON_DELIVERY seller as COD (appliedFee 0, excluded from first-seller slot)', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.TIERED_DISCOUNT,
        additionalSellerDiscount: 0.5,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: false,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'COD Seller', shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ON_DELIVERY },
        { sellerId: '2', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Online Seller 1', shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ONLINE },
        { sellerId: '3', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Online Seller 2', shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ONLINE },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      // COD seller should have appliedFee 0 and originalFee 0
      const codSeller = result.shippingBreakdown.find((s) => s.sellerId === '1');
      expect(codSeller?.appliedFee).toBe(0);
      expect(codSeller?.originalFee).toBe(0);
      // First ONLINE seller (sellerId: '2') should get first-seller slot (full fee = 10)
      const firstOnline = result.shippingBreakdown.find((s) => s.sellerId === '2');
      expect(firstOnline?.appliedFee).toBe(10);
      // Second ONLINE seller (sellerId: '3') should get discount (10 * 0.5 = 5)
      const secondOnline = result.shippingBreakdown.find((s) => s.sellerId === '3');
      expect(secondOnline?.appliedFee).toBe(5);
      // Total should only include online sellers: 10 + 5 = 15
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(15);
    });
    it('should treat PAY_ONLINE seller as online (legacy behavior)', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.FULL_SUM,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: false,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Online Seller', shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ONLINE },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(10);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].appliedFee).toBe(10);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].originalFee).toBe(10);
    });
    it('should treat missing shippingPaymentMode as online (legacy behavior)', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.FULL_SUM,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: false,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Legacy Seller' }, // No shippingPaymentMode
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(10);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].appliedFee).toBe(10);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].originalFee).toBe(10);
    });
    it('should treat undefined shippingPaymentMode as online (legacy behavior)', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.FULL_SUM,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: false,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Undefined Seller', shippingPaymentMode: undefined },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(10);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].appliedFee).toBe(10);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].originalFee).toBe(10);
    });
    it('should treat null shippingPaymentMode as online (legacy behavior)', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.FULL_SUM,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: false,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Null Seller', shippingPaymentMode: null as never },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(10);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].appliedFee).toBe(10);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].originalFee).toBe(10);
    });
    it('should be case-insensitive for PAY_ON_DELIVERY', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.FULL_SUM,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: false,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Lowercase COD', shippingPaymentMode: 'pay_on_delivery' },
        { sellerId: '2', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Mixed Case COD', shippingPaymentMode: 'Pay_On_Delivery' },
        { sellerId: '3', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Online Seller', shippingPaymentMode: 'pay_online' },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown.find((s) => s.sellerId === '1')?.appliedFee).toBe(0);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown.find((s) => s.sellerId === '2')?.appliedFee).toBe(0);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown.find((s) => s.sellerId === '3')?.appliedFee).toBe(10);
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(10);
    });
  });
  describe('applyShippingMethodMultiplier', () => {
    it('should return 0 for pickup', () => {
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10, 'pickup')).toBe(0);
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10, 'PICKUP')).toBe(0);
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10, 'Pickup')).toBe(0);
    });
    it('should return 45% of base fee rounded to 2 decimals for express', () => {
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10, 'express')).toBe(4.5);
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10, 'EXPRESS')).toBe(4.5);
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10, 'Express')).toBe(4.5);
      // Test rounding: 10 * 0.45 = 4.5 (already 2 decimals)
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(11.11, 'express')).toBe(5.0); // 11.11 * 0.45 = 4.9995 -> 5.00
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(7.77, 'express')).toBe(3.5); // 7.77 * 0.45 = 3.4965 -> 3.50
    });
    it('should return full base fee rounded to 2 decimals for vip (default)', () => {
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10, 'vip')).toBe(10);
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10, 'VIP')).toBe(10);
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10, 'Vip')).toBe(10);
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10)).toBe(10); // undefined defaults to vip
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10, null)).toBe(10); // null defaults to vip
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10.123, 'vip')).toBe(10.12); // rounded
    });
    it('should handle zero and negative base fees', () => {
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(0, 'express')).toBe(0);
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(-5, 'express')).toBe(0); // safeBase treats negative as 0
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(0, 'vip')).toBe(0);
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(0, 'pickup')).toBe(0);
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/shared/validation/src/lib/cart.spec.ts">
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  CART_LIMITS,
  cartQuantitySchema,
  addToCartSchema,
  updateCartItemSchema,
} from './cart';
describe('cart validation schemas', () => {
  describe('cartQuantitySchema', () => {
    it('accepts 1', () => {
      const result = cartQuantitySchema.safeParse(1);
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data).toBe(1);
      }
    });
    it('accepts 99', () => {
      const result = cartQuantitySchema.safeParse(99);
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data).toBe(99);
      }
    });
    it('rejects 0', () => {
      const result = cartQuantitySchema.safeParse(0);
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('rejects -1', () => {
      const result = cartQuantitySchema.safeParse(-1);
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('rejects 1.5 (non-integer)', () => {
      const result = cartQuantitySchema.safeParse(1.5);
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('rejects 100', () => {
      const result = cartQuantitySchema.safeParse(100);
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
  });
  describe('addToCartSchema', () => {
    const validInput = { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 1 };
    it('accepts valid input (happy path)', () => {
      const result = addToCartSchema.safeParse(validInput);
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data.sellerProductId).toBe('sp-1');
        expect(result.data.quantity).toBe(1);
      }
    });
    it('accepts max quantity 99', () => {
      const result = addToCartSchema.safeParse({ sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 99 });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data.quantity).toBe(99);
      }
    });
    it('rejects quantity 0', () => {
      const result = addToCartSchema.safeParse({ sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 0 });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('rejects quantity -1', () => {
      const result = addToCartSchema.safeParse({ sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: -1 });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('rejects quantity 1.5 (non-integer)', () => {
      const result = addToCartSchema.safeParse({ sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 1.5 });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('rejects quantity 100', () => {
      const result = addToCartSchema.safeParse({ sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 100 });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('rejects empty sellerProductId', () => {
      const result = addToCartSchema.safeParse({ sellerProductId: '', quantity: 1 });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('rejects whitespace-only sellerProductId', () => {
      const result = addToCartSchema.safeParse({ sellerProductId: '  ', quantity: 1 });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('trims sellerProductId', () => {
      const result = addToCartSchema.safeParse({ sellerProductId: '  sp-1  ', quantity: 1 });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data.sellerProductId).toBe('sp-1');
      }
    });
  });
  describe('updateCartItemSchema', () => {
    it('accepts empty object', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({});
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data).toEqual({});
      }
    });
    it('accepts all-null', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({ quantity: null, color: null, size: null });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data).toEqual({ quantity: null, color: null, size: null });
      }
    });
    it('trims color', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({ color: '  red  ' });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data.color).toBe('red');
      }
    });
    it('trims size', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({ size: '  M  ' });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data.size).toBe('M');
      }
    });
    it('rejects quantity 0', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({ quantity: 0 });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('rejects empty color after trim', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({ color: '   ' });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('rejects 51-char color', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({ color: 'a'.repeat(51) });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('accepts 50-char color', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({ color: 'a'.repeat(50) });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data.color).toBe('a'.repeat(50));
      }
    });
    it('rejects 21-char size', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({ size: 'a'.repeat(21) });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('accepts 20-char size', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({ size: 'a'.repeat(20) });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data.size).toBe('a'.repeat(20));
      }
    });
    it('accepts valid color and size', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({ color: 'blue', size: 'L' });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data.color).toBe('blue');
        expect(result.data.size).toBe('L');
      }
    });
    it('accepts valid quantity', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({ quantity: 5 });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data.quantity).toBe(5);
      }
    });
  });
  describe('CART_LIMITS constant', () => {
    it('has correct values', () => {
      expect(CART_LIMITS.quantity.min).toBe(1);
      expect(CART_LIMITS.quantity.max).toBe(99);
      expect(CART_LIMITS.color.max).toBe(50);
      expect(CART_LIMITS.size.max).toBe(20);
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/shared/validation/src/lib/cart.ts">
import { z } from 'zod';
import { idSchema, trimmedString } from './primitives';
export const CART_LIMITS = {
  quantity: { min: 1, max: 99 },
  color: { max: 50 },
  size: { max: 20 },
} as const;
export const cartQuantitySchema = z
  .number()
  .int()
  .min(CART_LIMITS.quantity.min)
  .max(CART_LIMITS.quantity.max);
export const addToCartSchema = z.object({
  sellerProductId: idSchema,
  quantity: cartQuantitySchema,
});
export const updateCartItemSchema = z.object({
  quantity: cartQuantitySchema.nullish(),
  color: trimmedString(1, CART_LIMITS.color.max).nullish(),
  size: trimmedString(1, CART_LIMITS.size.max).nullish(),
});
export type AddToCartInput = z.input<typeof addToCartSchema>;
export type AddToCartData = z.output<typeof addToCartSchema>;
export type UpdateCartItemInput = z.input<typeof updateCartItemSchema>;
export type UpdateCartItemData = z.output<typeof updateCartItemSchema>;
export type CartQuantityData = z.output<typeof cartQuantitySchema>;

import {
  createProductInfoSchema,
  createProductSchema,
  productEditorFormSchema,
  productVariantSchema,
  updateProductSchema,
} from './catalog';
const variant = { size: '42', sizeKind: 'FOOTWEAR', colorIds: [1], weight: 0.8 };
const product = { name: 'Air Max', sku: 'AM-1', categoryIds: [2], brandId: null, variants: [variant] };
describe('catalog schemas', () => {
  it('accepts valid products and variants with optional fields as null', () => {
    expect(createProductSchema.safeParse(product).success).toBe(true);
    expect(updateProductSchema.safeParse({ ...product, id: 9, descriptions: [{ languageCode: 'fa', description: 'x' }] }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(productVariantSchema.safeParse({ ...variant, price: null, discount: 0, stockQuantity: 0 }).success).toBe(true);
  });
  it('rejects missing names/skus and invalid variants with the existing messages', () => {
    expect(createProductSchema.safeParse({ ...product, sku: '' }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(updateProductSchema.safeParse(product).success).toBe(false);
    const bad = productVariantSchema.safeParse({ ...variant, size: '', weight: 0, discount: 120, stockQuantity: -1 });
    expect(bad.success ? [] : bad.error.issues.map((i) => i.message)).toEqual([
      'Variant size is required',
      'Weight must be greater than 0',
      'Discount cannot exceed 100',
      'Stock quantity cannot be negative',
    ]);
  });
  it('validates product infos', () => {
    expect(createProductInfoSchema.safeParse({ productId: 1, size: 'M', sizeKind: 'APPAREL', colorIds: [], weight: 1 }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(createProductInfoSchema.safeParse({ productId: 1, size: 'M' }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});
describe('productEditorFormSchema', () => {
  const form = {
    name: 'Air Max',
    sku: 'AM-1',
    categoryIds: [2],
    variants: [{ size: '42', colorIds: [1], weight: 0.8 }],
  };
  const paths = (v: unknown) => {
    const r = productEditorFormSchema.safeParse(v);
    return r.success ? [] : r.error.issues.map((i) => i.path.join('.'));
  };
  it('accepts a complete product', () => {
    expect(paths(form)).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('requires name, a non-blank sku and a category', () => {
    expect(paths({ ...form, name: '', sku: '  ', categoryIds: [] })).toEqual(['name', 'sku', 'categoryIds']);
  });
  it('requires each variant to have a size, a color and a positive weight', () => {
    expect(paths({ ...form, variants: [{ size: '', colorIds: [], weight: 0 }] })).toEqual([
      'variants.0.size',
      'variants.0.colorIds',
      'variants.0.weight',
    ]);
  });
});

import {
  bulkTranslationSchema,
  createCurrencySchema,
  currencyCodeSchema,
  exchangeRateFormSchema,
  setExchangeRateSchema,
  translationNameFormSchema,
  translationSchema,
  updateCurrencySchema,
} from './currency';
const ok = (s: { safeParse: (v: unknown) => { success: boolean } }, v: unknown) => s.safeParse(v).success;
describe('currency and translation schemas', () => {
  it('accepts the seeded currencies and rejects malformed codes', () => {
    expect(ok(createCurrencySchema, { code: 'IRR', name: 'Iranian Rial', symbol: '﷼', decimalPlaces: 0 })).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(currencyCodeSchema, 'usd')).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(currencyCodeSchema, 'U$D')).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(createCurrencySchema, { code: 'USD', name: '', symbol: '$', decimalPlaces: 2 })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(updateCurrencySchema, { decimalPlaces: 9 })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(updateCurrencySchema, { isActive: false })).toBe(true);
  });
  it('requires a positive exchange rate', () => {
    expect(ok(setExchangeRateSchema, { fromCurrencyCode: 'USD', toCurrencyCode: 'IRR', rate: 600000 })).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(setExchangeRateSchema, { fromCurrencyCode: 'USD', toCurrencyCode: 'IRR', rate: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(exchangeRateFormSchema, { rate: '58000.5' })).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(exchangeRateFormSchema, { rate: 'abc' })).toBe(false);
  });
  it('validates translations and allows clearing a value', () => {
    const t = { entityType: 'product', entityId: 3, locale: 'fa', fieldName: 'name', value: '' };
    expect(ok(translationSchema, t)).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(translationSchema, { ...t, locale: 'x' })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(translationSchema, { ...t, entityId: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(bulkTranslationSchema, { entityType: 'brand', entityIds: [1, 2], sourceLocale: 'en', targetLocales: ['fa'] })).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(bulkTranslationSchema, { entityType: 'brand', entityIds: [1], sourceLocale: 'en', targetLocales: [''] })).toBe(false);
  });
  it('limits translated names in the admin editor but allows clearing', () => {
    expect(ok(translationNameFormSchema, { value: '' })).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(translationNameFormSchema, { value: 'کفش ورزشی' })).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(translationNameFormSchema, { value: 'x'.repeat(101) })).toBe(false);
  });
});

import {

describe('seller schemas', () => {
  const seller = {
    name: 'Ali',
    lastName: 'Rezaei',
    username: 'ali',
    email: 'ali@example.com',
    password: 'secret123',
    storeName: 'Ali Kicks',
  };
  it('accepts a valid seller and optional fields as null', () => {
    expect(createSellerSchema.safeParse({ ...seller, phone: null, shippingFee: 5 }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(updateSellerSchema.safeParse({ id: 1, email: null, isActive: false }).success).toBe(true);
  });
  it('rejects missing required seller fields and bad emails', () => {
    expect(createSellerSchema.safeParse({ ...seller, storeName: '' }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(createSellerSchema.safeParse({ ...seller, email: 'nope' }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(updateSellerSchema.safeParse({ id: 1, email: 'nope' }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  const product = { productInfoId: 3, price: 150, costPrice: 0, discount: 10, stockQuantity: 0 };
  it('mirrors the seller product limits', () => {
    expect(createSellerProductSchema.safeParse(product).success).toBe(true);
    expect(createSellerProductSchema.safeParse({ ...product, price: 0 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(createSellerProductSchema.safeParse({ ...product, discount: 101 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(createSellerProductSchema.safeParse({ ...product, stockQuantity: 1.5 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(updateSellerProductSchema.safeParse({ id: 'sp1', stockQuantity: 0 }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(updateSellerProductSchema.safeParse({ id: '' }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  it('the editor form also requires a positive cost price', () => {
    expect(sellerProductFormSchema.safeParse(product).success).toBe(false);
    expect(sellerProductFormSchema.safeParse({ ...product, costPrice: 100 }).success).toBe(true);
  });
  it('admin seller forms: create requires the core fields, edit allows blanks', () => {
    const form = { name: 'Ali', lastName: 'R', username: 'ali', email: 'ali@example.com', storeName: 'S', shippingFee: '' };
    expect(sellerCreateFormSchema.safeParse(form).success).toBe(true);
    expect(sellerCreateFormSchema.safeParse({ ...form, storeName: ' ' }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(sellerCreateFormSchema.safeParse({ ...form, shippingFee: '-1' }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(sellerEditFormSchema.safeParse({ name: '', email: '' }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(sellerEditFormSchema.safeParse({ email: 'bad' }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(sellerEditFormSchema.safeParse({ shippingFee: 4.5 }).success).toBe(true);
  });
});

<file path="apps/kickzone-api/src/app/cart-inputs.validation.spec.ts">
import { BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from '@kickzone-workspace/resolvers';
import { addToCartSchema, updateCartItemSchema } from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import { AddToCartInput, UpdateCartItemInput } from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
// Cart inputs are validated by the resolver's ZodValidationPipe with the shared cart schemas.
describe('Cart Inputs Validation', () => {
  const addPipe = new ZodValidationPipe(addToCartSchema);
  const updatePipe = new ZodValidationPipe(updateCartItemSchema);
  describe('AddToCartInput', () => {
    const validAddToCartBase: AddToCartInput = {
      sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
      quantity: 1,
    };
    it.each([0, -1, 1.5])('should reject quantity %p via BadRequestException', (quantity) => {
      const input: AddToCartInput = { ...validAddToCartBase, quantity };
      expect(() => addPipe.transform(input)).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });
    it('should resolve quantity 1 unchanged', () => {
      const input: AddToCartInput = { ...validAddToCartBase, quantity: 1 };
      expect(addPipe.transform(input)).toEqual(input);
    });
  });
  describe('UpdateCartItemInput', () => {
    // Changed from the class-validator era: the shared cart rule (V2a) requires a
    // quantity of 1-99, so -5 is now rejected at the API instead of being clamped.
    it('should reject quantity -5 via BadRequestException', () => {
      const input: UpdateCartItemInput = { quantity: -5 };
      expect(() => updatePipe.transform(input)).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });
    it('should resolve quantity 2 unchanged', () => {
      const input: UpdateCartItemInput = { quantity: 2 };
      expect(updatePipe.transform(input)).toEqual(input);
    });
  });
});
</file>

<file path="apps/kickzone-api/src/app/product-variant-inputs.validation.spec.ts">
import { BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from '@kickzone-workspace/resolvers';
import { createProductSchema } from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import { CreateProductInput, ProductVariantInput } from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
import { SizeKind } from '@kickzone-workspace/product-sizes';
describe('Product Variant Inputs Validation', () => {
  const pipe = new ZodValidationPipe(createProductSchema);
  const validVariant: ProductVariantInput = { size: 'M', colorIds: [1], weight: 1 };
  const validCreateBase: CreateProductInput = {
    name: 'X',
    sku: 'S',
    categoryIds: [1],
    variants: [validVariant],
  };
  const withVariant = (patch: Partial<ProductVariantInput>): CreateProductInput => ({
    ...validCreateBase,
    variants: [{ ...validVariant, ...patch }],
  });
  describe('CreateProductInput with ProductVariantInput', () => {
    it('should resolve valid variant input', () => {
      expect(pipe.transform(validCreateBase)).toEqual(validCreateBase);
    });
    it('should resolve variant with size 4XL', () => {
      const input = withVariant({ size: '4XL', sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel });
      expect(pipe.transform(input)).toEqual(input);
    });
    it('should reject discount 101 via BadRequestException', () => {
      expect(() => pipe.transform(withVariant({ discount: 101 }))).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });
    it('should resolve discount 100', () => {
      const input = withVariant({ discount: 100 });
      expect(pipe.transform(input)).toEqual(input);
    });
    it('should reject stockQuantity 2.5 via BadRequestException', () => {
      expect(() => pipe.transform(withVariant({ stockQuantity: 2.5 }))).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });
    it('should resolve stockQuantity 0', () => {
      const input = withVariant({ stockQuantity: 0 });
      expect(pipe.transform(input)).toEqual(input);
    });
  });
});

import React from 'react';
import { render, screen, waitFor, act, fireEvent } from '@testing-library/react';
import { MockedProvider, MockedResponse } from '@apollo/client/testing';
import { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ThemeProvider, CssBaseline } from '@mui/material';
import { CustomerPaymentCallback } from './customer-payment-callback';
import { VERIFY_ZARINPAL_PAYMENT_MUTATION, CANCEL_PENDING_ZARINPAL_ORDER_MUTATION } from '@kickzone-workspace/customers-graphql';
// Mock theme for MUI components
const mockTheme = {
  palette: {
    mode: 'light',
  },
};
// Mock for useCustomersCartMutations
const mockClearCartMutation = jest.fn<Promise<unknown>, []>().mockResolvedValue({});
// Mock for useCartStore
const mockClearCartAction = jest.fn<void, []>();
// Mock sessionStorage
const mockSessionStorage = (() => {
  let store: Record<string, string> = {};
  return {
    getItem: jest.fn((key: string) => store[key] || null),
    setItem: jest.fn((key: string, value: string) => { store[key] = value; }),
    removeItem: jest.fn((key: string) => { delete store[key]; }),
    clear: jest.fn(() => { store = {}; }),
  };
})();
Object.defineProperty(window, 'sessionStorage', {
  value: mockSessionStorage,
  writable: true,
});
// Mock the cart hooks
jest.mock('@kickzone-workspace/customers-cart-hook', () => ({
  useCustomersCartMutations: () => ({
    clearCart: mockClearCartMutation,
  }),
}));
jest.mock('@kickzone-workspace/customer-cart-store', () => ({
  useCartStore: (selector: (state: { clearCart: () => void }) => { clearCart: () => void }) => selector({
    clearCart: mockClearCartAction,
  }),
}));
// Wrapper for React Router, Apollo Provider, and MUI Theme
const renderWithProviders = (ui: React.ReactElement, mocks: MockedResponse[] = []) => {
  return render(
    <MockedProvider mocks={mocks} addTypename={false}>
      <BrowserRouter>
        <ThemeProvider theme={mockTheme}>
          <CssBaseline />
          {ui}
        </ThemeProvider>
      </BrowserRouter>
    </MockedProvider>
  );
};
describe('CustomerPaymentCallback - Guest ZarinPal Cancel', () => {
  const authority = 'A00000123';
  const orderId = 'order-123';
  const orderNumber = 'ORD-123456';
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
    mockSessionStorage.clear();
  });
  const setupOrderInSessionStorage = () => {
    mockSessionStorage.setItem(
      `order_${orderId}`,
      JSON.stringify({ orderId, orderNumber, amount: 50000 })
    );
  };
  describe('Status=NOK with authority (Guest user)', () => {
    it('should call cancelPendingZarinPalOrder with authority when orderId exists in sessionStorage', async () => {
      setupOrderInSessionStorage();
      const mocks: MockedResponse[] = [
        {
          request: {
            query: CANCEL_PENDING_ZARINPAL_ORDER_MUTATION,
            variables: { orderId, authority, guestToken: undefined },
          },
          result: { data: { cancelPendingZarinPalOrder: true } },
        },
      ];
      const { waitFor: waitForRender } = renderWithProviders(
        <CustomerPaymentCallback />,
        mocks
      );
      // Simulate URL with Status=NOK and Authority
      await act(async () => {
        window.history.pushState({}, '', `/?Status=NOK&Authority=${authority}&orderId=${orderId}`);
        window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate'));
      });
      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(screen.getByText('پرداخت لغو شد')).toBeInTheDocument();
      });
      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(mocks[0].result?.data).toEqual({ cancelPendingZarinPalOrder: true });
      });
    });
    it('should call cancelPendingZarinPalOrder with authority only when orderId is NOT in sessionStorage (new tab scenario)', async () => {
      // No sessionStorage setup - simulates new browser tab
      const mocks: MockedResponse[] = [
        {
          request: {
            query: CANCEL_PENDING_ZARINPAL_ORDER_MUTATION,
            variables: { orderId: null, authority, guestToken: undefined },
          },
          result: { data: { cancelPendingZarinPalOrder: true } },
        },
      ];
      renderWithProviders(<CustomerPaymentCallback />, mocks);
      await act(async () => {
        window.history.pushState({}, '', `/?Status=NOK&Authority=${authority}`);
        window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate'));
      });
      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(screen.getByText('پرداخت لغو شد')).toBeInTheDocument();
      });
      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(mocks[0].result?.data).toEqual({ cancelPendingZarinPalOrder: true });
      });
    });
    it('should NOT clear sessionStorage if cancellation fails', async () => {
      setupOrderInSessionStorage();
      const mocks: MockedResponse[] = [
        {
          request: {
            query: CANCEL_PENDING_ZARINPAL_ORDER_MUTATION,
            variables: { orderId, authority, guestToken: undefined },
          },
          error: new Error('Network error'),
        },
      ];
      renderWithProviders(<CustomerPaymentCallback />, mocks);
      await act(async () => {
        window.history.pushState({}, '', `/?Status=NOK&Authority=${authority}&orderId=${orderId}`);
        window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate'));
      });
      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(screen.getByText('پرداخت لغو شد')).toBeInTheDocument();
      });
      // sessionStorage should still have the order data
      expect(mockSessionStorage.getItem(`order_${orderId}`)).not.toBeNull();
    });
    it('should clear sessionStorage after successful cancellation', async () => {
      setupOrderInSessionStorage();
      const mocks: MockedResponse[] = [
        {
          request: {
            query: CANCEL_PENDING_ZARINPAL_ORDER_MUTATION,
            variables: { orderId, authority, guestToken: undefined },
          },
          result: { data: { cancelPendingZarinPalOrder: true } },
        },
      ];
      renderWithProviders(<CustomerPaymentCallback />, mocks);
      await act(async () => {
        window.history.pushState({}, '', `/?Status=NOK&Authority=${authority}&orderId=${orderId}`);
        window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate'));
      });
      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(screen.getByText('پرداخت لغو شد')).toBeInTheDocument();
      });
      // Wait for mutation to complete and sessionStorage to be cleared
      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(mockSessionStorage.getItem(`order_${orderId}`)).toBeNull();
      });
    });
  });
  describe('Status=NOK without authority (edge case)', () => {
    it('should show cancelled status but not call mutation if neither authority nor orderId available', async () => {
      const mocks: MockedResponse[] = [];
      renderWithProviders(<CustomerPaymentCallback />, mocks);
      await act(async () => {
        window.history.pushState({}, '', '/?Status=NOK');
        window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate'));
      });
      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(screen.getByText('پرداخت لغو شد')).toBeInTheDocument();
      });
      // No mutation should be called
      expect(mocks.length).toBe(0);
    });
  });
  describe('Status=OK (should verify, not cancel)', () => {
    it('should NOT call cancel mutation when Status=OK', async () => {
      setupOrderInSessionStorage();
      const mocks: MockedResponse[] = [
        // verifyZarinPalPayment would be called, not cancel
        {
          request: {
            query: expect.anything(), // verify mutation
            variables: expect.objectContaining({ input: expect.objectContaining({ authority }) }),
          },
          result: { data: { verifyZarinPalPayment: { code: 100, message: 'Success', ref_id: 12345, success: true } } },
        },
      ];
      renderWithProviders(<CustomerPaymentCallback />, mocks);
      await act(async () => {
        window.history.pushState({}, '', `/?Status=OK&Authority=${authority}&orderId=${orderId}`);
        window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate'));
      });
      // Should show loading/verifying state, not cancelled
      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(screen.getByText('در حال تایید پرداخت...')).toBeInTheDocument();
      });
    });
  });
});

  const orderId2 = 'ord-2';

          },

      ];

describe('Cart Clear Behavior After Successful Payment Verification', () => {
  const authority = 'A00000123';
  const orderId = 'ord-1';
  const orderNumber = 'ORD-123456';
  const orderIds = ['ord-1', 'ord-2'];
  const amount = 50000;
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
    mockSessionStorage.clear();
    mockClearCartMutation.mockResolvedValue({});
    mockClearCartAction.mockClear();
  });
  const setupOrderInSessionStorage = () => {
    mockSessionStorage.setItem(
      `order_${orderId}`,
      JSON.stringify({ orderId, orderNumber, amount, orderIds })
    );
  };
  const triggerVerification = async (url: string) => {
    await act(async () => {
      window.history.pushState({}, '', url);
      window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate'));
    });
  };
  it('verified success (success === true) where server clearCart rejects -> local cart store clearCart still called once', async () => {
    const refId = 777888;
    const mocks: MockedResponse[] = [
      {
        request: {
          query: VERIFY_ZARINPAL_PAYMENT_MUTATION,
          variables: expect.objectContaining({
            input: expect.objectContaining({ authority, amount, order_id: orderId }),
          }),
        },
        result: {
          data: {
            verifyZarinPalPayment: {
              code: 100,
              message: 'Verified',
              ref_id: refId,
              success: true,
              orderIds,
              orderId,
              orderNumber,
            },
          },
        },
      },
    ];
    setupOrderInSessionStorage();
    // Server clearCart rejects
    mockClearCartMutation.mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('Network error'));
    renderWithProviders(<CustomerPaymentCallback />, mocks);
    await triggerVerification(`/?Status=OK&Authority=${authority}&orderId=${orderId}&orderIds=${orderIds.join(',')}`);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('پرداخت با موفقیت انجام شد')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText(`شماره تراکنش: ${refId}`)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    // Server clearCart mutation should be called once (and reject)
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockClearCartMutation).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });
    // Local clearCart action should still be called once despite server rejection
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockClearCartAction).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });
    // sessionStorage should be cleared for all orderIds
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockSessionStorage.getItem(`order_${orderIds[0]}`)).toBeNull();
      expect(mockSessionStorage.getItem(`order_${orderIds[1]}`)).toBeNull();
    });
  });
  it('success === false -> local clearCart NOT called', async () => {
    const refId = 555666;
    const serverMessage = 'Order confirmation failed';
    const mocks: MockedResponse[] = [
      {
        request: {
          query: VERIFY_ZARINPAL_PAYMENT_MUTATION,
          variables: expect.objectContaining({
            input: expect.objectContaining({ authority, amount, order_id: orderId }),
          }),
        },
        result: {
          data: {
            verifyZarinPalPayment: {
              code: 100,
              message: serverMessage,
              ref_id: refId,
              success: false,
              orderIds,
              orderId,
              orderNumber,
            },
          },
        },
      },
    ];
    setupOrderInSessionStorage();
    renderWithProviders(<CustomerPaymentCallback />, mocks);
    await triggerVerification(`/?Status=OK&Authority=${authority}&orderId=${orderId}&orderIds=${orderIds.join(',')}`);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('خطا در پرداخت')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText(serverMessage)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    // Server clearCart mutation should NOT be called
    expect(mockClearCartMutation).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    // Local clearCart action should NOT be called
    expect(mockClearCartAction).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    // sessionStorage should NOT be cleared
    expect(mockSessionStorage.getItem(`order_${orderId}`)).not.toBeNull();
    expect(mockSessionStorage.getItem(`order_${orderIds[1]}`)).not.toBeNull();
  });
});

    }),
    useWishlistSync: vi.fn(),
    getDiscountedUnitPrice: (price: number, discount: number) => {
      const basePrice = Number(price) || 0;
      const discountPercent = Number(discount) || 0;
      if (discountPercent <= 0) {
        return Number(basePrice.toFixed(2));

      const discounted = basePrice * (1 - discountPercent / 100);

    },
  };

      products: [],

      loadMore: vi.fn(),
      hasNextPage: false,
    });
    Object.defineProperty(window, 'matchMedia', {
      writable: true,
      value: vi.fn().mockImplementation((query: string) => {
        const listeners = new Set<(e: MediaQueryListEvent) => void>();
        return {
          matches: false,
          media: query,
          onchange: null,
          addListener: (cb: (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => void) =>
            listeners.add(cb),
          removeListener: (cb: (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => void) =>
            listeners.delete(cb),
          addEventListener: (
            _type: string,
            cb: (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => void
          ) => listeners.add(cb),
          removeEventListener: (
            _type: string,
            cb: (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => void
          ) => listeners.delete(cb),
          dispatchEvent: vi.fn(),
        };
      }),
    });
  });
  it('shows Lottie loading animation and hides hero and other sections when site is not loaded', () => {

        <CustomersHome mockLoading={true} />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    // Beautiful loading screen must be present
    expect(screen.getByTestId('home-loading-screen')).toBeInTheDocument();

    expect(screen.queryByText('Rise Above')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText('دسته‌بندی‌ها')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText('انتخاب‌های SAINTBALA')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    // Cleanup restores body overflow
    unmount();
    expect(document.body.style.overflow).toBe('');
  });
  it('renders all primary sections of the Campaign v4 design when loaded', () => {
    render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={['/']}>
        <CustomersHome initialData={mockHomePageData} />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    expect(screen.queryByTestId('home-loading-screen')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Rise Above')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('۱۰۰٪ اورجینال')).toBeInTheDocument();

    expect(glassCards.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    // Verify scroll buttons
    const prevBtn = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'قبلی' });
    const nextBtn = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'بعدی' });
    expect(prevBtn).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(nextBtn).toBeInTheDocument();
    // Mock scrollBy on the rail container
    const railRegion = screen.getByTestId('picks-rail');
    const scrollBySpy = vi.fn();
    railRegion.scrollBy = scrollBySpy;
    Object.defineProperty(railRegion, 'clientWidth', { value: 1000, configurable: true });
    // In RTL: prev should scroll positive (towards start/right), next should scroll negative (towards subsequent/left)
    fireEvent.click(prevBtn);
    expect(scrollBySpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({
        left: 750,
        behavior: 'smooth',
      })
    );
    fireEvent.click(nextBtn);
    expect(scrollBySpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({
        left: -750,
        behavior: 'smooth',
      })
    );
  });
  it('calls addItem with discounted unitPrice and hexCode color from PicksRailSection', () => {
    // Create a simple product with known price, discount, and color for testing
    const testProduct: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product = {

          products={[testProduct]}
          exchangeRate={270000}
          onAddItem={mockOnAddItem}
        />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    // Find the add to cart button - it's a full button (not IconButton) with specific text
    const addButtons = screen.getAllByRole('button');
    const addToCartButton = addButtons.find(
      (btn) =>
        btn.textContent?.includes('افزودن به سبد خرید') ||
        btn.textContent?.includes('Add to Cart') ||
        btn.getAttribute('aria-label')?.includes('افزودن به سبد')
    );
    expect(addToCartButton).toBeDefined();
    if (addToCartButton) {
      fireEvent.click(addToCartButton);
    }
    // Verify onAddItem was called with product and size (PicksRailSection callback signature)
    expect(mockOnAddItem).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockOnAddItem).toHaveBeenCalledWith(testProduct, 'L');

  const actual = await importOriginal();
  return {
    ...actual,
    useCustomersCartService: () => ({
      addItem: mockAddItem,
    }),
    useWishlistSync: vi.fn(),
    getDiscountedUnitPrice: (price: number, discount: number) => {
      const basePrice = Number(price) || 0;
      const discountPercent = Number(discount) || 0;
      if (discountPercent <= 0) {
        return Number(basePrice.toFixed(2));
      }
      const discounted = basePrice * (1 - discountPercent / 100);
      return Number(discounted.toFixed(2));
    },
  };
});

describe('CustomersShopScreen - cart size handling', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockUseProductsQuery.mockReturnValue({
      products: [],
      loading: false,
      loadMore: vi.fn(),
      hasNextPage: false,
    });
    Object.defineProperty(window, 'matchMedia', {
      writable: true,
      value: vi.fn().mockImplementation((query: string) => {
        const listeners = new Set<(e: MediaQueryListEvent) => void>();
        return {
          matches: false,
          media: query,
          onchange: null,
          addListener: (cb: (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => void) =>
            listeners.add(cb),
          removeListener: (cb: (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => void) =>
            listeners.delete(cb),
          addEventListener: (
            _type: string,
            cb: (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => void
          ) => listeners.add(cb),
          removeEventListener: (
            _type: string,
            cb: (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => void
          ) => listeners.delete(cb),
          dispatchEvent: vi.fn(),
        };
      }),
    });
  });
  const CART_BUTTON_LABEL = 'افزودن به سبد';
  it('T1: empty size string -> addItem called with size: null, never size: "L"', () => {
    const product = createMockProduct(1, 'SKU-1', 'Test Pants', 'men');
    product.productInfos = [
      {
        ...product.productInfos![0],
        size: '',
      },
    ];
    mockUseProductsQuery.mockReturnValue({
      products: [product],
      loading: false,
      loadMore: vi.fn(),
      hasNextPage: false,
    });
    render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={['/shop']}>
        <CustomersShopScreen />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    const buttons = screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: CART_BUTTON_LABEL });
    fireEvent.click(buttons[0]);
    expect(mockAddItem).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockAddItem).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ size: null })
    );
    expect(mockAddItem).not.toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ size: 'L' })
    );
  });
  it('T2: pants size "32x34" -> addItem called with size: "32x34"', () => {
    const product = createMockProduct(1, 'SKU-1', 'Test Pants', 'men');
    product.productInfos = [
      {
        ...product.productInfos![0],
        size: '32x34',
        sizeKind: 'PANTS',

  'sale',
  'caps',
  'bags',
  'socks',
  'jackets',

    { id: 2, slug: 'jordan', name: 'Jordan', isActive: true },
  ],
};

  (mockUseProductsQuery.mock.calls as Array<[ProductsArgs]>)
    .map(([args]) => args)
    .filter((args) => !args.onlyDiscounted)
    .at(-1);
const setDiscounted = (hasDiscounted: boolean) => {
  mockUseProductsQuery.mockImplementation((args: ProductsArgs) => ({
    products: args.onlyDiscounted && hasDiscounted ? [{ id: 1 }] : [],
    loading: false,
    loadMore: vi.fn(),
    hasNextPage: false,
  }));
};

  render(
    <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[url]}>
      <CustomersShopScreen />
    </MemoryRouter>
  );
describe('CustomersShopScreen - multi-select filters', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockQueryData.current = categoriesData;
    setDiscounted(true);
    window.matchMedia = vi.fn().mockImplementation((query: string) => ({
      matches: false,
      media: query,
      onchange: null,
      addListener: vi.fn(),
      removeListener: vi.fn(),
      addEventListener: vi.fn(),
      removeEventListener: vi.fn(),
      dispatchEvent: vi.fn(),
    }));
  });
  it('splitList and uniqueList parse comma lists, lowercased and de-duplicated', () => {
    expect(splitList('Men, t-shirts,,MEN')).toEqual(['men', 't-shirts']);
    expect(splitList('')).toEqual([]);
    expect(uniqueList(['a', '', 'a', 'b'])).toEqual(['a', 'b']);
  });
  it('sends categorySlugs when several categories are selected', () => {
    renderAt('/shop?category=men,t-shirts');
    expect(mainCall()).toEqual(
      expect.objectContaining({
        categorySlugs: ['men', 't-shirts'],
        category: undefined,
      })
    );
  });
  it('keeps the single category filter for one category', () => {
    renderAt('/shop?category=men');
    expect(mainCall()).toEqual(
      expect.objectContaining({ category: 'men', categorySlugs: undefined })
    );
  });
  it('sends brands when several brands are selected', () => {
    renderAt('/shop?brands=nike,jordan');
    expect(mainCall()).toEqual(
      expect.objectContaining({ brands: ['nike', 'jordan'], brand: undefined })
    );
  });
  it('shows every category chip, including t-shirts beyond the old 10-chip cap', () => {
    renderAt('/shop');
    expect(screen.getByText('cat-t-shirts')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('cat-shorts')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('marks every selected category chip as active', () => {
    renderAt('/shop?category=men,t-shirts');
    expect(screen.getByText('cat-men').closest('a')).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
    expect(screen.getByText('cat-t-shirts').closest('a')).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
    expect(screen.getByText('cat-women').closest('a')).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
  });
  it('toggling a chip adds or removes it from the category list in the link', () => {
    renderAt('/shop?category=men');
    const tshirtHref = screen.getByText('cat-t-shirts').closest('a')?.getAttribute('href') || '';
    expect(decodeURIComponent(tshirtHref)).toContain('category=men,t-shirts');
    const menHref = screen.getByText('cat-men').closest('a')?.getAttribute('href') || '';
    expect(menHref).not.toContain('category=');
  });
  it('hides the sale chip when no products are discounted', () => {
    setDiscounted(false);
    renderAt('/shop');
    expect(screen.queryByText('cat-sale')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('shows the sale chip when discounted products exist', () => {
    setDiscounted(true);
    renderAt('/shop');
    expect(screen.getByText('cat-sale')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('sends sizes when several sizes are selected', () => {
    renderAt('/shop?sizes=xl,3xl,4xl');
    expect(mainCall()).toEqual(
      expect.objectContaining({ sizes: ['xl', '3xl', '4xl'], size: undefined })
    );
  });
  it('keeps the single size filter for one size', () => {
    renderAt('/shop?sizes=4xl');
    expect(mainCall()).toEqual(
      expect.objectContaining({ size: '4xl', sizes: undefined })
    );
  });
  it('renders size filter with 4XL after 3XL in the dropdown', () => {
    renderAt('/shop');
    const sizeSelect = screen.getByLabelText(/سایز/i);
    expect(sizeSelect).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('selecting 4XL in size filter sends size=4xl to the products query', () => {
    renderAt('/shop?sizes=4xl');
    expect(mainCall()).toEqual(
      expect.objectContaining({ size: '4xl', sizes: undefined })
    );
  });
  it('selecting multiple sizes including 4XL sends sizes array to the products query', () => {
    renderAt('/shop?sizes=xl,3xl,4xl');
    expect(mainCall()).toEqual(
      expect.objectContaining({ sizes: ['xl', '3xl', '4xl'], size: undefined })
    );
  });
});
