import {
  createProductInfoSchema,
  createProductSchema,
  productFilterSchema,
  updateProductSchema,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from './zod-validation.pipe';
import {
  Category,
  Product,
  ProductConnection,
  SellerInfo,
  SellerProduct,
  User,
  UserRole,
  ProductDescription,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { RolesGuard, CatalogGuard } from '@kickzone-workspace/guards';
import { SizeKind } from '@kickzone-workspace/product-sizes';
import {
  CreateProductInfoInput,
  CreateProductInput,
  ProductArchivedStatus,
  ProductFilterInput,
  UpdateProductInput,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
import { ProductService, SellerService } from '@kickzone-workspace/services';
import { createConnection } from '@kickzone-workspace/utils';
import { SetMetadata, UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  Args,
  Context,
  Int,
  Mutation,
  Parent,
  Query,
  ResolveField,
  Resolver,
} from '@nestjs/graphql';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import GraphQLUpload from 'graphql-upload/GraphQLUpload.js';
import * as path from 'path';
export interface FileUpload {
  filename: string;
  mimetype: string;
  encoding: string;
  createReadStream: () => NodeJS.ReadableStream;
}
@Resolver(() => Product)
export class ProductResolver {
  constructor(
    private readonly productService: ProductService,
    private readonly sellerService: SellerService
  ) {}
  @Query(() => ProductConnection)
  async products(
    @Args('filter', { nullable: true }, new ZodValidationPipe(productFilterSchema))
    filter?: ProductFilterInput
  ): Promise<ProductConnection> {
    if (!filter) filter = { archivedStatus: ProductArchivedStatus.ACTIVE };
    if (!filter.archivedStatus)
      filter.archivedStatus = ProductArchivedStatus.ACTIVE;
    const [products, totalCount] = await this.productService.getProducts(
      filter
    );
    return createConnection(
      products,
      totalCount,
      filter?.first || 10,
      filter?.after
    );
  }
  @Query(() => [String])
  async distinctProductSizes(
    @Args('sizeKind', { type: () => SizeKind, nullable: true })
    sizeKind?: SizeKind
  ): Promise<string[]> {
    return this.productService.getDistinctProductSizes(sizeKind);
  }
  @Query(() => ProductConnection)
  async sellerProductsForMe(
    @Context() context: { req: { user: User } },
    @Args('filter', { nullable: true }, new ZodValidationPipe(productFilterSchema))
    filter?: ProductFilterInput
  ): Promise<ProductConnection> {
    const user = context.req.user;
    if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
    if (user.role !== UserRole.SELLER) throw new Error('Not a seller');
    const seller = await this.sellerService.findOneByUserId(user.id);
    if (!seller) throw new Error('Seller info not found');
    const [products, totalCount] = await this.productService.getSellerProducts(
      seller.id,
      filter
    );
    return createConnection(
      products,
      totalCount,
      filter?.first || 10,
      filter?.after
    );
  }
  @Mutation(() => Product)
  @UseGuards(CatalogGuard)
  async createProduct(
    @Args('input', new ZodValidationPipe(createProductSchema))
    input: CreateProductInput,
    @Context() context?: { req: { user?: User } }
  ): Promise<Product> {
    const product = await this.productService.createProduct(
      input,
      context?.req?.user
    );
    if (!product.productInfos) {
      product.productInfos = [];
    }
    return product;
  }
  @Mutation(() => Product)
  @UseGuards(CatalogGuard)
  async createProductInfo(
    @Args('input', new ZodValidationPipe(createProductInfoSchema))
    input: CreateProductInfoInput
  ): Promise<Product> {
    return this.productService.createProductInfo(input);
  }
  @Query(() => [Category])
  async categories(): Promise<Category[]> {
    return this.productService.getCategories();
  }
  @Mutation(() => [String])
  @UseGuards(CatalogGuard)
  async uploadProductInfoImages(
    @Args('productInfoId') productInfoId: number,
    @Args({ name: 'files', type: () => [GraphQLUpload] })
    files: Promise<FileUpload>[]
  ): Promise<string[]> {
    console.log('uploadProductInfoImages called');
    console.log('productInfoId:', productInfoId);
    console.log('files:', files);
    const uploadDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'uploads', 'products');
    if (!fs.existsSync(uploadDir)) {
      console.log('Creating upload directory:', uploadDir);
      fs.mkdirSync(uploadDir, { recursive: true });
    }
    let uploadedFiles;
    try {
      uploadedFiles = await Promise.all(files);
      console.log(
        'uploadedFiles:',
        uploadedFiles.map((f) => ({
          filename: f.filename,
          mimetype: f.mimetype,
          encoding: f.encoding,
        }))
      );
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error resolving uploaded files:', err);
      throw err;
    }
    const imageUrls: string[] = [];
    for (const file of uploadedFiles) {
      const { createReadStream, filename } = file;
      const baseName = path.basename(String(filename).replace(/\\/g, '/'));
      const sanitizedName = baseName.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9._-]/g, '_');
      const safeName = sanitizedName && !/^\.+$/.test(sanitizedName) ? sanitizedName : 'file';
      const uniqueName = `${Date.now()}-${safeName}`;
      const resolvedUploadDir = path.resolve(uploadDir);
      const filePath = path.resolve(uploadDir, uniqueName);
      if (!filePath.startsWith(resolvedUploadDir + path.sep)) {
        console.error('Path traversal attempt detected:', filename);
        throw new Error('Invalid filename');
      }
      try {
        await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
          const stream = createReadStream();
          stream
            .pipe(fs.createWriteStream(filePath))
            .on('finish', () => resolve())
            .on('error', reject);
        });
        imageUrls.push(`/uploads/products/${uniqueName}`);
        console.log('Saved file:', filePath);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error saving file:', filename, err);
        throw err;
      }
    }
    try {
      await this.productService.addImagesToProductInfo(
        productInfoId,
        imageUrls
      );
      console.log('Added image URLs to product info:', imageUrls);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error adding images to product info:', err);
      throw err;
    }
    return imageUrls;
  }
  @Mutation(() => Boolean)
  @UseGuards(CatalogGuard)
  async removeProductInfoImage(
    @Args('productInfoId') productInfoId: number,
    @Args('imageName') imageName: string
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const uploadDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'uploads', 'products');
    const safeName = path.basename(String(imageName).replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    if (!safeName || safeName === '.' || safeName === '..' || safeName !== imageName) {
      return false;
    }
    const resolvedUploadDir = path.resolve(uploadDir);
    const filePath = path.resolve(uploadDir, safeName);
    if (!filePath.startsWith(resolvedUploadDir + path.sep)) {
      return false;
    }
    try {
      // Remove the file from the filesystem
      if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
        fs.unlinkSync(filePath);
      }
      // Remove the image URL from the product info
      await this.productService.removeImageFromProductInfo(
        productInfoId,
        `/uploads/products/${safeName}`
      );
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error removing product info image:', error);
      return false;
    }
  }
  @Query(() => Product, { nullable: true })
  async product(
    @Args('id', { type: () => Int }) id: number
  ): Promise<Product | null> {
    return this.productService.getProductById(id);
  }
  @Query(() => [SellerProduct])
  @UseGuards(RolesGuard)
  @SetMetadata('roles', [UserRole.ADMIN])
  async sellerProductsByProduct(
    @Args('productId', { type: () => Int }) productId: number
  ): Promise<SellerProduct[]> {
    return this.productService.getSellerProductsByProduct(productId);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Product)
  @UseGuards(CatalogGuard)
  async archiveProduct(
    @Args('id', { type: () => Int }) id: number
  ): Promise<Product> {
    return this.productService.archiveProduct(id);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Product)
  @UseGuards(CatalogGuard)
  async unarchiveProduct(
    @Args('id', { type: () => Int }) id: number
  ): Promise<Product> {
    return this.productService.unarchiveProduct(id);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Boolean)
  @UseGuards(CatalogGuard)
  async deleteProduct(
    @Args('id', { type: () => Int }) id: number
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    return this.productService.deleteProduct(id);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Product)
  @UseGuards(CatalogGuard)
  async updateProduct(
    @Args('input', new ZodValidationPipe(updateProductSchema))
    input: UpdateProductInput,
    @Context() context?: { req: { user?: User } }
  ): Promise<Product> {
    return this.productService.updateProduct(input, context?.req?.user);
  }
  @ResolveField(() => String, { nullable: true })
  async description(
    @Parent() product: Product,
    @Context() context?: { req: { locale?: string } }
  ): Promise<string | null> {
    return this.productService.resolveProductDescription(
      product,
      context?.req?.locale || 'en'
    );
  }
  @ResolveField(() => [ProductDescription], { nullable: true })
  async descriptions(
    @Parent() product: Product
  ): Promise<ProductDescription[]> {
    if (product.descriptions) {
      return product.descriptions;
    }
    return this.productService.getProductDescriptions(product.id);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Boolean)
  async subscribeNewsletter(@Args('email') email: string): Promise<boolean> {
    return this.productService.subscribeNewsletter(email);
  }
}
@Resolver(() => SellerProduct)
export class SellerProductResolver {
  @ResolveField(() => Number, { nullable: true })
  async costPrice(
    @Parent() sellerProduct: SellerProduct,
    @Context() context: { req: { user?: User } }
  ): Promise<number | null> {
    const user = context.req.user;
    // Only expose costPrice to sellers and admins, not customers
    if (
      !user ||
      (user.role !== UserRole.SELLER && user.role !== UserRole.ADMIN)
    ) {
      return null;
    }
    return sellerProduct.costPrice;
  }
  @ResolveField(() => SellerInfo, { nullable: true })
  seller(@Parent() sellerProduct: SellerProduct) {
    return sellerProduct.seller;
  }
}

<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/seller-info.resolver.ts">
import {
  ProductConnection,
  SellerConnection,
  SellerInfo,
  SellerProduct,
  User,
  UserRole,
  ShippingPaymentMode,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { RolesGuard } from '@kickzone-workspace/guards';
import {
  CreateSellerInput,
  CreateSellerProductInput,
  ProductFilterInput,
  SellerFilterInput,
  UpdateSellerInput,
  UpdateSellerProductInput,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
import { ProductService, SellerService } from '@kickzone-workspace/services';
import { createConnection } from '@kickzone-workspace/utils';
import {
  createSellerProductSchema,
  createSellerSchema,
  cursorSchema,
  paginationFirstSchema,
  productFilterSchema,
  sellerFilterSchema,
  updateSellerProductSchema,
  updateSellerSchema,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from './zod-validation.pipe';
import { SetMetadata, UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  Args,
  Context,
  Int,
  Mutation,
  Parent,
  Query,
  ResolveField,
  Resolver,
} from '@nestjs/graphql';
@Resolver(() => SellerInfo)
export class SellerResolver {
  constructor(
    private readonly sellerService: SellerService,
    private readonly productService: ProductService
  ) {}
  @Mutation(() => SellerInfo)
  @UseGuards(RolesGuard)
  @SetMetadata('roles', [UserRole.ADMIN])
  createSeller(
    @Args('createSellerInput', new ZodValidationPipe(createSellerSchema))
    createSellerInput: CreateSellerInput
  ) {
    return this.sellerService.create(createSellerInput);
  }
  @Query(() => SellerConnection)
  @UseGuards(RolesGuard)
  @SetMetadata('roles', [UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.CUSTOMER])
  async sellers(
    @Context() context: { req: { user?: User } },
    @Args('filter', { nullable: true }, new ZodValidationPipe(sellerFilterSchema))
    filter?: SellerFilterInput,
    @Args(
      'first',
      { type: () => Int, defaultValue: 100 },
      new ZodValidationPipe(paginationFirstSchema)
    )
    first = 100,
    @Args(
      'after',
      { type: () => String, nullable: true },
      new ZodValidationPipe(cursorSchema)
    )
    after?: string
  ) {
    // For customers, only allow querying by IDs
    const user = context.req.user;
    if (user?.role === UserRole.CUSTOMER) {
      if (!filter?.ids || filter.ids.length === 0) {
        // Customers can only query by IDs
        return {
          edges: [],
          pageInfo: {
            endCursor: null,
            hasNextPage: false,
          },
          totalCount: 0,
        };
      }
    }
    const [sellers, totalCount] = await this.sellerService.findAll({
      ...filter,
      first,
      after,
    });
    // Build edges and pageInfo for SellerConnection
    const edges = sellers.map((seller) => ({
      node: seller,
      cursor: seller.id.toString(),
    }));
    const pageInfo = {
      endCursor: edges.length > 0 ? edges[edges.length - 1].cursor : null,
      hasNextPage: filter?.first ? sellers.length === filter.first : false,
    };
    return {
      edges,
      pageInfo,
      totalCount,
    };
  }
  @Query(() => SellerInfo, { nullable: true })
  @UseGuards(RolesGuard)
  @SetMetadata('roles', [UserRole.ADMIN])
  findOne(@Args('id', { type: () => Int }) id: number) {
    return this.sellerService.findOne(id);
  }
  @Query(() => SellerInfo, { nullable: true })
  @UseGuards(RolesGuard)
  @SetMetadata('roles', [UserRole.SELLER])
  async mySellerInfo(@Context() context: { req: { user: User } }) {
    const user = context.req.user;
    if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
    if (user.role !== UserRole.SELLER) throw new Error('Not a seller');
    return this.sellerService.findOneByUserId(user.id);
  }
  @Mutation(() => SellerInfo)
  @UseGuards(RolesGuard)
  @SetMetadata('roles', [UserRole.ADMIN])
  updateSeller(
    @Args('updateSellerInput', new ZodValidationPipe(updateSellerSchema))
    updateSellerInput: UpdateSellerInput
  ) {
    return this.sellerService.update(updateSellerInput);
  }
  @Mutation(() => SellerInfo)
  @UseGuards(RolesGuard)
  @SetMetadata('roles', [UserRole.ADMIN])
  toggleSellerActive(@Args('id', { type: () => Int }) id: number) {
    return this.sellerService.toggleActive(id);
  }
  @Mutation(() => SellerProduct)
  @UseGuards(RolesGuard)
  @SetMetadata('roles', [UserRole.ADMIN])
  createSellerProduct(
    @Args('sellerId', { type: () => Int }) sellerId: number,
    @Args('input', new ZodValidationPipe(createSellerProductSchema))
    input: CreateSellerProductInput
  ) {
    return this.sellerService.createSellerProduct(sellerId, input, true);
  }
  @Mutation(() => SellerProduct)
  @UseGuards(RolesGuard)
  @SetMetadata('roles', [UserRole.ADMIN])
  updateSellerProduct(
    @Args('sellerId', { type: () => Int }) sellerId: number,
    @Args('input', new ZodValidationPipe(updateSellerProductSchema))
    input: UpdateSellerProductInput
  ) {
    return this.sellerService.updateSellerProduct(sellerId, input, true);
  }
  // Seller-specific mutations for creating and updating their own products
  @Mutation(() => SellerProduct)
  @UseGuards(RolesGuard)
  @SetMetadata('roles', [UserRole.SELLER])
  async createMySellerProduct(
    @Context() context: { req: { user: User } },
    @Args('input', new ZodValidationPipe(createSellerProductSchema))
    input: CreateSellerProductInput
  ) {
    const user = context.req.user;
    if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
    if (user.role !== UserRole.SELLER) throw new Error('Not a seller');
    const seller = await this.sellerService.findOneByUserId(user.id);
    if (!seller) throw new Error('Seller info not found');
    return this.sellerService.createSellerProduct(seller.id, input, false);
  }
  @Mutation(() => SellerProduct)
  @UseGuards(RolesGuard)
  @SetMetadata('roles', [UserRole.SELLER])
  async updateMySellerProduct(
    @Context() context: { req: { user: User } },
    @Args('input', new ZodValidationPipe(updateSellerProductSchema))
    input: UpdateSellerProductInput
  ) {
    const user = context.req.user;
    if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
    if (user.role !== UserRole.SELLER) throw new Error('Not a seller');
    const seller = await this.sellerService.findOneByUserId(user.id);
    if (!seller) throw new Error('Seller info not found');
    return this.sellerService.updateSellerProduct(seller.id, input, false);
  }
  // Relay-style sellerProducts for the current seller (for sellers themselves)
  @Query(() => ProductConnection)
  async sellerProductsForMe(
    @Context() context: { req: { user: User } },
    @Args('filter', { nullable: true }, new ZodValidationPipe(productFilterSchema))
    filter?: ProductFilterInput
  ) {
    const user = context.req.user;
    if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
    if (user.role !== UserRole.SELLER) throw new Error('Not a seller');
    const seller = await this.sellerService.findOneByUserId(user.id);
    if (!seller) throw new Error('Seller info not found');
    const [products, totalCount] = await this.productService.getSellerProducts(
      seller.id,
      filter
    );
    return createConnection(
      products,
      totalCount,
      filter?.first || 10,
      filter?.after
    );
  }
  // Get a specific seller product by ID for editing
  @Query(() => SellerProduct, { nullable: true })
  @UseGuards(RolesGuard)
  @SetMetadata('roles', [UserRole.SELLER])
  async mySellerProductById(
    @Context() context: { req: { user: User } },
    @Args('id', { type: () => String }) id: string
  ) {
    const user = context.req.user;
    if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
    if (user.role !== UserRole.SELLER) throw new Error('Not a seller');
    const seller = await this.sellerService.findOneByUserId(user.id);
    if (!seller) throw new Error('Seller info not found');
    return this.sellerService.findSellerProductById(id, seller.id);
  }
  @ResolveField(() => User)
  user(@Parent() seller: SellerInfo) {
    return seller.user;
  }
  // This is the only sellerProducts ResolveField for SellerInfo
  @ResolveField(() => [SellerProduct])
  sellerProducts(@Parent() seller: SellerInfo) {
    return seller.sellerProducts;
  }
  @ResolveField(() => Number)
  shippingFee(@Parent() seller: SellerInfo) {
    return seller.shippingFee;
  }
  @ResolveField(() => ShippingPaymentMode)
  shippingPaymentMode(@Parent() seller: SellerInfo): ShippingPaymentMode {
    return seller.shippingPaymentMode ?? ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ON_DELIVERY;
  }

import { z } from 'zod';
/**
 * Catalog product rules. They mirror the former class-validator decorators on the
 * product GraphQL inputs so nothing that is accepted today is rejected.
 * (`sizeKind` is already restricted to the SizeKind enum by GraphQL.)

const requiredText = z.string().min(1);

  languageId: z.number().nullish(),
  languageCode: z.string().nullish(),
  description: requiredText,
});
export const productVariantSchema = z.object({

  sizeKind: z.string().nullish(),
  colorIds: z.array(z.number().int()),
  weight: z.number().positive('Weight must be greater than 0'),
  sku: z.string().nullish(),
  price: z.number().min(0, 'Price cannot be negative').nullish(),
  costPrice: z.number().min(0, 'Cost price cannot be negative').nullish(),
  discount: z
    .number()
    .min(0, 'Discount cannot be negative')
    .max(100, 'Discount cannot exceed 100')
    .nullish(),
  stockQuantity: z.number().int().min(0, 'Stock quantity cannot be negative').nullish(),
  boxLess: z.boolean().nullish(),
  images: z.array(z.string()).nullish(),
});

  name: requiredText,
  sku: requiredText,
  categoryIds: z.array(z.number().int()),
  brandId: z.number().int().nullish(),

  descriptions: z.array(productDescriptionSchema).nullish(),

    z.object({

import { z } from 'zod';
import { languageCodeSchema, TAXONOMY_LIMITS } from './taxonomy';
export const CURRENCY_LIMITS = {
  name: { max: 100 },
  symbol: { max: 10 },
  decimalPlaces: { min: 0, max: 8 },
  notes: { max: 1000 },
} as const;
/** Currency codes such as USD or IRR (letters only, 2-10 characters). */
export const currencyCodeSchema = z.string().trim().regex(/^[A-Za-z]{2,10}$/);
const currencyName = z.string().trim().min(1).max(CURRENCY_LIMITS.name.max);
const currencySymbol = z.string().trim().min(1).max(CURRENCY_LIMITS.symbol.max);
const decimalPlaces = z
  .number()
  .int()
  .min(CURRENCY_LIMITS.decimalPlaces.min)
  .max(CURRENCY_LIMITS.decimalPlaces.max);
const flag = z.boolean().nullish();
export const createCurrencySchema = z.object({
  code: currencyCodeSchema,
  name: currencyName,
  symbol: currencySymbol,
  decimalPlaces,
  isActive: flag,
  isBaseCurrency: flag,
});
export const updateCurrencySchema = z.object({
  code: currencyCodeSchema.nullish(),
  name: currencyName.nullish(),
  symbol: currencySymbol.nullish(),
  decimalPlaces: decimalPlaces.nullish(),
  isActive: flag,
  isBaseCurrency: flag,
});
export const setExchangeRateSchema = z.object({
  fromCurrencyCode: currencyCodeSchema,
  toCurrencyCode: currencyCodeSchema,
  rate: z.number().positive().finite(),
  effectiveDate: z.coerce.date().nullish(),
  notes: z.string().max(CURRENCY_LIMITS.notes.max).nullish(),
});
/** Admin exchange-rate form (rate typed as text). */
export const exchangeRateFormSchema = z.object({
  rate: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(1)
    .refine((v) => Number.isFinite(Number(v)) && Number(v) > 0),
  notes: z.string().max(CURRENCY_LIMITS.notes.max).optional(),
});
export const TRANSLATION_LIMITS = {
  entityType: { max: 50 },
  fieldName: { max: 100 },
  value: { max: 20000 },
} as const;
const entityType = z.string().trim().min(1).max(TRANSLATION_LIMITS.entityType.max);

  entityType,
  entityId: z.number().int().positive(),
  locale: languageCodeSchema,
  fieldName: z.string().trim().min(1).max(TRANSLATION_LIMITS.fieldName.max),
  /** May be empty: a blank value clears a translation. */
  value: z.string().max(TRANSLATION_LIMITS.value.max),
  isAutoTranslated: flag,
  translatedBy: z.number().int().nullish(),
});

  targetLocales: z.array(languageCodeSchema),

import { z } from 'zod';
import { idSchema, positiveIntSchema, trackingNumberSchema } from './primitives';
import { emailSchema } from './auth';
import { CART_LIMITS, cartQuantitySchema } from './cart';
/**
 * Shipping / order limits. They mirror the existing customer checkout form rules
 * so the server never rejects what the storefront already accepts.
 */
export const ORDER_LIMITS = {
  name: { min: 2, max: 100 },
  phone: { pattern: /^[+]?[\d\s\-()]{7,15}$/ },
  address: { min: 3, max: 200 },
  city: { min: 2, max: 100 },
  state: { min: 2, max: 100 },
  zipCode: { min: 3, max: 20, pattern: /^[a-zA-Z0-9\s-]+$/ },
  country: { min: 2, max: 100 },
  notes: { max: 2000 },
  productName: { max: 300 },
  productImage: { max: 2048 },
  items: { min: 1, max: 100 },
} as const;
export const ORDER_STATUSES = [
  'PENDING',
  'CONFIRMED',
  'PROCESSING',
  'SHIPPED',
  'DELIVERED',
  'CANCELLED',
  'REFUNDED',
] as const;
export const SHIPPING_METHODS = ['vip', 'express', 'pickup'] as const;
export const shippingMethodSchema = z.enum(SHIPPING_METHODS);
const lettersPattern = /^[\p{L}\s'-]+$/u;
export const shippingNameSchema = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .min(ORDER_LIMITS.name.min)
  .max(ORDER_LIMITS.name.max)
  .regex(lettersPattern);
export const shippingPhoneSchema = z.string().trim().regex(ORDER_LIMITS.phone.pattern);
/** Email is optional at checkout: empty string or a valid address. */
export const optionalEmailSchema = z.union([z.literal(''), emailSchema]);
export const shippingAddressSchema = z.object({
  customerName: shippingNameSchema,
  customerEmail: optionalEmailSchema,
  customerPhone: shippingPhoneSchema,
  shippingAddress: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(ORDER_LIMITS.address.min)
    .max(ORDER_LIMITS.address.max),
  city: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(ORDER_LIMITS.city.min)
    .max(ORDER_LIMITS.city.max)
    .regex(lettersPattern),
  state: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(ORDER_LIMITS.state.min)
    .max(ORDER_LIMITS.state.max)
    .regex(lettersPattern),
  zipCode: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(ORDER_LIMITS.zipCode.min)
    .max(ORDER_LIMITS.zipCode.max)
    .regex(ORDER_LIMITS.zipCode.pattern),
  country: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(ORDER_LIMITS.country.min)
    .max(ORDER_LIMITS.country.max),
});
const moneySchema = z.number().finite().min(0);
export const orderItemSchema = z.object({
  productId: idSchema,
  sellerProductId: idSchema.nullish(),
  productName: z.string().trim().min(1).max(ORDER_LIMITS.productName.max),
  productImage: z.string().max(ORDER_LIMITS.productImage.max).nullish(),
  quantity: cartQuantitySchema,
  unitPrice: moneySchema,
  totalPrice: moneySchema,
  color: z.string().trim().max(CART_LIMITS.color.max).nullish(),
  size: z.string().trim().max(CART_LIMITS.size.max).nullish(),
});
export const createOrderSchema = shippingAddressSchema.extend({
  sellerId: positiveIntSchema,
  items: z
    .array(orderItemSchema)
    .min(ORDER_LIMITS.items.min)
    .max(ORDER_LIMITS.items.max),
  notes: z.string().max(ORDER_LIMITS.notes.max).nullish(),
  shippingMethod: shippingMethodSchema.nullish(),
  shippingCost: moneySchema.nullish(),
});
export const updateOrderItemSchema = orderItemSchema.extend({
  id: idSchema.nullish(),
});
/** Admin order edit: every field optional; items are kept so the resolver can still reject them. */
export const updateOrderSchema = z.object({
  customerName: shippingNameSchema.nullish(),
  customerEmail: optionalEmailSchema.nullish(),
  customerPhone: shippingPhoneSchema.nullish(),
  shippingAddress: shippingAddressSchema.shape.shippingAddress.nullish(),
  city: shippingAddressSchema.shape.city.nullish(),
  state: shippingAddressSchema.shape.state.nullish(),
  zipCode: shippingAddressSchema.shape.zipCode.nullish(),
  country: shippingAddressSchema.shape.country.nullish(),
  items: z.array(updateOrderItemSchema).nullish(),
  notes: z.string().max(ORDER_LIMITS.notes.max).nullish(),
  trackingNumber: trackingNumberSchema.nullish(),
});
export const updateOrderStatusSchema = z.object({
  id: idSchema,
  status: z.enum(ORDER_STATUSES),
});
export type ShippingAddressInput = z.input<typeof shippingAddressSchema>;
export type ShippingAddressData = z.output<typeof shippingAddressSchema>;
export type OrderItemData = z.output<typeof orderItemSchema>;
export type CreateOrderData = z.output<typeof createOrderSchema>;
export type UpdateOrderData = z.output<typeof updateOrderSchema>;
export type UpdateOrderStatusData = z.output<typeof updateOrderStatusSchema>;
export type UpdateOrderStatusInput = z.input<typeof updateOrderStatusSchema>;
export type OrderStatusValue = (typeof ORDER_STATUSES)[number];

function normalizeSort(sortParam: string): string {
  if (sortParam === 'price_desc') return 'price_desc';
  if (sortParam === 'price_asc') return 'price_asc';
  // Accept legacy/home-page links like ?sort=new
  return 'newest';
}
function toProductsSort(selectedSort: string): {
  sort: string;
  sortOrder: 'asc' | 'desc';
} {
  if (selectedSort === 'price_asc') {
    return { sort: 'PRICE_ASC', sortOrder: 'asc' };
  }
  if (selectedSort === 'price_desc') {
    return { sort: 'PRICE_DESC', sortOrder: 'desc' };
  }
  return { sort: 'ID_DESC', sortOrder: 'desc' };
}
export function splitList(value: string): string[] {
  return uniqueList(
    value
      .split(',')
      .map((v) => v.trim().toLowerCase())
      .filter(Boolean)
  );
}
export function uniqueList(values: string[]): string[] {
  return Array.from(new Set(values.filter(Boolean)));
}
export function CustomersShopScreen() {
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  const { isRTL, currentLocale } = useLanguageContext();
  const isEn = currentLocale === 'en';
  usePageTitle(
    useCallback(
      () => (isEn ? 'Shop & Catalog' : 'فروشگاه و محصولات'),
      [isEn]
    )
  );
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const { brandSlug: brandSlugParam } = useParams<{ brandSlug?: string }>();
  const categoryParam = searchParams.get('category') || '';
  const brandFromQuery = searchParams.get('brand') || '';
  const brandParam = (brandSlugParam || brandFromQuery || '').toLowerCase();
  const brandsFromQuery = searchParams.get('brands') || '';
  const sizesFromQuery = searchParams.get('sizes') || '';
  const selectedCategories = useMemo(
    () => splitList(categoryParam),
    [categoryParam]
  );
  const selectedBrands = useMemo(
    () => uniqueList([brandParam, ...splitList(brandsFromQuery)]),
    [brandParam, brandsFromQuery]
  );
  const selectedSizes = useMemo(
    () => splitList(sizesFromQuery),
    [sizesFromQuery]
  );
  const sortParam = searchParams.get('sort') || '';
  const searchParam = searchParams.get('search') || '';
  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState(searchParam);
  const [debouncedSearch, setDebouncedSearch] = useState(searchParam);
  const [selectedSort, setSelectedSort] = useState(normalizeSort(sortParam));
  // Redirect legacy ?brand= to /brands/:slug while preserving other params
  useEffect(() => {
    if (brandSlugParam || !brandFromQuery) return;
    const next = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);
    next.delete('brand');
    const qs = next.toString();
    navigate(
      `${getCustomerBrandRoute(brandFromQuery)}${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`,
      { replace: true }
    );
  }, [brandSlugParam, brandFromQuery, searchParams, navigate]);
  useEffect(() => {
    setSearchInput(searchParam);
    setDebouncedSearch(searchParam);
  }, [searchParam]);
  useEffect(() => {

  }, [sortParam]);
  const { data: categoriesData } = useQuery<{ categories: HomeCategory[] }>(

  const categories = categoriesData?.categories;
  const { data: brandsData } = useQuery<
    { brands: ShopBrand[] },
    { onlyWithProducts: boolean }
  >(SHOP_BRANDS_QUERY, {
    variables: { onlyWithProducts: true },
    fetchPolicy: 'cache-first',
  });
  const brands = useMemo(
    () => (brandsData?.brands || []).filter((b) => b.isActive !== false),
    [brandsData?.brands]
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setDebouncedSearch(searchInput);
    }, 400);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [searchInput]);
  const buildShopUrl = useCallback(
    (state: {
      search: string;
      sort: string;
      categories: string[];
      brands: string[];
      sizes?: string[];
    }) => {
      const next = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);
      ['search', 'sort', 'category', 'brand', 'brands', 'sizes'].forEach((key) =>
        next.delete(key)
      );
      if (state.search) next.set('search', state.search);
      if (state.sort && state.sort !== 'newest') next.set('sort', state.sort);
      if (state.categories.length > 0)
        next.set('category', state.categories.join(','));
      // A single brand keeps its SEO-friendly /brands/:slug route.
      if (state.brands.length > 1) next.set('brands', state.brands.join(','));
      if (state.sizes && state.sizes.length > 0)
        next.set('sizes', state.sizes.join(','));
      const base =
        state.brands.length === 1
          ? getCustomerBrandRoute(state.brands[0])
          : CUSTOMER_ROUTES.SHOP;
      const qs = next.toString();
      return `${base}${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`;
    },
    [searchParams]
  );
  const syncUrl = useCallback(
    (patch: {
      search?: string;
      sort?: string;
      categories?: string[];
      brands?: string[];
      sizes?: string[];
    }) => {
      navigate(
        buildShopUrl({
          search: patch.search !== undefined ? patch.search : debouncedSearch,
          sort: patch.sort !== undefined ? patch.sort : selectedSort,
          categories: patch.categories ?? selectedCategories,
          brands: patch.brands ?? selectedBrands,
          sizes: patch.sizes ?? selectedSizes,
        }),
        { replace: true }
      );
    },
    [
      buildShopUrl,
      debouncedSearch,
      selectedSort,
      selectedCategories,
      selectedBrands,
      selectedSizes,
      navigate,
    ]
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    const currentSearch = searchParams.get('search') || '';
    const currentSort = normalizeSort(searchParams.get('sort') || '');
    if (currentSearch === debouncedSearch && currentSort === selectedSort) {
      return;
    }
    syncUrl({ search: debouncedSearch, sort: selectedSort });
  }, [debouncedSearch, selectedSort, searchParams, syncUrl]);
  const productsSort = toProductsSort(selectedSort);
  const { products, loading, loadMore, hasNextPage } = useProductsQuery({
    search: debouncedSearch,
    // One value keeps the original single filters; two or more use the multi-select arrays.
    category:
      selectedCategories.length === 1 ? selectedCategories[0] : undefined,
    categorySlugs:
      selectedCategories.length > 1 ? selectedCategories : undefined,
    brand: selectedBrands.length === 1 ? selectedBrands[0] : undefined,
    brands: selectedBrands.length > 1 ? selectedBrands : undefined,
    size: selectedSizes.length === 1 ? selectedSizes[0] : undefined,
    sizes: selectedSizes.length > 1 ? selectedSizes : undefined,
    sort: productsSort.sort,
    sortOrder: productsSort.sortOrder,
    pageSize: 16,
    onlyWithSellers: true,
    onlyInStock: true,
  });
  // Lightweight probe: is any in-stock product discounted? Drives the "sale" chip.
  const { products: discountedProbe } = useProductsQuery({
    search: '',
    pageSize: 1,
    onlyWithSellers: true,
    onlyInStock: true,
    onlyDiscounted: true,
  });
  const hasDiscountedProducts = discountedProbe.length > 0;
  const { addItem } = useCustomersCartService();
  const [isLoadingMore, setIsLoadingMore] = useState(false);
  const loaderRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const handleLoadMore = useCallback(async () => {
    if (isLoadingMore || !hasNextPage) return;
    setIsLoadingMore(true);
    try {
      await loadMore();
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingMore(false);
    }
  }, [isLoadingMore, hasNextPage, loadMore]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hasNextPage) return;
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        if (entries[0].isIntersecting) {
          handleLoadMore();
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.1 }
    );
    if (loaderRef.current) observer.observe(loaderRef.current);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [hasNextPage, handleLoadMore]);
  const categoryLabel = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedCategories.length === 0) return '';
    const fallbackMap: Record<string, string> = {
      women: LL.home.categories.women(),
      men: LL.home.categories.men(),
      hoodies: LL.home.categories.hoodies(),
      pants: LL.home.categories.pants(),
    };
    return selectedCategories
      .map((slug) =>
        resolveCategoryLabel(
          slug,
          categories,
          fallbackMap[slug.toLowerCase()] || slug
        )
      )
      .join(isEn ? ', ' : '، ');
  }, [selectedCategories, categories, LL, isEn]);
  const brandLabel = useMemo(
    () =>
      selectedBrands
        .map(
          (slug) =>
            brands.find((b) => b.slug.toLowerCase() === slug)?.name || slug
        )
        .join(isEn ? ', ' : '، '),
    [selectedBrands, brands, isEn]
  );
  const heading = selectedCategories.length > 0
    ? LL.shop.productsInCategory({ category: categoryLabel })
    : selectedBrands.length > 0
    ? LL.shop.productsByBrand({ brand: brandLabel })
    : LL.shop.allProducts();
  const hasActiveFilters = Boolean(
    selectedCategories.length > 0 ||
      selectedBrands.length > 0 ||
      debouncedSearch ||
      selectedSort !== 'newest'
  );
  const clearFilters = () => {
    setSearchInput('');
    setDebouncedSearch('');
    setSelectedSort('newest');
    navigate(CUSTOMER_ROUTES.SHOP, { replace: true });
  };
  const categoryChips = useMemo(() => {
    const preferred = [
      'women',
      'men',
      't-shirts',
      'hoodies',
      'pants',
      'sneakers',
      'sale',
    ];
    const bySlug = new Map(
      (categories || []).map((c) => [c.slug.toLowerCase(), c])
    );
    const ordered: HomeCategory[] = [];
    for (const slug of preferred) {
      const hit = bySlug.get(slug);
      if (hit) ordered.push(hit);
    }
    for (const c of categories || []) {
      if (!preferred.includes(c.slug.toLowerCase())) ordered.push(c);
    }
    // Hide the sale chip when nothing is discounted (unless it is already selected).
    return ordered.filter(
      (c) =>
        c.slug.toLowerCase() !== 'sale' ||
        hasDiscountedProducts ||
        selectedCategories.includes('sale')
    );
  }, [categories, hasDiscountedProducts, selectedCategories]);
  return (
    <CustomersLayout>
      <Container
        maxWidth="lg"
        sx={{
          pt: { xs: 1, md: 1.5 },
          pb: { xs: 4, md: 6 },
          fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
        }}
      >
        <Typography
          component="h1"
          sx={{
            fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
            fontSize: { xs: '22px', md: '28px' },
            fontWeight: 800,
            color: 'var(--ink)',
            mb: 2.5,
          }}
        >
          {heading}
        </Typography>
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: { xs: 'column', md: 'row' },
            gap: 2,
            mb: 2.5,
            alignItems: { xs: 'stretch', md: 'center' },
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
          }}
        >
          <TextField
            value={searchInput}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchInput(e.target.value)}
            placeholder={LL.shop.searchPlaceholder()}
            variant="outlined"
            size="small"
            sx={{
              width: { xs: '100%', md: 320 },
              ...filterControlSx,
            }}
            InputProps={{
              startAdornment: (
                <InputAdornment position="start">
                  <SearchIcon sx={{ color: 'var(--ink-3)', fontSize: 20 }} />
                </InputAdornment>
              ),
              endAdornment: searchInput ? (
                <InputAdornment position="end">
                  <ClearIcon
                    sx={{
                      color: 'var(--ink-3)',
                      fontSize: 18,
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                    }}
                    onClick={() => setSearchInput('')}
                  />
                </InputAdornment>
              ) : undefined,
            }}
          />
          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
              gap: 2,
              width: { xs: '100%', md: 'auto' },
            }}
          >
            <FormControl
              size="small"
              sx={{
                minWidth: 160,
                width: { xs: '100%', sm: 180 },
                ...filterControlSx,
              }}
            >
              <InputLabel id="shop-brand-label">
                {LL.shop.brandLabel()}
              </InputLabel>
              <Select
                labelId="shop-brand-label"
                multiple
                value={selectedBrands}
                label={LL.shop.brandLabel()}
                renderValue={() => brandLabel || LL.shop.allBrands()}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const value = e.target.value;
                  const picked =
                    typeof value === 'string' ? splitList(value) : value;
                  syncUrl({
                    brands: picked.includes('')
                      ? []
                      : uniqueList(picked.map((v) => v.toLowerCase())),
                  });
                }}
                MenuProps={{
                  PaperProps: {
                    sx: {
                      bgcolor: 'var(--paper)',
                      color: 'var(--ink)',
                      border: '1px solid var(--hair)',
                    },
                  },
                }}
              >
                <MenuItem value="">{LL.shop.allBrands()}</MenuItem>
                {brands.map((b) => (
                  <MenuItem key={b.id} value={b.slug.toLowerCase()}>
                    {b.name}
                  </MenuItem>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </FormControl>
            <FormControl
              size="small"
              sx={{
                minWidth: 160,
                width: { xs: '100%', sm: 180 },
                ...filterControlSx,
              }}
            >
              <InputLabel id="shop-sort-label">
                {LL.shop.sortLabel()}
              </InputLabel>
              <Select
                labelId="shop-sort-label"
                value={selectedSort}
                label={LL.shop.sortLabel()}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedSort(e.target.value)}
                MenuProps={{
                  PaperProps: {
                    sx: {
                      bgcolor: 'var(--paper)',
                      color: 'var(--ink)',
                      border: '1px solid var(--hair)',
                    },
                  },
                }}
              >
                <MenuItem value="newest">{LL.shop.newest()}</MenuItem>
                <MenuItem value="price_asc">{LL.shop.cheapest()}</MenuItem>
                <MenuItem value="price_desc">
                  {LL.shop.mostExpensive()}
                </MenuItem>
              </Select>
            </FormControl>
            <FormControl
              size="small"
              sx={{
                minWidth: 160,

                {LL.shop.sizeLabel()}

              <Select

                multiple
                value={selectedSizes}
                label={LL.shop.sizeLabel()}
                renderValue={(selected) =>
                  selected.length === 0
                    ? LL.shop.allSizes()
                    : selected.join(', ')
                }
                onChange={(e) => {

                  const picked =
                    typeof value === 'string' ? splitList(value) : value;
                  syncUrl({
                    sizes: picked.includes('')
                      ? []
                      : uniqueList(picked.map((v) => v.toLowerCase())),

                }}
                MenuProps={{
                  PaperProps: {

                      bgcolor: 'var(--paper)',
                      color: 'var(--ink)',
                      border: '1px solid var(--hair)',

                <MenuItem value="">{LL.shop.allSizes()}</MenuItem>

                  <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">

                {APPAREL_SIZES.map((size) => (

                {FOOTWEAR_EU_SIZES.map((size) => (
                  <MenuItem key={size} value={size}>
                    EU {size}
                  </MenuItem>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </FormControl>
          </Box>
        </Box>
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',
            flexWrap: 'wrap',
            gap: 1,
            mb: 4,

            flexDirection: isRTL ? 'row-reverse' : 'row',

          <Chip

            to={buildShopUrl({

              sort: selectedSort,

              brands: selectedBrands,

              fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
              bgcolor: selectedCategories.length === 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : 'transparent',
              color: selectedCategories.length === 0 ? '#fff' : 'var(--ink-2)',
              borderColor: 'var(--hair)',

                bgcolor: selectedCategories.length === 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--paper)',

          {categoryChips.map((cat) => {

              ? selectedCategories.filter((c) => c !== slug)
              : [...selectedCategories, slug];
            return (
              <Chip
                key={cat.id}
                label={cat.name}
                clickable
                component={RouterLink}
                to={buildShopUrl({
                  search: debouncedSearch,
                  sort: selectedSort,
                  categories: nextCategories,
                  brands: selectedBrands,
                })}
                aria-pressed={active}
                variant={active ? 'filled' : 'outlined'}
                sx={{
                  fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
                  bgcolor: active ? 'var(--accent)' : 'transparent',
                  color: active ? '#fff' : 'var(--ink-2)',
                  borderColor: 'var(--hair)',
                  '&:hover': {
                    bgcolor: active ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--paper)',
                  },
                }}
              />
            );
          })}
          {hasActiveFilters && (
            <Button
              size="small"
              onClick={clearFilters}
              startIcon={<ClearIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
              sx={{
                ml: { xs: 0, sm: 1 },
                color: 'var(--ink-2)',
                fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
                textTransform: 'none',
              }}
            >
              {LL.shop.clearFilters()}
            </Button>
          )}
        </Box>
        {loading && products.length === 0 ? (
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', py: 12 }}>
            <CircularProgress sx={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }} />
          </Box>
        ) : products.length === 0 ? (
          <Box sx={{ textAlign: 'center', py: 12 }}>
            <Typography
              sx={{
                color: 'var(--ink-3)',
                fontSize: '16px',
                fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
              }}
            >
              {LL.shop.noProducts()}
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        ) : (
          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: {
                xs: 'repeat(2, 1fr)',
                sm: 'repeat(2, 1fr)',
                md: 'repeat(3, 1fr)',
                lg: 'repeat(4, 1fr)',
              },
              gap: { xs: '16px', md: '24px' },
            }}
          >
            {products.map((product: KickzoneGraphqlTypes.Product) => (
              <CustomersProductCard
                key={product.id}
                product={product}
                variant="compact"
                onAddToCart={(p) => {
                  const sp =
                    p.sellerProducts?.find((s) => (s.stockQuantity || 0) > 0) ||
                    p.sellerProducts?.[0];
                  if (!sp) return;
                  const pInfo = p.productInfos?.[0];
                  addItem({
                    productId: String(p.id),
                    productName: p.name,
                    productImage: pInfo?.images?.[0] || null,
                    quantity: 1,
                    unitPrice: getDiscountedUnitPrice(sp.price, sp.discount),
                    color: pInfo?.colors?.[0]?.hexCode || pInfo?.colors?.[0]?.name || null,
                    size: pInfo?.size || null,
                    sellerId: String(sp.seller?.id || 1),
                    sellerName: '',
                    sellerShippingFee: sp.seller?.shippingFee || 0,
                    productInfoId: pInfo ? String(pInfo.id) : '',
                    sellerProductId: String(sp.id),
                    availableStock: sp.stockQuantity || 1,
                  });
                }}
              />
            ))}
          </Box>
        )}
        {hasNextPage && (
          <Box
            ref={loaderRef}
            data-testid="products-scroll-loader"
            sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', py: 6 }}
          >
            {isLoadingMore && (
              <CircularProgress size={28} sx={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }} />
            )}
          </Box>
        )}
      </Container>
    </CustomersLayout>
  );
}
export default CustomersShopScreen;

// Extract brand name from product name
function extractBrand(productName: string, fallback = 'Nike'): string {
  const normalized = (productName || '').trim();
  const brands = [
    'Nike',
    'Jordan',
    'Adidas',
    'Puma',
    'New Balance',
    'Under Armour',
    'Reebok',
    'Asics',
    'Converse',
    'Vans',
  ];
  for (const b of brands) {
    if (new RegExp(`^${b}\\b`, 'i').test(normalized)) {
      return b;
    }
  }
  const firstWord = normalized.split(/\s+/)[0];
  if (firstWord && /^[A-Za-z]+$/.test(firstWord)) {
    return firstWord.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + firstWord.slice(1).toLowerCase();
  }
  return fallback;
}
// Compute soft ambient tint RGB for glow background matching product variant color
function getProductAmbientTint(
  colors?: Array<{ hexCode: string; name?: string }> | null
): string {
  if (colors && colors.length > 0) {
    const firstHex = (colors[0].hexCode || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const firstName = (colors[0].name || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    // Olive / Green / Khaki
    if (
      firstHex.includes('556b2f') ||
      firstHex.includes('4b5320') ||
      firstHex.includes('6b8e23') ||
      firstName.includes('زیتون') ||
      firstName.includes('olive') ||
      firstName.includes('green') ||
      firstName.includes('سبز')
    ) {
      return '95, 135, 90';
    }
    // Black / Dark Slate -> soft violet/indigo glow
    if (
      firstHex === '#000000' ||
      firstHex === '#000' ||
      firstHex === '#111' ||
      firstHex === '#111111' ||
      firstName.includes('مشکی') ||
      firstName.includes('black') ||
      firstName.includes('تیره')
    ) {
      return '138, 128, 205';
    }
    // White / Off-white -> cool ice blue
    if (
      firstHex === '#ffffff' ||
      firstHex === '#fff' ||
      firstName.includes('سفید') ||
      firstName.includes('white')
    ) {
      return '170, 205, 240';
    }
    // Teal / Mint / Cyan
    if (
      firstName.includes('teal') ||
      firstName.includes('mint') ||
      firstName.includes('فیروزه') ||
      firstName.includes('سبز روشن')
    ) {
      return '80, 190, 175';
    }
    // Rose / Peach / Plum / Camo
    if (
      firstName.includes('rose') ||
      firstName.includes('pink') ||
      firstName.includes('صورتی') ||
      firstName.includes('camo') ||
      firstName.includes('چریک')
    ) {
      return '215, 135, 160';
    }
    if (firstHex.startsWith('#') && firstHex.length >= 7) {
      const r = parseInt(firstHex.slice(1, 3), 16);
      const g = parseInt(firstHex.slice(3, 5), 16);
      const b = parseInt(firstHex.slice(5, 7), 16);
      if (!isNaN(r) && !isNaN(g) && !isNaN(b)) {
        return `${r}, ${g}, ${b}`;
      }
    }
  }
  return '168, 152, 112'; // Quiet luxury champagne brass tint
}
// Convert numbers or strings containing numbers to Persian digits
export const toFarsiDigits = (val: string | number): string => {
  const farsiDigits = ['۰', '۱', '۲', '۳', '۴', '۵', '۶', '۷', '۸', '۹'];
  return String(val).replace(/\d/g, (d) => farsiDigits[parseInt(d, 10)]);
};
export function CustomerProductDetails() {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const parsedId = id ? parseInt(id, 10) : NaN;
  const productId = !isNaN(parsedId) && parsedId > 0 ? parsedId : undefined;
  const { LL } = useI18nContext();
  const { currentLocale, formatNumber } = useLanguageContext();
  const isRTL = currentLocale === 'fa';
  const themeMode = useUIStore((s) => s.theme.mode);
  const isDark = themeMode === 'dark';
  const { product, loading, error, refetch } = useProductById(productId);
  const { addItem } = useCustomersCartService();
  useEffect(() => {
    if (error) {
      console.error('[CustomerProductDetails] Error fetching product:', error);
    }
  }, [error]);
  // Selected State
  const [selectedColorwayKey, setSelectedColorwayKey] = useState<string | null>(
    null
  );
  const [selectedSize, setSelectedSize] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [activeImageIndex, setActiveImageIndex] = useState(0);
  const [isFavorite, setIsFavorite] = useState(false);
  const [isAddedRecently, setIsAddedRecently] = useState(false);
  const [snackbarOpen, setSnackbarOpen] = useState(false);
  const [expandedAccordion, setExpandedAccordion] = useState<string | false>(
    'description'
  );
  // Reviews State
  const [reviews, setReviews] = useState<ProductReview[]>(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !productId) return [];
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(`saintbala_reviews_${productId}`);
      if (stored !== null) {
        return JSON.parse(stored) as ProductReview[];
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return DEFAULT_PRODUCT_REVIEWS[productId] || [];
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!productId) return;
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(`saintbala_reviews_${productId}`);
      if (stored !== null) {
        setReviews(JSON.parse(stored) as ProductReview[]);
        return;
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    setReviews(DEFAULT_PRODUCT_REVIEWS[productId] || []);
  }, [productId]);
  const [reviewModalOpen, setReviewModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [newRating, setNewRating] = useState<number>(5);
  const [newAuthor, setNewAuthor] = useState('');
  const [newTitle, setNewTitle] = useState('');
  const [newComment, setNewComment] = useState('');
  const [newFitFeedback, setNewFitFeedback] = useState<
    'runs_small' | 'true_to_size' | 'runs_large'
  >('true_to_size');
  const [newSizePurchased, setNewSizePurchased] = useState(selectedSize || 'M');
  const [reviewSuccessSnackbar, setReviewSuccessSnackbar] = useState(false);
  const [helpfulVotes, setHelpfulVotes] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedSize) {
      setNewSizePurchased(selectedSize);
    }
  }, [selectedSize]);
  const reviewSummary = useMemo(() => {
    if (!reviews || reviews.length === 0) {
      return {
        average: 0,
        total: 0,
        breakdown: { 5: 0, 4: 0, 3: 0, 2: 0, 1: 0 } as Record<number, number>,
        trueToSizePercentage: 100,
      };
    }
    const total = reviews.length;
    const sum = reviews.reduce((acc, r) => acc + r.rating, 0);
    const average = +(sum / total).toFixed(1);
    const breakdown: Record<number, number> = { 5: 0, 4: 0, 3: 0, 2: 0, 1: 0 };
    let trueToSizeCount = 0;
    reviews.forEach((r) => {
      const star = Math.min(5, Math.max(1, Math.round(r.rating)));
      breakdown[star] = (breakdown[star] || 0) + 1;
      if (r.fitFeedback === 'true_to_size') {
        trueToSizeCount += 1;
      }
    });
    const trueToSizePercentage = Math.round((trueToSizeCount / total) * 100);
    return { average, total, breakdown, trueToSizePercentage };
  }, [reviews]);
  const handleSubmitReview = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newAuthor.trim() || !newComment.trim() || newRating < 1) return;
    const newReviewItem: ProductReview = {
      id: `rev-${Date.now()}`,
      author: newAuthor.trim(),
      verified: true,
      rating: newRating,
      title:
        newTitle.trim() ||
        (isRTL ? 'دیدگاه تأیید شده' : 'Verified Collector Review'),
      comment: newComment.trim(),
      date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      sizePurchased: newSizePurchased || selectedSize || undefined,
      fitFeedback: newFitFeedback,
      helpfulCount: 0,
    };
    const updated = [newReviewItem, ...reviews];
    setReviews(updated);
    if (productId) {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(
          `saintbala_reviews_${productId}`,
          JSON.stringify(updated)
        );
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
    }
    setReviewModalOpen(false);
    setNewAuthor('');
    setNewTitle('');
    setNewComment('');
    setNewRating(5);
    setReviewSuccessSnackbar(true);
  };
  const handleToggleHelpful = (reviewId: string) => {
    if (helpfulVotes[reviewId]) return;
    setHelpfulVotes((prev) => ({ ...prev, [reviewId]: true }));
    setReviews((prev) =>
      prev.map((r) =>
        r.id === reviewId ? { ...r, helpfulCount: r.helpfulCount + 1 } : r
      )
    );
  };
  // Image Zoom & Lightbox State
  const [isHoverZoom, setIsHoverZoom] = useState(false);
  const [zoomCoord, setZoomCoord] = useState({ x: 50, y: 50 });
  const [lightboxOpen, setLightboxOpen] = useState(false);
  const [lightboxZoom, setLightboxZoom] = useState(1);
  const [lightboxPan, setLightboxPan] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [isLightboxDragging, setIsLightboxDragging] = useState(false);
  const dragStartRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0, panX: 0, panY: 0 });
  const addedTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    document.body.classList.add('pdp-screen-active');
    return () => {
      document.body.classList.remove('pdp-screen-active');
      if (addedTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(addedTimerRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, []);
  // Update page title
  usePageTitle(() => product?.name || LL.navigation.products());
  // Extract brand & category
  const brand = useMemo(() => {
    return product ? extractBrand(product.name) : 'Nike';
  }, [product]);
  const primaryCategory = useMemo(() => {
    return product?.categories?.[0] || null;
  }, [product]);
  // Query similar products in the same category or general catalog
  const { products: similarCatalogProducts } = useProductsQuery({
    search: '',
    categoryId: primaryCategory?.id,
    pageSize: 6,
    onlyWithSellers: true,
    onlyInStock: true,
  });
  const similarProducts = useMemo(() => {
    return similarCatalogProducts
      .filter((p) => p.id !== productId && p.sellerProducts && p.productInfos)
      .slice(0, 4);
  }, [similarCatalogProducts, productId]);
  // Available variants with at least one in-stock seller
  const availableVariants = useMemo(() => {
    if (!product?.productInfos || !product?.sellerProducts) {
      return [];
    }
    return product.productInfos
      .map((productInfo) => {
        const matchingSellers =
          product.sellerProducts?.filter(
            (sp) =>
              (sp.productInfoId === productInfo.id ||
                sp.productInfo?.id === productInfo.id) &&
              sp.seller &&
              sp.stockQuantity > 0
          ) || [];
        if (matchingSellers.length === 0) {
          return null;
        }
        const sorted = [...matchingSellers].sort((a, b) => {
          const priceA =
            a.discount > 0 ? a.price - (a.price * a.discount) / 100 : a.price;
          const priceB =
            b.discount > 0 ? b.price - (b.price * b.discount) / 100 : b.price;
          if (priceA !== priceB) {
            return priceA - priceB;
          }
          return (b.stockQuantity || 0) - (a.stockQuantity || 0);
        });
        const bestSellerProduct = sorted[0];
        const finalPrice =
          bestSellerProduct.discount > 0
            ? bestSellerProduct.price -
              (bestSellerProduct.price * bestSellerProduct.discount) / 100
            : bestSellerProduct.price;
        return {
          productInfo,
          sellerProduct: bestSellerProduct,
          originalPrice: bestSellerProduct.price,
          finalPrice,
          discount: bestSellerProduct.discount || 0,
          stockQuantity: bestSellerProduct.stockQuantity || 0,
        };
      })
      .filter((v): v is NonNullable<typeof v> => v !== null);
  }, [product]);
  // Group variants by unique colorways
  const availableColorways = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<
      string,
      {
        key: string;
        colors: Array<{ id?: number; hexCode: string; name?: string }>;
        name: string;
        variants: typeof availableVariants;
      }
    >();
    const sourceVariants =
      availableVariants.length > 0
        ? availableVariants
        : (product?.productInfos || []).map((pi) => ({
            productInfo: pi,
            sellerProduct: (product?.sellerProducts || [])[0],
            originalPrice: 0,
            finalPrice: 0,
            discount: 0,
            stockQuantity: 0,
          }));
    sourceVariants.forEach((v) => {
      const colors = v.productInfo.colors || [];
      if (colors.length === 0) return;
      const key =
        colors
          .map((c) => (c.hexCode || '').toLowerCase().trim())
          .sort()
          .join(',') || `single-${v.productInfo.id}`;
      const existing = map.get(key);
      if (!existing) {
        map.set(key, {
          key,
          colors,
          name: formatVariantColorNames(colors),
          variants: [v],
        });
      } else {
        existing.variants.push(v);
      }
    });
    return Array.from(map.values());
  }, [availableVariants, product?.productInfos, product?.sellerProducts]);
  // Sync selected colorway
  useEffect(() => {
    if (availableColorways.length > 0) {
      if (
        !selectedColorwayKey ||
        !availableColorways.some((c) => c.key === selectedColorwayKey)
      ) {
        setSelectedColorwayKey(availableColorways[0].key);
      }
    } else {
      setSelectedColorwayKey(null);
    }
  }, [availableColorways, selectedColorwayKey]);
  // Active colorway
  const activeColorway = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedColorwayKey) return availableColorways[0] || null;
    return (
      availableColorways.find((c) => c.key === selectedColorwayKey) ||
      availableColorways[0] ||
      null
    );
  }, [availableColorways, selectedColorwayKey]);
  // Variants matching selected colorway
  const activeColorwayVariants = useMemo(() => {
    if (availableColorways.length === 0) {
      return availableVariants;
    }
    const match = availableColorways.find((c) => c.key === selectedColorwayKey);
    return match ? match.variants : availableVariants;
  }, [availableColorways, selectedColorwayKey, availableVariants]);
  // Available in-stock sizes for active colorway
  const availableSizes = useMemo(() => {
    const sizeSet = new Set<string>();
    activeColorwayVariants.forEach((v) => {
      if (v.productInfo.size && v.stockQuantity > 0) {
        sizeSet.add(v.productInfo.size);
      }
    });
    const rawSizes = Array.from(sizeSet);
    if (rawSizes.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }
    const firstKind = activeColorwayVariants[0]?.productInfo.sizeKind;
    const kind = isPantsSizeKind(firstKind)
      ? SizeKind.Pants
      : isFootwearSizeKind(firstKind)
        ? SizeKind.Footwear
        : SizeKind.Apparel;
    return sortSizeCodes(kind, rawSizes);
  }, [activeColorwayVariants]);
  // Determine if the active product is pants to format size labels accordingly
  const isPantsProduct = isPantsSizeKind(
    activeColorwayVariants[0]?.productInfo.sizeKind
  );
  const displaySize = (size: string): string =>
    isPantsProduct ? formatSizeLabel(SizeKind.Pants, size) || size : size;
  // Default selected size
  useEffect(() => {
    if (availableSizes.length > 0) {
      if (!selectedSize || !availableSizes.includes(selectedSize)) {
        setSelectedSize(availableSizes[0]);
      }
    } else {
      setSelectedSize(null);
    }
  }, [availableSizes, selectedSize]);
  // Active variant based on size & colorway
  const activeVariant = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeColorwayVariants.length === 0) {
      return availableVariants[0] || null;
    }
    if (selectedSize) {
      const match = activeColorwayVariants.find(
        (v) => v.productInfo.size === selectedSize
      );
      if (match) return match;
    }
    return activeColorwayVariants[0] || null;
  }, [activeColorwayVariants, selectedSize, availableVariants]);
  // Extract gallery images for active colorway
  const galleryImages = useMemo(() => {
    const imgs: string[] = [];
    // Primary: images from active colorway variants
    activeColorwayVariants.forEach((v) => {
      (v.productInfo.images || []).forEach((img) => {
        if (img && !imgs.includes(img)) {
          imgs.push(img);
        }
      });
    });
    // Secondary fallback: all product images
    if (imgs.length === 0 && product?.productInfos) {
      product.productInfos.forEach((pi) => {
        (pi.images || []).forEach((img) => {
          if (img && !imgs.includes(img)) {
            imgs.push(img);
          }
        });
      });
    }
    if (imgs.length === 0) {
      return [PRODUCT_IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER];
    }
    return imgs.map((img) => resolveProductImageUrl(img));
  }, [activeColorwayVariants, product?.productInfos]);
  // Reset active image index when colorway changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setActiveImageIndex(0);
  }, [selectedColorwayKey]);
  const activeMainImage =
    galleryImages[activeImageIndex] ||
    galleryImages[0] ||
    PRODUCT_IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER;
  const ambientRgb = useMemo(() => {
    return getProductAmbientTint(activeColorway?.colors);
  }, [activeColorway]);
  // Preferred brand from product.brand.name falling back to extractBrand(name) per spec §10
  const displayBrand = useMemo(() => {
    return product?.brand?.name ?? brand;
  }, [product?.brand?.name, brand]);
  // Description binding order per spec §10:
  // descriptions.find(d => d.language.code === currentLocale)?.description -> product.description -> fallback template
  // TODO(content): fallback description is generic (see spec §10)
  const localizedDescription = useMemo(() => {
    if (!product) return '';
    const match = product.descriptions?.find(
      (d) => d.language?.code === currentLocale
    )?.description;
    if (match) return match;
    if (product.description) return product.description;
    return isRTL
      ? `شلوار زنانه ${product.name} با طرح استایل فیل‌چاپ در رنگ ${
          activeColorway?.name || 'زیتونی'
        } — الهام‌گرفته از میراث شیکاگو جردن. برش راحت و آزاد با کمر کشی و بند تنظیم‌شونده در مچ، مناسب استایل روزمره و استریت.\n\nپارچه ریپ‌استاپ سبک و مقاوم در برابر پارگی، با جیب‌های کارگو کاربردی روی ران. این مدل اورجینال نایکی/جردن است و از تأمین‌کننده معتبر سنت‌بالا عرضه می‌شود.`
      : `${product.name} delivers athletic style, relaxed comfort, and durable ripstop fabric. Engineered with adjustable waistband and cargo pockets for effortless everyday streetstyle.`;
  }, [product, currentLocale, isRTL, activeColorway]);
  // Stock and Pricing calculations
  const pricingInfo = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeVariant) {
      return {
        originalPrice: activeVariant.originalPrice,
        finalPrice: activeVariant.finalPrice,
        discount: activeVariant.discount,
        stockQuantity: activeVariant.stockQuantity,
      };
    }
    const firstSellerProduct = product?.sellerProducts?.[0];
    if (firstSellerProduct) {
      const originalPrice = firstSellerProduct.price;
      const discount = firstSellerProduct.discount || 0;
      const finalPrice =
        discount > 0
          ? originalPrice - (originalPrice * discount) / 100
          : originalPrice;
      return {
        originalPrice,
        finalPrice,
        discount,
        stockQuantity: firstSellerProduct.stockQuantity || 0,
      };
    }
    return null;
  }, [activeVariant, product]);
  const isOutOfStock = pricingInfo == null || pricingInfo.stockQuantity === 0;
  // Add to cart handler
  const handleAddToCart = useCallback(() => {
    if (!product || !activeVariant) {
      return;
    }
    const { productInfo, sellerProduct, finalPrice } = activeVariant;
    const seller = sellerProduct.seller;
    if (!seller) {
      return;
    }
    addItem({
      productId: product.id.toString(),
      productName: product.name,
      productImage: productInfo.images?.[0] || null,
      quantity: 1,
      unitPrice: finalPrice,
      color: serializeVariantColorHexes(productInfo.colors),
      size: productInfo.size || null,
      sellerId: seller.id.toString(),
      sellerName: seller.storeName || '',
      sellerShippingFee: seller.shippingFee || 0,
      sellerShippingPaymentMode:
        (seller as { shippingPaymentMode?: 'PAY_ON_DELIVERY' | 'PAY_ONLINE' })?.shippingPaymentMode ||
        'PAY_ON_DELIVERY',
      productInfoId: productInfo.id.toString(),
      sellerProductId: sellerProduct.id.toString(),
      availableStock: sellerProduct.stockQuantity,
    });
    setIsAddedRecently(true);
    setSnackbarOpen(true);
    if (addedTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(addedTimerRef.current);
    }
    addedTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setIsAddedRecently(false);
    }, 2400);
  }, [product, activeVariant, addItem]);
  const handleResetLightbox = useCallback(() => {
    setLightboxZoom(1);
    setLightboxPan({ x: 0, y: 0 });
    setIsLightboxDragging(false);
  }, []);
  const handlePrevImage = useCallback(() => {
    setActiveImageIndex((prev) =>
      prev === 0 ? galleryImages.length - 1 : prev - 1
    );
    handleResetLightbox();
  }, [galleryImages.length, handleResetLightbox]);
  const handleNextImage = useCallback(() => {
    setActiveImageIndex((prev) =>
      prev === galleryImages.length - 1 ? 0 : prev + 1
    );
    handleResetLightbox();
  }, [galleryImages.length, handleResetLightbox]);
  const handleLightboxMouseDown = useCallback(
    (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
      if (lightboxZoom <= 1) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      setIsLightboxDragging(true);
      dragStartRef.current = {
        x: e.clientX,
        y: e.clientY,
        panX: lightboxPan.x,
        panY: lightboxPan.y,
      };
    },
    [lightboxZoom, lightboxPan]
  );
  const handleLightboxMouseMove = useCallback(
    (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
      if (!isLightboxDragging || lightboxZoom <= 1) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const dx = e.clientX - dragStartRef.current.x;
      const dy = e.clientY - dragStartRef.current.y;
      setLightboxPan({
        x: dragStartRef.current.panX + dx,
        y: dragStartRef.current.panY + dy,
      });
    },
    [isLightboxDragging, lightboxZoom]
  );
  const handleLightboxMouseUp = useCallback(() => {
    setIsLightboxDragging(false);
  }, []);
  const handleLightboxTouchStart = useCallback(
    (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
      if (lightboxZoom <= 1 || e.touches.length !== 1) return;
      const touch = e.touches[0];
      setIsLightboxDragging(true);
      dragStartRef.current = {
        x: touch.clientX,
        y: touch.clientY,
        panX: lightboxPan.x,
        panY: lightboxPan.y,
      };
    },
    [lightboxZoom, lightboxPan]
  );
  const handleLightboxTouchMove = useCallback(
    (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
      if (!isLightboxDragging || lightboxZoom <= 1 || e.touches.length !== 1) return;
      const touch = e.touches[0];
      const dx = touch.clientX - dragStartRef.current.x;
      const dy = touch.clientY - dragStartRef.current.y;
      setLightboxPan({
        x: dragStartRef.current.panX + dx,
        y: dragStartRef.current.panY + dy,
      });
    },
    [isLightboxDragging, lightboxZoom]
  );
  const handleLightboxTouchEnd = useCallback(() => {
    setIsLightboxDragging(false);
  }, []);
  // Loading Skeleton State
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <CustomersLayout disablePadding={true}>
        <Box
          className="pdp-lg"
          data-mode={themeMode}
          dir={isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}
          sx={{
            minHeight: '100vh',
            fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'var(--lg-font)',
            pt: { xs: '54px', sm: '60px', md: '64px' },
          }}
        >
          <Container maxWidth="xl" sx={{ py: { xs: 3, md: 5 }, maxWidth: 1376 }}>
            <Box sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
              <Skeleton
                variant="text"
                width={240}
                height={28}
                sx={{ bgcolor: 'var(--lg-pill-bg)' }}
              />
            </Box>
            <Grid container spacing={{ xs: 2.5, md: 4 }}>
              <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6, lg: 7 }}>
                <Box
                  className="lg-card"
                  sx={{
                    borderRadius: '32px',
                    p: { xs: '6px', sm: '12px' },
                  }}
                >
                  <Skeleton
                    variant="rectangular"
                    sx={{
                      borderRadius: { xs: '26px', sm: '24px' },
                      aspectRatio: { xs: '4 / 3.8', sm: '1 / 1' },
                      height: 'auto',
                      bgcolor: 'var(--lg-photo-well)',
                    }}
                  />
                </Box>
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 2, mt: 2, justifyContent: 'center' }}>
                  <Skeleton variant="rounded" width={72} height={72} sx={{ borderRadius: '16px', bgcolor: 'var(--lg-pill-bg)' }} />
                  <Skeleton variant="rounded" width={72} height={72} sx={{ borderRadius: '16px', bgcolor: 'var(--lg-pill-bg)' }} />
                  <Skeleton variant="rounded" width={72} height={72} sx={{ borderRadius: '16px', bgcolor: 'var(--lg-pill-bg)' }} />
                </Box>
              </Grid>
              <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6, lg: 5 }}>
                <Box
                  className="lg-card"
                  sx={{
                    borderRadius: '32px',
                    p: { xs: 2.5, md: 4 },
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    gap: 2.5,
                  }}
                >
                  <Skeleton variant="rounded" width={100} height={28} sx={{ borderRadius: '9999px', bgcolor: 'var(--lg-pill-bg)' }} />
                  <Skeleton variant="text" width="80%" height={40} sx={{ bgcolor: 'var(--lg-pill-bg)' }} />
                  <Skeleton variant="text" width="40%" height={24} sx={{ bgcolor: 'var(--lg-pill-bg)' }} />
                  <Skeleton variant="text" width="30%" height={36} sx={{ bgcolor: 'var(--lg-pill-bg)' }} />
                  <Skeleton variant="rounded" width="100%" height={48} sx={{ borderRadius: '9999px', bgcolor: 'var(--lg-pill-bg)' }} />
                  <Skeleton variant="rounded" width="100%" height={48} sx={{ borderRadius: '9999px', bgcolor: 'var(--lg-pill-bg)' }} />
                </Box>
              </Grid>
            </Grid>
          </Container>
        </Box>
      </CustomersLayout>
    );
  }
  // Not Found State
  if (error || !product) {
    return (
      <CustomersLayout disablePadding={true}>
        <Box
          className="pdp-lg"
          data-mode={themeMode}
          dir={isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}
          sx={{
            minHeight: '100vh',
            fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'var(--lg-font)',
            pt: { xs: '54px', sm: '60px', md: '64px' },
          }}
        >
          <Container
            maxWidth="sm"
            dir={isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}
            sx={{
              py: 12,
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              alignItems: 'center',
              textAlign: 'center',
            }}
          >
            <Box
              className="lg-card"
              sx={{
                p: 4,
                borderRadius: '32px',
                width: '100%',
                color: 'var(--lg-ink)',
              }}
            >
              <Typography variant="h5" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, mb: 1.5, color: 'var(--lg-ink)' }}>
                {isRTL ? 'محصول مورد نظر یافت نشد' : 'Product Not Found'}
              </Typography>
              <Typography
                variant="body2"
                sx={{ mb: 3, lineHeight: 1.8, color: 'var(--lg-ink-4)' }}
              >
                {isRTL
                  ? 'ممکن است این محصول حذف شده یا آدرس وارد شده نادرست باشد.'
                  : 'The requested product might have been moved or is no longer available.'}
              </Typography>
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 2, justifyContent: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                {error && (
                  <Button
                    onClick={() => refetch()}
                    className="lg-pill"
                    sx={{
                      borderRadius: '9999px',
                      px: 3.5,
                      py: 1.2,
                      fontWeight: 600,
                      color: 'var(--lg-ink)',
                    }}
                  >
                    {isRTL ? 'تلاش مجدد' : 'Retry'}
                  </Button>
                )}
                <Button
                  component={RouterLink}
                  to={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.HOME}
                  sx={{
                    borderRadius: '9999px',
                    px: 3.5,
                    py: 1.2,
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    background: 'var(--lg-solid-bg)',
                    color: 'var(--lg-solid-ink)',
                    '&:hover': {
                      background: 'var(--lg-solid-bg-hover)',
                    },
                  }}
                >
                  {isRTL ? 'بازگشت به فروشگاه' : 'Return to Shop'}
                </Button>
              </Box>
            </Box>
          </Container>
        </Box>
      </CustomersLayout>
    );
  }
  return (
    <CustomersLayout disablePadding={true}>
      <Box
        className="pdp-lg"
        data-mode={themeMode}
        dir={isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}
        sx={{
          minHeight: '100vh',

              height: { xs: 320, md: 540 },

          <Box
            className="lg-ambient-orb lg-orb-cyan"
            sx={{
              position: 'absolute',
              top: { xs: '240px', md: '120px' },
              right: isRTL ? { xs: 'auto', md: '50%' } : { xs: '-10%', md: '2%' },
              left: isRTL ? { xs: '-10%', md: '2%' } : { xs: 'auto', md: '50%' },
              width: { xs: 300, md: 500 },
              height: { xs: 300, md: 500 },
              borderRadius: '50%',
              background: 'radial-gradient(circle, #1d4ed8 0%, #0284c7 48%, transparent 75%)',

          <Box
            className="lg-ambient-orb lg-orb-gold"
            sx={{
              position: 'absolute',
              top: '50px',
              left: '50%',
              marginLeft: { xs: '-130px', md: '-210px' },
              width: { xs: 260, md: 420 },
              height: { xs: 260, md: 420 },
              borderRadius: '50%',
              background: 'radial-gradient(circle, #d4af37 0%, transparent 68%)',
              opacity: isDark ? 0.06 : 0.035,
              filter: 'blur(100px)',
            }}
          />
          {/* Deep Royal Indigo and Twilight Plum (#170d2b) behind recommendations & trust cards */}

            sx={{
              position: 'absolute',
              bottom: '10%',
              left: { xs: '5%', md: '18%' },
              width: { xs: 360, md: 600 },
              height: { xs: 360, md: 600 },
              borderRadius: '50%',
              background: 'radial-gradient(circle, #170d2b 0%, #2e1065 52%, transparent 75%)',

            }}
          />
        </Box>
        <Box
          component="main"
          id="main"
          sx={{
            maxWidth: 1376,
            mx: 'auto',
            px: { xs: 2, sm: 3, md: 4 },
            pt: { xs: 1.5, md: 2.5 },

            zIndex: 1,
          }}
        >
          {/* Breadcrumb Navigation */}
          <Box
            component="nav"
            aria-label="breadcrumb"
            sx={{
              pt: { xs: 1.25, md: 2 },
              pb: { xs: 1.25, md: 2.5 },
              overflowX: 'auto',
              '&::-webkit-scrollbar': { display: 'none' },
              msOverflowStyle: 'none',
              scrollbarWidth: 'none',
            }}
          >
            <Breadcrumbs
              separator={
                <Typography
                  sx={{
                    color: 'var(--lg-ink-5)',
