                    {/* Overlay Arrows (only if galleryImages.length > 1) */}
                    {galleryImages.length > 1 && (
                      <>
                        <IconButton
                          className="lg-icon"
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            isRTL ? handleNextImage() : handlePrevImage();
                          }}
                          aria-label={isRTL ? 'تصویر بعدی' : 'previous image'}
                          sx={{
                            position: 'absolute',
                            top: '50%',
                            transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                            insetInlineStart: { xs: 10, sm: 16 },

                {/* Thumbnails Row */}
                {galleryImages.length > 1 && (

            </Grid>
            {/* COLUMN 2: Product Information Card (In RTL, this renders on the left!) */}
            <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6, lg: 5 }}>
              <Box

                  {product.sku && (

                                p: 0,
                                display: 'flex',
                                alignItems: 'center',
                                justifyContent: 'center',
                                cursor: 'pointer',
                                background: 'transparent',
                                border: 'none',
                                boxShadow: isSelected
                                  ? '0 0 0 2px var(--lg-ring-offset), 0 0 0 4px var(--lg-ring)'

                                transform: isSelected ? 'scale(1.05)' : 'scale(1)',
                                transition: 'all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)',
                                '&:hover': {
                                  transform: 'scale(1.1)',
                                },
                              }}
                            >
                              <Box
                                sx={{
                                  width: '100%',
                                  height: '100%',
                                  borderRadius: '50%',
                                  background: discBg,
                                  border: '1px solid var(--lg-card-border)',
                                }}
                              />
                            </Box>
                          </Tooltip>
                        );
                      })}
                    </Box>
                  </Box>
                )}
                {/* Size Selector Section */}
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 1.25 }}>
                  <Box
                    sx={{
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    }}
                  >
                    <Typography
                      sx={{
                        fontSize: '0.875rem',
                        fontWeight: 600,
                        color: 'var(--lg-ink)',

                              fontSize: '0.875rem',
                              border: isSelected ? 'none' : undefined,
                              background: isSelected ? 'var(--lg-solid-bg)' : undefined,
                              color: isSelected ? 'var(--lg-solid-ink)' : 'var(--lg-ink)',

                      isAddedRecently ? (

                        : 'var(--lg-solid-ink) !important',

                      ? isRTL
                        ? 'ناموجود'
                        : 'Out of Stock'
                      : isRTL
                      ? 'افزودن به سبد خرید'
                      : 'Add to Cart'}

                </Box>
                {/* Accordions Section */}
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 1.25, pt: 1 }}>
                  {/* 1. Description Accordion */}
                  <Accordion
                    expanded={expandedAccordion === 'description'}

                      setExpandedAccordion(isExpanded ? 'description' : false)

                          color: 'var(--lg-muted)',
                          whiteSpace: 'pre-line',

                        {localizedDescription}
                      </Typography>
                    </AccordionDetails>
                  </Accordion>
                  {/* 2. Details & Materials Accordion */}
                  <Accordion

                    elevation={0}
                    sx={{
                      borderRadius: '16px !important',

                        ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)'

                      '&::before': { display: 'none' },

                    </AccordionSummary>
                    <AccordionDetails sx={{ px: 2.5, pb: 2.5, pt: 0 }}>
                      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 1 }}>
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'var(--lg-muted)', fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}>
                            {isRTL ? 'برند:' : 'Brand:'}
                          </Typography>

                          </Typography>
                        </Box>
                        {product.sku && (
                          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                            <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'var(--lg-muted)', fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}>
                              {isRTL ? 'کد اختصاصی (SKU):' : 'SKU:'}

                            <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--lg-ink)', fontSize: '0.8125rem', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                              {product.sku}
                            </Typography>
                          </Box>
                        )}
                        {/* TODO(content): Schema currently does not provide fabric composition; using fallback string per spec */}
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'var(--lg-muted)', fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}>
                            {isRTL ? 'جنس پارچه:' : 'Material:'}
                          </Typography>
                          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--lg-ink)', fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}>
                            {isRTL
                              ? '۱۰۰٪ کتان ریپ‌استاپ تنفس‌پذیر'
                              : '100% Breathable Ripstop Cotton'}
                          </Typography>
                        </Box>
                        {/* TODO(content): Schema currently does not provide care instructions; using fallback string per spec */}
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'var(--lg-muted)', fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}>
                            {isRTL ? 'نحوه شستشو:' : 'Care:'}
                          </Typography>
                          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--lg-ink)', fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}>
                            {isRTL
                              ? 'شستشو با ماشین در دمای ۳۰ درجه'
                              : 'Machine wash cold (30°C)'}
                          </Typography>
                        </Box>
                      </Box>
                    </AccordionDetails>
                  </Accordion>
                </Box>
              </Box>
            </Grid>
          </Grid>
          {/* Value Propositions Highlight Bar */}
          <Box sx={{ mt: { xs: 5, md: 7 }, mb: { xs: 6, md: 8 } }}>
            <Grid container spacing={{ xs: 2, sm: 2.5, md: 3 }}>
              {/* Feature 1: Authenticity */}
              <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
                <Box
                  className="lg-card"
                  data-testid="authentic-guarantee-card"
                  dir={isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}
                  sx={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: 2,
                    p: { xs: 2.5, sm: 3 },
                    borderRadius: { xs: '20px', md: '28px' },
                    textAlign: 'start',
                    flexDirection: 'row',
                  }}
                >
                  <Box
                    className="lg-pill"
                    sx={{
                      width: 48,
                      height: 48,
                      borderRadius: '16px',
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'center',
                      color: 'var(--lg-ink)',
                      flexShrink: 0,
                    }}
                  >
                    <GppGoodOutlined sx={{ fontSize: 24 }} />
                  </Box>
                  <Box sx={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                    <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.9375rem', mb: 0.25, color: 'var(--lg-ink)' }}>

                      variant="body2"
                      sx={{ color: 'var(--lg-muted)', fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}
                    >
                      {isRTL ? '۱۰۰٪ اورجینال نایک و جردن' : '100% Genuine Nike & Jordan'}
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>
                </Box>
              </Grid>
            </Grid>
          </Box>
          {/* Customer Reviews Section */}
          {REVIEWS_ENABLED && (
          <Box
            data-testid="customer-reviews-section"
            sx={{
              mt: { xs: 7, md: 9 },
              pt: { xs: 5, md: 6 },
              borderTop: '1px solid var(--lg-card-border)',

          >
            {/* Header with Title and "Write a Review" button if reviews exist */}
            <Box
              dir={isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}

                alignItems: { xs: 'flex-start', sm: 'center' },

                flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },

              <Box>
                <Typography
                  variant="h5"

                  variant="body2"
                  sx={{

                  {isRTL ? (
                    <>
                      نظرات مستند و معتبر خریداران دارای برچسب اصالت{' '}
                      <bdi>SAINTBALA</bdi>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    'Verified collector feedback on silhouette, fabric drape, and authentic craftsmanship.'
                  )}
                </Typography>
              </Box>
              {reviews.length > 0 && (
                <Button
                  variant="contained"

                    borderRadius: '9999px',
                    px: 3,
                    py: 1,

                    color: isDark ? '#000000' : '#ffffff',
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    fontSize: '0.8125rem',
                    textTransform: 'none',
                    letterSpacing: '0.04em',
                    boxShadow: 'none',
                    fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',
                    '&:hover': {
                      background: isDark
                        ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88)'
                        : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.88)',
                      boxShadow: 'none',
                    },
                  }}
                >
                  {isRTL ? 'ثبت دیدگاه' : 'Write a Review'}
                </Button>
              )}
            </Box>
            {reviews.length === 0 ? (
              /* High-Trust Empty State */
              <Box
                data-testid="reviews-empty-state"
                dir={isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}

                  textAlign: 'center',

                  background: isDark
                    ? 'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01) 100%)'

              >
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    width: 60,
                    height: 60,
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    mx: 'auto',
                    mb: 2.5,
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    background: isDark
                      ? 'rgba(201, 167, 116, 0.12)'
                      : 'rgba(201, 167, 116, 0.15)',
                    color: '#c9a774',
                  }}
                >
                  <RateReviewOutlined sx={{ fontSize: 30 }} />
                </Box>
                <Typography
                  variant="h6"
                  sx={{
                    fontWeight: 800,
                    color: 'var(--lg-ink)',
                    mb: 1,
                    fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',

                  {isRTL
                    ? 'اولین نفری باشید که نظر خود را درباره این اثر ثبت می‌کند'

                <Typography
                  sx={{
                    color: 'var(--lg-muted)',
                    maxWidth: 500,
                    mx: 'auto',
                    mb: 3,
                    fontSize: '0.9375rem',
                    lineHeight: 1.7,
                    fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',
                  }}
                >
                  {isRTL ? (
                    <>
                      تجربه ارزشمند خود را در مورد قواره، کیفیت متریال و ایستایی لباس با سایر خریداران{' '}
                      <bdi>SAINTBALA</bdi> به اشتراک بگذارید.

                  variant="contained"

                    borderRadius: '9999px',
                    px: 3.5,
                    py: 1.2,
                    background: isDark ? '#ffffff' : '#000000',
                    color: isDark ? '#000000' : '#ffffff',
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    fontSize: '0.875rem',
                    textTransform: 'none',
                    letterSpacing: '0.04em',
                    fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',
                    '&:hover': {
                      background: isDark
                        ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88)'
                        : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.88)',
                    },
                  }}
                >
                  {isRTL ? 'ثبت دیدگاه' : 'Write a Review'}
                </Button>

                <Box
                  dir={isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}
                  sx={{
                    p: { xs: 3, md: 4 },
                    borderRadius: '24px',
                    background: 'var(--lg-card-bg)',
                    border: '1px solid var(--lg-card-border)',

                  <Grid container spacing={4} alignItems="center">
                    {/* Overall Score */}
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 4 }}>
                      <Box sx={{ textAlign: { xs: 'center', md: isRTL ? 'right' : 'left' } }}>
                        <Typography
                          sx={{
                            fontSize: { xs: '2.5rem', sm: '3rem' },
                            fontWeight: 900,
                            lineHeight: 1,
                            color: 'var(--lg-ink)',
                            fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',

                            ? toFarsiDigits(reviewSummary.average.toFixed(1))

                              fontSize: '1.25rem',
                              fontWeight: 500,
                              color: 'var(--lg-muted)',
                              ml: 0.5,

                          variant="body2"
                          sx={{
                            color: 'var(--lg-muted)',
                            fontSize: '0.8125rem',
                            fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',

                          {isRTL
                            ? `بر اساس ${toFarsiDigits(reviewSummary.total)} دیدگاه تأیید شده`

                            alignItems: 'center',

                            borderRadius: '9999px',
                            background: isDark
                              ? 'rgba(201, 167, 116, 0.1)'
                              : 'rgba(201, 167, 116, 0.15)',
                            border: '1px solid rgba(201, 167, 116, 0.25)',

                          <CheckCircleOutline sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: '#c9a774' }} />

                              fontSize: '0.75rem',

                              color: '#c9a774',
                              fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',

                          const count = reviewSummary.breakdown[star] || 0;
                          const pct =

                              ? Math.round((count / reviewSummary.total) * 100)
                              : 0;
                          return (
                            <Box
                              key={star}
                              sx={{
                                display: 'flex',

                                gap: 1.5,
                                fontSize: '0.8125rem',

                                sx={{
                                  display: 'flex',
                                  alignItems: 'center',
                                  gap: 0.4,
                                  width: 48,
                                  flexShrink: 0,

                              >
                                <Typography
                                  sx={{

                                    color: 'var(--lg-ink)',
                                    fontSize: '0.8125rem',
                                    fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',

                                <Star sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: '#c9a774' }} />
                              </Box>

                                variant="determinate"

                                sx={{
                                  flex: 1,
                                  height: 6,
                                  borderRadius: 3,
                                  backgroundColor: isDark
                                    ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)'
                                    : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)',
                                  '& .MuiLinearProgress-bar': {
                                    backgroundColor: '#c9a774',
                                    borderRadius: 3,
                                  },
                                }}
                              />
                              <Typography
                                sx={{
                                  width: 40,
                                  textAlign: isRTL ? 'left' : 'right',
                                  fontWeight: 600,
                                  color: 'var(--lg-muted)',
                                  fontSize: '0.75rem',
                                  fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',
                                }}
                              >
                                {isRTL ? `${toFarsiDigits(pct)}٪` : `${pct}%`}
                              </Typography>
                            </Box>
                          );
                        })}
                      </Box>
                    </Grid>
                  </Grid>
                </Box>
                {/* Individual Review Cards */}
                <Grid container spacing={2.5}>
                  {reviews.map((rev) => (
                    <Grid key={rev.id} size={{ xs: 12 }}>
                      <Box
                        data-testid={`review-card-${rev.id}`}
                        dir={isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}
                        sx={{
                          p: { xs: 2.5, sm: 3.5 },
                          borderRadius: '20px',
                          background: 'var(--lg-card-bg)',
                          border: '1px solid var(--lg-card-border)',
                          backdropFilter: 'blur(12px)',
                          transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
                          '&:hover': {
                            borderColor: isDark
                              ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)'
                              : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12)',
                          },
                        }}
                      >
                        {/* Top row: Rating, Author, Verified badge, Date */}
                        <Box
                          sx={{
                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: { xs: 'flex-start', sm: 'center' },
                            justifyContent: 'space-between',
                            flexDirection: { xs: 'column', sm: 'row' },
                            gap: 1.5,
                            mb: 2,
                          }}
                        >
                          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                            <Rating
                              value={rev.rating}
                              readOnly
                              size="small"
                              sx={{
                                color: '#c9a774',
                                '& .MuiRating-iconEmpty': {
                                  color: isDark
                                    ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)'
                                    : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)',
                                },
                              }}
                            />
                            <Typography
                              sx={{
                                fontWeight: 700,
                                color: 'var(--lg-ink)',
                                fontSize: '0.9375rem',
                                fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',
                              }}
                            >
                              {rev.author}
                            </Typography>
                            {rev.verified && (
                              <Box
                                sx={{
                                  display: 'inline-flex',
                                  alignItems: 'center',
                                  gap: 0.5,
                                  px: 1,
                                  py: 0.25,
                                  borderRadius: '9999px',
                                  background: isDark
                                    ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)'
                                    : 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1)',
                                  color: '#10b981',
                                }}
                              >
                                <VerifiedOutlined sx={{ fontSize: 13 }} />
                                <Typography
                                  sx={{
                                    fontSize: '0.6875rem',
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',
                                  }}
                                >
                                  {isRTL ? 'خریدار تأیید شده' : 'Verified Buyer'}
                                </Typography>
                              </Box>
                            )}
                          </Box>
                          <Typography
                            variant="caption"
                            sx={{
                              color: 'var(--lg-muted)',
                              fontSize: '0.75rem',
                              fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',
                            }}
                          >
                            {isRTL ? toFarsiDigits(rev.date) : rev.date}
                          </Typography>
                        </Box>
                        {/* Middle: Size & Fit Info */}
                        {(rev.sizePurchased || rev.fitFeedback) && (
                          <Box
                            sx={{
                              display: 'flex',
                              alignItems: 'center',
                              gap: 1.5,
                              mb: 1.5,
                            }}
                          >
                            {rev.sizePurchased && (
                              <Typography
                                sx={{
                                  fontSize: '0.75rem',
                                  fontWeight: 600,
                                  color: 'var(--lg-muted)',
                                  background: isDark
                                    ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)'
                                    : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)',
                                  px: 1.2,
                                  py: 0.3,
                                  borderRadius: '6px',
                                }}
                              >
                                {isRTL
                                  ? `سایز: ${rev.sizePurchased}`
                                  : `Size: ${rev.sizePurchased}`}
                              </Typography>
                            )}
                            {rev.fitFeedback && (
                              <Typography
                                sx={{
                                  fontSize: '0.75rem',
                                  fontWeight: 600,
                                  color: 'var(--lg-muted)',
                                  fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',
                                }}
                              >
                                •{' '}
                                {rev.fitFeedback === 'runs_small'
                                  ? isRTL
                                    ? 'کوچک‌تر از سایز استاندارد'
                                    : 'Runs Small'
                                  : rev.fitFeedback === 'runs_large'
                                  ? isRTL
                                    ? 'بزرگ‌تر از سایز استاندارد'
                                    : 'Runs Large'
                                  : isRTL
                                  ? 'مطابق با سایز استاندارد'
                                  : 'True to Size'}
                              </Typography>
                            )}
                          </Box>
                        )}
                        {/* Title & Comment */}
                        <Typography
                          sx={{
                            fontWeight: 700,
                            fontSize: '0.9375rem',
                            color: 'var(--lg-ink)',
                            mb: 0.75,
                            fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',
                          }}
                        >
                          {rev.title}
                        </Typography>
                        <Typography
                          sx={{
                            color: 'var(--lg-muted)',
                            fontSize: '0.875rem',
                            lineHeight: 1.7,
                            fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',
                          }}
                        >
                          {rev.comment}
                        </Typography>
                        {/* Footer: Helpful button */}
                        <Box
                          sx={{
                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            justifyContent: 'flex-end',
                            mt: 2,
                            pt: 1.5,
                            borderTop: '1px solid var(--lg-card-border)',
                          }}
                        >
                          <Button
                            size="small"
                            data-testid={`helpful-btn-${rev.id}`}
                            onClick={() => handleToggleHelpful(rev.id)}
                            startIcon={<ThumbUpOutlined sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} />}
                            sx={{
                              textTransform: 'none',
                              fontSize: '0.75rem',
                              fontWeight: 600,
                              color: helpfulVotes[rev.id]
                                ? '#10b981'
                                : 'var(--lg-muted)',
                              fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',
                              '&:hover': {
                                background: 'transparent',
                                color: 'var(--lg-ink)',
                              },
                            }}
                          >
                            {isRTL
                              ? `مفید بود (${toFarsiDigits(rev.helpfulCount)})`
                              : `Helpful (${rev.helpfulCount})`}
                          </Button>
                        </Box>
                      </Box>
                    </Grid>
                  ))}
                </Grid>
              </Box>
            )}
          </Box>
          )}
          {/* Similar Products Section */}
          {similarProducts.length > 0 && (
            <Box sx={{ mt: { xs: 6, md: 8 } }}>
              <Box
                dir={isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}
                sx={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'space-between',
                  flexDirection: 'row',
                  mb: 3.5,
                  width: '100%',
                }}
              >
                <Typography
                  variant="h5"
                  component="h2"
                  sx={{
                    fontWeight: 800,
                    fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',
                    color: 'var(--lg-ink)',
                    textAlign: isRTL ? 'right' : 'left',
                  }}
                >
                  {isRTL ? 'پیشنهادهای مشابه' : 'You May Also Like'}
                </Typography>
                <Button
                  component={RouterLink}
                  to={CUSTOMER_ROUTES.HOME}
                  endIcon={
                    isRTL ? (
                      <ArrowBack sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                    ) : (
                      <ArrowForward sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                    )
                  }
                  sx={{
                    textTransform: 'none',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    fontSize: '0.875rem',
                    color: 'var(--lg-muted)',
                    fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',
                    '&:hover': {
                      background: 'transparent',
                      color: 'var(--lg-ink)',
                    },
                  }}
                >
                  {isRTL ? 'مشاهده همه' : 'View All'}
                </Button>
              </Box>
              <Grid container spacing={{ xs: 2, sm: 2.5, md: 3 }}>
                {similarProducts.map((simProd) => (
                  <Grid key={simProd.id} size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 4, lg: 3 }}>
                    <CustomersProductCard
                      appearance="glass"
                      product={simProd}
                      onCardClick={() => {
                        navigate(getCustomerProductDetailsRoute(simProd.id));
                      }}
                      onAddToCart={(prod) => {
                        const firstInfo = prod.productInfos?.[0];
                        const sp = prod.sellerProducts?.find(
                          (s) =>
                            (s.productInfoId === firstInfo?.id ||
                              s.productInfo?.id === firstInfo?.id) &&
                            s.seller &&
                            s.stockQuantity > 0
                        );
                        if (firstInfo && sp && sp.seller) {
                          const unitPrice =
                            sp.discount > 0
                              ? sp.price - (sp.price * sp.discount) / 100
                              : sp.price;
                          addItem({
                            productId: prod.id.toString(),
                            productName: prod.name,
                            productImage: firstInfo.images?.[0] || null,
                            quantity: 1,
                            unitPrice,
                            color: serializeVariantColorHexes(firstInfo.colors),
                            size: firstInfo.size || null,
                            sellerId: sp.seller.id.toString(),
                            sellerName: sp.seller.storeName || '',
                            sellerShippingFee: sp.seller.shippingFee || 0,
                            productInfoId: firstInfo.id.toString(),
                            sellerProductId: sp.id.toString(),
                            availableStock: sp.stockQuantity,
                          });
                          setSnackbarOpen(true);
                        } else {
                          navigate(getCustomerProductDetailsRoute(prod.id));
                        }
                      }}
                    />
                  </Grid>
                ))}
              </Grid>
            </Box>
          )}
        </Box>
        {/* Fullscreen / High-Res Lightbox Zoom Dialog */}
        <Dialog
          open={lightboxOpen}
          onClose={() => {
            setLightboxOpen(false);
            setLightboxZoom(1);
          }}
          maxWidth="lg"
          fullWidth
          dir={isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}
          PaperProps={{
            sx: {
              borderRadius: '28px',
              p: { xs: 2, sm: 3 },
              backdropFilter: 'blur(32px)',
              background: isDark
                ? 'rgba(15, 17, 23, 0.96)'
                : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98)',
              border: '1px solid var(--lg-card-border)',
              boxShadow: '0 30px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',
            },
          }}
        >
          {/* Header Bar */}
          <Box
            sx={{
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              pb: 2,
              borderBottom: '1px solid var(--lg-card-border)',
            }}
          >
            <Box>
              <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: '1.1rem', color: 'var(--lg-ink)', fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit' }}>
                {product.name}
              </Typography>
              <Typography
                variant="caption"
                sx={{ color: 'var(--lg-muted)', fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit' }}
              >
                {isRTL
                  ? `تصویر ${toFarsiDigits(activeImageIndex + 1)} از ${toFarsiDigits(galleryImages.length)}`
                  : `Image ${activeImageIndex + 1} of ${galleryImages.length}`}
              </Typography>
            </Box>
            {/* Lightbox Controls */}
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
              {/* Reset button */}
              {lightboxZoom > 1 && (
                <Tooltip title={isRTL ? 'اندازه اولیه' : 'Reset'} arrow>
                  <IconButton
                    size="small"
                    aria-label={isRTL ? 'اندازه اولیه' : 'Reset'}
                    onClick={handleResetLightbox}
                    className="lg-icon"
                    sx={{ width: 36, height: 36, color: 'var(--lg-ink)' }}
                  >
                    <RestartAlt fontSize="small" />
                  </IconButton>
                </Tooltip>
              )}
              <Tooltip title={isRTL ? 'بزرگ‌نمایی' : 'Zoom In'} arrow>
                <IconButton
                  size="small"
                  aria-label={isRTL ? 'بزرگ‌نمایی' : 'Zoom In'}
                  onClick={() => setLightboxZoom((z) => Math.min(3, +(z + 0.5).toFixed(1)))}
                  className="lg-icon"
                  sx={{ width: 36, height: 36, color: 'var(--lg-ink)' }}
                >
                  <ZoomIn fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
              </Tooltip>
              <Tooltip title={isRTL ? 'کوچک‌نمایی' : 'Zoom Out'} arrow>
                <IconButton
                  size="small"
                  aria-label={isRTL ? 'کوچک‌نمایی' : 'Zoom Out'}
                  onClick={() =>
                    setLightboxZoom((z) => {
                      const next = Math.max(1, +(z - 0.5).toFixed(1));
                      if (next === 1) setLightboxPan({ x: 0, y: 0 });
                      return next;
                    })
                  }
                  className="lg-icon"
                  sx={{ width: 36, height: 36, color: 'var(--lg-ink)' }}
                >
                  <ZoomOut fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
              </Tooltip>
              <Tooltip title={isRTL ? 'بستن' : 'Close'} arrow>
                <IconButton
                  size="small"
                  aria-label={isRTL ? 'بستن' : 'Close'}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setLightboxOpen(false);
                    handleResetLightbox();
                  }}
                  className="lg-icon"
                  sx={{ width: 36, height: 36, color: 'var(--lg-ink)' }}
                >
                  <Close fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
              </Tooltip>
            </Box>
          </Box>
          {/* Large Image Stage */}
          <Box
            onMouseDown={handleLightboxMouseDown}
            onMouseMove={handleLightboxMouseMove}
            onMouseUp={handleLightboxMouseUp}
            onMouseLeave={handleLightboxMouseUp}
            onTouchStart={handleLightboxTouchStart}
            onTouchMove={handleLightboxTouchMove}
            onTouchEnd={handleLightboxTouchEnd}
            sx={{
              position: 'relative',
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              minHeight: { xs: 320, sm: 460, md: 540 },
              maxHeight: '68vh',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              py: 2,
              cursor:
                lightboxZoom > 1
                  ? isLightboxDragging
                    ? 'grabbing'
                    : 'grab'
                  : 'default',
              userSelect: 'none',
              touchAction: lightboxZoom > 1 ? 'none' : 'auto',
            }}
          >
            {/* Prev Image */}
            {galleryImages.length > 1 && (
              <IconButton
                onClick={handlePrevImage}
                aria-label="previous image"
                className="lg-icon"
                style={{ left: 12 }}
                sx={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '50%',
                  transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                  zIndex: 10,
                  width: 44,
                  height: 44,
                  color: 'var(--lg-ink)',
                }}
              >
                <ChevronLeft />
              </IconButton>
            )}
            {/* Image with zoom level and pan translation */}
            <Box
              component="img"
              src={activeMainImage}
              alt={product.name}
              draggable={false}
              sx={{
                maxWidth: '100%',
                maxHeight: '64vh',
                objectFit: 'contain',
                transform: `translate(${lightboxPan.x}px, ${lightboxPan.y}px) scale(${lightboxZoom})`,
                transformOrigin: 'center center',
                transition: isLightboxDragging ? 'none' : 'transform 0.22s ease-out',
                userSelect: 'none',
                pointerEvents: 'none',
              }}
            />
            {/* Next Image */}
            {galleryImages.length > 1 && (
              <IconButton
                onClick={handleNextImage}
                aria-label="next image"
                className="lg-icon"
                style={{ right: 12 }}
                sx={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '50%',
                  transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                  zIndex: 10,
                  width: 44,
                  height: 44,
                  color: 'var(--lg-ink)',
                }}
              >
                <ChevronRight />
              </IconButton>
            )}
            {/* Pan guide hint when zoomed */}
            {lightboxZoom > 1 && (
              <Box
                className="lg-pill"
                sx={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  bottom: 14,
                  left: '50%',
                  transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
                  zIndex: 9,
                  px: 2,
                  py: 0.6,
                  pointerEvents: 'none',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 0.8,
                }}
              >
                <Typography
                  sx={{
                    fontSize: '0.75rem',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    color: 'var(--lg-ink)',
                    fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',
                  }}
                >
                  {isRTL
                    ? 'برای جابجایی تصویر کلیک کنید و بکشید'
                    : 'Click & drag to pan around image'}
                </Typography>
              </Box>
            )}
          </Box>
          {/* Modal Thumbnail Strip */}
          {galleryImages.length > 1 && (
            <Box
              sx={{
                display: 'flex',
                gap: 1.5,
                justifyContent: 'center',
                pt: 2,
                overflowX: 'auto',
              }}
            >
              {galleryImages.map((img, idx) => (
                <Box
                  key={`modal-thumb-${idx}`}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setActiveImageIndex(idx);
                    setLightboxZoom(1);
                  }}
                  className={idx === activeImageIndex ? undefined : 'lg-card'}
                  sx={{
                    width: 56,
                    height: 56,
                    borderRadius: '12px',
                    p: 0.5,
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    boxShadow:
                      idx === activeImageIndex
                        ? '0 0 0 2px var(--lg-ring-offset), 0 0 0 4px var(--lg-ring)'
                        : 'none',
                    background:
                      idx === activeImageIndex
                        ? 'var(--lg-card-bg)'
                        : undefined,
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
                    opacity: idx === activeImageIndex ? 1 : 0.65,
                    '&:hover': { opacity: 1 },
                  }}
                >
                  <Box
                    component="img"
                    src={img}
                    alt=""
                    sx={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'contain' }}
                  />
                </Box>
              ))}
            </Box>
          )}
        </Dialog>
        {/* Write a Review Modal */}
        <Dialog
          open={reviewModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setReviewModalOpen(false)}
          maxWidth="sm"
          fullWidth
          dir={isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}
          PaperProps={{
            sx: {
              borderRadius: '24px',
              p: { xs: 2.5, sm: 3.5 },
              backdropFilter: 'blur(32px)',
              background: isDark
                ? 'rgba(15, 17, 23, 0.96)'
                : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98)',
              border: '1px solid var(--lg-card-border)',
              boxShadow: '0 30px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
              fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',
            },
          }}
        >
          <Box
            component="form"
            onSubmit={handleSubmitReview}
            sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2.5 }}
          >
            {/* Header */}
            <Box
              sx={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                pb: 1.5,
                borderBottom: '1px solid var(--lg-card-border)',
              }}
            >
              <Box>
                <Typography
                  sx={{
                    fontWeight: 800,
                    fontSize: '1.125rem',
                    color: 'var(--lg-ink)',
                    fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',
                  }}
                >
                  {isRTL ? 'ثبت دیدگاه خریدار' : 'Write a Product Review'}
                </Typography>
                <Typography
                  variant="caption"
                  sx={{
                    color: 'var(--lg-muted)',
                    fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',
                  }}
                >
                  {product.name}
                </Typography>
              </Box>
              <IconButton
                size="small"
                onClick={() => setReviewModalOpen(false)}
                sx={{ color: 'var(--lg-muted)' }}
                aria-label={isRTL ? 'بستن' : 'Close'}
              >
                <Close fontSize="small" />
              </IconButton>
            </Box>
            {/* Rating Input */}
            <Box>
              <Typography
                sx={{
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  fontSize: '0.875rem',
                  color: 'var(--lg-ink)',
                  mb: 1,
                  fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',
                }}
              >
                {isRTL ? 'امتیاز کلی شما' : 'Overall Rating'} *
              </Typography>
              <Rating
                name="user-product-rating"
                value={newRating}
                onChange={(_, val) => {
                  if (val) setNewRating(val);
                }}
                size="large"
                sx={{
                  color: '#c9a774',
                  fontSize: '2rem',
                  '& .MuiRating-iconEmpty': {
                    color: isDark
                      ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)'
                      : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)',
                  },
                }}
              />
            </Box>
            {/* Fit Feedback Selector */}
            <Box>
              <Typography
                sx={{
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  fontSize: '0.875rem',
                  color: 'var(--lg-ink)',
                  mb: 1,
                  fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',
                }}
              >
                {isRTL ? 'نحوه قرارگیری روی بدن (قواره)' : 'Fit Assessment'}
              </Typography>
              <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 1, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                {[
                  {
                    id: 'runs_small',
                    en: 'Runs Small',
                    fa: 'کوچک‌تر از سایز',
                  },
                  {
                    id: 'true_to_size',
                    en: 'True to Size',
                    fa: 'مطابق سایز استاندارد',
                  },
                  {
                    id: 'runs_large',
                    en: 'Runs Large',
                    fa: 'بزرگ‌تر از سایز',
                  },
                ].map((fitOpt) => {
                  const isSelected = newFitFeedback === fitOpt.id;
                  return (
                    <Button
                      key={fitOpt.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() =>
                        setNewFitFeedback(
                          fitOpt.id as
                            | 'runs_small'
                            | 'true_to_size'
                            | 'runs_large'
                        )
                      }
                      sx={{
                        borderRadius: '9999px',
                        px: 2,
                        py: 0.5,
                        fontSize: '0.8125rem',
                        fontWeight: 600,
                        textTransform: 'none',
                        border: isSelected
                          ? '1px solid #c9a774'
                          : '1px solid var(--lg-card-border)',
                        background: isSelected
                          ? isDark
                            ? 'rgba(201, 167, 116, 0.15)'
                            : 'rgba(201, 167, 116, 0.2)'
                          : 'transparent',
                        color: isSelected ? '#c9a774' : 'var(--lg-muted)',
                        fontFamily: isRTL ? 'var(--font-sans)' : 'inherit',
                      }}
                    >
                      {isRTL ? fitOpt.fa : fitOpt.en}
                    </Button>
                  );
                })}
              </Box>
            </Box>
            {/* Author and Size Grid */}
            <Grid container spacing={2}>
              <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 8 }}>
                <TextField
                  fullWidth
                  required
                  label={isRTL ? 'نام یا نام مستعار' : 'Your Name / Handle'}
                  value={newAuthor}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewAuthor(e.target.value)}
                  variant="outlined"
                  size="small"

            sx={{

            }}
          >

              ? `${product.name} به سبد خرید افزوده شد.`
              : `${product.name} added to your cart.`}
          </Alert>
        </Snackbar>
      </Box>
    </CustomersLayout>
  );
}
